description:
Do you remember the Korean household goods brand Lucky? It was created by LuckyChemical Co., Ltd., the parent company of the global conglomerate LG Group, and has been a major provider of daily essential goods since the liberation of the country. What's even more surprising is that LG's first and much-loved brand, Lucky, began in the backyard of a family home in Busan. Busan's modern and contemporary history is thus intertwined with not only Korea's great events, but also its small ones, which makes it all the more interesting. The Busan Modern & Contemporary History Museum is a space where visitors can explore and experience Busan’s modern and contemporary history. The main building was renovated from the former Bank of Korea Busan Headquarters, a designated cultural property of the city, and opened earlier this year. The annex, which opened last year, is the former Dongyang Colonization Company and the American Cultural Center, both of which were symbols of colonialism during the Japanese occupation. These two historical buildings alone are worth a visit to the Busan Modern & Contemporary History Museum.

Vault Art Museum

The main building in particular is notable for its use of the Bank of Korea’s old facilities. For example, the underground space that once housed the bank's vaults has been transformed into the Vault Art Museum. Viewing artworks through thick iron doors and bars designed to withstand a nuclear attack is a unique experience that can only be had at the Busan Modern & Contemporary History Museum. What's more, the stylish, ever-changing lighting makes the unlit underground spaces even more secretive and mysterious. The four vaults, which have been off-limits for many years, will host the exhibition “The Original City Center, Colors of Reminiscence,” in which eight artists take a fresh look at Busan's original city center through sculpture, painting, installation, photography, and video.

Vault Art Museum

  • Address : BF1, Busan Modern & Contemporary History Museum Main Building, 112, Daecheong-ro, Jung-gu, Busan/li>
  • Operating Days & Hours : Tuesdays - Sundays 09:00~18:00
  • Closed Days : Every Monday (the next day if Monday is a public holiday)
  • Fee : Free
  • Inquiries : +82-51-607-8000

CASA BUSANO

On the first floor, where the Bank of Korea's customer lounge used to be, a café has been built that retains the original structure. It is an espresso café with an Italian flair, called CASA BUSANO. The ceiling with exposed pipes, the exotic interior, and the hip music attract visitors in. The café also makes full use of the history and story of the space. The signature menu includes “Bank of Korea Original Latte,” “Bank of Korea Original Padova ” “Bank of Korea Original Affogato,” and the “Gold Bar Cake,” a dessert inspired by gold bars. It is fun to discover that the vaulted room to the left of the café has been transformed into a dessert bar. Painted all yellow, the room is piled high with cakes in the shape of gold bars to delight the eyes and mouths of visitors. It's open from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. and closed on the second and fourth Sundays of the month. There is no parking, but you can use the nearby Yongdusan Public Parking Lot.

CASA BUSANO

  • Address : 1F, 112, Daecheong-ro, Jung-gu, Busan
  • Operating Days & Hours : Monday - Sunday 09:00~21:00
  • Closed Days : 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Monday of every month
  • Homepage : https://www.instagram.com/casabusano/
  • Inquiries : +82-507-1339-6349

Open Cultural Space

Another vault, to the right of CASA BUSANO, has been converted into the 'Bank of Korea Archive Room'. Here you can learn about the history of the Busan Branch of the Bank of Korea and the history of the Bank of Korea's currency issuance through various historical materials. You can see the paper money issued by the Bank of Korea in the early 1900s and the first Bank of Korea banknotes produced in Japan. The souvenir shop is located behind the information desk on the first floor. You can buy a variety of products to commemorate your trip to Busan, from simple souvenirs such as stickers, postcards, and stationery, to Busan-themed coffee and alcoholic drinks, and Busan's specialty, Gijang seaweed. Also popular are key chains and mugs featuring characters from the Busan Modern & Contemporary History Museum. In addition, the first floor has a variety of facilities, including a “Citizen's Convenience Facility” where you can take a break or get information about traveling in Busan, as well as a diaper changing room, a nursing room, and lockers. From the floor in front of the information desk, different colored lines indicate the location of each facility so you can follow them.

Open Cultural Space

  • Address : 1F, Busan Modern & Contemporary History Museum Main Building, 112, Daecheong-ro, Jung-gu, Busan
  • Operating Days & Hours : Tuesdays - Sundays 09:00~18:00
  • Closed Days : Every Monday (the next day if Monday is a public holiday)
  • Fee : Free of charge
  • Inquiries : +82-51-607-8000

Special Exhibition & Permanent Exhibition Halls

The second floor is a special exhibition hall and the third and fourth floors are permanent exhibition halls. In particular, the permanent exhibition rooms present content that reveals the history of Busan as the first port of call and the identity of Busan as a maritime capital. The first permanent exhibition room, located on the third floor, shows the time and space of Busan as it has changed since the opening of the port, from different perspectives depending on time, place, and events, under the theme of "Modern City of Busan". The modern history of Busan, the opening port city, unfolds like a movie, including the appearance of Busan where trams used to run, various objects reflecting life at that time, the changing history of Busan Port, and Busan's independence movement. The second permanent exhibition room on the 4th floor is themed 'Modern City Busan' and captures the changes that have taken place in Busan since the liberation of the country. Visitors can experience the modern history of Busan as experienced by our parents' generation, including Busan as a city for refugees, Busan in the era of industrialization symbolized by Madoros, and Busan as a hotbed of pro-democracy movements such as the April 19 Revolution and the Buma Democratic Uprising.

Special Exhibition & Permanent Exhibition Halls

  • Address : 2F, 3F, 4F, Busan Modern & Contemporary History Museum Main Building
  • Operating Days & Hours : Tuesdays - Sundays 09:00~18:00
  • Closed Days : Every Monday (the next day if Monday is a public holiday)
  • Fee : Free of charge
  • Inquiries : +82-51-607-8000

Children’s Experience Center

The Children's Experience Center, 'Deullaknallak', is located on the M2 floor on the east side of the main building near the Yongdusan Public Parking Lot. It offers a variety of educational and playful content such as reading, hands-on activities and English learning for children aged 5 to 8. In particular, the experience center based on Busan's modern and contemporary history, such as 'Dreaming Busan Port' where children can drive a boat, 'Epi's House' where they can try on old clothes, and 'Market Play' where they can make Gupo noodles and rice soup, provide a unique experience for children and parents alike. The center is open seven days a week from 9.30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. for 50 minutes per session and is closed on Mondays. It can only be used by booking in advance through the Busan Metropolitan Government's integrated reservation website.

Children’s Experience Center

  • Address : M2F, Busan Modern & Contemporary History Museum Main Building, 112, Daecheong-ro, Jung-gu, Busan

  • Closed Days : Every Monday (the next day if Monday is a public holiday)

  • No. of participants : Up to 30 people per session (children and parents) *Children are not allowed to enter alone (must be accompanied by a parent or guardian)
  • Note on Reservation : Only one session is available per person per day Same-day online reservation is not possible (online reservation available up to 2 days before the session) Walk-ins will be accepted only when it’s available (walk-ins may not be available if the sessions are fully booked).

desc_l10n.en:
Are you tired of the hustle and bustle of everyday life and have you shut out valuable thoughts?
On those days when you can't help but think, Mousai is the perfect place to give you food for thought.
Mousai is an independent bookstore and movie theater in Buk-gu, Busan, which stocks many independent books and art films. It also actively organizes cultural events such as reading groups and art education, fulfilling its role as a cultural complex in the neighborhood.
The name comes from Mousai, the goddess of art and learning in Greek mythology, and means 'to contemplate' in Greek, which is fitting for a space that stimulates thought with its many thought-provoking books, films and artistic gatherings.
As you walk in, you'll be greeted by a beautiful display of zero-waste products. The products are full of Mousai's own personality and show the "Mousai”-ness that makes you think twice about the environment. Just past the zero-waste stalls is a café where you can soak up the atmosphere over a drink - not just coffee and juice, but also beer and wine too. It's perfect for those who want to soak up the atmosphere of books and movies over a drink. 
There is also a theater in Mousai that shows independent films. It regularly shows independent short films that have unfortunately missed out on theatrical release, and in addition to regular screenings, it also shows a number of good films through special screenings. It's always open, even when it's not showing movies, so you can always drop in for a good read after buying a book.
The theater can also be rented for community cultural activities. In addition to the theater you can also rent community meeting room!
Whether you want to reacquaint yourself with books and moviesaven't seen in a while, or build a cultural community with friends and like-minded people, Mousai, an inspiring independent bookstore and movie theater, is the place to be!
desc_l10n.ja:
枯れた日常に疲れ、意味のあることについて考えられなくなったと思う時って、ありますよね？
そういう虚しさを感じた時は、考えるきっかけを作ってくれるスペース「ムサイ」がおすすめです。
ムサイは、多くの独立系出版社の本とインディーズ映画を保有する釜山北区の独立系書店でありミニシアターです。読書会やアート教育などの文化イベントも積極的に行っており、北区の文化・芸術複合施設としての役割を果たしています。
「ムサイ」は、ギリシャ神話に登場する芸術と学問の女神ムサの複数形ムサイに由来します。本来、ギリシャ語で「思いに耽る」という意味もあり、真摯なテーマの本や映画、アート関連のコミュニティを通じて色々なことを考えさせられる場所にぴったりの名前です。
入口に入ると、きれいに陳列されたゼロ・ウェイスト商品が目に飛び込んできます。ムサイの個性が感じられるこれらの商品は、環境について改めて考えさせられる「ムサイ」ならではの一面を垣間見ることができます。ゼロ・ウェイストコーナーの次は、ドリンクを飲みながら店内の雰囲気を楽しめるカフェがありますが、ここではコーヒーやジュース類だけでなく、ビールやワインも販売しています。お酒に酔いしれ、本や映画に触れて感傷に浸りたい方にはうってつけの場所です。
ムサイにはインディーズ映画を上映するシアターもあります。上映時期を逃してしまったインディーズのアートな短編映画を定期的に上映しており、定期上映以外にも、企画を通じて様々な良い作品を紹介しています。映画を上映していない時間帯でも常に開かれていて、本を購入した後に読書を楽しむときにも気軽に利用できます。
シアターは、貸館も行っていますので、文化にかかわるコミュニティ活動スペースとして活用できます。シアターはもちろん、コミュニティ向けの部屋も借りられますのでご参考になさってください！

久しぶりに本や映画に触れたい方、友人や同じ趣味を持つ人と文化・芸術コミュニティをつくりたい方は、素敵なインスピレーションを与えてくれる独立系書店&映画館ムサイにぜひ足を運んでみてください！
desc_l10n.ko:
각박한 일상에 지쳐 가치 있는 생각을 멀리하지는 않았나요? 
문득 그런 의문이 드는 날에 여러분에게 좋은 생각거리를 물어다 줄 공간, 무사이를 소개합니다.

무사이는 많은 독립서적과 독립 예술영화를 보유하고 있는 부산 북구의 독립서점이자 영화관입니다. 독서 모임이나 예술교육 등 문화행사도 적극적으로 운영하며 북구의 문화예술 복합공간으로서 역할을 다하고 있습니다.
‘무사이’는 그리스 신화에 나오는 예술과 학문의 여신, 무사이에서 따온 이름으로, 그리스어로 ‘생각에 잠기다’는 뜻을 가진다고 합니다. 여러 진중한 서적과 영화, 예술 모임으로 생각을 불러일으키는 공간 무사이와 잘 어울리죠.

입구에 들어서면 예쁘게 진열된 제로웨이스트 제품들이 눈에 띕니다. 무사이만의 개성을 가득 담은 제품들은 환경에 대해 한 번쯤 더 고민하게 하는 ‘무사이’스러운 면모를 보여줍니다. 제로웨이스트 매대를 지나면 음료와 함께 공간 분위기를 즐길 수 있는 카페가 등장하는데요, 커피나 주스류뿐만 아니라 맥주와 와인도 판매하고 있어 더욱 독특합니다. 취기를 빌려 책과 영화가 주는 감상에 젖고 싶은 분들에게는 최적의 구성입니다.

무사이 내에는 독립영화를 상영하는 극장도 있습니다. 아쉽게 상영 시기를 놓친 독립 예술 단편 영화를 정기적으로 상영하며, 정기 상영뿐 아니라 기획 상영을 통해 여러 좋은 영화를 소개하기도 합니다. 영화를 상영하지 않는 시간대에도 언제나 개방되어 있어, 책 구매 후 독서를 즐길 때도 언제든지 편안히 이용할 수 있습니다. 
극장은 대관을 통해 여러 문화 커뮤니티 활동 공간으로 활용할 수도 있습니다. 극장과 더불어 커뮤니티를 위해 만들어진 모임방 또한 대관 가능하니 참고하세요! 

오랜만에 책과 영화에 다가가고 싶은 분들, 또 지인이나 같은 관심사를 공유하는 사람들과 문화예술 커뮤니티를 형성하고 싶은 분들이라면 멋진 영감을 선사하는 독립서점&영화관 무사이에 꼭 방문해 보세요!
desc_l10n.zh:
您是否厌倦了冷漠的日常生活，觉得自己离有价值的思想越来越远？
在突然产生这种疑问的日子里，为您介绍能够激发深刻思考的空间——Mousai。
Mousai是釜山北区的一家独立书店兼电影院，拥有大量独立书籍和独立艺术电影。积极运营读书聚会和艺术教育等文化活动，发挥着北区文化艺术综合空间的作用。
“Mousai”取自希腊神话中的艺术和学术女神“Musai”，在希腊语中的意思是“陷入沉思”。这个名字与通过各种珍贵书籍、电影和艺术聚会唤起思考的空间“Mousai”十分相配。
一走进入口，就会见到陈列精美的零废弃产品。洋溢着Mousai独特个性的产品呈现出充满“Mousai”风格的面貌，让人们再次思考环境问题。经过零废弃柜台后，就会看到咖啡馆，可以点一杯饮料，享受咖啡馆的氛围，除了咖啡或果汁外，还出售啤酒和葡萄酒，因此更加独特。对于想借着醉意沉浸在书和电影中的人来说，堪称完美配置。
Musai还拥有放映独立电影的电影院，定期播放独立艺术短篇电影，如果您不幸错过上映时间，可以来此观影。此外，还通过策划放映活动介绍各类优秀电影。即使在不播放电影的时段也随时开放，可以在购买书籍后随时来这里享受舒适的阅读时光。
电影院还可以出租，作为各种文化社团活动空间使用。除了电影院外，专为社团打造的聚会室也供出租，敬请参考！
如果想久违地贴近书籍和电影，或者想和熟人或志同道合的人组成文化艺术社团，请一定要来为您带来出色灵感的独立书店&电影院——Mousai！

Mousai is an independent bookstore and movie theater in Buk-gu, Busan, which stocks many independent books and art films. It also actively organizes cultural events such as reading groups and art education, fulfilling its role as a cultural complex in the neighborhood.
The name comes from Mousai, the goddess of art and learning in Greek mythology, and means 'to contemplate' in Greek, which is fitting for a space that stimulates thought with its many thought-provoking books, films and artistic gatherings.
As you walk in, you'll be greeted by a beautiful display of zero-waste products. The products are full of Mousai's own personality and show the "Mousai”-ness that makes you think twice about the environment. Just past the zero-waste stalls is a café where you can soak up the atmosphere over a drink - not just coffee and juice, but also beer and wine too. It's perfect for those who want to soak up the atmosphere of books and movies over a drink. 
There is also a theater in Mousai that shows independent films. It regularly shows independent short films that have unfortunately missed out on theatrical release, and in addition to regular screenings, it also shows a number of good films through special screenings. It's always open, even when it's not showing movies, so you can always drop in for a good read after buying a book.
The theater can also be rented for community cultural activities. In addition to the theater you can also rent community meeting room!
Whether you want to reacquaint yourself with books and moviesaven't seen in a while, or build a cultural community with friends and like-minded people, Mousai, an inspiring independent bookstore and movie theater, is the place to be!
name: Mousai, a cultural complex for days when you want to get lost in thought

desc_l10n.en:
The first place that greets visitors to Busan is the Busan Travel Lounge, the refuge area for tourists in Busan. Busan Travel Lounge offers immaculately organized facilities and a suite of experience programs related to Busan. Let’s take a look at what Busan Travel Lounge is all about and what exciting programs they have in store for you!

Busan Travel Lounge

Busan Travel Lounge is a tourist cultural space that draws a large crowd of visitors thanks to its location across Busan Station. In addition to providing a much-needed rest area for travelers tired of moving, the lounge also has an information desk that details Busan’s tourist attractions, a storage room for people on foot to store their heavy luggage, and other facilities that cater to the convenience of tourists. Busan Travel Lounge also provides optimal services for all visitors to Busan, such as free meeting room rental and charging. The cute interior featuring Busan’s mascot, Boogi, and its landmark Gwangandaegyo Bridge, as well as flight departure timetables, are also a highlight of this place. The true strength of Busan Travel Lounge, however, lies in the variety of tour programs offered to the visitors every weekend.

1. Indoor One-day Classes

2. Thematic Busan Old City Center Tour Programs

3. Seasonal Busan Cultural Experiences

Let’s then take a look at what interesting programs await us!

Indoor One-day Classes

Sometimes, you end up with gaps in your schedule. If you have an hour to spare, drop by the Busan Travel Lounge and take the one-day classes there! Busan Travel Lounge offers one-day craft classes every weekend. Some of them are themed after Busan’s tourist sites, like the Busan Gwangalli Beach Cake-making and Busan Sea Mint Soap-making. In addition to cakes and soaps, the lounge offers a variety of crafting classes, including resin art, shrinkles, rattan, suncatchers, candles, knitting, coffee classes, ceramics, pop art, and more. In fact, these programs are worth setting aside some time in your schedule! The classes’ themes differ on a weekly basis, so if you're interested, be sure to check out Busan Travel Lounge's Instagram and Naver Smart Store pages before making a reservation. Note that tourists will be given priority in reservation, as the space explicitly caters to tourists!

Busan Preference Tour

One of the nicest moments in traveling is discovering a new taste for something you were unaware of before. In “Busan Preference Tour,” you can discover your new preferences as you explore the different parts of the city! Busan Travel Lounge offers seasonal tours that are themed after the different spaces in Busan and the preferences one can pursue in the city.

Preference for Film Cameras: Record Your Busan

For instance, “Preference for Film Cameras: Record Your Busan” program introduces you to the analog aesthetics of film cameras in the equally analog spaces of Busan’s old city center and its alleyways. The tour has two routes corresponding to the Dong-gu and Jung-gu Districts of the city. Both routes bring to life the charms of the two spaces, so you can take some really nice pictures in the program. Even if you are not familiar with film camera photography, don’t worry; the program includes a disposable film camera with more than 24 shots available and a simple tutorial for using film cameras.

Start from Busan Travel Lounge – Chinatown Street (Texas Street) – (former) Baekje Hospital – 168 Stairs – Ibagu Skyway Observatory

The Dong-gu Route starts at Busan Station, the heart of Busan’s transit system, and begins with a multicultural experience at Busan’s Chinatown. Then, the tour brings you to Ibagu-gil Road, which exemplifies Busan’s modern and contemporary history, leading to a panoramic view of Busan Port. How’s that for a thorough tour of Dong-gu District’s scenery and culture? Get your camera ready because you will be taking a lot of pictures on the tour!

Start from Busan Tourist Information Center – Yeongdodaegyo Wharf – Yongdusan Park – Gukje Market – Bosu Book Street

In the Jung-gu Route, you will explore the unique spots that speak to the lives of the people of Busan, such as the Yeongdodaegyo Wharf, Yongdusan Park, Gukje Market, and Bosu Book Street. As you record the alleyways and historic sites, which have witnessed the city’s growth, with a film camera, you will find that you have grown much closer to Busan. The Preference Tour offers different thematic tours according to the season, so make sure to follow the Busan Travel Lounge Instagram account and the Naver Smart Store page for updates. Alternatively, just jump into the first Preference Tour you encounter during your trip in Busan and discover a new taste for yourself!

Busan Old City Center Trekking Snap Tour

Trekking and snapshots at the same time! In the Busan Old City Center Trekking Snap Tour, you walk the city with a snap photography expert to discover the hidden alleyways of this charming city and record your visit through pictures. Because these tours are overseen by experts, you are sure to get a quality picture for your album. What’s more, you will get your pictures in both original and edited versions! This tour is likewise divided into two routes, one in the Jung-gu District and the other in the Nam-gu District. The itinerary and the sites you visit are identical to those in the Preference Tour, so refer to the information on Busan Preference Tours for more information!

Start from Busan Travel Lounge – Chinatown Street (Texas Street) – (former) Baekje Hospital – 168 Stairs – Ibagu Skyway Observatory

Start from Busan Tourist Information Center – Yeongdodaegyo Wharf – Yongdusan Park – Gukje Market – Bosu Book Street

One of the best sceneries in the scenic old city center of Busan can be found at the Sanbok Road. If you want to build a healthy body and an imaginative mind at the same time, sign up for this tour!

Dong-gu Route

Jung-gu Route

Seasonal Busan Cultural Experiences

Once you’ve toured the major tourist sites of Busan, it’s time to experience the life of Busan citizens. The Busan Travel Lounge operates a program where you can discover the culture of Busan citizens by season and experience the culture by living as a Busan citizen for a day. Go to a baseball game and sing and cheer with the crowd in the “Baseball Culture Experience” or take part in the “Yacht Tour” for a dynamic experience of Busan’s seas. Many “Seasonal Busan Cultural Experiences” await you in the future as well, so look forward to it! Busan Travel Lounge information: Go to
desc_l10n.ja:
釜山で最初に観光客を迎えてくれる場所は旅人の憩いの場「トラベルラウンジ」です。 便利な設備が備わっている釜山トラベルラウンジでは、旅行者が釜山に関する様々な体験が楽しめるよう、多様なプログラムが運営されています。釜山トラベルラウンジがどんなところなのか、どんな面白いプログラムを用意しているのか、一つ一つ見てみましょう。

釜山トラベルラウンジ

釜山駅の向かい側にある釜山トラベルラウンジは、多くの観光客が訪れる文化・観光の複合施設です。移動に疲れた旅行者に必要な休憩スペースがあり、釜山の観光スポットに関する情報を提供するインフォメーションセンターや、徒歩旅行で邪魔になる重い荷物を預けられる手荷物預かり所など、旅行の利便性を向上するため、最大限のサービスを提供しています。また、会議室の無料レンタル、充電サービスなど、様々な目的で釜山を訪れた人々にきめ細やかなサービスを提供しています。釜山のマスコットキャラクターのプギや飛行機のフライト情報、ランドマークの広安大橋などを活用したキュートなインテリアもポイントです。 ですが、釜山トラベルラウンジの本当の強みは、旅行者のための多彩な観光プログラムにあります。 毎週週末、釜山トラベルラウンジでは様々なプログラムが行われています。

1.室内で楽しむワンデークラス

2.テーマ別釜山旧都心ツアープログラム

3.季節別釜山文化体験

それでは！これらのプログラムの特徴や面白さについて詳しく見ていきましょう！

室内で楽しむワンデークラス

旅行を始める前、あるいは帰国の前、中途半端に時間が余ることって、ありますよね？ 1時間あれば十分です。悩まずに釜山トラベルラウンジのワンデークラスで、余った時間を有効活用しましょう！ 釜山トラベルラウンジでは、毎週末、手作りワンデークラスが開催されます。 中でも、釜山広安里海ケーキづくり、釜山海ミント石けんづくりのように、釜山旅行の記念となる手作りクラスもあり、特別感が味わえます。ケーキと石けん以外にも、shrinkles、ラタン、キャンドル、編み物を使った工芸品、レジンアート、サンキャッチャーづくり、コーヒー体験、陶芸、ポップアートなど、様々な手作りが体験できるクラスを運営しています。 ワンデークラスを目的にわざわざ訪問したくなるほどの充実ぶりです。 毎週クラスのテーマが変わりますので、興味のある方はぜひ釜山トラベルラウンジのInstagramやスマートストアで事前に確認し、予約してください。旅行者のためのスペースで、釜山市民より旅行者を優先してお申込を受け付けますので、参考にしてください！

旧都心ツアープログラム

釜山の旧都心に触れてみましょう！

釜山で自分の趣味を見つけるツアー

旅の醍醐味は、自分でも気づかなかった自分の趣味を発見する瞬間にあるのではないでしょうか？ 「釜山で自分の趣味を見つけるツアー」は、釜山のあちこちを探訪し、自分の趣味に出会うツアープログラムです。 釜山トラベルラウンジは釜山の様々な場所と釜山で追求できる趣味をテーマに、珍しいツアーを季節ごとに企画しています。

フィルムカメラの趣味を活かした釜山での記録

釜山の旧都心で行われる「フィルムカメラの趣味を活かした釜山での記録」は、アナログ趣味を持つ人たちと一緒に釜山の旧都心の路地をフィルムカメラで記録するウォーキングツアーです。釜山旧都心を代表する東区と中区にコースが分かれていますが、各コースの魅力がはっきりしていて、特色ある写真を撮ることができます。 24枚以上が入った使い捨てフィルムカメラと、フィルムカメラの使い方について簡単な教育も受けられるため、フィルムカメラをあまり知らない方でも気軽に参加することができます。

東区コース

釜山トラベルラウンジで集合–チャイナタウン通り(テキサス通り)–(旧)百済病院–168階段–イバグ展望台

釜山の交通の中心地である釜山駅からスタートする東区コースでは、エキゾチックなチャイナタウンの文化を体験し、釜山近現代史のエッセンスが詰まったイバグキルで釜山港が一望できる景色を鑑賞します。釜山東区ならではの風景と文化の魅力を存分に楽しむことができます。ツアーでは、夢中になってカメラのシャッターを切ること間違いなしです！

中区コース

釜山総合観光案内所で集合–影島大橋船着き場–龍頭山公園–国際市場 –宝水洞本屋通り

中区コースでは、影島大橋船着き場、龍頭山公園、国際市場、宝水洞本屋通りなど、釜山の人々の暮らしに触れることができる特色あふれるスポットをすべて巡ります。釜山の歴史と文化が詰まった場所、時代の痕跡が残っている路地をフィルムカメラで記録していると、いつの間にか釜山がもっと身近に感じられるはずです。 自分の趣味を見つけるツアーのテーマも季節によって変わりますので、やはり釜山トラベルラウンジのInstagramとスマートストアをしっかりチェックし、自分にぴったりのツアーを楽しんでください。ですが、釜山旅行の日程の中でふらっとツアーに参加してみたら、自分の趣味が偶然見つかったという驚きの出会いがあるかもしれません。

釜山旧都心でのシティーウォーク＆スナップショット・ツアー

シティーウォークとスナップショット・ツアーを同時に！ 釜山旧都心でのシティーウォーク＆スナップショット・ツアーは、プロのカメラマンと一緒に釜山の様々な場所を歩きながら、観光客自ら隠れた釜山の路地を写真に残せるツアーです。プロが同行するので、指導を受けながらお気に入りの写真を撮影するなど、特別な体験ができます。撮影した写真は、オリジナル本と補正本の両方を一緒に送ってもらえます。このツアーも中区コースと南区コースに分かれています。コースの詳細な場所と内容は、「釜山で自分の趣味を見つけるツアー」と同じですので、参考にしてください！

東区コース

釜山トラベルラウンジで集合–チャイナタウン通り(テキサス通り)–(旧)百済病院–168階段–イバグ展望台

中区コース

釜山総合観光案内所で集合–影島大橋船着き場–龍頭山公園–国際市場–宝水洞本屋通り

釜山の旧都心は山腹道路の景色が美しいことでも広く知られています。旧都心のあちこちを回って、丈夫な体と感性豊かな心を養いたい方に一押しのツアーです！

釜山トラベルラウンジでのミッションナイトツアー

釜山旅行に夜景は欠かせません。 夜景スポットを見て、写真撮影のミッションを完遂する楽しみも味わえる「釜山トラベルラウンジミッションナイトツアー」をご紹介します。 釜山トラベルラウンジミッションナイトツアーも旧都心の中区と東区コースに分かれています。

東区コース

釜山トラベルラウンジで集合–チャイナタウン通り(テキサス通り)–(旧)百済病院–168階段–イバグ展望台

中区コース

釜山総合観光案内所で集合–影島大橋船着き場–龍頭山公園–国際市場–宝水洞本屋通り

各コースの集合場所に集まった参加者には「SNS宝探しミッション」が与えられます。スマートフォンによる夜の撮影と補正のノウハウについて簡単なレッスンを受けた参加者は、各コースのツアーを回って直接撮った「宝石のような釜山の夜景」の写真をInstagram#見つけた宝物、#釜山の夜景をハッシュタグを付けて投稿します。写真をアップした参加者のうち、ハッシュタグ推薦に掲載された方には、使い捨てフィルムカメラをプレゼントするキャンペーンも実施中です。 釜山の夜景に出会えるチャンスとエキサイティングな写真のミッションツアー！美しい夜景をスマートフォンのカメラできれいに撮りたいと前から思っていた方には、とくに満足していただけるのではないでしょうか？

季節別釜山文化体験

釜山の観光スポットを回った後は、釜山市民の文化を体験する番です。 釜山トラベルラウンジでは、季節ごとに釜山市民の文化を発掘し、一日「釜山市民」として過ごし、文化を体験してみるプログラムを運営しています。野球の応援歌やスローガン、応援方法を学んで釜山野球を観戦することで、情熱あふれる釜山の野球応援文化の魅力にどっぷりハマる「野球文化体験」、釜山の海を生き生きと体験できる「ヨットツアー」などもあります。その他にも、これから釜山文化体験が季節ごとに新しく運営される予定ですので、ぜひご期待ください！ 釜山トラベルラウンジに関する情報： 詳しくはこちら
desc_l10n.ko:
타지에서 온 여행객을 가장 먼저 반기는 곳, 바로 여행자들의 쉼터 '트래블라운지'인데요. 부산트래블라운지는 정돈된 시설에 더해 여행객들이 부산과 관련된 다양한 체험을 즐길 수 있도록 여러 프로그램을 운영 중입니다. 부산 트래블라운지가 어떤 곳인지, 또 어떤 흥미로운 프로그램을 준비했는지 함께 살펴볼까요?

부산 트래블라운지

부산 트래블라운지는 부산역 맞은편에 위치해 많은 여행객이 찾는 관광문화복합공간입니다. 이동으로 지친 여행객들에게 꼭 필요한 휴식공간은 물론이고, 부산 여행지 정보를 제공하는 데스크, 뚜벅이 여행에 큰 걸림돌이 되는 무거운 짐을 맡기는 보관소 등 여행을 위한 편의를 최대한으로 갖추고 있습니다. 또 무료 회의실 대관, 충전 등 다양한 목적으로 부산에 온 모든 분에게 최선의 서비스를 제공합니다. 부산 마스코트 부기나 비행기 출발시간표, 랜드마크 광안대교 등을 활용한 귀여운 인테리어도 포인트입니다. 그러나 부산 트래블라운지의 진짜 강점은 여행객들을 위한 다채로운 관광 프로그램에 있죠. 매주 주말 부산트래블라운지에서는 다양한 프로그램을 운영중입니다.

1. 실내에서 즐기는 원데이 클래스

2. 테마별 부산 원도심 투어 프로그램

3. 시즌별 부산문화체험

어떤 재밌는 프로그램들인지 이제부터 하나하나 자세히 알아보자구요!

실내에서 즐기는 원데이 클래스

여행 출발 전, 혹은 돌아가기 전 애매하게 시간이 남을 때가 있지 않나요? 1시간이면 충분합니다. 고민하지 말고 부산 트래블라운지 원데이클래스로 자투리 시간 알차게 보내봐요! 부산 트래블라운지에서는 주말마다 만들기 원데이클래스가 열립니다. 그중에는 부산 광안리 바다 케이크 만들기, 부산 바다 민트 비누 만들기처럼 부산여행을 기념하는 클래스도 있어 더욱 특별합니다. 케이크와 비누 외에도 레진아트, 슈링클스, 라탄, 썬캐쳐, 캔들, 뜨개아트, 커피체험, 도자기, 팝아트 등 다양한 만들기 클래스를 운영 중입니다. 일부러 시간을 비워서라도 찾아가고 싶을 정도입니다. 매주 클래스 주제가 다르니 관심 있는 분들은 꼭 부산 트래블라운지 인스타그램 및 스마트스토어에서 미리 확인 후 예약하길 바랍니다. 또 여행객을 위한 공간이라 부산 시민 신청자보다 여행객 신청자를 우선하여 받고 있으니 참고해주세요!

원도심 투어 프로그램

부산의 원도심, 직접 만나 보세요!

부산 취향투어

여행의 묘미는 자신도 몰랐던 취향을 발견하는 순간에 있지 않을까요? 부산 곳곳을 탐방하며 나의 새로운 취향을 만날 수 있는 투어 프로그램, '부산 취향 투어'입니다. 부산 트래블라운지는 부산의 다양한 공간과 부산에서 추구할 수 있는 취향을 주제로 시즌별 색다른 투어를 운영 중입니다.

필카 취향으로 부산 기록하기

부산 원도심에서 진행하는 '필카 취향으로 부산 기록하기'는 아날로그틱한 취향을 가진 분들과 함께 부산 원도심 골목을 필카로 기록해보는 도보 투어입니다. 부산의 대표 원도심인 동구와 중구로 코스가 구분되어 있는데요. 각 코스의 매력이 뚜렷해 특색 있는 사진을 남길 수 있습니다. 24매 이상의 일회용 필름카메라와 함께 간단한 필름카메라 사용 교육도 제공해 필름카메라를 잘 모르는 분들도 부담 없이 참여할 수 있었습니다.

동구 코스

부산 트래블라운지 집결 – 차이나타운거리(텍사스거리) – (구)백제병원 – 168계단 – 이바구전망대

동구 코스에서는 부산 교통의 중심지 부산역에서 시작해 해외 감성 넘치는 차이나타운의 문화를 경험하고, 부산 근현대사의 정수가 담긴 이바구길에서 부산항이 한눈에 들어오는 뷰를 감상합니다. 부산 동구만의 풍경과 문화가 정말 매력적이죠? 투어에 참여한다면 누구라도 카메라 셔터를 정신없이 누르게 될 것 같네요!

중구 코스

부산 종합관광안내소 집결 – 영도대교 물양장 – 용두산공원 – 국제시장 – 보수동책방골목

중구 코스에서는 영도대교 물양장, 용두산공원, 국제시장, 보수동책방골목 등 부산사람들의 삶을 마주할 수 있는 특색 넘치는 스팟을 모두 돌아봅니다. 부산의 역사와 문화를 담은 장소, 세월의 흔적이 묻은 골목길을 필름카메라로 기록하다 보면 어느새 부산과 한층 더 가까워진 기분이 듭니다. 시즌에 따라 취향 투어의 주제도 바뀌므로, 역시 부산 트래블라운지 인스타그램과 스마트스토어를 꼼꼼히 확인해 나에게 딱 맞는 취향 투어 즐기시길 바랍니다. 혹은 부산여행 일정 중 진행하는 취향 투어에 랜덤으로 참여해 내 취향을 발굴할 기회를 얻을 수도 있겠죠?

부산 원도심 시티 트래킹 스냅투어

트래킹과 스냅사진 투어를 동시에! 부산 원도심 시티 트래킹 스냅투어는 전문 스냅작가와 함께 부산의 여러 장소를 걸으며 여행객이 진짜 숨은 부산의 골목들을 사진으로 남길 수 있도록 하는 투어입니다. 전문 스냅작가와 동행하는 만큼 퀄리티 좋은 사진을 직접 찍어볼 수 있어 더 의미가 깊습니다. 촬영한 사진은 두고두고 간직할 수 있도록 원본과 보정본을 함께 전송합니다. 해당 투어 역시 중구 코스와 남구 코스로 구분되어 있습니다. 코스 세부 장소와 내용은 부산 취향 투어와 같으니 참고해주세요!

동구 코스

부산 트래블라운지 집결 – 차이나타운거리(텍사스거리) – (구)백제병원 – 168계단 – 이바구전망대

중구 코스

부산 종합관광안내소 집결 – 영도대교 물양장 – 용두산공원 – 국제시장 – 보수동책방골목

부산 원도심은 산복도로 경치가 아름답기로도 유명하죠. 원도심 곳곳을 돌아다니며 튼튼한 신체와 감성 충만한 마음을 장착하고 싶은 분들이라면 꼭 참여해 보세요!

부산트래블라운지 미션 나이트 투어

부산여행에 야경이 빠질 순 없죠. 야경 감상과 더불어 사진 미션으로 재미까지 챙긴 '부산트래블라운지 미션 나이트 투어', 살펴볼까요? 부산트래블라운지 미션 나이트 투어 역시 부산 원도심 중구와 동구 코스로 구성되어 있는데요.

동구 코스

부산 트래블라운지 집결 – 차이나타운거리(텍사스거리) – (구)백제병원 – 168계단 – 이바구전망대

중구 코스

부산 종합관광안내소 집결 – 영도대교 물양장 – 용두산공원 – 국제시장 – 보수동책방골목

각 코스의 집결지에 모인 참여자들에게는 'SNS 보물찾기 미션'을 공유합니다. 참여자들은 간단한 야간 스마트폰 촬영과 보정 노하우를 전수받고, 각 코스별 투어를 돌며 직접 찍은 '보물 같은 부산의 야경' 사진에 인스타그램 #찾았다보물, #부산야경 해시태그를 걸어 올립니다. 사진을 업로드한 참여자 중 해시태그 추천글에 등재된 분들에게 일회용 필름카메라 경품을 제공하는 이벤트까지 진행 중입니다. 부산 야경을 만나볼 기회에 신나는 사진 미션 투어까지. 평소 아름다운 야경을 스마트폰 카메라에 멋지게 담고 싶었던 분들이라면 아주 만족도가 높을 것 같네요!

시즌별 부산문화체험

부산 명소를 돌아봤다면 이제는 부산 시민의 문화를 경험해볼 차례입니다. 부산 트래블라운지에서는 시즌별 부산 시민들의 문화를 발굴해, 그날 하루 '부산 시민'으로 살아보며 문화를 경험해보는 프로그램을 운영 중입니다. 부산 야구를 관람하고 응원가, 구호, 응원법을 배우며 열정 넘치는 부산 야구 응원 문화의 매력을 느낄 수 있는 '야구문화 체험', 부산 바다를 생동감 넘치게 체험할 수 있는 '요트 투어' 등이 있는데요. 이외 앞으로 새롭게 운영될 신선한 '시즌별 부산문화체험'도 많으니 기대해 주세요!
desc_l10n.zh:
最先迎接远道而来的外地游客的地方，是游客们的休息区“旅游中心”。 釜山旅游中心不仅设施齐全，还为游客准备了各种各样的与釜山相关的体验节目。下面就一起一探究竟，看看釜山旅游中心到底是什么地方，提供哪些有趣的节目吧！

釜山旅游中心

位于釜山站对面的釜山旅游中心，是吸引众多游客前来的旅游文化复合空间。除了为长途跋涉的游客提供休息空间之外，还具备提供釜山景点信息的前台和帮无车旅游族解放双手的行李寄存处等各种便利设施。此外还支持免费会议室租场和充电等，向来访釜山的所有人提供满足需求的全面服务。运用釜山吉祥物釜鸥、航班时刻表和釜山地标广安大桥等完成的精致可爱的装潢也是一大亮点。 要说釜山旅游中心最大优势，还得属面向游客的精彩旅游节目。 釜山旅游中心在每周末都会开展各色各样的精彩节目。

1.在室内体验的一日课程

2.不同主题的釜山老城区游览项目

3.不同季节的釜山文化体验

究竟有哪些有趣的节目，下面就一起一探究竟吧！

在室内体验的一日课程

在旅行启程或返程前，往往会有不知道该干嘛的空闲时间。 如果够一个小时的话，别犹豫啦，在釜山旅游中心体验一日课程，充实利用闲暇时间吧！ 游中心每周末都会开设手工一日课程。 尤其像制作釜山广安里海洋蛋糕、制作釜山海洋薄荷皂等具有旅行纪念意义的课程，让这里更显特别。除了蛋糕和手工皂之外，还有树脂工艺、热缩片、藤编、太阳捕手、蜡烛、针织艺术、咖啡体验、陶瓷、波普艺术等各种手工课程。 给人一种想特意腾出时间来学的冲动。 每周的课程主题不同，有兴趣的话建议通过釜山旅游中心Instagram和Smart Store提前确认后预约。因为这里是为游客打造的空间，所以优先受理游客申请，预约时请参考！

老城区游览项目

亲身体验釜山老城区！

釜山取向之旅

旅行的妙趣应该就是发现不为所知的自我取向的瞬间！ “釜山取向之旅”是通过探访釜山各处，找到合心意的新取向的游览项目。 釜山旅游中心以釜山的不同空间和不同取向为主题，按季运营独具特色的游览项目。

用胶片相机取向记录釜山

在釜山老城区进行的“用胶片相机取向记录釜山”是与偏好复古的人群一起用胶片相机记录釜山老城区街景的徒步游览项目。该项目由釜山代表性老城区东区路线和中区路线构成，无论选择哪一个，都能拍出各具魅力与特色的照片。 届时将提供能拍摄24张以上的一次性胶片相机并附上简单的使用说明，即便没用过胶片相机也能轻松参与其中。

东区路线

在釜山旅游中心集合 – 中华街（德州街） – （原）百济医院 – 168阶梯 – 故事路观景台

东区路线从釜山交通枢纽釜山站出发，接着体验充满异国风情的中华街文化，然后在蕴含釜山近现代史精髓的故事路欣赏一眼尽览的釜山港美景。釜山东区独有的风景和文化，是不是非常有魅力呢？相信参与其中的任何人，都会不由自主地狂按快门！

中区路线

在釜山综合旅游咨询处 – 影岛大桥浅水码头 – 龙头山公园 – 国际市场 – 宝水洞书店街

中区路线将游览影岛大桥浅水码头、龙头山公园、国际市场和宝水洞书店街等可以了解釜山居民生活风貌的特色景点。用胶片相机记录融入釜山历史和文化的场所和保留岁月印迹的胡同街，不知觉间会对釜山更加动情。 取向之旅的主题也因季而异，一定记得提前通过釜山旅游中心Instagram和Smart Store确认，选择并享受最适合自己的游览项目。或者也可以在釜山旅游行程中随机参与进行中的项目，说不定会有发现新取向的惊喜哦！

釜山老城区市区徒步快照之旅

徒步和快照之旅一举两得！ 釜山老城区市区徒步快照之旅是和专业快照摄影师一起徒步釜山的多个场所，发现宝藏般的釜山街景拍照的项目。因为由专业快照摄影师陪同，所以能保证拍出高品位照片。拍出来的照片原件和修图版本将一起发送给参与者，以便纪念和收藏。该项目也分中区路线和南区路线，路线详情和内容与釜山取向之旅一致，请作参考！

东区路线

在釜山旅游中心集合 – 中华街（德州街） – （原）百济医院 – 168阶梯 – 故事路观景台

中区路线

在釜山综合旅游咨询处 – 影岛大桥浅水码头 – 龙头山公园 – 国际市场 – 宝水洞书店街

釜山老城区的山腹道路以绝美的风景而闻名。想通过徒步游览老城区强身健体并填充感性，就一定不要错过哦！

釜山旅游中心夜间任务之旅

釜山之旅可不能少了夜景。 欣赏夜景的同时还要完成拍照任务的“釜山旅游中心夜间任务之旅”，听起来是不是很有趣呢？ 釜山旅游中心夜间任务之旅也由釜山老城区中区路线和东区路线构成。

东区路线

在釜山旅游中心集合 – 中华街（德州街） – （原）百济医院 – 168阶梯 – 故事路观景台

中区路线

在釜山综合旅游咨询处 – 影岛大桥浅水码头 – 龙头山公园 – 国际市场 – 宝水洞书店街

在各路线起点集合的参与者们将收到“SNS寻宝任务”，在现教现学简单的手机夜拍和修图窍门后，在各路线游览途中拍下“宝藏般的釜山夜景”照片后加上#寻宝成功#釜山夜景主题标签发布到Instagram即可。完成任务的参与者中被选入主题标签推荐帖的参与者，还将通过活动获赠一次性胶片相机。 既能欣赏釜山夜景还能参与有趣的拍照任务，如果平时怀有想用手机相机拍美丽夜景的欲望，一定会对这个项目超级满意！

不同季节的釜山文化体验

逛完釜山的著名景点，接下来轮到体验釜山市民文化了。 釜山旅游中心正在运营按季发掘釜山市民文化，并作为“釜山市民”度过一天的文化体验节目。其中有参观釜山棒球赛并学习应援歌、口号和应援方法，从而感受热情四射的釜山棒球应援文化的“棒球文化体验”和生动感受釜山大海的“快艇游”。日后还将有许多有趣新颖的“不同季节的釜山文化体验”，请多多期待！ 釜山旅游中心信息： 立即前往

description:
The first place that greets visitors to Busan is the Busan Travel Lounge, the refuge area for tourists in Busan. Busan Travel Lounge offers immaculately organized facilities and a suite of experience programs related to Busan. Let’s take a look at what Busan Travel Lounge is all about and what exciting programs they have in store for you!

Busan Travel Lounge

Busan Travel Lounge is a tourist cultural space that draws a large crowd of visitors thanks to its location across Busan Station. In addition to providing a much-needed rest area for travelers tired of moving, the lounge also has an information desk that details Busan’s tourist attractions, a storage room for people on foot to store their heavy luggage, and other facilities that cater to the convenience of tourists. Busan Travel Lounge also provides optimal services for all visitors to Busan, such as free meeting room rental and charging. The cute interior featuring Busan’s mascot, Boogi, and its landmark Gwangandaegyo Bridge, as well as flight departure timetables, are also a highlight of this place. The true strength of Busan Travel Lounge, however, lies in the variety of tour programs offered to the visitors every weekend.

1. Indoor One-day Classes

2. Thematic Busan Old City Center Tour Programs

3. Seasonal Busan Cultural Experiences

Let’s then take a look at what interesting programs await us!

Indoor One-day Classes

Sometimes, you end up with gaps in your schedule. If you have an hour to spare, drop by the Busan Travel Lounge and take the one-day classes there! Busan Travel Lounge offers one-day craft classes every weekend. Some of them are themed after Busan’s tourist sites, like the Busan Gwangalli Beach Cake-making and Busan Sea Mint Soap-making. In addition to cakes and soaps, the lounge offers a variety of crafting classes, including resin art, shrinkles, rattan, suncatchers, candles, knitting, coffee classes, ceramics, pop art, and more. In fact, these programs are worth setting aside some time in your schedule! The classes’ themes differ on a weekly basis, so if you're interested, be sure to check out Busan Travel Lounge's Instagram and Naver Smart Store pages before making a reservation. Note that tourists will be given priority in reservation, as the space explicitly caters to tourists!

Busan Preference Tour

One of the nicest moments in traveling is discovering a new taste for something you were unaware of before. In “Busan Preference Tour,” you can discover your new preferences as you explore the different parts of the city! Busan Travel Lounge offers seasonal tours that are themed after the different spaces in Busan and the preferences one can pursue in the city.

Preference for Film Cameras: Record Your Busan

For instance, “Preference for Film Cameras: Record Your Busan” program introduces you to the analog aesthetics of film cameras in the equally analog spaces of Busan’s old city center and its alleyways. The tour has two routes corresponding to the Dong-gu and Jung-gu Districts of the city. Both routes bring to life the charms of the two spaces, so you can take some really nice pictures in the program. Even if you are not familiar with film camera photography, don’t worry; the program includes a disposable film camera with more than 24 shots available and a simple tutorial for using film cameras.

Start from Busan Travel Lounge – Chinatown Street (Texas Street) – (former) Baekje Hospital – 168 Stairs – Ibagu Skyway Observatory

The Dong-gu Route starts at Busan Station, the heart of Busan’s transit system, and begins with a multicultural experience at Busan’s Chinatown. Then, the tour brings you to Ibagu-gil Road, which exemplifies Busan’s modern and contemporary history, leading to a panoramic view of Busan Port. How’s that for a thorough tour of Dong-gu District’s scenery and culture? Get your camera ready because you will be taking a lot of pictures on the tour!

Start from Busan Tourist Information Center – Yeongdodaegyo Wharf – Yongdusan Park – Gukje Market – Bosu Book Street

In the Jung-gu Route, you will explore the unique spots that speak to the lives of the people of Busan, such as the Yeongdodaegyo Wharf, Yongdusan Park, Gukje Market, and Bosu Book Street. As you record the alleyways and historic sites, which have witnessed the city’s growth, with a film camera, you will find that you have grown much closer to Busan. The Preference Tour offers different thematic tours according to the season, so make sure to follow the Busan Travel Lounge Instagram account and the Naver Smart Store page for updates. Alternatively, just jump into the first Preference Tour you encounter during your trip in Busan and discover a new taste for yourself!

Busan Old City Center Trekking Snap Tour

Trekking and snapshots at the same time! In the Busan Old City Center Trekking Snap Tour, you walk the city with a snap photography expert to discover the hidden alleyways of this charming city and record your visit through pictures. Because these tours are overseen by experts, you are sure to get a quality picture for your album. What’s more, you will get your pictures in both original and edited versions! This tour is likewise divided into two routes, one in the Jung-gu District and the other in the Nam-gu District. The itinerary and the sites you visit are identical to those in the Preference Tour, so refer to the information on Busan Preference Tours for more information!

Start from Busan Travel Lounge – Chinatown Street (Texas Street) – (former) Baekje Hospital – 168 Stairs – Ibagu Skyway Observatory

Start from Busan Tourist Information Center – Yeongdodaegyo Wharf – Yongdusan Park – Gukje Market – Bosu Book Street

One of the best sceneries in the scenic old city center of Busan can be found at the Sanbok Road. If you want to build a healthy body and an imaginative mind at the same time, sign up for this tour!

Dong-gu Route

Jung-gu Route

Seasonal Busan Cultural Experiences

Once you’ve toured the major tourist sites of Busan, it’s time to experience the life of Busan citizens. The Busan Travel Lounge operates a program where you can discover the culture of Busan citizens by season and experience the culture by living as a Busan citizen for a day. Go to a baseball game and sing and cheer with the crowd in the “Baseball Culture Experience” or take part in the “Yacht Tour” for a dynamic experience of Busan’s seas. Many “Seasonal Busan Cultural Experiences” await you in the future as well, so look forward to it! Busan Travel Lounge information: Go to

desc_l10n.en:
Spend the rest of your summer cooling off at Banyeo Chorok Park & Jangsan Valley, where kids can play with nature!
Banyeo Chorok Park is especially popular with families, offering a variety of facilities at the Banyeo Recreational Green Space, including a picnic area, a net playground, and a barefoot loess path. Both children and adults can enjoy interacting with nature. To access these facilities and the valley, you'll have to climb a fairly steep path, making it a great place for both fun and a healthy exercise.

The main attraction here is the 43-meter long roller slide, the longest in Busan, offering an exhilarating experience for children. Safety rules are clearly posted, so as long as you follow them, you can enjoy the ride safely. At the end of the slide, you'll find a net playground where toddlers can swing and play, as well as hammocks and wooden chairs for adults to relax in.


Right next to the Recreational Green Space is a shallow stream that's great for wading and playing in, and full of small fish that children will love to catch. Just remember: Release your catch back into the stream!
desc_l10n.ja:
子どもたちが自然の中で思う存分遊べる場所、盤如チョロク公園＆萇山渓谷で、残暑を涼しく過ごしませんか？
盤如チョロク公園はとくに子連れで行くのに最適と評判の場所です。チョロク(緑)公園の中にある「盤如・休・レジャー緑地」は、ピクニックゾーン、アスレチックネット、裸足で歩ける黄土道など、様々な設備が整えられており、子どもも大人も自然と触れ合いながら楽しい時間を過ごすことができます。色々な設備と渓谷を楽しむためには、かなり傾斜のある道を登る必要がありますが、あらかじめ登山も兼ねるつもりで心の準備をしておきましょう。

ここで一番人気の施設は全長43mのローラーすべり台。釜山最長なので、スリル満点の体験ができます。安全のためのいくつかのルールが丁寧に表示されていますので、それを守りさえすれば、安心して楽しむことができます。ローラーすべり台の終点のところには、幼児も寝転んで遊ぶのに適したアスレチックネットもあります。ハンモック、木製の椅子が設置されていて、子守で疲れた大人も快適に過ごすことができます。


「休・レジャー緑地」ののすぐそばには浅い渓流が流れていて、足を浸して遊ぶことができ、小さな魚がたくさん生息しているので、採集が好きなお子さんも夢中になること間違いなしです。自然を満喫できる素晴らしい場所ですが、環境保護のために川で捕まえた魚は全て放しましょう。
desc_l10n.ko:
아이들이 자연과 함께 뛰어놀 수 있는 이곳, 반여 초록공원 & 장산계곡에서 남은 여름 시원하게 보내봐요!

반여 초록공원은 특히 아이들을 데리고 가기 좋은 장소로 유명한데요. 초록공원 내 ‘반여 휴 여가녹지’에는 피크닉 존과 네트 놀이대, 맨발 황톳길 등 다양한 시설이 조성돼있어, 아이와 어른 모두 자연과 교감하며 즐거운 시간을 보낼 수 있습니다. 여러 시설과 계곡을 즐기려면 상당히 경사진 길을 올라야 하는데, 미리부터 등산도 함께 즐긴다는 생각으로 오면 좋을 듯합니다.


이곳에서 가장 유명한 기구는 무려 43m 길이로 이어진 롤러 슬라이드입니다. 부산 최장 길이의 슬라이드인 만큼 아이들에게 아주 짜릿한 경험을 선사합니다. 몇 가지 안전수칙이 친절하게 표시돼있어 그대로 지키기만 하면 안전하게 기구를 즐길 수 있습니다. 롤러슬라이드가 끝나는 곳에는 네트 놀이대도 있는데요. 유아들이 뒹굴며 놀이하기에 좋습니다. 해먹, 나무 의자가 마련돼 있어 지친 어른들에게도 편합니다.



휴 여가녹지 바로 옆에는 얕은 계곡이 흐르고 있는데요. 발 담그며 놀이할 수 있고, 작은 물고기들이 많이 살아 채집을 재미있어하는 아이들에게 좋습니다. 다만 잡았던 물고기는 꼭 계곡에 다시 놓아줘야 한다는 점 잊지 마세요!
desc_l10n.zh:
这里是小朋友们可以在大自然中尽情玩耍的空间，在盘如绿色公园和苌山溪谷，度过清凉又惬意的时光吧！
盘如绿色公园尤其是广受欢迎的亲子游场所，公园内的“盘如休休闲绿地”内设有野餐区、绳网游乐设施和赤脚黄土路等各类设施，无论大人或小孩都能度过与自然交融的愉快时光。要想体验更多设施和溪谷，需要再爬一段陡坡，最好怀着享受登山的心态上路。

这里最有名的是长达43米的滚筒滑梯，是釜山内最长的滑梯，给孩子们带来惊险刺激的体验。具体遵守事项都有亲切提示，只需照做就能安全地享受惊险乐趣。滚筒滑梯的终点处还有绳网游乐设施，适合小朋友们尽情地翻滚游玩。旁边还有为筋疲力尽的大人们准备的吊床和木椅。


休休闲绿地的一边流淌着浅浅的溪谷，可以把脚泡在溪水里游玩，里面还有很多小鱼，尤其适合喜欢采集的小朋友们玩耍。不过要切记，捕捉的鱼一定要重新放生哦！

desc_l10n.en:
Experience the rejuvenating power of nature at Jungang Park (formerly Daeshin Park) and Daeshin Valley—a tranquil inner-city oasis filled with refreshing phytoncides to revitalize your spirit! 

The former Daeshin Park is conveniently located near Dong-A University Hospital and is easily accessible. The park's main attraction is its cypress forest, where you can enjoy the fresh air immediately upon arrival. Well-maintained walking paths wind through the forest, making it easy for visitors to take a leisurely walk. The park also offers various amenities for both residents and tourists, including a flat area for jogging and playing badminton, resting benches, a mineral spring, and basic exercise equipment.

It used to supply drinking water to the Busan area. There are two water sources in Daeshin Park. The first, located near the cypress forest and Daeshin Valley, has been turned into a lake where you can see carp, soft-shelled turtles, and other creatures.

Nestled near a cypress forest, Daeshin Valey offers shallow water that reaches a child’s knees, making it perfect for splashing around and cooling off. The stream is teeming with small fish and marsh snails that children can collect and play with, providing a wonderful opportunity for children to connect with nature. Just be sure to release your catch back into the stream to help preserve the natural environment!
desc_l10n.ja:
忙しい毎日に活力を吹き込む「フィトンチッドあふれる」都会の公園！
中央公園(旧・大新公園)&大新渓谷で爽やかな自然を存分に楽しみましょう～。


東亜大学病院の近くにあってアクセスの良い(旧)大新公園。ここの最大の特徴はヒノキの森です。そのおかげで公園に入るとすぐに新鮮な空気を体で感じることができます。木々の間に遊歩道も整備されていて、気軽に散歩できます。子どもが遊びまわったりバドミントンができる平らなスペースや休憩できる椅子、わき水、ちょっとした運動器具などの設備も見えます。

ここは、かつて釜山住民の飲料水を供給していた場所でもあります。大新公園には二つの水源地がありますが、ヒノキの森と大新渓谷の近くに位置する水源地は第1水源地で、現在は鯉やすっぽんなどの生き物を観察できる溜池になっています。

ヒノキの森の近くにある大新渓谷の渓流は、子どもの膝位までの深さなので、水遊びで涼むのに適しており、小さな魚やカワニナがたくさん生息していて、採集して遊ぶことができます。なかなか自然体験ができない都会の子どもたちには良い思い出になるはずです。自然を満喫できる素晴らしい場所ですが、環境保護のために川で捕まえた魚は全て放しましょう。
desc_l10n.ko:
바쁜 일상 속 생기를 불어넣을 ‘피톤치드 뿜뿜’ 도심 속 공원!
중앙공원(구 대신공원) & 대신계곡에서 자연의 상쾌함을 마음껏 즐겨보자구요~.


동아대병원과 가까이 있어 접근성이 좋은 (구)대신공원. 이곳의 가장 큰 특징은 편백나무숲인데요. 그래서인지 들어서자마자 신선한 공기가 온몸으로 느껴집니다. 삼림 사이 산책로도 깔끔하게 조성되어 주민들이 간단히 산책하기에 좋습니다. 뛰어놀거나 배드민턴을 칠 수 있는 평지 공간, 잠시 쉬어갈 수 있는 의자, 약수터와 간단한 운동 기구 등 주민과 관광객을 위한 시설도 눈에 띕니다.


이곳은 과거 부산 지역 식수를 공급했던 곳이기도 합니다. 대신공원 내 두 개의 수원지가 있는데요. 편백나무숲과 대신계곡 근처 위치한 수원지는 제1수원지로, 현재는 잉어, 자라 등 생물을 관찰할 수 있는 호수로 활용되고 있습니다.


편백나무숲 근처에 있는 대신계곡은 어린아이 무릎 정도까지 오는 얕은 깊이라 물장구치며 더위를 식히기에 적당하고, 작은 물고기와 다슬기가 많이 살아 채집하며 놀 수 있습니다. 자연을 체험하기 어려운 아이들에게 좋은 경험이 되겠죠? 다만 잡은 생물들은 자연환경을 보존하기 위해 모두 놓아주고 오기, 잊지 마세요!
desc_l10n.zh:
为忙碌的日常注入活力，“植物杀菌素满满”的市区公园！
在中央公园（原大新公园）和大新溪谷，尽享清新大自然吧~

（原）大新公园临近东亚大学医院，可达性非常高，这里的最大特色是拥有一片扁柏树林。正因如此，一踏进公园便能感受到前所未有的新鲜空气。树林间的散步路非常平整，适合居民们平时简单散散步。此外还有可以跑跳或打羽毛球等的平地空间、暂时停下来歇脚的椅子、山泉和简单的运动器材等方便居民与游客的便利设施。

这里曾经是釜山地区饮用水供应地，大新公园内有两个水源地，位于扁柏树林和大新溪谷附近的是第一水源地，如今用作可以观察鲤鱼、鳖等生物的湖。

扁柏树林附近的大新溪谷水深约达小朋友的膝盖，正适合玩水消暑，还有很多小鱼和川蜷，可以同时享受采集的乐趣。对于城市中的小朋友们而言，无疑会是体验大自然的难得经验！但是请切记，为了保护自然环境，捕捉的生物一定要放生，千万不要忘记哦！

desc_l10n.en:
Discover a hidden gem known only to Busan locals! 
Take the kids to a peaceful valley near Gudeok Camping Site for a relaxing getaway.


Gudeok Camping Site is located next to the former Daeshin Park. If you follow the walking trail that starts at Daeshin Park, you'll discover a beautiful natural area. The most notable nearby attraction is Naewonjeongsa Temple, which is famous for its temple stay program and is the largest temple near the city center. It's a fantastic place to explore and connect with nature.

Since this area supplies drinking water, you’ll notice several large water sources. Near Gudeok, you'll find the 'second water source,' where you can see carp and other aquatic life, as well as a fountain that operates at different times throughout the day. There is also a sports field near the campsite where you can enjoy a quick game of football.



The stream that runs around the campsite is shallow enough for children to splash around in, making it a great place to cool off with a dip in the summer.
desc_l10n.ja:
地域住民だけが知る穴場スポット！
九徳キャンプ場の近く、静かな渓谷で子どもと一緒に、家族団らんの癒しの時間を過ごしてみませんか？


九徳キャンプ場渓谷は(旧)大新公園と繋がっていますが、大新公園から始まる遊歩道「スプセンロード」を辿っていくと、また違う景色が広がります。この周辺で最も広く知られている場所は、テンプルステイで有名な「内院精舎」で、都心に近いお寺の中でも規模が断トツです。境内を見て回りながら、自然に癒されることができます。

かつて地域の飲料水を供給していた、かなり大きな規模の水源地もあります。九徳キャンプ場近くの水源地は「第2水源地」で、鯉などの生き物を観察することができ、噴水も定刻に稼働するので、見ているだけで涼しい気分になります。
キャンプ場の近くには、サッカーを楽しめる運動場があり、健康づくりのための運動を楽しむのに適しています。


キャンプ場の近くを流れる渓流は、子どもたちの水遊びに適した深さなので、夏の暑さがまだ続く時期に訪れ、足を浸して涼を楽しんでみましょう。
desc_l10n.ko:
찐 부산인들만 아는 숨겨진 자연 명소!
구덕야영장 근처 조용한 계곡에서 아이들과 함께 단란한 힐링 타임 가져보는 건 어떨까요?


구덕야영장 스팟은 (구)대신공원과 이어져 있는데요. 대신공원에서 시작되는 산책로, 숲쌘로드를 따라가다 보면 새로운 자연 명소가 펼쳐집니다. 근방에 가장 잘 알려진 장소는 템플스테이로 유명한 ‘내원정사’로, 도심과 가까이 위치한 절 중에서도 단연 큰 규모입니다. 전체적으로 둘러보며 자연과 함께 힐링하기 정말 좋죠.

과거 식수를 공급했던 지역이니만큼 꽤 큰 규모의 수원지도 볼 수 있습니다. 구덕야영장 근방 수원지는 ‘제2수원지’인데요. 잉어 등 생물을 관찰할 수 있으며, 시간에 맞추어 분수도 운영하고 있어 보는 재미가 쏠쏠합니다. 
야영장 근처에는 간단히 축구를 즐길 수 있는 운동장이 있어 생활운동을 즐기기에도 충분합니다.



야영장 주변에 흐르는 계곡은 아이들이 물장난치기에 적당한 얕은 수위로, 더위가 가시지 않은 여름에 찾아가 발 담그며 선선한 기운을 느끼기에 좋습니다.
desc_l10n.zh:
地地道道的釜山人之间的宝藏自然名胜！
在九德露营场附近僻静的溪谷，和孩子们一起度过其乐融融的治愈时光吧！


九德露营场区域与（原）大新公园相连，沿着从大新公园出发的散步路——林盛路一直走，眼前就会出现全新的自然名胜。比较广为人知的是以寺院寄宿闻名的“内院精舍”，在临近市中心的寺庙中规模居首。光是慢慢地逛一圈感受大自然，也是一件非常治愈的事情。

上面提到这里过去曾是饮用水供应地，位于九德露营场附近的便是“第二水源地”。在这里不仅能观察鲤鱼等生物，还会定时上演喷泉表演，值得一看。 
露营场附近还有可以踢足球的运动场，足以享受其他生活运动。


露营场周围的溪谷水深也比较浅，适合小朋友们简单玩水，在酷热难耐的夏天去泡脚，可以将热意一扫而光。

description:
Discover a hidden gem known only to Busan locals! 
Take the kids to a peaceful valley near Gudeok Camping Site for a relaxing getaway.


Gudeok Camping Site is located next to the former Daeshin Park. If you follow the walking trail that starts at Daeshin Park, you'll discover a beautiful natural area. The most notable nearby attraction is Naewonjeongsa Temple, which is famous for its temple stay program and is the largest temple near the city center. It's a fantastic place to explore and connect with nature.

Since this area supplies drinking water, you’ll notice several large water sources. Near Gudeok, you'll find the 'second water source,' where you can see carp and other aquatic life, as well as a fountain that operates at different times throughout the day. There is also a sports field near the campsite where you can enjoy a quick game of football.



The stream that runs around the campsite is shallow enough for children to splash around in, making it a great place to cool off with a dip in the summer.
name: Auto camping in Gudeok Valley, a perfect getaway to a hidden natural spot

name_l10n.en: Auto camping in Gudeok Valley, a perfect getaway to a hidden natural spot

desc_l10n.en:
Do you know Yosan Kim Jeonghan, a key figure in Busan's literary history? The reservoir depicted in Yosan's work Sahachon is actually Beomeosa Yongseong Dam. So Yongseong Dam is not only a reservoir in the heart of the city, but also a place of literary significance.

Yongseong Valley has a stream that flows from Yongseong Dam, creating a stunning waterfall that is sure to refresh your mind. However, as shown in the photo, the water upstream from the dam is very powerful, making it unsafe to enter the waterfall.



Consider exploring the valley, where the water is only knee-deep, making it safe for young children to play. The area is also home to many small fish, making it an excellent place to learn about ecology. Nearby, you’ll find a walking trail called Nuri-gil and a rest area, perfect for combining water play with a leisurely walk.

Visit Yongseong Valley for a blend of Busan's history refreshing stream!
desc_l10n.ja:
釜山の文学史で欠かせない文人、楽山・金廷漢をご存じですか？金廷漢の短編小説「寺下村」に登場する貯水池は、梵魚寺「龍城ダム」がモチーフになっています。つまり、龍城ダムは単なる都会の貯水池に留まらず、文学史的価値のある場所といえます。

龍城渓谷の渓流は龍城ダムから始まりますが、気持ち良く落ちる渓流の滝を見ていると、心まできれいに洗われるような気がします。写真からも分かるように、龍城ダムの近くの上流は非常に激しい流れで、安全上の理由で入水できませんので、注意してくださいね。



人々がたくさん集まる場所は下流の方です。ここは子どもの膝位の深さで、幼児が遊んでも安心できるスポットです。また、小さな魚が多く、生態体験にもうってつけです。渓流の近くには「文化体験ヌリギル」という遊歩道と休憩スペースが整備されており、水遊びと軽い登山を一緒に楽しむことができます。

涼しい渓流で釜山の歴史を感じることができる龍城渓谷へお越しください！
desc_l10n.ko:
부산 문학사에서 빼놓을 수 없는 문인, 요산 김정한을 아시나요? 요산의 작품 <사하촌> 속 저수지의 모티브가 된 장소가 바로 범어사 ‘용성댐’입니다. 이처럼 용성댐은 단지 도심 속 저수지가 아닌, 문학사적 가치가 있는 장소라고 할 수 있습니다.


용성댐으로부터 이어지는 물줄기가 바로 용성계곡입니다. 시원하게 떨어지는 폭포수가 마음까지 깨끗이 씻어주는 듯하죠. 사진에서 볼 수 있듯 용성댐 근처 상류는 물이 매우 거세게 흐르기 때문에, 안전상 입수가 불가능하다는 점 참고 바랍니다. 




사람들이 주로 모이는 곳은 계곡 하류입니다. 이곳은 아이들 무릎까지 오는 높이로, 깊지 않아 유아들이 놀기에 좋습니다. 또 자잘한 물고기들이 많아 생태체험을 하기에도 알맞습니다. 계곡 근처에는 ‘문화체험누리길’이라는 산책로와 휴식 공간이 잘 마련되어 있어, 물놀이와 가벼운 등산을 함께 즐길 수 있습니다. 

시원한 계곡물과 함께 부산의 역사를 느끼고 싶다면 용성계곡에 방문해보세요!
desc_l10n.zh:
是否听说过釜山文学史上举足轻重的文人——乐山金廷汉呢？其作品《寺下村》中水库的灵感源泉便是梵鱼寺的“龙城坝”。由此可见，龙城坝不仅仅是位于城市中的水库，也是一处拥有文学史价值的场所。

从龙城坝起始的水流便是龙城溪谷，倾泻而下的瀑布仿佛将内心也清洗的一干二净。从照片可以看出，龙城坝附近的上游水流湍急，出于安全起见禁止入水，请作参考。



人群熙攘的地方是溪谷下游，这里的水深也只有小朋友的膝盖处，非常适合低龄儿童游玩，还有很多小鱼，是最好不过的生态体验地。溪谷附近还有名为“文化体验世界路”的散步路和休息空间，可以同时享受玩水和简单的登山乐趣。

想畅享清凉的溪水并感受釜山历史的话，一定记得访问龙城溪谷！

desc_l10n.en:
Surrounded by beautiful natural scenery, this is one of the best hidden hikes to enjoy the forest trails and Yongsogol Reservoir in all four seasons.  
Smell the relaxing seasonal scent with a gentle breeze from the reservoir. You'll experience a different side of Gijang on this walk.

Take the kids out on the weekends and keep fit with a walk on the beautiful waterfront deck.

Yongso Well-Being Park is a great place for walks for all ages, from toddlers to the elderly.
It is especially recommended for families.
desc_l10n.ja:
四季折々の美しい自然を感じながら、林道の散策路と龍沼コル貯水池の風景を楽しむことができる穴場の散策コースです。
貯水池から気持ち良く吹いてくる風に当たりながら、季節の香りをゆっくり堪能してみてください。散歩によってまた新たな機張の一面が発見できるかもしれません。

週末には子供と一緒にピクニックを楽しんだり、美しい水辺の木道を歩いたりすると、きっと健康にも良いはずです。

小さなお子さんからお年寄りまで、老若男女問わず散歩が楽しめる龍沼ウェルビーイング公園！
家族連れやお散歩大好きという方にとくにおすすめです。
desc_l10n.ko:
사계절 내내 아름다운 자연풍경을 느끼며 숲길 산책로와 용소골저수지를 즐길 수 있는 숨은 산책 코스 중 하나입니다.
저수지에서 은은하게 불어오는 바람과 함께 여유로운 계절 내음을 맡아보세요. 산책으로 또 다른 기장을 느낄 수 있을 거예요.

주말이면 아이들과 함께 나들이도 하고, 아름다운 수변 데크를 따라 걷기 운동하며 건강도 지킬 수 있습니다.

어린아이부터 어르신까지, 남녀노소 모두가 산책할 수 있는 용소 웰빙공원! 
가족 단위 산책러분들에게 특히 추천합니다.
desc_l10n.zh:
这里是既能享受四季优美的自然风景，还能在林道散步路和龙沼谷水库度过惬意时光的宝藏散步路线之一。
迎着从水库吹来的清风，感受闲适的季节气息吧。相信通过散步会领略到机张的全新魅力。

周末可以带上孩子一起出游，沿着美丽的水边栈道走一走，还可以强身健体。

男女老少皆宜的散步胜地——龙沼健康公园！
尤其向全家一起出动的散步爱好者推荐。

desc_l10n.en: Think Gugak is difficult to learn? Now it's easy and fun to learn at the Gugak Experience Hall, Busan National Gugak Center! The Gugak Experience Hall opened in October 2023. Unlike the Busan National Gugak Center, which focus mostly on performances, the Gugak Experience Hall offers various experiences and exhibitions that bring you closer to traditional Korean music. When you first enter the center, you’ll see the outdoor performance stage. This is where you can enjoy exciting Gugak performances, many of which are free. In addition to the outdoor stage, there is also an indoor performance hall that hosts a variety of shows. To make the most of your visit, it is a good idea to check the the Busan National Gugak Center’s performance schedule on their website before visiting the center. ▷Shortcut to the website Inside the Experience Hall, you will find exhibits related to gugak. The first floor is an immersive media art room where you can enjoy the coolness of gugak through colorful gugak media art. The digital data exhibition room on the 1st and 2nd floors is a place where you can learn things you didn't know about gugak, and various archival materials are displayed to pique your curiosity. The immersive exhibition room on the second floor is a space where you can experience Korean musical instruments through digital devices, which is especially attractive to visitors with children. Right next door is a children's experience room where they can make paper art of the janggu, an hourglass-shaped Korean drum and the taepyeongso, or traditional wind instrument, which is a great way for them to experience Korean music. There are also plenty of resting areas throughout the center, so you can take a break after enjoying a performance or exhibition. The Gugak Experience Hall is located right in front of Busan Citizens Park, so it's a great place to end your day with a leisurely stroll in the park afterwards. Spend an enriching day at the Gugak Experience Hall, where you can experience the beauty of Korean music with a modern twist!
desc_l10n.ja: 難しく感じられていた国楽、国立釜山国楽院・国楽体験館で気軽に楽しく学んでみましょう！ 2023年10月、国立釜山国楽院の中に国楽体験館がオープンしました。主に公演だけが行われていた国立釜山国楽院とは異なり、国楽体験館には国楽をもっと身近に感じられる様々な体験と展示がたくさん行われています。 体験館の入り口に入ると、まず屋外公演場が目に飛び込んできます。にぎやかな国楽の公演が行われる場所で、ほとんどは無料で鑑賞できます。屋外公演場だけでなく、国楽院内の室内公演場でも頻繁に上演されています。ホームページから国立釜山国楽院のスケジュールを事前に確認していくと、お好きな公演が存分に楽しめるでしょう。 ▷ホームページはこちら 体験館の中では、国楽に関する展覧会が見られます。 まず1階のイマーシブ展示室はメディアアート空間で、華やかな国楽のメディアアートを通じて国楽の素晴らしさが再現されています。 1、2階のデジタル資料展示室は様々なアーカイブ資料が展示されており、国楽についてあまり知られていない内容が学べるので興味をそそられます。 デジタル機器を活用して国楽の楽器を体験できる2階のイマーシブ展示室は、子連れの方には特に魅力的なスペースではないでしょうか。すぐ隣にはチャングや太平簫をペーパーアートで作ることができる子供向け体験スペースがあり、子供たちが楽しく国楽を体験するのに適しています。 体験館の各所には休憩スペースも十分に用意されており、公演や展示会を観た後に休むこともできます。 国楽体験館は釜山市民公園のすぐ前にありますので、体験館を訪れた後に市民公園をのんびりお散歩して一日を締めくくるのも良いでしょう。国立釜山国楽院・国楽体験館で伝統音楽の美しさとモダンな感性を同時に感じ、教養あふれる一日を過ごしてみてください！
desc_l10n.ko: 어렵기만 했던 국악, 이제 국립부산국악원 국악체험관에서 쉽고 재미있게 배워보세요! 2023년 10월, 국립부산국악원 내 국악체험관이 문을 열었는데요. 주로 공연만을 다뤘던 기존 국립부산국악원과 달리, 국악체험관에는 국악에 대한 친근감을 높이는 다양한 체험과 전시가 잔뜩 준비돼있습니다. 체험관 입구에 들어서면 가장 먼저 야외공연장이 눈에 띕니다. 흥겨운 국악 한마당이 펼쳐지는 곳으로, 주로 무료로 감상할 수 있는 공연이 진행되는데요. 야외공연장뿐만 아니라 국악원 내 실내공연장에서도 활발하게 공연을 운영하고 있습니다. 홈페이지에서 국립부산국악원의 공연 일정을 미리 확인해 공연 알차게 즐기길 추천합니다. ▷홈페이지 바로가기 체험관 내부에서는 국악과 관련된 전시를 만나볼 수 있습니다. 우선 1층 실감 전시실은 미디어아트 공간인데요. 화려한 국악 미디어아트로 국악의 멋스러움을 만끽할 수 있습니다. 1·2층 디지털 자료 전시실은 국악에 관해 몰랐던 내용을 알아가는 곳으로, 다양한 아카이빙 자료가 전시돼있어 흥미를 자극합니다. 2층 실감 전시실은 디지털 기기를 활용해 국악 악기들을 체험하는 공간인데요. 아이들과 함께 온 분들에게는 이 공간이 특히 매력적일 듯합니다. 바로 옆 공간에도 장구와 태평소를 종이 아트로 만들 수 있는 어린이체험공간이 마련되어 있어, 아이들이 국악을 즐겁게 체험하기에 좋습니다. 체험관 곳곳에는 공연이나 전시 관람 후 잠시 쉬어갈 수 있는 휴식공간도 충분히 마련돼있습니다. 국악체험관은 부산시민공원 바로 앞에 위치해 있어, 방문 후 시민공원에서 산책하며 여유롭게 하루를 마무리하기에도 좋습니다. 국립부산국악원 국악체험관에서 전통 음악의 아름다움과 현대적 감성을 함께 느끼며 교양 넘치는 하루를 보내보세요!
desc_l10n.zh: 您是否曾经觉得国乐很难懂？现在请在国立釜山国乐院国乐体验馆轻松愉快地学习国乐吧！ 2023年10月，国立釜山国乐院开设了国乐体验馆。与主要负责演出的国立釜山国乐院不同，国乐体验馆提供各种提高国乐亲民感的体验和展览。 穿过体验馆入口，最先映入眼帘的是室外演出场地。这里是一个表演欢快国乐的地方，主要提供可以免费欣赏的演出。除了室外演出场地外，国乐院内的室内演出场地也积极为游客奉上演出。推荐您登陆网站提前查看国立釜山国乐院的演出日程，享受丰富的演出。 ▷立即前往网站 在体验馆内可以参观与国乐相关的展览。 首先，1楼的实感展览室是一个媒体艺术空间。可以通过华丽的国乐媒体艺术尽情感受国乐的魅力。 1楼和2楼的数字资料展览室是一个可以了解国乐知识盲点的地方，展出了各种存档资料，激发了人们的兴趣。 2楼实感展览室是一个可以通过数字设备体验国乐乐器的空间。对于携孩子一同出游的人来说，这个空间格外有魅力。旁边还设有儿童体验空间，可以通过纸艺制作长鼓和太平箫，适合让孩子们愉快地体验国乐。 体验馆各个角落都准备了充足的休息空间，观看演出或展览后可以小憩一下。 国乐体验馆位于釜山市民公园正前方，参观结束后可以在市民公园散步，悠闲地结束一天的行程。请在国立釜山国乐院国乐体验馆感受传统音乐之美和现代感性，度过充满文化气息的一天吧！

description: Think Gugak is difficult to learn? Now it's easy and fun to learn at the Gugak Experience Hall, Busan National Gugak Center! The Gugak Experience Hall opened in October 2023. Unlike the Busan National Gugak Center, which focus mostly on performances, the Gugak Experience Hall offers various experiences and exhibitions that bring you closer to traditional Korean music. When you first enter the center, you’ll see the outdoor performance stage. This is where you can enjoy exciting Gugak performances, many of which are free. In addition to the outdoor stage, there is also an indoor performance hall that hosts a variety of shows. To make the most of your visit, it is a good idea to check the the Busan National Gugak Center’s performance schedule on their website before visiting the center. ▷Shortcut to the website Inside the Experience Hall, you will find exhibits related to gugak. The first floor is an immersive media art room where you can enjoy the coolness of gugak through colorful gugak media art. The digital data exhibition room on the 1st and 2nd floors is a place where you can learn things you didn't know about gugak, and various archival materials are displayed to pique your curiosity. The immersive exhibition room on the second floor is a space where you can experience Korean musical instruments through digital devices, which is especially attractive to visitors with children. Right next door is a children's experience room where they can make paper art of the janggu, an hourglass-shaped Korean drum and the taepyeongso, or traditional wind instrument, which is a great way for them to experience Korean music. There are also plenty of resting areas throughout the center, so you can take a break after enjoying a performance or exhibition. The Gugak Experience Hall is located right in front of Busan Citizens Park, so it's a great place to end your day with a leisurely stroll in the park afterwards. Spend an enriching day at the Gugak Experience Hall, where you can experience the beauty of Korean music with a modern twist!

desc_l10n.en:
Math can be fun at the Busan Mathematics Culture Museum. Explore the exciting world of mathematics at the Busan Mathematics Culture Center, the world's largest math culture space. The Busan Mathematics Culture Museum was opened to spread the joy of mathematics to people, and it holds various exhibitions and experience programs to popularize mathematics among the public. The museum is spread over five floors, so there are many different things to explore on each floor. After registering for the experience programs in the lobby on the B1-1st floor, go up to the second floor where the full-blown math experience programs begin.

2F : Mathematics Play Hall & Mathematics Library

3F : Career Exploration Hall & Media Hall

4층 : Subject Experience Hall & History and Wisdom Hall

5F : Board Game Hall

The Mathematics Play Hall on the second floor is a playful place to explore math. It's filled with hands-on, interactive programs that bring math to life, whether you're trying to figure out the size of a pizza slice or building your own da Vinci Dome. It's great for toddlers and early elementary students who are new to math. The Mathematics Library, located on the same floor, has math-related books to help you explore math in more depth. The Subject Experience Hall on the fourth floor is organized around the theme of math in textbooks, making it more fun for elementary and middle school students and up who are starting to learn math in school. The History and Wisdom Hall on the same floor displays math in human history, so check it out if you're interested in learning more about the history of math. When you're done, you can spend some time with your kids playing fun board games in the Board Game Hall on the fifth floor. Also on the third floor is the Career Exploration Hall, where you can learn about how math is used in different careers, and the Media Hall, where you can watch math videos. You can enter the Busan Mathematics Culture Museum by reservation or on the spot. If there are many visitors, you may not be allowed to enter, so it is recommended to make a reservation.
desc_l10n.ja:
誰一人として、数学を諦めさせません！世界最大の数学文化施設「釜山数学文化館」で、面白い数学の世界を探検してみましょう。 釜山数学文化館は、数学の楽しさを多くの人に知ってもらうために開館されました。数学文化を普及するための様々な展示や体験プログラムを運営しています。5階建てで広々としているため、フロアごとに多様な体験ができます。 B1～1階ロビーで受け付けをしてから入館すると、2階から本格的な数学体験館が始まります。

2階：数学遊び館&数学図書館

3階：進路探索館&映像館

4階：教科体験館&歴史知恵館

5階：ボードゲーム室

2階の数学遊び館では、遊びを通して数学に触れることができます。ピザのピースの大きさを当てる遊びやダヴィンチ・ドームを自分で作る体験など、自分で工夫しながら数学を楽しく学べるプログラムが満載です。初めて算数や数学に触れる子ども、小学校低学年にとくにおすすめです。 同じフロアにある数学図書館では、数学に関する書籍が揃っており、本を通して数学を深く掘り下げて学ぶことができます。 4階の教科体験館は、教科書の中の数学をテーマに体験できる構成になっています。学校で本格的に算数や数学を学び始める小学校の中学年以上の児童が、楽しく教科書の数学に接することができるよう、導いています。同じフロアにある歴史知恵館では、数学史について展示していますので、数学の歴史を学びたいなら、見学しておきたいですね。 体験が終わった後には、5階のボードゲーム室で子どもたちと一緒にボードゲームをするのも楽しいはずです。 そのほか、数学が様々な職業でどのように活用されているかが分かる進路探索館と数学に関する映像を観覧できる映像館は3階にあります。 釜山数学文化館は、予約なしでも入館可能ですが、訪問者が多い場合、現場での受付が難しいこともありますので、なるべく予約してから訪れることをおすすめします。
desc_l10n.ko:
부산수학문화관과 함께라면 우리 모두 수포자 탈출 가능! 세계 최대 규모 수학 문화공간, 부산수학문화관에서 흥미로운 수학의 세계를 탐험해봐요. 부산수학문화관은 수학의 즐거움을 사람들에게 널리 전파하기 위해 개관한 곳으로, 수학 문화의 대중화를 위해 여러 가지 전시와 체험 프로그램을 운영 중입니다. 5층 규모로 넓게 조성돼있는 만큼 층별로 만나볼 수 있는 공간도 매우 다양합니다. B1~1층 로비에서 체험 접수 후 입장하면 2층부터 본격적인 수학체험관이 마련돼있습니다.

2층 : 수학놀이관 & 수학도서관

3층 : 진로탐색관 & 영상관

4층 : 교과체험관 &역사지혜관

5층 : 보드게임실

2층 수학놀이관은 놀이를 통해 수학을 접할 수 있는 공간인데요. 피자 조각의 크기를 알아맞히는 활동이나, 다빈치 돔을 직접 만들어보는 체험 등 직접 부딪히며 수학에 재미를 붙이는 프로그램으로 가득합니다. 처음 수학을 접하는 어린아이와 초등학교 저학년들에게 좋겠죠? 같은 층에 있는 수학도서관에는 수학 관련 도서가 비치되어, 책을 통해 수학을 더 깊이 탐구해볼 수 있습니다. 4층 교과체험관은 교과서 속 수학을 테마로 체험을 구성했는데요. 학교에서 본격적으로 수학을 배우기 시작하는 초등학교 중학년 이상 학생들이 보다 재미있게 교과서 속 수학을 접할 수 있도록 돕습니다. 같은 층 역사지혜관에서는 인류 역사 속 수학을 전시해뒀으니, 수학의 역사를 공부하고 싶은 분들은 둘러보시길 추천합니다. 체험을 모두 마친 후 5층 보드게임실에서 아이들과 함께 재미있는 보드게임을 즐기며 시간을 보내도 좋겠죠? 그 외 수학이 다양한 직업에서 어떻게 활용되는지를 알아보는 진로탐색관과 수학 영상을 관람하는 영상관은 3층에서 둘러볼 수 있습니다. 부산 수학문화관은 예약 혹은 현장 접수를 통해 입장 가능합니다. 방문객이 많을 경우 현장에서 접수가 힘들 수 있으니, 되도록 예약 후 방문해주세요!
desc_l10n.zh:
有了釜山数学文化馆，我们都可以摆脱“放弃学习数学的人”身份！请在世界最大的数学文化空间——釜山数学文化馆探索有趣的数学世界吧。 釜山数学文化馆的开设目的是向人们广泛传播数学的乐趣，为了实现数学文化的大众化，运营各种展览和体验项目。拥有5层规模，每层可以参观的空间也极其丰富多样。 在B1~1楼大厅登记体验后入场，从2楼开始设有正式数学体验馆。

2楼：数学游戏馆&数学图书馆

3楼：前途探索馆&影像馆

4楼：教学体验馆&历史智慧馆

5楼：桌游室

2楼的数学游戏馆是一个可以通过游戏接触数学的空间。提供各种可以亲自参与、为数学增添乐趣的项目，比如猜测披萨块大小的活动、亲手制作达芬奇穹顶的体验等。对于第一次接触数学的孩子和小学低年级学生来说非常合适吧？ 同一楼层的数学图书馆收藏了数学相关书籍，可以通过书籍更加深入地探索数学。 4楼教学体验馆以教科书中的数学为主题组成体验项目。帮助在学校正式开始学习数学的小学中年级以上的学生以更有趣的方式接触教科书中的数学。同一楼层的历史智慧馆展示着人类历史中的数学，想了解数学历史的游客不妨参观一下。 体验结束后，可以在5楼的桌游室和孩子们一起玩有趣的桌游，度过快乐的时光。 此外，还可以参观3楼的前途探索馆和影像馆，在前途探索馆可以了解数学在各种职业中是如何运用的，在影像馆可以观看数学视频。 釜山数学文化馆可以通过预约或现场报名的方式入场。访客较多时，有可能无法现场报名，因此建议尽量提前预约后再访问。

desc_l10n.en:
As you slowly climb the forest trail at Bongsu-ro in Yeonje-gu, Busan, 
you'll come across a hospitality banner and a Buddha statue that greets you with a bright smile.

Mahasa is a temple of the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism that was first built during the Silla Dynasty, making it one of the first temples in Busan. The temple was burned down during the Imjin War, or the Japanese Invasions of Korea in 1592, but was gradually rebuilt throughout the 18th and 19th centuries.
The wellness program is updated each year, with experiences such as meditation, temple food therapy, and more to balance physical, mental, and social health in the serene, deep mountains.
When you feel so frustrating and disturbed,
When you want wisdom and compassion to fill you up, 
why not spend some time inhaling and exhaling in Mahasa Temple?

Coming down the mountain path while listening to the sound of a bell at Mahasa Temple, one of the Eight Scenic Views in Suyeong-gu, will be another special memory.
desc_l10n.ja:
釜山蓮堤区ポンスロの上り坂の林道をゆっくり歩いて行くと、 
おもてなしの垂れ幕が見え、そして満面の笑みで迎えてくれる仏像に出会います。

摩訶寺は本来、新羅時代に建てられた曹渓宗の寺院で、釜山初の寺院に数えられています。壬辰倭乱(文禄・慶長の役)で全焼してしまいましたが、18～19世紀にかけて段階的に復元されました。
静けさに包まれた深山の中で、瞑想や精進料理セラピーなど、様々な体験を通じて心身の健康はもちろん、社会的健康を整えてくれるウェルネスプログラムが、毎年更新されて多彩に行われます。
なんとなく焦りを感じたとき、心がざわついたとき
知恵と慈悲の心で満たされたいと思うとき、
摩訶寺で呼吸を整え、憩いの時間を過ごしてみてはいかがでしょうか。

水営八景の一つ、摩訶寺の鐘の音を聞きながら山道を下るのも、特別な思い出になるはずです。
desc_l10n.ko:
부산 연제구 봉수로 오르막길을 천천히 오르다보면 
환대의 현수막을 만나고, 환한 미소로 맞이하는 불상을 마주하게 됩니다.
마하사는 신라 시대에 처음 지어진 조계종 사찰로, 부산 최초의 사찰 중 하나입니다. 임진왜란 때 사찰 건물이 전소되었지만, 18~19세기에 걸쳐 단계적으로 복원되었습니다. 
고즈넉하고 깊은 산속에서 명상, 사찰음식 테라피 등 다양한 체험을 통해 신체적, 정신적, 사회적 건강의 균형을 잡아주는 웰니스 프로그램이 매해 새롭고 다채롭게 진행됩니다.
마음이 답답하고, 분주한 마음이 들 때.
지혜와 자비가 내 안에 채워지길 바라는 마음이 들 때,
마하사에서 들숨과 날숨의 시간을 보내보는 것은 어떨까요?

수영 팔경 중 하나인 마하사의 종소리를 들으며 산길을 내려오는 것도 특별한 추억으로 남을 것 같습니다.
desc_l10n.zh:
沿着釜山莲堤区烽燧路的上坡林荫道漫步时，
您会看到一条欢迎横幅和一尊面带灿烂微笑、迎接八方来客的佛像。
摩诃寺是新罗时代建造的第一座曹溪宗寺庙，是釜山最早的寺庙之一。壬辰倭乱时期寺庙建筑物被烧毁，但在18至19世纪得到阶段性的复原。
每年推出全新且丰富多样的养生项目，可以在静谧的深山中通过冥想、寺庙食疗等各种体验维持身体、精神和社会健康的平衡。
当您心情沉闷和繁杂的时候，
当您想用智慧和慈悲填充内心的时候，
请来摩诃寺尽情呼吸新鲜空气，度过放松的时光吧？
一边聆听水营八景之一“摩诃寺”的钟声一边走下山路，也会为您留下特别的回忆。

description:
As you slowly climb the forest trail at Bongsu-ro in Yeonje-gu, Busan, 
you'll come across a hospitality banner and a Buddha statue that greets you with a bright smile.

Mahasa is a temple of the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism that was first built during the Silla Dynasty, making it one of the first temples in Busan. The temple was burned down during the Imjin War, or the Japanese Invasions of Korea in 1592, but was gradually rebuilt throughout the 18th and 19th centuries.
The wellness program is updated each year, with experiences such as meditation, temple food therapy, and more to balance physical, mental, and social health in the serene, deep mountains.
When you feel so frustrating and disturbed,
When you want wisdom and compassion to fill you up, 
why not spend some time inhaling and exhaling in Mahasa Temple?

Coming down the mountain path while listening to the sound of a bell at Mahasa Temple, one of the Eight Scenic Views in Suyeong-gu, will be another special memory.
name: Busan's First Buddhist Temple: Mahasa Temple

desc_l10n.en:
Ibagu-gil Photo Studio brings a sense of nostalgia with its old building and wooden sign. The place feels like it’s been around forever, but surprisingly, it's only recently opened.

The interior of the photo studio features a mix of vintage props that creates a warm and cozy atmosphere. A large teddy bear and brown furniture add to the mellow vibe of the photos here.

The studio specializes in black-and-white photography and offers a wide range of photography types, including family, couples, weddings, and portraits. The owner is an experienced photographer, ensuring that your photos will be perfect for your purposes. Every detail carefully, from the layout to background and prop placement, is carefully thought out, so your photos will turn out beautifully.
They also offer photo restoration services, so if you have old, blurry or faded photos, this is the perfect place to bring them back to life.


Ibagu-gil Photo Studio is a member store of Ibagu Pay, so you can earn incentive rewards when you use Ibagu Pay, making it even more affordable.
If you have a special occasion you don’t want to miss and want to capture it with a professional photographer, Ibagu-gil Photo Studio is the perfect choice!
desc_l10n.ja:
ヴィンテージな建物と木製看板が、アナログの感性でノスタルジックな雰囲気を醸し出すイバグキル写真館。その雰囲気だけを見ると、長い年月を感じさせますが、実はここ、オープンして間もないそうです。

写真館の中には、穏やかで柔らかな雰囲気が漂うヴィンテージの小道具が置かれ、全体が調和しています。大きなクマのぬいぐるみとブラウン系の家具が、温かみのある写真の雰囲気をさらに引き立てています。

ここは白黒写真をメインに、家族写真、カップル写真、結婚写真、証明写真などライフステージに合わせた多様な写真を撮影しています。プロの写真家が手掛けており、用途に合わせて満足してもらえる写真を撮ります。構図や背景、小道具の配置まできめ細かく考え抜かれているので、それはもう、きれいに撮れるはずです。
さらに、昔の写真の復元も可能だそうです。ぼやけてしまったり、色あせたりした思い出の写真をここで新しく蘇らせてみましょう。


イバグキル写真館は東区の地域通貨「イバグペイ」に加盟しているので、イバグペイを使うと、ポイントが獲得でき、リーズナブルな価格でご利用いただけます。
写真に残しておきたい特別な日、写真のプロがとどめておいてくれた瞬間を大切にしたい方は、ぜひイバグキル写真館を訪れてみてください！
desc_l10n.ko:
빈티지한 건물과 나무 간판의 아날로그 감성이 향수를 불러일으키는 이바구길 사진관. 공간의 성숙함만 보면 아주 오랜 세월 자리를 지켰을 것 같지만, 의외로 실제 오픈한 지는 그리 오래되지 않았다고 합니다. 



사진관 내부에는 따뜻하고 부드러운 분위기의 빈티지 소품들이 조화롭게 배치돼 있습니다. 
커다란 곰인형과 브라운 계열 가구들이 공간의 온화한 분위기를 한층 돋보이게 합니다.



이곳은 흑백사진을 주력으로, 가족사진, 커플 사진, 결혼사진, 증명사진 등 다양한 종류의 사진을 다룹니다. 베테랑 사진작가인 사장님의 전문적인 손길을 통해 용도에 맞게 만족스러운 사진을 만들어내는데요. 구도부터 배경, 소품 배치까지 섬세하게 고려하니 당연히 예쁘게 나오겠죠?
또 옛날 사진 복원도 가능하다고 하니, 흐릿하거나 색이 바랜 추억의 사진들을 이곳에서 새롭게 재탄생시켜봐도 좋겠습니다.



이바구길 사진관은 동구 지역화폐 ‘이바구페이’ 가맹점으로, 이바구페이를 활용할 시 인센티브 적립 혜택을 받을 수 있어 가격 부담도 적습니다.
그냥 지나칠 수 없는 특별한 날, 전문가가 만들어내는 예쁜 추억 한 컷 간직하고 싶다면 이바구길 사진관을 방문해보세요!
desc_l10n.zh:
故事路照相馆拥有复古建筑物和怀旧木招牌，唤起人们的怀旧之情。仅从空间的成熟度来看，似乎已经存在了很长一段时间，然而出人意料的是，这家店实际开业时间并不长。

照相馆内部和谐地摆放着一些复古小物件，营造出温暖柔和的氛围。巨大的玩具熊和棕色系家具进一步突显了照片的温馨氛围。

这家照相馆以拍摄黑白照片为主，提供家庭照、情侣照、结婚照和证件照等各种照片的拍摄服务。通过资深摄影师的专业技术，根据用途拍摄出让人满意的照片。从构图到背景，再到道具布置，均经过了细致的考虑，自然会拍出漂亮的照片。
此外，据说这里还可以修复旧照片，可以试试将模糊或褪色的照片带到这里，让它们获得重生。


故事路照相馆是东区当地货币“Ibagu Pay”的加盟店，使用Ibagu Pay付款时，可以享受奖励积分，因此价格负担较小。
如果您想在不容错过的特别日子里珍藏一张由专业人士为您留下的美好回忆，就来故事路照相馆吧！

desc_l10n.en:
The sea meets futuristic landscaping in the heart of the city. Enjoy a special evening stroll at North Port Waterfront Park!

The North Port Waterfront Park is a waterfront park developed as part of the the North Port Redevelopment Project. It’s also a downtown park, easily accessible by getting off at Busan Station and walking across the pedestrian bridge. The park’s vibrant lights and futuristic design make it an attractive new spot for enjoying Busan’s nighttime views.
The park is well lit, making it a great place for a relaxing walk at night. It is also spacious with a well-maintained path, perfect for running or taking the kids or dog for an evening out.
Though it’s best known as a nighttime walking spot thanks to the beautiful night view of the Busanhangdaegyo Bridge in the background, you can also enjoy the lush pampas grass along the promenade during the day.

The North Port Waterfront Park features multi-purpose plazas, lawns, ground fountains, decks and more to create a more fulfilling experience for visitors. With beautiful landscaping that blends naturally into the urban environment, it’s a great place to enjoy an evening.
desc_l10n.ja:
都会の海と近未来的な景色の融合、北港親水公園で特別な夜のお散歩をお楽しみください！

北港親水公園は北港再開発事業により造成されました。釜山駅の空中歩道橋を歩いてアクセスできる都心の公園でもあります。広い公園を埋め尽くす色とりどりの照明と近未来的な公園のデザインが魅力的で、釜山の新しい夜景スポットとしても注目されています。
明るい照明に照らされているので、夜のお散歩を安全に楽しむことができ、公園が広くて散策路もきちんと整備されているので、ランニングにも、子どもや愛犬と一緒に夜のお出かけを楽しむのにもぴったりの場所です。
釜山港大橋を背景に美しい夜景が広がり、夜の散歩スポットとして親しまれていますが、昼は散策路の道沿いにパンパス(白銀葦)の生い茂った景色を鑑賞することができるので、昼と夜、それぞれの景観の魅力がはっきりしています。

北港親水公園には、多目的広場、芝生広場、床噴水、木道などが整えられていて施設が充実しており、公園を訪れる人々に満足感を与えてくれます。都心の景観と調和する美しい造園に触れられる場所、北港親水公園で楽しい夜をお過ごしください。
desc_l10n.ko:
도심 속 바다와 미래적인 조경의 만남, 북항 친수공원에서 특별한 밤 산책 즐겨보세요!


북항 친수공원은 북항 재개발사업을 통해 조성된 친수공간으로, 부산역에 내려 공중보행교를 따라 걷다 보면 도착하는 도심 속 공원이기도 합니다.
넓은 공원을 가득 채우는 형형색색의 조명과 미래적인 공원 디자인이 매력적이라 부산의 새로운 야경 명소로도 거론되고 있습니다.
조명 덕분에 보다 안전하게 밤 산책을 즐길 수 있는 공간이기도 한데요. 
공원 자체가 넓고 산책로가 깔끔하게 마련돼있어 러닝하기에도 제격이며, 아이들이나 반려견과 밤 나들이를 즐기기에도 좋습니다.
부산항대교를 배경으로 한 아름다운 야경 덕에 주로 밤 산책 명소로 알려지기는 했지만, 낮에는 산책로 갓길에 팜파스가 우거진 경관을 볼 수 있어 나름의 매력이 충분합니다.


북항 친수공원에는 다목적 광장, 잔디마당, 바닥분수, 데크 등이 알차게 구성돼있어 공원을 찾는 사람들에게 더욱 만족스러운 경험을 선사합니다. 도심 경관과 잘 어우러지는 아름다운 조경을 만나볼 수 있는 곳, 북항 친수공원에서 즐거운 밤 보내보시길 추천합니다.
desc_l10n.zh:
市中心的大海与未来主义造景相遇，请在北港亲水公园享受特别的夜间散步吧！

北港亲水公园是通过北港再开发项目建造的亲水空间，也是一个市中心的公园，在釜山站下车，沿着天桥步行，就能抵达。充满广阔公园的缤纷灯光和未来主义公园设计极具吸引力，因此被认为是釜山的新晋夜景景点。
由于灯光明亮，因此也是一个可以更加安全地享受夜间散步的空间。公园本身就很宽敞，铺建了整洁的散步路，非常适合跑步，也很适合和孩子们或宠物犬一起夜游。
以釜山港大桥为背景的夜景美不胜收，主要作为夜间散步景点而闻名。但是，白天在散步路的路肩上也可以欣赏到茂密的潘帕斯草原景观，所以白天和夜晚都有各自独特的魅力。

北港亲水公园由多功能广场、草坪、地面喷泉和栈道等组成，为来到公园的游客奉上更加满意的体验。在北港亲水公园，可以欣赏到与市中心景观融为一体的美丽造景，推荐大家来这里度过愉快的夜晚。

desc_l10n.en:
Let’s learn more about the Busan North Port Redevelopment Promotion Hall, where you can enjoy a panoramic view of the sea and get a glimpse of the future of North Port!

Bukhang, or North Port, is gaining attention as Korea’s first port redevelopment project. The Busan North Port Redevelopment Promotion Hall is a space created to help visitors learn more about the project. Conveniently located near Busan Station, it’s situated within the Busan Port International Passenger Terminal for easy access.

The first thing you’ll notice is the breezy ocean view overlooking the North Port. The view alone is reason enough to come, but the comfortable interior and cozy seating make it even better.

The diorama showing the redevelopment of the North Port is also worth mentioning. You can also see the redevelopment vision in the promotional video! 

In addition to the redevelopment, you can learn about the history of Busan Port, making it a great place to explore both the past and future of the North Port.
If you want to catch a glimpse of the future of the North Port, which will become the heart of Busan with the upcoming changes, this is the place to be!
desc_l10n.ja:
解放感あふれる海を眺めながら北港の未来を垣間見る「北港再開発広報館」についてご紹介します。

韓国初の港湾再開発事業として注目されている北港。このような北港再開発をより具体的に知ってもらえるように造られたのが「北港再開発広報館」です。釜山駅からとても近く、国際旅客ターミナル内に位置しているので、アクセスが便利です。

まず目を引くのは、北港を一望できるオーシャンビューです。景色を眺めるためだけに訪れてもきっと満足できます。また、快適な内部と居心地の良い椅子も魅力です。

北港再開発で実現する北港の未来の姿が見られるジオラマも注目に値します。具体的な再開発のビジョンは、広報館で上映されている映像でも確認できます！

再開発に関する内容のほか、釜山港の歴史を知ることができる場所も用意されています。このように、北港の過去と未来を知る文化館としてもおすすめです。
新たな変化がもたらされ、釜山の中心地として注目を集める北港の未来を知りたい方は、ぜひ一度訪れてみてください！
desc_l10n.ko:
탁 트인 오션뷰를 배경으로 북항의 미래를 만나볼 수 있는 ‘북항 재개발 홍보관’, 함께 알아볼까요?


국내 최초 항만재개발사업으로 주목받고 있는 북항. 이런 북항 재개발을 보다 구체적으로 알아갈 수 있도록 조성된 공간이 바로 ‘북항 재개발 홍보관’입니다. 
부산역에서 아주 가깝고, 국제여객터미널 내 위치해 접근성이 좋습니다.


가장 먼저 시선을 끄는 요소는 북항이 한눈에 내려다보이는 시원한 오션뷰입니다. 경치를 감상하기 위해 찾아와도 만족할 정도인데요. 쾌적한 내부 환경과 편히 머무를 수 있는 자리도 매력 포인트입니다.


북항 재개발과 관련해 새롭게 개발될 북항의 모습을 구현한 디오라마도 주목할 만합니다.  구체적인 재개발 비전은 홍보관에서 상영하는 영상으로도 확인 가능하니 참고해주세요! 


재개발 관련 내용 외에, 부산항의 역사를 알 수 있는 공간도 마련돼있는데요. 때문에 북항의 과거와 미래를 알아가는 문화관으로서도 찾아가기 좋습니다.
새로운 변화를 통해 부산의 중심지로 떠오를 북항의 미래를 미리 엿보고 싶다면 한번 방문해 보세요!
desc_l10n.zh:
北港再开发宣传馆以开阔的海景为背景而建，是一个展望北港未来的地方，让我们一起来了解它吧。

北港因为韩国的首个港口再开发项目备受瞩目。为了让人们更具体地了解北港再开发而建造的空间就是“北港再开发宣传馆”。距离釜山站很近，位于釜山港国际客轮站内，交通便利。

最先吸引眼球的元素是将北港尽收眼底的开阔海景。哪怕只是为了欣赏风景而来，也会让人心满意足。宜人的内部环境和舒适的座位也是其魅力点。

关于北港再开发，立体透视模型呈现了新开发的北港面貌，值得关注。具体的再开发计划还可以通过宣传馆播放的视频了解，敬请参考！

除了再开发相关内容外，还设有可以了解釜山港历史的空间。因此，也很适合作为了解北港的过去和未来的文化馆参观。
如果您想提前了解通过新的变化跃升为釜山中心的北港的未来，那就来这里吧！

description:
Let’s learn more about the Busan North Port Redevelopment Promotion Hall, where you can enjoy a panoramic view of the sea and get a glimpse of the future of North Port!

Bukhang, or North Port, is gaining attention as Korea’s first port redevelopment project. The Busan North Port Redevelopment Promotion Hall is a space created to help visitors learn more about the project. Conveniently located near Busan Station, it’s situated within the Busan Port International Passenger Terminal for easy access.

The first thing you’ll notice is the breezy ocean view overlooking the North Port. The view alone is reason enough to come, but the comfortable interior and cozy seating make it even better.

The diorama showing the redevelopment of the North Port is also worth mentioning. You can also see the redevelopment vision in the promotional video! 

In addition to the redevelopment, you can learn about the history of Busan Port, making it a great place to explore both the past and future of the North Port.
If you want to catch a glimpse of the future of the North Port, which will become the heart of Busan with the upcoming changes, this is the place to be!
name: Perfect Promotion with Ocean View! Busan North Port Redevelopment Promotion Hall

desc_l10n.en:
Spend an artistic day at Buk-gu’s Culture and Arts Platform, where the spirit of culture and art is alive and well! 

The Culture and Arts Platform offers a variety of different art experience programs and exhibitions. In the lobby, you'll find charming handicrafts and unique pieces created by students. Some some of these unique handicrafts are available for purchase, and you’re sure to find something that grabs your attention as soon as you walk in.

On the first floor, you can take part in a variety of arts and crafts activities like writing, painting, ceramics, wood carving and more. Whether you’re a child who loves creating things or an adult with a passion for art, there's something for everyone.
The second floor has a lecture hall where various special lectures are held. The hands-on program and lecture schedules vary, so it’s a good idea to call ahead for details. 


The Manse Gallery, located on the third floor, hosts exhibitions with a different theme each time. The exhibitions are not only about art, but also about history and culture, which makes them even more meaningful.

If you're looking for a more intimate encounter with art and culture, check out the Culture and Arts Platform, a space where everyone can unleash their artistic side!
desc_l10n.ja:
文化と芸術が息づく北区の芸術施設「文化芸術プラットフォーム」で、アートで満ち溢れるひと時をお過ごしください！

様々なアート体験プログラムや展覧会が行われる「文化芸術プラットフォーム」。ロビーには可愛らしい工芸品や受講生の持ち味を活かした作品が陳列されており、個性豊かな工芸品を購入することもできるので、建物に足を踏み入れた瞬間から興味をそそられます。

1階では、作文、絵描き、陶芸、木彫りなど、様々な文化・芸術に関する体験が楽しめます。ものづくりが好きな子どもから芸術を愛する大人まで、みんなが幸せな時間を過ごすことができます。
2階には、各種講座が行われる講演会場があります。体験や講演は不定期で開催されるため、スケジュールが知りたい方はお電話でお問い合わせてください。


3階の万歳ギャラリーでは、毎回異なるテーマの展覧会が開催されます。アート作品に限らず歴史や文化を深く掘り下げた展示も行われますので、有意義な時間を過ごすことができそうです。

文化やアートを身近に感じたい方、誰もが秘めた内なるアーティストの一面を発揮できる「文化芸術プラットフォーム」で、楽しい時間をお過ごしください！
desc_l10n.ko:
문화와 예술이 살아 숨 쉬는 북구의 예술 공간, 문화예술플랫폼에서 예술적인 하루를 보내보세요!


다양한 예술 체험 프로그램과 전시가 진행되는 ‘문화예술플랫폼’. 로비에서부터 아기자기한 공예품들과 수강생들의 창의적인 작품이 진열돼 있는데요. 개성 넘치는 공예품들을 구매할 수도 있어 첫발부터 흥미를 자극합니다.


1층에서는 글쓰기, 그림, 도자기 공예, 나무 카빙을 비롯한 여러 문화예술 관련 체험을 즐길 수 있습니다. 만들기를 좋아하는 아이부터 예술을 사랑하는 어른들까지, 모두에게 행복한 시간을 선물하죠. 
2층에는 각종 특강이 진행되는 강연장이 마련돼있습니다. 체험과 강연의 경우 비정기적으로 진행되므로 일정과 관련해 궁금한 점은 전화 문의를 통해 안내받기를 추천합니다.


3층 만세갤러리에서는 매번 다른 주제로 전시회가 열립니다. 예술 작품뿐만 아니라 역사와 문화를 깊게 성찰할 수 있는 전시도 열려 더욱 의미가 깊습니다.

문화예술을 보다 친근하게 만나고 싶은 분들이라면, 누구나 예술가적 면모를 발휘할 수 있는 공간 ‘문화예술플랫폼’에서 즐거운 시간 보내보세요!
desc_l10n.zh:
请在呈现生动文化与艺术的北区艺术空间——文化艺术平台度过充满艺术气息的一天！

“文化艺术平台”举办各种艺术体验项目和展览。大厅里陈列着可爱的工艺品和学员们制作的个性艺术品。还可以购买个性洋溢的工艺品，从走进大厅的第一步起就激发了游客的兴趣。

在1楼可以享受写作、绘画、陶瓷工艺和木雕等各种文化艺术相关体验。从喜欢制作工艺品的孩子到热爱艺术的成年人，为所有人奉上幸福的时光。
2楼设有演讲厅，可以举办各种专题讲座。不定期举办体验和演讲，如果您想了解日程安排，建议致电咨询。


3楼的万岁画廊经常举办不同主题的展览会。不仅展出艺术作品，还举办可以让人深刻反思历史和文化的展览，因此意义更加深远。

如果您想进一步贴近文化艺术，就来“文化艺术平台”吧，请在所有人都可以发挥艺术家天赋的这个地方度过愉快的时光吧！

desc_l10n.en:
With the slogan “A place where books meet people and become a light and a guide," The Bookdoochilseong Library in Busan’s North Port immediately grabs attention with its towering stacks of books reaching the ceiling, cascading bookshelves, and Chaekoreum Plaza, where you can enjoy movies and performances.

The Bookdoochilseong Library is emerging as a new cultural complex and landmark in North Port, offering a diverse and creative cultural space that includes an academic center, cafe, and performance venue.
The library is divided into seven rooms, inspired by the motif of the Big Dipper constellation, with books arranged by theme and subject, making it easy for everyone to find something to read. The cozy and comfortable interior, where you can sit anywhere, inspires a desire to read.

The Bookdoocillseong Library is also known as a place to experience art and culture through various programs, such as the ‘Dodam Dodam Academy’, which fosters children's creativity, the ‘Sunset Concert’, which captures the romantic vibes of the sunset through musical performances, and ‘Single Men and Women's Love Story’, which explores the theme of love through reading and conversation. If you are interested, why not join one of them!
desc_l10n.ja:
「人と本が出会い、輝き、道標になる場所」というスローガンを掲げる北港の「北斗七星図書館」。天井まで並べられた無数の本が、人々の目を引きます。階段状の書架、そして映画や公演が楽しめるチェゴルム広場は、この図書館の象徴的な存在です。

新しい文化複合施設の北斗七星図書館は、学堂、カフェ、公演会場など多様でクリエイティブな文化施設の役割を果たし、北港のランドマークとして注目を集めています。
星座の北斗七星をモチーフに7つの空間に分けて設計されたこの図書館は、テーマや話題別に本が配置されているため、誰でも簡単にほしい本が見つけられます。どこでも座って本を読むことができる居心地の良いインテリアも、読書欲を刺激します。

北斗七星図書館は、様々なプログラムを通じて文化と芸術が享受できる施設としても広く知られています。子どもたちの創造性を育む「トダムドダムアカデミー」、感性をくすぐる夕暮れ時のライブ「夕暮れコンサート」、恋愛をテーマにした読書と対話を通じて本音で悩みを分かち合う「独身男女の恋愛話」など、様々なテーマのプログラムを楽しむことができるので、興味のある方はぜひ参加してみてください！
desc_l10n.ko:
‘책이 사람을 만나 빛이 되고 길이 되는 공간’이라는 슬로건을 건 북항의 ‘북두칠성 도서관’ 천장과 맞닿은 수많은 책이 단번에 시선을 사로잡습니다. 계단식 서가, 영화와 공연을 즐길 수 있는 책오름 광장은 이곳의 특징이죠.

북두칠성 도서관은 학당, 카페, 공연장 등 다양하고도 창의적인 문화공간의 역할을 톡톡히 해내며 새로운 문화복합공간이자 북항의 랜드마크로 떠오르고 있습니다.

북두칠성 별자리를 모티브로 7개 공간으로 설계된 북두칠성 도서관은 주제와 이슈별로 도서가 배치되어있어 누구나 쉽게 책을 찾을 수 있습니다. 어디든 앉아 책을 볼 수 있는 아늑하고 편안한 인테리어는 책 읽고 싶은 욕구를 자극하죠.


북두칠성 도서관은 다양한 프로그램을 통해 문화예술을 향유하는 공간으로도 유명한데요. 아이들의 창의성을 키워주는 ‘도담도담 아카데미’, 해질녘의 감성을 음악 공연으로 풀어내는 ‘해질녘 콘서트’, 연애를 주제로 독서와 대화를 통해 진솔한 고민을 나누는 ‘싱글남녀 연애이야기’ 등 다양한 주제의 프로그램을 즐길 수 있으니 관심 있으신 분들은 꼭 한번 참여해보세요!
desc_l10n.zh:
北港的“北斗七星图书馆”打出“书与人相遇，成为光芒和道路的空间”的标语，书籍与天花板衔接，一下子吸引了人们的视线。这里的特色是阶梯式书架及可以欣赏电影和演出的书岳广场。

北斗七星图书馆充分发挥学堂、咖啡厅和演出场地等各种创意性文化空间的作用，成为新的文化复合空间和北港地标。
北斗七星图书馆以北斗七星星座为主题设计了7个空间，根据主题和热门话题摆放书籍，所有人均可轻松查找书籍。可以坐在任何地方阅读书籍，温馨舒适的室内装饰激发了阅读的欲望。

北斗七星图书馆作为通过各种项目享受文化艺术的空间也非常有名。提供各个主题的项目，比如培养孩子创意性的“茁壮成长学院”、用音乐演出表达日落氛围的“日落演唱会”、以恋爱为主题、通过阅读和对话坦诚地分享苦恼的“单身男女恋爱故事”等，感兴趣的人一定要参加哦！
