desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Space K Seoul is pleased to present The Season We Fade Away, a solo exhibition by Moonassi (b. 1980). Rooted in the traditions of Korean painting, the artist has long explored the mind, human relationships, and the subtle inner currents that flow between them. In this exhibition, his paintings serve as both a journey following the flow of emotions and a site for quiet contemplation of the self. For Moonassi, each stroke that remains on paper resembles a ripple spreading across the surface of the mind—like a tremor that gently disturbs still water. Just as the faintest vibration expands into waves, the movements of the inner self—elusive and resistant to words—slowly take shape on the picture plane. The Season We Fade Away reflects on how emotions are born from and fade within relationships. Emotions are awakened and stirred by encounters with others. Like waves on the water, relationships and emotions seep into one another, exchanging light. The artist captures these moments of delicate balance: from figures facing one another, to sharing a gaze toward a single point, to pausing for a breath before a face reflected on the water’s surface. Moonassi does not suppress or define emotions. Instead, he chooses to let them be. This attitude of acceptance becomes a way of seeing the self reflected through others, leading to a quiet observation of one's own being amidst these fluctuations. As suggested by the characters in his name—"Mu (無: non-)" and "Na (我: self)"— his work traverses the boundaries between fullness and emptiness, the self and the other, peering into the space that lies between. In his compositions where the traditional ink meets modern sensibility, emotions do not simply disappear. Rather, they linger, changing form, only to resurface when the time is right. The Season We Fade Away is an exhibition that reflects our own faces on the surface of the water where emotion and relationship intersect. Viewers are invited to accept emotions as they are and, in passing through the tremors of relationships, encounter a quiet moment of return to the self.
desc_l10n.ko: 무나씨는 한국화를 기반으로 마음과 관계, 그리고 그 사이를 흐르는 내면의 파동을 오래 탐구해 왔습니다. 그의 개인전 《우리가 지워지는 계절에》은 감정이 관계 속에서 어떻게 태어나고, 또 어떻게 사라지는지를 바라봅니다. 감정은 타인과의 마주침에서 깨어나 흔들리고 관계와 감정은 수면 위의 물결처럼 서로에게 스며들며 빛을 교환합니다. 작가는 그 미묘한 균형의 순간을 붙잡습니다. 서로 마주하거나, 한 곳을 향해 시선을 나누거나, 맑은 물 위에 반사된 얼굴 앞에서 잠시 숨 고르는 순간까지. 감정과 관계가 교차하는 수면 위에서 우리 각자의 얼굴을 비추는 전시입니다. 감정을 있는 그대로 받아들이고, 관계의 떨림을 지나 다시 자신에게 돌아오는 고요한 순간과 만나실 수 있습니다.

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Space K Seoul is pleased to present The Season We Fade Away, a solo exhibition by Moonassi (b. 1980). Rooted in the traditions of Korean painting, the artist has long explored the mind, human relationships, and the subtle inner currents that flow between them. In this exhibition, his paintings serve as both a journey following the flow of emotions and a site for quiet contemplation of the self. For Moonassi, each stroke that remains on paper resembles a ripple spreading across the surface of the mind—like a tremor that gently disturbs still water. Just as the faintest vibration expands into waves, the movements of the inner self—elusive and resistant to words—slowly take shape on the picture plane. The Season We Fade Away reflects on how emotions are born from and fade within relationships. Emotions are awakened and stirred by encounters with others. Like waves on the water, relationships and emotions seep into one another, exchanging light. The artist captures these moments of delicate balance: from figures facing one another, to sharing a gaze toward a single point, to pausing for a breath before a face reflected on the water’s surface. Moonassi does not suppress or define emotions. Instead, he chooses to let them be. This attitude of acceptance becomes a way of seeing the self reflected through others, leading to a quiet observation of one's own being amidst these fluctuations. As suggested by the characters in his name—"Mu (無: non-)" and "Na (我: self)"— his work traverses the boundaries between fullness and emptiness, the self and the other, peering into the space that lies between. In his compositions where the traditional ink meets modern sensibility, emotions do not simply disappear. Rather, they linger, changing form, only to resurface when the time is right. The Season We Fade Away is an exhibition that reflects our own faces on the surface of the water where emotion and relationship intersect. Viewers are invited to accept emotions as they are and, in passing through the tremors of relationships, encounter a quiet moment of return to the self.
name: Munassi 《The Season We Fade Away》

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The “Seoul Mini Mountains” exhibition is rooted in a research project by Borio-Lab, led by Géraldine Borio, an assistant professor at the University of Hong Kong’s Department of Architecture. With over 17 years of architectural and urban research experience across Asian cities such as Bangkok, Hong Kong, and Seoul, Professor Borio’s work forms the foundation of this exhibition. Jointly presented with the Seoul Museum of History, the exhibition revisits Seoul’s urban landscape by investigating the role and impact of voids (empty spaces) in the city center on its urban narrative and identity. The exhibition highlights Seoul's distinctive topography through photographs and drawings created by Professor Borio and her students. This research delves into how historical developments have shaped the voids in Seoul and how their ‘boundaries’ have changed. It analyzes these spaces through the observation of the ‘activities’ occurring within these undeveloped areas. You are invited to take part in this meaningful opportunity to experience a foreign scholar’s fresh perspective on Seoul and to reflect on the value of seeing spaces and objects in a new light. We look forward to your visit.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 今回の展示は、バンコク、香港、ソウルなどアジアで17年以上にわたって建築と都市の研究を行ってきた、香港大学建築学科のジェラルディン・ボリオ(Géraldine Borio)准教授が運営する研究所、ボリオラボ(Borio-Lab)の研究プロジェクトの一環として、成果の一つである「ソウルの小さな山-SEOUL MINI MOUNTAINS」をテーマに、ソウル歴史博物館と共同で開催されるものです。 「ソウルの小さな山」展では、ソウルの中心部に残るボイド(空間)が果たす役割と、それが都市の物語やアイデンティティに与える影響を探りながら、ソウルを再評価することを目的としています。ジェラルディン・ボリオ准教授と学生たちが撮影した写真やドローイングを通じて、ソウルの特徴的な地形を紹介しています。 この研究は、ソウルにおけるボイドが「歴史」の流れの中でどのように形成され、ボイドの「境界」がどのように変化したかを考察するとともに、ボイドの未開発地域で行われている「活動」を観察することによって、都市のボイドを分析しています。 外国人学者の視点でソウルを再解釈した研究成果を市民の皆様と共有する貴重な機会ですので、ぜひご来場いただき、空間や物事を新たな視点で捉える重要性を再認識するきっかけとしていただければと思います。多くの方々のご観覧をお待ちしています。
desc_l10n.ko: 이번 전시는 방콕, 홍콩, 서울 등 아시아에서 17년 이상 건축 및 도시 연구를 진행해 온 홍콩대학교 건축학과 제럴딘 보리오 (Géraldine Borio) 조교수가 운영하는 연구소, 보리오 랩(Borio-Lab)의 연구 프로젝트 중 하나인 ‘서울의 작은 산-SEOUL MINI MOUNTAINS’이라는 결과물을 바탕으로, 서울역사박물관과 공동으로 개최된 전시입니다. 서울 도심에 남은 보이드(빈 공간)가 하는 역할과 도시 서사 및 정체성에 미치는 영향을 탐구하여 서울을 재조명하는 <서울의 작은 산>展은 제럴딘 보리오 조교수와 학생들이 직접 찍은 사진과 드로잉을 통해 서울의 특수한 지형을 보여주는 전시입니다. 해당 연구는 서울 내 보이드가 '역사'의 흐름에 따라 어떻게 형성되었는지, 보이드의 '경계'가 어떻게 변화됐는지를 살펴볼 수 있으며, 보이드의 미개발 영역 내부에서 이루어지는 '활동'의 관찰을 통해 도시의 보이드를 분석했습니다. 외국인 학자의 눈으로 서울을 재해석한 연구를 시민들과 공유할 수 있게 된 귀한 자리에 발걸음해 주신다면, 공간과 사물을 새롭게 대하는 시각에 대한 소중함을 되새기는 기회가 될 것입니다. 많은 관람 부탁드립니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 本次展览是基于香港大学建筑系助理教授Géraldine Borio运营的研究所——Borio-Lab的研究项目“首尔的小山-SEOUL MINI MOUNTAINS”的成果。该项目是在曼谷、香港、首尔等亚洲城市进行超过17年的建筑及城市研究的结晶。本次展览由Borio-Lab与首尔历史博物馆共同举办。 探索首尔市中心空隙的作用、城市叙事以及对认同感的影响，重新审视了名为《首尔的小山》的展览。该展览通过Géraldine Borio教授及其学生们亲自拍摄的照片和素描，展示了首尔特殊的地形特征。 该研究旨在探讨首尔市内的void是如何随着历史的发展而形成的，以及边界或特性是如何变化的。通过观察这些未开发领域内部的活动，分析了城市中现状。如果能够有幸站在与市民共享的角度，借助外国学者的独特视角重新诠释首尔，这将是一个极为宝贵的机会，重温对空间和事物的新认识。诚邀大家多多关注这项研究。

desc_l10n.ko: 한국 창작춤의 산실, 서울시무용단이 선보이는 현대적 감각으로 재해석한 전통춤의 본질. 세계가 주목하는 K-스타일의 전통복식과 함께 물, 바람, 흙, 번개, 허공, 하늘, 불, 빛 여덟 가지의 색을 담아 은유적이고도 강렬한 무대를 선보입니다. 시대를 넘어 이어져 온 전통이 우리의 몸 안에서 다시 살아나는 순간을 함께하시길 바랍니다.

desc_l10n.ko: 한상윤 작가의 작품 속에 등장하는 돼지는 행복을 전해줍니다. 2024년 10월, 삼세영에서 낙천적이며 기쁨을 주는 돼지를 그리는 한상윤 작가의 전시를 개최함으로 행복한 돼지의 꿈과 희망, 해학미의 추구를 느낄 수 있는 기회가 될 것으로 기대합니다.

desc_l10n.ko: 코오롱그룹이 운영하는 문화예술 나눔공간으로, 동시대 미술을 조명하는 다양한 전시가 열리는 비영리 미술관입니다. 국내외 작가들의 창작을 소개하며 시민들에게 열린 문화 교류의 장을 제공합니다. 현대적인 건축과 감각적인 전시 연출로 예술 애호가들에게 주목받고 있습니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Centering on Korean traditional orchestra, the performance creates a new resonance that harmonizes diverse sound bodies including Western instruments, merging tradition and modernity, past and future. Expanding the possibilities of Korean orchestral music, the Seoul Metropolitan Traditional Orchestra presents an evolved identity of K-Orchestra through this <Next Level> stage, the representative series Mixed Orchestra. The program features Manchun-gok, the starting point of creative Korean orchestral music; Susang-gok, highlighting the clear tone of the Danso; a collaborative performance by geomungo performer and producer Park Daul; and premieres of new works by composers Kim Hyunseop and Lee Gowoon. The performance brings together tradition and creation, past and future, on one stage, showcasing a new dimension of Korean orchestral sound. Celebrating its 60th anniversary this year, the Seoul Metropolitan Traditional Orchestra shares the resonance of our music that combines the depth of tradition with contemporary sensibility. Experience the new leap of the Korean-style orchestra at Mixed Orchestra <Next Level>.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 国楽管弦楽を中心に西洋楽器など多様な音響が調和し、伝統と現代、過去と未来が共存する新しい響きをお届けします。国楽管弦楽の可能性を拡張してきたソウル市国楽管弦楽団の代表シリーズであるミックスドオーケストラは、今回の<ネクストレベル>の舞台を通じて、さらに進化したK-オーケストラのアイデンティティを披露します。創作国楽管弦楽の出発点となった晩春曲、短簫の澄んだ音色が引き立つ受賞曲、コムンゴ演奏者でありプロデューサーのパク・ダウルの協演舞台、そして常駐作曲家のキム・ヒョンソプ、イ・ゴウンの新作初演まで、伝統と創作、過去と未来が一つの舞台で出会い、国楽管弦楽の新たな次元を切り開きます。今年創立60周年を迎えたソウル市国楽管弦楽団は、長い歴史と遺産をもとに、伝統の深さに現代的な感覚を加え、韓国音楽の現在と未来を盛り込んだ響きを観客と分かち合います。韓国型オーケストラの新しい跳躍、ミックスドオーケストラ<ネクストレベル>で体験してみてください。
desc_l10n.ko: 국악관현악을 중심으로 서양악기 등 다양한 음향체가 어우러져 전통과 현대, 과거와 미래가 공존하는 새로운 울림을 선사합니다. 국악관현악의 가능성을 확장해온 서울시국악관현악단의 대표 시리즈 믹스드 오케스트라는 이번 <넥스트 레벨> 무대를 통해 한층 더 진화한 K-Orchestra의 정체성을 선보입니다. 창작 국악관현악의 출발점이 된 만춘곡, 단소의 맑은 음색이 돋보이는 수상곡, 거문고 연주자이자 프로듀서 박다울의 협연 무대, 그리고 상주작곡가 김현섭·이고운의 신작 초연까지—전통과 창작, 과거와 미래가 하나의 무대에서 만나 국악관현악의 새로운 차원을 보여줍니다. 올해 창단 60주년을 맞은 서울시국악관현악단은 오랜 역사와 유산을 바탕으로, 전통의 깊이에 현대적 감각을 더해 우리 음악의 현재와 미래를 담은 울림을 관객과 나눕니다. 한국형 오케스트라의 새로운 도약, 믹스드 오케스트라 <넥스트 레벨〉에서 경험해보세요.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 以国乐管弦乐为核心，融合西洋乐器等多元声效，缔造传统与现代、过去与未来共存的全新音境。首尔市国乐管弦乐团代表系列“混合管弦乐团”拓展了国乐管弦乐的可能性，本次通过《Next Level》舞台展现了升级版的K-Orchestra的本质特点。从开创国乐管弦乐创作先河的《满春曲》，到凸显短箫清越音色的《随想曲》；从伽倻琴演奏家兼制作人朴多蔚的协奏舞台，到驻团作曲家金贤燮·李高云的新作首演，传统与创作、过去与未来在同一舞台上交汇，展现国乐管弦乐的全新维度。迎来创团60周年的首尔市国乐管弦乐团，将以深厚的历史和遗产为根基，在传统底蕴中融入现代感性，与观众共享承载韩国音乐当下与未来的声音。敬请莅临混合管弦乐团《Next Level》，共同见证韩式管弦乐的全新飞跃。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Centering on Korean traditional orchestra, the performance creates a new resonance that harmonizes diverse sound bodies including Western instruments, merging tradition and modernity, past and future. Expanding the possibilities of Korean orchestral music, the Seoul Metropolitan Traditional Orchestra presents an evolved identity of K-Orchestra through this <Next Level> stage, the representative series Mixed Orchestra. The program features Manchun-gok, the starting point of creative Korean orchestral music; Susang-gok, highlighting the clear tone of the Danso; a collaborative performance by geomungo performer and producer Park Daul; and premieres of new works by composers Kim Hyunseop and Lee Gowoon. The performance brings together tradition and creation, past and future, on one stage, showcasing a new dimension of Korean orchestral sound. Celebrating its 60th anniversary this year, the Seoul Metropolitan Traditional Orchestra shares the resonance of our music that combines the depth of tradition with contemporary sensibility. Experience the new leap of the Korean-style orchestra at Mixed Orchestra <Next Level>.
name: Mixed Orchestra : Next Level

Opened in April 2013, the Seongbuk Young Art Space has made continuous attempts to discover creative and experimental artists, and furthermore, to build an open art culture through networking and collaboration based on the local community. As a specialized space for visual arts, the Seongbuk Young Art Space is establishing itself as a venue of experience where creators from multiple genres, including youth and emerging artists, prepare for the future and accumulate experiences together.

desc_l10n.ko: 성북예술창작터는 시각예술분야의 창작자를 지원·양성하고, 창작의 다양한 지형에서 실험을 이어가는 ‘살아있는 창작의 공간’으로 조성된 성북구립미술관의 첫 번째 분관입니다. 2013년 4월 문을 연 성북예술창작터는 창의적이고 실험적인 예술가를 발견하고, 나아가 지역-커뮤니티를 기반으로 한 네트워킹 및 협업으로 열린 미술문화를 만들어가기 위한 지속적인 시도를 이어왔습니다. 성북예술창작터는 시각예술전문공간으로서 청년, 신진 작가를 포함하여 다장르의 창작자들과 함께 미래를 준비하고 축적해나가는 경험의 장으로 자리매김하고 있습니다.

It pursues diversity in the art market as a space that creates synergy by connecting the ideas presented by artists to the public, and as a supporter that encourages the discovery of new tastes.

desc_l10n.ko: 드로잉룸(dR)은 시대성과 작가정신을 지향하는 현대미술의 친숙한 경험 전달을 위한 상업 전시 공간입니다. dR은 동시대 작가의 시각 언어를 이끌고 움직이는(draw) 매개체 역할에 충실하고자 합니다. 대중에게 예술가들이 제시한 아이디어를 연결하여 시너지를 만드는 공간이자 새로운 취향을 발견할 수 있도록 지지하는 조력자로 미술시장의 다양성을 추구합니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The citizen docent program of the 2025 Cheonggyecheon Public Art Project Cheonggye Coexistence, celebrating the 20th anniversary of the Cheonggyecheon Restoration, offers an opportunity to revisit the history and spatial meaning of Cheonggyecheon and to deeply understand how various artworks connect the city, people, and nature. Stroll along the works as if taking a walk through the city center, and experience a time of sharing thoughts embedded in each piece beyond simple appreciation. [Schedule] English docent program for foreigners: November 20 (Thursday), 15:00–15:50 [How to Apply] Apply by email at cheonggye.art@gmail.com from October 27 (Monday) to November 7 (Friday). Please include your name and contact information. Participants will be contacted separately regarding selection results. [Capacity] 15 people Children may participate when accompanied by a guardian. [Program Structure] Orientation (5 minutes) – Introduction to the history and spatial significance of Cheonggyecheon, and explanation of the purpose and concept of the Cheonggye Coexistence project Artwork Tour (40 minutes) – A docent-led walking tour of six public art pieces, sharing insights on the planning, design, and production of each work, as well as the artists’ intentions, followed by a Q&A and discussion with participants Conclusion (5 minutes) – Sharing impressions of the artworks, guidance on satisfaction survey participation Walk along the flow of Cheonggyecheon and immerse yourself in the world of public art. A new artistic experience awaits, beginning with your own perspective.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} チョンゲチョン(清渓川)復元20周年を記念して行われる2025チョンゲチョン(清渓川)公共美術プロジェクト《チョンゲ(清渓)共存》で市民ドーセントプログラムを運営します。チョンゲチョン(清渓川)の歴史と空間的意味を見つめ直し、さまざまな芸術作品が都市と人、自然をつなぐ方法を深く理解できる機会です。都心の中を散歩するように作品に沿って歩きながら、単なる観覧を超えて作品に込められた考えを一緒に分かち合う時間を体験してみてください。 [日程] 外国人向け英語解説プログラム：11月20日(木)15:00~15:50 [参加方法] 10月27日(月)~11月7日(金)にEメールにて申込 cheonggye.art@gmail.com *参加者氏名、連絡先は必須記載、参加可否は別途連絡 [募集人数]15人 *子どもは保護者同伴可能 [プログラム構成] 1. オリエンテーション(5分) - チョンゲチョン(清渓川)の歴史と空間的意味の紹介、《チョンゲ(清渓)共存》プロジェクトの趣旨および企画意図について説明 2. 作品ツアー(40分) - 計6点の公共美術作品に沿って歩くドーセントツアー、作品別企画・設計・制作ビハインドおよび作家の意図伝達、市民と共にする質疑応答および討論進行 3. まとめ(5分) - 今日の本作の中で印象深かった点を共有、満足度調査の参加案内 チョンゲチョン(清渓川)の流れに沿って繰り広げられる公共美術の世界へ一緒に歩いてみましょう。あなたの視線から始まる新しい芸術体験が待っています。
desc_l10n.ko: 청계천 복원 20주년을 기념해 진행되는 2025 청계천 공공미술 프로젝트 《청계공존》에서 시민 도슨트 프로그램을 운영합니다. 청계천의 역사와 공간적 의미를 다시 바라보고, 다양한 예술작품이 도시와 사람, 자연을 연결하는 방식을 깊이 있게 이해할 수 있는 기회입니다. 도심 속 산책하듯 작품을 따라 걸으며, 단순한 관람을 넘어 작품에 담긴 생각을 함께 나누는 시간을 경험해 보세요. [일정] 외국인 대상 영어해설 프로그램: 11. 20.(목) 15:00 ~ 15:50 [참여방법] 10.27(월) ~ 11.7(금) 기간 동안 이메일 신청 cheonggye.art@gmail.com *참가자 성함, 연락처 필수 기재, 참가 여부 별도 연락 [모집인원] 15명 *어린이는 보호자 동반 가능 [프로그램 구성] 1. 오리엔테이션 (5분) - 청계천 역사와 공간적 의미 소개, 《청계공존》 프로젝트 취지 및 기획 의도 설명 2. 작품 투어 (40분) - 총 6점의 공공미술 작품을 따라 걷는 도슨트 투어, 작품별 기획·설계·제작 비하인드 및 작가 의도 전달, 시민과 함께하는 질의응답 및 토론 진행 3. 마무리 (5분) - 오늘 본 작품 중 인상 깊었던 점 공유, 만족도 조사 참여 안내 청계천의 흐름을 따라 펼쳐지는 공공미술의 세계로 함께 걸어보세요. 당신의 시선에서 시작되는 새로운 예술 경험이 기다립니다.

It welcomes visitors with a new exhibition that shares serious yet engaging imagination about the art needed in the present and future.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 今回の展示は気候危機、人類の時代の美術は何をし、どのように存在すべきかを問い、人間中心主義から抜け出し「他の」感覚と思惟、態度で美術を実践します。現在と未来に必要な美術に対する真剣で興味深い想像力を分かち合う新しい展示に観覧客の皆様を招待します。
desc_l10n.ko: 이번 전시는 기후 위기, 인류세 시대 미술은 무엇을 하고 어떻게 존재해야 하는지를 질문하며 인간 중심주의에서 벗어나 '다른' 감각과 사유, 태도로 미술을 실천합니다. 현재와 미래에 필요한 미술에 대한 진지하고도 흥미로운 상상력을 나누는 새로운 전시로 관람객 여러분을 반갑게 맞이하겠습니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 本次展览在探讨气候危机、人类时代美术应该做什么、如何存在的同时，告诉我们要摆脱人类中心主义，用“不同”的感觉、思维和态度来实践美术。我们将通过分享对现在和未来所需美术的真挚有趣的想象力的新展览，热情地欢迎每位参观者。

In 2024, the theme of “The Moving Grand Theater” is a beautiful journey where Baby Bear Harry and a girl set out to find the world's greatest Christmas show. LE GRANDE THEATRE will be held at The Hyundai Seoul's Sounds Forest, offering an enchanting experience akin to a grand Christmas circus show. This meticulously designed space provides unforgettable memories and opportunities to capture stunning photos that will last a lifetime. This winter, escape the cold and visit The Hyundai Seoul's H Village for a delightful indoor experience.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ヨイド(汝矣島)のランドマークである「ザ・現代ソウル」では、毎年クリスマスシーズンに特別な体験型展示を開催し、訪れる人々がその雰囲気を存分に楽しめるよう工夫されています。2024年は、「小さなクマのハリーと少女が、世界最高のクリスマスショー『移動劇場』を探しに出かける美しい旅」をテーマにしたLE GRANDE THEATREが、ザ・現代ソウルのSounds Forestで開催されます。まるでクリスマスの大型サーカスショーに迷い込んだかのような感動と幻想的な雰囲気を同時に楽しめるこの展示では、細部までこだわり抜いた空間で忘れられない思い出を作ることができ、一生の宝物になるような素敵な写真も残せます。寒い冬、室内で楽しめるザ・現代ソウルのHヴィレッジにぜひ足を運んでみてください。
desc_l10n.ko: 여의도의 랜드마크인 더 현대 서울은 매년 크리스마스 시즌마다 특별한 체험 전시를 선보여, 방문객들이 그 분위기를 마음껏 즐길 수 있도록 한다. 2024년에는 '아기곰 해리와 소녀가 세계 최고의 크리스마스 쇼 "움직이는 대극장"을 찾아 떠나는 아름다운 여정'을 테마로, 더 현대 서울 사운즈 포레스트에서 펼쳐지는 LE GRANDE THEATRE가 진행된다. 마치 크리스마스의 대형 서커스 쇼에 들어온 듯한 감동과 몽환적인 분위기를 동시에 느낄 수 있는 이곳은, 세심하게 꾸며진 공간에서 잊지 못할 추억을 만들고 평생 간직할 수 있는 멋진 사진도 남길 수 있다. 추운 겨울, 실내에서 즐길 수 있는 더현대서울 H빌리지를 방문해보자.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 汝矣岛上的标志性建筑“The Hyundai Seoul”每年圣诞节都会举办特别的体验展览，让访客们沉浸于节日的欢乐氛围之中。2024年，该活动将以“小熊哈利与少女踏上寻觅世界顶级圣诞秀大剧场的奇妙旅程”为主题，在“The Hyundai Seoul”的Sounds Forest区域呈现LEGRANDE THEATRE。在这里，访客们将仿佛置身于一场盛大的圣诞杂技表演之中，感受那份激动人心的感动与梦幻般的氛围。精心装饰的空间将为大家提供留下难忘回忆的完美场所，同时，也能捕捉到值得珍藏一生的精彩瞬间。在寒冷的冬日里，不妨前来参观一下室内可享的“The Hyundai Seoul H Village”，享受这份独特的节日体验吧。

In 2024, the theme of “The Moving Grand Theater” is a beautiful journey where Baby Bear Harry and a girl set out to find the world's greatest Christmas show. LE GRANDE THEATRE will be held at The Hyundai Seoul's Sounds Forest, offering an enchanting experience akin to a grand Christmas circus show. This meticulously designed space provides unforgettable memories and opportunities to capture stunning photos that will last a lifetime. Since its founding, Gallery Chosun has participated in Art Cologne and Art Basel Miami, focusing on contemporary art exhibitions to promote Korean contemporary art internationally.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 2004年に開館したギャラリー朝鮮は、韓国の作家の国際市場進出のため、ドイツのART COLOGNE、東京のNICAF、北京のCIGEなどに参加し、韓国で400件余りの展示を開催してきた朝鮮画廊に母体を置いています。2004年に開館した後、ART COLOGNEやアート・バーゼル・マイアミ・ビーチなどに参加し、contemporary artを中心に企画展示を行い、韓国の現代美術を世界に知らせています。
desc_l10n.ko: 2004년 개관한 갤러리조선은 국내작가들의 국제시장 진출을 위해 독일의 ART COLOGNE, 동경의 NICAF, 베이징의 CIGE 등에 참가하고 400여건의 국내전시를 개최해온 조선 화랑에 모체를 두고 있습니다. 2004년 개관한 이후 아트 퀠른과 아트 바젤 마이애미 아트페어 등에 참가하며 contemporary art를 중심으로 기획 전시 하여 한국 현대미술을 세계에 알리고 있습니다.

desc_l10n.en: Superior Gallery presents Gave At Exhibition by artists Baek Ji-hye and Jeong Yeon-yeon to welcome the refreshing autumn. The artist Baek Ji-hye applies traditional portrait techniques to contemporary portrayals, emphasizing feminine sensibilities with a focus on 'girls' and infusing emotional elements into her work. She researched and reinterpreted portraits from the Joseon Dynasty era, giving birth to “realistic girl painting” and creating traditional color paintings from a feminine perspective. Artist Jeong Yeon-yeon addresses women's diversity and social reality in a bright and honest tone, expressing her hope for peace by breaking down discrimination with classic blue, which symbolizes male authority. Experience the unique perspectives of two artists searching for hope beyond boundaries at Superior Gallery. The Gaze At exhibition by artists Baek Ji-hye and Jeong Yeon-yeon will run until November 9th.
desc_l10n.ja: さわやかな秋を迎え、Superior Galleryでは、作家のペク·チヘ、チョン·ヨンヨンの特別企画展『パラボダ(眺める)展』開催します。ペク·チヘは、伝統肖像画技法を現代人物画に活用し、「少女」を中心に女性的感受性を強調し、感情的な要素を表現します。また、朝鮮王朝時代の肖像画を研究·再解釈し、「真彩少女画」を誕生させ、女性的な視点で伝統彩色画を描き出します。チョン·ヨンヨンは、女性の多様性と社会的な面での現実を明るく率直なタッチで表現しながら、男性権威を象徴するクラシックブルーを使い、差別をなくし平和を願う気持ちを作品に表現しました。境界を越えて希望を探す二人の作家の「眺め」をSuperior Galleryでご覧ください。ペク·チヘ、チョン·ヨンヨンの『パラボダ(眺める)展』は、11月9日まで行われます。
desc_l10n.ko: 슈페리어갤러리는 싱그러운 가을을 맞아 백지혜, 정연연 작가의 특별한 기획전‘바라보다 展’을 선보입니다. 백지혜 작가는 전통 초상화 기법을 현대 인물화에 적용하여 '소녀'를 중심으로 여성적 감수성을 강조해 감정적인 요소를 녹여냅니다. 조선시대 초상화를 연구하고 재해석하여 '진채소녀화'를 탄생시켰으며, 여성적인 시각으로 전통 채색화를 그려냅니다. 정연연 작가는 여성의 다양성과 사회적 현실을 밝고 솔직한 어조로 다루며, 남성 권위를 상징하는 클래식 블루로 차별을 허물어 평화의 시간을 바라는 마음을 작품에 담아냈습니다. 경계를 넘어 희망을 찾는 두 작가의 특별한 바라보기를 슈페리어갤러리에서 온전히 느껴보시기 바랍니다. 백지혜, 정연연 작가의 ‘바라보다 展’은 오는 11월 9일까지 진행됩니다.
desc_l10n.zh: Superior Gallery为了迎接清新的秋天，将带来Park Jihye、Jung Yeonyeon画家的双人展《凝视展》。 Park Jihye作家将传统肖像画技法运用到现代人物画中，以‘少女’为中心，强调女性的感受力，融入了感情要素。研究并重新诠释了朝鲜时代的肖像画，诞生了‘真彩少女画’，以女性的视角描绘传统彩色画。Jung Yeonyeon以明朗、真实的语调讲述了女性的多样性和社会现实，用象征男性权威的古典蓝色消除其实，在作品中表达了最和平的期望。希望在Superior Gallery体会到越过界限、寻找希望的两位作家的特别品味。Park Jihye、Jung Yeonyeon画家的《凝视展》将截止11月9日展出。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} In anticipation of the opening of the Seoul Metropolitan Museum of Photography in 2024, a major retrospective exhibition titled "KooBohnchang’s Voyages" will be held, featuring the works of Koo Bohnchang (born 1953), an icon of modern Korean photography as well as contemporary art. This exhibition will display over 500 works and around 600 materials, ranging from Koo Bohnchang's first work, "Self-Portrait" (1968), to his most recent works. It showcases the deep and expansive world of the artist's creations. Following the artist's artistic journey, we invite you to embark on a new voyage, starting from the 'Room of Curiosity,’ passing through 'Adventurous Journey, One World, Temple of the Soul,’ and concluding with 'The Open Room.’
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 2024年ソウル市立写真美術館開館を控え、韓国現代写真だけでなく同時代美術を代表するク・ボンチャン(具本昌)(1953)の大規模回顧展『ク・ボンチャン(具本昌)の航海』を開催します。 今回の展示は、ク・ボンチャン(具本昌)の航海の最初の作品である『自画像(Self-Portrait)』(1968)から最近の作品まで500点余りの作品と600点余りの資料を展示し、作家の深くて広い作品世界を披露します。作家の芸術航路に沿って「好奇心の部屋」から、「冒険の旅路、一つの世界、魂の寺院」を経て「開かれた部屋」を最後に新しい航海の展示をご覧ください。
desc_l10n.ko: 2024년 서울시립 사진미술관 개관을 앞두고 한국 현대사진뿐만 아니라 동시대 미술을 대표하는 구본창(具本昌, 1953)의 대규모 회고전 《구본창의 항해》를 개최합니다. 이번 전시는 구본창의 첫 작품인 〈자화상(Self-Portrait)〉(1968)부터 최근 작품까지 500여 점의 작품과 600여 점의 자료를 전시해 작가의 깊고 넓은 작품세계를 선보입니다. 작가의 예술 항로를 따라 ‘호기심의 방’에서 출발해 ‘모험의 여정, 하나의 세계, 영혼의 사원’을 거쳐 ‘열린 방’을 끝으로 다시 새로운 항해를 떠나보시기를 바랍니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 2024年首尔市立摄影美术馆即将开馆，除了韩国现代摄影，还将举办代表同时代美术的具本昌(1953)的大规模回顾展《具本昌的航海》。 本次展览展示了从具本昌的第一部作品《自画像(Self-Portrait)》(1968)，到最近的作品共500幅作品和600多件资料，可以了解到艺术家有深度、领域广的作品世界。顺着艺术家的艺术航线，从‘好奇心之屋’出发，经过‘冒险的旅行，一个世界、灵魂的寺院’，再以‘开放的房间’为终点，再次踏上新的航海旅程。

It offers complete immersion in nature through observatories overlooking the Seoul cityscape as well as gardens. Along with a spatial composition allowing quiet contemplation and appreciation of works, it is equipped with sensational lighting, spacious pathways, and comfortable resting spaces, allowing anyone of all ages to naturally feel the charm of art. It is drawing attention as a famous Gangseo exhibition and Magok exhibition attraction that everyone can enjoy together, from family visitors to couples, friends, and office workers. It is highly suitable as a date spot for special days or a weekend outing course, serving as an open art museum where anyone can comfortably experience the world of art. For the convenience of visitors, it is located near Magok Station, offering excellent accessibility. Various cultural facilities and commercial spaces co-locate within the One Grove Mall, allowing you to enjoy dining or shopping together after viewing exhibitions.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} マイアートミュージアム・ワングローブ店は、忙しい日常の中でも芸術を身近に感じられるよう、快適で洗練された展示環境を提供しています。静かに思索にふけりながら作品を鑑賞できる空間構成に加え、感性豊かな照明、ゆとりのある動線、心地よい休憩スペースまで完備されており、老若男女問わず誰もが自然に芸術の魅力に触れることができます。 家族連れからカップル、友人、そして仕事帰りの方まで、誰もが楽しめるカンソ(江西)・マゴク(麻谷)エリアを代表する展示スポットとして注目を集めています。特別な日のデートや週末のお出かけコースとしても最適で、誰もが気軽に芸術の世界を体験できる開かれた美術館です。 また、アクセスにも優れており、マゴク(ホーム&ショッピング)駅からほど近く、ワングローブモール内の多様な文化施設や商業施設が隣接しているため、展示を鑑賞した後に食事やショッピングを楽しむこともできます。
desc_l10n.ko: 마이아트뮤지엄 원그로브점은 현대인의 바쁜 일상 속에서도 예술을 부담 없이 접할 수 있도록 쾌적하고 세련된 전시 환경을 제공합니다. 조용히 사색하며 작품을 감상할 수 있는 공간 구성과 함께 감각적인 조명, 여유로운 동선, 편안한 휴식 공간까지 마련되어 있어 남녀노소 누구나 자연스럽게 예술의 매력을 느낄 수 있습니다. 가족 단위 관람객부터 연인, 친구, 직장인까지 모두가 함께 즐길 수 있는 강서전시회, 마곡전시회 명소로 주목받고 있습니다. 특별한 날의 데이트 장소나 주말 나들이 코스로도 제격이며 누구나 부담 없이 예술의 세계를 경험할 수 있는 열린 미술관입니다. 관람객 편의를 위해 마곡역 인근에 위치해 접근성이 뛰어나며 원그로브몰 내 다양한 문화시설과 상업공간이 함께 있어 전시 관람 후 식사나 쇼핑을 함께 즐길 수 있습니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Superior Gallery presents a three-artist exhibition The Exhibition 《I Will Come to Like》 by Oksuk, Phonormal, and Frida Ok in October 2025. The three participating artists, who work on both illustration shared in digital environments and original paintings, reconstruct moments of daily life into memories and show a wide range of diversity in works through their respective colors and distinctive expressions. Oksuk calmly yet vividly depicts scenes of rest and travel discovered in urban daily life, expanding into “emotional landscapes” that record brief moments of rest within a busy life. Phonormal humorously expresses daily life and inner emotions, and through playful color contrasts and composition, completes scenes in which remembered thoughts and new imagery are naturally combined. Frida Ok portrays stories of elderly couples and natural landscapes with warm sentiments, visually conveying the warmth and accumulated time of life through repetitive brushstrokes and the dense flower paths in which the elderly couples appear. This exhibition aims to deliver visual pleasure and empathy through the works of the three artists and to provide a place where viewers can encounter “scenes they will come to like” within their own memories and emotions. The Exhibition 《I Will Come to Like》 runs until November 6, 2025.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} スーペリアギャラリーは2025年10月、オクスク、フォーノーマル、フリダオク作家の3人展《私が好きになる展示》展を開催します。デジタル環境で共有されるイラストと原画作業を並行する3人の作家が参加し、日常の瞬間を記憶で再構成し、それぞれ異なる色味と個性のある表現で幅広い作品の多様性を見せてくれます。オクスク作家は都市の日常の中で発見した休息と旅の場面を落ち着いていながらもリアルに描き出し、忙しい日常の中で少しの休息を記録する「情緒的風景画」に拡張します。フォーノーマル作家は日常と内面の感情をウィットに富んだタッチで表現し、軽快な色の対比と構図を通じて記憶された考えや新しい心象の要素が加わり、現実と想像が自然に調和した場面を生み出します。フリダオク作家は老夫婦の叙事と自然の風景を温かい情緒で表現し、反復的な筆のタッチと密度のある花道の中の老夫婦の姿を通じて人生に積み重ねられた時間と温もりを視覚的に見せてくれます。3人の作家の作品が視覚的楽しさと共感を伝えることを期待し、各自の記憶と感情の中で「好きになる場面」に向き合う場になることを願います。《私が好きになる展示》展は2025年11月6日まで行われます。
desc_l10n.ko: 슈페리어갤러리는 2025년 10월, 옥슥·포노멀·프리다옥 세 작가의 3인전 《내가 좋아하게 될 전시》展을 개최합니다. 디지털 환경에서 공유되는 일러스트와 원화 작업을 병행하는 세 명의 작가가 참여하여, 일상의 순간을 기억으로 재구성하고 각기 다른 색감과 개성 있는 표현으로 폭넓은 작품의 다양성을 보여줍니다. 옥슥 작가는 도시의 일상 속에서 발견한 휴식과 여행의 장면을 차분하면서도 생생하게 담아내며, 바쁜 일상 속 잠깐의 쉼을 기록하는 ‘정서적 풍경화’로 확장합니다. 포노멀 작가는 일상과 내면의 감정을 위트 있게 풀어내고, 경쾌한 색의 대비와 구도를 통해 기억된 생각이나 새로운 심상의 요소가 더해져 현실과 상상이 자연스럽게 어우러진 장면을 완성합니다. 프리다옥 작가는 노부부의 서사와 자연의 풍경을 따뜻한 정서로 담아내며, 반복적인 붓터치와 밀도감 있는 꽃길 속 노부부의 모습을 통해 삶에 쌓인 시간과 온기를 시각적으로 보여줍니다. 세 작가의 작품이 시각적 즐거움과 공감을 전하기를 기대하며, 각자의 기억과 감정 속에서 ‘좋아하게 될 장면’을 마주하는 자리가 되기를 바랍니다. 《내가 좋아하게 될 전시》展은 2025년 11월 6일까지 진행됩니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} SUPERIOR画廊将于2025年10月举办Oxc、For normal、Fridaock三位艺术家的3人展《让我爱上的展览》。本次展览将邀请三位在数字环境中共享插画与原创并行的艺术家，以记忆重构日常瞬间，通过各具特色的色彩和个性表达展现作品的广泛多样性。Oxc作家以沉静而鲜活的笔触捕捉城市日常中发现的休憩和旅行场景，将其延伸为记录繁忙日常中片刻歇息的“情感风景画”。For normal以诙谐视角诠释日常与内心情感，通过明快色彩对比与构图，融入记忆思绪和新意象，完成现实与想象自然交融的画面。Fridaock则以温暖情愫描绘老夫妇的叙事和自然景致，通过重复笔触与繁花小径中相依的身影，视觉化呈现岁月积淀的温度和生命厚度。期待三位艺术家的作品能传递视觉愉悦和情感共鸣，愿观者能在各自的记忆与情感中，邂逅一场“注定爱上的场景”。《让我爱上的展览》将持续展至2025年11月6日。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Superior Gallery presents a three-artist exhibition The Exhibition 《I Will Come to Like》 by Oksuk, Phonormal, and Frida Ok in October 2025. The three participating artists, who work on both illustration shared in digital environments and original paintings, reconstruct moments of daily life into memories and show a wide range of diversity in works through their respective colors and distinctive expressions. Oksuk calmly yet vividly depicts scenes of rest and travel discovered in urban daily life, expanding into “emotional landscapes” that record brief moments of rest within a busy life. Phonormal humorously expresses daily life and inner emotions, and through playful color contrasts and composition, completes scenes in which remembered thoughts and new imagery are naturally combined. Frida Ok portrays stories of elderly couples and natural landscapes with warm sentiments, visually conveying the warmth and accumulated time of life through repetitive brushstrokes and the dense flower paths in which the elderly couples appear. This exhibition aims to deliver visual pleasure and empathy through the works of the three artists and to provide a place where viewers can encounter “scenes they will come to like” within their own memories and emotions. The Exhibition 《I Will Come to Like》 runs until November 6, 2025.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Every year, the Gongpyeong Historic Sites Museum (26, Ujeongguk-ro, Jongno-gu) hosts a special exhibition that highlights the history and significance of the Jongno area. This year marks the museum’s seventh special exhibition, spotlighting the story of YMCA Seoul, which began in the heart of Jongno. The exhibition traces the YMCA’s 120-year journey, offering an in-depth look at its role in Korea’s modern history, particularly in education, civil society, and sports. Part 1 covers the founding of the YMCA, the construction of its headquarters, and its involvement in nationalist movements during the Japanese occupation period. Part 2 focuses on post-liberation civic movements, while Part 3 presents the introduction and development of everyday sports in modern Korea through photographs, blueprints, publications, and various other materials.

desc_l10n.ko: 공평도시유적전시관(종로구 우정국로 26)은 매년 종로 일대의 역사 및 장소성을 밝히는 기획전시를 개최하고 있습니다. 이번 전시는 공평도시유적전시관의 일곱 번째 기획전시로, 종로에서 시작한 ‘서울YMCA’의 역사를 주제로 다룹니다. 전시는 120여 년간 서울YMCA가 걸어온 발자취를 따라, 근현대 교육·사회·체육활동의 역사를 한눈에 볼 수 있도록 기획되었습니다. 1부에서는 YMCA의 창립과 회관 건립의 역사, 일제강점기 민족운동, 2부에서는 해방 이후 시민운동을 조명하고, 3부에서는 근대 생활체육의 도입과 발전 등을 주제로 사진, 도면, 책자 등 다양한 자료를 소개합니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The curated exhibition 《80 Urban Reality》 in the GanaArt Collection at the Seoul Museum of Art explores the realities surrounding cities in the 1980s from various perspectives through the collection and artworks. The 1980s in Korean society marked a significant era of rapid industrialization and economic growth, ushering in a new phase of urbanization. During that time, artists had their own attitudes towards cities and created various artworks reflecting their perspectives. This exhibition is organized into three sub-themes: ‘The Other Side of Urbanization,' 'Urbanites,' and 'Beyond Urban Surroundings: Origin of Life,' based on a common thematic consciousness that runs through the exhibited works. Through the artists' perspectives from that era, we hope this exhibition provides an opportunity to empathize with the realities of that time and contemplate their significance in our present lives.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ガナアートコレクション企画常設展『80都市現実』は、80年代の都市を取り巻く現実をソウル市立美術館のガナアートコレクションと所蔵品を通じて多角的に考察する展示です。 1980年代、韓国社会は急激な産業化と経済成長を基盤に都市化の新しい局面を迎えた時期でした。当時の芸術家たちは都市に対する自分の態度を堅持し、多様な作品を制作しました。今回の展示は、3つの共通のテーマ「都市化の裏面」、「都市の人々」、「都市を越えて-生命の根源」で構成されています。芸術家たちの見解を通して、当時の現実を知り、現在の私たちの人生はどんな意味を持っているのかを考える機会になることを願います。
desc_l10n.ko: 가나아트 컬렉션 기획상설전 《80 도시현실》은 80년대 도시를 둘러싼 현실을 서울시립미술관 가나아트 컬렉션과 소장품을 통해 다각도로 살펴보는 전시입니다. 1980년대 한국 사회는 급격한 산업화와 경제 성장을 기반으로 도시화의 새로운 국면을 맞이한 시기였습니다. 당대의 예술가들은 도시에 대한 자신만의 태도를 견지하며 다양한 작품을 제작하였습니다. 이번 전시는 출품작들을 관통하는 공통된 주제의식에 따라 3개의 소주제('도시화의 이면', '도시인', '도시를 넘어 - 생명의 근원')로 구성되었습니다. 당대 예술가의 시각을 통하여 당시의 현실에 공감하고, 현재 우리의 삶에는 어떤 의미를 지니고 있는지 생각해 볼 기회가 되기를 바랍니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} GanaArt Collection 企划常设展《80 都市现实》是通过首尔市立美术馆GanaArt Collection和收藏品，从多角度了解80年代围绕城市的现实。1980年代的韩国社会以急剧的产业化和经济增长为基础，迎来了城市化新局面的时期。当代艺术家坚持着对城市的态度创造了各种作品。本次展览的参展作品贯通的共通主题意识，由三个小主题(“都市化的背面”、“都市人”、“跨越都市-生命的根源”)构成。通过当代艺术家的视角共鸣当时的现实，是能够让我们思考现在我们的生活的意义的机会。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The curated exhibition 《80 Urban Reality》 in the GanaArt Collection at the Seoul Museum of Art explores the realities surrounding cities in the 1980s from various perspectives through the collection and artworks. The 1980s in Korean society marked a significant era of rapid industrialization and economic growth, ushering in a new phase of urbanization. During that time, artists had their own attitudes towards cities and created various artworks reflecting their perspectives. This exhibition is organized into three sub-themes: ‘The Other Side of Urbanization,' 'Urbanites,' and 'Beyond Urban Surroundings: Origin of Life,' based on a common thematic consciousness that runs through the exhibited works. Through the artists' perspectives from that era, we hope this exhibition provides an opportunity to empathize with the realities of that time and contemplate their significance in our present lives.
name: GanaArt Collection Permanent Exhibition《80 Urban Reality》

desc_l10n.ko: 옛시장실 재현공간은 해방 이후부터 2008년 5월까지 60여 년 동안 역대 서울시장이 사용했던 집무공간입니다. 서울도서관 3층 정중앙에 위치한 옛시장실 재현공간은 기획상황실, 접견실, 집무실로 구성되어 있으며, 그 당시의 사무집기와 가구 등이 그대로 재현되어 있습니다.

It features eight running tracks and a grass field measuring 110 m by 75 m. The stadium has a two-tiered spectator area, partially covered by a canopy roof. It holds significant symbolic value as the main venue for the 1986 Asian Games and the 1988 Seoul Olympics.

desc_l10n.ko: 서울올림픽주경기장은 잠실에 위치한 서울종합운동장 내 주경기장(메인 스타디움)으로 약 6만6천5백 석의 좌석이 있으며 최대 10만 명의 관중을 수용할 수 있습니다. 8개의 트랙과 가로 110m, 세로 75m의 잔디구장을 갖추고 있으며 관중석은 반개형 지붕을 가진 2층 구조로 되어있습니다. 1986 서울 아시안 게임과 1988 서울 올림픽을 치른 주경기장으로 매우 상징성이 큰 건물입니다.

desc_l10n.ko: 뚝섬한강공원 눈썰매장은 겨울철 가족, 친구, 연인과 함께 즐길 수 있는 대표적인 겨울 놀이터입니다. 눈썰매뿐 아니라 다양한 놀이기구와 체험 공간이 마련되어 있어 남녀노소 누구나 즐길 수 있는 매력을 제공합니다. 미니바이킹(5천 원), 슬라이딩카(6천 원), 꼬마기차(5천 원), 스윙거(5천 원) 등의 놀이기구와 함께 빙어잡기(4천 원), 달고나 뽑기(4천 원), 솜사탕 만들기(5천 원), 야구공 던지기(5천 원)와 같은 체험활동도 즐길 수 있습니다. 또한, 국가유공자, 장애인, 경로, 다둥이 카드 소지자는 증빙서류를 제시하면 입장료의 50%가 할인되며, 36개월 미만 영아는 무료로 입장할 수 있습니다. 도심 속에서 겨울의 낭만과 즐거움을 만끽할 수 있는 이곳은 가족 단위 방문객에게 특히 인기입니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The Seoul Museum of Art presents its 2025 Public Space Project featuring world-renowned artist Ernesto Neto, who has broadened the horizon of contemporary sculpture. His new work Ba Ka Ba, The Dance That Crosses Forever is a large-scale installation traversing the lobby and open areas of the Seosomun Main Building. The work is crafted by crocheting industrial cotton fabrics in brown, reminiscent of tree trunks and night, and in pink, symbolizing flowers and day, filled with locally sourced guava leaves and tea tree leaves. The spirit of Brazil’s Neo-Concrete movement—emphasizing sensory engagement, participation, and subjective experience—finds new life in Neto’s work within today’s urban spaces, extending the possibilities of art. The SeMA Public Space Project 《The Dance That Crosses Forever》 aims to present a venue where art awakens the senses in everyday life, as city and museum converge.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ソウル市立美術館は2025年の共用空間プロジェクトの一環として、同時代の彫刻の地平を広げてきた世界的な芸術家エルネスト・ネトを招請します。彼の新作〈バカバ、永遠に交差するダンス〉は、ソソムン(西小門)本館ロビーと開かれた空間を横切る大型設置作業で、木の幹と夜を連想させる茶色と花と昼を象徴するピンク色の産業用綿織物をクロシェ技法で編んだ構造物に、韓国産のグアバの葉と茶の木の葉を満たして完成させました。感覚と参加、主体的経験を重視したブラジルのネオ・コンクレティスムの精神は、ネトの作業の中で今日の都市空間の中で新たに具現され、芸術の新しい可能性につながっています。SeMA共用空間プロジェクト《永遠に交差するダンス》が都市の暮らしと美術館が出会い、日常の中で感覚を呼び覚ます芸術の可能性を示す場になることを願います。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울시립미술관은 2025년 공용공간 프로젝트의 일환으로 동시대 조각의 지평을 넓혀 온 세계적인 예술가 에르네스토 네토를 초청합니다. 그의 신작〈바 카 바, 영원히 교차하는 춤〉은 서소문 본관 로비와 열린 공간을 가로지르는 대형 설치작업으로, 나무줄기와 밤을 연상시키는 갈색과 꽃과 낮을 상징하는 분홍색의 산업용 면직물을 크로셰 기법으로 엮은 구조물에 국내산 구아바 잎과 차나무 잎을 채워 완성되었습니다. 감각과 참여, 주체적 경험을 중시했던 브라질 네오 콘크리트 운동의 정신은 네토의 작업 안에서 오늘날 도시 공간 속에 새롭게 구현되며, 예술의 새로운 가능성으로 이어지고 있습니다. SeMA 공용공간 프로젝트 《영원히 교차하는 춤》이 도시의 삶과 미술관이 만나, 일상 속에서 감각을 일깨우는 예술의 가능성을 보여주는 장이 되기를 바랍니다.

His new work Ba Ka Ba, The Dance That Crosses Forever is a large-scale installation traversing the lobby and open areas of the Seosomun Main Building. The work is crafted by crocheting industrial cotton fabrics in brown, reminiscent of tree trunks and night, and in pink, symbolizing flowers and day, filled with locally sourced guava leaves and tea tree leaves. Images of citizens holding protest signs by day and street artists wielding spray cans by night intersect, highlighting the nature of the street as a medium for conveying messages. The works capture the process of resistance and liberation toward freedom through these street movements.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Doezny作家は抵抗の動きに注目し、今回の個展《MOVEMENT》でより本質的な物語を展開します。これまで扱ってきた解放のテーマを深く掘り下げ、抑圧の根源と解放に向けた実践の道筋を描き出します。昼間にピケットを持って街に出る市民たちと、夜にスプレーを持つストリートアーティストの姿が交差し、壁を通じてメッセージを伝えるストリートの特性に焦点を当てます。作品はこうしたストリートの動きによって、自由を求める抵抗と解放の過程を映し出しています。
desc_l10n.ko: Doezny 작가는 저항의 움직임에 주목하며 이번 개인전 《MOVEMENT》 에서 보다 본질적인 이야기를 풀어냅니다. 기존에 다루어온 해방의 주제에 대한 심화된 탐구를 통해, 억압의 출처와 해방을 위한 실천의 동선을 그립니다. 낮에 피켓을 들고 거리에 나서는 시민들과 밤에 스프레이를 든 거리예술가의 이미지가 교차되며, 벽을 매개로 메시지를 전달하는 거리의 특성에 주목합니다. 작품은 이러한 거리의 움직임을 통해 자유를 향한 저항과 해방의 과정을 담아냅니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 作家Doezny密切关注着抵抗运动的动态，并在其个人展览《MOVEMENT》中，通过更为深刻的笔触，向观众展现了更为本质的故事。通过深入探索之前提及的解放主题，描绘了压迫的根源以及解放的具体实践路径。市民们白天手持标语牌走上街头，与夜晚时分利用喷雾在墙壁上创作的街头艺术家们的身影相互交织，共同体现了街头文化中，以墙壁为独特载体传播信息的独特魅力。这部作品通过一系列的街头活动，生动地描绘了对自由进行抵抗并最终获得解放的历程。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The Seoul Museum of Art will host the exhibition “Turbulent Times: Women Life Art” in 2024 to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Chun Kyung-ja’s birth (1924–2015). This exhibition will feature works and archives from 22 female artists who lived during the same period as Chun Kyung-ja. Unlike previous exhibitions or research, this exhibition highlights Chun Kyung-ja’s modern mindset and influence on her era. It also sheds light on other female artists of her time who, unlike Chun, struggled to break free from the traditional confines of Eastern painting during the Japanese occupation. These women collectively lived through a tumultuous era marked by significant historical events, including the Japanese colonial era (1909–1945), Korea’s liberation on August 15, 1945, the Korean War (1950–1953), the April 19 Revolution (1960), the May 16 military coup (1961), military dictatorship (1961–1979), the December 12 military rebellion (1979), the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement (1980), the new military regime (1980–1993), and the ongoing democratization movements following the establishment of the South Korean government. Society, personal life, and art are inseparable, and this exhibition aims to explore the interconnectedness of political, social, and artistic trends from the Japanese colonial period to the 1990s. By examining the broader context of the Eastern art scene during that time, it seeks to reveal the influence of these movements on the artists. The exhibition will cover various aspects, including educational institutions during the colonial period, the development of the Joseon Art Exhibition (Chosun Misun), post-liberation educational institutions, and the National Art Exhibition (Gukjeon), along with the political and social interventions that occurred in between. It will also provide a detailed and objective look at the trajectory of Eastern painting, group activities, achievements, and individual biographies of the artists. This approach helps to better understand their artistic worlds and trace their evolution from being labeled as "female Eastern painters" to becoming the "artists" they are recognized today. This exhibition delves deeply into various materials, including Chun Ja's candid autobiography, various articles, writings, and artworks. By thoroughly researching these sources, the exhibition aims to uncover the many individuals who played a role in her life and explore her relationships with them. A carefully organized biography will correct past misunderstandings and inaccuracies about the artist, paving the way for more in-depth research in the future. Through this exhibition, we honor Chun Kyung-ja, a pioneer of modern Korean art, while shedding light on the works of other artists who lived through the "era of turbulence" and contributed to the development of modern Korean art with their diverse creations. The exhibition reexamines the artistic worlds of Chung Chan-young, Lee Hyun-ok, Chung Yong-hee, Bae Jeong-rye, Park Rae-hyun, Chun Kyung-ja, Park In-kyung, Geum Dong-won, Moon Eun-hee, Lee In-sil, Lee Kyung-ja, Jang Sang-eui, Ryu Min-ja, Lee Sook-ja, Oh Nang-ja, Yoon Ae-geun, Lee Hwa-ja, Shim Kyung-ja, Won Moon-ja, Song Su-ryeon, Joo Min-sook, Kim Choon-ok, and Cha Myung-hee, without boundaries or limitations, within the context of contemporary art movements.

left: 0px} ソウル市立美術館は、2024年にチョン・ギョンジャ(千鏡子、1924–2015)の生誕100周年を迎えるにあたり、彼女と同時代を生きた22名の女性作家の作品と資料を展示する「激変の時代、女性の生活と芸術」展を開催します。 本展は、これまでの展示や研究とは異なり、チョン・ギョンジャ作家の現代的な思考を浮き彫りにし、彼女が与えた影響を探るとともに、彼女と同じ時代を生きながらも、チョン・ギョンジャとは異なり、日本の植民地時代によって東洋画に課せられた枠を超えることが容易ではなかった女性作家たちに焦点を当てています。 これらの作家たちは共通して、日本の植民地時代(1909–1945)、8.15光復(1945)、朝鮮戦争(1950–1953)、4.19革命(1960)、5.16軍事クーデター(1961)、軍事独裁(1961–1979)、12.12軍事反乱(1979)、5.18光州民主化運動(1980)、新軍部政権(1980–1993)、そして大韓民国政府樹立後も続いた民主化運動など、激動の時代を生き抜きました。社会、個人の生活、芸術は決して切り離すことはできないため、本展は日本による植民地時代から1990年代に至るまでの政治・社会的流れと美術の流れを一つにまとめ、その関連性を探りながら、当時の東洋画壇全体を俯瞰することを目指しました。 したがって、日本の植民地時代の教育機関、『朝鮮美展』の展開、光復後の教育機関、『国展』の展開とその間に行われた政治・社会的介入、東洋画の流れ、団体活動と業績など、多くの資料と各作家の年譜を客観的な視点で体系的に整理し、彼女たちの作品世界を正確に理解し、彼女たちがどのようにして似た素材と技法で絵を描く「女流東洋画家」から今日の「作家」へと成長してきたのかを探ります。特に、チョン・ギョンジャ作家の真率な自叙伝、さまざまな記事や文章、作品などの多様な資料を深く研究し、それを基に彼女の人生に登場するさまざまな人物を探し出し、彼女たちとの関係を探究して詳しく整理した年譜を通じて、これまでの誤解と誤りを正し、今後より深い研究が進むことを期待しています。 本展を通じて、韓国現代美術の先駆者であるチョン・ギョンジャ作家を讃えるとともに、「激変の時代」を生き抜き、さまざまな作品で韓国現代美術の発展に貢献したチョン・チャニョン(鄭燦英)、イ・ヒョノク(李賢玉)、チョン・ヨンヒ(鄭用姫)、ぺ・ジョンレ(裵貞禮)、パク・レヒョン(朴崍賢)、チョン・ギョンジャ(千鏡子)、パク・インギョン(朴仁京)、クム・ドンウォン(琴東媛)、ムン・ウニ(文銀姬)、イ・インシル(李仁實)、イ・ギョンジャ(李敬子)、チャン・サンイ(張相宜)、リュ・ミンジャ(柳敏子)、イ・スクジャ(李淑子)、オ・ナンジャ(吳浪子)、ユン・エグン(尹愛根)、イ・ファジャ(李和子)、シム・ギョンジャ(沈敬子)、ウォン・ムンジャ(元文子)、ソン・スリョン(宋秀璉)、チュ・ミンスク(朱敏淑)、キム・チュノク(金春玉)、チャ・ミョンヒ(車明熹)作家の作品世界を、いかなる境界も制限もない同時代の美術の流れの中で再評価することを目指します。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울시립미술관은 2024년 천경자(1924–2015) 탄생 100주년을 맞이해 그와 동시대를 살았던 여성 작가 22명의 작품과 자료로 전시 《격변의 시대, 여성 삶 예술》을 개최합니다. 본 전시는 그간의 전시나 연구와 달리 천경자 작가의 이런 현대적 사고방식을 부각하고 그가 미친 영향, 그리고 당시 그와 동시대를 살았지만, 천경자와 달리 일제강점기로 인해 동양화에 씌워진 굴레를 벗어나기 쉽지 않았던 여성 작가들을 조망하고자 했습니다. 이들은 공통으로 일제강점기(1909–1945), 8·15광복(1945), 한국전쟁(1950–1953), 4·19혁명(1960), 5·16군사정변(1961), 군사독재(1961–1979), 12·12군사반란(1979), 5·18 광주민주화운동(1980), 신군부 정권(1980–1993), 그리고 대한민국 정부 수립 이후 계속된 민주화 운동 등으로 이어지는 격변의 시대를 살아냈습니다. 사회, 개인의 삶, 예술은 결코 분리될 수 없기에 본 전시는 일제강점기부터 1990년대에 이르기까지 정치 사회적 흐름과 미술의 흐름을 한데 묶고 그 연관성을 찾아 당시 동양 화단 전체를 조망하고자 했습니다. 따라서 일제강점기 교육기관, 《조선 미전》의 전개, 광복 이후 교육기관, 《국전》의 전개와 그사이에 이루어진 정치, 사회적인 개입, 동양화의 흐름, 단체활동과 업적 등 많은 자료와 각 작가의 연보를 객관적 시각으로 체계를 잡고 상세히 정리해 이들의 작품세계를 정확히 이해하고, 이들이 어떻게 비슷한 소재와 기법으로 그림을 그리던 ‘여류 동양화가’에서 지금의 ‘작가’로 성장해 왔는지 살펴보고자 합니다. 특히, 천경자 작가의 진솔한 자서전, 각종 기사와 글, 작품 등 다양한 자료를 심도 있게 연구, 이를 토대로 그의 삶에 등장하는 다양한 인물들을 찾고 이들과의 관계를 탐색해 상세히 정리한 연보를 통해 그간 그에 대한 오해와 오류를 바로잡고 향후 보다 심화한 연구가 진행될 수 있을 거라 기대합니다. 본 전시를 통해, 한국 현대미술의 선구자인 천경자 작가를 기리는 동시에 '격변의 시대'를 살아내고 다양한 작품으로 한국 현대미술의 발전에 이바지한 정찬영, 이현옥, 정용희, 배정례, 박래현, 천경자, 박인경, 금동원, 문은희, 이인실, 이경자, 장상의, 류민자, 이숙자, 오낭자, 윤애근, 이화자, 심경자, 원문자, 송수련, 주민숙, 김춘옥, 차명희 작가의 작품세계를 어떤 경계도 제한도 없는 동시대 미술 흐름 속에서 재조명하고자 합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 首尔市立美术馆在2024年迎来千镜子(1924–2015)诞辰100周年之际，将举办22名与他同时代生活的女性作家的作品和资料展示《巨变时代，女性生活艺术》。 本展与之前的展览和研究不同,刻画了千镜子作家的这种现代思考方式,并展望了他所产生的影响,以及当时和他生活在同一时代,但与千镜子不同,因"日本帝国主义强占时期"而难以摆脱东洋画束缚的女性作家。 他们共同经历了 日本帝国主义强占时期(1909–1945)、8·15光复(1945)、韩国战争(1950–1953)、4·19革命(1960)、5·16军事政变(1961)、军事独裁(1961–1979)、12·12军事叛乱(1979)、5·18光州民主化运动(1980)、新军部政权 (1980–1993)以及大韩民国政府成立后持续的民主化运动等剧变的时代。 社会、个人生活、艺术是绝对不能分离的,因此本展将 日本帝国主义强占时期 到 1990 年代的政治、社会潮流和美术潮流结合在一起,寻找其关联性,眺望当时的东洋画坛整体。 因此,日本帝国主义强占时期 教育机关、《朝鲜 美展》的展开、光复后教育机关、《国展》的展开和期间形成的政治、社会介入、东洋画的潮流、团体活动和业绩等众多资料和各作家的年谱,以客观的视角掌握体系,详细整理,正确理解他们的作品世界,观察她们是如何从以相似的素材和手法画画的"女东方画家"成长为现在的"作家"的。 特别是千镜子作家真实的自传、各种报道和文章、作品等多种资料，以此为基础，寻找他生活中的各种人物，探索他们的关系，通过详细整理的年报，希望纠正这段时间对他的误会和错误，今后进行更加深入的研究。 通过本次展示，在纪念韩国现代美术先驱者千镜子作家的同时，还活出了"剧变的时代"，通过多样的作品为韩国现代美术的发展做出了贡献的JEONG CHANYEONG、LEE HYEONOK、JEONG YONGHUI、BAE JEONGRYE、BAK RAEHYEON、千镜子、BAK INGYEONG、GEUM DONGWON、MUN EUNHUI、LEE INSIL、LEE GYEONGJA、JANG SANGUI、RYU MINJA、LEE SUKJA、OH NANGJA、YUN AEGEUN、LEE HWAJA、SIM GYEONGJA、SONG SURYEON、JU MINSUK、GIM CHUNOK、CHA MYEONGHUI作家的"在没有任何界限的美术时代的重新审视。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The Seoul Museum of Art will host the exhibition “Turbulent Times: Women Life Art” in 2024 to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Chun Kyung-ja’s birth (1924–2015). This exhibition will feature works and archives from 22 female artists who lived during the same period as Chun Kyung-ja. Unlike previous exhibitions or research, this exhibition highlights Chun Kyung-ja’s modern mindset and influence on her era. It also sheds light on other female artists of her time who, unlike Chun, struggled to break free from the traditional confines of Eastern painting during the Japanese occupation. These women collectively lived through a tumultuous era marked by significant historical events, including the Japanese colonial era (1909–1945), Korea’s liberation on August 15, 1945, the Korean War (1950–1953), the April 19 Revolution (1960), the May 16 military coup (1961), military dictatorship (1961–1979), the December 12 military rebellion (1979), the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement (1980), the new military regime (1980–1993), and the ongoing democratization movements following the establishment of the South Korean government. Society, personal life, and art are inseparable, and this exhibition aims to explore the interconnectedness of political, social, and artistic trends from the Japanese colonial period to the 1990s. By examining the broader context of the Eastern art scene during that time, it seeks to reveal the influence of these movements on the artists. The exhibition will cover various aspects, including educational institutions during the colonial period, the development of the Joseon Art Exhibition (Chosun Misun), post-liberation educational institutions, and the National Art Exhibition (Gukjeon), along with the political and social interventions that occurred in between. It will also provide a detailed and objective look at the trajectory of Eastern painting, group activities, achievements, and individual biographies of the artists. This approach helps to better understand their artistic worlds and trace their evolution from being labeled as "female Eastern painters" to becoming the "artists" they are recognized today. This exhibition delves deeply into various materials, including Chun Ja's candid autobiography, various articles, writings, and artworks. By thoroughly researching these sources, the exhibition aims to uncover the many individuals who played a role in her life and explore her relationships with them. A carefully organized biography will correct past misunderstandings and inaccuracies about the artist, paving the way for more in-depth research in the future. Through this exhibition, we honor Chun Kyung-ja, a pioneer of modern Korean art, while shedding light on the works of other artists who lived through the "era of turbulence" and contributed to the development of modern Korean art with their diverse creations. The exhibition reexamines the artistic worlds of Chung Chan-young, Lee Hyun-ok, Chung Yong-hee, Bae Jeong-rye, Park Rae-hyun, Chun Kyung-ja, Park In-kyung, Geum Dong-won, Moon Eun-hee, Lee In-sil, Lee Kyung-ja, Jang Sang-eui, Ryu Min-ja, Lee Sook-ja, Oh Nang-ja, Yoon Ae-geun, Lee Hwa-ja, Shim Kyung-ja, Won Moon-ja, Song Su-ryeon, Joo Min-sook, Kim Choon-ok, and Cha Myung-hee, without boundaries or limitations, within the context of contemporary art movements.
name: CHUN Kyung-ja Centennial 《Turbulent Times: Women Life Art》
