desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} As the second story in the “Pansori Azit Nohlae Box <Pansori Short Stories Vol.2,” this solo pansori performance embodies the subtlety of human affairs and the charm of short stories depicted by Guy de Maupassant. Singers Lee Ye-rin, Lee Seung-min, and Hwang Ji-young bring "A Piece of String," "The Colonel's Ideas," and "Bed No. 29" to life, each infusing their unique style into Maupassant's delicate realism, showcasing their talents not only as singers but also as storytellers. These are short stories akin to fleeting dreams from the night before—brief yet lingering in the mind all day. Director Park In-hye focuses on the nature of short stories that compel us to move on even when left feeling unsettled, wistful, or caught off guard, portraying this as a reflection of human life. As pansori ends with a whirlwind, so too do Maupassant’s stories portray the diverse realities of human experience, seen through the eyes of the singers. This invites the audience to ponder "How do humans live?" and ultimately, "How should humans live?"
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Pansori Azit Nohlae Boxの短編シリーズ第2弾として、ギィ・ド・モーパッサンが描く人間社会の微妙な側面と短編小説の魅力をパンソリ(伝統的民俗芸能)の一人芝居で表現した作品です。 『紐』『大佐の考え』『二十九号の寝台』の3作を、それぞれイ・イェリン、イ・スンミン、ファン・ジヨンが演じ、モーパッサン独特の繊細なリアリズムにそれぞれの個性を重ね、ソリクン(伝統音楽の歌い手)としてだけでなく、語り手としての魅力も引き出しています。 まるで昨晩見た夢のように、短い時間ながら一日中頭の中でぐるぐると巡るような短い物語。 演出のパク・インヘは「ページをめくるしかない」短編小説の特徴に注目し、物足りなさやもどかしさ、不意を突かれたような心情を描きながら、それでも次の物語に進まざるを得ない人間の生き様を表現しています。 モーパッサンの小説に描かれる多彩な人間模様をソリクン(伝統音楽の歌い手)の視点で見つめ、「人はどう生きるのか？」という問いを超え、究極的には「人はどう生きるべきか？」という根源的な問いを投げかける作品です。
desc_l10n.ko: 판소리아지트 놀애박스 단편시리즈의 두번째 이야기로, 기 드 모파상이 그려내는 인간사의 미묘함과 단편 소설의 매력을 담아낸 판소리 1인극이다. '노끈', '대장 투안', '29호 침대'를 각각 이예린, 이승민, 황지영이 풀어내며 모파상 특유의 섬세한 리얼리즘에 각자의 색깔을 입혀 소리꾼 뿐 아니라 이야기꾼으로서 개인의 매력을 발산한다. 어젯밤 꾼 꿈같은, 잠시 짧은 밤이지만 하루 종일 머릿속을 맴맴 돌고 도는 그런 짧은 이야기. 연출 박인혜는 '넘겨버릴 수 밖에 없는' 단편 소설의 특성에 주목하여 아쉽기도 하고, 찝찝하기도 하고, 허를 찔린 듯한 마음에 벙찌지만 다음 이야기로 넘어가야 하는 인간의 삶을 그려낸다. 판소리가 그리 끝나듯, '어질더질' 끝나버리는 모파상의 소설 속의 다양한 인간사를 소리꾼의 시선으로 바라보아 '인간은 어떻게 살아가는가?'를 넘어 궁극적으로 '인간은 어떻게 살아가야 하는가?' 라는 질문을 던진다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 这是板索里基地娱乐箱短篇系列的第二个故事， 这是一部以板索里形式呈现的单人剧，它讲述了居伊·德·莫泊桑所描绘的人间史的微妙之处以及他短篇小说的独特魅力。 '细绳' '队长Tuan' '29号床' 分别由YI YERIN,YI SEUNGMIN,HWANG JIYEONG解开 在莫泊桑特有的细腻现实主义风格中，他们各自融入了独特的色彩，不仅作为说唱演员展现自我，而且在这一过程中也散发出了个人的独特魅力。 就像昨晚的梦境，虽然只是夜晚的短暂经历，但一整天都在脑海中萦绕不去，那简短的故事情节如此挥之不去。 导演PAK INHYE关注短篇小说"无可抵挡"的特点， 该片描绘了一种复杂的心境，既令人惋惜又使人感到不适。尽管主角因被击中要害的心情而笼罩在一片阴霾之下，但他仍要鼓起勇气，迈向下一个故事，开始新的人类生活。 就像板索里那样结束， 从说唱演员的视角来审视莫泊桑小说中，在“眩晕”落幕之后所展现的形形色色的人物与事件。 超越“人类如何生活？”这一问题，最终提出“人类应该如何生活？”的议题。

desc_l10n.en: When it comes to the city of Seoul, there are several different images that come to mind. And among those images, Seoul captures a variety of contrasts from light and dark; cold and warm, busy and peaceful, beautiful and ordinary, and more. Seoul Vibe is a project that seeks out to find these dualities through a myriad of ways.
desc_l10n.ja: ソウルを新しく見つめ、感じて、体験できる展示「SEOUL VIBE」がソウルのクァンファムン(光化門)に位置するギャラリークァンファにおいて4月30日まで開催されます。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울 바이브 대한민국의 중심, 삶의 모든 이야기가 응축된 곳 서울은 어두우면서 찬란하고, 차가우면서 뜨겁다. 소란스러우면서 고요하고 무심하지만 다정하다. <서울 바이브>는 이렇게 놀라운 서울의 이야기를 체화하는 작업이다. 그리고 우리는 서울에서 사람과 희망과 함께 살아간다
desc_l10n.zh: SEOUL VIBE 韩国的中心，所有人生的故事都将在这里凝结 昏暗而灿烂，冰冷又热烈的首尔。 喧闹又寂静，冷漠却又多情。 《SEOUL VIBE》是一部将首尔精彩故事物化作品。 并且我们和大家还有希望一起在首尔生活着。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The National Museum of Korea presents the special exhibition <Our Yi Sun sin>, commemorating the four hundred eightieth anniversary of the birth of Admiral Yi Sun sin and the eightieth anniversary of Liberation. Centered on records left by Yi Sun sin himself, this exhibition sheds light on his inner thoughts and emotions beyond his role as a war hero, as well as on how he became a symbol shaped by later generations. This is the first comprehensive Yi Sun sin exhibition by the National Museum of Korea and includes twenty items (thirty four pieces) from the Yi Sun sin family, including the handwritten Nanjung Ilgi and the Yi Sun sin Long Sword, along with six National Treasures (fifteen pieces), thirty nine Treasures (forty three pieces), six Registered Cultural Heritage items (nine pieces), totaling two hundred fifty eight items (six hundred sixty nine pieces).
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 国立中央博物館がイ・スンシン(李舜臣)将軍生誕480周年と光復(日本の植民地支配からの解放)80周年を記念して特別展<私たちのイ・スンシン>を開催します。今回の展示は、イ・スンシンが直接残した記録を中心に、戦争の英雄という枠を超え、人間イ・スンシンの内面と感情、そして時代が作ってきた象徴としてのイ・スンシンを立体的に照らし出します。イ・スンシンに関する資料を集大成した国立中央博物館初のイ・スンシン特別展は、<乱中日記>の直筆本、<イ・スンシンの長剣>など、イ・スンシン宗家の遺物20件34点を含め、国宝6件15点、宝物39件43点、国家登録文化遺産6件9点が展示され、総展示品258件669点の膨大な規模を誇ります。
desc_l10n.ko: 국립중앙박물관이 이순신 장군 탄신 480주년과 광복 80주년을 기념하여 특별전 <우리들의 이순신>을 개최합니다. 이번 전시는 이순신이 직접 남긴 기록을 중심으로 전쟁 영웅을 넘어 인간 이순신의 내면과 감정, 그리고 시대가 만들어온 상징으로서의 이순신을 입체적으로 조명합니다. 이순신 자료를 집대성한 국립중앙박물관 최초의 이순신 특별전은 <난중일기> 친필본, <이순신 장검> 등 이순신 종가 유물 20건 34점을 포함하여 국보 6건 15점, 보물 39건 43점, 국가등록문화유산 6건 9점이 전시되며, 총 전시품 258건 669점의 방대한 규모를 자랑합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 国立中央博物馆为纪念李舜臣将军诞辰480周年和光复80周年，将举办《我们的李舜臣》特展。本次展览以李舜臣亲笔留下的记录为中心，立体地展现了作为战争英雄之外的李舜臣的内心与情感，以及时代所塑造、具有象征意义的李舜臣的形象。国立中央博物馆首次举办的李舜臣特别展作为首次荟萃李舜臣资料的综合大展，展览规模浩大，共展出258件（669项）藏品。其中包括《乱中日记》真迹、《李舜臣长剑》等李舜臣宗家遗物20件（34项），以及国宝6件（15项）、宝物39件（43项）、国家注册文化遗产6件（9项）。

A visual arts exhibition by seven artists, which modernly reinterprets the historical context of the Samgakji gallery street formed after the Korean War, will be held at the Yongsan Cultural Foundation Pop-up Hall. We invite you to the 'The Place of Beginning' exhibition, where the creative energy accumulated in Samgakji in the past and today's artistic perspectives intersect.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 数多くの無名の画家たちが生計を立てながら最後まで筆を放さなかった熾烈なる芸術の地、「サムガクチ(三角地)」をご存知ですか？ 朝鮮戦争後に形成されたサムガクチ(三角地)画廊街の歴史的脈絡を現代的に再解釈した7人の視覚芸術展が、ヨンサン(龍山)文化財団ポップアップホールで開催されます。 過去のサムガクチ(三角地)に蓄積された創作のエネルギーと今日の芸術的視点が交差する「始まりの場」展に皆さんをお招きします。
desc_l10n.ko: 수많은 무명 화가들이 생계를 이어가며 끝까지 붓을 놓지 않았던 치열한 예술의 공간, ‘삼각지’를 아시나요? 한국전쟁 이후 형성된 삼각지 화랑 거리의 역사적 맥락을 현대적으로 재해석한 7인의 시각예술 전시가 용산문화재단 팝업홀에서 열립니다. 과거 삼각지에 축적된 창작의 에너지와 오늘의 예술적 시선이 교차하는 '시작의 자리'전시에 여러분을 초대합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 您是否了解 “三角地”？这里曾是无数无名画家为生计奔波，却始终不曾放下画笔的热血艺术之地。 龙山文化财团快闪展厅将举办七位视觉艺术家展览，本次展览用现代视角重新解读朝鲜战争后形成的三角地画廊街的历史脉络。 诚邀各位莅临“起始之地”展览，一同感受三角地昔日积淀的创作力量和当下艺术视角的交融碰撞。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Opened in Insadong in 1999, Artside Gallery operates under the motto “art is the constant centralization of the surroundings.” It aims to bridge artists and the art market by providing various creative directions to domestic and international artists. Based on its beliefs and perspectives, Artside Gallery has been at the forefront of introducing the diverse works and artistic worlds of talented artists from Korea, China, Asia, Europe, and beyond to the domestic and international art scene. Since relocating to Tongui-dong in 2010, the gallery has continued to curate exhibitions that reflect its distinct identity. Through its participation in various domestic and international art fairs, Artside Gallery has opened the door to the global art market and solidified its position as an internationally recognized gallery.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 1999年にインサドン(仁寺洞)で開館した「Artside Gallery」は、「アートとは周辺(Side)の絶え間ない中心化」という信条のもと、国内外のアーティストに多様な創作活動の方向性を提供し、アーティストと美術市場との架け橋としての役割を果たしています。Artside Galleryは、その信念と視点に基づき、韓国や中国をはじめとするアジアや、ヨーロッパの優れたアーティストのさまざまな作品世界を国内外の美術界に紹介してきました。2010年にトンイドン(通義洞)に移転後も、Artside Galleryならではの特色ある作品展示を企画しており、国内外のアートフェアへの参加を通じて国際美術市場の文化を広げ、国際的な規模のギャラリーとしての地位を確立しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 1999년 인사동에 개관한 아트사이드 갤러리는 사이드(Side), '예술이란 주변의 끊임없는 중심화'라는 신조로, 국내외 작가들에게 창작 활동 방향을 다양하게 제시하며 작가와 미술 시장의 경계를 잇는 통로의 역할을 지향합니다. 아트사이드가 가진 신념과 시각을 바탕으로 한국과 중국 등 아시아와 유럽 각지의 역량 있는 작가들의 다양한 작품세계를 국내외 미술계에 소개해오고 있습니다. 2010년 통의동으로 이전해 꾸준히 아트사이드 갤러리만의 색깔을 지닌 작품들로 전시기획을 해오고 있으며 여러 국내외 아트페어 참여를 통해 국제 미술 시장의 문화를 개방하고 국제적 규모의 갤러리로 자리매김했습니다.

Based on its beliefs and perspectives, Artside Gallery has been at the forefront of introducing the diverse works and artistic worlds of talented artists from Korea, China, Asia, Europe, and beyond to the domestic and international art scene. Since relocating to Tongui-dong in 2010, the gallery has continued to curate exhibitions that reflect its distinct identity. Through its participation in various domestic and international art fairs, Artside Gallery has opened the door to the global art market and solidified its position as an internationally recognized gallery.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} B the B is a permanent exhibition space that curates Seoul’s attractive beauty brands with B the B’s unique sensibility. Explore AI-powered beauty tech devices that are rarely accessible, diagnose your skin and scalp, and experience virtual makeup and photo booth sessions. You can also test recommended products based on your diagnosis and enjoy a one-stop service for online purchases. This special exhibition is designed so you can experience your morning beauty routine step by step—from Step 1. Skincare to Step 9. Cleansing—from morning to night. As you stroll through the biophilia-themed exhibition hall, you’ll feel as if you’ve stepped into a forest with lush green leaves and birdsong. Participate in various regularly updated events and receive gifts.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} B the Bは、ソウルの魅力的なビューティーブランドを独自のセンスででキュレーションした常設展示空間です。ここではなかなか目にすることのできないAI基盤のビューティーテック機器を使い、肌や頭皮の診断を体験できます。さらに、バーチャルメイクアップや人生4カットなど、多様な体験プログラムも用意されています。また、診断結果に基づいてすすめられた製品をその場で試し、オンライン購入までできるワンストップサービスを受けることができます。今回の企画展では、朝から夜まで一日のビューティールーチンをSTEP 1. スキンケアからSTEP 9. クレンジングまで順番に体験できる構成になっています。バイオフィリアをコンセプトにした展示空間を歩けば、青々とした葉や鳥の鳴き声で、まるで森の中にいるような感覚を味わえるでしょう。定期的に開催される多様なイベントに参加し、プレゼントももらっていってください。
desc_l10n.ko: 비더비는 서울의 매력적인 뷰티 브랜드를 B the B만의 감각으로 큐레이팅한 상설 전시 공간입니다. 쉽게 만나볼 수 없던 AI 기반의 뷰티테크 기기를 통해 내 피부와 두피를 진단해보고 가상 메이크업과 인생네컷 등 다양한 체험 프로그램을 경험해보세요. 또한 진단을 통해 추천받은 제품을 테스트하고 온라인 구매까지 가능한 원스톱 서비스를 제공받으실 수 있습니다. 이번 기획전은 아침부터 밤까지 아침 뷰티 루틴을 STEP 1. 스킨케어부터 STEP 9. 클렌징까지 순서대로 체험해볼 수 있도록 구성하였습니다. 바이오필리아 컨셉의 전시장을 거닐면 푸릇한 잎파리와 새소리로 숲 속에 들어온 듯한 느낌을 받으실 수 있습니다. 주기적으로 바뀌는 다양한 이벤트에 참여하며 선물도 받아가세요.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} B the B是一个常设展览空间，用其独一无二的视角展现首尔独具魅力的美妆品牌。通过难得一见的AI美妆科技设备，为您提供皮肤与头皮诊断，并体验虚拟化妆、人生四格照等各种体验活动。此外，通过诊断，您可以测试推荐的产品并在线购买，享受一站式服务，本次企划展按照从STEP 1.护肤到STEP 9.洁面的顺序，让您能够完整体验从早到晚的晨间美容流程。漫步于以“亲生命性”为主题的展厅，葱郁的绿叶与清脆的鸟鸣将让您仿佛置身森林之中。您还可以参加定期变更的丰富活动，并领取精美礼品。

Every human being experiences a period of helplessness. The artist too has lived through such a time, and what that time offered her was a profound insight into fundamental existence. At the root of her work lies the theme of “nature.” The artist whispers to us about what nature means to humankind. Through this essential reflection, she seeks to share the roots of her artistic practice, inviting us to reconsider the global theme of “nature.”
desc_l10n.ko: 2025년 지난한 여름을 견딘 자국이 남은 계절, 삼세영 갤러리는 송선희 작가의 전시와 함께합니다. 인간이라면 누구나 무력감을 느끼는 시기를 겪게 됩니다. 작가에게도 그 시기는 존재하였고, 그 시기가 선물해 준 것은 근원적인 존재에 대한 통찰이었습니다. 작가의 작업 근원에는 ‘자연’이라는 주제가 자리 잡고 있습니다. 작가는 우리에게 자연이 어떠한 의미인지 속삭이며, 근원적인 통찰을 통해 본인 작업의 뿌리를 이야기 나누고자 하는 작가의 마음에서 우리는 범지구적인 화두인 “자연”에 대해 돌아보고자 합니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} To mark its 20th anniversary, Gongganhye Gallery presents the second part of its special exhibition, running from September 15 to October 4, 2025. The exhibition revisits the gallery’s journey: from its beginnings as a photography-specialized gallery in 2005, to its relocation next to the Blue House in Samcheong-dong in 2010, and its expansion into painting, sculpture, video, and installation art, shaping the trajectory of contemporary art. The exhibition will feature works by three artists who have steadily developed their unique artistic worlds in collaboration with Gongganhye Gallery: Jen Pak, Chen Ruo Bing, and Kwak Intan. Through their diverse generational, regional, and formal languages, the exhibition seeks to map out the expanded landscape of contemporary visual arts.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} コン・グンヘギャラリーは開館20周年を迎え、2025年9月15日から10月4日まで特別展2部を開催します。今回の展示は、2005年に写真専門ギャラリーとしてスタートし、2010年に現在のサムチョンドン(三清洞)、チョンワデ(青瓦台)の隣へと移転した当ギャラリーの軌跡を振り返るものです。絵画、彫刻、映像、インスタレーションといった多様なメディアを扱い、現代美術の動向を牽引してきた歩みをご紹介します。 コン・グンヘギャラリーとともに独自の制作活動を続けてきた3名の作家、ジェン・パク(Jen PAK)氏、チェン・ルオビン(Chen Ruo Bing)氏、クァク・インタン(Kwak Intan)氏を迎えます。世代や地域、そして表現方法の違いを超え、現代における視覚芸術の広がりを展望する機会となれば幸いです。
desc_l10n.ko: 공근혜갤러리는 개관 20주년을 맞이하여 2025년 9월 15일부터 10월 4일까지 특별전 2부를 개최합니다. 이번 전시는 2005년 사진전문 갤러리로 출발해 2010년 지금의 삼청동 청와대 옆으로 이전하면서 회화, 조각, 영상, 설치에 이르기까지 매체 확장을 통해 동시대 미술의 흐름을 주도해온 궤적을 되짚는 자리로 기획되었습니다. 공근혜갤러리와 지난 시간을 꾸준히 함께 걸어오며 독창적인 작업 세계를 구축해 온 젠박(Jen PAK), 첸 루오빙(Chen Ruo Bing), 곽인탄(Kwak Intan) 세 작가를 모시고, 세대와 지역, 조형 언어의 차이를 넘어 동시대 시각예술의 확장된 현재의 지형도를 조망하고자 합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 孔槿惠画廊为庆祝开馆20周年，将从2025年9月15日至10月4日举办2次特别展。本次展览将回顾画廊自2005年以摄影专业画廊为起点，至2010年迁至现在的三清洞青瓦台旁边，并通过绘画、雕塑、影像和装置等媒体扩展，回望主导同时代美术趋势的历程。 孔槿惠画廊将邀请与其一路前行，并建立独创工作世界的Jen PAK、Chen Ruo Bing和Kwak Intan三位作家，展现跨越世代、地区和结构语言的差异，展望同时代视觉艺术扩展后的全新格局。

The exhibition revisits the gallery’s journey: from its beginnings as a photography-specialized gallery in 2005, to its relocation next to the Blue House in Samcheong-dong in 2010, and its expansion into painting, sculpture, video, and installation art, shaping the trajectory of contemporary art. The exhibition will feature works by three artists who have steadily developed their unique artistic worlds in collaboration with Gongganhye Gallery: Jen Pak, Chen Ruo Bing, and Kwak Intan. Through their diverse generational, regional, and formal languages, the exhibition seeks to map out the expanded landscape of contemporary visual arts.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The artist’s paintings ‘A series of empty houses’ are deep multidimensional structures containing improbable transpositions of time and space. She re-assembles the fragments of memory that she has gathered from the shoreline. We are drawn in to the structures and we find ourselves surrounded by floors made of ice, windows through which we can see a raging sea by moonlight and where, the sea itself is advancing in to the room and we are really standing on a beach. Viewrs could be active participants in a multi-faceted space where gravity has been suspended. Film stories are fiction, but when those single frames are assembled and viewed together they create the powerful illusion of having witnessed an 'event', no matter how unlikely that event might be. 'Empty Houses on the Coast' leaves me with exactly that sensation of having witnessed the improbable come to life.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 展示で紹介する絵画は「空き家」をテーマにした連作です。作家が沿岸で収集した記憶のカケラを集めて構成したこれらの作品は、時間と空間が絵画になった多次元的な構造を表しています。 観覧者は、氷の床と潮の満ち引きによって激しく揺れ動く海が見える窓、そして海が押し寄せる室内に囲まれながら、海辺に立っているような感覚になります。平面な絵画の空間をただ見つめることを超え、重力が止まった多面的な空間の中で能動的な体験をすることになるでしょう。 映画の中のストーリーは実際に起こりそうにないですが、フレームが集まり、一度に視界に入ったとき「事件」を目撃する強烈な幻想が生まれます。今回の展示は、起こりそうもない出来事を現実で目撃したかのような感覚を伝えます
desc_l10n.ko: 전시에서 소개되는 그림들은 ‘빈집’을 소재로 한 연작입니다. 작가가 연안에서 수집한 기억의 파편들을 모아서 구성한 이 작품들은, 시간과 공간이 그림으로 전환된 다차원적인 구조를 드러냅니다. 관람자는 얼음 바닥과 조수에 의해 격앙된 바다가 보이는 창문 그리고 바다가 밀려오는 실내에 둘러싸이는 동시에, 바닷가에 서있게 됩니다. 평면 회화 공간을 응시하는 것을 넘어서, 중력이 멈춘 다면적 공간 안에서 능동적인 참여자가 되는 경험을 제공합니다. 영화 속 이야기는 실제로 일어날 것 같지 않지만, 프레임들이 모여서 한 번에 보일 때는 ‘사건’을 목격하는 강렬한 환영이 생깁니다. 이번 전시는 일어날 것 같지 않은 일을 현실에서 목격한 듯한 바로 그런 감각을 전합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 展示会上介绍的是以“空房子”为素材的一系列画作。这些作品由作家在沿岸地区收集的记忆碎片构成，展现了时间和空间转化为画面的多维结构。 参观者仿佛同时置身于海边，被描绘着冰面、潮水汹涌的大海窗户以及海浪涌入室内的场景所包围。这些作品超越了传统的平面绘画空间，让观者在仿佛重力停止的多维空间中，获得了主动参与的艺术体验。 在电影中，这样的故事似乎不会真实发生，但当这些画作聚集在一起，一次性呈现在眼前时，却让人仿佛目击了某个“事件”，产生了强烈的共鸣。此次展览给人一种错觉，仿佛在现实生活中目睹了那些原本似乎不可能发生的事情。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} In commemorating Kwon Jin Kyu's 50th anniversary, Seoul Museum of Art's Nam Seoul Museum is launching the "Kwon Jin Kyu's Forever Home" exhibition in 2023. Having received the Kwon Jin Kyu collection in 2021, the Seoul Museum of Art has transformed five exhibition rooms on the 1st floor of Nam Seoul Museum into a permanent exhibition space dedicated to Kwon JinKyu's valuable works and materials. This exhibition succinctly presents Kwon Jin Kyu's entire artistic realm, where he continuously observes and studies the subjects around him, capturing only their essence to manifest an enduring soul and eternity that never fades away. Kwon Jin Kyu (1922–1973) navigated through the Japanese colonial era and post-liberation during the severed diplomatic ties between Korea and Japan. Despite the challenges, he engaged as a sculptor, shuttling between the two countries. He established a unique artistic realm. For him, true art was incessantly observing and studying the subjects around him, capturing only their essence. He pursued not realism or beauty but an enduring soul, an eternity that never fades away. Seoul Museum of Art's Nam Seoul Museum aims to be both a perpetual resting place for his works and a nurturing ground for new research. Please explore his works in the exhibition inspired by the architectural structures, wooden furniture, shelves, and more from Tokyo Musashino Art University, where Kwon Jin Kyu dedicated himself to his work and the Seoul studio.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ソウル市立南ソウル美術館は、2023年、作家クォン·ジンギュ死去50周忌を迎え、『クォン·ジンギュの永遠の家』を開催します。2021年にクォン·ジンギュコレクションの保管を受けたソウル市立美術館は、南ソウル美術館1階5つの展示室をクォン·ジンギュ常設展示室として造設し、貴重な作品や資料を展示しています。 今回の展示は、周辺の対象を絶えず観察·研究し、本質だけを盛り込み、決して消えない魂や永遠性を具現化したクォン·ジンギュの作品世界をご覧いただけます。 クォン·ジンギュ(1922–1973)は、日本による植民地時代を経て、日韓国交断絶の状況の中、韓国と日本を行き来しながら彫刻家として活動し、独自の作品世界を作り上げました。彼にとって真の作品は、自分の周りの対象を絶えず観察・研究し、単に本質だけを盛り込んだものでした。彼が追求したのは、リアルでも美しいものでもなく、決して消えない魂や永遠性でした。 ソウル市立南ソウル美術館は、クォン·ジンギュの常設展示室を、彼が制作に熱中していた東京武蔵野美術学校やソウルのアトリエの建築構造や木造家具などからインスピレーションを受けて造設し、芸術研究の一部として大切に保管しています。ぜひ、ソウル市立南ソウル美術館で彼の作品世界をご堪能ください。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울시립 남서울미술관은 2023년 권진규 작고 50주기를 맞아 ≪권진규의 영원한 집≫을 개막합니다. 2021년 권진규 컬렉션을 수증한 서울시립미술관은 남서울미술관 1층 5개의 전시실을 권진규 상설전시실로 조성하고 귀한 작품과 자료를 선보입니다. 이번 전시는 주변의 대상을 끊임없이 관찰, 연구하여 단순히 본질만을 담아내어 결코 사라지지 않는 영혼, 영원성을 구현한 권진규의 작품세계 전체를 집약적으로 보여줍니다. 권진규(1922–1973)는 일제강점기를 거쳐 광복 이후 한일국교단절 상황에서 한국과 일본을 어렵게 오가며 조각가로 활동했고, 독자적인 작품세계를 구현했습니다. 그에게 진정한 작품은 자기 주변의 대상을 끊임없이 관찰, 연구하여 단순히 본질만을 담아낸 것이었습니다. 그가 추구한 것은 사실적인 것도, 아름다운 것도 아닌, 결코 사라지지 않는 영혼, 영원성이었습니다. 서울시립 남서울미술관은 그의 작품의 영원한 안식처이자 새로운 연구의 산실이 되고자 합니다. 권진규가 작업에 열중했던 도쿄 무사시노미술학교와 서울 아틀리에의 건축구조, 목조 가구, 선반, 등에서 영감을 받아 조성한 전시실에서 그의 작품을 둘러보시기 바랍니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 首尔市立南首尔美术馆为纪念Kwon Jinkyu离世50周年，将于2023年举办《Kwon Jinkyu永远的家》。2021年获得Kwon Jinkyu收藏品的首尔市立美术馆奖南首尔美术馆1层5个展厅打造成Kwon Jinkyu的常设展厅，展示珍贵的作品和资料。 本次展览集中展示了Kwon Jinkyu的作品世界，通过不断观察和研究周围的对象，单纯的包含本质，体现永不消失的灵魂和永恒性。 Kwon Jinkyu(1922-1973)经过日本帝国主义抢占时期，在光复后韩日断交的情况下，以雕刻家的身份艰难往返于韩国和日本之间，实现了独立的作品世界。对他来说，真正的作品是不断观察和研究自己周围的对象，单纯的表现出本质。他追求的不是事实，也不是美丽，而是永不消失的灵魂和永恒性。首尔市立南首尔美术馆是其作品的永久安置处和新研究的温床。 一起参观一下Kwon Jinkyu在东京武藏野美术大学和Atelier投入热情打造的建筑建构、木质家具、架子等中获得灵感的展览室。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} In commemorating Kwon Jin Kyu's 50th anniversary, Seoul Museum of Art's Nam Seoul Museum is launching the "Kwon Jin Kyu's Forever Home" exhibition in 2023. Having received the Kwon Jin Kyu collection in 2021, the Seoul Museum of Art has transformed five exhibition rooms on the 1st floor of Nam Seoul Museum into a permanent exhibition space dedicated to Kwon JinKyu's valuable works and materials. This exhibition succinctly presents Kwon Jin Kyu's entire artistic realm, where he continuously observes and studies the subjects around him, capturing only their essence to manifest an enduring soul and eternity that never fades away. Kwon Jin Kyu (1922–1973) navigated through the Japanese colonial era and post-liberation during the severed diplomatic ties between Korea and Japan. Despite the challenges, he engaged as a sculptor, shuttling between the two countries. He established a unique artistic realm. For him, true art was incessantly observing and studying the subjects around him, capturing only their essence. He pursued not realism or beauty but an enduring soul, an eternity that never fades away. Seoul Museum of Art's Nam Seoul Museum aims to be both a perpetual resting place for his works and a nurturing ground for new research. Please explore his works in the exhibition inspired by the architectural structures, wooden furniture, shelves, and more from Tokyo Musashino Art University, where Kwon Jin Kyu dedicated himself to his work and the Seoul studio.
name: Kwon Jin Kyu's Forever Home

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The museum is a place where memories are preserved and shared. The Seoul Museum of History actively encourages citizen donations to collect materials that embody Seoul’s history and culture and introduces newly donated items through exhibitions. This year, they have prepared a special exhibition focusing on items donated from 25 different places last year. Although each piece varies in the time it holds and its rarity, every item is a precious treasure to both the donors and the museum. To better highlight the value of these materials, the museum restores items in poor condition, translates classical Chinese texts into modern Korean for better understanding, and creates a more visitor-friendly exhibition environment. As you explore the exhibition, they hope you enjoy the time spent sharing these diverse treasures and memories.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 博物館は記憶を保管し、共有する場所です。ソウル歴史博物館は、ソウルの歴史と文化を秘めた資料を収集するため、市民からの寄贈を積極的に推進し、展示を通じて新たな寄贈資料をお知らせしています。 今年は、昨年25カ所から寄贈を受けた資料を中心に企画展示を準備しました。資料それぞれが秘める時間の量や希少性は異なりますが、寄贈者と博物館にとっては、どれも貴重な宝物です。 資料の価値がより際立つように、博物館では状態の悪い資料を保存処理し、漢文資料は現代の世代が理解できるようにハングルに翻訳し、観覧しやすい環境を整えて展示します。 展示室を巡りながら、さまざまな宝物や記憶を共有するひとときとなることを願っています。
desc_l10n.ko: 박물관은 기억을 보관하고 나누는 장소입니다. 서울역사박물관은 서울의 역사와 문화를 간직한 자료를 수집하기 위하여 시민 기증을 적극적으로 추진하고, 전시를 통하여 신규 기증자료를 알리고 있습니다. 올해는 작년에 25곳에서 기증 받은 자료를 중심으로 기획전시를 준비했습니다. 자료 하나하나가 간직한 시간의 양과 희소성은 다르지만, 기증자와 박물관에게는 모두 소중한 보물입니다. 자료의 가치가 좀 더 드러날 수 있도록 박물관에서는 상태가 안좋은 자료는 보존처리를 하고, 한문자료는 현 세대가 이해할 수 있는 한글로 번역하고, 관람이 편한 환경을 조성하여 전시로 선보이고자 합니다. 전시실을 둘러 보시면서 다양한 보물들과 다양한 기억을 나누는 시간이 되시길 바랍니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 博物馆是承载着保管与分享记忆使命的场所。首尔历史博物馆为了广泛收集并妥善保存首尔地区的历史与文化遗产资料，积极鼓励并推进市民捐赠活动。通过精心策划的展览宣传展示新接收的捐赠资料。 今年围绕去年获得的25处捐赠资料为核心，精心筹备了企划展示。尽管这些资料在保存年限和稀缺程度上各有差异，但无论是对于慷慨的捐赠者还是博物馆而言都是无价的珍宝。 为了进一步提升资料的价值，将对状态不佳的资料进行妥善保存与处理，将汉字资料翻译成现代韩文，以便当代人能够轻松理解，营造一个舒适宜人的参观环境，以展示的形式，将珍贵的资料呈现给公众。 诚挚地邀请大家参观展览室，与众多珍贵的宝物相遇，共同回味它们承载的丰富记忆与故事。

This house is one of the early 20th-century Western-style buildings constructed by Westerners who entered Seoul, along the hills of Hongpa-dong, Sajik-dong, and Haengchon-dong in the Seodaemun area. Reborn as the Lee Hoe-young Memorial Hall, this house possesses rich historical backgrounds and values even from an architectural history perspective. To remember its significance together, the Lee Hoe-young Memorial Hall gave this old Western-style building the nickname 'The Old House on Sajik-dong Hill' while reshaping the site. Mr. Lee Hoe-young devoted himself to the anti-Japanese independence movement, contributing his entire family wealth to establish the Shinheung Military Academy. At the Lee Hoe-young Memorial Hall, encounter the history of the independence movement expressed with modern aesthetics, alongside the stories of the finest family of the Joseon Dynasty, the greatest revolutionaries of Joseon, the people who turned darkness into light, and the people who turned orchid leaves into blades.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} イ・フェヨン(李会栄)記念館は、独立運動家のウダン(友堂)イ・フェヨン(李会栄)先生と6人の兄弟、そしてその同志たちの志を称える空間です。この家は、20世紀初頭、ソウルに居住した西洋人たちがソデムン(西大門)一帯のホンパドン(紅把洞)、サジクドン(社稷洞)、ヘンチョンドン(杏村洞)の丘に沿って建てた洋風建築の一つです。 イ・フェヨン(李会栄)記念館として新たに生まれ変わったこの家は、建築史の観点からも豊かな歴史と価値を秘めています。その由来を後世に伝えるため、記念館では敷地を整備する際、この歴史ある洋風建築に「サジクドン(社稷洞)の丘の古い家」という愛称を付けました。 イ・フェヨン(李会栄)先生は、家門の財産をすべて投じて新興武官学校を設立するなど、抗日独立運動に生涯を捧げました。イ・フェヨン(李会栄)記念館で、朝鮮屈指の名門家でありながら最高の革命家でもあった彼ら、暗闇を光に変えた人々、そして蘭の葉を刀に変えた人々の物語とともに、現代的な美意識で表現された独立運動史をご体験ください。
desc_l10n.ko: 이회영기념관은 독립운동가 우당 이회영 6형제와 그의 동지들을 기리는 공간입니다. 이 집은 서울에 들어온 서양인들이 서대문 일대에서 홍파동 사직동 행촌동 언덕을 따라 지은 20세기 초기 양식 건물 중 하나입니다. 이회영기념관으로 새로 태어난 이 집은 건축 역사로 봐도 풍부한 내력과 가치를 지니고 있습니다. 그 뜻 또한 함께 기억하고자 이회영기념관에서는 터를 새로 닦으면서 오래된 이 양식 건물에 ‘사직동 언덕 묵은집’이라는 별칭을 붙였습니다. 이회영 선생은 온 집안의 재산을 출연해 신흥무관학교를 설립하는 등 항일 독립운동에 투신했습니다. 이회영기념관에서 조선 최고의 가문, 조선 최고의 혁명가들, 어둠을 빛으로 바꾼 사람들, 난잎을 칼로 바꾼 사람들의 이야기와 함께 현대적 미감으로 표현된 독립운동사를 만나보세요.

These artists expand various social issues from personal reflections to broader social concepts, displaying them in the gallery. desc_l10n.ko: 슈페리어갤러리는 ‘인간, 관계, 공존’을 주제로 작업하는 김찬주, 안희진, 이겨레 작가의 [너와 나 그리고 그곳에] 전시를 선보입니다. 작가들은 다양한 사회 문제를 개인의 고민에서 시작해 사회적 개념으로 확장하여 이를 전시장에 펼쳐 놓습니다. 예술이 현 사회 속에서 어떤 역할을 할 수 있는가에 대한 물음으로 시작한 캔버스 위의 풍경은 회화가 세상을 변화시킬 수 있다는 작가들의 예술관을 반영하고 있습니다. 나로부터 시작해 다 같이 어울리는 공존의 시선을 슈페리어갤러리에서 느껴보시길 바랍니다. [너와 나 그리고 그곳에] 전시는 9월 2일까지 진행됩니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The story of four men who dreamed of peace. Taejong, who ascended to the throne covered in the blood of countless vassals, relatives, and brothers, gave his sons the title "Nyeong (寧)," meaning "peace." Why did he choose this word? The princes who received the name "Nyeong" had to desperately search for what peace meant to them, navigating days and nights filled with desire and duty, despair and discipline, joy and fear. This work questions the meaning of "peace" through the lives of Taejong and his three sons.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 平安を夢見る4人の物語 正嫡と外戚、兄弟たちの多くの血を浴びて王の座に就いた太宗。そんな彼は、なぜ子どもたちに「平安」を意味する「寧」という名を大君に授けたのでしょうか。「寧」という名を受けた王子たちは、数多くの昼と夜、欲望と責任、絶望と節制、喜びと恐怖の間で、自分がたどり着かなければならない平安とは何かを必死で探さなければなりませんでした。この作品は、太宗と3人の王子たちのそれぞれ異なる人生の中で、「平安」とは何かについて問いかけています。
desc_l10n.ko: 평안을 꿈꾼 네 명의 이야기 정적과 외척, 형제들의 수많은 피를 뒤집어쓰고 왕의 자리에 오른 태종, 그는 왜 자식들에게 ‘평안하다’라는 뜻의 녕(寧)을 대군의 이름으로 내렸을까? 녕(寧)의 이름을 받은 왕자들은 수많은 낮과 밤 욕망과 책임, 절망과 절제, 희락과 두려움 사이에서 필사적으로 자신이 도달할 평안함이 무엇인지 찾아야 했습니다. 이 작품은 태종과 세 왕자의 각기 다른 삶 속에서 ‘평안’에 대해 묻습니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 追寻安宁的四人之梦 在肃静与外戚的阴影下，背负着兄弟们的淋漓鲜血登上王位的太宗，为何会将寓意“平安”的“宁”字，赐予自己的儿子作为大君之名？被赐予“宁”之名的王子们，在无数的日夜里，于欲望与责任、绝望与节制、欢愉与恐惧之间，必须拼尽全力去寻找他们所能抵达的“安宁”究竟为何物。这部作品，正是在太宗与三位王子迥异的人生轨迹中，追问关于“平安”的真谛。

desc_l10n.ko: 그라운드시소는 국내외 다양한 문화예술 IP로 전시를 제작, 소개하는 전시플랫폼입니다. 그라운드시소에서 열리는 전시들을 살펴보면 예술문화의 변화와 흐름을 기민하게 받아들이고 유연하게 반응해 다양한 트렌드와 이슈들을 주목하며 그에 맞춰 변화하고 성장하는 모습들을 지켜볼 수 있습니다. 서촌에 방문하게 된다면 들려야하는 빠지지 않는 코스 중 한 곳으로 깔끔하고 정돈된 전시 공간과 루트로 사람들의 마음을 사로잡습니다. 또한 건물 자체만으로도 아름다운 볼거리를 제공해 산책코스로도 사랑받고 있는 장소입니다. 가장 높은 층에서는 인왕산을 배경으로 하는 서촌의 전망도 구경할 수 있습니다.

As architect Florian Beigel said, "Design is not about planning a picnic, but preparing a mat," piknic was planned as a single venue where various artistic activities such as exhibitions, performances, gardens, gastronomy, and reading are possible. The old building, which was used as a pharmaceutical company's headquarters in the 1970s, has been reborn as a cultural space where an exhibition hall, cafe, shop, restaurant, garden, and vegetable garden coexist while retaining the mood of the past. Currently, at piknic, various cultural programs are regularly held, including diverse special exhibitions, creative performances such as a play theater, a novel theater, and a silent film theater, as well as a garden school, music appreciation sessions, and piknic kids.

desc_l10n.ko: 2018년 개관한 피크닉은 도심 속 문화 공간입니다. “디자인은 피크닉을 계획하는 것이 아니라 돗자리를 준비하는 일이다”라는 건축가 플로리안 베이겔의 말처럼, 피크닉은 전시, 공연, 정원, 미식, 독서 등 다양한 예술 활동이 가능한 하나의 장으로 계획되었습니다. 1970년대에 제약회사 사옥으로 쓰이던 옛 건물은 과거의 정취를 간직한 채 전시장, 카페, 상점, 레스토랑, 정원과 텃밭이 함께 자리하는 문화 공간으로 다시 태어났습니다. 현재 피크닉에서는 다양한 기획 전시를 비롯해 희곡극장, 소설극장, 무성영화극장 등 창작 공연과 정원학교, 음악감상회, 피크닉 키즈 등 여러 문화 프로그램이 정기적으로 개최되고 있습니다.

Inspired by Kim Chung-up's thought and architecture, artist Lee Jung-yoon newly transforms the Kim Chung-up Architecture Culture House into a 'Singing House,' centering on her work. We hope you experience the moment when various senses intersect and expand in the correspondence between the two artists, crossing boundaries between architecture and art, form and rhythm, settlement and movement.

desc_l10n.ko: 성북구립미술관은 김중업의 건축적 철학이 담긴 공간, 김중업 건축문화의 집에서 2026년 기획전시 ≪이정윤: 노래하는 집≫을 개최합니다. 김중업의 사유와 건축에서 영감을 받은 작가 이정윤은 <다정한 오너먼트> 작업을 중심으로 김중업 건축문화의 집을 ‘노래하는 집’으로 새롭게 변주합니다. 건축과 예술, 조형과 리듬, 정주와 이동을 넘나드는 두 예술가의 조응 속에서 다양한 감각이 교차하고 확장되는 순간을 경험해보시길 바랍니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Space K Seoul is pleased to present 《Dreams for Hire》, a solo exhibition by London-based artist Minyoung Choi (b.1989). The artist gathers fragments of memories from her childhood and experiences of migration and presents them as dreamlike scenes between dreams and reality. Dolphins appear in the Han River at sunset, penguins appear next to a person asleep in the living room, or a rainbow in the middle of the night shines like a cluster of moons, creating a new landscape where elements that wouldn't coexist on the same screen are mixed together. The artist's magical realist landscapes invite us to imagine unique narratives and meanings. Minyoung Choi's strange and familiar world feels like dreams where the impossible is realized, and they allow us to look at the various realities we encounter in a new light.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} KOLONの文化芸術シェアスペース「スペースKソウル」では、ロンドンを拠点に活動するチェ・ミニョン作家(1989年生)の個展<夢をお貸しします>を開催します。作家は幼少期や移住経験の記憶のカケラを集めて、夢と現実の狭間にある夢幻的な場面として表現します。例えば、夕暮れのハンガン(漢江)にイルカが現れたり、リビングで眠る人のそばにペンギンが現れたり、深夜に浮かぶ虹が月がさのように輝いたりと、一つの画面には共存し得ない要素が混ざり合った新しい風景が誕生します。作家が生み出す魔法のようなリアリズムの風景は、私たちに独特な物語と意味を想像させます。チェ・ミニョン作家の見慣れないけれど、どこか親しみのある世界は、まるで不可能が実現する夢のように感じられ、私たちが直面するさまざまな現実を新たな次元から眺めることとなるでしょう。
desc_l10n.ko: 코오롱의 문화예술 나눔공간 스페이스K 서울은 런던을 중심으로 활동하는 최민영(b.1989)의 개인전 《꿈을 빌려드립니다》를 개최합니다. 작가는 유년 시절과 이주의 경험에서 비롯된 기억의 편린들을 모아 꿈과 현실 사이의 몽환적인 장면으로 표현합니다. 일몰의 한강에 돌고래가 출몰하거나, 거실에 잠든 사람 옆에 펭귄이 나타나거나, 한밤중 뜬 무지개가 달무리처럼 빛이 나면서 한 화면에 공존할 수 없는 요소들이 뒤섞인 새로운 풍경이 탄생합니다. 작가가 빚어낸 마술적 사실주의 풍경들은 우리에게 독특한 서사와 의미를 상상하게 합니다. 최민영의 낯설고 친숙한 세계는 마치 불가능한 일이 실현되는 꿈처럼 다가오며, 우리가 마주하는 다양한 현실을 새로운 차원에서 바라보게 합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Space K首尔，作为COLON的文化艺术分享空间，即将举办以伦敦为核心灵感的CHOI MINYEONG（生于1989年）个人展览《将梦想借予你》。此次展览汇聚了艺术家从幼年时期到移居经历中的记忆碎片，通过梦幻般的场景展现梦想与现实之间的交织。作品中，日落后的汉江上海豚跃动，客厅中沉睡之人身旁企鹅现身，深夜时分彩虹如月晕般璀璨升起，这些在常规认知中无法共存的元素，在画布上融合成一幅幅新奇的风景。CHOI MINYEONG所创造的魔术现实主义景致，激发了观众对独特叙事与深层意义的想象。她所呈现的这个既陌生又熟悉的世界，如同实现不可能之梦般触手可及，引领我们以全新的视角审视周遭的现实世界。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Space K Seoul is pleased to present 《Dreams for Hire》, a solo exhibition by London-based artist Minyoung Choi (b.1989). The artist gathers fragments of memories from her childhood and experiences of migration and presents them as dreamlike scenes between dreams and reality. Dolphins appear in the Han River at sunset, penguins appear next to a person asleep in the living room, or a rainbow in the middle of the night shines like a cluster of moons, creating a new landscape where elements that wouldn't coexist on the same screen are mixed together. The artist's magical realist landscapes invite us to imagine unique narratives and meanings. Minyoung Choi's strange and familiar world feels like dreams where the impossible is realized, and they allow us to look at the various realities we encounter in a new light.
name: Minyoung Choi: Dreams for Hire

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Gallery THEO, known for showcasing Korean art's broad spectrum and diversity, was established in 2020 by two directors with experience in the UK and the international art market. They aimed to introduce global expertise and networks to the Korean art scene. Located in front of the UNESCO World Heritage site Seonjeongneung, THEO is dedicated to supporting young and talented Korean artists, regardless of artistic genre, and uncovering the potential in their works. The gallery actively provides a platform for Korean artists to grow and thrive. In addition, THEO introduces international artists to the Korean and Asian art communities, fostering cross-cultural exchanges and expanding artistic discourse beyond national borders. THEO continues to host exhibitions featuring diverse artists worldwide. It aims to create a space where artists can coexist and flourish, driven by a commitment to challenging projects and artistic excellence.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 韓国美術の幅広いスペクトラムと多様性が際立つギャラリー「THEO」は、2020年にイギリスとアメリカの美術市場でキャリアを積んだ2人のディレクターによって設立されました。THEOは国際的な専門性とネットワークを韓国美術界に導入することを目指しています。 世界文化遺産に指定されたソンジョンヌン(宣靖陵)の前に位置するTHEOは、芸術ジャンルにとらわれず、若く才能ある韓国のアーティストたちを支援し、その作品に潜在能力を見出すことに専念しています。韓国のアーティストたちにプラットフォームを提供し、彼らの成長と発展を積極的にサポートしています。 また、THEOは海外のアーティストを韓国およびアジアのアーティストに紹介し、国を超えた文化交流を促進し、芸術的な論議を広げることに努めています。現在もTHEOは世界中のさまざまなアーティストの展示会を開催しており、新しい挑戦を追求するプロジェクトとアーティストの卓越した才能を尊重する姿勢を基盤に、アーティストたちが共存し繁栄できる空間へと進化しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 한국미술의 폭 넓은 스펙트럼과 다양성이 돋보이는 갤러리 띠오(THEO)는, 2020년 영국과 미술 시장에서 경력을 쌓은 두 명의 디렉터가 국제적 전문성과 네트워크를 한국 미술계에 도입하기 위해 설립되었습니다. 세계 문화유산으로 지정된 선정릉 앞에 위치한 띠오는, 예술 장르에 관계 없이 젊고 재능 있는 한국 예술가들을 지원하고 그들의 작품에서 잠재력을 찾아내는 데 전념하고 있습니다. 한국의 예술가들에게 플랫폼을 제공하여 그들이 성장하고 발전할 수 있도록 적극적으로 지원합니다. 또한 띠오는 해외 작가들을 한국 및 아시아 작가들에게 소개하며, 국가를 넘어 세계의 문화 간 교류를 촉진하고 예술적 담론을 확장하기 위해 노력하고 있습니다. 현재까지도 띠오는 전 세계 다양한 작가들의 전시회를 개최하고 있습니다. 이곳은 도전적인 프로젝트와 예술가들의 우수성에 대한 헌신을 바탕으로, 예술가들이 함께 공존하고 번영할 수 있는 공간으로 나아갈 예정입니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} THEO画廊，以其彰显韩国美术的广泛性与多样性而著称，是由两位在2020年于英国美术市场积累丰富经验的总监共同创立的。他们旨在将国际专业水准与网络力量引入韩国美术界，以推动其进一步发展。 坐落于世界文化遗产宣靖陵之前，THEO画廊跨越艺术类型的界限，积极投身于扶持年轻且才华横溢的韩国艺术家。它深入挖掘这些艺术家作品中的潜力，为他们搭建起一个展示才华的平台，并全力支持他们的成长与艺术探索。 此外，THEO还致力于成为连接韩国及亚洲艺术家与海外作家的桥梁，通过引介与交流，促进跨国界、全球性的文化交流与艺术讨论，不断拓宽艺术视野。至今，该画廊持续举办着汇聚全球各地艺术家作品的展览，以富有挑战性的项目和对艺术卓越性的不懈追求为基础，携手艺术家们共同迈向一个共存共荣的艺术空间。

desc_l10n.en: One early morning in early April, while strolling in the corner of Paju as usual, I unexpectedly came across a certain scenery. The dense fog gradually cleared, revealing a place filled with dew-covered grass awakening from sleep, permeating the air with freshness. The sounds of footsteps on the ground and leaves rustling harmonized. Finding a space where I could be free brought me great joy. Since then, I found myself returning to that spot even when the grass grew wildly uncontrollable during the torrential rains of the monsoon season or when the snow piled up thickly. Around the middle of April, a week with the most rapid changes occurs there. The same plants grow in different locations each year, and accordingly, the impressions of the place change each time. Although they quickly disappeared, it was an attempt to capture the most beautiful week. Pause for a moment and immerse yourself in the presence of artworks that capture the essence of both existence and non-existence within 7 am Green pew.
desc_l10n.ja: 4月初めの早朝、いつものようにパジュ(坡州)の片隅を散歩していると偶然ある風景に出くわしました。 立ち込めた霧が徐々に晴れて現れたここは、露を含んだ草が目を覚ますような匂いで満たされ、土を踏む音と葉っぱが触れ合う音が調和していました。自分自身が自由にいられる空間を見つけたようで嬉しかったです。 その後、数え切れないほど草が生い茂ってきた時も、雨が土砂降りに降る梅雨の時期も、冷たい雪がどっさりと積もった時も訪れる場所となりました。 4月中旬頃の一週間は、その場に最も早い変化が生じる時期です。同じ植物が毎年違うところに育ち、それによってこの場所の印象も毎回変化しました。すぐに消えてしまいますが、だからこそ一番美しい一週間を盛り込もうとしました。 そばに存在しているようで存在しないパーツを集めて作った展示『7am Green pew』をぜひご覧ください。
desc_l10n.ko: 어느 4월 초 이른 아침, 여느 때와 같이 파주의 한구석을 산책하다가 우연히 어떤 풍경을 마주했습니다. 자욱한 안개가 서서히 걷히며 드러난 이곳은 이슬을 머금은 풀들이 잠에서 깨어나는 냄새로 가득 차 있었으며, 흙 밟는 소리와 잎사귀들이 맞닿으며 내는 소리들이 함께 조화를 이루고 있었습니다. 내 자신이 자유롭게 있을 수 있는 공간을 찾아낸 것 같아 반가움이 컸습니다. 그 후로 헤칠 수 없을 만큼 풀이 무성하게 자라났을 때에도, 비가 억수같이 내리는 장마철에도, 시리도록 소복이 눈이 쌓일 때도 찾게 되는 자리가 생겼습니다. 4월 중순 즈음의 일주일은 그 자리에 가장 빠른 변화가 생기는 시기입니다. 같은 식물들이 매년 다른 위치에 자라나고, 그에 따라 그곳의 인상도 매번 변화했습니다. 금세 사라져버리지만 그렇기에 가장 아름다운 일주일을 담아내고자 했습니다. 곁에 존재하면서도 존재하지 않는 조각을 모아 만든 《7am Green pew》에 잠시 머물러 보세요.
desc_l10n.zh: 4月初的一个清晨，像往常一样在坡州的一个角落散步时偶然遇到的某种风景。 雾气渐渐散去，这里充满了满是露珠的草丛从睡梦中苏醒的味道，踩泥土的声音和叶子相接发出的声音融合在一起。好像找到了可以自由呆着的空间，所以非常高兴。 从那以后，草长得茂盛、大雨倾盆的雨季、雪积成堆的时候都有了想去看看的地方。 4月中旬左右的一周是那个地方发生变化最快的时期，同样的植物每年都在不同的位置生长，那里的景观也在变化着。虽然很快就会消失，但正因为如此，想拍出最美丽的一周。 将身边存在却又不存在的碎片收集而成的《7am Green pew》，请暂时驻足欣赏吧。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The SeMA Omnibus is a largescale collection-based exhibition presented at the main branch and three branches of the Seoul Museum of Art under the theme of the museum’s 2024 institutional agenda, “connection.” The exhibition SeMA Omnibus: I Want to Love Us, at the Buk-Seoul Museum of Art, reflects the diverse stories of minorities that cannot be reduced to a collective narrative and envisions a new community connected by individuals who are all unique in their own right. This exhibition is focused on social minorities oppressed and/or discriminated against due to various reasons, such as race, nationality, gender, age, physical condition, sexual orientation, sociocultural environment, and/or economic status. In any highly competitive neoliberal society, the problems faced by minorities are often treated as secondary or not recognized as problems at all, and attempts at collectivization frequently fall apart. On the other hand, even when minorities are collectivized through social welfare policies or collectivized to assert their rightful place in society, individual lives are overlooked, and only the aspects of the collective identity that society expects are reduced to “a single story.” Minorities need collectivization to eliminate oppression and discrimination, but they face the paradox in which individual diversity is erased during the process of unification in and among minority groups. This exhibition aims to demonstrate ways to include the diversity of individuals without collectivizing minorities. Through art, it seeks ways for vulnerable individuals to affirm themselves and find love for the “us” composed of individuals with unique bodies and minds. Instead of categorizing the works by specific identities, the exhibition focuses on the shared experiences of social minorities. Furthermore, it explores the possibility of individuals uniting while respecting each other's diversity. * The title of this exhibition is borrowed from the book Minor Feelings, with permission from Cathy Park Hong and Jeff Chang.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} SeMAオムニバスは、2024年にソウル市立美術館がテーマとして掲げる「連結」に基づき、本館と分館など4カ所で開催される大規模な所蔵品企画展です。北ソウル美術館で開催されるSeMAオムニバス《私は私たちを愛したい》は、集団化された物語に還元されることのない社会的少数者たちの多様な話に耳を傾け、互いに異なる個人が連結されて新しいコミュニティを想像するために企画された展示です。 この展示は、人種、国籍、性別、年齢、身体的条件、性的指向、社会文化的環境、経済状況など、さまざまな理由で抑圧や差別を受けている社会的少数者たちに焦点を当てています。競争が激化した新自由主義社会では、少数者が抱える問題は二次的に扱われるか、問題自体が認識されず、集団化しようとする試みは頻繁に崩れることがあります。一方、社会福祉政策の観点や少数者が社会で自分の権利を主張するために集団化された場合でも、個々の生活は無視され、集団化されたアイデンティティで社会が期待する部分だけが縮小されて「単一の物語」として伝えられます。少数者は抑圧と差別を排除するために集団化を必要としますが、その過程で少数者個々の多様性が消失するという逆説的な状況に直面します。本展示では、少数者を集団化することなく個々の多様性を受け入れる道を示そうとしています。アートを通じて、脆弱な個人が自分を肯定し、互いに異なる身体と心を持つ個人から成る「私たち」を愛する方法を探ります。展示は、作品を特定のアイデンティティでカテゴライズするのではなく、少数者たちが共有する共通的な経験に焦点を当て、個人が互いの多様性を尊重しながら連帯できる可能性を模索します。 * 本展示のタイトルは、『Minor Feelings』(2021)から借用したもので、Cathy Park HongとJeff Changから使用許可を得ています。
desc_l10n.ko: SeMA 옴니버스는 2024년 서울시립미술관 기관의제 ‘연결’을 주제로 하여 본관과 분관 등 4곳에서 개최되는 대규모 소장품 기획전이다. 북서울미술관에서 열리는 SeMA 옴니버스 《나는 우리를 사랑하고 싶다》는 집단화된 이야기로 환원되지 않는 사회적 소수자들의 다양한 이야기에 귀를 기울이고, 서로 다른 개인들로 연결되는 새로운 공동체를 상상하기 위해 기획된 전시이다. 전시는 인종, 국적, 성별, 나이, 신체적 조건, 성적 지향, 사회문화적 환경, 경제적 상황 등 다양한 이유로 억압과 차별을 받는 사회적 소수자들에 주목한다. 경쟁이 과열된 신자유주의 사회에서 소수자가 가진 문제는 부차적으로 다루어지거나 문제 자체로 인식되지 않으며, 집단화하려는 시도는 빈번하게 와해된다. 다른 한편으로 사회 복지 정책의 차원에서 혹은 소수자가 사회에서 제 몫을 주장하기 위해 집단화되더라도 개별적인 삶은 무시되고 집단화된 정체성에서 사회가 기대하는 부분만 축소되어 “단일한 이야기”로 전달된다. 소수자는 억압과 차별을 철폐하기 위해 집단화를 필요로 하지만, 소수자 집단 내부의 결집 과정에서 소수자 개별의 다양성이 삭제되는 역설을 겪는다. 이번 전시에서는 소수자를 집단화하지 않고 개별의 다양성을 포용할 수 있는 길을 보여주고자 한다. 예술을 통해, 취약한 개인이 자신을 긍정하고 서로 다른 몸과 마음을 가진 개인으로 구성된 ‘우리’를 사랑할 수 있는 방법을 찾는다. 전시는 작업을 특정 정체성으로 범주화하여 보여주기보다 소수자들이 공유하는 공통적인 경험에 초점을 맞춘다. 그리고 개인이 서로의 다양성을 존중하면서 연대할 수 있는 가능성을 모색한다. * 본 전시 제목은 『마이너 필링스』(2021)에 나오는 문구를 차용하였으며, 캐시 박 홍과 제프 창에게 사용 허락을 받았다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} SeMA omnibus是围绕2024年首尔市立美术馆的核心议题“连接”而精心策划的一场大型藏品展览，该展览横跨主楼与副楼等四处展区。同时，北首尔美术馆亦将推出SEMAomnibus《我想爱我们》，该系列旨在倾听那些无法被单一化叙事所涵盖的社会少数群体的多元故事，通过艺术构想，探索构建跨越个体界限的新共同体愿景。 本次展览聚焦于那些因人种、国籍、性别、年龄、身体条件、性取向、社会文化环境及经济状况等多重因素而遭受压迫与歧视的社会少数群体。在新自由主义社会背景下，过度竞争往往导致少数群体的议题被边缘化或忽视，集体化的努力亦频繁遭遇挑战。尽管社会福利政策和少数群体的自我组织在一定程度上寻求改变，但往往侧重于集体认同的构建，却忽视了个体生活的多样性，导致“单一故事”的再现。展览深刻反思了少数群体在寻求团结以对抗压迫与歧视的过程中，可能面临的个体多样性被削弱的悖论。因此，展览力求展现一条非集体化却包容个别差异的道路，通过艺术的力量，帮助脆弱的个体找到自我肯定的方式，并学会去爱那个由不同身体与心灵组成的“我们”。展览的核心不在于将作品归类于某种特定的认同感之下，而是聚焦于少数群体共享的普遍经验，同时鼓励个人在尊重彼此多样性的基础上，探索合作与联合的新可能。 * 本次展览的题目是《Minor Feelings》(2021年)中的句子，得到了Cathy Park Hong和Jeff Chang的正式使用许可。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The SeMA Omnibus is a largescale collection-based exhibition presented at the main branch and three branches of the Seoul Museum of Art under the theme of the museum’s 2024 institutional agenda, “connection.” The exhibition SeMA Omnibus: I Want to Love Us, at the Buk-Seoul Museum of Art, reflects the diverse stories of minorities that cannot be reduced to a collective narrative and envisions a new community connected by individuals who are all unique in their own right. This exhibition is focused on social minorities oppressed and/or discriminated against due to various reasons, such as race, nationality, gender, age, physical condition, sexual orientation, sociocultural environment, and/or economic status. In any highly competitive neoliberal society, the problems faced by minorities are often treated as secondary or not recognized as problems at all, and attempts at collectivization frequently fall apart. On the other hand, even when minorities are collectivized through social welfare policies or collectivized to assert their rightful place in society, individual lives are overlooked, and only the aspects of the collective identity that society expects are reduced to “a single story.” Minorities need collectivization to eliminate oppression and discrimination, but they face the paradox in which individual diversity is erased during the process of unification in and among minority groups. This exhibition aims to demonstrate ways to include the diversity of individuals without collectivizing minorities. Through art, it seeks ways for vulnerable individuals to affirm themselves and find love for the “us” composed of individuals with unique bodies and minds. Instead of categorizing the works by specific identities, the exhibition focuses on the shared experiences of social minorities. Furthermore, it explores the possibility of individuals uniting while respecting each other's diversity. * The title of this exhibition is borrowed from the book Minor Feelings, with permission from Cathy Park Hong and Jeff Chang.
name: SeMA Omnibus - I Want to Love Us

In the cold winter, with gently falling snow, you can experience the strong vitality of plants that grow new buds, and the charm of white and clean Hanji (Korean traditional paper) like snow. The New Year's special exhibition "Snow" showcases works by artist Kim Hyun-Joo, who primarily works with stone and Hanji, and bonsai works with attractive new buds particularly prominent in winter. desc_l10n.ko: 2025년 따뜻한 새해를 알리는 특별전 눈에 여러분을 초대합니다. 아직 추운 겨울 소복이 내리는 눈, 그 속에서도 새눈이 자라는 식물의 강한 생명력, 눈처럼 새하얗고 깨끗한 한지의 매력. 새해 기획전 눈은 돌과 한지를 주 매체로 작업하는 김현주 작가의 작품과 겨울철 유난히 돋보이는 가지의 새눈이 매력적인 분재 작품을 선보입니다. 새하얀 눈의 여백과 한지의 질감, 그리고 식물의 강인함으로 차가운 공기를 깨고 따뜻하게 다가오는 순수한 자연을 여러분께 전합니다. 직접 보고 마음으로 느끼며 당신의 ‘눈’에 소중히 담아 가세요.

It stands as a symbolic place that connects nature, the city, and people—a vast natural wonder running through the heart of South Korea and a cherished cultural heritage of the nation. At the Hangang Story Exhibition Hall, visitors can experience the history and cultural significance of the Hangang River, exploring its evolution through different eras and stories intricately tied to everyday life. *Temporarily closed from July 1, 2025 for improvement of aging facilities

desc_l10n.ko: 한강은 우리 곁에서 함께하는 삶의 터전과 문화 향유의 공간입니다. 자연과 도시, 사람을 연결하는 상징적인 장소이며 대한민국의 중심을 가로지르는 거대한 자연이자 우리 민족의 자랑스러운 문화유산입니다. 한강이야기전시관에서 시대별 한강의 변천사부터 우리 삶과 연결된 이야기까지 한강의 역사와 문화적 가치를 경험하는 계기가 되기를 바랍니다. *노후시설 개선을 위한 25년7월1일부터 임시휴관

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} We recall the moment of opening a wardrobe door. The time brushing past fabrics, the memories lingering on our fingertips, countless garments and stories, and small attempts accumulate to become a single legacy. This exhibition focuses on the unseen, initial moments before fashion is completed. It is a journey tracing how the smallest fragments of thought—an unfamiliar object, a passing landscape, a sudden imagination—are realized into a single garment. A single flower, a folded piece of paper, and a moment of light and shadow are reborn as wearable art through a designer's perspective. Through a carefully selected collection from the 500,000 authentic archives amassed by the E-Land Museum over 30 years, you can encounter the magnificent beginnings of global designers, from Alexander McQueen to Yves Saint Laurent, in one place.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} クローゼットの扉を開ける瞬間を思い浮かべてみてください。布の間をかすめていく時間、指先に残る記憶、数々の衣服と物語、そして小さな試みが幾重にも積み重なり、一つの遺産となります。本展は、ファッションが完成する前、目に見えない「始まりの瞬間」に注目します。見慣れない事物、通り過ぎた風景、偶然ひらめいた想像のように、ごく小さな思考の断片が、どのようにして一着の衣服へと完成していくのかを辿る旅路です。 一輪の花、折られた一枚の紙、光と影が織りなす瞬間は、デザイナーの視線を経て「まとう芸術」へと生まれ変わります。イーランドミュージアムが30年間にわたり収集してきた50万点の本物のアーカイブから厳選されたコレクションを通じて、アレキサンダー・マックイーンからイヴ・サンローランまで、世界的なデザイナーたちの偉大なる始まりを会場で体感してみてください。
desc_l10n.ko: 옷장 문을 여는 순간을 떠올립니다. 천 사이로 스치는 시간, 손끝에 남는 기억, 수많은 옷과 이야기, 그리고 작은 시도들이 차곡차곡 쌓여 하나의 유산이 됩니다. 이번 전시는 패션이 완성되기 이전, 보이지 않는 처음의 순간에 주목합니다. 낯선 사물, 스쳐 간 풍경, 우연히 떠오른 상상처럼 아주 작은 생각의 조각들이 어떻게 하나의 옷으로 완성되는지를 따라가는 여정입니다. 꽃 한 송이, 접힌 종이 한 장, 빛과 그림자의 순간은 디자이너의 시선을 거쳐 입는 예술로 다시 태어납니다. 이랜드 뮤지엄이 30년간 수집해 온 50만 점의 진품 아카이브 중 엄선된 컬렉션을 통해 알렉산더 맥퀸부터 이브 생 로랑까지 세계적인 디자이너들의 위대한 시작을 한자리에서 만나볼 수 있습니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 回想推开衣橱门的那一刻。布料间流转的时光、指尖留存的回忆，一件件衣物与背后的故事，还有无数次小小的尝试，层层累积，最终沉淀为一份珍贵遗产。本次展览聚焦时尚作品诞生之初、那些不为人知的起点。跟随展品一同探寻陌生的物件、转瞬即逝的风景、灵光一闪的思绪，这些细碎的灵感碎片，是如何一步步化作一件件服饰。 一朵繁花、一张折纸、光影交错的瞬间，经由设计师的巧思打磨，蜕变为可身着的艺术。衣恋博物馆30年来收藏了50万件珍贵藏品，本次展览从中精选佳作。在这里，您可以一站式邂逅从亚历山大・麦昆到伊夫・圣·罗兰等一众国际知名设计师的创作原点。
