desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} On view from August 9 to November 10, Space K Seoul is pleased to present "Yellow Sea", a solo exhibition of works by Kylie Manning. Informed by coastal experiences from her upbringing in Alaska and Mexico, the works combine seascapes and ambiguous figures, moving between moments of clarity and abstraction. In a technique employed by Dutch Baroque painters, the artist builds up layers of thin paint, refracting light through the oils in each layer to create a self-luminous effect. The result is a lush harmony of radiant textures and delicate colors. This exhibition features the artist’s most ambitious project to date, submerging viewers in the rippling compositions of a new installation created specifically for Space K. Three large paintings on silk scrim will cascade through the exhibition space like film strips of the surrounding compositions. Measuring nearly 7 meters wide, three silk scrims by Manning are suspended in the center of the exhibition space, creating a stage-like effect. Each scrim is divided into five individual strips, acting as live gridded capsules. This allows the audience to traverse the oscillating vistas of Manning’s work alongside her represented figures. Manning draws inspiration from the tides of the ‘Yellow Sea’ that joins China and the Korean peninsula, meditating on ‘what is distilled after a tide removes excess debris, noise, and marks’. This exhibition will be an exciting opportunity to immerse visitors in the majestic seascapes alchemized by ‘Kylie Manning'.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Space K Seoulでは8月9日から11月10日まで、アメリカのブルックリンを拠点に国際的に活動している「カイリー・マニング(Kylie Manning、1983年生まれ)」の個展《黄海》を開催します。アラスカとメキシコでの海との関わりが色濃く表れた彼女の絵画は、海の風景と人物が交錯し、具象と抽象を行き来します。彼女はオランダのバロック絵画の技法を用い、薄く彩色した層を何層も重ね、その層の油分で光を屈折させることで、作品自体が発光する効果を狙っています。そのため、彼女の作品はつややかな質感と繊細な色彩のバランスが際立っています。 今回の展示では、Space Kの空間を考慮し、大型絵画3点を展示場の中央に吊るす新作を意欲的に発表します。薄いシルクに描かれた7メートルの絵画は、まるで劇の舞台のように演出されます。フィルムのように分割された彼女の風景は時間性を加え、観覧客の記憶の中の風景を刺激します。観覧客は、揺れるベールの間を行き来しながら、カイリー・マニングの作品世界により深く触れることができます。 また、彼女は潮の満ち干きが大きい「黄海」に注目し、「溢れる残骸と騒音、そして痕跡が引き潮のように流れた後、何が濾過され、濃縮されるのか？」という絵画的な考察を展示タイトルに象徴的に表現しています。 今回の展示は、「カイリー・マニング」が伝える海の風景とその物語を通じて、壮大な絵画の世界を観察する興味深い機会となるでしょう。
desc_l10n.ko: 스페이스K 서울은 8월 9일부터 11월 10일까지 미국 브루클린 기반으로 국제적 활동을 이어가는 ‘카일리 매닝(Kylie Manning b.1983)’의 개인전《황해》를 개최합니다. 알래스카와 멕시코에서 바다와 함께했던 작가의 지난 경험이 두드러진 회화는 바다의 풍경과 인물이 혼재되어 구상과 추상을 넘나듭니다. 작가는 네덜란드 바로크 회화 기법을 차용해, 엷게 채색한 층을 여러 겹 쌓고 각층의 유분으로 빛을 굴절시켜 작품 스스로 발광하는 효과를 노립니다. 때문에 작가의 화면은 윤택한 질감과 섬세한 색채의 균형이 돋보입니다. 이번 전시에서 작가는 특별히 스페이스K의 공간을 고려해 대형 회화 3점을 전시장 가운데 매다는 신작을 야심 차게 선보입니다. 얇은 실크에 그려진 7미터 크기의 회화들은 마치 극의 무대처럼 연출됩니다. 필름처럼 나뉜 작가의 풍광은 시간성을 더해 관객의 기억 속 풍경을 자극하고, 관객은 흩날리는 베일 사이를 오가며 ‘카일리 매닝’의 작품세계에 보다 깊숙이 다가섭니다. 한편, 작가는 조수간만의 차가 큰 ‘황해’에 주목하고, ‘넘치는 잔해와 소음 그리고 흔적이 썰물처럼 빠져나간 후에 무엇이 걸러지고 농축되는가?’에 대한 회화적 사유를 전시 제목으로 은유합니다. 이번 전시는 ‘카일리 매닝’이 전하는 바다 풍광 서사로 장엄한 회화의 면면을 관찰하는 흥미로운 기회가 될 것입니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Space K首尔将于8月9日至11月10日举办美国布鲁克林为基地开展国际活动的艺术家凯莉·曼宁（Kylie Manning 1983年生）的个人展《黄海》。艺术家在阿拉斯加和墨西哥与海洋相伴的经历突显在她的绘画中，这些作品融合了海洋的风景与人物，在具象与抽象之间游走。艺术家借用了荷兰巴洛克绘画的技法，通过多层薄涂的色彩和每层油分的折射效果，试图让作品自身发光。因此，她的画面中光泽的质感与细腻的色彩平衡尤为显著。在此次展览中，艺术家特别考虑了Space K的空间，雄心勃勃地展示了三幅悬挂在展厅中央的大型新作。这些绘制在薄丝绸上的7米大画仿佛戏剧的舞台般呈现。分成不同画面的艺术风景如同电影片段般增加了时间性，激发观众记忆中的风景，观众可以在飘动的面纱之间穿行，更深入地接触凯莉·曼宁的作品世界。另一方面，艺术家关注潮汐变化剧烈的“黄海”，并通过展览标题隐喻了“当潮水般涌来的残骸、噪音和痕迹褪去后，什么被过滤和浓缩了？”这一绘画性的思考。本次展览将是一个有趣的机会，让观众观察到凯莉·曼宁通过她的海洋风景叙事所传达的壮丽画作的各个方面。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} On view from August 9 to November 10, Space K Seoul is pleased to present "Yellow Sea", a solo exhibition of works by Kylie Manning. Informed by coastal experiences from her upbringing in Alaska and Mexico, the works combine seascapes and ambiguous figures, moving between moments of clarity and abstraction. In a technique employed by Dutch Baroque painters, the artist builds up layers of thin paint, refracting light through the oils in each layer to create a self-luminous effect. The result is a lush harmony of radiant textures and delicate colors. This exhibition features the artist’s most ambitious project to date, submerging viewers in the rippling compositions of a new installation created specifically for Space K. Three large paintings on silk scrim will cascade through the exhibition space like film strips of the surrounding compositions. Measuring nearly 7 meters wide, three silk scrims by Manning are suspended in the center of the exhibition space, creating a stage-like effect. Each scrim is divided into five individual strips, acting as live gridded capsules. This allows the audience to traverse the oscillating vistas of Manning’s work alongside her represented figures. Manning draws inspiration from the tides of the ‘Yellow Sea’ that joins China and the Korean peninsula, meditating on ‘what is distilled after a tide removes excess debris, noise, and marks’. This exhibition will be an exciting opportunity to immerse visitors in the majestic seascapes alchemized by ‘Kylie Manning'.
name: Kylie Manning: Yellow Sea

name_l10n.ja: カイリー・マニング:黄海

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Gallery Planet will host a two-p e rson exhibition 《Crosswalk》 featuring artists Kim Jung-in and Cho Hyun-seo from August 8 to September 13, 2024. 《Crosswalk》 begins by examining the perspectives of two artists who set out from different directions, meet, and diverge at an intersection. Through Kim Jung-in's images, which actively reveal subjective judgments uniquely human through a mixture of internalized and externalized memories, and Cho Hyun-seo's works, which seek to define aesthetic taste through the judgments of trained artificial intelligence, we ultimately find ourselves contemplating the paintings of our current era. As the exhibition title 'Crosswalk' suggests (a place where paths cross or meet), following the viewpoints of the two artists standing at the intersection leads us to a time of selected memories that have become filters. We experience numerous moments of (un)conscious choices as internal and external memories mix, pass through external memory, and reappear before our eyes. Based on their unique qualities, reflecting innate senses and learned tastes, the artists technically preserve images in their own memory vessels. The divergent perspectives of the two artists, which this exhibition highlights, are revealed at this point.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Gallery Planetは、2024年8月8日から9月13日まで、作家キム・ジョンインとチョ・ヒョンソの2人展『クロスウォーク Crosswalk』を開催します。『クロスウォーク Crosswalk』は、異なる方向から出発した二人の作家が交差点で出会い、また別の方向へと散っていく視点についての問いかけから始まります。内なる記憶と外側だけを着飾った記憶の混ざり合いを通して、人間だけが持つ主観的な判断を積極的に表現するキム・ジョンインと、学習したAIの判断をもとに自分の美的嗜好を定義しようとするチョ・ヒョンソの作品を通じて、現代絵画について考えさせられます。互いに交差したり、出会った場所という意味を持つ「クロスウォーク」という展示名が示すように、交差点で交わる二人の作家の視点を追いかけると、やがてフィルターを通して選択された記憶の時間へと移動することになります。内外の記憶が混じり合い、外部のメモリーを経由して再び私たちの目の前に現れるまで、私たちは無数の(無)意識的な選択の瞬間を経験します。生まれつきの感覚と学習した嗜好が反映された作家たちは、自分自身の記憶の器に技術的にイメージを刻み込みます。今回の展示で注目される二人の作家の交差する視線は、まさにこの地点で明らかになります。
desc_l10n.ko: 갤러리 플래닛은 오는 2024년 8월 8일부터 9월 13일까지 김정인, 조현서 작가의 2인전 《크로스워크 Crosswalk》를 개최한다. 《크로스워크 Crosswalk》는 서로 다른 방향에서 출발해 교차점에서 만나고 흩어지는 두 작가의 시선에 대해 질문을 던지며 시작한다. 내재된 기억과 외화(外華)된 기억의 혼합을 통해 인간만이 할 수 있는 주관적인 판단을 적극적으로 드러내는 김정인과 학습된 인공지능의 판단으로 자신의 미적 취향을 정의하고자 하는 조현서의 이미지 속에서, 우리는 결국 지금 시대의 회화에 대해 고민하게 된다. 서로 엇갈리거나 마주친 곳이라는 뜻을 가진 크로스워크 전시명처럼, 교차로에 선 두 작가의 시선을 쫓아가면 이윽고 필터가 되어준 선택된 기억의 시간으로 이동하게 된다. 내외부의 기억이 섞여 외부의 메모리를 경유해 다시 우리 눈앞에 나타나기까지 우리는 수많은 (무)의식적 선택의 순간을 겪는다. 타고난 감각과 학습된 취향들이 반영된 고유성을 바탕으로 작가들은 자신만의 기억 그릇에 이미지를 기술적으로 남겨두는 것이다. 이번 전시에서 주목하는 두 작가의 엇갈린 시선은 바로 이 지점에서 드러난다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Gallery Planet将于2024年8月8日至9月13日举办GIM JEONGIN、JO HYEONSEO两位艺术家的双人展《Crosswalk》。《Crosswalk》展览以两位艺术家从不同方向出发，在交汇点相遇并分离的视角为切入点，提出问题。GIM JEONGIN通过内在记忆与外在记忆的融合，积极展现了人类独有的主观判断，JO HYEONSEO则通过人工智能的判断来定义自己的美学品味。在他们的作品中，我们不禁反思当代绘画的本质。正如展览名称“Crosswalk”所暗示的那样，当我们追随这两位艺术家交错或相遇的视角时，最终会进入一个被选择性记忆过滤的时间。内外部记忆混合，通过外部记忆再现到我们眼前之前，我们经历了无数个（无）意识的选择瞬间。艺术家们基于与生俱来的感官和学习得来的品味，在他们独特的记忆容器中通过技术手段保留这些图像。在此次展览中，两位艺术家交错的视角正是在这一点上得以展现。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Gallery Planet will host a two-p e rson exhibition 《Crosswalk》 featuring artists Kim Jung-in and Cho Hyun-seo from August 8 to September 13, 2024. 《Crosswalk》 begins by examining the perspectives of two artists who set out from different directions, meet, and diverge at an intersection. Through Kim Jung-in's images, which actively reveal subjective judgments uniquely human through a mixture of internalized and externalized memories, and Cho Hyun-seo's works, which seek to define aesthetic taste through the judgments of trained artificial intelligence, we ultimately find ourselves contemplating the paintings of our current era. As the exhibition title 'Crosswalk' suggests (a place where paths cross or meet), following the viewpoints of the two artists standing at the intersection leads us to a time of selected memories that have become filters. We experience numerous moments of (un)conscious choices as internal and external memories mix, pass through external memory, and reappear before our eyes. Based on their unique qualities, reflecting innate senses and learned tastes, the artists technically preserve images in their own memory vessels. The divergent perspectives of the two artists, which this exhibition highlights, are revealed at this point.
name: crosswalk

The exhibition consists of three sections developed through collaboration with artists and curators, exploring phenomena that arise when unstable and subjective worlds at personal, social, and urban levels come into contact. Expanding from the most intimate and imaginative realms to geopolitical and foundational dimensions, the exhibition asks how relationships can remain close without collapsing into sameness.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} アブダビ音楽芸術財団(Abu Dhabi Music & Arts Foundation)共同企画。《近接した世界》」は建国から半世紀の間、移住と豊かな天然資源、急激な都市の変革が交差して形成された湾岸国家のアラブ首長国連邦に関連した、3世代、40人余りの作家を紹介します。芸術家でありキュレーターとして活動する人々との協業を通じて構成された3つのセクションは、個人的・社会的・都市的な次元の不安定で主観的な世界が互いに接触する際に生じる現象を探求します。最も私的で想像的な領域から地政学的・根源的な次元まで拡張し、作家とキュレーターは密接さの中で同一性へと崩壊しない関係はどのように可能なのかという問いを投げかけます。
desc_l10n.ko: 아부다비 음악예술재단(Abu Dhabi Music & Arts Foundation) 공동 기획. 《근접한 세계》는 건국 이래 지난 반세기동안 이주와 풍부한 천연자원, 급격한 도시 변혁이 교차하며 형성된 걸프국가 아랍에미리트와 연관된 세 세대를 가로지르는 40여 명이 넘는 작가들을 소개합니다. 예술가이자 큐레이터로 활동하는 이들과의 협업을 통해 구성된 세 개의 섹션은 개인적·사회적·도시적 차원의 불안정하고 주관적인 세계가 서로 접촉할 때 발생하는 현상을 탐구합니다. 가장 사적이고 상상적인 영역에서부터 지정학적·근원적 차원까지 확장하며, 작가와 큐레이터는 밀접함 속에서 동일함으로 붕괴되지 않는 관계는 어떻게 가능한가라는 질문을 던집니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 与阿布扎比音乐艺术基金会（Abu Dhabi Music & Arts Foundation）共同策划。展览《咫尺世界（PROXIMITIES）》介绍了与海湾国家阿拉伯联合酋长国相关的、跨越三个世代的40余名艺术家。在自建国以来的半个世纪里，移民浪潮、丰富的自然资源与急剧的城市变革相互交织，塑造了阿联酋国家的独特面貌。通过与身兼艺术家与策展人身份的多位合作者共同构建的三个展区，展览探索了个人、社会和城市维度中那些不稳定且主观的世界相互接触时所产生的现象。从最私密和富于想象的领域，延伸到地缘政治与根源性层面，艺术家与策展人提出了一个疑问，那就是在如此紧密的联系中，如何才能构建一种不因“同一”而瓦解的关系？

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Souimun Gate was a gate of the Hanyangdoseong (the Seoul City Wall), located between Sungnyemun Gate and Donuimun Gate, serving as the southwestern passage of Hanyang during the Joseon Dynasty. The area around Souimun Gate was a bustling hub of land and water transportation, filled with goods and people from all over the country. Outside the gate, executions of serious criminals and Catholic believers who were thought to threaten Confucian ideology were carried out, making it widely known that severe punishments awaited those who committed crimes. During the Japanese occupation, Souimun Gate was demolished in 1914 for road improvements, as it was perceived as an obstacle to urban modernization. This exhibition provides an opportunity to explore the bustling scenes and the history of demolition of Souimun Gate, which guarded the southwestern part of the Seoul City Wall.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ソイムン(昭義門)は、朝鮮王朝時代にスンニェムン(崇礼門)とトニムン(敦義門)の間に位置し、ハニャン(漢陽)の南西部への通路として機能していたハニャン(漢陽)都城の城門です。ソイムン(昭義門)周辺は朝鮮王朝時代、陸路と水路の交通の要所として、全国から集まる物資や人々で賑わう場所でした。また、ソイムン(昭義門)の外では重罪人や性理学の理念を脅かすカトリック信者への処刑が行われることもありました。これは、ソイムン(昭義門)を通る多くの人々に、罪を犯せば厳しく処罰されるという事実を広く知らせるためでした。ソイムン(昭義門)は日本統治時代、都市の近代化を妨げる障害物と見なされ、1914年に道路整備を理由に撤去されました。今回の展示では、ハニャン(漢陽)都城の南西部を守っていたソイムン(昭義門)の賑わいのあった時代から撤去に至る歴史までを振り返る貴重な機会となるでしょう。
desc_l10n.ko: 소의문(昭義門)은 조선시대 숭례문과 돈의문 사이에 위치하여 한양의 서남쪽 통행로 역할을 했던 한양도성의 성문입니다. 소의문 일대는 조선시대 육로와 수로 교통의 요충지로 전국에서 올라온 물자와 사람들로 북적이는 공간이었습니다. 또한 소의문 밖에서는 중죄인들과 성리학적 이념을 위협하는 천주교인의 사형이 집행되기도 하였습니다. 소의문을 드나드는 많은 사람에게 죄를 범하면 엄하게 처벌된다는 사실을 널리 알릴 수 있기 때문이었습니다. 소의문은 일제강점기에 도시의 근대화를 가로막는 장애물로 인식되면서 1914년 도로 정비를 이유로 철거되었습니다. 이번 전시는 한양도성 서남쪽을 지켰던 소의문의 번화했던 모습에서 훼철의 역사까지 살펴볼 수 있는 기회가 될 것입니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 昭义门是汉阳都城的一座城门，位于朝鲜时代的崇礼门与敦义门之间，主要承担着汉阳西南侧通行道路的功能。这一区域在朝鲜时代是陆路与水路交通的重要枢纽，汇聚了来自全国各地的物资与人群。此外，昭义门外还是执行重罪犯及秉持威胁性理学观念的天主教徒死刑的场所，以此广泛警示出入城门的人们，犯罪将受到严厉制裁。然而，在日本帝国主义强占时期，昭义门被视为阻碍城市近代化的障碍物，并于1914年以道路整修为由被拆除。本次展览将提供一个机会，让人们从守护汉阳都城西南侧昭义门的繁华景象，回顾到其被摧毁的历史。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Souimun Gate was a gate of the Hanyangdoseong (the Seoul City Wall), located between Sungnyemun Gate and Donuimun Gate, serving as the southwestern passage of Hanyang during the Joseon Dynasty. The area around Souimun Gate was a bustling hub of land and water transportation, filled with goods and people from all over the country. Outside the gate, executions of serious criminals and Catholic believers who were thought to threaten Confucian ideology were carried out, making it widely known that severe punishments awaited those who committed crimes. During the Japanese occupation, Souimun Gate was demolished in 1914 for road improvements, as it was perceived as an obstacle to urban modernization. This exhibition provides an opportunity to explore the bustling scenes and the history of demolition of Souimun Gate, which guarded the southwestern part of the Seoul City Wall.
name: Souimun, the Lost Gate of Seoul City Wall

The Old Seoul Station is not merely a building but was the gateway of the city that accompanied Seoul’s history, from modernization and industrialization to division, liberation, and democratization. This exhibition vividly brings back the memories of the Old Seoul Station through a wide range of artifacts, photographs and videos, and contemporary art works. It is a meaningful exhibition where visitors can see, feel, and experience one hundred years of Seoul at a glance.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ソウルの中心で100年の歴史を有する旧ソウル駅舎(文化駅ソウル284)で、ソウルの過去と現在に出会う特別な展示が開かれます。旧ソウル駅舎は単なる建物ではなく、近代化と産業化、分断と解放、民主化まで、ソウルの歴史を共に歩んできた都市の関門でした。今回の展示は、旧ソウル駅舎の記憶をさまざまな所蔵品、写真、映像、そして現代美術作品を通じて鮮明に蘇らせます。ソウルの100年を一目で見て、感じて、体験できる意味深い展示です。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울의 중심에서 100년의 시간을 품은 옛서울역사(문화역서울284)에서, 서울의 과거와 현재를 만나는 특별한 전시가 열립니다. 옛서울역사는 단순한 건물이 아니라, 근대화와 산업화, 분단과 해방, 민주화까지 서울의 역사를 함께해온 도시의 관문이었습니다. 이번 전시는 옛서울역사의 기억을 다양한 소장품, 사진과 영상, 현대미술 작품을 통해 생생하게 되살립니다. 서울의 100년을 한눈에 보고, 느끼고, 체험할 수 있는 뜻깊은 전시입니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Superior Gallery will present in November 2025 the solo exhibition 《Where Warmth Shines》 by artist Choi Hyun Hee, who depicts memories of daily life, light, and the warmth of life through landscapes and objects. This exhibition focuses on light and objects that the artist has painted for a long time and conveys the memory of time and experience that connects treasured memories with the present. Based on oil painting, Choi Hyun Hee observes objects in daily life and reconstructs them on canvas. The warm memories recalled by the artist resonate with memories within us and lead to another kind of warmth. It is hoped that this exhibition will become a moment in which visitors once again encounter the gentle memories that have remained in their hearts and in which each person’s light connects with another. The exhibition 《Where Warmth Shines》 will continue until December 11, 2025.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} スーペリアギャラリーは2025年11月、日常の記憶と光、そして生命の温もりを風景と事物で表現するチェ・ヒョンヒ作家の個展《温かさが輝くそこには》を開催します。今回の展示は、作家が長い間描いてきた光とオブジェを中心に、心に蓄えられた記憶と現在をつなぐ時間と経験の記憶を映し出します。チェ・ヒョンヒ作家は油絵をもとに日常の事物を観察し、画面に再構成します。 作家の中に浮かび上がる温かい記憶は、私たちの記憶と交わり、また別の温もりにつながっていきます。今回の展示がそのように各自の心の中に留まっていた温かい記憶に再び向き合い、互いの光が重なり合う瞬間になることを願います。《温かさが輝くそこには》展は2025年12月11日まで行われます。
desc_l10n.ko: 슈페리어갤러리는 2025년 11월, 일상의 기억과 빛, 그리고 생명의 온기를 풍경과 사물로 담아내는 최현희 작가의 개인전 《따스함이 빛나는 그곳엔》을 개최합니다. 이번 전시는 오랜 시간 작가가 그려온 빛과 오브제를 중심으로, 간직된 기억과 현재를 이어주는 시간과 경험의 기억을 보여줍니다. 최현희 작가는 유화를 기반으로 일상의 사물을 관찰해 화면에 재구성합니다. 작가가 떠올린 따뜻한 기억들은 우리 안의 기억과 맞닿으며 또 다른 온기로 이어집니다. 이번 전시가 그렇게 각자의 마음속에 머물러 있던 따스한 기억을 다시 마주하며, 서로의 빛이 이어지는 순간이 되길 바랍니다. 《따스함이 빛나는 그곳엔》展은 2025년 12월 11일까지 진행됩니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 崔贤熙艺术家的个人展《充满暖意之地》将于2025年11月在Superior画廊举办。本次展览以艺术家长期描绘的光和物件为中心，展现连接珍藏记忆与当下，关于体验和经验的回忆。崔贤熙以油画为媒介，将观察到的日常生活中的物体重构于画面中。艺术家心中涌现的温暖记忆，与我们内心的记忆痕迹相连，并延续出新的暖意。愿此次展览能让观者重新邂逅留存于各自心底的温暖记忆，并让彼此的光芒得以延续。展览将持续至2025年12月11日。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Connected to Dongdaemun History & Culture Park, DDP, and the surrounding Dongdaemun markets, B the B is a beauty complex and cultural space where Seoul’s beauty companies and residents can closely interact. It also serves as a creative lounge where visitors can relax in an urban natural setting. You can enjoy various free content, including brand pop-ups from leading Seoul beauty companies, curated product exhibitions aligned with the latest trends, and experiences with products that combine innovative technology. Additionally, seasonal events are frequently held in the healing space reminiscent of a forest retreat, offering beauty-related content and information.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} B the B は、トンデムン(東大門)歴史文化公園とDDP、そして周辺のトンデムン(東大門)市場とつながるビューティー複合文化空間です。ここでは、ソウルのビューティー企業と市民が近い距離でコミュニケーションをとれるスペースであり、都会の中で自然を感じながら休息を楽しめるクリエイティブラウンジです。ソウルのビューティーを代表する企業のブランドポップアップやトレンドに合わせた製品キュレーション展示、革新技術を融合させた製品体験など、さまざまなコンテンツを無料で楽しむことができます。また、森の中の休養林を思わせるヒーリングスペースでは、ビューティー関連のコンテンツや情報が得られるシーズンごとのイベントも随時開催されています。
desc_l10n.ko: 동대문역사문화공원과 DDP, 주변 동대문 시장과 연결되어 있는 뷰티복합문화공간 B the B는 서울의 뷰티 기업과 시민들이 가깝게 소통할 수 있는 공간이자, 도심 속 자연에서 휴식을 즐길 수 있는 크리에이티브 라운지입니다. 서울 뷰티 대표 기업들의 브랜드 팝업 및 트렌드 컨셉에 맞는 제품 큐레이션 기획 전시, 혁신기술 결합형 제품 체험 등 다양한 콘텐츠를 무료로 감상할 수 있습니다. 또한 숲 속 휴양림을 연상하는 힐링 공간에서 뷰티 관련 콘텐츠와 정보를 접할 수 있는 시즌별 이벤트가 수시로 전개됩니다.

It also serves as a creative lounge where visitors can relax in an urban natural setting. Additionally, seasonal events are frequently held in the healing space reminiscent of a forest retreat, offering beauty-related content and information.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The exhibition features over 80 photographs of Cheonggyecheon shantytowns and their residents, captured by photographers Kuwabara Shisei, Nomura Motoyuki, and Hong Soon-tae, and held in the collections of the Seoul Museum of History and Cheonggyecheon Museum. Divided into three sections, the exhibition provides a photographic glimpse into the diverse scenes of Cheonggyecheon’s shantytowns from the 1960s to the 1970s. Part 1, “Scenes of the Shantytown,” showcases images of the shantytown around Cheonggyecheon and the huts in the lower area during the 1970s. Part 2, “People of the Shantytown,” portrays the residents' daily lives. Part 3, “Demolition and Overpass,” highlights the displacement of shantytown communities due to Cheonggyecheon’s redevelopment and the construction of the new overpass. You are invited to take a meaningful journey to reflect on the lives of Cheonggyecheon’s former residents, now transformed by urban development.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 今回の展示では、ソウル歴史博物館とチョンゲチョン(清渓川)博物館が所蔵している、桑原史成、野村基之、ホン・スンテ(洪淳泰)によるチョンゲチョン(清渓川)の掘っ立て小屋とその村に住む人々の姿を捉えた約80点の写真を展示します。 展示は3部構成となっており、1960年代から70年代のチョンゲチョン(清渓川)の板子村やその周辺の様子を写真でご覧いただけます。 第1部『板子村の風景』では、チョンゲチョン(清渓川)周辺の板子村の姿や、1970年代のチョンゲチョン(清渓川)下流地域の掘っ立て小屋がそのまま紹介されています。 第2部『板子村の人々』では、板子村に住む人々の日常生活が描かれています。 第3部『板子村の撤去と高架道路』では、チョンゲチョン(清渓川)の覆蓋工事によりソウルの郊外へと追いやられた板子村と、そこに新たに建設された高架道路の様子が展示されています。 今では見ることができない、かつてチョンゲチョン(清渓川)の板子村に住んでいた人々の日常を振り返る、貴重な時間となることを願っております。
desc_l10n.ko: 이번 전시는 서울역사박물관과 청계천박물관에서 소장 중인 구와바라 시세이, 노무라 모토유키, 홍순태의 사진 중 청계천 판잣집과 판자촌 사람들의 모습이 담긴 사진 80여 점을 전시합니다. 전시는 총 3부로 구성되어 1960~1970년대 청계천 판자촌과 주변의 다양한 모습을 사진으로 볼 수 있습니다. 1부 '판자촌 풍경'은 청계천 주변 판자촌의 모습과 1970년대 청계천 하류지역의 움막집 모습을 그대로 보여주며, 2부 '판자촌 사람들'은 이 판자촌에 거주하는 사람들의 일상적인 모습을 보여줍니다. 3부 '판자촌 철거와 고가도로'에서는 청계천 복개 공사로 인해 서울의 외곽으로 밀려나는 판자촌과 그곳에 새롭게 건설된 고가도로의 모습을 볼 수 있습니다. 이제는 고가도로로 변해 볼 수 없어진 옛 청계천 판자촌 주민들의 지난 일상을 되새기는 뜻깊은 시간을 함께해 주시길 바라며, 많은 관심과 관람 부탁드립니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 此次展览将展出首尔历史博物馆与清溪川博物馆收藏的80多张照片，这些照片由桑原史成、野村基之、红纯太拍摄，内容涵盖清溪川板房以及板子村人民的生活面貌。 展览共分为三个部分，通过展出的照片，可以窥见1960至70年代清溪川棚户区及其周边的多种风貌。 第一部分“板子村风景”原汁原味地呈现了清溪川周边棚户区的景象，以及1970年代清溪川下游地区窝棚的风貌。第二部分“板子村的人们”则细致描绘了居住在这片棚户区内人们的日常生活状态。至于第三部分“板子村与高架桥的变迁”，它记录了因清溪川覆盖工程而被迫迁移至首尔外围的板子村，以及随后在那里新建起的高架桥景象。 希望大家能够一同回味清溪川板子村居民们过去的生活，那段日子如今已成为了高架桥下的回忆。

You can experience dazzling robot movements and fascinating AI technologies, and go beyond simple observation to explore how these technologies are transforming our lives and society. The museum is divided into several levels. The public area welcomes visitors with robots and AI. The multipurpose space introduces and offers hands-on experience with robotics and AI technologies from various companies. The permanent exhibition hall encourages reflection and questions about the relationship between robots, AI, and humans. The special exhibition floor hosts rotating themed and planned exhibitions.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ソウルロボット人工知能科学館(RAIM)では、人類の知性と想像力で開発して発展させたロボットと人工知能を直接楽しんで学ぶことができます。華麗に動くロボットと興味深い人工知能技術を体験し、学ぶことを超え、このような技術が私たちの生活と社会をどのように変化させているのかについても学びます。ロボット・人工知能が観覧客を歓迎する共用空間、企業のロボット・人工知能技術を紹介して体験する多目的空間、ロボット、人工知能、人間との関係を思惟して質問する常設展示室、企画展および特別展が行われる企画展示室はフロア別に空間が分かれています。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울로봇인공지능과학관(RAIM)에서는 인류의 지성과 상상력으로 개발하고 발전시킨 로봇과 인공지능을 직접 즐기고 배울 수 있습니다. 현란하게 움직이는 로봇과 흥미로운 인공지능 기술을 경험하고, 배우는 것을 넘어 이러한 기술이 우리의 삶과 사회를 어떻게 변화시키고 있는지에 대해서도 살펴봅니다. 로봇·인공지능이 관람객을 환영하는 공용공간, 기업의 로봇·인공지능 기술을 소개하고 체험하는 다목적 공간, 로봇, 인공지능, 인간과의 관계를 사유하고 질문하는 상설전시실, 기획전 및 특별전이 진행되는 기획전시실 층별로 공간이 나눠져 있습니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 《Electric Shock》 is a report on electricity. Electricity, defined as the totality of energy generated through electrons, is a key resource that operates modern society. From household appliances to digital consumption, advanced production lines, and logistics systems, it is difficult to imagine life without electricity. The recent commercialization of artificial intelligence and the expansion of big tech companies have exponentially increased power consumption. Securing and supplying electricity in a stable manner has become a critical issue in rapidly adopting advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, beginning to determine the competitiveness of nations and corporations. The era of electrical hegemony has arrived, and alongside endless desires for technological advancement, various efforts to develop power within finite resources are underway. Electricity is no longer merely an energy source that enriches daily life but has become an essential weapon that determines survival. This urgency has led to indiscriminate development, turning even efforts for carbon neutrality into romantic promises seen as delaying technological progress. Reflective movements that once called for sustainable coexistence such as posthumanism and the Anthropocene are fading into history already written over the immediate electric war unfolding before us. Electric Shock reveals and traces the sharp relationship between technology and the environment occurring today through a single circuit called electricity.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 《エレクトリックショック》は、「電気」に関する報告書です。電気は、「電子を通じて発生するエネルギーの総体」であり、現代社会を作動させる重要な資源です。実生活で使う家電製品からデジタル消費、高度化された生産ラインと物流システムまで、電気のない暮らしを想像するのは容易ではありません。最近台頭している人工知能(AI)の商用化とビッグテック企業の拡張は、電力消費を指数関数的に加重させています。人工知能のような先端技術を素早く受け入れるためには、電気をいかに安定的に確保し、供給するかが最も重要な問題として浮上しており、これは国や企業の競争力を左右し始めています。いわゆる「電気覇権時代」が到来し、技術発展に向けた果てしない欲望とともに、有限な資源の中で電力開発のための多様な模索が行われています。電気は、もはや日常を潤すエネルギー源ではなく、生存を左右する必須武器になりました。このような渇望は無分別な開発を招いており、カーボンニュートラルのために行ってきた努力さえも、技術発展を遅延させるロマンチックな約束へと変貌させています。ポストヒューマニズム、人新世、人間と非人間など「持続可能な」共存を要請してきた自省的な動きは、目の前に広がる「電気戦争」の上で、すでに過去の歴史として消えつつあります。《エレクトリックショック》は、今日実際に起こっている技術と環境の鋭い対立関係を電気という一つの回路として表し、これを追跡します。
desc_l10n.ko: 《일렉트릭 쇼크》는 ‘전기’에 관한 보고서입니다. 전기는 ‘전자를 통해 발생하는 에너지의 총체’로, 현대 사회를 작동시키는 중요한 자원입니다. 실생활에서 사용하는 가전제품부터 디지털 소비, 고도화된 생산 라인과 물류 시스템까지, 전기 없는 삶을 상상하기란 쉽지 않습니다. 최근 대두되고 있는 인공지능(AI)의 상용화와 빅테크 기업의 확장은 전력 소비를 기하급수적으로 가중시키고 있습니다. 인공지능과 같은 첨단 기술을 빠르게 수용하기 위해서는 전기를 얼마나 안정적으로 확보하고 수급하느냐가 가장 중요한 문제로 떠올랐으며, 이는 국가와 기업의 경쟁력을 결정하기 시작했습니다. 이른바 ‘전기 패권 시대’가 열렸으며, 기술 발전을 향한 끝없는 욕망과 함께 유한한 자원 속에서 전력 개발을 위한 다양한 모색이 이루어지고 있습니다. 전기는 더 이상 일상을 윤택하게 하는 에너지원이 아니라, 생존을 좌우하는 필수 무기가 되었습니다. 이러한 갈급함은 무분별한 개발을 초래하고 있으며, 탄소 중립을 위해 수행했던 노력들마저 기술 발전을 지연시키는 낭만적인 약속으로 둔갑시키고 있습니다. 포스트 휴머니즘, 인류세, 인간과 비인간 등 ‘지속 가능한’ 공존을 요청하던 자성적 움직임들은 당장 눈앞에 펼쳐진 “전기 전쟁” 위에 이미 쓰여버린 역사로 사라져 가고 있습니다. 《일렉트릭 쇼크》는 오늘날 실제 벌어지고 있는 기술과 환경의 첨예한 관계를 전기라는 하나의 회로로 드러내며 이를 추적합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 《电力冲击（Electric Shock）》是一份关于“电力”的报告。电力是“通过电子产生的能量总和”，是驱动现代社会运转的重要资源。从日常生活中使用的家用电器，到数字消费、高度自动化的生产线与物流系统，我们难以想象没有电力的生活。最近崭露头角的人工智能（AI）商业化和大型科技公司的扩张，正以几何级数加剧电力消耗。为了快速接纳人工智能（AI）等尖端技术，如何稳定地保障和供应电力已成为最重要的问题，这将影响到国家和企业的竞争力。所谓的“电力霸权时代”已经开启，伴随着对技术发展的无尽欲望，人类正在有限的资源中为开发电力进行着各种探索。电力已不再是仅仅让日常生活更加富足的能源，而是决定生存与否的必备武器。这种焦灼感正在引发无节制的开发，甚至把为碳中和所做的努力扭曲为一种延缓技术发展的浪漫承诺。那些曾呼吁“可持续”共存的自我反思运动，如后人类主义、人类世、人类与非人类等议题在当前的“电力战争”中正逐渐消逝成为历史。《电力冲击（Electric Shock）》正是以电力这一单一回路为线索，揭示并追踪着当今技术与环境之间真实的尖锐厉害关系。

Established in 2006, it is a beloved recreational sports facility for climbing enthusiasts, operated free of charge. The wall is divided into three sections: the left wall at 15 meters, the central wall at 18 meters, and the right wall at 13 meters, making it important for users to choose a course that matches their skill level. desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} トゥクソムハンガン(漢江)公園に位置する屋外ロッククライミング場で、高さ15m、幅40mの施設です。 2006年に作られ、無料で運営されているため、ロッククライミングを楽しむ人々から人気のレジャースポーツ施設です。 左壁15M、中央壁18M、右壁13Mで構成されており、利用者の実力に合ったコースを進めることが大切です。また、管理事務所の裏側に設置されている更衣室も利用できます。 そして、初心者のための壁が別に設置されており、事前に施設管理者に連絡するとロッククライミング講習も受けることができます。手足が洗える場所も完備されています。
desc_l10n.ko: 뚝섬 한강공원에 위치한 야외 인공암벽장으로 높이 15m에 폭 40m 규모의 시설입니다. 2006년에 조성되었으며 무료로 운영 중이라 클라이밍을 즐기는 사람들에게 많은 사랑을 받고 있는 레포츠 시설입니다. 왼쪽 벽 15M, 중앙 벽 18M, 오른쪽 벽 13M로 구성되어 있어 이용자의 실력에 맞는 코스를 진행하는 것이 중요합니다. 또한 관리사무소 뒤편에 탈의실이 설치되어 있어 이용이 가능합니다. 이뿐만 아니라 왼쪽 벽 옆에 초보자를 위한 벽이 따로 설치되어 있어 사전에 시설 관리자와 협의하에 교육 진행이 가능합니다. 운동이 끝난 후 손과 발을 씻을 수 있는 곳도 준비되어 있습니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} A woman who has carried the pain of separation in her heart for over 70 years shows the last handwritten letter she received from her husband before they became separated due to the Korean War. Through videos of maps drawn by separated families depicting their hometowns and the stories behind them, viewers can virtually visit these childhood places beyond the armistice line, places they can no longer reach. Although no one knows when a reunion might happen, videos containing the life stories and memories of separated families are shown, with the hope they may one day reach their relatives still in North Korea.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 70年以上もの長い間、離散の痛みを胸に抱いて生きてきた女性が、朝鮮戦争で離散家族となる前に夫から受け取った最後の手紙や、離散家族が直接描いた故郷の地図、関連の映像を通じて、行けなくなった休戦ラインの向こうにある、幼少期の思い出が詰まった故郷を訪れることができます。再会の日は約束できませんが、後に北朝鮮にいる離散家族に伝えるため、生前の離散家族の姿とエピソードを記録した映像が上映されます。
desc_l10n.ko: 70년이 넘는 긴 시간 동안 이산의 아픔을 가슴에 품고 살아온 여인이 한국전쟁으로 이산가족이 되기 전, 남편에게 받은 마지막 손편지와 이산가족이 직접 그린 고향지도와 관련 사연 영상을 통해 휴전선 넘어 가볼 수 없는 어린 시절의 추억이 서린 고향을 방문해 볼 수 있습니다. 언제일지 만남을 기약할 수 없지만, 나중에 재북 이산가족에게 전달할 수 있도록 이산가족의 생전 모습과 사연이 담긴 영상을 상영합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 这位女性，在过去的七十多年间，始终承载着离散带来的深切痛苦。在成为韩国战争中的离散家属之前，她凭借着丈夫寄来的最后一封信、离散家属亲手绘制的故乡地图，以及与之相关的故事视频，得以跨越心灵的界限，重温那段因停战线而无法亲身踏足的童年记忆之地。尽管她与故乡亲人重逢的具体时刻难以预定，但她心怀希望，制作并保存了这些记录离散家属生前影像与故事的视频。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Hirako, who studied painting at Wimbledon College of Art in London and continues to work internationally based in Tokyo, seeks the coexistence of man and nature. He created a hybrid character as a medium to connect human with nature. The character, who has a human body and tree head, travels with dogs, cats, and various plants in the exhibition. Sometimes by the river, sometimes in the forest, and other times in a room, these scenes with flora and fauna are transformed into a variety of media, including painting, sculpture, and installation, to give the viewers a more sensory understanding of nature. Through this, Hirako questions anthropocentric attitudes toward nature, suggesting that nature be viewed on an equal footing rather than as an object to be explored and conquered.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} KOLON文化芸術空間「Space K Seoul」では、日本の作家、平子雄一の個展『旅 行 』を開催します。ロンドンウィンブルドン大学で絵画を専攻し、東京を中心に国際的活動を続けている平子雄一は、人間と自然の共存を追求します。作家は、人間と自然をつなぐ媒介体として混種のキャラクターを誕生させます。人の体に木の頭を持つ形をしたこのキャラクターは、今回の展示で子犬、猫、そして多様な植物と共にする旅を繰り広げます。時には川辺で、時には森の中で、時には部屋で動植物と共にする場面は絵画、彫刻、設置など多様な媒体に変奏され観客に自然に対する感覚的理解度を高めさせます。これを通じて、平子雄一は、自然を開拓と征服の対象ではなく、同等の位置から眺めることを提案し、人間中心の自然に対する態度を喚起させます。
desc_l10n.ko: 을 개최합니다. 런던 윔블던 대학에서 회화를 전공하고 도쿄를 중심으로 국제적 활동을 이어가는 작가는 인간과 자연의 공존을 추구합니다. 작가는 인간과 자연을 연결하는 매개체로 혼종의 캐릭터를 탄생시킵니다. 사람의 몸에 나무 머리를 지닌 형상의 이 캐릭터는 이번 전시에서 강아지, 고양이 그리고 다양한 식물들과 함께하는 여정을 펼칩니다. 때로는 강가에서, 때로는 숲속에서, 때로는 방에서 동식물들과 함께하는 장면들은 회화, 조각, 설치 등 다양한 매체로 변주되어 관객들에게 자연에 대한 감각적 이해도를 높이고자 합니다. 이를 통해 유이치 히라코는 자연을 개척과 정복의 대상이 아니라 동등한 위치에서 바라보길 제안하며 인간 중심의 자연에 대한 태도를 환기합니다."}">코오롱 문화예술 나눔공간 ‘스페이스K 서울’은 일본 작가 유이치 히라코 (Yuichi Hirako, b.1982)의 개인전 《여행》 을 개최합니다. 런던 윔블던 대학에서 회화를 전공하고 도쿄를 중심으로 국제적 활동을 이어가는 작가는 인간과 자연의 공존을 추구합니다. 작가는 인간과 자연을 연결하는 매개체로 혼종의 캐릭터를 탄생시킵니다. 사람의 몸에 나무 머리를 지닌 형상의 이 캐릭터는 이번 전시에서 강아지, 고양이 그리고 다양한 식물들과 함께하는 여정을 펼칩니다. 때로는 강가에서, 때로는 숲속에서, 때로는 방에서 동식물들과 함께하는 장면들은 회화, 조각, 설치 등 다양한 매체로 변주되어 관객들에게 자연에 대한 감각적 이해도를 높이고자 합니다. 이를 통해 유이치 히라코는 자연을 개척과 정복의 대상이 아니라 동등한 위치에서 바라보길 제안하며 인간 중심의 자연에 대한 태도를 환기합니다."}">을 개최합니다. 런던 윔블던 대학에서 회화를 전공하고 도쿄를 중심으로 국제적 활동을 이어가는 작가는 인간과 자연의 공존을 추구합니다. 작가는 인간과 자연을 연결하는 매개체로 혼종의 캐릭터를 탄생시킵니다. 사람의 몸에 나무 머리를 지닌 형상의 이 캐릭터는 이번 전시에서 강아지, 고양이 그리고 다양한 식물들과 함께하는 여정을 펼칩니다. 때로는 강가에서, 때로는 숲속에서, 때로는 방에서 동식물들과 함께하는 장면들은 회화, 조각, 설치 등 다양한 매체로 변주되어 관객들에게 자연에 대한 감각적 이해도를 높이고자 합니다. 이를 통해 유이치 히라코는 자연을 개척과 정복의 대상이 아니라 동등한 위치에서 바라보길 제안하며 인간 중심의 자연에 대한 태도를 환기합니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Superior Gallery presents the exhibition <Connecting Time> by artists Yeye, Yoon Yeojin, and Nogang Lee. Yeye records her special and joyful moments spent with her dog 'Moonge' over 15 years, capturing the emotions within her artwork. Yoon Yeojin meticulously captures everyday scenes, objects, and subconscious feelings, expressing them through her art. Nogang Lee tells the stories of modern life through his 'hermit series' reinterpreting symbols of traditional Korean art and his 'bear series', which anthropomorphizes bears. Reconnect with precious memories and look forward to new beginnings by warmly embracing the works of these three artists at Superior Gallery.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} スーペリアギャラリーは、記憶と現在をつなぎ、癒しと慰め、そしてウィットを込めたyeye作家、ユン・ヨジン作家、イ・ノガン作家の《時をつなぐ》展を開催します。yeye作家は、15年間を共にした愛犬「ムンゲ」との特別で幸せな日々を記録し、その中に宿る感情を作品に込めています。ユン・ヨジン作家は、日常の風景や出来事、無意識に浮かんでくる感情を繊細に捉えて表現しています。そしてイ・ノガン作家は、韓国伝統美術の象徴を現代風に再解釈した仙人シリーズや、熊を擬人化したクマシリーズを通じて、現代人の人生について語ります。数多くの思い出の中で大切な記憶を振り返り、近づく始まりのために、このスーペリアギャラリーで温かな気持ちを抱きながら、3名のアーティストの作品をぜひお楽しみください。
desc_l10n.ko: 슈페리어갤러리는 기억과 현재을 이어 힐링과 위안, 그리고 위트를 담아내는 예예, 윤여진, 이노강 작가의 《시간을 잇는》 전을 선보입니다. 예예 작가는 15년을 함께한 반려견 '뭉게' 와의 특별하고 행복했던 일상을 기록하며, 그 안에 깃든 감정을 작품에 담아냅니다. 윤여진 작가는 일상 속 풍경과 사물, 무의식적으로 떠오르는 감정을 섬세하게 포착해 표현합니다. 이노강 작가는 한국 전통 미술의 상징을 현대적으로 재해석한 신선 시리즈와 곰을 의인화한 곰돌이 시리즈를 통해 현대인의 삶의 이야기를 전합니다. 수많은 추억 속에서 소중한 기억을 되새기며, 다가올 시작을 위해, 슈페리어갤러리에서 따뜻한 마음으로 세 작가의 작품을 안아보시길 바랍니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Superior Gallery将展出由艺术家Ye Ye、Yoon Yeo Jin和Lee No Kang共同呈现的《连接时间》展览，展览通过连接记忆与现在，传递治愈、安慰和智慧。Ye Ye艺术家记录了与陪伴了15年的爱犬共同度过的特别而幸福的日常，并将其中蕴藏的情感通过作品展现出来。Yoon Yeo Jin艺术家细腻地捕捉并表达了日常生活中的风景、物品以及无意识中浮现的情感。Lee No Kang艺术家通过现代诠释韩国传统艺术符号的“神仙”系列和将熊拟人化的“熊仔”系列，讲述了现代人的生活故事。在无数回忆中回味珍贵的记忆，为即将到来的新开始，欢迎您带着温暖的心情，在Superior Gallery欣赏三位艺术家的作品。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Superior Gallery presents the exhibition <Connecting Time> by artists Yeye, Yoon Yeojin, and Nogang Lee. Yeye records her special and joyful moments spent with her dog 'Moonge' over 15 years, capturing the emotions within her artwork. Yoon Yeojin meticulously captures everyday scenes, objects, and subconscious feelings, expressing them through her art. Nogang Lee tells the stories of modern life through his 'hermit series' reinterpreting symbols of traditional Korean art and his 'bear series', which anthropomorphizes bears. Reconnect with precious memories and look forward to new beginnings by warmly embracing the works of these three artists at Superior Gallery.
name: The Exhibition <Connecing Time>

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} This exhibition begins with 36 works from the Lee Kun-hee Collection, donated to the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art (MMCA) and regional art museums in 2021, as well as pieces from the Leeum Museum of Art. To deepen the understanding of each artist’s world, it also includes 24 additional works borrowed from public and private institutions including the Seoul Museum of Art, various public and private galleries, and personal collections. Based on the concepts of landscape, color, and materiality, the exhibition is organized under three major themes: 'Forms, Scenes, and Nature', 'Color Comes Alive', and 'When Creation Is Performed Through Matter' The title, A World Beyond the Canvas, is inspired by Korean modernist painter Lee In-sung’s metaphor for painting as a “separate world that reflects the aesthetic consciousness of the artist.” It encapsulates the artists’ pursuit of an ultimate world they sought to reach through their art.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} この展示は、2021年に国立現代美術館と地域美術館に寄贈された李健熙コレクションとリウム美術館の所蔵品36点をその出発点とし、ソウル市立美術館をはじめとする公私立美術館とギャラリー、個人所蔵の作品24点を一緒に構成し、個々の作家の作品世界をより深く理解できるようにしました。 風景、色彩、物性の概念に基づき、「姿、情景、そして自然」、「色は生きて動く」、「物質に随行するとき」という3つの大きなテーマで構成され、展示のタイトルである「絵」という別世界は韓国の近代画壇を象徴するイ・インソンが「画家の美意識を再現した別世界」で絵画を比喩したものから借用したもので、作家たちが絵を通じて到達しようとした究極の世界を探求しようとする意味を含みます。
desc_l10n.ko: 이 전시는 2021년 국립현대미술관과 지역미술관에 기증된 이건희컬렉션과 리움미술관의 소장품 36점을 그 출발점으로 삼고, 서울시립미술관을 비롯한 공사립미술관과 갤러리, 개인 소장의 작품 24점을 함께 구성하여 개별 작가들의 작품세계를 더욱 깊이 이해할 수 있도록 하였습니다. 풍경, 색채, 물성의 개념을 토대로 하여, ‘모습, 정경, 그리고 자연’, ‘색은 살아 움직인다’, ‘물질로 수행을 할 때’라는 세 개의 큰 주제로 구성되며, 전시의 제목인 그림이라는 별세계는 한국의 근대화단을 상징하는 이인성이 “화가의 미의식을 재현시킨 별세계(別世界)”로 회화를 은유한 것에서 차용한 것으로, 작가들이 그림을 통해 도달하고자 했던 궁극의 세계를 탐구하고자 하는 의미를 함축합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 该展览以2021年捐赠给国立现代美术馆和地区美术馆的李健熙收藏品和Leeum美术馆的36件收藏品为出发点，共同组成了包括首尔市立美术馆在内的公私立美术馆和画廊、个人收藏的24件作品，让您更深入地了解每个作家的作品世界。 以风景、色彩、物性的概念为基础，由“样子、情景、自然”、“鲜活的颜色”、“用物质修行时”三大主题组成，展览标题《绘画的另一个世界》是象征韩国近代画坛的李仁成利用再现“画家审美意识的另一个世界”来隐喻绘画，蕴含着作家们通过希望通过绘画探索终极世界的意义。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Seoul Arts Center is delighted to present One Step at a Time: Heehwan Seo, a Master of Hangul Calligraphy, an exhibition highlighting the life and art of Pyeongbo Heehwan Seo. Held in commemoration of the 30th anniversary of Seo’s passing, this large-scale retrospective provides a comprehensive overview of Seo’s extensive oeuvre, spanning works from his early years to his later life. Seo, also known by his art name “Pyeongbo [one step at a time],” was a representative Hangul calligrapher of 20th-century Korea. In 1968, his presentation won the Presidential Award at the 17th National Art Exhibition of Korea, marking the first time a work of calligraphy received this particular honor. Until his death at the age of 61 in 1995, Seo devoted his entire life to exploring Hangul’s calligraphic potential. This incomparable artistic achievement cements his status as an indispensable figure in the history of Korean calligraphy. This exhibition was designed to trace Seo’s journey in achieving the feat of Hangul calligraphy being accepted as an art form. Establishing Hangul calligraphy as an art form — and more importantly, as a calligraphical art — was his lifelong goal, and his perseverance eventually realized this dream. Seo once said, “A turtle in a lake waits a thousand years for its turn to perch atop a lotus leaf,” and his 61-year journey was, indeed, true to his art name, Pyeongbo — one step at a time — in both art and life, advancing step by step without rushing or resting. We hope this exhibition offers visitors an opportunity to deepen their understanding of Seo’s life and art and to keep his memory alive.

desc_l10n.ko: 한글 서예의 대가 서희환 작가의 서거 30년을 맞이하여 최초로 선보이는 대규모 회고전으로, 작가의 초기작부터 말년의 작품까지 총 120여 점과 다양한 아카이브 자료를 소개합니다. 평생 한글 서예만을 작업한 서희환 작가의 작품을 선보이는 만큼, 서예가 어렵게 느껴졌던 이들도 더욱 쉽고 친근하게 전시를 즐길 수 있습니다. 매월 마지막 주 수요일인 문화가 있는 날에는 성인을 대상으로 전시 관람과 함께 한글 서예를 체험할 수 있는 “보통의 하루, 특별한 여백”이 진행될 예정입니다. 일반 관람객을 대상으로 하는 도슨트 해설은 1일 3회 상시 운영됩니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 这是为纪念韩文书法大师徐喜焕作家逝世30年而首次举办的大型回顾展，本次展览介绍了从作家的早期作品到晚年作品等共计120多件和各种存档资料。通过展出一生只创作韩文书法作品的徐喜焕作家的作品，让觉得书法很难的游客也能更加轻松地享受展览。每月最后一周的星期三是文化日，这天将针对成年人举行“平凡的一天，特别的留白”活动，具体内容有参观展览和体验韩文书法等，针对普通游客的讲解员解说活动正常1天运营3次。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} THART is a dedicated media art exhibition hall located in Hongdae. This story-immersive media art theater fuses theater and media art, transforming a former performance venue once filled with the passion of countless artists into an exhibition space. Combining digital technology and art creates mesmerizing lights and sounds, offering visitors a sensational experience. Additionally, the story-immersive exhibitions allow for deep engagement, providing artistic emotion and inspiration through interaction. THART is where one can experience a new form of artistic expression through the convergence of art, technology, and storytelling.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} THARTは、ホンデ(弘大)に位置するメディアアート専用展示館です。ティアーター(Theater)とメディアアート(Media Art)が出会って誕生したストーリー没入型メディアアート劇場として、かつては数多くの芸術家たちが情熱を注いだ公演場が展示館として生まれ変わりました。 デジタル技術と芸術が合わさって作り出す光と音は、観覧客に体験したことのない恍惚とした感覚を与えてくれます。それだけでなく、ストーリーが加わったストーリー没入型展示で観覧客により深く楽しんでもらい、芸術的感動とインスピレーションを伝えています。芸術と技術、ストーリーテリングの融合による新しい芸術的経験を体験できる場所です。
desc_l10n.ko: 띠아트는 홍대에 위치한 미디어아트 전용 전시관입니다. 띠어터(Theater)와 미디어아트(Media Art)가 만나 탄생한 스토리 몰입형 미디어아트 극장으로, 이전에는 수많은 예술인들이 열정을 쏟았던 공연장이 전시관으로 탈바꿈한 곳입니다. 디지털 기술과 예술이 결합해 만들어내는 빛과 소리는 관람객들에게 경험해보지 못한 황홀한 감각을 선사합니다. 뿐만 아니라 스토리가 더해진 스토리몰입형 전시로 관람객들에게 깊이있는 몰입을 가능케하며, 상호작용을 통한 예술적 감동과 영감을 전달하고 있습니다. 예술과 기술, 스토리텔링의 융합을 통한 새로운 예술적 경험을 체험할 수 있는 곳입니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} THART是位于弘大的一家专门展览媒体艺术的展馆。THART 是Theater（剧场）和Media Art（媒体艺术）的结合，诞生了一个故事沉浸型的媒体艺术剧场。这一场地曾是许多艺术家倾注激情的表演场所，现在则转变为展览馆。 数字技术与艺术结合所产生的光与声音，为观众带来前所未有的惊艳感官体验。除此之外，加入故事元素的沉浸型展览使观众能够深入体验，通过互动传递艺术的感动和灵感。这里是一个通过艺术、技术和故事讲述的融合，提供全新艺术体验的地方。

The show dramatically portrays the creation of artwork through each scene, with unexpected twists, witty performances, and stylish urban dance. With vivid lighting, stunning visual effects, and thrilling music, the performance offers a high level of immersion and is designed to be easily enjoyed by audiences of all ages. It is especially popular among families.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 2008年に初演されたペインターズは、華麗な振り付けとライブドローイング、メディアアートが融合した新しい概念のアートパフォーマンスです。ペインターズはセンスの良いアーバンダンス、ウィットあふれるパフォーマンスとともに、毎シーン予想を覆す反転を通じてアート作品が誕生する過程をドラマチックに見せてくれます。また、多彩な照明と華麗な視覚効果、迫力溢れる音楽が調和し、没入度を高め、老若男女誰でも楽しめるように構成されており、家族連れの観客にも人気があります。
desc_l10n.ko: 2008년 초연된 페인터즈는 화려한 안무와 라이브 드로잉 및 미디어 아트가 결합한 새로운 개념의 아트 퍼포먼스입니다. 페인터즈는 감각적인 어반 댄스, 위트 넘치는 퍼포먼스와 더불어 매 씬 예상을 뒤엎는 반전을 통해 아트 작품이 탄생하는 과정을 드라마틱하게 보여줍니다. 또한, 다채로운 조명과 화려한 시각 효과, 박진감 넘치는 음악이 어우러져 몰입도를 높이며 남녀노소 누구나 쉽게 즐길 수 있도록 구성되어 있어 가족 단위 관객들에게도 큰 사랑을 받고 있습니다.

The exhibition enables visitors to view the Han River in various contexts as depicted in folk songs from all regions of the country. It also features rare folk song SP and LP records, lyric books containing lyrics, and musical scores. <[Experience] Han River in Memory> This is an experience zone designed to allow visitors to appreciate the various aspects of the Han River through ASMR videos, landscape paintings, and maps, and share precious memories of the Han River. We hope this special exhibition, <Han River, Flows with Sound>, which illuminates the Han River that has flowed alongside Seoul citizens for a long time, will be a meaningful opportunity to feel the emotions of our people through folk songs deeply.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} <ハンガン(漢江)が登場するウリソリ> ハンガン(漢江)が登場する代表的な民謡には、ハンガン(漢江)を歌った<ハンガンスタリョン(漢江水打令)>、<ノドゥル川辺>、ハンガン(漢江)で働きながら歌っていた<シソン舟歌>や<インジェ(麟蹄)テッモクアリラン>などがあります。 展示では全国各地の民謡を通じて多様な背景で現れるハンガン(漢江)を見ることができ、他にも現在珍しい民謡SP盤·LP盤や歌詞が収録された歌詞集、楽譜も観覧できます。 <[体験]記憶の中のハンガン(漢江)> ASMR映像や山水画、地図などを通じてハンガン(漢江)の様々な姿を鑑賞し、ハンガン(漢江)に対する大切な思い出を共有できるように設けられた体験ゾーンです。 長い間、ソウル市民のそばを流れてきたハンガン(漢江)にスポットをあてた今回の特別展<ハンガン(漢江)、ソリで流れる>を通じて、民謡の中の朝鮮民族の情緒を深く感じる意味深い時間になることを願います。
desc_l10n.ko: <한강이 등장하는 우리소리> 한강이 등장하는 대표적인 민요에는 한강을 노래한 <한강수타령>, <노들강변>, 한강에서 일하며 부르던 <시선뱃노래>와 <인제뗏목아리랑> 등이 있습니다. 전시에서는 전국 각지의 민요에서 다양한 배경으로 나타나는 한강을 살펴볼 수 있으며, 이외에도 현재 보기 드문 민요 SP·LP 음반과 사설이 수록된 가사집, 악보들도 관람하실 수 있습니다. <[체험] 기억 속의 한강> ASMR 영상과 산수화, 지도 등을 통해 한강의 다양한 모습을 감상하고, 한강에 대한 소중한 기억을 공유할 수 있도록 준비된 체험존입니다. 오랜 시간 서울시민과 함께 흘러온 한강을 조명하는 이번 특별전 <한강, 소리로 흐르다>를 통해 민요 속 우리 민족의 정서를 깊이 느껴보는 뜻깊은 시간이 되길 바랍니다.

It is composed of works held by the Seoul Museum of Art and by the artists, centering on works created from the late 1950s, which is generally regarded as the starting point of Korean contemporary art, and which used “photography” or “photographic images” as a medium of creation. Through this, the exhibition sheds light on the process in which photography has functioned as a creative tool that opens new worlds for artists, as well as the role it has performed within the expansion of contemporary art. (Exhibition photo: ⓒ Jeong Youngdon)
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 写真美術館の開館以来、初めて全館を活用して開催される今回の展示は、ソウル市立美術館と作家が所蔵する作品のうち、韓国の現代美術の出発点とされる1950年代後半以降に「写真」あるいは「写真イメージ」を創作の媒介とした作品を中心に構成されます。本展を通じて、写真が芸術家たちに新しい世界を開く創造的な道具として作用してきた過程と、同時代美術の拡張の中で果たしてきた役割にスポットを当てます(全景写真：ⓒ チョン・ヨンドン)。
desc_l10n.ko: 사진미술관 개관 이후 처음으로 전관을 활용해 선보이는 이번 전시는, 서울시립미술관과 작가가 소장한 작품 중 통상 한국 현대미술의 출발점으로 여겨지는 1950년대 후반 이후 ‘사진’ 혹은 ‘사진 이미지’를 창작의 매개로 삼은 작품들을 중심으로 구성됩니다. 이를 통해 사진이 예술가들에게 새로운 세계를 여는 창의적 도구로 작용해온 과정과, 동시대 미술의 확장 속에서 수행해온 역할을 조명합니다. (전경사진: ⓒ 정영돈)
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 这是该摄影美术馆自开馆以来首次启用全部展厅举办的展览，展品主要选自首尔市立美术馆和艺术家的收藏品，其中包括通常被视为韩国现代艺术起点、1950年代后期以来，以“摄影”或“摄影图像”为创作媒介的作品。通过此次展览，旨在回顾摄影作为创意性的工具为艺术家开启新世界的过程，以及在同时代艺术拓展中所发挥的作用。（展厅照片：ⓒ 郑永敦）
