desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} In the summer of 1925, the Han River flood claimed numerous lives and destroyed houses and buildings. The city of Gyeongseong was left isolated with electricity and transportation cut off, and farmlands surrounding the city that sustained its residents were washed away or turned into sand fields. The flood even changed the course of the Han River and erased entire villages. Known as the “Great Flood of the Eulchuk Year,” this disaster had both direct and indirect significant impacts on Seoul. Later, when flood control facilities were installed on the Han River, the flood served as the benchmark, and flood control became a major issue in urban planning. A century later, as continuous flood control efforts have led to floods fading from public memory, the climate crisis has struck. Faced with extreme downpours that have become part of daily life, we are once again reminded of the severity of great floods. On the centennial of the Eulchuk Year Great Flood, this exhibition revisits this historic disaster, serving as an opportunity to collectively consider measures for future climate change preparedness.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 1925年の夏、ハンガン(漢江)に起きた大洪水は莫大な死傷者を出し、家屋や建物を破壊しました。都市のキョンソン(京城)は電気と交通が途絶えて孤立し、都市民の食糧を供給していた近郊の田畑はすべて流されたり、砂原になってしまいました。さらに、ハンガン(漢江)の流路を変え、村を流してしまったりもしました。「乙丑年の大洪水」と呼ばれるこの水害は、ソウルに直接・間接的に大きな影響を及ぼしました。その後、ハンガン(漢江)に防水施設を設置する際には乙丑年の大洪水が基準となり、都市計画の方向性を決める際に治水は重要な論題となりました。 それから一世紀後、持続的な治水事業でソウルでの洪水が次第に忘れ去られていく頃、気候危機が迫ってきました。日常となった激しい豪雨の前で、私たちは再び大洪水の深刻さを思い浮かべずにはいられません。まさに今、乙丑年の大洪水100周年を迎え、この歴史的な災害を振り返る今回の展示を通じて、今後の気候変動に対する対策を皆で考えるきっかけになることを願います。
desc_l10n.ko: 1925년 여름, 한강에 일어난 대홍수는 막대한 사상자를 내고 가옥과 건물을 파괴했습니다. 도시 경성은 전기와 교통이 끊겨 고립에 빠졌고, 도시민들의 먹거리를 책임지던 근교의 논밭은 전부 쓸려가거나 모래밭이 돼 버렸습니다. 심지어 한강의 유로를 바꾸고, 마을을 없애버리기까지 했습니다. ‘을축년 대홍수’라 불리는 이 수해는 서울에 직간접적으로 크나큰 영향을 미쳤습니다. 이후 한강에 방수 시설을 설치할 때는 을축년 대홍수가 기준이 됐고, 도시계획의 방향을 정할 때 치수는 중요한 논제가 됐습니다. 그로부터 한 세기 뒤, 지속적인 치수 사업으로 서울에서의 홍수가 점차 잊혀 갈 때 기후위기가 닥쳐왔습니다. 일상이 된 극한 폭우 앞에서 우리는 또다시 대홍수의 심각성을 떠올리지 않을 수 없습니다. 바로 지금, 을축년 대홍수 100주년을 맞아 이 역사적인 재난을 돌아보는 이번 전시를 통해 앞으로의 기후변화에 대한 대비책을 다 함께 고민하는 계기가 되기를 바랍니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 1925年夏天，汉江流域遭遇特大洪灾，造成大量人员伤亡，房屋建筑损毁殆尽。都城“京城”电力中断、交通瘫痪，沦为孤岛。供应市民粮食的近郊农田悉数被淹，化为沙地。洪水甚至改变了汉江的河道，吞噬了无数村庄。这场被称为“乙丑年大洪水”的灾难，给首尔带来了直接和间接的巨大冲击。自此，乙丑年大洪水成为了汉江防洪设施建设的基准，也让治水成为城市规划的核心议题。 一个世纪后的今天，当持续的治水工程已让洪水记忆逐渐褪色时，气候危机却再度降临。在极端暴雨已成为常态的此刻，我们不得不重新审视那场大洪水的警示。值此乙丑年大洪水一百周年，谨望本次回顾历史灾难的展览，能成为一个契机，促使我们共同思索与谋划应对未来气候变化的未雨绸缪之策。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} In the summer of 1925, the Han River flood claimed numerous lives and destroyed houses and buildings. The city of Gyeongseong was left isolated with electricity and transportation cut off, and farmlands surrounding the city that sustained its residents were washed away or turned into sand fields. The flood even changed the course of the Han River and erased entire villages. Known as the “Great Flood of the Eulchuk Year,” this disaster had both direct and indirect significant impacts on Seoul. Later, when flood control facilities were installed on the Han River, the flood served as the benchmark, and flood control became a major issue in urban planning. A century later, as continuous flood control efforts have led to floods fading from public memory, the climate crisis has struck. Faced with extreme downpours that have become part of daily life, we are once again reminded of the severity of great floods. On the centennial of the Eulchuk Year Great Flood, this exhibition revisits this historic disaster, serving as an opportunity to collectively consider measures for future climate change preparedness.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Celestial Whisper is an exhibition by sculptor Meekyoung Shin, who has built a unique body of work using soap as her main material. The theme of the exhibition, angels, is a religious symbol that connects God and humans. More than that, however, angels serve as symbolic beings that have become a natural part of our perception. Visualizing the image of angels as those that lie somewhere between what exists and what is absent, the artist first became interested in angels when she came across a fragrance called “Angel.” In this exhibition, Shin highlights the meaning of angels, something that everyone knows of yet has never seen. Her angel is a being in the realm of illusion, hovering between heaven and earth, life and death, body and soul, and is presented metaphorically through the material properties of soap. The artist has used soap as a material for her sculptures for more than 30 years. For Shin, soap also has a materiality to it that wavers between transparency and opacity. Still, it is destined to wear down over time, while its scent can only be experienced by those who have come in contact with it in person. These characteristics of soap are connected to the symbolism of angels, who are intermediate beings between heaven and earth. In particular, the transparency of soap, the light that maximizes its transparency, and its many different scents allow visitors to experience the presence of angels that oscillate between existence and absence. Visitors can draw closer to contemporary art by appreciating sculptures made from everyday soap, allowing their imagination to run wild through angels, a familiar yet unseen entity. We hope that this exhibition, which is filled with the light and fragrance of angels that evoke a kind of fantasy across generations, will inspire you to rediscover the very same angels you have always felt are familiar.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 展示「透明で香り漂う天使の羽の色のように」は、石鹸を彫刻の材料として使用し、独自の作品を構築してきた彫刻家シン·ミギョンの展示です。展示のテーマである「天使」は、神と人間をつなぐ宗教的表象であり、芸術的、文学的想像を通じて私たちの認識の中に馴染むようになった象徴的な存在です。作家は、「エンジェル」という名前の香りに偶然出会い、「天使」というテーマに関心を持つようになり、世の中に「存在するものと不在するものの間にある対象」として天使を視覚化した作品を作り始めました。 今回の展示では、皆が知っているが、誰も見た人はいない天使が持つ意味に注目します。 作家が表現する天使は、天上と地上、生と死、肉体と魂の間を行き来する幻想の領域にある存在で、石鹸の物質的属性を通じて隠喩的に表現されます。作家が30年余りの間、彫刻の材料として使用した「石鹸」は、透明さと不透明さを行き来する物性だけでなく、磨り減ってなくなる性質、そして香りを持っています。このような石鹸の特徴は、天上と地上をつなぐ中間的存在である天使の象徴性と似ており、特に石鹸の「透明性」とこれを極大化する「光」、そして「香り」を媒介にして存在と不在の間を行き来する天使の存在を感じることができます。 展示では、日常で向き合う石鹸で作った彫刻を鑑賞しながら作家の世界観を理解し、実際に見たことはないが見慣れた存在である天使を通じて、潜在的な想像力を繰り広げることができるでしょう。世代を超えて興味深い想像を呼び起こす天使の光と香りに満ちた今回の展示が、これまで身近に感じてきた天使という存在について再び考える機会になることを願います。
desc_l10n.ko: 《투명하고 향기 나는 천사의 날개 빛깔처럼》은 비누를 조각의 재료로 사용하여 독자적인 작품세계를 구축해온 조각가 신미경이 선보이는 전시이다. 전시의 주제인 ‘천사’는 신과 인간을 연결하는 종교적 표상이자, 예술적, 문학적 상상을 통해 우리의 인식 속에 익숙하게 자리하게 된 상징적인 존재이다. 작가는 엔젤이라는 이름의 향을 우연히 접하면서 천사라는 주제에 관심을 가지게 되었고, 세상에 ‘존재하는 것과 부재하는 것 사이에 있는 대상’으로서 천사의 모습을 시각화하여 보여준다. 신미경은 이번 전시에서 모두가 알고 있지만, 아무도 본 사람은 없는 천사가 가진 의미에 주목한다. 그가 표현하는 천사는 천상과 지상, 삶과 죽음, 육체와 영혼 사이를 오가는 환상의 영역에 있는 존재로서 비누의 물질적 속성을 통해 은유적으로 제시된다. 작가가 30여 년 동안 조각의 재료로 사용한 ‘비누’는 투명함과 불투명함을 오가는 물성뿐 아니라 닳아 없어지는 성질, 그리고 향기를 가지고 있다. 이러한 비누의 특징은 천상과 지상을 잇는 중간적 존재인 천사의 상징성과 연결된다. 특히 비누의 ‘투명성’과 이를 극대화하는 ‘빛’, 그리고 ‘향기’를 매개로 하여 존재와 부재 사이를 오가는 천사를 공감각적으로 경험할 수 있을 것이다. 관람객들은 일상에서 마주하는 비누로 만든 조각을 감상하며 작가의 작품세계를 이해하고, 실제로 본 적은 없지만 익숙한 존재인 천사를 통해 잠재된 상상력을 마음껏 펼쳐볼 수 있다. 세대를 초월하여 흥미로운 상상을 불러일으키는 천사의 빛과 향기로 가득한 이번 전시가 그동안 친숙하게 느껴왔던 천사를 재발견하는 기회가 되기를 바란다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 雕塑家SHIN MIGYEONG举办了一场名为“像天使翅膀的透明芬芳色彩”的展览，他运用肥皂这一独特的雕塑材料，创造出了一个别具一格的艺术世界。展览的主题天使作为一种连接上帝和人类的宗教符号，通过艺术和文学的想象，在我们的感知中成为了一种象征性的存在。作者偶然间接触到一种名为“天使”的气味，从此对天使的话题产生了浓厚的兴趣。 在本次展览中，SHIN MIGYEONG深入探讨了天使这一众所周知却鲜少为人所见的神秘存在。他笔下的天使，是一个穿梭于天与地、生与死、身体与灵魂之间的幻想境界的使者。艺术家巧妙地运用肥皂这一物质属性，隐喻地呈现了天使的特质。艺术家三十余年来一直将“肥皂”作为雕塑创作的核心材料。肥皂的特性丰富多样，它既能在透明与不透明之间自如转换，又易于磨损，更散发着独特的香气。观众将能够通过肥皂的“透明度”、最大化呈现的“光”以及迷人的“气味”，以联觉的方式体验天使在存在与缺席之间游走的神秘魅力。 参观者可以欣赏由日常生活中常见的肥皂雕刻而成的雕塑作品，从而一窥艺术家的创意世界。也可以通过从未见过的天使等熟悉而又神秘的存在激发潜在的想象力。希望这个洋溢着天使光芒与独特气息的展览，能够触动几代人的内心，唤起他们激动人心的想象，成为一次重新认识和发现那些熟悉而又充满魅力的天使形象的难得机会。

The theme of the exhibition, angels, is a religious symbol that connects God and humans. More than that, however, angels serve as symbolic beings that have become a natural part of our perception. Visualizing the image of angels as those that lie somewhere between what exists and what is absent, the artist first became interested in angels when she came across a fragrance called “Angel.” In this exhibition, Shin highlights the meaning of angels, something that everyone knows of yet has never seen. Her angel is a being in the realm of illusion, hovering between heaven and earth, life and death, body and soul, and is presented metaphorically through the material properties of soap. The artist has used soap as a material for her sculptures for more than 30 years. For Shin, soap also has a materiality to it that wavers between transparency and opacity. Still, it is destined to wear down over time, while its scent can only be experienced by those who have come in contact with it in person. These characteristics of soap are connected to the symbolism of angels, who are intermediate beings between heaven and earth. In particular, the transparency of soap, the light that maximizes its transparency, and its many different scents allow visitors to experience the presence of angels that oscillate between existence and absence. Visitors can draw closer to contemporary art by appreciating sculptures made from everyday soap, allowing their imagination to run wild through angels, a familiar yet unseen entity. We hope that this exhibition, which is filled with the light and fragrance of angels that evoke a kind of fantasy across generations, will inspire you to rediscover the very same angels you have always felt are familiar.
name: Celestial Whisper

The school actively participated in national movements such as the March 1st Movement during the Japanese colonial period, the June 1st Movement, and the Gwangju Student Movement. Monuments commemorating the March 1st Movement and the June 10th Movement are erected, allowing visitors to reflect on history. Additionally, the school is famous for its exotic architectural style and is a popular tourist destination, as it was a filming location for the drama “Winter Sonata.”

desc_l10n.ko: 1908년 일제강점기 때 교육을 통해 나라를 구하고, 세우고자 설립한 대한민국 최초의 사립학교입니다. 일제강점기 3·1운동, 6·1만세운동, 광주 학생 운동 등 민족 운동에 적극 동참하였고, 3·1운동 책원비와 6·10 만세운동 기념비가 세워져 있어 역사를 되새길 수 있습니다. 또한, 중앙고등학교는 드라마 '겨울연가'의 촬영지로 이국적인 건축 양식으로 유명해 많은 관광객들이 찾는 명소입니다.

Passed down across time and borders, this song carries the memories of migration, solidarity, loss, and hope, and it is both the voice and emotional record of a nation. Sori Island: Arirang Through the Ages is a chamber concert by the Seoul Metropolitan Traditional Orchestra, held in celebration of the 80th anniversary of Korea’s Liberation. This performance captures the breath of each era expressed through Arirang, delicately interpreted through the tones of traditional Korean instruments. From the Imjin War and resistance militias to forced migrations, armed independence movements, and globalization, travel through modern Korean history following the melodies of Arirang. This is a stage where Korea's history and emotions are conveyed not in words but in sound, through the rich, resonant timbre of traditional instruments. Highly recommended for those wishing to experience the depth of Korean traditional music.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 韓国人の情緒を盛り込んだ代表的な民謡、アリラン。歳月と国境を越えて伝わったこの歌は、移住と連帯、喪失と希望の記憶を秘めた民族の声であり、情緒の記録です。<ソリソム：時代と共にしたアリラン>は、韓国光復(日本の植民地から解放)80周年を記念してソウル市国楽管弦楽団が披露する室内楽公演で、アリランが盛り込んでいる時代の息吹を国楽器の繊細な音色で表現します。文禄・慶長の役、義兵闘争、強制移住、武装独立運動、世界化まで、アリランの旋律に沿って、韓国近現代史の感情と流れを音楽でお楽しみください。国楽器の魅力的な深い旋律を通じて、言葉ではなく音で伝える韓国の歴史と情緒。韓国の伝統音楽の奥深さを体験したい方に心を込めておすすめします。
desc_l10n.ko: 한국인의 정서를 담은 대표적인 민요, 아리랑. 세월과 국경을 넘어 전해진 이 노래는, 이주와 연대, 상실과 희망의 기억을 간직한 민족의 목소리이자 정서의 기록입니다. 〈소리섬 : 시대와 함께한 아리랑〉은 대한민국 광복 80주년을 기념해 서울시국악관현악단이 선보이는 실내악 공연으로, 아리랑이 담고 있는 시대의 숨결을 국악기의 섬세한 음색으로 풀어냅니다. 임진왜란, 의병 항쟁, 강제 이주, 무장 독립운동, 세계화까지 아리랑의 선율을 따라 한국 근현대사의 감정과 흐름을 음악으로 만나보세요. 국악기의 매력적인 깊은 선율을 통해, 말이 아닌 소리로 전하는 한국의 역사와 정서. 한국 전통음악의 깊이를 경험하고 싶은 분들께 진심을 담아 추천드립니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 《阿里郎》是蕴含韩国人情感的代表民谣，这首穿越岁月、跨越国界的歌曲，承载了迁徙和年代、分离和希望的回忆，记录着民族的心声和情怀。《声音岛：与时代同行的阿里郎》是纪念韩国光复80周年，由首尔市国乐管弦乐团推出的室内乐演出，用国乐乐器细腻的音色诠释了阿里郎蕴含的时代气息。随着阿里郎的旋律，用音乐感受壬辰倭乱、义军抗争、强制迁徙、武装独立运动、世界化等韩国近现代史的情感和趋势。通过国乐乐器魅力非凡的深沉旋律，用声音而非语言传达韩国历史和情怀，强烈推荐想要深层体验韩国传统音乐的人们观看。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Arirang, the most iconic Korean folk song, embodies the soul of the Korean people. Passed down across time and borders, this song carries the memories of migration, solidarity, loss, and hope, and it is both the voice and emotional record of a nation. Sori Island: Arirang Through the Ages is a chamber concert by the Seoul Metropolitan Traditional Orchestra, held in celebration of the 80th anniversary of Korea’s Liberation. This performance captures the breath of each era expressed through Arirang, delicately interpreted through the tones of traditional Korean instruments. From the Imjin War and resistance militias to forced migrations, armed independence movements, and globalization, travel through modern Korean history following the melodies of Arirang. This is a stage where Korea's history and emotions are conveyed not in words but in sound, through the rich, resonant timbre of traditional instruments. Highly recommended for those wishing to experience the depth of Korean traditional music.
name: Seoul Metropolitan Traditional Orchestra Chamber Music Series  - Sori Island: Arirang Through the Ages

desc_l10n.ko: FineCharacter 2026은 캐릭터를 단순한 상품이나 라이선스 콘텐츠를 넘어 하나의 예술 작품으로 조명하는 국내 최초의 캐릭터 아트 전시입니다. 오늘날 캐릭터는 일상 속에서 소비되는 콘텐츠를 넘어 작가의 세계관과 철학, 감성을 담아내는 예술적 매체로 확장되고 있습니다. FineCharacter는 이러한 변화에 주목하여 캐릭터와 파인아트, 디자인, 아트토이, 브랜드 IP를 하나의 공간에서 선보이는 새로운 형태의 전시 플랫폼입니다. 전시에는 캐릭터 아티스트, 일러스트레이터, 조형 작가, 아트토이 브랜드, 콘텐츠 IP 기업 등이 참여하며, 작품 전시뿐 아니라 판매, 협업, 라이선싱 등 다양한 비즈니스 기회를 함께 제공합니다. 관람객은 캐릭터를 작품으로 감상하고 소장하는 새로운 아트 소비 문화를 경험할 수 있으며, 참여 작가와 브랜드는 자신의 창작 세계를 더욱 넓은 시장과 대중에게 선보일 수 있습니다. 캐릭터와 예술의 경계를 허물고 새로운 문화 생태계를 제안하는 FineCharact

Completed in collaboration with Magnum Photos and the Martin Parr Foundation, this exhibition encompasses Martin Parr's artistic world spanning over 50 years, from his early black-and-white works in the 1970s to his late works, through 14 representative series of the artist, over 500 photographic works, and 90 photobooks. Going beyond a retrospective of a single photographer, this exhibition aims to re-examine the way images are produced and consumed today. (Panoramic photo: ⓒ Genie Project)

desc_l10n.ko: 현대 사진의 거장 마틴 파의 회고전《마틴 파: We Are Martin Parr》는 마틴 파 작고 이후 아시아에서 처음 개최되는 대규모 회고전입니다. 매그넘 포토스(Magnum Photos)와 마틴 파 재단(Martin Parr Foundation)의 협력으로 완성된 이 전시는 작가의 대표 연작 14개 시리즈와 사진 작품 500여 점, 사진책 90권을 통해 1970년대 초기 흑백 작업부터 후기 작업까지 50여 년에 걸친 마틴 파의 예술세계를 총망라합니다. 본 전시는 한 사진가의 회고전을 넘어, 오늘날 이미지가 생산되고 소비되는 방식을 다시 바라보고자 합니다. (전경사진: ⓒ 지니프로젝트)

Artist Yoon Eui-jin uses repeated brushstrokes on traditional Korean paper to depict surreal landscapes that embody the dark hours of life and the quiet hope found within them, capturing the lingering impressions of fleeting emotions. Artist Lee Chae-il transforms everyday objects such as classic cars, cats, and the sea into fairy-tale-like scenes, evoking warm memories and hope. Together, their landscapes retrace the memories of yesterday and the familiarity of today, shining a light on hope for the future. We hope that this exhibition offers a meaningful moment to confront the present and imagine a hopeful tomorrow through the works of these two artists.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 今回の展示は、激しい日常の中でしばらく立ち止まって「今」を振り返り、「明日」の可能性に向き合う感情の流れをテーマにしています。ユン・ウィジン作家は障子の上に幾重にも筆を重ね人生の暗い時間とその中の静かな希望を超現実的な風景で表現し、すれ違った感情の残像を盛り込みます。イ・チェイル作家はクラシックカーや猫、海など日常のオブジェを童話的な場面で解釈し、暖かい記憶と希望を喚起します。ユン・ウィジン、イ・チェイル作家の風景は、昨日の記憶と慣れ親しんだ今日を振り返り、明日への希望を照らします。二人の作家の作品を通じて、今日に深く向き合い、明日の希望を思い浮かべる時間になることを期待します。
desc_l10n.ko: 이번 전시는 치열한 일상 속에서 잠시 멈춰 서서 ‘지금’을 되돌아보고 ‘내일’의 가능성을 마주하는 감정의 흐름을 주제로 합니다. 윤의진 작가는 장지 위에 겹겹이 쌓인 붓질로 삶의 어두운 시간과 그 안의 조용한 희망을 초현실적 풍경으로 표현하며, 스쳐 지나간 감정의 잔상을 담아냅니다. 이채일 작가는 클래식 자동차와 고양이, 바다 등 일상의 오브제를 동화적인 장면으로 풀어내며 따뜻한 기억과 희망을 환기합니다. 윤의진, 이채일 작가의 풍경은 어제의 기억과 익숙한 오늘을 되짚으며, 내일을 향한 희망을 비춥니다. 두 작가의 작품을 통해 오늘을 깊이 마주하고 내일의 희망을 떠올리는 시간이 되기를 기대합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 本次展览的主题是在繁忙的日常生活中驻足片刻，回顾“现在”，面对“未来”可能性的情感趋势。尹义珍作家用纸张上层层叠加的画笔和超现实风景将生活中的黑暗时刻和其中静谧的希望表现出来，记录了擦肩而过的情感残影。李彩一作家则用童话般的场景诠释了古典汽车、猫咪和大海等日常主题，唤醒温暖的回忆和希望。尹义珍、李彩一作家作品中的风景回望了过去的回忆和熟悉的现在，点亮未来的希望。期待通过两位作家的作品，度过深刻面对现在，回想未来希望的时间。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} This exhibition centers around the emotional flow of taking a pause in the midst of a hectic life to reflect on the present and confront the potential of tomorrow. Artist Yoon Eui-jin uses repeated brushstrokes on traditional Korean paper to depict surreal landscapes that embody the dark hours of life and the quiet hope found within them, capturing the lingering impressions of fleeting emotions. Artist Lee Chae-il transforms everyday objects such as classic cars, cats, and the sea into fairy-tale-like scenes, evoking warm memories and hope. Together, their landscapes retrace the memories of yesterday and the familiarity of today, shining a light on hope for the future. We hope that this exhibition offers a meaningful moment to confront the present and imagine a hopeful tomorrow through the works of these two artists.

Among them, the artist has depicted Vairocana Buddha, Bodhisattva statues in the contemplative pose, stone pagodas, and other cultural treasures observed closely over many years. These works are created with ink and brush, capturing the beauty and gentle smile of our national treasures beyond religious boundaries, offering viewers a sense of comfort. The background patchwork drawn with ramie fabric is composed thread by thread, reflecting the artist’s connections and relationships. The exhibition seeks to present experimental works in both materials and technique, extending beyond traditional ink painting.

desc_l10n.ko: 이번 전시의 주된 소재는 불상과 자연물입니다. 그중에서도 직접 오랜 세월 눈여겨 보았던 비로자나불이나 반가사유상, 석탑 등 종교를 떠나서 우리의 국보나 보물의 아름다움과 잔잔한 미소를 먹과 필의 힘으로 그려, 보는 이로 하여금 편안함을 느끼도록 하였습니다. 작품의 배경으로 그린 모시 조각보는 나와 연결된 인연들을 생각하며 씨줄과 날줄을 한올 한올 그렸으며, 전통 수묵에만 머물지 않고 재료와 방법 면에서 실험적 작품을 선보이려 노력하였습니다.

desc_l10n.en: This two-person exhibition features Jeong Kwan and Kim Hyeju, who create works that redefine the craft format through paradoxical and audacious methods, highlighting the limitations of ceramics. This exhibition, which focuses on fresh attempts to break through the boundaries of craft in contemporary art, reveals the limitless potential of craft through the incompleteness of ceramics expressed by the two artists, encouraging a deeper exploration due to their unresolved nature.
desc_l10n.ja: この展示は、陶磁の限界点を浮き彫りにした逆説的かつ果敢な方法で工芸の形式を再編する作品を作るチョン・グァン、キム·ヘジュの2人展です。現代美術における工芸の限界値を突き破る新鮮な試みに注目した今回の展示は、両作家が表現する陶磁の未完結性によって、「完結されないためさらに邁進しなければならない」という工芸の無限な可能性を表現します。
desc_l10n.ko: 본 전시는 도자의 한계점을 부각한 역설적이고도 과감한 방법으로 공예의 형식을 재편하는 작품을 만드는 정관, 김혜주 작가의 2인전입니다. 현대미술에서 공예의 물성이 갖는 한계치를 뚫는 신선한 시도에 주목한 이번 전시는, 두 작가가 표현하는 도자의 미완결성으로 말미암아, 해결되지 않기에 더욱 매진해야 할, 공예의 무한한 가능성을 내비칩니다.
desc_l10n.zh: 本次展览将陶瓷的局限性刻画为相互矛盾又大胆的方式重新改变工艺形式作品的Jung Kwan、Kim Hyeju两位作家的双人展。关注突破现代美术中工艺物质属性， 此次展览是一次新鲜的尝试，两位作家通过表现陶瓷的未解决型，展现了工艺品的无限可能性。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} How does our body operate in an art museum? While gazing at the artworks and walking through the exhibition hall, the viewer's body moves amidst concentration and tension. Nevertheless, when talking about viewing, the body rarely appears. The exhibition pays attention to the 'body', which is easily overlooked within the art museum experience in this way. An interlude is originally music played between acts in an opera or play, changing the atmosphere and preparing for the transition to the next scene. Like an interlude, the exhibition is situated amidst the journey of viewing, providing a buffer time to relax the body and tune the senses.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 美術館で私たちの身体はどのように機能しているのだろうか？ 作品を見つめながら展示会場を行き来する間、観客の身体は集中と緊張の中で動く。それにもかかわらず、観覧について語る際、身体の存在が語られることは滅多にない。展示は、このように美術館の体験の中で容易に見過ごされがちな「身体」に注目する。間奏曲(interlude)は、本来オペラや演劇で幕間に演奏され、雰囲気を転換し、次の場面への移行を準備する音楽である。展示は、間奏曲のように観覧の旅路の間に位置し、身体を弛緩させ、感覚を調整する緩衝の時間を提供する。
desc_l10n.ko: 미술관에서 우리의 몸은 어떻게 작동할까? 작품을 응시하며 전시장을 오가는 동안, 관람객의 몸은 집중과 긴장 속에서 움직입니다. 그럼에도 관람에 대해 이야기할 때 몸은 좀처럼 등장하지 않습니다. 전시는 이처럼 미술관 경험 안에서 쉽게 간과되는 ‘몸'에 주목합니다. 간주곡(interlude)은 본래 오페라나 연극에서 막과 막 사이에 연주되며, 분위기를 전환하고 다음 장면으로의 이행을 준비하는 음악입니다. 전시는 간주곡처럼 관람의 여정 사이에 자리해 몸을 이완하고 감각을 조율하는 완충의 시간을 마련합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 在美术馆里，我们的身体究竟是如何运转的？当我们凝望作品、在展厅间穿梭时，身体始终处于专注和紧张的状态。然而，人们在谈论观展经历时，却很少提及身体。本次展览正是聚焦于这个在美术馆体验中常被忽略的“身体”。间奏曲(interlude)原指在歌剧或戏剧幕间演奏的音乐，用来转换气氛、引入下一幕。本场展览便如同这样一首间奏曲，置于观展旅程之间，为观众带来一段松弛身体、调和感官的缓冲时刻。

While gazing at the artworks and walking through the exhibition hall, the viewer's body moves amidst concentration and tension. Nevertheless, when talking about viewing, the body rarely appears. The exhibition pays attention to the 'body', which is easily overlooked within the art museum experience in this way. An interlude is originally music played between acts in an opera or play, changing the atmosphere and preparing for the transition to the next scene. Like an interlude, the exhibition is situated amidst the journey of viewing, providing a buffer time to relax the body and tune the senses.
name: Somatic Ground - Small Studio Semi

name_l10n.ja: 身体のための間奏曲 - 小木場セミ
name_l10n.zh: 身体的间奏曲—小木匠世美（Somatic Ground - Small Studio Semi）

desc_l10n.en: With Walpurgis Night, the festival of witches, as the subject, we will shed light on the genealogy of Korean feminist art and explore changes in the Korean feminist art between the 1st and 4th generations, looking back on the changed social image through critical mind. Pioneers of Korean feminist art and new artists meet, sympathize and solidarity through the history of changes in Korean society dwelling in their works, in 2023. We publicize Korean feminist art to the public living in the present, and through feminist art between various generations, we want to open a meeting place that can promote a sense of solidarity.
desc_l10n.ja: 魔女たちの祭りが開かれるバルプルギスの夜を題材に、韓国のフェミニズムアートの系譜にスポットを当て、第1世代と第4世代の間でフェミニズムアート界の変化を探求し、共通の問題意識を通じて変化した社会を振り返ります。韓国のフェミニズムアートの先駆者と新人作家たちが力を合わせ、作品の中に込めた韓国社会の変遷史を通じて、2023年の現在を生きている大衆に韓国のフェミニズムアートを伝えます。多様な世代のフェミニズムアートを通じた作家たちのメッセージをご覧下さい。
desc_l10n.ko: 마녀들의 축제가 열리는 발푸르기스의 밤을 소재로 하여 한국 여성주의 미술의 계보를 조명하고 1세대와 4세대 사이 여성주의 미술계의 변화를 탐구함으로써 공통의 문제의식을 통해 변화한 사회상을 돌아보고자 합니다. 한국의 여성주의 미술의 선구자들과 신진작가들이 만나 공감하고 연대하며, 작품속에깃든 한국사회의 변천사를 통해 2023년 현재를 살아가고 있는 대중에게 한국 여성주의 미술을 알리고, 다양한 세대간 여성주의미술을 통한 연대 의식을 고취할 수 있는 만남의 장을 열고자 합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: 以举办魔女们的庆典的瓦尔普吉斯的夜晚为主题,审视韩国女性主义美术的谱系,探索第一代和第四代之间女性主义美术界的变化,通过共同的问题意识,回顾变化的社会面貌。 韩国女性主义美术的先驱者和新进作家们相遇,产生共鸣并联合起来,通过作品中蕴含的韩国社会的变迁史,在2023年向生活至今的大众宣传韩国女性主义美术,通过多种世代间的女性主义的美术,开启可以鼓吹连带意识的见面场所。

desc_l10n.ko: 고터·세빛 관광안내소는 고속터미널역(G2출구)에서 반포한강공원을 연결하는 지하 공공보행통로 내에 위치해있습니다. 영어, 중국어, 일본어 안내 서비스가 가능한 전문 관광통역안내사가 상주해 있어 외국인도 원활한 안내 서비스를 받을 수 있습니다. 내부에는 다양한 관광안내 책자가 비치되어있으며, 외국인 관광객을 위한 와우패스 기기, 동전 환전기, 키오스크 등이 설치되어있습니다. 고터·세빛 관광안내소 인근의 고투몰은 교통과 쇼핑의 중심지로 즐길거리가 풍부하며, 반포한강공원으로의 편리한 접근성을 갖추고 있습니다. 이와 관련된 관광 일정에 대해 문의사항이 있는 경우, 내방하여 편리하게 안내를 받고 일정 계획에 도움을 받을 수 있습니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 'Ask Nature: Biomimicry' is an exhibition centered on architectural wisdom inspired by nature. Students from 26 universities nationwide gather to explore the potential of sustainable architecture through architectural experiments that imitate natural forms, behaviors, and systems. This exhibition goes beyond a simple display of works. It investigates and interprets the principles and orders inherent in nature from an architectural perspective, proposing a new architectural language through the experimental structure of a pavilion. It also explores the public value of architecture and the potential for communication through interaction with citizens. Moreover, students take full initiative in every stage, from design to production, construction, and dismantling, making the exhibition a laboratory for directly experiencing and sharing the interconnections between architecture and nature, city and environment.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 「Ask Nature：Biomimicry」は自然から学ぶ建築的知恵をテーマに、全国26大学の建築学科の学生たちが集まって自然の形態、行動、システムを模倣した建築的実験を通じて持続可能な建築の可能性を探求する展示です。この展示は単純な作品展示を超え、自然に内在する原理と秩序を建築的に探求して解釈し、パビリオンという実験的構造物を通じて新しい建築言語を提案し、市民との相互作用を通じて建築の公共性とコミュニケーションの可能性まで一緒に探索します。また、設計から製作、施工、解体までの全過程を学生たちが直接主導し、建築と自然、都市と環境など多様な関係を体得して共有する実験の場です。
desc_l10n.ko: ‘Ask Nature : Biomimicry’는 자연에서 배우는 건축적 지혜를 주제로, 전국 26개 대학 건축학과 학생들이 모여 자연의 형태, 행동, 시스템을 모방한 건축적 실험을 통해 지속가능한 건축의 가능성을 탐구하는 전시입니다. 이 전시는 단순한 작품 전시를 넘어, 자연에 내재된 원리와 질서를 건축적으로 탐구하고 해석하며 파빌리온이라는 실험적 구조물을 통해 새로운 건축 언어를 제안하며 시민과의 상호작용을 통해 건축의 공공성과 소통 가능성까지 함께 탐색합니다. 또한 설계부터 제작, 시공, 해체까지의 전 과정을 학생들이 직접 주도하며, 건축과 자연, 도시와 환경 등 다양한 관계들을 몸으로 체득하고 공유하는 실험의 장입니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} “Ask Nature : Biomimicry”是以在自然中学习的建筑智慧为主题，来自全韩26所大学建筑系的学生汇聚一堂，通过模仿自然形态、行动、系统的建筑实验，探索可持续建筑可能性的展览。本次展览不仅仅是对作品的展示，更是对大自然的内在原理和秩序进行建筑探索和诠释，通过名为Pavilion的实验性结构，提出新的建筑语言，在与市民的相互作用下，共同探索建筑的公共性和可沟通性。另外，从设计到制作、施工、拆卸的全部过程均由学生亲自主导，是亲身体验和分享建筑与自然、城市与环境等各种关系的实验场所。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 'Ask Nature: Biomimicry' is an exhibition centered on architectural wisdom inspired by nature. Students from 26 universities nationwide gather to explore the potential of sustainable architecture through architectural experiments that imitate natural forms, behaviors, and systems. This exhibition goes beyond a simple display of works. It investigates and interprets the principles and orders inherent in nature from an architectural perspective, proposing a new architectural language through the experimental structure of a pavilion. It also explores the public value of architecture and the potential for communication through interaction with citizens. Moreover, students take full initiative in every stage, from design to production, construction, and dismantling, making the exhibition a laboratory for directly experiencing and sharing the interconnections between architecture and nature, city and environment.

desc_l10n.en: 2025 Seoul City Wall Museum First Half Special Exhibition World Heritage and Capital Fortifications of Hanyang The "Capital Fortifications of Hanyang" were built to defend Hanyang, the capital of Joseon. While many fortresses of historical heritage in many contemporary cities have disappeared due to urban development, Hanyang's capital fortifications have maintained their form to the present day, preserving both tangible and intangible historical value. To promote and conserve these values worldwide, Seoul City, Gyeonggi Province, Goyang City, and the National Heritage Administration are collaborating to inscribe Hanyang's capital fortifications on the World Heritage List. This exhibition examines the meaning of UNESCO World Heritage, the World Heritage Convention and its operating bodies, the World Heritage inscription process, and the international value of Hanyang's capital fortifications, aiming to explore how Hanyang's capital fortifications are progressing from being solely Korea's heritage to becoming heritage for the entire world.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 2025年ハニャン(漢陽)都城博物館上半期企画展 世界遺産とハニャン(漢陽)の首都城郭 World Heritage and Capital Fortifications of Hanyang 「ハニャン(漢陽)の首都城郭」は、朝鮮の都だったハニャン(漢陽)を守るために築城されました。同時代のいくつかの都市において城郭遺産は都市開発によりなくなりましたが、ハニャン(漢陽)の首都城郭はその姿を現在まで維持しながら、有形・無形の歴史的価値を保存しています。このような価値を世界に知らせ、保全するため、ソウル市、キョンギ(京畿)道、コヤン(高陽)市と国家遺産庁が協力し、ハニャン(漢陽)の首都城郭を世界遺産リストに登載するために努力しています。 今回の展示では、ユネスコ世界遺産の意味、世界遺産協約と運営機構、世界遺産の登載手続、ハニャン(漢陽)の首都城郭が持つ国際的価値などを調べ、韓国だけの遺産ではなく、世界中の人々の遺産へと進むハニャン(漢陽)の首都城郭について見ていきたいと思います。
desc_l10n.ko: 2025년 한양도성박물관 상반기 기획전 세계유산과 한양의 수도성곽 World Heritage and Capital Fortifications of Hanyang “한양의 수도성곽”은 조선의 도읍지였던 한양을 방어하기 위해 축성되었습니다. 동시대의 여러 도시에서 성곽 유산은 도시 개발로 사라졌지만 한양의 수도성곽은 그 모습을 현재까지 유지하면서 유무형의 역사적 가치를 보존하고 있습니다. 이러한 가치를 전 세계에 알리고 보전하기 위해 서울시, 경기도, 고양시와 국가유산청은 서로 협력하여 한양의 수도성곽을 세계유산 목록에 등재하기 위해 노력하고 있습니다. 이번 전시에서는 유네스코 세계유산의 의미, 세계유산협약과 운영기구, 세계유산 등재 절차, 한양의 수도성곽이 지닌 국제적 가치 등을 살펴보고 대한민국만의 유산이 아닌 전 세계인의 유산으로 나아가는 한양의 수도성곽을 알아보고자 합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 2025年汉阳都城博物馆上半年企划展 世界遗产和汉阳首都城郭 World Heritage and Capital Fortifications of Hanyang “汉阳首都城郭”是为了守卫朝鲜首都汉阳而修建的。在同时代的多个城市中，城郭遗产因城市开发而消失，但汉阳首都城郭却依然保留了原貌，并保留了有形和无形的历史价值。为了向全世界宣传和保留其价值，首尔市、京畿道、高阳市和国家遗产厅相互合作，努力将汉阳的首都城郭列入世界遗产名录。 在此次展览中，我们将了解联合国世界遗产的意义、世界遗产公约和运营机构、世界遗产申遗程序、汉阳首都城郭蕴含的国际价值等，并了解到汉阳首都城郭不仅是韩国的遗产，也是全世界人民的遗产。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The special exhibition "Gathering Vibrance" at the Samgaksan Geumam Museum of Art showcases the aspirations of women during the Joseon Dynasty through the works of two female artists, Jeong Myoung-jo and Choi Yoon-ha, each presenting their interpretation in different genres.Jeong Myoung-jo expresses the back profile of women wearing traditional Hanbok in hyperrealistic style. As a university student,Jeong began drawing the charm of traditional garments at a Hanbok shop near her school. Choi Yoon-ha (Maison de Yoon) presents jewelry pieces that reinterpret traditional elements with a modern twist. The artist has created Hanbok accessories for K-pop idols such as IU, BLACKPINK's Rosé, and NMIXX's Seolyoon.During the Joseon Dynasty, a Confucian society with distinct gender roles and rigid class divisions, women were expected to minimize exposure. In the Yeongjo and Jeongjo periods, hair accessories were banned due to a royal decree. The only areas where women could express their femininity and adorn themselves were their styled hair and accessories worn on their clothes.This exhibition aims to reflect women’s instinct for adornment and their desires for wealth, fertility, and happiness through their decorative choices.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} サムガクサン(三角山)クマム(黔岩)美術館の企画展 <爽やかさをかき集めて＞では、チョン・ミョンジョ作家とチェ・ユンハ作家が朝鮮時代を生きた女性たちの願いを作品に込め、それぞれ異なるジャンルでお披露目します。チョン・ミョンジョ作家は伝統韓服を纏った女性の後ろ姿を描いた絵をハイパーリアリズムで表現しました。チョン作家は、大学時代に学校近くにある韓服店の伝統婚礼服に魅了され、絵を描き始めました。チェ・ユンハ作家(メゾンド・ユン)は伝統を守りつつも、現代風に再構成した装飾具をお見せします。チェ作家はこれまで、IUをはじめBLACKPINKのロゼ、NMIXXのソリュンなど、K-POPアイドルの装飾具も手掛けて来ました。 朝鮮時代の儒教社会により男女には違いがあり、身分格差もはっきりしていました。女性はなるべく露出を控え、歴代王であるヨンジョ(英祖）およびチョンジョ(正祖)の時代には加髢、いわゆるつけ毛装着の禁止令により豪華な装飾が禁じられていました。自身の女性らしさを出し、着飾ることが許されたのはチョクチンモリ、いわゆる結った髪や韓服の上につける装飾具が全てでした。こういった女性の装飾に対する気持ちや富貴栄華、多産、多福を望む女性たちの願いを企画展でお見せします。
desc_l10n.ko: 삼각산금암미술관 기획전시 <싱그러움을 그러모아>는 조선시대 여성들의 염원을 작품으로 담아 정명조, 최윤하 두 여성 작가가 각기 다른 장르로 선보인다. 정명조 작가는 전통 한복을 입은 여성의 뒷모습 그림을 극사실주의로 표현한다. 정 작가는 대학생 때 학교 근처 한복집에서 전통 활옷의 매력에 그림을 그리기 시작했다. 최윤하(메종 드 윤) 통해 전통을 고수하면서 현대적으로 재해석한 장신구 작품을 보여준다. 작가는 아이유, 블랙핑크 로제, 엔믹스 설윤 등 k-pop 아이돌의 한복 장신구를 제작했다. 조선시대는 유교 사회로 남녀가 유별하며 신분의 차이가 뚜렷했다. 여성은 최대한 노출을 자제하고, 영·정조 시대에는 가체 금지령으로 인해 사치스러운 머리 장식을 할 수 없었다. 자신의 여성을 드러내고 꾸밀 수 있는 부위는 쪽을 진 머리와 옷 위로 치장하는 장신구가 전부였다. 이러한 여성들의 꾸밈에 대한 본능과 부귀영화, 다산, 다복을 바라는 염원을 이번 기획전시를 통해 보여주고자 한다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 三角山黔岩美术馆策划展出了名为《收集清新的气息》的作品，该作品以朝鲜时代女性的愿望为主题，由CHEONG MYEONGJO和CHOI YUNHA两位女艺术家分别采用不同体裁进行创作并呈现。CHEONG MYEONGJO艺术家将穿着传统韩服的女性背影画作以超现实主义风格展现出来。在大学时期，CHEONG MYEONGJO就开始在学校附近的韩服店为那些充满魅力的传统礼服作画。而CHOI YUNHA则展示了其固守传统的同时，运用现代手法重新诠释的首饰作品。艺术家制作了iu、blackpink成员rose、nmixx成员雪允等k-pop偶像的韩服首饰。朝鲜时代是一个儒教社会，男女有别，身份差异显著。女性在这一时期尽量避免暴露，特别是在英祖、正祖时代，由于禁止佩戴假发，她们无法进行奢华的头饰装扮。女性能够用以展示和装饰自己的部位，仅限于一束扎起的头发以及装饰在衣物上的饰品。此次企划展旨在向大家展示朝鲜时代女性对于打扮的本能追求，以及她们对富贵荣华、多产多福的美好愿望。

In particular, it has expressed human emotions and narratives of life through the tiger motif. While maintaining this pictorial language, this exhibition has realized the three-dimensional texture of the artworks through SIMULAQUE's unique "Physical Art-Tech (UV 3D print)" technology.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 今回の展示は、伝統的な民画の象徴性と現代的な感覚を融合させてきたジ・ミンソン作家の代表作を中心に構成されています。ボム(BEOM)というテーマのもと、民画の中の象徴を現代的に再解釈し、特に虎をモチーフとして人間の感情や人生の物語を表現してきました。今回の展示では、このような絵画的言語を維持しながらも、SIMULAQUE(シミュラーク)独自の「Physical Art-Tech(UV 3D print)」技術を用いて、作品に立体的な質感を実現しました。
desc_l10n.ko: 이번 전시는 전통 민화의 상징성과 현대적 감각을 결합해온 지민선 작가의 대표작들을 중심으로, 범(BEOM)이라는 테마 아래 민화 속 상징을 현대적으로 재해석하며, 특히 호랑이 모티프(motif)를 통해 인간의 감정과 삶의 서사를 표현해왔습니다. 이번 전시에서는 이러한 회화적 언어를 유지하면서도, SIMULAQUE(시뮬라크)의 독자적인 “Physical Art-Tech(UV 3D print)기술을 통해 작품의 입체적 질감을 구현하였습니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Since 2017, the Buk-Seoul Museum of Art has been experimenting with flexible communication with audiences through its Vacant Space Project, displaying artworks in spaces other than exhibition halls. The 2025 vacant space exhibition “Sonic Planet – Hertz and Dough” continues this approach, inviting visitors to sense both their own sounds and those of surrounding beings, and to feel the resonance of coexistence. The participating artist team Hertz and Dough is also the first artist group to launch the museum’s “Artist Research” program, which explores the ways in which artistic inquiry and contemplation expand within the creative process. They perceive the world through sound and develop their own narratives by studying the act of listening itself. In the world of sound, where technology and ecology, human and non-human, space and environment intersect, they are asking questions about what and how we hear and understand. The exhibition proposes the following attitudes to create different access points to connect with each other through sound. First, rather than looking for more, close your eyes and listen to the sounds of the here and now. Second, establish listening as an active act rather than mere reception; and third, move beyond an anthropocentric auditory experience to a more sensitive observation of the diverse sounds of the planet. Through these approaches, the soundscape that surrounds us may be transformed into a complex “sonic planet”a sensory field of sound environments.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 北ソウル美術館は2017年から毎年、遊休空間プロジェクトを通じて展示場ではなく美術館のあちこちに作品を置き、観客との柔軟なコミュニケーションを試みてきました。2025年遊休空間展示《地球の響き-ヘルツ・アンド・ドウ》もその延長線で、美術館を訪れた人々が自身と周辺に存在する音を一緒に感じ、共生の響きを感じることができることを願います。 今回の展示の参加作家であるヘルツ・アンド・ドウ(Hertz and Dough)は、芸術家の創作過程で探求と思惟がどのように拡張されるのか、その面々を探る北ソウル美術館「アーティストリサーチ」の第一歩を踏み出す芸術家でもあります。彼らはサウンドを通じて世界を理解し、リスニング感覚そのものについての研究として自らの物語を作り上げています。技術と生態、人間と非人間、空間と環境が交差する音の世界で、私たちは何をどのように聞いて理解するかについて質問を投げかけるのです。 展示は音を媒介に互いをつなげる多様な接近点を設けるために次のような態度を提案します。まず、より多くのものを見るよりも、むしろ目を閉じて耳を傾け、今ここの響きを聞いてみてください。また、リスニングを単なる受容ではなく能動的行為として設定し、人間中心の聴覚経験を超え、地球が抱く多様な音を繊細に観察してみてください。これにより、私たちを取り巻くサウンドスケープ(soundscape)から、複合的な「音の地区」という感覚の場として、音の環境を転換させることができるでしょう。
desc_l10n.ko: 북서울미술관은 2017년부터 매년 유휴공간 프로젝트를 통해 전시장이 아닌 미술관 곳곳에 작품을 놓으며, 관객과의 유연한 소통을 실험해왔습니다. 2025년 유휴공간 전시 《지구 울림-헤르츠앤도우》 역시 그 연장선에서 미술관을 찾은 이들이 자신과 주변 존재의 소리를 함께 감각하며 공생의 울림을 느낄 수 있길 바랍니다. 이번 전시의 참여 작가인 헤르츠앤도우(Hertz and Dough)는 예술가의 창작 과정에서 탐구와 사유가 어떻게 확장되는지 그 면면을 살피는 북서울미술관 ‘아티스트 리서치’의 첫발을 내딛는 예술가이기도 합니다. 이들은 사운드를 통해 세계를 이해하며, 청취 감각 자체에 대한 연구로써 스스로의 이야기를 만들어 가고 있습니다. 기술과 생태, 인간과 비인간, 공간과 환경이 교차하는 소리의 세계에서 우리는 무엇을 어떻게 듣고 이해할지에 대해 질문을 던지는 것입니다. 전시는 소리를 매개로 서로를 연결하는 다양한 접근점을 마련하고자 다음과 같은 태도를 제안합니다. 먼저, 더 많은 것을 보기보다 오히려 눈을 감고 귀를 기울여 지금 여기의 울림을 들어보세요. 또 듣기를 단순한 수용이 아닌 능동적 행위로서 설정하고, 인간 중심의 청각 경험을 넘어 지구가 품는 다양한 소리를 섬세하게 관찰해보세요. 이를 통해 우리를 둘러싼 사운드스케이프(soundscape)에서 나아가 복합적인 ‘소리 지구(地區)’라는 감각의 장으로서 소리 환경을 전환시킬 수 있을 것입니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 北首尔美术馆从2017年开始，每年通过闲置空间项目，在美术馆各处摆放作品，而不仅仅是在展厅，实现了与观众们的灵活沟通。2025年闲置空间展览《地球回音——Hertz and Dough》同样是对此种展览方式的延伸，希望来到美术馆的人们能够共同感受自己和身边存在的声音，感受相互依存的回音。 参加此次展览的作家Hertz and Dough也是首批参加北首尔美术馆“艺术家探索”项目的艺术家，该项目旨在了解艺术家创作过程中的探索和思维是如何拓展的。他们通过声音来了解世界，通过倾听对自身的研究来创作自己的故事。在技术和生态、人类和非人类、空间和环境交汇的声音世界里，我们会对如何倾听和理解提出问题。 展览以声音为媒介，制定相互连接的多种切入点，并提出如下建议：首先，与其看更多的东西，不如闭上眼睛倾听，听听现在这里的回音。另外，把倾听设定为主动行为，而不是单纯地接受，超越以人为本的倾听体验，细致地观察地球内蕴藏的各种声音。通过这些，可以从围绕我们的音景（soundscape）走向复合的“声音区”感官空间，从而转换声音环境。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Since 2017, the Buk-Seoul Museum of Art has been experimenting with flexible communication with audiences through its Vacant Space Project, displaying artworks in spaces other than exhibition halls. The 2025 vacant space exhibition “Sonic Planet – Hertz and Dough” continues this approach, inviting visitors to sense both their own sounds and those of surrounding beings, and to feel the resonance of coexistence. The participating artist team Hertz and Dough is also the first artist group to launch the museum’s “Artist Research” program, which explores the ways in which artistic inquiry and contemplation expand within the creative process. They perceive the world through sound and develop their own narratives by studying the act of listening itself. In the world of sound, where technology and ecology, human and non-human, space and environment intersect, they are asking questions about what and how we hear and understand. The exhibition proposes the following attitudes to create different access points to connect with each other through sound. First, rather than looking for more, close your eyes and listen to the sounds of the here and now. Second, establish listening as an active act rather than mere reception; and third, move beyond an anthropocentric auditory experience to a more sensitive observation of the diverse sounds of the planet. Through these approaches, the soundscape that surrounds us may be transformed into a complex “sonic planet”a sensory field of sound environments.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Artist Choi Jae-Yi continues her work under the belief that the deeply personal is also universal. After enduring a period of illness, she found inspiration in the sight of trees lying exposed to the sea breeze in Jeju, using this as a motif in her work. She began to express the contrast between wind and home—where wind represents abstraction and freedom, and home serves as a final point of emotional expression. Through her work, she engages in an internal dialogue, finding both emotional liberation and healing in the act of creation. On the other hand, artist Hwang Ho-Seok jots down striking words or ideas for his work. He reflects on them over time, creating stories and images, often choosing photos he has previously taken. He then discovers and expresses unnoticed details or emotions within these photos. He seeks to translate intimate feelings drawn from everyday life and relationships into his paintings, hoping viewers will find healing through this expression. Through Roland Barthes' concept of nuance, the works of these two artists encompass more than mere differences; they depict emotions in distinct ways, allowing for varied interpretations. This divergence shapes the mood of each piece, offering viewers a more profound emotional connection. Despite their contrasting motifs and approaches, both artists share a common purpose: to explore emotional healing. They invite viewers to freely interpret and find solace in their works, subtly whispering that each person can find personal healing within the relationship between their everyday lives and surroundings. – Curator Sim Da-Seul
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} チェ・ジェイ作家は、「極めて個人的なものが普遍的である」という考えのもとで作品を制作し続けています。作家は闘病生活を経て、チェジュ(済州)島の海風を受けながら横たわっていた木々の風景から作品のモチーフを得て、風と家という対照的な存在を表現し始めました。ここで風は「抽象」と「自由」を意味し、家は感情の「終止符」を打つ存在です。作家は制作の過程で内面と対話し、作品制作を通じて感情の自由さと癒しを得ています。 ファン・ホソク作家は、作業のために印象的な言葉や思考をメモします。時間をおいてそれを考え、物語やイメージを作り出しますが、これは主に撮影した写真の中から選ばれたイメージです。そして、その写真の中で注目されていない部分や感情を発見し、表現します。日常生活や周囲との関係の中で、内面的な感情が絵画作品として表現され、それを観賞した人々が癒されることを作家は願っています。 ロラン・バルトの「ニュアンス」の概念において、二人の作家の作品は単なる違い以上のものを内包しています。異なる言語で感情を描写する過程で生じる違いは、さまざまな解釈を引き出します。その違いが各作品のムードを形成し、観覧者はそれを通じて深い感情的なつながりを体験します。異なるモチーフと制作過程を持ちながらも、作品を通じて感情の癒しという共通の目的を追求している二人の作家は、観覧者一人ひとりの個人的な日常や周囲との関係の中で、自由に作品を解釈し癒されることを、私たちにささやくように語りかけています。 -キュレーター シム·ダスル
desc_l10n.ko: 최제이 작가는 지극히 개인적인 것이 보편적이라는 생각 아래 작업을 이어갑니다. 작가는 투병 생활 이후, 제주도의 해풍을 맞으며 누워있던 나무의 풍경에서 작품의 모티브를 얻고, 바람과 집이라는 대비되는 존재를 표현하기 시작하였습니다. 여기서 바람은 추상과 자유의 의미이며, 집은 감정의 마침표를 찍는 존재입니다. 작가는 작업을 하는 동안 내면과 대화하고, 작업하는 행위로부터 감정의 자유로움과 치유를 얻습니다. 황호석 작가는 작업을 위해 인상적인 낱말 혹은 생각을 메모합니다. 작가는 시간을 두고 이를 생각한 후 이야기와 이미지를 만들며, 이는 주로 찍어 둔 사진의 이미지가 선택됩니다. 그리고 그 사진 안에서 주목받지 못한 부분 혹은 감정을 발견하고 표현합니다. 일상과 주변, 그 관계 속에서 내밀한 감정이 회화 작업으로 표현되고, 이를 본 관람객들이 치유되기를 작가는 소망합니다. 롤랑바르트의 뉘앙스 개념에서 두 작가의 작품은 단순한 차이 이상의 것을 내포합니다. 각기 다른 언어로 감정을 묘사하며, 그 과정에서 발생하는 차이는 각기 다른 해석을 열어줍니다. 더불어 그 차이는 각 작품의 무드를 형성하며, 관람객은 이를 통해 더욱 깊이 있는 감정적 연결을 경험합니다. 서로 다른 모티브와 작업 과정을 갖지만, 작업을 통해 감정의 치유라는 공통된 목적을 탐구하는 두 작가는 관람객 각자의 개인적인 일상과 주변의 관계 속에서 작품을 자유롭게 해석하고 치유 받게 될 것이라고 우리에게 속삭이듯 말하고 있습니다. -심다슬 큐레이터
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} JAY CHOI认为，尽管某些东西极其个人化，但它们却具有普遍性，因此他选择继续工作。在与病魔抗争之后，作者在济州岛上找到了创作的灵感。他迎着海风，望着那片树木葱郁的风景，从中汲取了作品的主题。他开始展现风与房子之间形成的鲜明对比：在这里，风象征着抽象与自由，而房子则代表着情感的归宿与终结。在创作过程中，作者不断与自己的内心进行对话，从这一行为中获得了情感的释放与治愈。 HWANG HOSEOK作家在工作时，会记录下印象深刻的单词或想法。他会花时间思考，进而创作出故事和人物形象，其中主要选取的是拍摄的照片中的形象。随后，他会发现并表达出照片中那些未被大众关注的部分或情感。作家的希望是，通过绘画作品展现出日常生活中以及周围关系中隐秘的情感，让观赏这些作品的游客们能够获得治愈。 在罗兰·巴特的色彩理论框架下，两位作家的作品展现出超越单纯差异的深刻内涵。他们运用不同的语言来描绘情感，这一过程中所产生的差异为作品开辟了多元化的解释空间。同时，这些差异也塑造了各自作品的独特氛围，使观众能够借此体验到更为深层次的情感共鸣。尽管两位作家在主题选择和创作过程上有所不同，但他们都在探索治愈情感的共同目标。通过他们的作品，我们仿佛能听到低语，提示我们在各自的个人生活和周围关系中，作品将获得自由的阐释，并带来心灵的慰藉。 -SIM DASEUL策展人

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Art Cube 2R2 is a complex exhibition space operated by Art Token Inc., an art content solution company. It serves as an exhibition platform that expands and connects digitally generated art into offline exhibition experiences. Based on the convergence of art and technology, it is designed to allow visitors to multi-dimensionally experience works of various genres, such as painting, drawing, installation, media art, and digital content, within a single space. Furthermore, as a space of connection bridging the inside and outside of boundaries, it oversees the flow of contemporary art where the past and present, reality and imagination, and the local and global intersect. By connecting domestic and international artists, content, technologies, and platforms, it expands the possibilities of exchange. Going beyond a simple exhibition hall, it experiments with the physical realization of digital art and new distribution methods for art content. Through these endeavors, it continuously explores new possibilities for art appreciation and exhibition formats, presenting a new gallery model reflecting contemporary art and media environments.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Art Cube 2R2は、アートコンテンツソリューション企業である㈱アートトークンが運営する複合展示空間であり、オンラインで生成されたデジタルアートをオフラインの展示体験へと拡張・連動させる展示プラットフォームです。芸術と技術の融合を基盤に、絵画、ドローイング、インスタレーション、メディアアート、デジタルコンテンツなど、多様なジャンルの作品を一つの空間の中で立体的に体験できるよう設計されています。また、境界の内と外をつなぐ「連結の空間」として、過去と現在、現実と想像、ローカルとグローバルが交差する現代美術の潮流を展望します。国内外の作家やコンテンツ、技術、プラットフォームを結びつけて交流の可能性を広げ、単なる展示会場を超えて、デジタルアートの物理的な具現化とアートコンテンツの新たな流通方式を模索しています。このような試みを通じて、芸術の鑑賞方法や展示形式における新たな可能性を継続的に模索し、同時代の美術とメディア環境を反映した新しいギャラリーモデルを提示します。
desc_l10n.ko: Art Cube 2R2는 아트 콘텐츠 솔루션 기업 ㈜아트토큰이 운영하는 복합 전시 공간으로, 온라인에서 생성된 디지털 아트를 오프라인 전시 경험으로 확장하고 연결하는 전시 플랫폼입니다. 예술과 기술의 융합을 기반으로 회화, 드로잉, 설치, 미디어 아트, 디지털 콘텐츠 등 다양한 장르의 작품을 하나의 공간 안에서 입체적으로 경험할 수 있도록 설계되었습니다. 또한 경계의 안과 밖을 잇는 연결의 공간으로서 과거와 현재, 현실과 상상, 로컬과 글로벌이 교차하는 동시대 미술의 흐름을 조망합니다. 국내외 작가와 콘텐츠, 기술, 플랫폼을 연결해 교류 가능성을 확장하며, 단순한 전시장을 넘어 디지털 아트의 물리적 구현과 아트 콘텐츠의 새로운 유통 방식을 실험합니다. 이러한 시도를 통해 예술의 감상 방식과 전시 형식에 대한 새로운 가능성을 지속적으로 모색하며, 동시대 미술과 미디어 환경을 반영한 새로운 갤러리 모델을 제시합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Art Cube 2R2是艺术内容解决方案企业（株）Art Token运营的综合展览空间，也是一座打通线上数字艺术与线下实体观展体验的展览平台。空间以艺术与科技融合为核心，汇集绘画、素描、装置艺术、媒体艺术、数字内容等多元品类作品，让观众在同一空间获得沉浸式、立体化的观展体验。同时，这里也是打破边界的交流空间，纵览当代艺术脉络，见证过往与当下、现实与想象、本土与国际的交融碰撞。场馆联动海内外艺术家、艺术内容、技术和平台，拓展艺术交流的更多可能。它不止是单纯的展厅，更致力于探索数字艺术的实体落地、艺术内容全新传播模式。通过这种尝试，持续挖掘艺术鉴赏形式和展览形态的新方向，打造契合当代艺术与媒介环境的全新画廊模式。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Art Cube 2R2 is a complex exhibition space operated by Art Token Inc., an art content solution company. It serves as an exhibition platform that expands and connects digitally generated art into offline exhibition experiences. Based on the convergence of art and technology, it is designed to allow visitors to multi-dimensionally experience works of various genres, such as painting, drawing, installation, media art, and digital content, within a single space. Furthermore, as a space of connection bridging the inside and outside of boundaries, it oversees the flow of contemporary art where the past and present, reality and imagination, and the local and global intersect. By connecting domestic and international artists, content, technologies, and platforms, it expands the possibilities of exchange. Going beyond a simple exhibition hall, it experiments with the physical realization of digital art and new distribution methods for art content. Through these endeavors, it continuously explores new possibilities for art appreciation and exhibition formats, presenting a new gallery model reflecting contemporary art and media environments.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} This exhibition presents the works of three artists who explore the unknown world through "imaginary landscapes" that unfold personal and social emotions encountered in various spaces as reflections of the artist's inner flow. The scenes remembered from past times and places are reimagined in a dreamlike manner, where the subtle emotions felt at that moment intersect with the current state of consciousness. This transforms everyday spaces into unknown worlds, adding a lyrical resonance to ordinary landscapes. The exhibition, featuring paintings and photographs by the participating artists, delves into how the theme of "liberalization from restriction"—the most fundamental human pursuit of escaping the familiar to dream of new worlds—is perceived in our contemporary lives.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 今回の展示会では、さまざまな空間で対面する個人的そして社会的な情緒を、作家の内面の流れに沿って展開した「心象風景」を通じて、未知の世界を具現化する3人の作家の作品を公開します。過去の時空間で記憶された情景が、その瞬間に感じた作家の微妙な感情と現在の内面意識が交錯し、夢幻的に再構成されることで、日常的な空間を未知の世界へと拡張し、日常の風景に詩的な共鳴を与えています。参加作家の絵画と写真で表現された内面的な風景を通して、馴染みのある空間を離れ、新しい世界を夢見る人間の最も本質的な追求価値である「境界からの解放(liberalization from restriction)」というテーマが、現代を生きる私たちにどのように認識されているのかを照らし出します。
desc_l10n.ko: 이번 전시는 다양한 공간에서 마주하게되는 개인적 그리고 사회적 정서를 작가의 내면의 흐름으로 전개한 심상 풍경을 통해 미지의 세계를 구현하는 작가 3인의 작품을 선보인다. 과거의 시공간에서 기억된 정경이 그 순간에 느꼈던 작가의 미묘한 감정과 현재의 내면 의식과 교차되어 몽환적으로 재구성되는데 일상적 공간을 미지의 세계로 확장시키며 일상적 풍경에 서정적 공명을 더한다. 참여 작가의 회화와 사진으로 표현된 내면 풍경을 통해 익숙한 공간에서 벗어나 새로운 세계를 꿈꾸는 인간의 가장 본질적 추구 가치인 '경계로 부터의 해방 (liberalization from restriction)' 이라는 주제가 동시대를 살아가는 우리에게 어떻게 인식되는지 조명한다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 此次展览展示了三位艺术家通过内在情感的流动，以寻常风景呈现个人和社会情感在各种空间中的邂逅，从而构建出未知的世界。过去时空中记忆中的景象与当时艺术家微妙的情感和当前的内在意识相交融，梦幻般地重新构建，将日常空间扩展为未知世界，为日常风景增添抒情的共鸣。通过参与艺术家的绘画和摄影表达的内在风景，展览探讨了人类在熟悉的空间中脱离，追求新的世界这一最本质的价值——“从束缚中解放（liberalization from restriction）”在我们生活的当代社会中如何被感知。
