desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Dilkusha, meaning "a joyful heart" in Persian, is the historical name given to the residence of Albert W. Taylor and Mary L. Taylor. The Taylor family commenced construction in 1923 and completed Dilkusha in 1924. Following a devastating fire in 1926, the structure was rebuilt in 1930. After the Japanese colonial authorities deported the Taylor couple in 1942, the property was briefly managed by Albert's younger brother, William W. Taylor. In 1959, the house was purchased by lawmaker Cho Kyeong-kyu of the Liberal Party. However, following the forfeiture of his assets to the state in 1963, ownership of Dilkusha transferred to the government. Left neglected for decades, the property severely deteriorated and lost its original form. In 2005, Professor Kim Ik-sang of Seoile University located the estate at the request of Albert’s son, Bruce T. Taylor. In 2006, Bruce finally returned to his childhood home after 66 years, bringing Dilkusha back to public prominence.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ディルクシャ(DILKUSHA)はペルシア語で「喜びの心」という意味で、アルバート・W・テイラーとメアリー・L・テイラー夫妻が暮らしていた家の名前です。テイラー夫妻は1923年に工事を始め、1924年にディルクシャを完成させました。1926年に火災が発生し、1930年に再建されました。1942年、日本当局によってテイラー夫妻は追放され、ディルクシャは弟のウィリアム・W・テイラーが一時的に管理していました。その後、1959年に自由党のチョ・ギョンギュ議員がディルクシャを買い取りましたが、1963年にチョ議員の財産が国に没収されたことで、ディルクシャも国の所有となりました。その後、ディルクシャは長い間放置され、本来の姿を失ってしまいました。そんな中、2005年にソイル大学校のキム・イクサン教授がアルバートの息子であるブルース・T・テイラーの依頼を受け、ディルクシャを捜し当てました。2006年、ブルースはついに66年ぶりに自分が子どもの頃に暮らしていたディルクシャを訪れ、こうしてディルクシャは再び人々の前に姿を現しました。
desc_l10n.ko: 딜쿠샤(DILKUSHA)는 페르시아어로 ‘기쁜 마음’이라는 뜻으로 앨버트 W. 테일러와 메리 L. 테일러 부부가 살던 집의 이름입니다. 테일러 부부는 1923년에 공사를 시작하여 1924년에 딜쿠샤를 완공하였습니다. 1926년에는 화재가 발생해 1930년에 재건되었습니다. 1942년 일제가 테일러 부부를 추방한 후 딜쿠샤는 동생 윌리엄 W. 테일러가 잠시 관리하였습니다. 이후 1959년에 자유당 조경규 의원이 딜쿠샤를 매입하였으나 1963년에 조경규 의원의 재산이 국가로 넘어가면서 딜쿠샤도 국가 소유가 되었습니다. 그 후로 딜쿠샤는 오랜 기간 방치되어 본모습을 잃게 되었습니다. 그러던 중 2005년에 서일대학교 김익상 교수가 앨버트의 아들인 브루스 T. 테일러의 의뢰를 받아 딜쿠샤를 찾아내었습니다. 2006년 브루스는 마침내 66년 만에 자신이 어린 시절에 살던 딜쿠샤를 방문하였고, 딜쿠샤는 그렇게 다시 세상에 알려지게 되었습니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} DILKUSHA一词源自波斯语，意为“愉悦之心”，这里曾是阿尔伯特・W・泰勒与玛丽・L・泰勒夫妇的居所。泰勒夫妇于1923年动工修建，1924年正式竣工。1926年宅邸遭遇火灾，之后于1930年完成重建。1942年，在日本帝国主义势力的逼迫下，泰勒夫妇遭到驱逐，此后宅邸暂由其弟弟威廉・W・泰勒代为管理。1959年，自由党议员赵景圭购入该建筑。1963年，赵景圭议员的财产被收归国有，DILKUSHA也随之成为国家资产。此后，宅邸长期无人打理，渐渐失去了原本的样貌。2005年，瑞逸大学的金益相教授受阿尔伯特之子布鲁斯・T・泰勒委托，找到了这座老宅。2006年，时隔66年，布鲁斯终于重返儿时居住过的DILKUSHA，这座建筑也再度重回大众视野。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Dilkusha, meaning "a joyful heart" in Persian, is the historical name given to the residence of Albert W. Taylor and Mary L. Taylor. The Taylor family commenced construction in 1923 and completed Dilkusha in 1924. Following a devastating fire in 1926, the structure was rebuilt in 1930. After the Japanese colonial authorities deported the Taylor couple in 1942, the property was briefly managed by Albert's younger brother, William W. Taylor. In 1959, the house was purchased by lawmaker Cho Kyeong-kyu of the Liberal Party. However, following the forfeiture of his assets to the state in 1963, ownership of Dilkusha transferred to the government. Left neglected for decades, the property severely deteriorated and lost its original form. In 2005, Professor Kim Ik-sang of Seoile University located the estate at the request of Albert’s son, Bruce T. Taylor. In 2006, Bruce finally returned to his childhood home after 66 years, bringing Dilkusha back to public prominence.
name: Dilkusha

desc_l10n.en: Character pop artist Lemar Kim and hop-funk artist Yakgwa present innovative works, seamlessly navigating between physical and digital mediums. Choreographer Kim Se-ryung and painter Hwang So-young also create their works with entirely different palettes and methods, focusing on canvas works. This exhibition, through collaborations across various arts like visual arts, digital art, and dance, creates a harmonious blend of seemingly incompatible works. Through the "NUMAZ WHOLESALE WEEK" exhibition, we invite you to experience the distinctive works and collaborations of NUMAZ members firsthand. The NUMAZ WHOLESALE WEEK exhibition will run until August 27th.
desc_l10n.ja: キャラクターポップアーティスト「LEMAR KIM」とホープパンクアーティスト「ヤックァ」、この2人の作家は、実物とデジタルメディアを行き来しながら独創的な作品を作り上げます。振付師「キム·セリョン」とペインター「ファン·ソヨン」も絵画を中心に全く違う色味と方法で作品を披露します。『NUMAZ WHOLESALE WEEK』展は、美術、デジタル、舞踊など様々なジャンルの芸術を組み合わせ、見たことない調和を作り出す展示です。ぜひ、作家たちの個性的な作品のコラボレーションをご覧ください。『NUMAZ WHOLESALE WEEK』展は、8月27日まで開催されます。
desc_l10n.ko: 캐릭터 팝아티스트 “르마킴”과 호프펑크 아티스트 "약과", 두 작가는 실물과 디지털 매체를 넘나들며 독창적인 작품을 선보입니다. 안무가 “김세령”과 페인터 ”황소영“ 또한 캔버스 작업을 중심으로 전혀 다른 색감과 방식으로 작품을 만들어 나갑니다. 이번 전시는 미술, 디지털, 무용 등 다양한 예술들의 조합으로 서로의 협업을 통해 어울리지 않을 것 같은 작업의 조화로움을 만들어냅니다. “NUMAZ WHOLESALE WEEK” 展을 통해 뉴마즈의 맴버들의 개성 있는 작품과 협업을 직접 감상하시기 바랍니다. NUMAZ WHOLESALE WEEK 展은 오는 8월 27일까지 진행됩니다.
desc_l10n.zh: 卡通形象流行艺术家LemarKim和朋克艺术家药果两位作家创造了在实物和数码之间跳转的独创性作品，编舞家Kim Seryung和画家Hwang Soyoung通过画布展现了不同色彩和方式的作品。此次展览由美术、数码、舞蹈等各种艺术组合而成，创造出不搭配却又和谐的展览。请通过“NUMAZ WHOLESALE WEEK” 欣赏NUMAZ成员们充满个性的合作作品， NUMAZ WHOLESALE WEEK 展将截止8月27日展出。

desc_l10n.en: The special exhibition " Sketching Heart's Delight " at Dilkusha is a collaborative project with Urban Sketchers Seoul, consisting of four themes: 'The Red Brick House in Eunhaengnamugol, Dilkusha' capturing Dilkusha's exterior, 'Golden Bouquet Illuminating Dilkusha' featuring the symbolic ginkgo tree, 'The Colors of Joy' depicting the living rooms on the first and second floors of Dilkusha, and 'Dilkusha, Home of an Independence Activist' portraying Albert's independence activities. For this exhibition, Dilkusha held 'Dilkusha Day' three times last year, and 64 out of 176 drawings of either the interior, exterior, or meaning of Dilkusha submitted by 122 Urban Sketchers Seoul members who were invited to Dilkusha through pre-registration are on display. In addition, there is a video space showcasing 'Dilkusha Day' moments, an area displaying sketchers' art supplies, and an experience space ca lled 'My Drawing of Dilkusha' with paper and art supplies prepared for visitors to participate in the exhibition by drawing Dilkusha themselves.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ディルクシャの企画展<喜びの心>はアーバンスケッチャーズソウル(Urban Sketchers Seoul)とコラボした企画展で、ディルクシャの外観を盛り込んだ「ウンヘンナムゴル赤いレンガ造りの家、ディルクシャ」、ディルクシャの象徴である銀杏を素材にした「ディルクシャを輝かせた黄金色の花束」、ディルクシャの1・2階のリビングを描いた「喜びの心の色」、アルバートの独立活動を盛り込んだ「ディルクシャ、ある独立運動家の家」など、計4テーマで構成されています。 今回の展示のために、ディルクシャは昨年3回にわたって「ディルクシャデー」を開催し、事前申請を通じてディルクシャに招待されたアーバンスケッチャーズソウルの会員122人が直接描いて提出したディルクシャ内外部または意味が込められた絵176点のうち64点が展示されました。 その他にも「ディルクシャデー」の様子を収めた映像とスケッチャーズの画材を展示した空間、観覧客の方々が直接ディルクシャを描いて展示に参加できるように紙と画材が用意された「私が描くディルクシャ」体験空間も設けられています。
desc_l10n.ko: 딜쿠샤의 기획전 <기쁜 마음을 그리다>는 어반 스케쳐스 서울(Urban Sketchers Seoul)과 협업한 기획전으로, 딜쿠샤의 외관을 담은 ‘은행나무골 붉은 벽돌집, 딜쿠샤’, 딜쿠샤의 상징 은행나무를 소재로 삼은 ‘딜쿠샤를 빛낸 황금빛 꽃다발’, 딜쿠샤 1․2층 거실을 그린 ‘기쁜 마음의 빛깔’, 앨버트의 독립 활동을 담은 ‘딜쿠샤, 어느 독립운동가의 집’ 총 4가지의 주제로 구성되었습니다. 이번 전시를 위해 딜쿠샤는 지난해 세 차례에 걸쳐 '딜쿠샤 데이'를 개최하였고, 사전 신청을 통해 딜쿠샤에 초대된 어반 스케쳐스 서울 회원 122명이 직접 그려 제출한 딜쿠샤 내․외부 또는 의미를 담은 그림 176점 중 64점이 전시되었습니다. 이외에도 '딜쿠샤 데이'의 모습을 담은 영상과 스케쳐스의 화구를 전시한 공간, 관람객분들께서 직접 딜쿠샤를 그려 전시에 참여할 수 있도록 종이와 화구가 준비된 '내가 그리는 딜쿠샤' 체험 공간도 마련되어 있습니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 迪尔库沙（Dilkusha）企划展《描绘喜悦心情》是与首尔城市速写者（Urban Sketchers Seoul）合作的企划展，它由包含迪尔库沙（Dilkusha）外观的“银杏树谷红砖房，迪尔库沙（Dilkusha）”、以迪尔库沙（Dilkusha）的象征银杏树为素材的“闪耀迪尔库沙（Dilkusha）的黄金花束”、描绘迪尔库沙（Dilkusha）一楼和二楼卧室的“喜悦心情颜色”、包括阿尔伯特独立活动的“迪尔库沙（Dilkusha），独立运动家之家”共4个主题构成。 为了这次展览，迪尔库沙（Dilkusha）在去年举办了三次“迪尔库沙（Dilkusha）日”，展出了经过事前申请，被邀请到迪尔库沙（Dilkusha）的122名首尔城市速写者（Urban Sketchers Seoul）会员亲自绘制并提交的迪尔库沙（Dilkusha）内外部或意义深远的176幅画作中的64幅。 除此之外，还准备了展现“迪尔库沙（Dilkusha）日”样子的视频和素描工具的展览空间，为了能让游客们亲自参与绘制展览迪尔库沙（Dilkusha），还设置了备有纸张和画具的“我绘制的迪尔库沙（Dilkusha）”体验空间。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Superior Gallery presents the Warm & Cool ART Collection exhibition by artists Kwon Kyung-yeop, Kim In, and Brian Kims, who communicate with cold reason and warm sensibility. In his works, Kwon Kyung-yeop conveys healing experiences and hopes for life, portraying the relationship between humans and animals and harmony with nature. Artist Kim In creates cheerful images by repeating and rhythmically arranging familiar images in a new combination. Meanwhile, artist Brian Kims expresses emotions and thoughts through over 100 characters depicting various appearances and behaviors. Experience the Warm & Cool artworks brimming with new discoveries and pure emotions at Superior Gallery. The Warm & Cool ART Collection exhibition is until May 27th.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Superior Galleryは、冷たい理性と温かい感性でコミュニケーションする作家クォン・ギョンヨプ、キム・イン、ブライアン・キムスの『Warm & Cool ART Collection』展を開催します。クォン・ギョンヨプは、治癒の経験と人生の希望を伝え、人間と動物の間の絆、自然との調和を作品に盛り込みます。キム·インは、作品のイメージを繰り返しリズム感を与えると同時に、見慣れたイメージを新たに結合させて軽快なイメージを構成します。ブライアン・キムスは、それぞれ異なる外形と行動を描写する100余りのキャラクターを通じて感情と考えを表現します。 新しい発見と純粋な感動に満ちたWarm&Coolの作品をSuperior Galleryで感じてみてください。『Warm & Cool ART Collection』展は5月27日まで開催します。

[Warm & Cool ART Collection] 전시는 5월 27일까지 진행됩니다.

desc_l10n.ko: 이번 전시 《ICON: The Chair Series》는 권영술이 구축해 온 회화 세계를 집약적으로 보여줍니다. 의자의 내부에는 도시와 건축, 음악과 풍경, 인간의 흔적과 자연의 형상이 뒤섞여 있습니다. 서로 다른 이미지들은 꿈속의 장면처럼 자유롭게 떠다니지만 하나의 유기적 질서 안에서 연결됩니다. 과거의 기억과 현재의 감각, 미래의 상상은 한 화면 안에서 공존하며, 관람자는 의자라는 형상을 따라 시간의 여러 층위를 경험하게 됩니다.

desc_l10n.en: In celebration of the 10th anniversary of its opening, the Seoul Museum of Art presents an exhibition titled "SeMA Anthology: Ten Orders," featuring ten artists who envision new landscapes transcending the past and future. Rather than organizing the present through an archival listing of the Seoul Museum of Art's trajectory, this exhibition attempts to actively sense the coming time by focusing on imagination as an active, creative act that connects the past and the future. To explore how the formal and thematic essence of imagination connects with art, the exhibition examines the unique grammar inherent in the language of imagination and replaces it with the particularity embedded in contemporary artworks. This will serve as a kind of aesthetic exploration and creative experiment about how our present embraces the past, anticipates the future, and pioneers the constantly emerging unknown world.
desc_l10n.ja: ソウル市立北ソウル美術館は開館10周年を記念し、10人の作家とともに過去と未来を行き来しながら新しい風景を想像する展示『SeMAアンソロジー:10の注文』を開催します。この展示では、北ソウル美術館の今までの軌跡をアーカイブ形式に辿る展示ではなく、近づいてくる時間を能動的に感じるという試みの中で、過去と未来をつなぐ積極的な創造行為の「想像」に注目する展示です。想像の形式や主題的本質がどのように芸術とつながるかを探求するため、言語が持つ特有の文法を同時代の芸術作品に内在した展示になっています。これは私たちの現在がどのように過去を受け入れ、未来を迎え、刻々と訪れる未知の世界をどのように開拓していくのかに対する一種の美学的探索であり創作実験の展示となるでしょう。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울시립 북서울미술관은 개관 10주년을 기념하여 열 명의 작가와 함께 과거와 미래를 넘나드는 새로운 풍경을 상상하는 전시 ≪SeMA 앤솔러지: 열 개의 주문≫을 선보입니다. 이 전시는 북서울미술관이 지나온 궤적의 아카이브적 나열을 통해 현재를 정비하기보다는, 다가오는 시간을 능동적으로 감각하려는 시도속에 과거와 미래를 연결하는 적극적인 창조 행위로서 '상상'에 주목합니다. 상상의 형식적, 주제적 본질이 어떻게 예술과 연결되는지를 탐구하고자, 전시는 상상하는 언어가 지닌 특유의 문법을 동시대 예술 작품에 내재한 특수성으로 치환하여 살펴봅니다. 이것은 우리의 현재가 어떻게 과거를 끌어안고, 미래를 맞이하며, 시시각각 도래하는 미지의 세계를 함꼐 개척해나갈 것인지에 대한 일종의 미학적 탐색이자 창작 실험이 될 것입니다.
desc_l10n.zh: 首尔市立美术馆为纪念开馆10周年，邀请了10名作家共同办展回想过去和展望未来的展览《SeMA Anthology: 十个订单》。本次展览比起通过北首尔美术馆的足迹存档组织现在，而是将"想象力"作为一种积极的创造性行为，连接过去和未来，试图积极感知即将到来的时代。为了探索想象的形式和主题本质如何与艺术联系起来，展览通过当代艺术作品固有的特殊性替代审视想象语言的独特语法。这将是一种关于我们的现在和如何拥抱过去、迎接未来、共同探索每时每刻正在涌现的未知世界的美学探索和创意试验。

desc_l10n.en: From August 10 to 12, 2023, for 3 days, the 2023 Korea lnt’l EDUCATION WEEK will be held on the 1st floor, Hall A of COEX mall. The expo is organized by the Korean Association of Elementary, Middle, and High School Principals, the Korean Association of Middle School Principals, and the E Korea lnt’l EDUCATION WEEK Organizing Committee. Hosted by Global Biz Market and co-hosted by the Korea Smart Edutech Cooperative Association, the education-specific exhibition will hold an education professional workshop and conference on the topics of presenting the direction of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Edutech education and practical applications in actual classrooms, together with education experts/organizations and AI specialists.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 《Promise (Where Being Be)》 presents the concept of mutual coexistence beyond linguistic meaning, recalling the interconnected solidarity of nature that has traversed time and space long before civilization. Just as the origins of the words promise and bind are intertwined, beings have long been entangled like threads and have existed together through vast stretches of time. The exhibition consists of five subthemes Lucy, Warning Bell, Microcosm, Subtle Name, and Natural State Beyond Boundaries, along with an archive that surveys the artist’s major body of work. By summoning the long timeline shared by early humans and ourselves, the exhibition reveals the responsibility humanity must bear for the destruction of nature and life, evoking the possibility of coexistence through bleached coral, life in the Demilitarized Zone, and disappearing wildflowers, and leading toward the path of ecological solidarity proposed by the artist. Amid rapidly changing global environments, 《Jae-Eun Choi : Promise (Where Being Be)》 asks what kind of life we should aspire to.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 《約束(Where Beings Be)》」は、「共生之約」という作家の表現のように、言語的な意味を超え、文明以前から時空を貫通してきた自然の相互連帯性を再確認させる概念として提示されます。「約」と「束」の語源が結ばれている形であるように、悠久な時間の中で存在(Beings)は文字どおり糸のように複雑に絡み合いながら、共に在り続けてきました。 本展示は、「ルーシー」、「警鐘」、「小宇宙」、「微名」、「自然国家：境界を越えて」という小テーマで構成され、同時に作家の主要作品世界を眺望できるアーカイブが共に提示されます。最初の人類と現在の私たちが共有してきた長い時間の軸を召喚し、自然と生命の破壊に人間が耐えなければならない責任を表わす展示は、白化した珊瑚とDMZの生命、そして消滅する野花を通じて共生の可能性を喚起させ、作家が提案する生態的連帯の道につながります。急変する地球環境の中で、《チェ・ジェウン：約束》は、私たちがどのような生き方を目指すべきかを問い返します。
desc_l10n.ko: 《약속(Where Beings Be)》은 ‘공생지약(共生之約)’이라는 작가의 표현처럼, 언어적인 의미를 넘어 문명 훨씬 이전부터 시공을 관통해 온 자연의 상호 연대성을 되새기게 하는 개념으로 제시됩니다. ‘약(約)’과 ‘속(束)’의 기원이 묶여 있는 형상이듯, 유구한 시간 속에서 존재들(Beings)은 말 그대로 실타래처럼 얼기설기 엮여 다 같이 자리해 왔습니다. 본 전시는 ‘루시’, ‘경종(警鐘)’, ‘소우주’, ‘미명(微名)’, ‘자연국가: 경계를 넘어’라는 소주제로 구성되며, 더불어 작가의 주요 작품세계를 조망할 수 있는 아카이브가 함께 제시됩니다. 최초의 인류와 현재의 우리가 공유해 온 긴 시간의 축을 소환하며 자연과 생명의 파괴에 인간이 감내해야 할 책임을 드러내는 전시는 백화된 산호와 DMZ의 생명들, 그리고 소멸하는 들꽃을 통해 공생의 가능성을 환기시키며 작가가 제안하는 생태적 연대의 길로 이어집니다. 급변하는 지구 환경 속에서 《최재은: 약속》은 우리가 어떠한 삶을 지향할지를 되묻습니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 《约定（Where Beings Be）》正如艺术家所表述的“共生之约”一般，被呈现为一个跨越语言意义、让人重新思考文明出现之前便已贯穿时空的自然相互连带性的概念。正如“约”与“束”的起源字形本就交织相连一样，在漫长的时间长河中，万物（Beings）确实如同线团般彼此交织、共同延续。 本次展览由“露西”、“警钟”、“小宇宙”、“微名”、“自然国家：跨越边界”等小主题构成，一同呈现了能够纵览艺术家主要作品世界的档案资料。这场展览召唤着从最初的人类到当下的我们所共享的漫长时光轴，揭示了人类对自然和生命破坏所应承担的责任。它通过白化的珊瑚、DMZ的生命，以及逐渐消失的野花，唤醒人们对共生可能性的探索，并引领观众走向艺术家提出的生态连带之路。在急剧变化的地球环境中，《崔在恩：约定（Where Beings Be）》向我们提出应追求何种生活的疑问。

desc_l10n.ko: 경복궁에 서쪽에 있는 마을로, 조선시대에 역관이나 의원 등 중인 계급이 많이 모여 살았던 동네입니다. 오랫동안 골목을 지켜온 낡은 상점들과 한옥집, 그리고 새로 생겨난 가게들의 조화로 특유의 정겨움과 소박함을 느낄 수 있습니다. 최근에는 다양한 팝업스토어가 서촌한옥마을에서 열리기도 하며, 한옥마을의 분위기에 맞춰 꾸며진 여러 맛집과 카페들이 즐비합니다.

desc_l10n.en: Alchemy of Souls: Light and Shadow Immersive Media Art Exhibition, based on the original drama of the same name, will be held at Gallery Gwanghwa from June 15th to October 15th. The exhibition reimagines ten major themes from the drama, including the main storyline and the characters Jung Jin Gak and Jin Yo Won, through media art that provides an interactive space for visitors. In this exhibition, various themed experiential scenarios, including the world of the drama "Alchemy of Souls" in the country of Daeho, and the four seasons of the world in Daeho, are arranged to allow visitors to experience the universe of "Alchemy of Souls” directly. Using holograms, projection mapping, and media art that utilize light and graphics, the exhibition conveys a dreamlike and elegant depiction of Daeho, the world of "Alchemy of Souls," and the fusion of souls. It creates a sensation of being the protagonist simply by standing there, immersing visitors in the experience. When purchasing a ticket, you will receive a barcode that can be used in the exhibition hall. After the viewing, you can scan the barcode in the kiosk to check the contents you have experienced.
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国ドラマ『還魂』をテーマにしたメディアアート展示『幻魂:光と影』がGallery Gwanghwaで6月15日から開催されます。ドラマの主要な物語とドラマの元となるチョン·ジンガク、チン·ヨウォンをはじめとする10余りの主要テーマをメディアアートで再現し、観覧客が楽しめる展示空間をお届けします。 韓国ドラマ『還魂』の世界観、天下四季-大護国の四季など、10以上のテーマ別体験シナリオを通じて『還魂』の世界観を体験できます。ホログラム、プロジェクションマッピング演出、光とグラフィックを活用したメディアアートで夢幻的で優雅な大護国と幻魂術を表現し、そこに立っているだけでドラマの主人公になったような気持ちにさせてくれます。 入場券を購入すると、展示場で使えるバーコードが届きます。観覧終了後にキオスクでバーコードをかざすと体験したコンテンツを確認できます。

desc_l10n.zh: 以同名原著电视剧为主题的沉浸式媒体艺术展《还魂:光与影沉浸式媒体艺术展》将于6月15日至10月15日在Gallery Gwanghwa举行。 此次展览将电视剧中主要故事和其背景的Jeong Jingak、Jin Yowon 等10多个主要主题重新诠释为媒体艺术，为参观者提供体验空间。 在本次展览中，通过大湖国-电视剧《还魂》的世界观、天下四界-大湖国的四季等10余个主题的体验剧本，可以亲身体验还魂的世界观。 全息图、投影映射表演、利用光和图像的媒体艺术表现梦幻优雅的大湖国和还魂术，只是站在那里就有成为主人公的感觉。 如果购买门票，可以获得在展厅使用的条形码，观展结束后可以在自主服务机上识别条形码确认体验过的内容。

description: Alchemy of Souls: Light and Shadow Immersive Media Art Exhibition, based on the original drama of the same name, will be held at Gallery Gwanghwa from June 15th to October 15th. The exhibition reimagines ten major themes from the drama, including the main storyline and the characters Jung Jin Gak and Jin Yo Won, through media art that provides an interactive space for visitors. In this exhibition, various themed experiential scenarios, including the world of the drama "Alchemy of Souls" in the country of Daeho, and the four seasons of the world in Daeho, are arranged to allow visitors to experience the universe of "Alchemy of Souls” directly. Using holograms, projection mapping, and media art that utilize light and graphics, the exhibition conveys a dreamlike and elegant depiction of Daeho, the world of "Alchemy of Souls," and the fusion of souls. It creates a sensation of being the protagonist simply by standing there, immersing visitors in the experience. When purchasing a ticket, you will receive a barcode that can be used in the exhibition hall. After the viewing, you can scan the barcode in the kiosk to check the contents you have experienced.
name: Alchemy of Souls: Light and Shadow Immersive Media Art Exhibition

It is a space that unravels the philosophy of travel and the creative heritage that the Maison has continued for over 170 years into a single narrative. The story, starting from trunk production in 1854, introduces the journey of Louis Vuitton's development into a global cultural house through thematic spaces. Following the exhibition route leading from the 5th floor down to the 4th floor, the narrative of Louis Vuitton's creation and travel unfolds naturally. The exhibition consists of a total of 12 spaces, unfolding the brand's history starting with trunks, the origin of the monogram, the artisan's workshop, the evolution of iconic bags, and Louis Vuitton's cultural narrative expanded through art and design collaborations, music, and fashion, just like a single journey.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ルイ・ヴィトン ヴィジョナリー・ジャーニー・ソウル(Louis Vuitton Visionary Journeys Seoul)は、ルイ・ヴィトンの旅と職人精神、ヘリテージを体験する文化的な旅であり、ブランドの遺産に光を当てる没入型の展示です。 170年以上にわたり受け継がれてきたメゾンの旅の哲学と創造的な遺産が一つの物語として紡がれる空間。1854年のトランク製作から始まった物語は、ルイ・ヴィトンがグローバルなカルチャーハウスへと発展してきた過程をテーマ別の空間で紹介しています。5階から4階へと続く展示動線に沿って、ルイ・ヴィトンの創造と旅の物語が自然に展開します。 展示は全12の空間で構成され、トランクから始まったブランドの歴史やモノグラムの起源、職人の工房とアイコンバッグの進化、そして芸術・デザインのコラボレーションや音楽、ファッションへと拡張されたルイ・ヴィトンの文化的軌跡を、一つの旅のように描き出します。
desc_l10n.ko: ‘루이 비통 비저너리 저니 서울(Louis Vuitton Visionary Journeys Seoul)’은 루이 비통의 여행과 장인 정신, 헤리티지를 경험하는 문화적 여정으로, 브랜드의 유산을 조명하는 몰입형 전시입니다. 메종이 170여 년 동안 이어온 여행의 철학과 창조적 유산을 하나의 서사로 풀어낸 공간이다. 1854년 트렁크 제작에서 출발한 이야기는 루이 비통이 글로벌 문화 하우스로 발전해온 여정을 주제별 공간으로 소개한다. 5층에서 4층으로 이어지는 전시 동선을 따라 루이 비통의 창조와 여행의 서사가 자연스럽게 펼쳐집니다. 전시는 총 12개의 공간으로 구성되어, 트렁크로 시작한 브랜드의 역사와 모노그램 기원, 장인의 공방과 아이콘 백의 진화, 그리고 예술·디자인 협업과 음악, 패션으로 확장된 루이 비통의 문화적 서사를 하나의 여정처럼 펼쳐 보입니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} “Louis Vuitton Visionary Journeys Seoul”是一场感受路易威登旅行哲学、匠人精神与品牌传承的文化盛宴，通过沉浸式展览的形式，深度展现品牌的历史底蕴。 该空间以一条完整的叙事主线，呈现了路易威登170多年来传承至今的旅行哲学和创意遗产。从1854年皮箱制作起步的故事，通过一个个主题空间，讲述了路易威登如何发展成为全球文化品牌的历程。参观者沿着从5层通往4层的展览动线，便可自然而然地感受到路易威登关于创造和旅行的叙事。 展览共由12个展区组成，如同一段完整旅程，依次呈现路易威登以皮箱为起点的品牌历史、经典字母组合图案的起源、匠人工坊与标志性手袋的演变，以及延伸至艺术设计联名、音乐与时尚领域的品牌文化内容。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Those who dive deep underwater know how to move toward the light. Space K Seoul, Kolon’s cultural and artistic sharing space, hosts the solo exhibition 《Deep Diver》 by Bae Yun Hwan (b. 1983). The artist peels away the familiar layers of light and guides us into the achromatic world of black. That darkness is not emptiness, but rather a space of dense contemplation. His work abandons color and even minimizes form, forcing the gaze inward, deeper and deeper. Just as a diver holds their breath and enters stillness, viewers are invited to halt their thoughts before the canvas, open their senses, and confront its depth. Bae Yun Hwan is an artist who begins with personal experiences and expands his vision to global issues. In his creative process, he unravels not only individual anguish but also the disintegration of communities and the signs of the times such as disasters and wars, expressed through his own allegorical techniques, thereby leading contemporary painting. This exhibition unfolds his narratives more broadly and deeply through works across various genres, including painting, drawing, installation, and video.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 水中に深く潜る人は、光に向かって進む方法を知っている。 コーロンの文化芸術分かち合い空間であるスペースKソウルは、ペ・ユンファン(b.1983)の個展《ディープダイバー(Deep Diver)》を開催します。ペ・ユンファンは見慣れた光の層を取り除き、黒という無彩色の世界へ私たちを案内します。その闇は空虚ではなく、濃密な思惟の空間です。作家の作業は色を捨て、形さえ最小化したまま視線を中に、さらに中に押し込みます。まるでダイバーが息を止めて静けさの中に入るように、観覧者は画面の前で思考を止め、感覚を開いたままその深さに向き合うことになります。 ペ・ユンファンは自分の経験から出発し、地球規模のイシューへと視線を広げてきた作家です。創作過程で直面した個人の苦悩はもちろん、共同体の解体、災害や戦争のような時代の兆候を自分だけの寓話的技法で表現し、同時代の絵画を導いてきました。今回の展示では、絵画、ドローイング、設置、映像などさまざまなジャンルの作品を通じて、その叙事をさらに広く深く繰り広げます。
desc_l10n.ko: 물속으로 깊이 잠수하는 이는 빛을 향해 나아가는 법을 안다. 코오롱의 문화예술 나눔공간 스페이스K 서울은 배윤환(b. 1983)의 개인전 《딥다이버(Deep Diver)》를 개최합니다. 배윤환은 익숙한 빛의 층을 걷어내고, 검정이라는 무채색의 세계로 우리를 안내합니다. 그 어둠은 공허가 아니라, 농밀한 사유의 공간입니다. 작가의 작업은 색을 버리고, 형태마저 최소화한 채 시선을 안으로, 더 안으로 밀어 넣습니다. 마치 잠수자가 숨을 참고 고요 속으로 들어가듯, 관람자는 화면 앞에서 사고를 멈추고 감각을 연 채 그 깊이를 마주하게 됩니다. 배윤환은 자신의 경험에서 출발해 전 지구적 이슈로 시선을 확장해 온 작가입니다. 창작 과정에서 마주한 개인의 고뇌는 물론, 공동체의 해체, 재난과 전쟁 같은 시대의 징후들을 자신만의 우화적 기법으로 풀어내며 동시대 회화를 이끌어 왔습니다. 이번 전시에서는 회화, 드로잉, 설치, 영상 등 다양한 장르의 작품을 통해 그 서사를 더욱 넓고 깊게 펼쳐 보입니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Where you can directly encounter original paintings by European masters such as Rembrandt, Goya, Jacques-Louis David, and Turner, will be held at the ALT.1 Museum in The Hyundai Seoul from March 21 to July 4, 2026. This exhibition is a large-scale classic painting exhibition that carefully selects and presents over 50 paintings by masters who led the flow of Western art history from the mid-16th century to the mid-19th century, among the representative collections of the Toledo Museum of Art located in Ohio, USA. You can observe in one place the works that formed major turning points in the history of European painting, from the post-Renaissance period to Baroque, Rococo, Neoclassicism, and Romanticism. The exhibition is composed of a total of 6 sections, structured so that visitors can also examine the social and cultural roles that painting has played within the history of European art. Visitors can broadly experience not only the pictorial perfection of the works but also the historical background, philosophical context, patronage structures, and the flow of the art market contained within them. This exhibition, which introduces the European painting collection of the Toledo Museum of Art with a history of over 100 years to Korea, is expected to be a special opportunity to directly verify the flow of Western art history and the artistic achievements of the masters as a blockbuster exhibition centered on original paintings.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} レンブラント、ゴヤ、ジャック＝ルイ・ダヴィッド、ウィリアム・ターナーなどヨーロッパ絵画の巨匠たちの原画を直接鑑賞できる〈レンブラントからゴヤまで：トレド美術館名作展〉が、2026年3月21日から7月4日まで、The Hyundai Seoul ALT.1美術館で開催されます。 本展は、米国オハイオ州に位置するトレド美術館(Toledo Museum of Art)の代表的な所蔵品の中から、16世紀中頃から19世紀中頃にかけて西洋美術史の流れを牽引した巨匠たちの絵画約50点を厳選して展示する大規模なクラシック絵画展です。ルネサンス以降、バロック、ロココ、新古典主義、ロマン主義に至るまで、ヨーロッパ絵画史の主な転換点を形成した作品を一箇所で鑑賞することができます。 本展は6つのセクションで構成されており、絵画がヨーロッパ美術史の中で果たしてきた社会的、文化的役割を共に考察できるように構成されています。観覧客は、作品の絵画的完成度のみならず、その背景にある時代精神や哲学的文脈、後援構造、さらには芸術市場の流れまで幅広く体験することができます。 100年以上の歴史を誇るトレド美術館のヨーロッパ絵画コレクションを韓国で紹介する本覧は、原画中心のブロックバスター展として、西洋美術史の流れと巨匠たちの芸術的成果を直接確認できる特特別な機会となることが期待されます。
desc_l10n.ko: 렘브란트, 고야, 자크 루이 다비드, 터너 등 유럽 회화 거장들의 원화를 직접 만나볼 수 있는 〈렘브란트에서 고야까지 : 톨레도 미술관 명작展〉이 2026년 3월 21일부터 7월 4일까지 더현대 서울 ALT.1 미술관에서 개최됩니다. 본 전시는 미국 오하이오주에 위치한 톨레도 미술관(Toledo Museum of Art)의 대표 소장품 가운데, 16세기 중반부터 19세기 중반까지 서양 미술사의 흐름을 이끌어온 거장들의 회화 50여 점을 엄선하여 선보이는 대규모 클래식 회화전입니다. 르네상스 이후 바로크, 로코코, 신고전주의, 낭만주의에 이르기까지 유럽 회화사의 주요 변곡점을 형성한 작품들을 한자리에서 조망할 수 있습니다. 전시는 총 6개의 섹션으로 구성되며, 이번 전시는 회화가 유럽 미술사 안에서 수행해온 사회적,문화적 역할을 함께 살펴볼 수 있도록 구성되었습니다. 관람객은 작품의 회화적 완성도뿐만 아니라 그 안에 담긴 시대적 배경, 철학적 맥락, 후원 구조, 예술 시장의 흐름까지 폭넓게 경험할 수 있습니다. 100년이 넘는 역사를 지닌 톨레도 미술관의 유럽 회화 컬렉션을 국내에서 소개하는 이번 전시는, 원화 중심의 블록버스터 전시로서 서양미술사의 흐름과 거장들의 예술적 성취를 직접 확인할 수 있는 특별한 자리가 될 것으로 기대됩니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 《从伦勃朗到戈雅：托莱多美术馆名作展》将于2026年3月21日至7月4日，在首尔现代ALT.1美术馆开展。本次展览可近距离欣赏伦勃朗、戈雅、雅克-路易·大卫、透纳等欧洲绘画大师的原作作品。 本次大型古典绘画展，精选美国俄亥俄州托莱多美术馆的典藏佳作，展出50余幅16世纪中叶至19世纪中叶时期，引领西方美术发展脉络的艺术大师画作。展览汇聚了文艺复兴之后，历经巴洛克、洛可可、新古典主义、浪漫主义等不同流派的经典作品，可全面了解欧洲绘画史上各大重要发展阶段。 展览共分为6个展区，整体布局还将带领观众一同探寻绘画在欧洲美术史上承载的社会和文化价值。参观者不仅能领略画作精湛的艺术水准，还可深入感受作品背后的时代背景、哲学脉络、赞助体系及艺术市场的发展趋势。 本次展览将拥有百年以上历史的托莱多美术馆欧洲绘画藏品引进韩国，是以原作展品为核心的重磅大展。有望成为近距离领略西方美术发展脉络、感受艺术大师艺术成就的难得契机。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Where you can directly encounter original paintings by European masters such as Rembrandt, Goya, Jacques-Louis David, and Turner, will be held at the ALT.1 Museum in The Hyundai Seoul from March 21 to July 4, 2026. This exhibition is a large-scale classic painting exhibition that carefully selects and presents over 50 paintings by masters who led the flow of Western art history from the mid-16th century to the mid-19th century, among the representative collections of the Toledo Museum of Art located in Ohio, USA. You can observe in one place the works that formed major turning points in the history of European painting, from the post-Renaissance period to Baroque, Rococo, Neoclassicism, and Romanticism. The exhibition is composed of a total of 6 sections, structured so that visitors can also examine the social and cultural roles that painting has played within the history of European art. Visitors can broadly experience not only the pictorial perfection of the works but also the historical background, philosophical context, patronage structures, and the flow of the art market contained within them. This exhibition, which introduces the European painting collection of the Toledo Museum of Art with a history of over 100 years to Korea, is expected to be a special opportunity to directly verify the flow of Western art history and the artistic achievements of the masters as a blockbuster exhibition centered on original paintings.
name: Rembrandt to Goya, Master of European Painting from the Toledo Museum of Art

desc_l10n.ko: 북한인권세계대회에서는 남북의 음악 교류를 통한 특별한 공연이 진행됩니다. 남과 북의 음악인들이 함께 어우러짐으로써 화합과 이해의 가능성을 보여주며, 세대를 아우르는 무대를 통해 희망, 자유, 인권의 가치를 음악적 메세지로 관객에게 전달될 것입니다. 본 공연은 문화 교류의 장을 마련함과 동시에, 예술이 인권 증진과 한반도 통일의 가치를 드러내는 힘을 지녔음을 보여줄 것입니다.

Haechi, the symbol of Seoul, is an animal of 'justice and integrity' that distinguishes good from evil, and a sacred, imaginary animal that protects 'safety' by warding off disasters and brings 'luck and happiness.' On the 53-meter media wall (video window) stretching along the path from the King Sejong Statue in Gwanghwamun Square to Haechi Madang, you can experience media art exhibitions.

desc_l10n.ko: 광화문광장 해치마당은 광화문역과 광화문광장을 연결하고, 휴식과 만남의 장소가 되는 곳입니다. 서울의 상징 해치는 선악을 가리는 '정의와 청렴'의 동물이며, 재앙을 물리쳐 '안전'을 지켜주고, '복과 행복'을 가져다주는 신령스러운 상상의 동물입니다. 광화문광장 세종대왕동상에서 해치마당으로 이어지는 길목에 펼쳐진 53m의 미디어월(영상창)에는 미디어아트 전시를 만나 볼 수 있습니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Highly recommended for these individuals! -Tourists who want to experience the depth of Korean culture beyond K-pop. -Couples/friends/family travelers who want to make a night in Seoul special. -Those who previously found traditional Korean music difficult but are looking for a 'fun' introductory performance. Performance Introduction 〈Mixed Orchestra 26〉 is a performance that preserves the roots of traditional Korean music while boldly expanding it with contemporary sensibilities. Over the rich scale of a Korean traditional music orchestra, the piri and gayageum clearly draw the textures of tradition, and beatboxing adds rhythm and energy, completing an attractive sound where tradition and modernity coexist. This performance is a stage where you can encounter the elaborate melodies, improvisation, and deep emotions of Korean music all in one place. Beyond the familiar travel courses, it will be a live experience that will make you remember the night in Seoul in the most Korean way.

desc_l10n.ko: 이런 분께 추천해요! - K-pop을 넘어 한국 문화의 깊이를 경험하고 싶은 관광객 - 서울에서 하루 밤을 특별하게 만들고 싶은 커플/친구/가족 여행객 - 한국 전통음악이 어렵게 느껴졌지만 ‘재밌게’ 입문할 공연을 찾는 분 공연 소개 〈믹스드 오케스트라 26〉는 한국 전통음악의 뿌리를 지키면서도, 지금의 감각으로 과감하게 확장해 나가는 공연입니다. 국악관현악의 풍성한 스케일 위에 피리와 가야금이 전통의 결을 선명하게 그려내고, 비트박스가 리듬과 에너지를 더해 전통과 현대가 공존하는 매력적인 사운드를 완성합니다. 이번 공연은 한국 음악이 지닌 정교한 선율과 즉흥성, 깊은 정서를 한 자리에서 만날 수 있는 무대입니다. 익숙한 여행 코스 너머, 서울의 밤을 가장 한국답게 기억하게 해줄 라이브 경험이 될 것입니다.

Performance Introduction 〈Mixed Orchestra 26〉 is a performance that preserves the roots of traditional Korean music while boldly expanding it with contemporary sensibilities. Over the rich scale of a Korean traditional music orchestra, the piri and gayageum clearly draw the textures of tradition, and beatboxing adds rhythm and energy, completing an attractive sound where tradition and modernity coexist. This performance is a stage where you can encounter the elaborate melodies, improvisation, and deep emotions of Korean music all in one place. Beyond the familiar travel courses, it will be a live experience that will make you remember the night in Seoul in the most Korean way.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The story of Kim Young-sik, a master potter recognized as an intangible cultural heritage of Gyeongsangbuk-do, traces back to the Joseon Dynasty. According to Hajae Diary, written by Ji Kyushik, an official supplier of various wares to the royal court and government offices, Kim’s great-grandfather, Kim Bi-an, constructed a Mangdaengi kiln in 1903, confirming Kim’s lineage as a descendant of royal porcelain artisans. For nearly 300 years, the family has upheld the tradition of Joseon white porcelain, and Kim Young-sik, as the eighth-generation master, brings a unique artistic "persistence" to his craft. The “Persistence of Self” exhibition showcases Kim’s dedication to the tradition of Joseon white porcelain. Through his resolute commitment, he creates hard and beautiful porcelain fired at high temperatures. This exhibition highlights his blue-and-white porcelain's purity and understated elegance, born from his unwavering craftsmanship. Bonsai plants, radiating a vibrant energy, are also displayed to enhance his artistic vision. The exhibition celebrates the depth and value of Korean cultural heritage, sustained through one man’s determination and dedication.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} キョンサンブクド(慶尚北道)の無形遺産である沙器匠、朝鮮窯の「聞山キム·ヨンシク」の物語は、朝鮮王朝時代にさかのぼります。当時、宮廷や官庁に器を納めていた公人であるチ·ギュシクが記した『荷斎日記』には、1903年にキム·ヨンシク沙器匠の曽祖父キム·ビアンが窯を築いた記録があり、彼が王室の陶器を制作していた官窯の末裔であることが証明されています。約300年にわたり朝鮮白磁の伝統を継承してきた第8代キム·ヨンシク沙器匠の工房には、彼独自の芸術的な「こだわり」が息づいています。 「自己の固執」展では、朝鮮白磁の伝統を守り、伝統工芸の道を歩み続けるキム·ヨンシク沙器匠が「自己の固執」を掲げ、高温で焼き上げた堅く美しい「磁器」への愛情を表現した作品世界を紹介します。本展覧会では、キム·ヨンシク沙器匠の熟練した手によって生み出された青白磁が、淡白で純粋な美を放ちます。また、青々とした生命力あふれる盆栽が作品に彩りを添え、彼の芸術世界を一層豊かに演出しています。このように、彼の個人的なこだわりによって受け継がれてきた高貴で深みのある韓国固有の伝統文化が、改めて光を放つことでしょう。
desc_l10n.ko: 경상북도 무형 유산 사기장, 조선요 문산 김영식의 이야기는 조선시대를 거슬러 올라간다. 당시 궁궐과 관청에 각종 그릇을 납품하는 공인 지규식이 쓴 「하재일기(荷齋日記)」 에는 1903년 김영식의 증조부인 김비안이 망댕이가마를 축조한 사실이 기록되어, 그가 왕실 자기를 제작한 관요의 후손임을 증명한다. 약 300여 년 가까이 조선백자의 명맥 을 이어오는 8대 김영식 사기장의 작업관에는 그만이 가지고 있는 예술적인 ‘고집’이 있다. <자기의 고집>展은 조선백자 전통을 고수하며 전승도예의 길을 걸어가는 그가 ‘자기(自己)’의 고집을 내세워, 고온에 서 구워 낸 단단하고 아름다운 ‘자기(瓷器)’를 사랑하는 그의 작품 세계를 보여주고자 한다. 본 전시에서는 김영식 사기장의 고집 있는 손끝에서 탄생한 푸르른 백색의 청화백자가 담백하고 순수한 미를 자랑한 다. 또한 푸른 생명력이 돋보이는 분재가 함께 어우러져 그의 예술 세계를 더욱 풍부하게 만들어주며, 개인의 고집으 로 이어온 고귀하고 깊이 있는 우리 고유의 전통문화가 재조명되어 빛날 것이다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 庆尚北道非物质文化遗产瓷器匠人、来自朝鲜尧汶山的金荣植的故事，其根源可追溯至朝鲜时代。1903年，金荣植的曾祖父金毗安的事迹被记录在由当时提供器皿的公认池圭植所撰写的《荷斋日记》中，文中提到：“1903年，金毗安使用锤子烧窑。”这一记载证实了金毗安是王室瓷器制作官窑的后裔，他的家族近300年来一直是朝鲜白瓷技艺的命脉所在。 传承至第八代，金荣植在其工作馆中展现了他独有的艺术“执着”。他坚守朝鲜白瓷的传统，走在传承陶艺的道路上，坚持自我，在高温的窑火中淬炼他的作品。他渴望向世人展示他的瓷器世界，热爱那些经过烧制而变得坚硬且美丽的瓷器。 在本次展览中，金荣植瓷匠以他执着的技艺所创作的蓝白色青花白瓷，展现出一种清淡纯美的韵味。这些瓷器与突显绿色生命力的盆栽相结合，使他的艺术世界更加丰富多彩。金荣植所传承的高贵且有深度的传统文化，将会重新受到人们的关注并发扬光大。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} A digital content media art exhibition called 'delight,' which is enjoying popularity in London, dynamically reinterprets the past and future of Seoul. The Delight exhibition has reinterpreted the past and future of Seoul, metaphorically represented the city’s stories, and expressed these dynamic aspects through creative media art. The Delight exhibition began in Seoul and has since been presented in various cities worldwide including New York, Washington D.C., Paris, Mexico City, Dubai, and Tokyo. It has received numerous accolades and positive reviews. As of November and December 2023, it also holds the record for ranking first in ticket sales for its exhibition in London. In 2023, marking its third anniversary and a standalone exhibit in London, the Delight exhibition returns to Gallery Gwanghwa in Gwanghwamun. The exhibition features a refreshed arrangement and staging of over 22 varieties of content, including both acclaimed existing works and newly created pieces.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ソウルの過去と未来をダイナミックに再解釈したデジタルコンテンツメディアアート 現在ロンドンでもホットな展示「delight」のソウルバージョンが再上陸 『delight exhibition』は、ソウルの過去と未来を再解釈し、都市の物語を隠喩的に表現し、そのダイナミックな姿を創意的メディアアートで表現してきました。 『delight exhibition』は、ソウルをはじめとし、ニューヨーク、ワシントンDC、パリ、メキシコシティ、ドバイ、東京など世界各国で披露され、多くの注目を得ました。 2023年11月と12月の現在、ロンドン展示のチケット販売1位にもランクインしました。 2023年の『delight exhibition』は、ロンドン単独展示と開始3周年を記念し、クァンファムン(光化門)に位置するGallery Gwanghwaで、従来の高い評価を受けたコンテンツと新たに演出されるコンテンツ22種を新たな演出と構成で披露します。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울의 과거와 미래를 다이나믹하게 재해석한 디지털 콘텐츠 미디어 아트. 현재 런던에서 핫하게 전시되는 "delight" 서울 전시. <delight exhibition>은 서울의 과거와 미래를 재해석하고 도시의 이야기들을 은유적으로 표현해 왔으며 그 다이나믹한 모습들을 창의적 미디어 아트로 표현해 왔습니다. <delight exhibition>은 Seoul을 시작으로 지금까지 New York, Washington D.C., Paris, Mexico City, Dubai, Tokyo 등 세계각국에 선보여왔으며 수많은 호평을 받고 있습니다. 2023년 11월, 12월 현재 런던 전시 티켓판매 1위에 랭크된 기록도 보유하고 있습니다. 2023년 delight exhibition은 London 단독전시와 그 시작 3주년을 기념하여 광화문에 위치한 갤러리 광화에서 기존에 좋은 평가를 받은 콘텐츠와 새롭게 연출된 콘텐츠 22여종을 새로운 연출과 구성으로 선보입니다.

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} A digital content media art exhibition called 'delight,' which is enjoying popularity in London, dynamically reinterprets the past and future of Seoul. The Delight exhibition has reinterpreted the past and future of Seoul, metaphorically represented the city’s stories, and expressed these dynamic aspects through creative media art. The Delight exhibition began in Seoul and has since been presented in various cities worldwide including New York, Washington D.C., Paris, Mexico City, Dubai, and Tokyo. It has received numerous accolades and positive reviews. As of November and December 2023, it also holds the record for ranking first in ticket sales for its exhibition in London. In 2023, marking its third anniversary and a standalone exhibit in London, the Delight exhibition returns to Gallery Gwanghwa in Gwanghwamun. The exhibition features a refreshed arrangement and staging of over 22 varieties of content, including both acclaimed existing works and newly created pieces.
name: 2024 Delight Seoul

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The 2024 Nodeul Island Classic is the only event in Korea where you can enjoy full-length ballet and opera performances along the Hangang River. This year’s Nodeul Island Classic will feature the ballet "Sleeping Beauty" and the opera "Carmen." Both pieces achieved artistic significance during the late 19th century, a transition period, and served as a prelude to 20th-century art, reflecting the changing ideals, values, and evolving roles of women of that time. Enjoy the value of the classics and experience a new era of outdoor classical performances with the Nodeul Island Classic.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 「2024ハンガン(漢江)ノドゥルソム(ノドゥル島)クラシック」は、韓国で唯一、ハンガン(漢江)の岸辺で楽しめる全幕バレエとオペラの公演です。 今回のハンガン(漢江)ノドゥルソム(ノドゥル島)クラシックでは、バレエ『眠れる森の美女』とオペラ『カルメン』を上演します。 この二作品は、19世紀後半の歴史的転換期において芸術的な成果を収め、20世紀への扉を開くものとなりました。当時の信念や正義、そして女性像の変遷が作品に色濃く反映されています。「屋外クラシック公演」の新たな時代を切り開く「ハンガン(漢江)ノドゥルソム(ノドゥル島)クラシック」とともに、古典の価値を心ゆくまでご堪能ください。
desc_l10n.ko: 2024 한강노들섬클래식은 국내에서 유일하게 한강변에서 볼 수 있는 전막 발레, 오페라 공연입니다. 이번 한강노들섬클래식에서는 발레<잠자는 숲속의 미녀>와 오페라 <카르멘>을 선보입니다. 두 작품은 시대의 전환기인 19세기 후반에 예술사적 성과를 이루며 20세기의 마중물이 된 작품들로 당대의 신념과 정의, 여성상의 변화 등이 작품 안에 담겨있습니다. ‘야외 클래식 공연’ 향유의 새 시대를 여는 <한강노들섬클래식>과 함께 고전의 가치를 만끽하시기 바랍니다.

desc_l10n.ko: LG아트센터 서울은 ‘문화예술의 창작과 교류를 통한 기업 이윤의 사회 환원’을 목적으로 운영되고 있는 비영리 공연장입니다. 국내외 수준 높은 공연을 선보이는 복합 문화예술 공간으로, 연극·무용·클래식·재즈 등 장르를 넘나드는 공연이 열립니다. 마곡지구에 새롭게 자리하며 최첨단 무대 시설을 갖춘 공연장으로 주목받고 있으며, 서울의 공연예술 명소로 자리 잡고 있습니다.

Thanks to the affection and patronage of people throughout the years, we've flourished in Insa-dong, serving as a cornerstone for the past nine years. This year, in 2024, we've prepared events where you can reflect on the history of Museum Kimchikan and share memories of your time here. We've also arranged various events and gifts, so come by, share your memories, and receive presents.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ミュージアムキムチ館がインサ洞で開館9周年を迎えました。これまで多くの方々がミュージアムキムチ館を愛してくださり、ご来店くださったおかげで、9年間インサ洞で長い時間を過ごすことができました。 2024年はミュージアムキムチ館の歴史をみて、ミュージアムキムチ館での思い出を振り返るイベントを準備しました。その他、様々なイベントやプレゼントもありますので、ぜひお越しいただき、思い出を分かち合ってみてください。
desc_l10n.ko: 어느덧 뮤지엄김치간이 인사동에서의 개관 9주년을 맞이했습니다. 그 동안 많은 분들이 뮤지엄김치간을 사랑해주시고 찾아주신 덕분에 9년간 인사동의 터줏대감처럼 지낼 수 있었습니다. 이번 2024년에는 뮤지엄김치간의 역사를 돌아보고, 뮤지엄김치간과 있었던 추억 이야기를 나눠볼 수 있는 행사들을 준비해 보았습니다. 다양한 이벤트와 선물도 다양하게 준비했으니 방문하셔서 추억도 나눠 주시고 선물도 받아가세요.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 不知不觉间，Museum kimchikan迎来了仁寺洞开馆9周年。 这九年来，全赖广大朋友们对Museum kimchikan的厚爱与支持，使我们有幸如同仁寺洞的先驱者一般，共同见证并参与了这里的繁荣与变迁。 为了回顾Museum Kimchikan的历史并分享博物馆的辛奇间及回忆故事，我们特别策划了一系列活动。 我们精心准备了丰富多样的活动和礼物，诚挚邀请您来访领取您的专属礼物。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The 2024 Nodeul Island Classic is the only event in Korea where you can enjoy full-length ballet and opera performances along the Hangang River. This year’s Nodeul Island Classic will feature the ballet "Sleeping Beauty" and the opera "Carmen." Both pieces achieved artistic significance during the late 19th century, a transition period, and served as a prelude to 20th-century art, reflecting the changing ideals, values, and evolving roles of women of that time. Enjoy the value of the classics and experience a new era of outdoor classical performances with the Nodeul Island Classic.

desc_l10n.ko: 2024 한강노들섬클래식은 국내에서 유일하게 한강변에서 볼 수 있는 전막 발레, 오페라 공연입니다. 이번 한강노들섬클래식에서는 발레<잠자는 숲속의 미녀>와 오페라 <카르멘>을 선보입니다. 두 작품은 시대의 전환기인 19세기 후반에 예술사적 성과를 이루며 20세기의 마중물이 된 작품들로 당대의 신념과 정의, 여성상의 변화 등이 작품 안에 담겨있습니다. ‘야외 클래식 공연’ 향유의 새 시대를 여는 <한강노들섬클래식>과 함께 고전의 가치를 만끽하시기 바랍니다.

This unique exhibition commemorates the 65th anniversary of diplomatic relations between South Korea and Sweden. Featuring the collection from the National Museum of Sweden, it offers a unique opportunity to experience the charm of Nordic Impressionism and the distinctive sensibilities of Nordic art, which have not been previously accessible in Korea. The aim is to promote the relatively unfamiliar Nordic and Swedish art in Korea through this exhibition, shedding light on the spirit and footsteps of young Swedish artists who have contributed to the advancement of art and the diversity of international art.

desc_l10n.ko: 이번 전시는 스웨덴국립미술관과 마이아트뮤지엄이 공동 기획한 전시로서 스웨덴, 덴마크, 노르웨이를 대표하는 예술가들의 75점의 명작을 선보입니다. 대한민국-스웨덴 수교 65주년을 기념하여 개최되는 특별 전시입니다. 그동안 국내에서 만나볼 수 없었던 북유럽 예술의 대표 스웨덴국립미술관 컬렉션으로 북유럽풍 인상주의의 매력과 북유럽 특유의 감성을 느낄 수 있습니다 . 예술 발전 및 국제 예술의 다양성에 기여한 스웨덴의 젊은 예술가들의 정신과 발자취를 알아보며 한국에서는 생소한 북유럽 미술과 스웨덴 예술을 이번 전시를 통해 널리 알리고자 합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 本次展览由瑞典国家美术馆和My Art艺术馆联合举办，展出了瑞典、丹麦、挪威代表艺术家的75件代表作。这是为纪念韩国与瑞典建交65周年而举办的特别展览。 此前在韩国从未见过的北欧艺术的代表瑞典国立美术馆系列，可以感受到北欧风印象主义的魅力和北欧特有的感性。通过本次展览，我们将了解为艺术发展及国际艺术的多样性做出贡献的瑞典年轻艺术家的精神和足迹，并广泛宣传在韩国比较陌生的北欧美术和瑞典艺术。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 《Our Time Begins Here》 is an exhibition that illuminates the construction process of the Seo-Seoul Museum of Art and the narrative of time engraved in the southwestern region (and its people) as a 'record of memories'. Through the resonance of works that reflect the scenes of West Seoul remaining amidst the processes of creation and extinction, and the time differences that occur in between using the language of art, it constructs the memories of the construction of the Seo-Seoul Museum of Art, its surrounding time, places, and community into a multi-layered structure. By weaving together the diverse layers of relationships surrounding the museum—from the people who passed through the birth of the Seo-Seoul Museum of Art together, to the region and future generations—under the name of 'us', it seeks to explore the meaning of 'time' that new media art possesses within the accumulated narratives. You can encounter the artworks in niche spaces at address 0, which deviate from existing exhibition categories, such as the museum learning space, lobby, loading dock shutters, and grass plaza. Now, as the Seo-Seoul Museum of Art takes its first breath, we ask for your great interest in our time that will unfold 'here'.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 《私たちの時間はここから》は、西ソウル美術館の設立過程と、ソウル南西部地域(および住民)に刻まれた時間の叙事を「記憶の記録」として照らし出す展示です。生成と消滅の過程の中に残る西ソウルの光景、そしてその間に生じる時差を芸術の言語で照らし出す作品の共鳴を通じて、西ソウル美術館の設立とそれを取り巻く時間、場所、共同体の記憶を多層的な構造で構成します。西ソウル美術館の誕生を共にしてきた人々、地域、そして未来世代に至るまで、美術館を取り巻く多様な関係の層を「私たち」という名前で結びつけ、蓄積された叙事の中でニューメディアアートが持つ「時間」の意味を探求します。 美術館の学びの空間、ロビー、荷役場のシャッター、芝生広場など、従来の展示の枠を超えた「0番地」の隙間空間で作品に出会うことができます。西ソウル美術館の最初の息吹が始まる今、「ここ」で繰り広げられる私たちの時間に、ぜひご関心をお寄せください。
desc_l10n.ko: 《우리의 시간은 여기서부터》는 서서울미술관 건립 과정과 서남권 지역(민)에 새겨진 시간의 서사를 ‘기억의 기록’으로 조명하는 전시입니다. 생성과 소멸의 과정 속에 잔재하는 서서울의 장면들, 그리고 그 사이에서 발생하는 시차를 예술의 언어로 비추어내는 작품들의 공명을 통해, 서서울미술관의 건립과 그 주변을 둘러싼 시간, 장소, 공동체의 기억을 다층적 구조로 구성합니다. 서서울미술관의 탄생을 함께 지나온 사람들, 지역과 미래 세대에 이르기까지 미술관을 둘러싼 다양한 관계의 층위를 ‘우리’라는 이름으로 엮어내어 축적된 서사 속에서 뉴미디어 예술이 지닌 ‘시간’의 의미를 탐색하고자 합니다. 미술관 배움 공간, 로비, 하역장 셔터, 잔디마당 등 기존 전시 범주에서 벗어난 0번지 틈새 공간에서 작품을 만나보실 수 있습니다. 서서울미술관의 첫 숨이 시작되는 지금, ‘여기’에서 펼쳐질 우리의 시간에 많은 관심 바랍니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 《我们的时光由此启程》通过“记忆档案”的视角，梳理西首尔美术馆的筹建历程，挖掘留存于首尔西南片区的岁月往事。展览借由一件件艺术作品，用艺术语言映照西首尔在兴废更迭中留存的城市光景和时代落差，以多层次叙事架构，铺陈美术馆落成、周遭土地变迁与社群记忆。展览将见证美术馆诞生的亲历者、地区乃至后代新生代等各类关联群体，统合在“我们”的概念之下，串联层层积淀的地域故事，探寻新媒体艺术所承载的“时间”意义。 展品跳出常规展厅范围，散布在美术馆研学教室、大厅、卸货区卷帘门旁、草坪庭院等馆内边角闲置空间（零号空地）。西首尔美术馆自此开启崭新序章，诚邀各界关注在此徐徐展开的属于我们的时光。

Hong Gildong, the first hero of Joseon who will overturn a corrupt world. The best performance of the year end and New Year season, the National Theater Madangnori. This time it is Hong Gildong. Overcoming the sorrow of being born as a concubine’s child and becoming the leader of the Hwalbindang, Hong Gildong delivers a thrilling strike of justice against a fallen world. A spectacular stage that combines duplication techniques, gliding, acrobatics, and magic, along with witty dialogue, refreshing satire, and delightful humor. Madangnori <Hong Gildong Is Coming> blends laughter, satire, action, and catharsis into one joyful celebration. A festive scene like a banquet. From children to grandparents, everyone is invited to enjoy an exciting time this winter at the National Theater.

desc_l10n.ko: 세상을 향한 통쾌한 한 방, K-히어로 홍길동이 나가신다! 부패한 세상, 판을 뒤집을 조선의 첫 번째 영웅 홍길동! 연말연시 최고의 공연, 국립극장 마당놀이! 이번엔 홍길동이다! 서자의 설움을 딛고 활빈당의 수장이 되어 타락한 세상을 향해 통쾌한 정의의 일격을 날리는 홍길동! 분신술과 활공, 아크로바틱과 마술이 뒤섞인 화려한 무대, 재치 있는 입담, 속 시원한 풍자 그리고 익살스러운 해학까지! 웃음과 풍자, 액션과 카타르시스가 한데 어우러진 마당놀이 <홍길동이 온다> 잔칫집 같은 흥겨운 한 마당! 아이부터 할머니, 할아버지까지 모두 함께 올 겨울 국립극장에서 신명나게 놀아보세!

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Gyeongguksa Temple, nestled on the eastern slopes of Samgaksan (now known as Bukhansan), is a historic temple founded in the late Goryeo period. Renowned for its scenic mountain surroundings and fresh spring water, it attracts many visitors. The temple complex has 17 buildings, including Geungnakbojeon (Hall of Supreme Bliss), Yeongsanjeon, Myeongbujeon, Gwaneumjeon, and Sibangseonwon. Geungnakbojeon houses the Amitabha Buddha triad, along with wooden Buddhist paintings (designated as Treasure No. 748), Shinjungtaenghwa, and Palsangtaenghwa. Sibangseonwon offers a weekly Sunday meditation session, and the temple also hosts temple stay programs at Hwanheodang and Manwoldang. As one of Seoul's significant temples, Gyeongguksa was frequently visited by former President Syngman Rhee. During his tenure as Vice President, Richard Nixon of the United States visited the temple and later described it as one of his most memorable experiences in his memoirs, even including a photograph of his visit.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 三角山(現在のプカンサン(北漢山))の東側のふもとに位置するキョングクサ(慶國寺)は、コリョ(高麗)時代末期に創建された歴史ある寺院です。周囲の山々が美しく、薬水(飲めば薬効があって健康に良いと言われる湧き水)もあるため、多くの人が訪れる場所です。キョングクサ(慶國寺)には、極楽宝殿、霊山殿、冥府殿、観音殿、四方禅院など、17棟の建物があります。その中でも、極楽宝殿には、阿弥陀三尊仏をはじめ、国宝第748号に指定されている木彫りの仏画や神衆仏画、八相図などが奉安されています。また、四方禅院では毎週日曜日に「日曜禅房」が開かれており、歓喜堂や満月堂ではテンプルステイが行われています。 ソウル周辺の代表的な寺院であり、イ・スンマン(李承晩)が大統領時代によく訪れた場所です。副大統領時代に韓国を訪れたアメリカのニクソン(Nixon, R.M.)は、自身の『回顧録』において、この寺院を参拝したことが最も印象的だったと述べ、写真も掲載しました。
desc_l10n.ko: 삼각산(현 북한산) 동쪽 기슭에 자리잡은 경국사는 고려 말에 창건된 오래된 사찰입니다. 주변 산세가 좋고 약수가 있어 많은 사람들이 찾아오는 곳입니다. 경국사는 극락보전, 영산전, 명부전, 관음전, 시방선원 등 17동의 건물으로 이루어져 있습니다. 그 중 극락보전에는 아미타삼존불을 비롯하여 보물 제748호로 지정된 목각탱화 및 신중탱화·팔상탱화 등이 봉안되어 있습니다. 또한 시방선원에서는 매주 일요일에 일요선방이 개설되며, 환희당과 만월당에서는 템플 스테이가 진행되고 있습니다. 서울 주위의 대표적인 사찰로 이승만(李承晩)이 대통령 시절 자주 찾던 곳이며, 부통령시절에 방한 했던 미국의 닉슨(Nixon,R.M.)은 그의 『회고록』에서, 이 절에 참배했던 것이 가장 인상적이었다는 것과 함께 사진을 수록하기도 했습니다.

Nixon）于其《回忆录》中深情地记述道，他对其中一座寺庙的参拜经历印象尤为深刻，书中还收录了当时拍摄的照片作为纪念。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Superior Gallery will hold a two-person exhibition 《Exhibition Filling the Heart》 by artists Min Yul and Lee Dong Hoon in September 2025. This exhibition seeks to fill the emotional voids forgotten in the fast flow of daily life and portrays an inner journey to discover small, precious moments of happiness and rest. Artist Min Yul delicately captures moments of tranquility and contemplation found in ordinary sceneries such as wooden chairs, the sky, and the wind, depicting imaginary sanctuaries where one can pause and reflect inwardly. Artist Lee Dong Hoon conveys warmth and leisure of everyday life through his symbolic character “Bruno the Goose,” using concise colors and layered brushstrokes to express emotional depth. Although different in perspective, both artists capture the essence of emotions that resonate universally, encouraging viewers to reflect on their own hearts and experience small happiness and recharging moments. The exhibition 《Exhibition Filling the Heart》 will run until September 24, 2025.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} スーペリアギャラリーは2025年9月、ミン・ユル、イ・ドンフン作家2人展《心を満たす展示》を開催します。急速に流れていく日常の中で忘れられた感情の余白を満たし、小さくて大切な幸せと休息を発見する内面の旅を描いています。ミン・ユル作家は、木の椅子、空、風など日常の些細な風景に込められた静けさと思惟の瞬間を繊細にとらえ、とどまりながら内面を振り返ることができる想像の憩いの場を描き出します。イ・ドンフン作家は象徴的なキャラクター「ガチョウのブルーノ」を通じて日常のゆとりと温かさを伝え、簡潔な色彩と多層的な筆のタッチで感情の深さを表現します。2人の作家はそれぞれ異なる視線の中でも共感できる感情の本質を捉え、自分の心を振り返り小さな幸せと充電の時間を経験できることを期待します。《心を満たす展示》展は2025年9月24日まで行われます。
desc_l10n.ko: 슈페리어 갤러리는 2025년 9월, 민율·이동훈 작가 2인전 《마음을 채우는 전시》를 개최합니다. 빠르게 흘러가는 일상 속에서 잊혀진 감정의 여백을 채우고, 작고 소중한 행복과 쉼을 발견하는 내면의 여정을 담고 있습니다. 민율 작가는 나무 의자, 하늘, 바람 등 일상의 사소한 풍경에 깃든 고요와 사유의 순간을 섬세하게 포착하며, 머물며 내면을 돌아볼 수 있는 상상의 쉼터를 그려냅니다. 이동훈 작가는 상징적 캐릭터 ‘거위 브루노’를 통해 일상의 여유와 따뜻함을 전하며, 간결한 색채와 다층적 붓터치로 감정의 깊이를 표현합니다. 두 작가는 각기 다른 시선 속에서도 공감되는 감정의 본질을 포착해, 자신의 마음을 되돌아보고 작은 행복과 충전의 시간을 경험할 수 있기를 기대합니다. 《마음을 채우는 전시》展은 2025년 9월 24일까지 진행됩니다.

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Superior Gallery will hold a two-person exhibition 《Exhibition Filling the Heart》 by artists Min Yul and Lee Dong Hoon in September 2025. This exhibition seeks to fill the emotional voids forgotten in the fast flow of daily life and portrays an inner journey to discover small, precious moments of happiness and rest. Artist Min Yul delicately captures moments of tranquility and contemplation found in ordinary sceneries such as wooden chairs, the sky, and the wind, depicting imaginary sanctuaries where one can pause and reflect inwardly. Artist Lee Dong Hoon conveys warmth and leisure of everyday life through his symbolic character “Bruno the Goose,” using concise colors and layered brushstrokes to express emotional depth. Although different in perspective, both artists capture the essence of emotions that resonate universally, encouraging viewers to reflect on their own hearts and experience small happiness and recharging moments. The exhibition 《Exhibition Filling the Heart》 will run until September 24, 2025.
name: Exhibition Filling the Heart

In this continuing journey, we invite you to pause for a moment in the exhibition hall and experience the perspectives and stories contained in the artworks. The world of creation approaches with originality and profound resonance, offering new viewpoints on life and presenting meaningful questions.
