desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 首尔市立美术馆的分馆遍布首尔各地，其中就包括即将开放的新馆，以多元化的运营模式紧密相连，共同回应着艺术的时代脉动与潮流变迁。 《时空剧本》旨在深入剖析美术馆在当下所经历的内外部变革，它围绕“时间”这一核心议题，引领观众思考博物馆建筑的演变与发展。 近期，包括韩国美术馆在内的1980年以后的国家运动季政策相吻合，在集中开馆的国立公里美术馆内正在针对建筑老化带来的问题进行探讨。 目睹了旧城改造重建如何改变城市地形的现场之后，本次展览将焦点对准了美术馆这一非凡且具有标志性的公共建筑，深入剖析其生涯周期中背后的含义。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The Seoul Museum of Art, including the upcoming new building, operates its branches throughout Seoul in various ways, in line with the flow of time and art trends. “Architecture, Space Time Scenarios” is an exhibition planned to explore in depth the internal and external changes surrounding the Seoul Museum of Art at this point and to consider the museum's architecture with a focus on ‘time.’ Various discussions regarding architectural deterioration have taken place at national public art museums, including the Seoul Museum of Art, in response to national events and policies since the 1980s. Furthermore, witnessing urban redevelopment and reconstruction sites altering the city's landscape, this exhibition focuses on the 'life cycle of architecture' implied within art museums' special and symbolic public architecture.
name: Architecture, Space Time Scenarios

It houses a diverse collection of literary books, focusing on poetry, novels, and essays. Not only does it provide various reading group venues for residents, but it also operates curated exhibitions centered on domestic literary works and authors, as well as humanities lectures and poetry writing classes. This space, where you can feel the ambiance of hanok and nature, won the grand prize at the 2015 Korea Hanok Competition. We hope you will experience the charm of traditional Korean architecture and find solace in nature.

desc_l10n.ko: 청운문학도서관은 한옥으로 지어진 종로구 16번째 도서관으로 독서와 사색, 휴식이 가능한 매력적인 공간입니다. 시, 소설, 수필 위주의 다양한 문학 도서를 소장하고 있으며 주민들에게 각종 독서모임 장소를 제공하는 것은 물론 국내 문학 작품 및 작가 중심의 기획전시와 인문학 강연, 시 창작교실 등을 운영하고 있습니다. 한옥과 자연의 정취를 느낄 수 있는 공간으로 2015 대한민국 한옥공모전에서 대상 차지한 곳으로, 한국 전통 건축의 매력을 느끼며 자연 속에서 마음의 양식을 쌓아보시길 바랍니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The year 2025 marks both the twentieth anniversary of the completion of the Cheonggyecheon restoration and the twentieth anniversary of the opening of the Cheonggyecheon Museum. The Cheonggyecheon Museum began as an exhibition hall to promote the Cheonggyecheon Restoration Project. Ten years after its opening, it was remodeled into a professional museum that comprehensively highlights the history of Cheonggyecheon. Since then, it has actively presented exhibitions, education, research, and cultural events that help citizens better understand Seoul through the history of Cheonggyecheon and its riverside. This exhibition looks into what the past twenty years of the museum have been filled with through the “Room of a Twenty-Year-Old Youth.” In addition, it provides an opportunity to think about what new horizons Cheonggyecheon, as a historical and cultural content that remembers Seoul, can open in the future.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 2025年はチョンゲチョン(清渓川)の復元が完工して20年になる年であり、チョンゲチョン(清渓川)博物館が開館して20年になる年です。チョンゲチョン(清渓川)博物館の出発はチョンゲチョン(清渓川)復元事業を広報するための展示館でしたが、開館10年後の展示館のリニューアルを経て、チョンゲチョン(清渓川)の歴史にスポットを当てた専門博物館に生まれ変わりました。そのため、チョンゲチョン(清渓川)と川辺の歴史を通じてソウルをよりよく理解できるよう、展示、教育、調査、文化行事などの事業を活発に繰り広げ、市民と交流しています。今回の展示は、このような博物館の20年がどんな時間で満たされたのか、「今年二十歳になったばかりの青春の部屋」を通じて振り返ります。さらに、チョンゲチョン(清渓川)がソウルの記憶を伝える一つの歴史文化コンテンツとして、どのような新しい可能性を切り開くことができるのか考える時間を設けました。
desc_l10n.ko: 2025년은 청계천복원이 완공된지 20년이 되는 해이자, 청계천박물관이 개관 한지 20년이 되는 해입니다. 청계천박물관의 출발은 청계천복원 사업을 홍보하기 위한 전시관이었으나, 개관 10년 후인 전시관 리모델링을 거쳐 청계천의 역사를 총체적으로 조명하는 전문 박물관으로 거듭났습니다. 이에 청계천과 천변의 역사를 통해 서울을 더 잘 이해할 수 있도록 전시, 교육, 조사, 문화행사 등의 사업을 활발히 펼치며 시민들과 만나고 있습니다. 이번 전시는 이러한 박물관의 스무 해가 어떤 시간들로 채워 졌는지 '올해 갓 스무살이 된 청춘의 방'을 통해 살펴봅니다. 더불어 청계천이 서울을 기억하는 하나의 역사문화 콘텐츠로 어떤 새로운 지평을 열어 갈 수 있을지 생각하는 시간을 마련했습니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 2025年，即是清溪川修复工程竣工20周年，也是清溪川博物馆开馆20周年。清溪川博物馆最初是为宣传清溪川修复项目而设立的展览馆，在开馆10年后经过场馆改造，蜕变为一个全面展现清溪川历史的专业博物馆。此后，博物馆通过举办展览、教育、调查、文化活动等项目，积极致力于让市民通过清溪川及川边的历史更好地了解首尔。本次展览通过“今年刚满二十岁的青春房间”，回顾了博物馆这二十载岁月是由怎样的时光填充而成的。同时，也为我们提供了一个思考的契机，那就是清溪川作为首尔记忆的一部分，将如何作为一项历史文化内容，开启怎样的新视野。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The year 2025 marks both the twentieth anniversary of the completion of the Cheonggyecheon restoration and the twentieth anniversary of the opening of the Cheonggyecheon Museum. The Cheonggyecheon Museum began as an exhibition hall to promote the Cheonggyecheon Restoration Project. Ten years after its opening, it was remodeled into a professional museum that comprehensively highlights the history of Cheonggyecheon. Since then, it has actively presented exhibitions, education, research, and cultural events that help citizens better understand Seoul through the history of Cheonggyecheon and its riverside. This exhibition looks into what the past twenty years of the museum have been filled with through the “Room of a Twenty-Year-Old Youth.” In addition, it provides an opportunity to think about what new horizons Cheonggyecheon, as a historical and cultural content that remembers Seoul, can open in the future.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra will hold the "2025 Seoul Philharmonic Riverside Concert in Collaboration with the Federation of Korean Industries." Under the baton of Jaap van Zweden, the orchestra’s third music director and a Dutch conductor, the performance will take place against the romantic backdrop of the Han River on a summer night. The concert will feature orchestral music as well as collaborations with cello, trumpet, soprano, and baritone soloists. The performance will culminate in a spectacular fireworks display illuminating the early summer night sky, accompanied by beautiful classical melodies. This event is part of the "80th Anniversary of Liberation Commemoration Project" and is sponsored by the Federation of Korean Industries, which has led efforts to promote free market economy, sound economic development, and globalization. The riverside concert is free and open to all citizens without prior registration. Entry to the 2,000-seat venue at Hangang Park will be on a first-come, first-served basis. Audience members may also enjoy the music freely around the venue using their own mats and portable chairs. Convenient access to the concert site is available via Subway Line 5, Yeouinaru Station. For those unable to attend in person, the concert will also be livestreamed on the Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra’s and Seoul City’s “Live Seoul” YouTube channels.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ソウル市立交響楽団は『韓国経済人協会と共にする2025ソウル市立交響楽団川辺音楽会』を開催します。ソウル市交響楽団の第3代音楽監督に就任したオランダ出身のヤープ・ヴァン・ズヴェーデンの指揮の下、夏の夜、ロマンチックなハンガン(漢江)を背景にソウル市交響楽団の演奏と共にチェロ、トランペット、ソプラノ、バリトンとの多様な共演を披露します。また、美しいクラシックメロディーと共に初夏の夜空を彩る華やかな花火で公演の最後を飾ります。今回の公演は「光復80周年記念事業」の一環として行われ、自由市場経済の暢達と健全な国民経済の発展および国際化促進の先頭に立っている韓国経済人協会が後援します。 川辺音楽会は事前の申し込みなしに市民なら誰でも無料で観覧でき、ハンガン(漢江)公園に設けられた2千席の客席に先着順で入場できます。また、市民が直接用意したレジャーシートと簡易椅子を利用して客席の周辺で自由に音楽を鑑賞することもできます。地下鉄5号線「ヨイナル」駅を利用すれば楽に公演会場に到着することができ、公演会場への訪問が困難な市民のためにソウル市立交響楽団およびソウル市「ライブソウル」YouTubeチャンネルで生中継も行う計画です。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울시립교향악단은 '한국경제인협회와 함께하는 2025 서울시립교향악단 강변음악회'를 개최합니다. 서울시향의 제3대 음악감독으로 취임한 네덜란드 출신 얍 판 츠베덴의 지휘 아래 여름밤 낭만적인 한강을 배경으로 서울시향의 오케스트라 연주와 더불어 첼로, 트럼펫, 소프라노, 바리톤과의 다양한 협연을 선보일 예정입니다. 또한, 아름다운 클래식 선율과 함께 초여름 밤하늘을 수놓는 화려한 불꽃놀이로 공연의 대미를 장식합니다. 이번 공연은 '광복 80주년 기념사업'의 일환으로 진행되며, 자유시장경제의 창달과 건전한 국민경제의 발전 및 국제화 촉진을 위해 앞장서고 있는 한국경제인협회가 후원합니다. 강변음악회는 사전 신청 없이 시민 누구나 무료로 관람할 수 있으며, 한강공원에 마련된 2천 석의 객석에 선착순으로 입장할 수 있습니다. 또한, 시민들이 직접 준비한 돗자리와 간이의자를 이용해 객석 주변에서 자유롭게 음악을 감상하는 것도 가능합니다. 지하철 5호선 여의나루역을 이용하면 편하게 공연장에 도착할 수 있으며, 공연장 방문이 어려운 시민들을 위해 서울시향 및 서울시 ‘라이브 서울’ 유튜브 채널을 통한 생중계도 진행할 계획입니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Artist Research: 《Unfinished Flora―Soyo Lee》 and 《Time Blooms―Anna Ridler》, part of the Artist Research series at the Buk Seoul Museum of Art, introduce creative worlds based on artist research meticulously constructed through original approaches that traverse various academic and technological fields. This exhibition was planned to reexamine the academic, artistic, and social value of research conducted by artists. The two artists’ explorations of human constructed systems of knowledge and time intersect with studies of natural orders such as vegetation zones and flowering rhythms and are realized through art. This exhibition, which presents different research based artistic practices addressing the relationship between humans and non humans, aims to step away from human centered global thinking and to awaken a planetary sensibility that imagines possibilities of coexistence among the diverse beings that make up the Earth.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ソウル市立美術館北ソウル美術館の「芸術家の研究」シリーズ「未完の植物誌—イ・ソヨ」、「花時計—アンナ・リドラー」は、いくつかの学術および技術領域を行き来する独創的な方法で精巧に築かれた、芸術家たちの研究に基づいた創作世界を紹介する展示です。本展示は、芸術家が遂行する研究の学術的・芸術的・社会的な価値にスポットを当てるために企画されました。知識と時間という人間が作った体系に対する二人の芸術家の探求は、植生帯や開花のリズムのような自然の秩序に関する研究とかみ合って芸術として具現化されます。人間と非人間の関係に関する、互いに異なる研究基盤の芸術を披露する今回の展示が、人間中心の「地球的思惟」から一歩退き、地球という惑星を成す多様な存在の共生の可能性を想像する「惑星的な感覚」を呼び覚ます場になることを願います。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울시립미술관 북서울미술관의 ‘예술가의 연구’ 시리즈 《미완의 식물지—이소요》, 《꽃 시계—안나 리들러》는 여러 학술 및 기술 영역을 넘나드는 독창적 방식으로 정교하게 축조된 예술가들의 연구에 기반한 창작 세계를 소개하는 전시입니다. 본 전시는 예술가가 수행하는 연구의 학술적·예술적·사회적인 가치를 재조명하기 위해 기획되었습니다. 지식과 시간이라는 인간이 만든 체계에 대한 두 예술가의 탐구는 식생대, 개화 리듬 등의 자연 질서에 관한 연구와 맞물리며 예술로 구현됩니다. 인간과 비인간의 관계에 관한 서로 다른 연구기반 예술을 선보이는 이번 전시가 인간 중심의 ‘지구적 사유’에서 물러나, 지구 행성을 이루는 다양한 존재들의 공생 가능성을 상상하는 ‘행성적 감각’을 일깨우는 장이 되기를 바랍니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 首尔市立美术馆北首尔美术馆的“艺术家研究”系列展览《未完成的植物志——李秀耀》、《花钟——安娜·瑞德尔》，是一场介绍艺术家们以他们独特的方式和跨多个学术和技术领域的研究为基础精心构建的创作世界的展览。本次展览旨在重新审视艺术家所进行的研究在学术、艺术及社会层面的价值。两位艺术家对人类所构建的知识和时间体系的探索，与对植物带、开花节奏等自然秩序的研究相互交织，最终以艺术形式呈现。本次展览展现了两种基于不同研究、探讨人类与非人类关系的艺术实践。我们期待此次展览能成为一次契机，促使观众从人类中心的“全球性思维”中暂时抽离，唤醒一种能够想象地球行星上多样生命共存可能的“行星性感知”。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Artist Research: 《Unfinished Flora―Soyo Lee》 and 《Time Blooms―Anna Ridler》, part of the Artist Research series at the Buk Seoul Museum of Art, introduce creative worlds based on artist research meticulously constructed through original approaches that traverse various academic and technological fields. This exhibition was planned to reexamine the academic, artistic, and social value of research conducted by artists. The two artists’ explorations of human constructed systems of knowledge and time intersect with studies of natural orders such as vegetation zones and flowering rhythms and are realized through art. This exhibition, which presents different research based artistic practices addressing the relationship between humans and non humans, aims to step away from human centered global thinking and to awaken a planetary sensibility that imagines possibilities of coexistence among the diverse beings that make up the Earth.

desc_l10n.en: "Though this short time feels like three autumns, how many autumns will there be in ten days?” We present the ambiance of a traditional hanbok-style autumn evening, accompanied by the melodies of our traditional Korean musical instruments and classical vocal performances. “Ujo Dugeo Ilgagi” expresses the anxious feeling of waiting for a beloved one. “As the flowers bloom and fall” conveys the emotions of departing. “Love lies” speaks of a longing that can't be seen even in dreams. Program 1. As the flowers bloom and fall – Ost. “The Throne” (2015 film) 2. Ujo Dugeo “Ilgagi” 3. Love Lies – Ost. “Love, Lies” (2016 film) 4. Carpenters – Close to you 5. Folk Songs Medley – Arirang / Miryang Arirang / Ballad of the Roasted Chestnut Refreshments Offered Enjoy 'Cheong Tae Jeon,” a traditional tea from Jangheung Cheongwandawon with traditional snacks. Cast Chae-young Kim (Vocalist), Seok-eon Kim (Flute/Saenghwang), Yun-hee Jang(Haegeum), Min-song Kim (Keyboard), Yu-a Lee (Korean Calligraphy) Ticket Reservation: https://3d9efgulalc.typeform.com/to/vbu9YNNi

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} This opening exhibition of The Prima Art Center unveils for the first time 487 small ceramic pieces collected by the late Lee Woobok, founder of Daewoo Group and a key contributor to Korea’s industrial and economic development. Alongside his corporate career, he deeply appreciated the beauty of Korean art and ceramics and dedicated himself to preserving cultural heritage. He was particularly captivated by the serene and generous beauty of Joseon white porcelain and blue-and-white porcelain, collecting numerous small ceramic works over many years with great care. The exhibition title Sojunghyundae (小中顯大) means “Greatness revealed within smallness.” The 487 artifacts on display include 103 Goryeo celadon pieces, 3 Joseon buncheong ware pieces, and 381 Joseon white porcelain pieces.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ザ・プリマアートセンターの開館展で、故ソウン イ・ウボク会長が50年余りにわたって収集した小さな陶磁コレクション487点を初めて公開します。大宇グループの創業メンバーであり、韓国の産業化と経済発展に貢献した故人は、企業活動とともに韓国の美術と陶磁の美しさを深く享有し、大切な文化遺産を守ることに献身してきました。特に、朝鮮の純白磁と青華白磁に込められた端正で寛容な美しさに魅了され、長い時間をかけてさまざまな小さな陶磁器を一点一点丹念に集めてきました。展示タイトルの「小中顕大」は、「小さなものの中に大きなものが現れる」という意味を含んでいます。今回の展示に出品された487点の遺物は、高麗青磁103点、朝鮮青磁3点、朝鮮白磁381点で構成されています。
desc_l10n.ko: 더프리마아트센터의 개관전으로 고(故) 소운 이우복 회장이 50여 년에 걸쳐 수집한 소품 도자 컬렉션 487점을 처음으로 공개합니다. 대우그룹 창업 멤버로서 대한민국의 산업화와 경제 발전에 기여한 고인은, 기업 활동과 더불어 한국 미술과 도자의 아름다움을 깊이 향유하며, 소중한 문화유산을 지키는 일에 헌신해 오셨습니다. 특히 조선의 순백자와 청화백자에 담긴 단정하고 너그러운 아름다움에 매료되어, 오랜 시간에 걸쳐 다양한 소품 도자기를 한 점 한 점 정성껏 모아 오셨습니다. 전시 제목 ‘소중현대(小中顯大)’는 “작은 것 속에 큰 것이 드러난다”는 뜻을 담고 있습니다. 이번 전시에 출품된 487점의 유물은 고려청자 103점, 조선 분청자 3점, 조선 백자 381점으로 구성되어 있습니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The Prima艺术中心开幕展首次公开了已故绍耘李雨馥会长历时50余年珍藏的487件小件陶瓷系列作品。作为大宇集团创始成员，李会长为韩国的工业化和经济发展作出了重要贡献，与此同时，他深深沉醉于韩国美术和陶瓷之美，并始终致力于守护珍贵的文化遗产。尤其被朝鲜王朝纯白瓷与青花白瓷中所蕴含的端庄、雍容的美学所吸引，长年累月精心甄选收集了各类小件陶瓷。展览标题“小中显大”，意为“于微物中见大千”。本次展出的487件文物包括103件高丽青瓷、3件朝鲜粉青瓷及381件朝鲜白瓷。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} As Korea's sole toy fair where you can encounter art toys from around the world in one place, various global artists and IP brands participate directly to become the center of collectible culture. A memorable summer for collectors who have wanted to meet global art toys, as well as those encountering art toys for the first time. This event, held at COEX Seoul, goes beyond a simple exhibition, featuring various collections and lifestyle content, including curated keyrings, a second-hand market, and IP collaboration content. TOY CON SEOUL keeps pace with the globally growing art toy market, promoting brand collaborations between global brands, distinctive emerging IPs, and local artists. Through this, it values the discovery and nurturing of next-generation artists as a key principle, aiming to cultivate the value of the collectible toy market beyond simple exhibition by bringing together brands, artists, and companies. Additionally, special collaborations between global art toy brands and local artists, limited-edition art toys available only at the event venue, keyring curation, and merchandise are prepared.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 世界中のアートトイが一堂に会する韓国唯一のトイフェアで、さまざまなグローバルアーティストとIPブランドが直接参加し、コレクタブル文化の中心となります。グローバルアートトイに参加したかったコレクター、アートトイに初めて接するみんなのための特別な夏。ソウルCOEXで開かれるこのイベントは、単なる展示を超え、キーリングキュレーション、セカンドハンドマーケット、IPコラボコンテンツなど、多様なコレクションとライフスタイルコンテンツで構成されます。 トイコンソウルは、世界的に成長しているアートトイ市場に歩調を合わせ、グローバルブランドをはじめとする個性あふれる新進IP、ローカルアーティスト間のブランドコラボを図り、これを通じて次世代アーティストの発掘と育成を主な価値としています。単なる展示を超え、ブランドとアーティスト、企業が出会い、コレクタブルトイ市場の価値を向上させることを目指します。また、グローバルアートトイブランドとローカルアーティストの特別なコラボおよびイベント会場でのみ見ることのできる限定版アートトイ、キーリングキュレーションおよびグッズも用意しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 전 세계의 아트토이를 한자리에서 만나볼 수 있는 한국 유일 토이 페어로서, 다양한 글 로벌 아티스트와 IP 브랜드가 직접 참여해 컬렉터블 문화의 중심이 됩니다. 글로벌 아트토이를 만나고 싶었던 컬렉터, 아트토이를 처음 접하는 사람 모두를 위한 특별한 여름. 서울 코엑스에서 열리는 이 행사는 단순한 전시를 넘어, 키링 큐레이션, 세컨핸드 마켓, IP 협업 콘텐츠 등 다양한 컬렉션과 라이프스타일 콘텐츠로 구성됩니다. 토이콘 서울은 전 세계적으로 성장하고 있는 아트토이 시장에 발맞추어 글로벌 브랜드를 비롯한 개성 넘치는 신진 IP, 로컬 아티스트 간의 브랜드 협업을 도모하고, 이를 통해 차세대 아티스트 발굴과 육성을 주요 가치고 삼고 있으며 단순한 전시를 넘어 브랜드와 아티스트, 기업이 만나 컬렉터블 토이 시장의 가치를 함양시키는 것을 목표합니다. 또한 글로벌 아트토이 브랜드와 로컬 아티스트의 특별한 협업 및 행사 현장에서만 만날 수 있는 한정판 아트토이, 키링 큐레이션 및 굿즈들이 준비되어있습니다.

A memorable summer for collectors who have wanted to meet global art toys, as well as those encountering art toys for the first time. This event, held at COEX Seoul, goes beyond a simple exhibition, featuring various collections and lifestyle content, including curated keyrings, a second-hand market, and IP collaboration content. TOY CON SEOUL keeps pace with the globally growing art toy market, promoting brand collaborations between global brands, distinctive emerging IPs, and local artists. Through this, it values the discovery and nurturing of next-generation artists as a key principle, aiming to cultivate the value of the collectible toy market beyond simple exhibition by bringing together brands, artists, and companies. Additionally, special collaborations between global art toy brands and local artists, limited-edition art toys available only at the event venue, keyring curation, and merchandise are prepared.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The current exhibition is designed to provide a comprehensive view of the world captured through the eyes of photographers Im In-sik, Jung Bum-tae, Han Young-soo, Hong Soon-tae, and Hwang Heon-man, showcasing their perspectives on children. The exhibition features photographs of children from the 1950s to the 1970s, which can be seen as depicting grandparents' childhoods. It looks at the innocent expressions of children and the various cultural games of that era, including games like Gonggi Nori, horseback riding, and sledding with friends in nature.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 今回の展示は、写真作家のイム・インシク、チョン・ボムテ、ハン・ヨンス、ホン・スンテ、ファン・ホンマンの目に映った子供たちの姿とその中に込められた作品世界が楽しめます。私たちのおじいちゃんやおばあちゃんの幼い頃の姿ともいえる1950年代から1970年代までの子供の写真を紹介します。無邪気な子供たちの姿や自然と一緒に友達と楽しんだ空気遊び、馬乗り、そり乗りなど、その時代の多様な遊びの文化を垣間見ることができます。
desc_l10n.ko: 이번 전시는 임인식, 정범태, 한영수, 홍순태, 황헌만 사진작가의 눈에 비친 아이들의 모습과 그 속에 담긴 작품 세계를 한 눈에 조망할 수 있도록 구성했습니다. 지금 우리 할아버지, 할머니의 어릴 적 모습이라 할 수 있는 1950년대부터 1970년대까지의 어린이 사진이 소개됩니다. 천진난만한 아이들의 모습과 자연과 벗 삼아 친구들과 즐겼던 공기놀이, 말타기, 썰매타기 등 그 시절 다양한 놀이문화를 살펴볼 수 있습니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 本次展览集结了INSIK、JEONG BEOMTAE、HAN YEONGSU、HONG SUNTAE和HWANG HEONMAN摄影师的作品，他们镜头下的孩子们形象栩栩如生，同时展现了丰富多彩的作品世界。 一同回顾那些可以称之为爷爷奶奶辈儿时模样的珍贵照片。通过这些照片，我们可以一窥那个天真烂漫的年代，孩子们与大自然为伴，与朋友们一同享受着抓石子儿、骑马、滑雪橇等丰富多彩的游戏文化。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The '2026 International Sleep & Healing Expo (Sleep & Wellness Festa)' is Korea's first and largest specialized sleep healing expo co-hosted by The Korea Economic Daily, Coex Co., Ltd., and the Korea Sleep Industry Association. Held on a scale of 150 companies and 300 booths across the entire Hall B on the 1st floor of COEX, you can encounter all areas of sleep environment and lifestyle in one place, including sleep tech, healthcare, sleep medical products and services, mattresses, bedding, and sleep lighting. A Special Pavilion for Healing Tourism & Wellness and Korea's first Special Pavilion for Silver Towns will be operated together, alongside colorful side events such as an industrial conference featuring global speakers, sleep trail, interactive event zone, sound sleep zone, healing zone, and prize zone. Free admission is available upon pre-registration, and benefits such as a welcome sleep kit gift, prize draw, and priority seminar seat reservation are provided.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 2026国際睡眠治癒博覧会(Sleep & Wellness Festa)は、韓国経済新聞、㈱COEX、(社)韓国睡眠産業協会が共同主催する、韓国初・最大規模の睡眠治癒専門博覧会です。COEX 1階Bホール全館にて、150社・300ブースの規模で開催され、スリープテック・ヘルスケア、睡眠関連の医療製品・サービス、マットレス、寝具、睡眠照明など、睡眠環境やライフスタイルに関わる幅広い分野を一堂にご覧いただけます。会場では、ヒーリングツーリズム・ウェルネス特別館や、韓国初となるシルバータウン特別館を設置。さらに、世界各国の専門家が参加する産業カンファレンスをはじめ、スリープトレイル、体験イベントゾーン、快眠ゾーン、ヒーリングゾーン、抽選イベントゾーンなど、多彩な関連プログラムも開催されます。事前登録をすると入場無料となるほか、ウェルカム・スリープキットのプレゼント、抽選会への参加、セミナー優先予約などの特典をご利用いただけます。
desc_l10n.ko: 2026 국제수면치유박람회(Sleep & Wellness Festa)'는 한국경제신문, ㈜코엑스, (사)한국수면산업협회가 공동 주최하는 국내 최초·최대 규모의 수면 치유 전문 박람회입니다. 코엑스 1층 B홀 전관에서 150개사·300부스 규모로 열리며, 슬립테크·헬스케어, 수면 의료 제품·서비스, 매트리스·침구·수면조명 등 수면 환경·라이프스타일 전 분야를 한자리에서 만날 수 있습니다. 치유관광·웰니스 특별관과 국내 최초 실버타운 특별관이 함께 운영되며, 글로벌 연사가 참여하는 산업 컨퍼런스, 슬립 트레일, 체험 이벤트존, 꿀잠존, 치유존, 경품존 등 다채로운 부대행사가 진행됩니다. 사전 등록 시 무료 입장이 가능하며 웰컴 슬립키트 증정, 경품 추첨, 세미나 좌석 우선 예약 혜택이 제공됩니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 2026国际睡眠疗愈博览会（Sleep & Wellness Festa）由韩国经济新闻、（株）COEX、（社团法人）韩国睡眠产业协会联合主办，是韩国首个、规模最大的睡眠疗愈专业博览会。展会在COEX 1楼 B厅全馆举办，汇聚150家企业、设置300个展位。现场可一站式参观睡眠科技、健康护理、睡眠医疗产品与服务、床垫、床上用品、睡眠照明等睡眠环境及生活方式全领域产品。展会同步运营疗愈康养旅游特别馆、韩国首个养老社区特别馆，还将举办有全球演讲嘉宾参与的产业论坛、睡眠体验之旅，并设置体验活动区、好眠专区、疗愈专区、抽奖区等丰富多彩的配套活动。提前登记即可免费入场，同时可获赠睡眠主题欢迎礼包、参与抽奖活动，并享有论坛席位优先预约权益。

Held on a scale of 150 companies and 300 booths across the entire Hall B on the 1st floor of COEX, you can encounter all areas of sleep environment and lifestyle in one place, including sleep tech, healthcare, sleep medical products and services, mattresses, bedding, and sleep lighting. A Special Pavilion for Healing Tourism & Wellness and Korea's first Special Pavilion for Silver Towns will be operated together, alongside colorful side events such as an industrial conference featuring global speakers, sleep trail, interactive event zone, sound sleep zone, healing zone, and prize zone. Free admission is available upon pre-registration, and benefits such as a welcome sleep kit gift, prize draw, and priority seminar seat reservation are provided.

desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 世界中で大ヒットを記録したNetflixシリーズ『イカゲーム』とKコンテンツの底力を見せた映画『パラサイト 半地下の家族』の音楽監督であり、韓国を代表するミュージシャン、チョン·ジェイルの単独コンサートが12月、セジョン(世宗)文化会館大劇場で開かれます。 チョン·ジェイルは10月1日、ロンドンのバビカンセンターで開催されたK-ミュージックフェスティバル10周年開幕公演でロンドンのシンフォニーオーケストラと共演し、会場を大いに盛り上げました。 今回の単独コンサートでは、世界中で大ヒットした『イカゲーム』、『パラサイト 半地下の家族』のOSTをはじめ、最近発売したソロアルバム『Listen』の音楽を鑑賞でき、演奏者としての魅力はもちろん、作曲家や音楽監督、指揮者の彼が持つ幅広い音楽的スペクトラムをご覧いただけます。 チョン·ジェイルコンサートは、12月、セジョン(世宗)文化会館で開かれます。セジョン(世宗)文化会館は、韓国を代表する公演芸術機関です。ソウルの中心地であるクァンファムン(光化門)に位置し、クァンファムン(光化門)広場やキョンボックン(景福宮)などソウルを代表する観光地に囲まれています。セジョン(世宗)文化会館でチョン·ジェイルのコンサートを楽しみながら、周辺のソウル観光地も一緒に巡りましょう。
desc_l10n.ko:
전 세계에서 메가히트를 기록한 넷플릭스 시리즈 <오징어 게임>와 K콘텐츠의 저력을 보여준 영화 <기생충>의 음악감독이자 한국을 대표하는 뮤지션 정재일의 단독콘서트가 오는 12월 세종문화회관 대극장에서 열립니다.

정재일은 지난 10월 1일 런던 바비칸 센터에서 개최된 K-뮤직 페스티벌 10주년 개막공연에서 런던 심포니 오케스트라와 협연해 현지 관객들의 기립박수를 이끌어냈습니다.

이번 단독 콘서트에서는 대중들이 사랑한 <오징어 게임>, <기생충> OST를 비롯해 최근 발매한 솔로 앨범 <Listen>을 생생하게 접할 수 있는 무대로, 연주자로서의 매력은 물론 작곡가, 음악감독, 지휘자 등 그가 가진 넓고 깊은 음악적 스펙트럼을 직접 확인할 수 있을 것입니다.

정재일 콘서트는 12월, 세종문화회관에서 열린다. 세종문화회관은 한국을 대표하는 공연예술기관입니다. 서울의 중심지 광화문에 위치하여, 광화문 광장과 경복궁 등 서울을 대표하는 관광지로 둘러싸여 있습니다. 세종문화회관에서 정재일 콘서트도 즐기고, 주변 서울 관광지도 함께 즐겨보세요.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} In the second half of 2025, the Hanyangdoseong Museum opens its special exhibition Demolition of Hanyangdoseong, Breaking the Boundaries of Hanyang. King Taejo Yi Seong-gye, founder of the Joseon dynasty, established palaces, the Jongmyo Shrine, and the Sajik Altar in Hanyang based on Confucian ideals, and in 1396 began construction of Hanyangdoseong to defend the capital. The city wall functioned as both a physical boundary separating the capital from the provinces and a symbol of royal authority. After Japan’s victory in the Russo-Japanese War, it began interfering in the Korean Empire, establishing the Wall Disposal Committee in 1907 to commence the full-scale demolition of Hanyangdoseong. Under the pretext of modernization and urban development, gates and walls were destroyed, replaced with colonial government facilities and residential areas. To mark the 80th anniversary of Liberation, this exhibition presents the process of the demolition of Hanyangdoseong by Japan and the transformation of Seoul into a colonial city, using a wide range of historical materials.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 2025年、ハニャン(漢陽)都城博物館下半期企画展<ハニャン(漢陽)漢陽都城の撤去、漢陽の境界を崩す>が開幕しました。 朝鮮王朝を建国したテジョ(太祖)イ・ソンゲ(李成桂)は儒教の理念に基づき、ハニャン(漢陽)に宮殿と宗廟、社稷を建て、1396年、首都防御のためにハニャン(漢陽)都城の築造を始めました。ハニャン(漢陽)都城は首都と地方を区分する物理的な境界であり、王の権威を表すシンボルでした。日露戦争の勝利後、日本は大韓帝国に干渉し、1907年に城壁処理委員会を設置し、ハニャン(漢陽)都城を本格的に撤去しました。近代化と都市整備を名分に城門と城壁を破壊し、その場所に植民地統治施設と住宅地を建てました。光復(日本の植民地支配からの解放)80周年を迎えて開かれる今回の展示では、日本によるハニャン(漢陽)都城の撤去過程と植民都市に変わっていくソウルの姿を、多様な展示物を通じて見ていきたいと思います。
desc_l10n.ko: 2025년 한양도성박물관 하반기 기획전 <한양도성 훼철, 한양의 경계를 허물다>가 개막했습니다. 조선을 건국한 태조 이성계는 유교 이념을 바탕으로 한양에 궁궐과 종묘, 사직을 세우고, 1396년 수도 방어를 위해 한양도성 축조를 시작하였습니다. 한양도성은 수도와 지방을 구분하는 물리적 경계이자 왕의 권위를 드러내는 상징물이었습니다. 러일전쟁 승리 후 일본은 대한제국을 간섭하며 1907년 성벽처리위원회를 설치, 한양도성을 본격적으로 철거했습니다. 근대화와 도시 정비를 명분으로 성문과 성벽을 파괴하고 그 자리에 식민지 통치 시설과 주택지를 세웠습니다. 광복 80주년을 맞아 열리는 이번 전시에서는 일본에 의한 한양도성 훼철 과정과 식민도시로 변해가는 서울의 모습을 다양한 전시물을 통해 살펴보고자 합니다.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Ceramic art, considered one of humanity's oldest forms of expression, embodies the symbolic language and imaginative structures refined through history. As the artist notes, ceramics have reflected their time's philosophy, aesthetics, lifestyles, and trends through color, shape, and pattern. Yoo Eui-jeong focuses on this inherent nature of ceramics, creating works with a hybrid temporality. One of Yoo's signature techniques involves allowing glaze to drip over white porcelain and layering it with iconic imagery from both the past and present. The way the glaze's form fades and distorts as it flows downward symbolizes the evolving cultural symbols shaped by the passage of time. In this exhibition, Yoo Eui-jeong draws inspiration from Baekja, which reached its zenith during the Joseon Dynasty, presenting works that reflect contemporary relevance. White porcelain, originally a symbol of the royal court's dignity, also became widely cherished by commoners for its simplicity, with blue-and-white porcelain and iron-painted porcelain dominating different social strata. Yoo experiments with how baekja, imbued with such historical context, can manifest in meaningful ways from a modern perspective.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 「人類最古の芸術ともいえる陶芸には、長い歴史の中で磨かれた象徴の言語や想像の構造が宿っています。」 作家の言葉どおり、陶磁器はその時代の思想や美的感覚、生活様式や流行を色や形、文様によって映し出してきました。ユ・ウィジョンは、こうした陶磁器の特性に注目し、異なる時代が交錯する時間性を持つ作品を制作しています。 近年、彼が多く用いている表現技法は、白磁の上に釉薬を垂らし、その上に過去と現在を象徴するモチーフを重ねるというものです。釉薬が下へ流れるにつれて形がぼやけたり歪んだりする様子は、時間の流れとともに移り変わる文化的象徴を表現しています。 本展では、ユ・ウィジョンは朝鮮王朝時代に最盛期を迎えた白磁をモチーフに、現代性を反映させた作品を発表します。白磁はもともと朝鮮王朝の威厳を象徴する宮廷用の陶磁器でしたが、その素朴な形状から庶民の間でも広く愛用されており、社会階層によって青華白磁や鉄画白磁が主流となりました。ユ・ウィジョンは、このような歴史的背景を持つ白磁を、現代の視点からどのように新たな形で表現できるのかを探求しています。
desc_l10n.ko: "인류의 가장 오래된 예술이라 할 수 있는 도예에는 지나온 역사를 통해 다듬어진 상징의 언어와 상상의 구조가 담겨있다." 작가의 말대로, 도자는 당대의 사상과 미감, 생활상과 유행을 색과 형태, 문양을 통해 반영해 왔다. 유의정은 이러한 도자의 속성에 주목하여 혼종적인 시간성을 지닌 작품을 만든다. 최근 그의 대표적인 표현법은 백자 위에 유약을 흘러내리게 표현하고, 그 위로 과거와 현재의 대표적인 도상들을 덮는 것이다. 유약의 형상이 아래로 내려갈수록 희미해지고 왜곡되는 모습은 시간의 흐름 속에서 변화하는 문화적 상징을 나타낸다. 본 전시에서 유의정은 조선시대에 전성기를 이룬 백자를 모티브로 삼아 동시대성을 투영한 작품을 선보인다. 백자는 본래 조선 왕실의 위엄을 상징하는 왕실의 자기이면서도 그 소박한 형태로서 서민들에게 널리 애용되었으며 각 계층별로 청화백자와 철화백자가 주류를 이뤘다. 유의정은 이 같은 맥락을 지닌 백자가 동시대적 시각에서 어떻게 유효한 모습으로 나타날 수 있는지를 실험한다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 在陶艺这门堪称人类最古老的艺术中，蕴含着经由历史磨砺而出的象征性语言和想象结构。 正如作者所述，陶瓷以其丰富的颜色、多样的形态及独特的图案，反映了当代的思想观念、审美取向、生活面貌以及流行趋势。俞义正着眼于这些陶瓷所具备的特性，创作出了蕴含混合时间感的作品。 近期，他具有代表性的表现手法是在白瓷上倾注釉料，并在其上覆盖着融合过去与现在的经典图像。釉料在向下流淌的过程中逐渐变得模糊与扭曲，这一形象象征着文化随着时间的流逝而发生的变迁。 在本次展示会上，俞义正将围绕朝鲜时代达到鼎盛期的白瓷这一主题，展出能够体现同时代特色的作品。白瓷原本是象征朝鲜王室威严的瓷器，但其朴素的形态也被广泛应用于平民阶层，其中青花白瓷和铁花白瓷尤为流行。俞义正尝试探索了如何在同时代的视角下，将这种具有历史脉络的白瓷以更具效果的方式呈现出来。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Ceramic art, considered one of humanity's oldest forms of expression, embodies the symbolic language and imaginative structures refined through history. As the artist notes, ceramics have reflected their time's philosophy, aesthetics, lifestyles, and trends through color, shape, and pattern. Yoo Eui-jeong focuses on this inherent nature of ceramics, creating works with a hybrid temporality. One of Yoo's signature techniques involves allowing glaze to drip over white porcelain and layering it with iconic imagery from both the past and present. The way the glaze's form fades and distorts as it flows downward symbolizes the evolving cultural symbols shaped by the passage of time. In this exhibition, Yoo Eui-jeong draws inspiration from Baekja, which reached its zenith during the Joseon Dynasty, presenting works that reflect contemporary relevance. White porcelain, originally a symbol of the royal court's dignity, also became widely cherished by commoners for its simplicity, with blue-and-white porcelain and iron-painted porcelain dominating different social strata. Yoo experiments with how baekja, imbued with such historical context, can manifest in meaningful ways from a modern perspective.
name: Yoo Eui Jeong 《The Baek-Ja 》

It is characterized by its robust and dignified sound, primarily in the Ujo mode. This musical lineage, which began with Park Yu-jeon and continued through Jeong Jae-geun, Jeong Eung-min, and Jeong Gwon-jin, was on the brink of extinction until it was revived by Yoon Jin-cheol, who was recognized as a holder of the National Intangible Cultural Heritage. Recently, it has been actively performed again. This performance is particularly notable as it marks a female singer's first complete rendition of Boseongsori Jeokbyeokga. Audiences will experience Kim So-jin's unique interpretation and color.

desc_l10n.ko: 보성소리 적벽가는 고제 소리의 예스러운 맛이 고스란히 남아있는 귀한 소리로 우조 위주의 씩씩하고 당당한 소리가 특징이다. 박유전에서 시작되어 정재근-정응민-정권진으로 이어지다 전승이 끊어질 위기에 처했던 소리를 이어받은 윤진철이 국가무형유산 보유자로 인정되어 최근 활발히 불리고 있다. 특히 이번 공연은 여성 소리꾼이 부르는 보성소리 적벽가 첫 완창 무대이며 김소진의 색깔이 담긴 ‘김소진만의 보성소리 적벽가’를 만나볼 수 있다.

desc_l10n.en: Canvas N Gallery will host "GWTF: Go with the Flow" featuring two artists, Kim Yeon-hong and Ahn Rio, from October 13th, 2023, to November 12th, 2023. They all immerse themselves in the flow of things that are not visible. While artist Kim Yeonhong follows the "flow of phenomena" such as light and wind, artist Ahn Rio explores another universe created by the "flow of thoughts." This exhibition was planned to focus on ‘flow,’ a common theme between the two artists, with the meaning of ‘going with the flow.’ Each exhibition room is divided into light, water, and wood, highlighting things that flow or the artist's results that result from the flow.
desc_l10n.ja: canvasｎギャラリーは、2023年10月13日から11月12日まで作家キム·ヨンホン、アン·リオと共に展示『GWTF:Go with the Flow』を進開催します。皆、目に見えないものの流れに順応するという考えから、キム·ヨンホンは、光や風などの「現象の流れ」を表現し、アン・リオは、「考えの流れ」で生成される宇宙を表現します。今回の展示は、両作家の共通テーマである「流れ」に集中し、「流れに乗る」という意味で企画されました。各展示室を、光、水、木に分け、流れていくものや流れの先に生まれる作家の表現を披露します。
desc_l10n.ko: 캔버스N 갤러리는 2023년 10월 13일부터 11월 12일까지 김연홍, 안리오 2인의 작가와 함께 《GWTF: Go with the Flow》를 진행한다. 이들은 모두 눈으로 보이지 않는 것들의 흐름에 천착한다. 김연홍 작가가 빛, 바람 등의 ‘현상의 흐름’을 좇는다면 안리오 작가는 ‘생각’의 흐름으로 생성되는 또 다른 우주를 좇는다. 이번 전시는 두 작가의 공통 주제인 ‘흐름’에 집중하여 ‘흐름을 타다’라는 뜻으로 전시를 기획하였다. 각 전시실은 빛, 물, 나무로 나뉘어 흘러가는 것들, 혹은 흘러서 발생한 작가의 결과물들을 조명한다.
desc_l10n.zh: Canvas N画廊将于2023年10月13日至11月12日，与Kim Yeonhong、An Rio一同举办《GWTF: Go with the Flow》展览。两位艺术家都关注肉眼看不见的事物的流动。艺术家Kim Yeonhong追求的是光、风等自然现象的流动，而艺术家An Rio追求的是"思想"流动所创造的另一个宇宙。本次展览聚焦于两位艺术家的共同主题“流动”。展览的策划意在“随之流动”，每个展厅被分为光、水和木，以突出流动的事物或作家眼中流动产生的产物。

desc_l10n.ko: 가든뷰는 서울의 '가든스 바이 더 베이'인 '서울식물원' 인근에 위치하고 있으며 이를 착안하여 구상된 뷰티&헬스 및 오가닉 전문 스토어 입니다. 어느 한 장르에만 해당되지 않는 여러 장르의 상품들을 접할 수 있는 멀티 스토어로 국내외 다양한 브랜드 상품들을 한번에 경험할 수 있어 고객들에게 많은 사랑을 받고 있습니다. 특히 사후 면세(Global Tax Free)가 적용 가능하고 영어,일본어,중국어 등 통역이 가능하며 외국인 관광객을 대상으로 매장 방문시 다양한 상시 이벤트를 제공하고 있어 큰 인기를 얻고 있습니다.

Planned by the KAIST Experience Design Lab, this exhibition sheds new light on the relationship between the city and humans through data visualization and immersive media.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ヨンドゥンポ(永登浦)の産業・金融・文化が交差する複合的な風景を背景に、都市を「生きている有機体」として再解釈した展示です。KAIST経験デザイン研究室が企画した本展は、データの視覚化や没入型メディアを通じて、都市と人間の関係を新たな視点で照らし出します。
desc_l10n.ko: 영등포의 산업·금융·문화가 교차하는 복합적 풍경을 바탕으로, 도시를 살아 움직이는 유기체로 재해석한 전시입니다. KAIST 경험디자인연구실이 기획한 본 전시는 데이터 시각화와 몰입형 미디어를 통해 도시와 인간의 관계를 새롭게 조명합니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 以永登浦产业、金融、文化交融的复合型城市风貌为基础，这场展览将城市重新诠释为鲜活灵动的有机生命体。由韩国科学技术院（KAIST）体验设计研究室策划的本次展览，通过数据可视化和沉浸式媒体艺术，全新诠释城市与人类之间的关联。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The Helsinki-based design studio COMPANY has traveled the world for the past 20 years in search of unique manufacturing techniques and the local artisans who have preserved them. Their exploration is a process of deeply understanding the cultures and people of unfamiliar lands and falling in love with the whole world, which is 'World Affair' itself. The exhibition showcases the journey of intimate conversations and collaborations that the two artists have shared with makers from all over the world. The exhibition unfolds the 'cycle of ideas' where inspiration gained on-site is realized through the hands of artisans via drawings, and the finished objects meet people in the market and spread out into the world. By following the long journey of a single object from its birth to its encounter with the world, we invite you to feel the value of respect and affection contained in the artists' touch.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ヘルシンキを拠点に活動するデザインスタジオ「COMPANY」は、過去20年余りにわたり、世界各地に息づく独自の製造技術と、それを守り続けてきた地域の職人たちを訪ねる旅を続けてきました。彼らの探検は、見知らぬ土地の文化や人々を深く理解し、世界そのものと恋に落ちるプロセス、すなわち「World Affair」そのものです。本展は、二人の作家が世界中の作り手たちと交わした緊密な対話と、協働の旅路を紐解きます。現地で得たインスピレーションがドローイングを経て職人の手によって形となり、完成したプロダクトが再び市場で人々に出会い、世界へと広がっていく「アイデアの循環」が展示空間に広がります。一つのモノが誕生し、世界と出会うまでの長い旅路を辿りながら、作家の眼差しに込められた敬意と愛情の価値を、ぜひ肌で感じてみてください。
desc_l10n.ko: 헬싱키 기반의 디자인 스튜디오 콤파니(COMPANY)는 지난 20여 년간 전 세계의 고유한 제조 기술과 이를 지켜 온 지역의 장인들을 찾아 여행해 왔습니다. 이들의 탐험은 낯선 땅의 문화와 사람들을 깊이 이해하고, 온 세상과 사랑에 빠지는 과정, 곧 ‘World Affair’ 그 자체입니다. 전시는 두 작가가 세계 곳곳의 제작자들과 나눈 긴밀한 대화와 협업의 여정을 보여줍니다. 현장에서 얻은 영감이 드로잉을 거쳐 장인의 손길로 실현되고, 완성된 물건이 다시 시장에서 사람들을 만나 세상으로 퍼져 나가는 “아이디어의 순환”이 전시 속에 펼쳐집니다. 하나의 물건이 탄생하고 세상과 만나기까지의 긴 여정을 따라가며, 작가의 손길에 담긴 존중과 애정의 가치를 함께 느껴 보시기 바랍니다.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 总部位于赫尔辛基的设计工作室COMPANY，在过去20余年间走遍全球，寻访各地独有的传统制造工艺，以及坚守这些技艺的本土匠人。这场漫长寻访，是深入陌生土地、读懂当地人文与居民，继而爱上整个世界的过程，这也正是本次“World Affair”展览的核心。展览完整呈现两位艺术家与世界各地手艺人深入交流与对话、携手共创的完整历程。从实地采风获得灵感，经由手绘草图落地，再由匠人亲手打磨成实物，成品走入市场、与大众相遇并传播至世界各地——这套“创意循环”将在展览中完整铺展开来。欢迎您跟随一件器物从诞生到与世界相遇的完整旅程，一同感受艺术家倾注在作品之中的尊重和热爱。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} How can we carry forward heritage through digital technology? And in that process, how can human creativity and values be respected? This exhibition, held in collaboration with the NC Cultural Foundation and the 2025 Arumjigi Academy, intersects Arumjigi’s expertise accumulated in the fields of traditional culture and crafts with the NC Cultural Foundation’s long-standing insights into AI, ethics, and creativity. It has been organized as an opportunity to present diverse tangible works that demonstrate the potential of technology to connect past and future, and to bridge generations. Here, you can discover the new heritage created by AI and digital technology and envision a future where technology coexists as a tool while human creativity and values are respected.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} デジタル技術を通じてヘリテージをどのように未来へと受け継いでいけるのでしょうか。 そしてその過程で、人間の創造性や価値はどのように尊重されるべきなのでしょうか。 NC文化財団が主催する2025アルムジギアカデミーと連携した今回の展示では、伝統文化・工芸分野で評価を得てきたアルムジギの専門性に加え、長年にわたりAIや倫理、創造性の分野で研究を重ねてきたNC文化財団の洞察が交差し、技術が過去と未来をつなぎ、世代を超えて広がる可能性を示す多様なコンテンツを紹介します。 AI、デジタル技術が生み出す新しいヘリテージをこの場で体験し、人間の創造性と価値が尊重され、技術が道具として共存しながら未来へと受け継がれていくビジョンを一緒に描いてみませんか。
desc_l10n.ko: 디지털 기술을 통해 헤리티지를 어떻게 이어갈 수 있을까요? 그리고 그 과정에서 인간의 창의성과 가치는 어떻게 존중될 수 있을까요? NC문화재단과 함께하는 2025 아름지기 아카데미와 연계하여 선보이는 이번 전시는 전통문화 ·공예 분야에서 축적된 아름지기의 전문성과, AI·윤리·창의성 분야에서 오랜 담론을 이끌어온 NC문화재단의 통찰이 교차하며, 기술이 과거와 미래를 잇고, 세대와 세대를 잇는 가능성을 보여줄 다양한 실물 콘텐츠를 보여줄 자리로 마련하였습니다. AI, 디지털 기술이 만들어내는 새로운 헤리티지를 이 자리에서 만나며, 인간의 창의성과 가치가 존중되면서 기술이 도구로서 함께 공존하는 미래를 함께 그려봅니다.

And in that process, how can human creativity and values be respected? This exhibition, held in collaboration with the NC Cultural Foundation and the 2025 Arumjigi Academy, intersects Arumjigi’s expertise accumulated in the fields of traditional culture and crafts with the NC Cultural Foundation’s long-standing insights into AI, ethics, and creativity. It has been organized as an opportunity to present diverse tangible works that demonstrate the potential of technology to connect past and future, and to bridge generations. Here, you can discover the new heritage created by AI and digital technology and envision a future where technology coexists as a tool while human creativity and values are respected.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Weaving Relations is an exhibition that spans the theme of "Architecture" for the 2024 Seoul Museum of Art exhibition. It delves into the essential attributes of architecture as a process of creating value and experience through relationship building and examines this process through various conceptual approaches. Weaving Relations induces a shift in perspectives on life by exploring various ways of relationship building, facilitated by physical spaces that serve as fundamental conditions for self-recognition. Through the works of seven artists, the exhibition prompts contemplation on the transformations in how we perceive life. Through this, the aim is to awaken modern individuals to the dynamic value of relationship building, which can counter feelings of isolation and identity loss. The exhibition title, Weaving Relations, borrowed from Antoine de Saint-Exupéry's literary work "The Little Prince," encapsulates the essence of relationship building. Weaving Relations refers to forming relationships based on temporality, repetition, and process while also being grounded in communal nature, which is the essence of architecture. What are we weaving, and what are we being weaved by? The exhibition aims to produce various narratives that accumulate deep relationship moments.

은 서울시립미술관의 2024년 전시 의제인 '건축'을 관통하는 전시로 건축의 본질적 속성을 '관계맺기'를 통해 가치와 경험을 만드는 행위로 파악하고 '관계맺기'를 다양한 개념적 접근으로 살펴보는 전시입니다.
 은 자아를 확인하는 기본 조건이 되는 물리적인 공간, 그리고 그 공간을 매개로 발생하는 '관계맺기'를 다양한 방식으로 이야기하는 7명의 작가와 작품을 통해, 삶을 바라보는 시선의 변화를 유도합니다. 
이를 통해 고립감과 정체성 상실을 느끼는 현대인들에게 '관계맺기'가 갖는 삶의 역동적인 가치를 일깨우고자 합니다.

'길든다'는 것은 시간성과 반복성, 과정을 전제하는 동시에 건축의 본질인 공동성에 바탕한 관계맺기를 의미합니다. 우리는 무엇을 길들이고, 무엇에 길들고 있을까요?

Through the works of seven artists, the exhibition prompts contemplation on the transformations in how we perceive life. Through this, the aim is to awaken modern individuals to the dynamic value of relationship building, which can counter feelings of isolation and identity loss. The exhibition title, Weaving Relations, borrowed from Antoine de Saint-Exupéry's literary work "The Little Prince," encapsulates the essence of relationship building. Weaving Relations refers to forming relationships based on temporality, repetition, and process while also being grounded in communal nature, which is the essence of architecture. What are we weaving, and what are we being weaved by? The exhibition aims to produce various narratives that accumulate deep relationship moments.
name: Weaving Relations

desc_l10n.ko: ‘궁 페스티벌’은 단순한 콘서트형 페스티벌을 넘어, 음악, 음료, 음식 등 다양한 콘텐츠가 어우러지는 ‘복합문화 공간’을 제공합니다. ’궁‘을 테마로 관객을 ‘귀빈’처럼 모시는 특별한 경험을 선사하며, ‘일렉트로닉 음악’과 ‘상모 돌리기’, ‘레이저 쇼’ 등 역동적인 전통문화 요소들이 조화를 이루는 무대에서 새로운 감동을 전달할 예정입니다. 관객들은 ‘눈으로 보이고 들리는 음악’과 ‘귀로 들리고 보이는 음악’을 동시에 경험하며, 기존 페스티벌의 한계를 뛰어넘는 깊은 몰입감을 느낄 수 있습니다. 전통과 현대가 동시에 공존하는 새로운 복합 문화 축제입니다.

desc_l10n.ko: 뚝섬 윈드서핑장은 한강에서 다양한 수상스포츠를 즐길 수 있는 곳입니다. 서핑장 내에 여러 사설 업체들이 모여 있어, 윈드서핑부터 시작해 카약, 패들보드, 패들요가, 바나나보트 등 여러 해상스포츠를 경험해 볼 수 있습니다. 교육 프로그램 또한 1회 체험권, 1일 체험권, 다회 체험권 등으로 다양하기 때문에 동호인 뿐만 아니라 초보자들도 부담없이 함께 즐길 수 있습니다. 렌탈 서비스도 제공하고 있어 외국인 방문객들도 늘고 있는 추세입니다. 이국적인 풍경과 여름의 노을로도 유명한 곳이니, 활동적이고 이색적인 스포츠를 즐기고 싶다면 이곳을 방문해보길 바랍니다.

desc_l10n.en: The Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP) Design Archive KSVD: 1972-1973 exhibition celebrates the 50th anniversary of the founding of the KSVD that established the identity of modern design in Korea. It offers a chance for expo-goers to witness the transformation of social awareness of the development and concept of Korean modern-day visual design that began during the first and second phases of the Five-Year Economic Development Plan back in the '70s, thanks to the proactiveness of designers at the time. ※ This content is provided by the S-TCEP (Seoul - Tourism, Culture, Exhibitions, Performing Arts) Alliance.
desc_l10n.ko: DDP 디자인 아카이브 KSVD: 1972~1993에서는 현대 디자인 정체성 확립의 시작인 KSVD 설립 이후 50주년의 의미를 되새겨보고, 디자이너들이 자발적으로 주도한 활동을 통해 제1·2차 경제개발 5개년 계획 이후 서울 올림픽을 전후로 한국 현대 시각디자인의 발전과 디자인에 대한 사회적 인식의 변화를 살펴볼 수 있다. ※ 본 콘텐츠는 S-TCEP 얼라이언스에서 제공받았습니다. ‘S-TCEP’은‘Seoul-Tourism, Culture, Exhibitions, PerformingArts’의 약자로 서울의 관광·문화·공연·전시 분야 협의체입니다.
desc_l10n.zh: DDP设计档案KSVD：1972~1993为我们展示：建立50周年并设立现代设计的存在属性的KSVD的意义，设计师们主动出击，在韩国第1，2次经济开发5年计划后，在首尔奥运会前后，韩国设计产业的发展以及对设计产业的认识的变化。 . ※ 本 项 目由 S-TECP 联 盟提供， S-TECP 是 Seoul-Tourism, Culture, Exhibitions, PerformingArts’ 的 缩写 ，是首尔市的 观 光，文化，公演，展示 领 域的 协议 委 员会 。

desc_l10n.en: In June, Superior Gallery presents a two-person exhibition by artists Jung Hwa Baek and Joyce Jin, who embody nature, human beings, and love. Both artists showcase their paintings that depict subtle yet heartwarming scenes observed through their unique perspectives on nature and humanity, establishing their own artistic realms. Both artists portray evocative artworks by observing ordinary moments in the surrounding landscapes and interpersonal relationships through their unique perspectives. The colors and visual elements presented by the two artists will create a pleasant and heartwarming experience, evoking feelings of coziness, warmth, and love for the viewers. The exhibition Mood, sunday will run until July 11th.
desc_l10n.ja: Superior Galleryは6月を迎え、自然、人、愛に似た作品を作るチョン・ファベクとジョイス・ジン作家の2人展を開催します。二人は、自然と人から感じられる些細かつ暖かい視線で場面を捉え、自分だけの領域を構築していく作品を作ります。周辺の風景や他人の関係ですれ違う状況を自分の視線で捉え、表現します。見る人に温かさや愛を届ける展示『Mood, sunday』は7月11日まで行われます。
desc_l10n.ko: 슈페리어갤러리는 6월을 맞아 자연을 닮고 사람을 닮고 사랑을 닮은 정화백과 조이스진 작가의 2인전을 선보입니다. 두 작가는 자연과 사람에서 느껴지는 사소하지만 따뜻한 시선으로 바라본 장면을 포착해 자신만의 영역을 구축해나가는 회화를 선보입니다. 주변의 풍경과 타인의 관계에서 스치기 쉬운 상황을 두 작가는 자신만의 시선으로 바라보며 정감 있는 작품을 선보입니다. 두 작가가 선보이는 색감과 화상은 보는 이로 하여금 포근함과 따스함, 사랑을 느끼게 하는 기분 좋은 작품이 될 것입니다. <Mood, sunday>전시는 오는 7월 11일까지 진행됩니다.
desc_l10n.zh: SUPERIOR美术馆为了迎接6月，将推出像大自然、人和爱情的Jung Hwabaek、Joyce-Jin画家的双人展。两位画家捕捉到了大自然和人身上感受到的微小却温暖的场面，展现了自己构建的专属领域绘画。两位画家通过自己的视线捕捉到了周围风景和他人的关系中容易略过的情况，展现了包含了情感的作品。两位画家展现的色彩和画像是让观众感受到柔和、温暖、爱情的能让人心头一暖的作品，《Mood, sunday》将持续举办至7月11日。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 《Where Writing Breathes》 is an exhibition that explores 'Creation', the institutional agenda of the Seoul Museum of Art for 2026. The word 'author' is widely used not only in the art world but also in various fields such as literature and music, strongly connotes the meaning of creation or expressing an artwork originally. This exhibition is inspired by the general perception of an 'author' as a person who writes, namely a litterateur, and seeks to understand artistic creation through 'writing,' paying attention to the texts produced by artists. The exhibition's title, 'Geuljit' (Writing), refers to the gestures of writing that have taken on various forms of movement, metaphorically representing the vitality of writing that passes through the artist's body and unfolds in the exhibition space.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 《クルジッ、書く芸術》は、ソウル市立美術館の2026年の機関議題である「創作」を探求する展示です。美術界のみならず、文学や音楽などさまざまな分野で通用する「作家」という言葉は、芸術作品を独創的に創り出す、あるいは表現するという創作の意味を強く内包しています。本展は、作家を執筆者、すなわち文学家とみなす一般的な認識に着目し、「執筆」を通じて美術の創作を理解し、美術家が生み出す文章に注目します。展示タイトルである「クルジッ」は、多様な形態の動きを持つようになった文章の身振りを意味するもので、作家の身体を通り展示空間に広がる文章の生命力を隠喩しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 《글짓, 쓰는 예술》은 서울시립미술관의 2026년 기관 의제인 ‘창작’을 탐구하는 전시입니다. 미술계뿐 아니라 문학과 음악 등 여러 분야에서 통용되는 ‘작가’라는 단어는 예술 작품을 독창적으로 짓거나 표현한다는 창작의 의미를 강하게 내포합니다. 이번 전시는 작가를 글 쓰는 사람, 즉 문학가로 여기는 일반적인 인식에 착안하여 ‘글쓰기’를 통해 미술 창작을 이해하며, 미술가가 생산하는 글에 주목합니다. 전시의 제목인 ‘글짓’은 여러 형태의 움직임을 갖게 된 글의 몸짓을 의미하는 것으로, 작가의 몸을 통과하여 전시 공간에 펼쳐지는 글의 생명력을 은유합니다.
