You can enjoy natural royal Korean dishes displaying clean and neat taste and harmony of ingredients because the restaurant uses the best ingredients. The restaurant is frequently used for the receptionof domestic and foreign customers.
desc_l10n.ja: 格調高い外観を備える、宮中韓定食の店。天然材料を使い、すっきりとした旨味と材料との調和が織り成す逸品料理を味わうことができます。韓国人はもちろん外国人の接待にも利用されています。
desc_l10n.ko: 봉래헌은 그 외관만큼이나 맛깔스럽고 격조 있는 궁중 한정식 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 蓬莱轩是一家专门提供美味高品质宫廷韩式套餐的餐厅。宫廷韩式套餐采用天然食材，顾客可以品尝到正宗宫廷味道。另外本店是国内外游客在韩国经常 光顾的餐厅之一 。

description: Bongraeheon, serves noble and delicious Korean dishes. You can enjoy natural royal Korean dishes displaying clean and neat taste and harmony of ingredients because the restaurant uses the best ingredients. The restaurant is frequently used for the receptionof domestic and foreign customers.
name: Bongraeheon (Mayfield Hotel)

desc_l10n.en: Nampo Myeonok, established in 1972, was founded by owner Kwak Bong-sun, a native of Jinampo in Pyeongan Province, who settled in Seoul after the Korean War and introduced North Korean-style cold noodles. Now operated by the third generation, the restaurant's Pyongyang cold noodles are characterized by using dongchimi fermented underground in the traditional Pyeongan Province method as the broth. It is said that past presidents have also frequented Nampo Myeonok to enjoy its cold noodles. Inside, there are traditional floor-seating tables where you sit cross-legged, allowing you to experience Korea's traditional seating culture while dining.
desc_l10n.ja: 1972年に開業した南浦面屋は、平安道の真南浦出身のクァク・ボンスン社長が韓国戦争後にソウルに定住し、以北式冷麺を披露した店で、現在3代目に渡って運営されています。平安道の方式通り、冬虫夏草を地中に埋めて発酵させた後、これをスープに使うのがここの平壌冷麺の特徴です。歴代大統領も南浦面屋(ナンポミョンオク:남포면옥)の冷麺を食べに訪れたそうで、店内には両足で座る伝統的な座式テーブルもあり、韓国の伝統的な座式文化を体験しながら食事をすることもできます。
desc_l10n.ko: 동치미 국물 맛이 일품인 평양냉면과 따뜻한 어복쟁반
desc_l10n.zh: 南浦冷面塾成立于 1972 年，是由朝鲜战争结束后定居首尔的平安道镇南浦人郭奉顺创建的第三代餐厅，并引进了北朝鲜风味冷面。该餐厅的特色是将冬菜埋在地下，发酵后用作肉汤。据说，历届总统也喜欢吃南浦面馆的冷面。店内还有传统的坐席，您可以双腿并用，体验韩国传统的坐文化。

description: Nampo Myeonok, established in 1972, was founded by owner Kwak Bong-sun, a native of Jinampo in Pyeongan Province, who settled in Seoul after the Korean War and introduced North Korean-style cold noodles. Now operated by the third generation, the restaurant's Pyongyang cold noodles are characterized by using dongchimi fermented underground in the traditional Pyeongan Province method as the broth. It is said that past presidents have also frequented Nampo Myeonok to enjoy its cold noodles. Inside, there are traditional floor-seating tables where you sit cross-legged, allowing you to experience Korea's traditional seating culture while dining.
name: Nampomyeonok

name_l10n.ja: ナンポミョノッ(南浦麺屋)

desc_l10n.en: A Table is a French restaurant that features comfortable and stylish French cuisine. The daily special depends on what ingredients are bought fresh each day. They serve only set menus, and their specialties are tenderloin, sirloin steak, and marinated lamb chops.
desc_l10n.ja: 洗練されたフランス料理が楽しめるお店。その日に仕入れた材料を使ってメニューを組む。注文はコースのみで、メインメニューはアンシム(牛ヒレ)のステーキ、トゥンシム(牛ロース)のステーキ、ヤンガルビ(ラムリブ)などでから選ぶ。ヤンガルビ(ラムリブ)は5,000ウォン追加。予約必須だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 편하고 세련된 프랑스 밥상을 선보이는 프랑스식 레스토랑.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是一家舒适时尚的法式餐厅。以每天采购回来的食材决定当日的菜单。因为只提供套餐，分别有牛里脊肉、牛排和羊小排供选择。点羊排骨时，得外加5000韩元。本店必须提前预约。

description: A Table is a French restaurant that features comfortable and stylish French cuisine. The daily special depends on what ingredients are bought fresh each day. They serve only set menus, and their specialties are tenderloin, sirloin steak, and marinated lamb chops.
name: A Table

desc_l10n.en: Pan-fried beef (Bulgogi) and cold noodles are popular dishes. Customers especially never forget the true taste of cold noodles and come back again. This is because the simple flavor of broth is made solely from beef. While it keeps the tradition for 60 years, it entered the market of the USA and tries to globalize the dishes.
desc_l10n.ja: 肉と冷麺で有名なお店。牛肉だけで煮込んだスープの淡白な味と風味は絶妙だ。60年間、平壌(ピョンヤン)冷麺の伝統を守りつづけながらアメリカにも進出。冷麺の味を世界に広げようと努力しているところだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 60년 평양냉면의 전통을 지켜오는 동안 미국까지 진출하여 냉면의 세계화.
desc_l10n.zh: 这里著名的是烤肉和冷面。来吃冷面的客人经常光顾的主要原因是为了品尝用牛肉熬制的淸淡口感的汤。这家店继承了平壤(北朝鲜)冷面60年的传统，目前已进入美国饮食市场，立志把冷面推向世界化。

description: Pan-fried beef (Bulgogi) and cold noodles are popular dishes. Customers especially never forget the true taste of cold noodles and come back again. This is because the simple flavor of broth is made solely from beef. While it keeps the tradition for 60 years, it entered the market of the USA and tries to globalize the dishes.
name: Wooraeok

desc_l10n.en: This restaurant specializes in samgyetang (chicken and ginseng soup), which they have served for over 15 years. The samgyetang here is simple with a traditional flavor, and is served with ginseng wine.
desc_l10n.ja: さっぱりとした昔なつかしいサムゲタン(若鶏のスープ)を味わうことができるところ。サムゲタンと一緒に出てくる朝鮮人参酒が食欲をそそる。漢方サムゲタンとあわびが入ったサムゲタンもあり、持ち帰りも可能。
desc_l10n.ko: 15년 넘는 경력의 단순하고 깔끔한 옛 맛이 나는 삼계탕.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到简单的古早味参鸡汤，店家以拥有15年的经验而自豪。与参鸡汤一起端上桌的人参酒相当开胃，还有药炖参鸡汤和鲍鱼参鸡汤。提供打包服务。

description: This restaurant specializes in samgyetang (chicken and ginseng soup), which they have served for over 15 years. The samgyetang here is simple with a traditional flavor, and is served with ginseng wine.
name: Panax

desc_l10n.en: The speciality at this restaurant is beoseot maeuntang, a refreshingly spicy mushroom stew. As the stew first starts boiling, oyster mushrooms and traditional Korean herbs are simmered in the broth, then removed and served. Handmade cut noodles are added to the broth next. After most of the soup has been eaten, a nutritious mixture of stir-fried rice with eggs and diced vegetables is prepared using some of the flavorful broth.
desc_l10n.ja: きのこのメウンタン(ピリ辛鍋)が有名なお店。平茸やセリを少し火に通し味わった後、ここに麺を入れて食べる。さらに、最後に卵やみじん切りの野菜とご飯を入れて味わうこともできる。
desc_l10n.ko: 시원한 버섯매운탕이 유명한 집
desc_l10n.zh: 爽口的香菇辣汤锅为此店的招牌料理。辣汤煮开了之后，便将菇类和水芹放进锅里煮，过一会便可食用。最后将刀切面条放进锅中煮熟，用餐完毕后，店家还会替顾客制作鸡蛋和丰富蔬菜的营养炒饭。

description: The speciality at this restaurant is beoseot maeuntang, a refreshingly spicy mushroom stew. As the stew first starts boiling, oyster mushrooms and traditional Korean herbs are simmered in the broth, then removed and served. Handmade cut noodles are added to the broth next. After most of the soup has been eaten, a nutritious mixture of stir-fried rice with eggs and diced vegetables is prepared using some of the flavorful broth.
name: Gayang Kalguksu Beoseonmaeuntang

name_l10n.ja: カヤン・カルグクス・ボソンメウンタン

desc_l10n.en: Operated by “Living Treasure Of Korean Royal Cuisine” since 1991, Jihwaja is a high-class traditional Korean restaurant located in the center of downtown Seoul. It has enjoyed a high reputation as the finest restaurant that offers The Legitimacy of Korean Royal Cuisine, the essence of the Korean food culture.Jihwaja reflects the sophisticated ambiance of the neighborhood that features a 600-year Joseon Dynasty history. And has been offering very healthy and nutritious dishes, as they are prepared with only natural ingredients and royal culinary techniques, without using any MSG, artificial flavors or additives. Jihwaja has been committing to promote Korea's authentic traditional food culture-Korean Royal Cuisine across the world through the generations.
desc_l10n.ja: 991年から「韓国王室料理の生きた宝」が運営しているチファジャは、ソウルの中心部にある高級伝統的な韓国料理店です。韓国料理文化の本質である「韓国ロイヤル料理法」を誇る最高のレストランとして高い評価を得ています。チファジャは洗練された雰囲気を持つ朝鮮600年の歴史をそのまま反映しています。また、MSGや人工風味、添加物などは一切使わずに天然成分やロイヤル・クッキング技術のみで調理され、健康的で栄養価の高い料理を提供してきました。チファジャは、韓国の伝統的食文化である韓国王室料理を全世界に広めることを約束します。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울의 중심부에 위치한 고급 전통 한식당
desc_l10n.zh: 自1991年开始经营“朝鲜王朝宫廷御膳”的池花子是一家位于首尔市中心的高级传统韩国餐厅。作为最顶级的餐厅，池花子享有很高的声誉，提供韩国皇家美食的专业烹饪，这是韩国饮食文化的精髓。池花子体现了拥有600年朝鲜王朝历史的悠久底蕴，一直提供非常健康和营养的菜肴，因为它们仅使用天然成分和皇家烹饪技术，不使用任何味精，人造香料或添加剂。池花子一直致力于在世界各地推广韩国正宗的传统饮食文化-韩国皇家美食。

description: Operated by “Living Treasure Of Korean Royal Cuisine” since 1991, Jihwaja is a high-class traditional Korean restaurant located in the center of downtown Seoul. It has enjoyed a high reputation as the finest restaurant that offers The Legitimacy of Korean Royal Cuisine, the essence of the Korean food culture.Jihwaja reflects the sophisticated ambiance of the neighborhood that features a 600-year Joseon Dynasty history. And has been offering very healthy and nutritious dishes, as they are prepared with only natural ingredients and royal culinary techniques, without using any MSG, artificial flavors or additives. Jihwaja has been committing to promote Korea's authentic traditional food culture-Korean Royal Cuisine across the world through the generations.
name: Jihwaja

desc_l10n.en: Gumasan has long been famous for loach soup and sizzling marinated beef ribs. The beef, brought to your table freshly grilled, can be a little sweet, but it pairs nicely with the Masan loach soup.
desc_l10n.ja: 汝矣島(ヨイド)で古くから有名なチュオタン(どじょうスープ)と牛カルビの専門店。カルビの味は少し甘め。厨房で焼いてから出されるのですぐ食べることができる 。
desc_l10n.ko: 여의도에서 오랜 기간 유명세를 치르고 있는 추어탕 및 소갈비 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店是在汝矣岛地区享有盛名的泥鳅汤及烤排骨专卖店。店家会先在厨房将肉烤熟后才端给顾客。

description: Gumasan has long been famous for loach soup and sizzling marinated beef ribs. The beef, brought to your table freshly grilled, can be a little sweet, but it pairs nicely with the Masan loach soup.
name: Gumasan

desc_l10n.en: The bakers at Iseungnamui Kkotgwa Ppang made a name for themselves by using flowers to decorate their cakes. You can also taste various cupcakes. You need to place an order one day in advance for one of their flower-decorated cakes. Produced and sold on the same day, so it’s fresh.
desc_l10n.ja: カップケーキとケーキのお店。ケーキに生花を使って話題になったところだ。様々な種類のカップケーキを味わうことができる。生花のケーキは前日までに予約が必要だ。その日に生産し、その日に販売するため、新鮮です。
desc_l10n.ko: 케이크에 생화를 사용하여 화제가 된 케이크전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店因为使用鲜花装饰蛋糕，因此造成话题。在此也能品尝到多种口味的杯子蛋糕。鲜花蛋糕须提早一天预约。 当天生产当天销售，保证新鲜。

description: The bakers at Iseungnamui Kkotgwa Ppang made a name for themselves by using flowers to decorate their cakes. You can also taste various cupcakes. You need to place an order one day in advance for one of their flower-decorated cakes. Produced and sold on the same day, so it’s fresh.
name: Iseungnamui Kkotgwa Ppang

name_l10n.ja: イスンナメ・コッ・グァ・パン

desc_l10n.en: Sujeong specializes in saengtae (fresh pollack) dishes, and their saengtaetang (spicy pollack soup), which is full of egg sacks and innards, is especially excellent. Many people come for saengtaetang at lunchtime, so expect long lines.
desc_l10n.ja: センテチゲ(スケトウダラの鍋)の専門店。内蔵がたっぷり入ったセンテチゲの味は逸品だ。昼食時には並ばないとけないほどの人気店。
desc_l10n.ko: 생태찌개를 전문으로 하는 곳으로, 곤이와 애를 듬뿍 넣은 생태탕 맛이 일품
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为饺子和五香酱肉专卖店，另能品尝到最近已相当罕见的炸牛肉。晚上则可以在此小酌一杯，再搭配一份五香酱肉。价格也相当令人满意。

description: Sujeong specializes in saengtae (fresh pollack) dishes, and their saengtaetang (spicy pollack soup), which is full of egg sacks and innards, is especially excellent. Many people come for saengtaetang at lunchtime, so expect long lines.
name: Sujeong

desc_l10n.en: This restaurant has maintained its reputation as a juk (porridge) specialty restaurant ever since it opened in the Yeouido financial district in 1983. The juk here are savory and crisp-tasting due to their use of fresh, seasonal ingredients. The mostpopular dishes are the abalone juk, the mushroom and oyster juk, and the shrimp juk.
desc_l10n.ja: 1983年にオープン以来、お粥だけで汝矣島(ヨイド)の証券街で名声を維持するお店。新鮮な旬の素材で作ったお粥は、さっぱり味が絶品。
desc_l10n.ko: 30년 가까이 죽 한 가지만으로 여의도 증권가에서 오랫동안 명성을 유지하는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店自从1983年开业后，便仅以粥这一道料理，在汝矣岛证券街享誉盛名。店家使用新鲜时令食材制作出的料理味道鲜美。

description: This restaurant has maintained its reputation as a juk (porridge) specialty restaurant ever since it opened in the Yeouido financial district in 1983. The juk here are savory and crisp-tasting due to their use of fresh, seasonal ingredients. The mostpopular dishes are the abalone juk, the mushroom and oyster juk, and the shrimp juk.
name: Daeyeo

desc_l10n.en: You can enjoy jabeohoe (sashimi made with various small fish) and sekkosi (shredded raw fish). Customers mostly order the assorted platter, or sekkosi, which in this restaurant is a platter of shredded flatfish, flounder, and sole. With every order of sashimi, they serve a refreshing and delicious seaweed soup with fish. They offer an assortment of fishes, such as spot belly rockfish, yellowtail amberjack, black rockfish, black sea bream, gizzard shad fish, sea bream, and horn fish, depending on seasonal availability.
desc_l10n.ja: 刺身専門店。セコシ(背越、魚を骨ごと刺身にする調理法)でも刺身を楽しむことができる。モドゥム(刺身の盛り合わせ)とセコシが人気メニュー。あら汁のミヨグク(わかめスープ)もおいしい。刺身の盛り合わせにはクロソイ、ぶり、クロダイ、コハダ、タイ、サヨリなど様々な旬の魚が出される。
desc_l10n.ko: 잡어 회와 세꼬시를 즐길 수 있는 곳. 대부분 모둠이나 세꼬시 주문.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到杂鱼生鱼片和带骨生鱼片，大多数的顾客会选择综合生鱼片或是带骨生鱼片。带骨生鱼片是使用比目鱼、木叶鲽和高眼鲽等，带骨切制而成。搭配生鱼片一起享用的鲜鱼海带汤，相当清爽可口。综合生鱼片包含有石斑鱼、鲂鱼、目张鱼、黑鲷、鲫鱼、鲷鱼和鱵鱼等各式各样的生鱼片，菜单会根据季节而变换。

description: You can enjoy jabeohoe (sashimi made with various small fish) and sekkosi (shredded raw fish). Customers mostly order the assorted platter, or sekkosi, which in this restaurant is a platter of shredded flatfish, flounder, and sole. With every order of sashimi, they serve a refreshing and delicious seaweed soup with fish. They offer an assortment of fishes, such as spot belly rockfish, yellowtail amberjack, black rockfish, black sea bream, gizzard shad fish, sea bream, and horn fish, depending on seasonal availability.
name: Jindong Hoetjip

name_l10n.ja: チンドン・フェッチブ

desc_l10n.en: Neobijip is famous for spicy galbi jjim (braised short ribs). The beef ribs are marinated in a spicy sauce and then are steamed with rice cakes. It is a very popular dish with Japanese tourists in the Myeongdong area. The fresh galbi and vegetable hot pot are also excellent. They also offer yukhoe, a Korean version of beef tartare in which seasoned, marinated beef is served raw.
desc_l10n.ja: 牛カルビをピリ辛のタレによく漬け込んで餅と共に煮込むメウンカルビチム(ピリ辛味のカルビ煮込み)で有名なお店。明洞(ミョンドン)を訪れた日本人観光客にも人気が高いところだ。カルビの焼肉とヤチェジョンゴル(野菜の寄せ鍋)も絶品。その他ユッケなども味わうことができる。
desc_l10n.ko: 소갈비를 매운 양념에 잘 재워서 떡과 함께 즉석에서 찜을 해 먹는 매운갈비찜.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的招牌料理为，将牛小排均匀涂抹上辣酱后，和年糕一起当场炖煮食用的辣味蒸排骨，此店在明洞一带的日本观光客中亦相当有名。新鲜牛小排和蔬菜锅亦相当出色，还可品尝到生牛肉。

description: Neobijip is famous for spicy galbi jjim (braised short ribs). The beef ribs are marinated in a spicy sauce and then are steamed with rice cakes. It is a very popular dish with Japanese tourists in the Myeongdong area. The fresh galbi and vegetable hot pot are also excellent. They also offer yukhoe, a Korean version of beef tartare in which seasoned, marinated beef is served raw.
name: Neobijip

desc_l10n.en: Ariake is one of the best Japanese restaurants in Seoul, particularly famous for the freshness of their ingredients. They offer a selection of around 90 authentic dishes, showcasing the light-tasting and stylish cuisine of the Kansai prefecture. There is a private room featuring a dignified, modern atmosphere and a harmonious black and white decor that can accommodate four to ten.
desc_l10n.ja: 素材の鮮度がよいことで有名なソウルで屈指の日本料理店の一つ。90種類あまりの関西地方の料理が味わえる。黒と白が調和した店内はモダンな雰囲気で4～10名まで対応できる個室もある。
desc_l10n.ko: 재료의 선도가 좋기로 유명한, 서울에서 손꼽히는 일식집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店以新鲜的食材闻名，为首尔地区顶级日式料理店之一，提供90多种精致清爽的正宗关西料理。店家利用黑白色调营造出时尚气氛，另设有可容纳4至10人的包房。

description: Ariake is one of the best Japanese restaurants in Seoul, particularly famous for the freshness of their ingredients. They offer a selection of around 90 authentic dishes, showcasing the light-tasting and stylish cuisine of the Kansai prefecture. There is a private room featuring a dignified, modern atmosphere and a harmonious black and white decor that can accommodate four to ten.
name: Ariake

desc_l10n.en: Sodo in Yeouido serves Japanese cuisine exclusively. The sashimi course offered at dinnertime is excellent. This is a good place to entertain guests.
desc_l10n.ja: ヨイド()汝矣島に位置する日本料理店。高級な日本食を楽しめるところだ。ディナーの刺身コースが豪華で、接待にも利用しやすい。
desc_l10n.ko: 여의도에서 고급스럽게 일식을 즐길 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为在汝矣岛可以享用到高级日式料理的店家，晚间生鱼片套餐的内容相当丰盛，也很适合招待贵宾到此用餐。

description: Sodo in Yeouido serves Japanese cuisine exclusively. The sashimi course offered at dinnertime is excellent. This is a good place to entertain guests.
name: Sodo

desc_l10n.en: Mado is famous for fried noodles. You'll find noodle dishes named for the main ingredient they're stir-fried with, whether it's seafood or beef. Savour a harmony of flavors: a sauce of simmered seaweed, radish, and grilled garlic, onions, and shallots; katsuobushi (dried, fermented, smoked tuna); and udon noodles of perfect thickness.
desc_l10n.ja: 焼きうどんで有名なところ。シーフード焼きうどんや牛肉焼きうどんなど様々な焼うどんを味わうことができる。にんにく、たまねぎ、葱を焼いて昆布や大根などでしっかり出汁をとったソースの味は絶妙だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 다양한 볶음우동으로 유명한 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店以口味多样的炒乌龙面闻名。炒乌龙面时，根据添加食材的不同，可分为海鲜炒乌龙面和牛肉炒乌龙面等口味。店家会先将大蒜、洋葱和大葱煎烤过，再添加以昆布和萝卜等食材熬煮的浓郁酱汁，最后与鲣鱼片和乌龙面完美的结合在一起。

description: Mado is famous for fried noodles. You'll find noodle dishes named for the main ingredient they're stir-fried with, whether it's seafood or beef. Savour a harmony of flavors: a sauce of simmered seaweed, radish, and grilled garlic, onions, and shallots; katsuobushi (dried, fermented, smoked tuna); and udon noodles of perfect thickness.
name: Mado

desc_l10n.en: Seongminchon is a shabu shabu restaurant with a 20-year history. They serve fresh seafood delivered daily directly from Yeosu. For lunch, the noodles and dumpling hot pot are popular with office workers in the area.
desc_l10n.ja: 20年の伝統を誇るしゃぶしゃぶの専門店。肉類や魚介類のしゃぶしゃぶを味わえる。毎日チョルラナムド(全羅南道)のヨス(麗水)から仕入れる海産物は新鮮だ。ランチにはマンドゥジョンゴル(餃子入りの鍋)が人気。
desc_l10n.ko: 20년 전통의 샤브샤브 전문점. 매일 여수에서 직송 받는 해물이 신선.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为拥有20年传统的涮涮锅专卖店，店家使用每天从丽水新鲜直送的海鲜，因此鲜度极佳。在午餐时段，面条锅或是饺子锅相当受到附近上班族的欢迎。

description: Seongminchon is a shabu shabu restaurant with a 20-year history. They serve fresh seafood delivered daily directly from Yeosu. For lunch, the noodles and dumpling hot pot are popular with office workers in the area.
name: Seongminchon

desc_l10n.en: Huijeong Sikdang serves budae jjigae (spicy sausage stew) made with generous amounts of sausage and ham. The broth is somewhat spicy and light. This place is well-known among the business people in the Yeouido area.
desc_l10n.ja: たっぷりのソーセージやハムが入ったプデチゲ(ソーセージのピリ辛寄せ鍋)の専門店。ピリ辛のとろっとしたスープがおいしい。近隣の汝矣島(ヨイド)のサラリーマンがよく訪れるところ。
desc_l10n.ko: 푸짐한 소시지와 햄 사리의 부대찌개 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为添加大量香肠和火腿的部队锅专卖店，香辣浓稠的汤头令人爱不释口，因此在汝矣岛附近的上班族间颇有名气。一到晚上，丁骨综合牛排也相当受到欢迎。

description: Huijeong Sikdang serves budae jjigae (spicy sausage stew) made with generous amounts of sausage and ham. The broth is somewhat spicy and light. This place is well-known among the business people in the Yeouido area.
name: Huijeong Sikdang

desc_l10n.en: Hwangsaengga Kalguksu (formerly Bukchon Kalguksu) is one of the most popular restaurants in Samcheong-dong. Big meat dumplings and noodles served in beef broth – this is what Hwangsaengga is all about. The dumplings contain nine different types of vegetables. Try to steer clear of the busy lunch and dinner hours if possible to avoid long waits for seats.
desc_l10n.ja: ファンセンガきしめんは、サムチョンドン(三清洞)を代表する美味しい店で ピョンヤン(平壌)式牛骨きしめん(カルグクス)専門店です。ワンマンドゥ(大きな蒸し餃子)といっしょに食べると、牛骨ダシとシコシコした麺が美味しく感じられる。9種類の野菜入りの餡がもちもちした皮に包まれたワンマンドゥ、きしめんが代表的なメニュー。昼食と夕食の時間帯は非常に混むので注意。
desc_l10n.ko: 인기 메뉴는 왕만두가 들어간 버섯전골, 1인분에 왕만두 3개와 칼국수.
desc_l10n.zh: 三清洞有名的美食餐馆，主营平壤式乡村刀切面。香浓的牛骨汤配上滑顺的面条，吃起来喷香可口。用9种蔬菜与筋道的饺子皮包出来的大蒸饺也是极受欢迎的菜品之一。午餐和晚餐时间总是人满为患，建议您避开高峰时间，选择人少时前往。

description: Hwangsaengga Kalguksu (formerly Bukchon Kalguksu) is one of the most popular restaurants in Samcheong-dong. Big meat dumplings and noodles served in beef broth – this is what Hwangsaengga is all about. The dumplings contain nine different types of vegetables. Try to steer clear of the busy lunch and dinner hours if possible to avoid long waits for seats.
name: Hwangsaengga Kalguksu

name_l10n.ja: ファンセンガきしめん
name_l10n.zh: 黄生家刀切面（原北村刀切面）

desc_l10n.en: The reasonable prices at Ttalgigol Bunsik have made it a favorite among students of Ehwa Women's University for over 40 years. You can choose from a variety of Korean food, but the bulgogi dolsot (marinated thinly shredded beef in a stone pot of rice)and sundubu jjigae (soft tofu stew) are the most popular.
desc_l10n.ja: イファ(梨花)女子大学とヨンセ(延世)大学の間にある学生に人気の韓国料理のお店。40年もの間学生に愛されてきたところだ。学生街だけあり安い価格で味わえる。プルゴギ定食やスンドゥブ(おぼろ豆腐のピリ辛鍋)が人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 40년 동안 이대 학생들에게 저렴한 가격으로 인기 있는 분식집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为小吃店，因价格低廉，故40年来一直相当受到梨花女子大学学生的喜爱，人气料理为石锅烤肉和豆腐锅。

description: The reasonable prices at Ttalgigol Bunsik have made it a favorite among students of Ehwa Women's University for over 40 years. You can choose from a variety of Korean food, but the bulgogi dolsot (marinated thinly shredded beef in a stone pot of rice)and sundubu jjigae (soft tofu stew) are the most popular.
name: Ttalgigol Bunsik

desc_l10n.en: This wine bar is a great place to relax and enjoy some wine. Boiled eggs are served as a basic side dish, and there are also such fusion side dishes as samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly) and salmon, which are excellent. They have a good selection of wines in the 30,000 and 40,000 won range. The recommended side dish is samgyeopsal seasoned with horseradish sauce. It is fully packed at dinnertime, but unfortunately they do not take reservations, so arriving early is recommended.
desc_l10n.ja: 気軽にワインを楽しむことができるワイン居酒屋。付き出しとしてゆで卵がでる。豚の三枚肉やサーモンなどを使ったフュージョン料理がおいしい。特におすすめはワサビソースサムギョプサル(わさびソースの三枚肉)。3～4万ウォン台と値頃のワインを多く揃えている。
desc_l10n.ko: 편안한 분위기에서 와인을 즐길 수 있는 와인 선술집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为顾客可以在轻松的气氛下享用美酒的小酒馆。进到店内后店家会端上基本的下酒菜–水煮蛋，以及五花肉、鲢鱼等各种下酒菜也相当美味，店家还提供许多3万至4万元的葡萄酒，推荐下酒菜为芥末五花肉。晚餐时段经常客满但店家不接受预约。

description: This wine bar is a great place to relax and enjoy some wine. Boiled eggs are served as a basic side dish, and there are also such fusion side dishes as samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly) and salmon, which are excellent. They have a good selection of wines in the 30,000 and 40,000 won range. The recommended side dish is samgyeopsal seasoned with horseradish sauce. It is fully packed at dinnertime, but unfortunately they do not take reservations, so arriving early is recommended.
name: Mamma KiKi

desc_l10n.en: Miumiu serves Hanwoo The meat is grilled over charcoals in a ceramic brazier. A selection of wines are available to accompany the meat, and the décor of the restaurant is modern.
desc_l10n.ja: 韓牛焼の専門店です 。陶器の炭火七輪で焼いて食べるのが特徴的だ。ワインも備えていて、焼肉と一緒に楽しむのもおすすめ。モダンな雰囲気のインテリアも印象的だ 。
desc_l10n.ko: 한우를 전문으로 하는 곳. 도자기 화로에 내오는 참숯.
desc_l10n.zh: 这是一家韩式烤牛肉专门店 ，将鲜美的牛肉放在陶瓷炭火烤炉上烧烤。另备有几种适合与烤肉一起享用的葡萄酒。室内装潢也充满时尚风。

description: Miumiu serves Hanwoo The meat is grilled over charcoals in a ceramic brazier. A selection of wines are available to accompany the meat, and the décor of the restaurant is modern.
name: Miumiu

desc_l10n.en: Enjoy Chinese cuisine in an atmosphere that seamlessly combines the classic and modern with great views of Seokchon Lake and Jamsil.
desc_l10n.ja: 中華料理レストラン。古典的な雰囲気と現代的な雰囲気を一度に感じることができるところだ。ソクチョンホス(石村湖水)を眺めながら食事を楽しめる。
desc_l10n.ko: 모던한 분위기에서 품격있게 중국요리를 즐길 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以同时感受到古典与现代的氛围，并能一边眺望石村湖水和蚕室的美景，一边品尝中式料理。

description: Enjoy Chinese cuisine in an atmosphere that seamlessly combines the classic and modern with great views of Seokchon Lake and Jamsil.
name: Dorim

desc_l10n.en: Alladinui Yanggogi is a restaurant that specializes in Arabic-style lamb. Lamb is seasoned Arabic-style and chargrilled. The lamb meat wrapped in pita is delicious.
desc_l10n.ja: アラブ式の羊肉のレストラン。アラブ式に味付けした肉を炭火で焼いて食べる料理だ。ピタパンに包んでサンドイッチのように食べるとまた違った味を楽しめる。
desc_l10n.ko: 아랍식으로 양념한 고기를 숯불에 구워 먹는 것이 특징.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到阿拉伯式的烤羊肉，特色在于将以阿拉伯方式腌渍过的羊肉，放在炭火上烧烤。若是以口袋饼包裹享用，则别有一番风味。

description: Alladinui Yanggogi is a restaurant that specializes in Arabic-style lamb. Lamb is seasoned Arabic-style and chargrilled. The lamb meat wrapped in pita is delicious.
name: Alladinui Yanggogi

desc_l10n.en: Eoyang's speciality is seafood. Fish, such as sea bream and rockfish, are caught on the fly from a large aquarium in a corner of the kitchen. They offer an assortment of sauces that go nicely with shrimp or meat, and you can order your choice of sauce, just like in China. They are also well-known for eoyang duban juice, made by boiling pork shanks with Asian medicinal ingredients, and then steaming them.
desc_l10n.ja: 海産料理がおいしい中華料理店。厨房に大きな生け簀があり活魚を調理してくれる。中国本場のようにソースや調理法を選ぶこともできる。 漢方薬と一緒に煮込んだも豚足のオヤントゥバンジュースも有名だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 해산물 요리에 강한 곳으로, 주방 한쪽에 커다란 수족관 보유.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为海鲜料理相当出名的中式餐厅。厨房一角设有巨大的水族箱，因此能保证石斑鱼和鲷鱼等食材的新鲜。此店和中国一样，顾客可以选择各式各样的酱汁搭配。将猪脚和中药材一起炖烂后，再进行蒸煮的渔阳豆瓣猪肉也相当有名。

description: Eoyang's speciality is seafood. Fish, such as sea bream and rockfish, are caught on the fly from a large aquarium in a corner of the kitchen. They offer an assortment of sauces that go nicely with shrimp or meat, and you can order your choice of sauce, just like in China. They are also well-known for eoyang duban juice, made by boiling pork shanks with Asian medicinal ingredients, and then steaming them.
name: Eoyang

desc_l10n.en: Located in a quiet residential neighborhood, Retrooven is a bakery that is well known for its tasty bread. They offer many kinds of bread, like ciabata and olive bread, and their primary concern is the taste of the bread itself, rather than the amount of fillings. The bread has an excellent chewy texture. Most of their bread is sold-out early in the afternoon, it is advisable to either visit early or call ahead.
desc_l10n.ja: 閑静な住宅街にあるベーカリーショップ。様々な材料を入れて作るよりも、チャバタやオリーブパンのようにパン自体の味に重点を置いている。午後になると商品のほとんどがなくなるため、パンが残っているか確認してから行くのがおすすめだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 치아바타나 올리브빵 같이 빵 자체의 맛에 중점을 둔 빵 맛이 좋기로 유명한 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在幽静住宅区附近的面包店，比起内馅，较注重意大利拖鞋面包或橄榄面包等，以面包本身的味道为中心，口感软却带有嚼劲的面包，大部分的面包到下午就卖完了，早点去或先打电话询问较好。

description: Located in a quiet residential neighborhood, Retrooven is a bakery that is well known for its tasty bread. They offer many kinds of bread, like ciabata and olive bread, and their primary concern is the taste of the bread itself, rather than the amount of fillings. The bread has an excellent chewy texture. Most of their bread is sold-out early in the afternoon, it is advisable to either visit early or call ahead.
name: Retrooven

desc_l10n.en: La Bonne Tarte dessert shop's mission is to make snacks that are healthy, even for children. They offer pies made with various ingredients, such as walnuts, walnut cream cheese, walnut chocolate chips, sweet potatoes, pumpkins, chocolates, apples, andblueberry cheese. You can also enjoy a cup of tea with your pie
desc_l10n.ja: 子供たちに安心して食べさせることができるおやつを作ろう、というコンセプトで始まったお店。くるみ、くるみクリームチーズ、くるみチョコレートチップ、さつまいも、かぼちゃ、チョコレート、りんご、ブルーベリーチーズなどのパイがある。お茶も一緒に楽しめるカフェも兼ねている。
desc_l10n.ko: 집에서 직접 만든 듯한 타르트를 먹을 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为以制作可以安心让孩子食用的点心为概念所开设的店家。店内备有核桃、奶油奶酪核桃、巧克力核桃、蕃薯、南瓜、巧克力、苹果和蓝莓等口味的甜派。另有兼营可搭配茶品一起享用的咖啡厅。

description: La Bonne Tarte dessert shop's mission is to make snacks that are healthy, even for children. They offer pies made with various ingredients, such as walnuts, walnut cream cheese, walnut chocolate chips, sweet potatoes, pumpkins, chocolates, apples, andblueberry cheese. You can also enjoy a cup of tea with your pie
name: La Bonne Tarte

desc_l10n.en: Musha is one of the izakaya (Japanese-style bars) which have recently become so popular in the Seorae Maeul area. Their sake list is quite good. They have an open kitchen, rooms with Japanese tatami floor mats, as well as outdoor tables.
desc_l10n.ja: 日本料理店。鯛のあら煮をはじめ、鶏の軟骨から揚げ、コノワタ、とろろ、ウニ、いくら和えなどがおすすめだ。日本酒の種類も豊富。 オープンキッチンになっていて畳み席、テラス席もある。 ​
desc_l10n.ko: 일본식 이자카야. 도미머리조림, 닭연골튀김, 고노와다, 간 마와 연어알과 참치가 같이 나오는 참치 도로로 우니 이쿠라 아에 등이 추천 메뉴.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为最近在Seorae Maeul地区风行的居酒屋之一。红烧鲷鱼头、酥炸鸡软骨、海鼠肠、山药泥搭配鲑鱼卵、鲔鱼和海胆的海鲜料理等，都是人气菜色，清酒的选择也不少。厨房采开放式设计，入口处备有榻榻米座位，室外也设有桌椅。

description: Musha is one of the izakaya (Japanese-style bars) which have recently become so popular in the Seorae Maeul area. Their sake list is quite good. They have an open kitchen, rooms with Japanese tatami floor mats, as well as outdoor tables.
name: Musha

desc_l10n.en: Biwon Son Kalguksu is a kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup) restaurant that has been in the Changkyunggung palace area for 30 years. The noodle soup is made with Korean beef flank and is light-tasting and delicious. Their mandu jeongol (dumpling hot pot) is also very good. The delicious dumplings are stuffed with mushrooms and other ingredients.
desc_l10n.ja: 昌慶宮(チャンギョングン)近くで30年営業しているカルクグス(韓国式うどん)のお店。ブランド韓国産牛の韓牛(ハヌ)のヤンジ(胸肉)でとったスープがおいしい。具だくさんの餃子が入ったマンドゥジョンゴル(餃子入り鍋)もおすすめだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 창경궁 부근에 있는 한우 양지로 국물을 낸 30년 된 칼국수 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 昌庆宫附近经营30年的刀切面店，用韩牛炖汤的汤汁清淡美味，这里的汤饺味倒也很特别，香菇和有着满满馅料的饺子很不错。

description: Biwon Son Kalguksu is a kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup) restaurant that has been in the Changkyunggung palace area for 30 years. The noodle soup is made with Korean beef flank and is light-tasting and delicious. Their mandu jeongol (dumpling hot pot) is also very good. The delicious dumplings are stuffed with mushrooms and other ingredients.
name: Biwon Son Kalguksu

name_l10n.ja: ピウォン・ソンカルクグス

desc_l10n.en: At Aji Gen you can get a drink accompanied by Japanese tempura and odeng (skewers of fish cake cooked in a broth). The restaurant is Japanese-owned, so the majority of the customers are Japanese. The fried dishes are the best, like the crispy deep-fried chicken karaage or agedashi tofu, which is battered and served drizzled with soy sauce.
desc_l10n.ja: てんぷらやおでんなどを肴に一杯楽しめるお店。日本人が経営するところで、客も大半が日本人。どれもおいしいが、鶏のから揚げや揚げ出し豆腐が特に人気。
desc_l10n.ko: 일식 튀김과 오뎅에 술 한잔을 걸치기 좋은 곳. 일본인이 운영하는 식당.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为适合享用日式油炸和关东煮，并且小酌一杯的好地方。此店为日本人所经营，因此大部分的顾客也都是日本人。将鸡肉炸得酥脆的炸鸡，或是将豆腐裹上面粉稍微油炸后捞起，并淋上酱油酱汁的炸豆腐等炸物，皆相当美味。

description: At Aji Gen you can get a drink accompanied by Japanese tempura and odeng (skewers of fish cake cooked in a broth). The restaurant is Japanese-owned, so the majority of the customers are Japanese. The fried dishes are the best, like the crispy deep-fried chicken karaage or agedashi tofu, which is battered and served drizzled with soy sauce.
name: Aji Gen

desc_l10n.en: Chuncheonjip Dakgalbi Makguksu is a dakgalbi restaurant. Dakgalbi is a dish of spicy chicken and vegetables that is grilled on a massive hot plate right at your table. The meat is boneless, making it easy to eat. Macaroni salad and kimchi comes as sides.
desc_l10n.ja: タッカルビ(鶏肉のピリ辛炒め)の専門店。鶏肉とキャベツなどの野菜を炒めたタッカルビはボリューム満点。あらかじめ骨を取り除いてあるので食べやすい。おかずのマカロニとキムチはお替り自由だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 닭갈비 고기에 매운 양념을 하여 철판에 볶아 먹는 닭갈비집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店提供辣炒鸡排，店家会将以辣酱腌渍过的鸡排肉置于铁板上，炒至熟透后便可食用，且辣炒鸡排经过剔骨，因此方便食用。随餐附赠的通心面和辛奇（kimchi）皆可续点。

description: Chuncheonjip Dakgalbi Makguksu is a dakgalbi restaurant. Dakgalbi is a dish of spicy chicken and vegetables that is grilled on a massive hot plate right at your table. The meat is boneless, making it easy to eat. Macaroni salad and kimchi comes as sides.
name: Chuncheonjip Dakgalbi Makguksu

name_l10n.ja: チュンチョンチブ・ダッカルビ・マッククス
name_l10n.zh: 春川家 辣炒鸡排 荞麦面(Chuncheonjipdakgalbimakguksu)

desc_l10n.en: Niwa is a cozy izakaya (Japanese-style bar) located within the traditional market that is in the center of Korea's Japanese neighborhood of Ichon-dong. It is quite hard to find, but they always have many customers at dinner time.
desc_l10n.ja: イチョンドン(二村洞)の中央市場に位置する日本居酒屋。見つけにくい位置だが、夜になると多くの人で賑うところだ。日本式の家庭料理を日本酒とともに味わうことができる。
desc_l10n.ko: 이촌동 중앙재래시장 안에 있는 아담한 이자카야.  일본식 가정요리를 안주 삼아 가볍게 사케 한잔하기 좋은 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为位于二村洞中央传统市场内的雅致居酒屋。虽然店址不易寻找，但一到晚上顾客便蜂拥而至。在此可以一边享用日式家常料理作为下酒菜，一边愉快地享用清酒。

description: Niwa is a cozy izakaya (Japanese-style bar) located within the traditional market that is in the center of Korea's Japanese neighborhood of Ichon-dong. It is quite hard to find, but they always have many customers at dinner time.
name: Niwa

desc_l10n.en: Builgalbi is the Seoul branch of a famous galbi restaurant in Busan. The representative dish here is sogeumgui, partly-frozen thinly-sliced sirloin that is grilled and dipped into an egg yolk-based sauce. To cleanse your palate after the meat course, take the opportunity to try their naengmyeon (cold buckwheat noodles), available either in an iced broth or mixed with a spicy chili sauce. Popular choices for lunch are their yukgaejang (spicy beef soup) and galbi-tang (short rib soup).
desc_l10n.ja: プサン(釜山)で有名な焼き肉店のソウル支店。薄く切った牛ヒレ肉を卵の黄身で作ったタレにつけて食べるソグムグイ(塩焼き)が代表メニューだ。肉を食べた後の締めはネンミョン(冷麺)がおすすめ。お昼時はユッケジャン(野菜と牛肉のピリ辛スープ)やカルビタン(カルビのスープ)などが人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 부산에서 유명한 갈빗집의 서울 분점. 소금구이.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为釜山知名的烤排骨店在首尔的分店。招牌菜为盐烤牛里脊，吃法是将稍微冷冻后再切成薄片的牛里脊烤熟后，沾佐以蛋黄制成的酱料享用。享用完烤肉后，则可以以冷面来解油腻。午餐时段的人气料理为辣牛肉汤和排骨汤等。

description: Builgalbi is the Seoul branch of a famous galbi restaurant in Busan. The representative dish here is sogeumgui, partly-frozen thinly-sliced sirloin that is grilled and dipped into an egg yolk-based sauce. To cleanse your palate after the meat course, take the opportunity to try their naengmyeon (cold buckwheat noodles), available either in an iced broth or mixed with a spicy chili sauce. Popular choices for lunch are their yukgaejang (spicy beef soup) and galbi-tang (short rib soup).
name: Builgalbi

desc_l10n.en: Bongsanjip is renowned for grilled chadolbagi (brisket point cut). The great taste comes from the marinade, a mix of soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, green onions, onion, and chili pepper.
desc_l10n.ja: チャドルバギ(あばら肉の焼肉)で有名な焼き肉店。薄くスライスしたチャドルバギをソースに付けて食べる。醤油ベースに長ネギや玉ネギなどを絶妙に配合したソースが味の秘訣だ。田舎風テンジャンチゲ(味噌鍋)も人気メニューだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 맛있는 차돌박이와 특제 양념소스의 조화로운 노포맛집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的霜降牛肉相当有名。美味的秘诀在于将酱油、砂糖、白醋、葱、洋葱和辣椒等，以适当比例调配而成的酱汁。搭配霜降牛肉一起享用的乡村风大豆酱锅亦相当有名。

description: Bongsanjip is renowned for grilled chadolbagi (brisket point cut). The great taste comes from the marinade, a mix of soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, green onions, onion, and chili pepper.
name: Bongsanjip

desc_l10n.en: The food is very fresh at Namseoul Minmul Jangeo; eels are put on the grill only once the order has been taken. The first course is eel bone tempura, eel porridge, and sauce. Fresh live eel is grilled front and back and basted with seasoning sauce five times, for about half an hour. The eel soup is made from eel bones that have been boiled and reduced for about five or six hours and is flavored with Chinese cabbage and Korean soy bean paste, yielding an exquisite flavor.
desc_l10n.ja: うなぎ専門店。ここは、注文を受けてから焼き始めるところだ。先に出されたうなぎの骨せんべいやうなぎのかゆを食べながら、何回もソースを塗りながら30分ほどじっくり焼くうなぎを待つ。うなぎの骨を5･6時間煮込んで白菜をいれ、みそで味をつけたスープも美味。
desc_l10n.ko: 소금구이의 담백한 매력의 장어,먹장어요리
desc_l10n.zh: 店家的鳗鱼并未先烤好放置，而是现点现烤。在享用烤鳗鱼前，店家会先送上炸鳗鱼骨、鳗鱼粥和烤鳗鱼的酱汁，再将新鲜现抓的鳗鱼放于烤盘上，翻面几次，约涂抹5次酱汁，烤约30分钟。将鳗鱼骨熬煮5、6个小时后，再用白菜和大豆酱提味的鳗鱼汤也是风味绝佳。

description: The food is very fresh at Namseoul Minmul Jangeo; eels are put on the grill only once the order has been taken. The first course is eel bone tempura, eel porridge, and sauce. Fresh live eel is grilled front and back and basted with seasoning sauce five times, for about half an hour. The eel soup is made from eel bones that have been boiled and reduced for about five or six hours and is flavored with Chinese cabbage and Korean soy bean paste, yielding an exquisite flavor.
name: Namseoul Minmul Jangeo

name_l10n.ja: ナムソウル・ミンムルジャンオ

desc_l10n.en: ​ Located at the entrance to Seorae Village, this premium wine select shop offers wine classes and space rental on the basement level.
desc_l10n.ja: ソレ 村 の 初入口 にあるプレミアムワインセレクトショップ 、 地下 1 階 のワインクラス 、 空間 レンタルが 可能 です 。
desc_l10n.ko: 프리미엄 와인 셀렉샵, 지하 1층 와인 클래스 및 공간대여 가능
desc_l10n.zh: 这家高级葡萄酒精品店位于西莱村入口处 ， 提供 B1 葡萄酒课程和场地租赁服务

description: ​ Located at the entrance to Seorae Village, this premium wine select shop offers wine classes and space rental on the basement level.
name: Winenara

desc_l10n.en: Nodeulgang is famous for croaker, a type of fish eaten (particularly in summer) for its energizing properties. The croaker is cured, giving the fish a nice firmness. After the croaker sashimi, a soup is served, made with the same fish. In addition tothe croaker, their hongeo samhap (a combination of three ingredients: aged skate, boiled pork, and fermented kimchi) also tastes great.
desc_l10n.ja: にべ料理で有名なお店。にべの歯ごたえが絶品だ。ミノフェ(にべの刺身)を注文すると皮と腹の刺身も一緒に出される。あらで作ったミノタン(にべのスープ)もおいしい。にべ以外にも発酵させたガンギエイと豚肉、キムチを一緒に食べるホンタクサムハプもおすすめだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 민어로 유명한 집으로, 민어를 적당히 숙성시켜 쫄깃한 맛. 민어회를 시키면 껍질과 부레, 뱃살이 함께 나옴 .  민어 외에도 홍어와 돼지고기, 신김치를 곁들인 삼합에다 동동주를 함께 먹는 홍탁삼합.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为黄姑鱼专卖店，熟成后的黄姑鱼口感带点黏性和韧性。黄姑鱼生鱼片的内容还包含鱼皮、鱼鳔和腹肉。黄姑鱼汤则是以鱼头和鱼卵烹煮而成。除黄姑鱼外，店家还有提供将魟鱼片、猪肉和酸辛奇（kimchi）一起包起来食用，并且附上咚咚酒的魟鱼三合一套餐。

description: Nodeulgang is famous for croaker, a type of fish eaten (particularly in summer) for its energizing properties. The croaker is cured, giving the fish a nice firmness. After the croaker sashimi, a soup is served, made with the same fish. In addition tothe croaker, their hongeo samhap (a combination of three ingredients: aged skate, boiled pork, and fermented kimchi) also tastes great.
name: Nodeulgang

desc_l10n.en: Obaltan makes delicious grilled beef tripe and large intestine. The secret behind the great taste is the marinade; red pepper powder, pineapple, garlic, ginger, sugar, and starch syrup are added to soy sauce and reduced with green onion and licorice root.A nice way to end the meal is with savory cheonggukjang (a stew of fermented soy bean paste) and nurungji (a thin crust of scorched rice from the bottom of the pot). Recommended for lunch are gopchang jeongol (a spicy casserole of beef intestines andvegetables) and yangbap (rice fried with sliced tripe on a griddle).
desc_l10n.ja: 牛のミノやコプチャン(ホルモン焼き)がおいしいお店。醤油や唐辛子の他にパイナップルや水あめなどが入ったタレが味の秘訣。コプチャンの最後には、チョングクチャン(納豆味噌鍋)がぴったり。お昼にはホルモンとご飯を鉄板でいためたポックンパブ(炒飯)がおすすめ。
desc_l10n.ko: 양, 대창구이가 맛있는 집. 양념 양곱창을 숯불에 구워 먹는 것이 특징.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为烤牛肚和烤牛大肠相当美味的店家。在酱油中加入大葱、甘草、辣椒粉、菠萝、大蒜、生姜、砂糖和水贻等制作而成的酱料，是美味的秘诀。最后以香气十足的清曲酱汤和锅巴为这一餐画上句号，是再好不过。午餐时段，则可以选择来份牛小肠锅，或是将牛肚切好后放至铁板拌炒的牛肚炒饭。

description: Obaltan makes delicious grilled beef tripe and large intestine. The secret behind the great taste is the marinade; red pepper powder, pineapple, garlic, ginger, sugar, and starch syrup are added to soy sauce and reduced with green onion and licorice root.A nice way to end the meal is with savory cheonggukjang (a stew of fermented soy bean paste) and nurungji (a thin crust of scorched rice from the bottom of the pot). Recommended for lunch are gopchang jeongol (a spicy casserole of beef intestines andvegetables) and yangbap (rice fried with sliced tripe on a griddle).
name: Obaltan

desc_l10n.en: You can enjoy wild hoe (sashimi) and seafood here. This restaurant isn't luxurious, but their food is quite satisfactory for the price. The restaurant is not very big, but it is very clean. Both wild and farm-raised fish are available.
desc_l10n.ja: 天然魚介類の刺身と海産物料理が味わえるところ。高級な雰囲気ではないが価格に比べて満足度は高い。養殖と天然物はメニューが異なっている。
desc_l10n.ko: 가격대비 만족도가 높은 자연산 회와 해물을 즐길 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以享用到野生的生鱼片和海鲜。价格非常平易近人。室内空间不大，但环境却相当整洁。菜单分为养殖和野生2种，价格也有些许的差异。

description: You can enjoy wild hoe (sashimi) and seafood here. This restaurant isn't luxurious, but their food is quite satisfactory for the price. The restaurant is not very big, but it is very clean. Both wild and farm-raised fish are available.
name: Macha Hoejip

desc_l10n.en: Hakoya specializes in Japanese ramen, udon, and soba (buckwheat noodles). They serve regional varieties of ramen, such as Hakata-style tonkatsu ramen (with pork broth) and Hokkaido-style shoyu ramen (with soy sauce). The noodles are all imported directly from Japan.
desc_l10n.ja: 豊富な種類の日本風ラーメンや蕎麦、うどんを専門に扱っているところ。博多風とんこつラーメン、北海道醤油ラーメンなど日本各地のラーメンを味わえる。麺は日本で製麺されたものを直輸入している。
desc_l10n.ko: 다양한 종류의 일식 라멘, 우동, 소바 등을 전문으로 하는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为各种日式拉面、乌龙面和荞麦面专卖店，提供博德豚骨拉面和北海道酱油拉面等日本各地的特色拉面，面条都是直接从日本进口的日制面条。

description: Hakoya specializes in Japanese ramen, udon, and soba (buckwheat noodles). They serve regional varieties of ramen, such as Hakata-style tonkatsu ramen (with pork broth) and Hokkaido-style shoyu ramen (with soy sauce). The noodles are all imported directly from Japan.
name: Hakoya

desc_l10n.en: Daeu Sikdang is the place to go to have spicy budae jjigae (spicy sausage stew). The main ingredients of this stew are ham, sausage, minced beef, rice cakes and noodles. The restaurant is comfortable and spacious, making it great for company dinners.
desc_l10n.ja: プデチゲ(ソーセージのピリ辛寄せ鍋)の有名店。ハム、ソーセージ、ミンチそして餅や麺などが主な材料として入っている鍋だ。平茸、マッシュルーム、セリ、春菊などの野菜類も豊富に入っている。店内は快適で広々しており、会社の集まりの場としてもよい。
desc_l10n.ko: 우리식 부대찌개를 맛볼 수 있는 곳. 햄, 소시지, 다진 고기와 떡, 국수사리 등이 주재료.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到韩式部队锅。店家会在锅中加入火腿、香肠、肉末、年糕和面条等主要食材，此外，蔬菜种类也相当丰富，有袖珍菇、洋菇、水芹和茼蒿等。室内环境相当舒适，也适合作为聚会的场地。

description: Daeu Sikdang is the place to go to have spicy budae jjigae (spicy sausage stew). The main ingredients of this stew are ham, sausage, minced beef, rice cakes and noodles. The restaurant is comfortable and spacious, making it great for company dinners.
name: Daewoo Budae Jjigae

desc_l10n.en: This is a traditional Dim Sum restaurant. If you’d like to try various kinds of dim sum and other Chinese dishes, try the set menu. In addition, the salad and fruit bar buffet is open to all.
desc_l10n.ja: 本格的な点心が味わえるレストラン。セットメニューは、中華料理と各種点心が楽しめ、単品も比較的手ごろな値段でたっぷり食べられる。野菜とフルーツサラダはお変わり自由だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 정통 딤섬을 맛볼 수 있는 곳으로  중식요리와 여러 종류의 딤섬이 주메뉴
desc_l10n.zh: 经营正宗中式点心。套餐包括中国料理和各式点心，单点的话价格也很公道，并且无限量供应蔬菜和水果沙拉。

description: This is a traditional Dim Sum restaurant. If you’d like to try various kinds of dim sum and other Chinese dishes, try the set menu. In addition, the salad and fruit bar buffet is open to all.
name: Western China

desc_l10n.en: Sicily is a cafe that specializes in hand-drip coffee, and is well-known for its excellent-tasting coffee. Here, you'll find raw coffee beans which are also available for purchase. They also offer light fare such as pasta dishes served with salad, bread, and coffee. The atmosphere here is classic and comfortable.
desc_l10n.ja: ハンドドリップコーヒーの専門店。韓国では珍しいデカフェの豆も取り揃えていてるところだ。食事メニューのパスタには、サラダ、パン、コーヒーが付いてくる
desc_l10n.ko: 커피 맛이 훌륭하기로 인정받고 있는 핸드 드립 커피 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为手冲滤泡式咖啡专卖店，在此可以见到雨季马拉巴、无咖啡因等咖啡生豆，亦有销售咖啡原豆。用餐方面则能品尝到意大利面，并且随餐附赠色拉、面包和咖啡。

description: Sicily is a cafe that specializes in hand-drip coffee, and is well-known for its excellent-tasting coffee. Here, you'll find raw coffee beans which are also available for purchase. They also offer light fare such as pasta dishes served with salad, bread, and coffee. The atmosphere here is classic and comfortable.
name: Sicily

desc_l10n.en: At Itsumo you can enjoy a variety of Japanese side dishes, such as tofu tempura and octopus salad seasoned with vinegar, both of which go nicely with ponzu sauce. Recommended is the Nagasaki chanpon, a spicy noodle soup with seafood and vegetables. The broth made from pork bones is poured over fried vegetables at high heat, and the resulting soup tastes refreshing and good to the last drop.
desc_l10n.ja: 日本風居酒屋。揚げ出し豆腐やたこ酢などの多様な日本の居酒屋メニューを味わうことができます。また長崎チャンポンもおすすめ。豚の骨からとったスープはさっぱりして味わい深い。
desc_l10n.ko: 다양한 일식 안주를 맛볼 수 있는 곳.  두부튀김, 문어초회, 나가사키짬뽕을 추천.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到各式日式下酒菜，炸豆腐和醋渍章鱼等，非常适合搭配酸橘醋享用。主食方面，长崎什锦面相当值得推荐，先将蔬菜丝爆炒后，再加入猪骨高汤滚煮，因此汤头相当开胃爽口。

description: At Itsumo you can enjoy a variety of Japanese side dishes, such as tofu tempura and octopus salad seasoned with vinegar, both of which go nicely with ponzu sauce. Recommended is the Nagasaki chanpon, a spicy noodle soup with seafood and vegetables. The broth made from pork bones is poured over fried vegetables at high heat, and the resulting soup tastes refreshing and good to the last drop.
name: Itsumo

desc_l10n.en: This Irish pub offers Guinness on tap for which they are quite popular. You can enjoy other imported beers fresh on tap besides Guinness. A wide variety of bottled beers are also available, including Hoegaarden, Kilkenny, Erdinger, and Sapporo.
desc_l10n.ja: ギネスビールが飲めることで人気のアイリッシュパブ。 瓶ビールではなく直輸入した生ビールを提供しているところだ。新鮮な味を楽しむことができる。ギネスの生ビールの他にもヒューガルデン、キルケニー、エルディンガー、サッポロなど様々な生ビールと瓶ビールを取り揃えている。
desc_l10n.ko: 기네스 생맥주를 마실 수 있어 인기있는 아이리시 펍.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为因可以品尝到Guinness生啤酒而大受欢迎的爱尔兰酒吧。店内提供的并非瓶装啤酒，而是直接进口的生啤酒，因此可以享用新鲜的口感。除了Guinness生啤酒外，另备有Hoegaarden、Kilkenny、Erdinger和Sapporo等各式生啤酒和瓶装啤酒。

description: This Irish pub offers Guinness on tap for which they are quite popular. You can enjoy other imported beers fresh on tap besides Guinness. A wide variety of bottled beers are also available, including Hoegaarden, Kilkenny, Erdinger, and Sapporo.
name: DUBLIN

desc_l10n.en: Lots of people come here for chirashizushi, sushi presented on top of a bowl of rice, rather than on bite-sized clumps of rice, which is more common. On top of the chirashizushi, you'll find generous portions of tuna, salmon, eel, flounder, sea bream, squid, shellfish, or sea urchin roe. For dinner, they offer a unique dish of warm changkonabe (a Japanese stew of meat and vegetables) and anju (Korean side dishes consumed with alcohol).
desc_l10n.ja: 隠れた日本料理の名店。マグロ、うなぎ、ヒラメ、タイ、イカ、貝柱、ウニなどがたっぷり入っているちらし寿司を看板メニューとしているお店だ。夜にはつまみ代わりに体があたたまるちゃんこ鍋も人気。新鮮な材料を厳選し使用している。
desc_l10n.ko: 동교동의 숨은 일식 맛집. 그릇에 담긴 밥 위에 생선을 올린 지라시 초밥.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为东桥洞的日式料理名店。店家的招牌料理并非是将生鱼片摆放在米饭上的普通寿司，而是将米饭盛装在碗盆中，再摆上生鱼片的散寿司，内容包含鲔鱼、鲑鱼、鳗鱼、比目鱼、鲷鱼、鱿鱼、干贝和海胆等丰富食材。在晚上也能作为下酒菜的热腾腾相扑火锅，是此店的特别料理。店家使用的食材皆相当新鲜，因此料理也很干净可口。

description: Lots of people come here for chirashizushi, sushi presented on top of a bowl of rice, rather than on bite-sized clumps of rice, which is more common. On top of the chirashizushi, you'll find generous portions of tuna, salmon, eel, flounder, sea bream, squid, shellfish, or sea urchin roe. For dinner, they offer a unique dish of warm changkonabe (a Japanese stew of meat and vegetables) and anju (Korean side dishes consumed with alcohol).
name: Sushi Gen

desc_l10n.en: Sohojeong specializes in gukshi, the traditional food of the Korean gentry from Andong, a city in the Gyeongsang region of Korea. A variety of other Korean dishes are on the menu as well. The special set menu, which comes with meat, jelly, Korean pancakes, and even noodles, is a substantial meal.
desc_l10n.ja: キョンサンド(慶尚道)アンドン(安東)地方に伝わる料理のアンドン(安東)ククシ(ククスの方言：うどん)を味わえるところ。ククシ以外にも色々な韓国料理メニューを用意している。肉類やムク(どんぐりの澱粉を煮てのり状になったものを冷やしてゼリー状に固めたもの)、ジョン(野菜や魚・肉を卵・小麦粉を付けて焼いたもの)、麺類などをすべて味わえるトゥクソンジョンシク(特選定食)がおすすめだ 。
desc_l10n.ko: 경상도 안동 지방의 반가 음식인 안동 국시의 맛을 느껴볼 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 这里是庆尚道安东地区的正宗口味，除了汤以外还有各种韩式料理，这里也提供包括了多种单品的套餐。

description: Sohojeong specializes in gukshi, the traditional food of the Korean gentry from Andong, a city in the Gyeongsang region of Korea. A variety of other Korean dishes are on the menu as well. The special set menu, which comes with meat, jelly, Korean pancakes, and even noodles, is a substantial meal.
name: Sohojeong

desc_l10n.en: At Manbongnim specializes in traditional Chinese cuisine that has been adapted to suit Korean tastes. Before moving to their current location, this restaurant was located in the Tower Hotel.
desc_l10n.ja: 高級な雰囲気の中華料理店。チャジャンミョン(ジャージャー麺)やチャンポンから海鮮おこげまで様々なメニューがある。ビジネスの集まりやパーティーなどでもよく利用されるところだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 우리 입맛에 맞는 정통 중국 요리를 맛볼 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到略为韩国化的正宗中式料理。此店原本位于Tower Hotel，后搬迁至此。

description: At Manbongnim specializes in traditional Chinese cuisine that has been adapted to suit Korean tastes. Before moving to their current location, this restaurant was located in the Tower Hotel.
name: Manbongnim

desc_l10n.en: Tour du Vin boasts a wine list of over 500 varieties, including quite a few unusual wines that are hard to find. Cheese plates, salads, and pasta dishes are also available.
desc_l10n.ja: 約500種類ものワインが用意されているワインバー。珍しいワインも揃っている。おつまみや食事用のチーズ、ザラダ、スパゲッティもおいしい。店内で選んだワインをテーブル席ですぐ飲むことができる。
desc_l10n.ko: 5백여 종의 와인과 치즈, 샐러드, 스파게티가 준비되어 있는 곳.  시중에서 만나볼 수 없는 이색적인 와인.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店备有500多种葡萄酒、奶酪、沙拉和意大利面，还有一些稀有的葡萄酒。顾客挑选完酒后，便可直接在旁边的座位上享用。

description: Tour du Vin boasts a wine list of over 500 varieties, including quite a few unusual wines that are hard to find. Cheese plates, salads, and pasta dishes are also available.
name: Tour du Vin

desc_l10n.en: The owner of Songnimwon hails from Shandong Province in China, and has been running this traditional restaurant for over 50 years. Although the interior is shabby, the prices are reasonable and the food is quality. Here, you can enjoy Chinese food the way it was prepared in the 70s and 80s.
desc_l10n.ja: 中国山東出身の華僑が営業する中華料理店。値段は安いが、味のレベルは高い。50年の伝統を誇るだけある。70～80年代のソウル式中華料理と言える。
desc_l10n.ko: 산동 출신 화교가 운영하는 곳. 허름하나 맛은 수준급.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店是由一名出身山东的华侨经营的.虽然店面不起眼，价格便宜，但味道绝佳，是一家拥有50年历史的传统中式饭馆.在此店可以尝到70~80年代首尔式的中国料理 。

description: The owner of Songnimwon hails from Shandong Province in China, and has been running this traditional restaurant for over 50 years. Although the interior is shabby, the prices are reasonable and the food is quality. Here, you can enjoy Chinese food the way it was prepared in the 70s and 80s.
name: Songnimwon

desc_l10n.en: The specialty of Di Matteo is traditional Naples pizza. Authentic Italian restaurants are everywhere nowadays, but when this restaurant first opened, their thin crust Italian-style pizza was a rarity and became a big hit. They offer 26 different kinds of pizza, but since any of their pizzas can be ordered with either Italian or Danish cheese, you could say they offer over 50 kinds.
desc_l10n.ja: 伝統的なナポリのピザが味わえるところ。コメディアンのイ･ウォンスン氏がイタリアでピザの作り方を学びオープンした店だ。薄いイタリア風のピザが味わえる。ピザの種類は26種類と豊富で、同じ種類のピザのなかでもチーズを選んで注文することもできる。
desc_l10n.ko: 전통 나폴리 피자를 맛볼 수 있는 곳
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到传统的拿坡里披萨，搞笑艺人李元承(译音)曾在意大利学习披萨的制作方法，学成归国后便经营了此店。虽然现在正宗意式餐厅越来越多，但在当时不易品尝到的薄皮披萨相当受欢迎。仅披萨的口味便有26种，但同一口味的披萨还可另外选择使用意大利或是丹麦产的奶酪，因此实际上是超过50种口味。

description: The specialty of Di Matteo is traditional Naples pizza. Authentic Italian restaurants are everywhere nowadays, but when this restaurant first opened, their thin crust Italian-style pizza was a rarity and became a big hit. They offer 26 different kinds of pizza, but since any of their pizzas can be ordered with either Italian or Danish cheese, you could say they offer over 50 kinds.
name: Di Matteo

desc_l10n.en: The representative dish at Doenjang Yesulgwa Sul is their savory doenjang bibimbap (soybean stew served with a bowl of mixed rice and vegetables), served in a large bowl.
desc_l10n.ja: 大皿に出てくる香ばしい味噌ビビンバが人気メニューのお店。香り高い味噌汁と野菜に混ぜて食べる味噌ビビンバの味は格別。二種類のメニューがあり、もう一つはカンジャンケジャン(カニの醤油漬け)の定食だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 큰 대접에 나오는 구수한 된장비빔밥이 대표 메뉴로, 구수한 된장찌개와 부추를 듬뿍 넣어 비벼 먹는 된장비빔밥과  간장게장 밥.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的招牌料理为盛在大碗中，香气四溢的大豆酱拌饭，香浓的大豆酱锅和拌着蔬菜享用的大豆酱拌饭相当美味。店内提供2种选择供顾客挑选，另一种为酱油腌螃蟹饭。

description: The representative dish at Doenjang Yesulgwa Sul is their savory doenjang bibimbap (soybean stew served with a bowl of mixed rice and vegetables), served in a large bowl.
name: Doenjang Yesulgwa Sul

name_l10n.ja: テンジャン・イェスルグァ・スル

desc_l10n.en: La Saveur offers authentic classic French cuisine like Bourgogne-style snails, goose liver, and Dijon-style sirloin. The tenderloin steak is recommended, as is the Bulsora, a small conch-like shellfish from Jeju Island, served as an appetizer with herbed butter.
desc_l10n.ja: 正統フレンチレストラン。ブルゴーニュ地方のカタツムリ料理やフォアグラなどクラシックな正統フランス料理を味わうことができます。済州島(チェジュド)産サザエをハーブとバターで調理した前菜とブランド韓国産牛の韓牛(ハヌ)のヒレステーキがおすすめ。
desc_l10n.ko: 오랫동안 서래마을에서 정통 프랑스 요리를 내고 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到培根烤蜗牛、鹅肝酱料理和纽约客牛排等经典传统法式料理。将产自济州岛的螺以香料和奶油调味而成的前菜，以及使用韩牛制作而成的菲力牛排等，都是值得推荐的菜色。

description: La Saveur offers authentic classic French cuisine like Bourgogne-style snails, goose liver, and Dijon-style sirloin. The tenderloin steak is recommended, as is the Bulsora, a small conch-like shellfish from Jeju Island, served as an appetizer with herbed butter.
name: La Saveur

desc_l10n.en: A specialty of this restaurant is the dumpling casserole boiled in soybean broth with a lot of seafood. Other popular menu items include dumpling soup, Korean pancakes and bulgogi. Both Korean and Western tables are available.
desc_l10n.ja: 味噌スープで煮込んだ餃子の寄せ鍋が味わえるレストラン。 味噌に海鮮、餃子がたっぷり入り、香ばしくてさっぱりした味が特徴だ。その他に餃子スープ、チヂミ、プルコギなどが味わえる。座敷、テーブル席がある 。
desc_l10n.ko: 된장국물에 끓인 만두전골을 맛볼 수 있는 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 大酱汤煮成的饺子火锅是本店的特色料理。加入了大量海鲜和饺子的大酱火锅，味道鲜香爽口。除此之外，也提供饺子汤、煎饼和烤肉等韩餐。具备西式餐桌和韩式座席，可根据自己的就餐习惯随意选择 。

description: A specialty of this restaurant is the dumpling casserole boiled in soybean broth with a lot of seafood. Other popular menu items include dumpling soup, Korean pancakes and bulgogi. Both Korean and Western tables are available.
name: Darakjeong

desc_l10n.en: A broth made from beef leg bones boiled down for twelve hours forms the base of Yeonhuidong Kalguksu's enjoyable kalguksu, handmade knife-cut noodle soup. In addition, their suyuk (steamed meat) is also worth trying.
desc_l10n.ja: 真夏にカルクグス(韓国式うどん)だけで営業しているお店。12時間も煮込んだ牛骨スープのカルクグスは絶品。そのほか、スユク(茹で肉)も一緒に食べる価値ありだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 한여름에도 칼국수만을 고집하는 곳. 열두 시간 우려낸 사골 국물의 칼국수.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店即使在炎热的夏天也只卖刀切面。刀切面的汤汁用筛骨熬制12个小时。除此之外白切肉也值得品尝。

description: A broth made from beef leg bones boiled down for twelve hours forms the base of Yeonhuidong Kalguksu's enjoyable kalguksu, handmade knife-cut noodle soup. In addition, their suyuk (steamed meat) is also worth trying.
name: Yeonhuidong Kalguksu

name_l10n.ja: ヨンヒドン・カルグクス

desc_l10n.en: For more than 40 years, Eulmildae has been offering Pyeongyang-style naengmyeon, made with handmade noodles served in an icy-cold broth. Because they use a lot of starch in their noodle dough, the noodles may not be to everyone's liking, but some people are crazy about them. Suyuk, a boiled beef dish made with brisket point cut, is also excellent.
desc_l10n.ja: 40年もの歴史を誇るピョンヤン(平壌)式ネンミョン(冷麺)店。練り粉の中にでん粉が多く入った手製の麺を味わえる。スユク(茹で肉)もおすすめだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 40여 년 역사의 평양식 냉면집. 서울 3대 평양냉면중 하나.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为拥有40多年历史的平壤冷面店。在冰镇的肉汤中轻轻放入自制的冷面。此店做冷面时，在和好的面里加了很多淀粉。用牛胸肉烹制的白切肉也是绝顶的美味。

description: For more than 40 years, Eulmildae has been offering Pyeongyang-style naengmyeon, made with handmade noodles served in an icy-cold broth. Because they use a lot of starch in their noodle dough, the noodles may not be to everyone's liking, but some people are crazy about them. Suyuk, a boiled beef dish made with brisket point cut, is also excellent.
name: Eulmildae

desc_l10n.en: The Ojangdong-area has many restaurants that serve Hamheung-style naengmyeon, a North Korean style of cold buckwheat noodles, but Ojangdong Heungnamjip is supposed to be the best and is the most popular among Koreans whose families originated in the north. Their bibim naengmyeon (chilled buckwheat noodles mixed with chili sauce) is served with sliced beef and the hoe naengmyeon comes topped with raw skate. As you might guess, the mixed naengmyeon includes both beef and raw skate. The noodles made from sweet potato starch and the sour flavor of the raw skate really stand out.
desc_l10n.ja: スープのないピリ辛の混ぜ冷麺の店が多いことで有名なオジャンドン(五壮洞)にある冷麺店。混ぜ冷麺には牛肉が、刺身入り冷麺にはホンオフェ(発酵したエイの刺身)が入っている。ソッキムネンミョン(冷麺)は牛肉とホンオフェ(ガンギエイの刺身)の両方が入ったもの。さつまいものでんぷんを使った麺とホンオフェ(ガンギエイの刺身)の酸味の効いた味は独特。
desc_l10n.ko: 오장동 냉면집 중 가장 낫다는 평가를 받고 있으며 이북 출신들이 가장 많이 찾는 함흥식 냉면집.
desc_l10n.zh: 不仅在五壮洞冷面家中人气最高，也是北方顾客最喜欢来访的咸兴冷面店。拌冷面中加入牛肉，生鱼片冷面中加入魟鱼生鱼片，什锦冷面中则既有牛肉又有生鱼片。

description: The Ojangdong-area has many restaurants that serve Hamheung-style naengmyeon, a North Korean style of cold buckwheat noodles, but Ojangdong Heungnamjip is supposed to be the best and is the most popular among Koreans whose families originated in the north. Their bibim naengmyeon (chilled buckwheat noodles mixed with chili sauce) is served with sliced beef and the hoe naengmyeon comes topped with raw skate. As you might guess, the mixed naengmyeon includes both beef and raw skate. The noodles made from sweet potato starch and the sour flavor of the raw skate really stand out.
name: Ojangdong Heungnamjip

name_l10n.ja: オジャンドン・フンナムチプ

desc_l10n.en: Dongbuk Hwagwawang specializes in the regional cuisine of Yanbian in northeastern China, the representative dishes of which are lamb skewers and huǒguō (Chinese hot pot). They also serve Cantonese dishes, including several varieties of tangsuyuk (sweet and sour pork) with tomato sauce, pineapple, and lemon. Prices are relatively low.
desc_l10n.ja: 羊串と火鍋を味わうことのできる北朝鮮と中国の国境のヨンビョン(延辺)地方の中華料理店。羊串と火鍋の他にも豊富なメニューが揃っている。タンスユク(酢豚)だけでも広東式、ケチャップ味、パイナップル味、レモン味など多様。価格もお手頃だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 조선족을 위한 연변식 중국요리. 양꼬치와 훠궈.
desc_l10n.zh: 朝鲜族延边式的中菜馆, 主要提供羊肉串和火锅。更备有广式、蕃茄酱、凤梨和柠檬等不同口味的糖醋肉, 价格实惠。

description: Dongbuk Hwagwawang specializes in the regional cuisine of Yanbian in northeastern China, the representative dishes of which are lamb skewers and huǒguō (Chinese hot pot). They also serve Cantonese dishes, including several varieties of tangsuyuk (sweet and sour pork) with tomato sauce, pineapple, and lemon. Prices are relatively low.
name: Dongbuk Hwagwawang

desc_l10n.en: Won Daegutang has made daegutang, codfish soup, for over 30 years. Every morning, they buy cod and vegetables and boil them in a cauldron which makes two hundred servings at a time to make their rich tasty soup. The spicy broth is a good cure for a hangover. They do not take reservations, so you'll have to wait in line.
desc_l10n.ja: サムガクチ駅近くのテグタン(たらスープ)通りにある有名店。30年伝統の辛く味わい深い テグタン(たらスープ)が絶品。豆もやしとセリなどが入り、さらにおいしさが引き立つ。最後の残りのスープにご飯を入れて食べるポクンバプ(チャーハン)もおすすめ。
desc_l10n.ko: 얼큰한 국물과 담백한 대구 맛으로 30년이 넘는 전통을 이어온 집
desc_l10n.zh: 本店有30年的历史，以辣辣的汤汁和清淡的鳕鱼闻名。每天早上采购鳕鱼和蔬菜，把食材放入一个铁锅中熬制，一次可熬制200人份的汤，香味浓厚。辣辣的汤非常解酒。如果不事先预约，需要排队等候。

description: Won Daegutang has made daegutang, codfish soup, for over 30 years. Every morning, they buy cod and vegetables and boil them in a cauldron which makes two hundred servings at a time to make their rich tasty soup. The spicy broth is a good cure for a hangover. They do not take reservations, so you'll have to wait in line.
name: Won Daegutang

name_l10n.ja: ウォン・テグタン(サムガクチ駅)
name_l10n.zh: 韩元大头鳕汤(三角地站)

desc_l10n.en: At Hyundae Kalguksu, you'll probably have to wait in line to have their kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup). Their broth is made with seven ingredients, including anchovies, kelp, dry shrimps, and pollack, and is very refreshing. They replenish your noodles and rice as often as you want. In the summer, another good choice is kongguksu (noodles in cold soybean soup).
desc_l10n.ja: ランチタイムには行列ができることで有名なカルクグス(韓国式うどん)店。いわしをベースにし、昆布、干し海老、干し明太など7種類の食材で作るダシはとてもすっきりした味わいに仕上がっている。 麺とご飯はお替わり自由。夏は冷たいコングクス(豆乳スープうどん)も人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 점심 시간에 길게 줄을 서야만 먹을 수 있는 칼국수 맛집.
desc_l10n.zh: 以鳀鱼为主，再加入海带、干虾仁、明太鱼等7种材料熬制的汤汁口感清爽，汤和米饭无限提供，夏季时豆奶面也很好吃。

description: At Hyundae Kalguksu, you'll probably have to wait in line to have their kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup). Their broth is made with seven ingredients, including anchovies, kelp, dry shrimps, and pollack, and is very refreshing. They replenish your noodles and rice as often as you want. In the summer, another good choice is kongguksu (noodles in cold soybean soup).
name: Hyundae Kalguksu

name_l10n.ja: ヒョンデ・カルクグス

desc_l10n.en: Ja-in Mungtigi uses only premium beef from cows raised in Jainmyeon, Kyeongsan in the North Gyeongsang province. "Mungtigi" refers to the rump bone, which is cut in large portions and served raw. To prepare mungtigi, the meat is served on rice and topped with sauce. Yukhoe, seasoned thinly-sliced beef tartare, is also worth trying.
desc_l10n.ja: ブランド韓国産牛のハヌ(韓牛)で有名なキョンサンブクト(慶尚北道)キョンサンシ(慶山市)で育ったＡランクの韓国産牛肉のみを使用しているお店。「ムンティギ」とは、牛のランプ肉を切って、生で食べることを意味する。メニューのムンティギスシはご飯の上にムンティギを乗せ、そこにソースをつけて食べるもの。ユッケもおすすめだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 경북 경산시 자인면에서 키운 일 등급 한우만을 사용하는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 这里只使用在庆北庆山市慈仁面饲养的一等韩牛，“mun ti gi”指的就是把牛臀肉切成块状直接生吃的意思，mun ti gi寿司就是在饭上摆上生牛肉，再倒上酱汁食用。生肉餐也可以尝试看看。

description: Ja-in Mungtigi uses only premium beef from cows raised in Jainmyeon, Kyeongsan in the North Gyeongsang province. "Mungtigi" refers to the rump bone, which is cut in large portions and served raw. To prepare mungtigi, the meat is served on rice and topped with sauce. Yukhoe, seasoned thinly-sliced beef tartare, is also worth trying.
name: Ja-in Mungtigi

desc_l10n.en: At this fusion Korean restaurant, sirloin and grilled short ribs are the main fare. They have an à la carte menu of about thirty different dishes, as well as full-course set menus. The Korean-style filet of grilled tenderloin in cognac sauce is outstanding.The decor is stylish and modern, and reminiscent of a wine bar.
desc_l10n.ja: サーロインやカルビを中心とした料理を味わえる韓国フュージョンレストラン。30種類の単品メニューとコース料理が用意されている。その中、コニャックサーロインは韓国式カルビとコニャックソースが合わさり、独特な味わいだ。店内はワインバーのようなモダンで粹なインテリア。
desc_l10n.ko: 등심과 갈비구이를 중심으로 하는 퓨전 한식 레스토랑.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店是提供以烤牛里脊肉与牛小排为主的无国界韩式料理店。店家备有30余种的单点以及套餐，其中最特别的菜色为将韩式烤牛里脊佐干邑白兰地酱汁的甘邑牛里脊。店内时尚洗炼的设计风格会使人联想到葡萄酒吧。

description: At this fusion Korean restaurant, sirloin and grilled short ribs are the main fare. They have an à la carte menu of about thirty different dishes, as well as full-course set menus. The Korean-style filet of grilled tenderloin in cognac sauce is outstanding.The decor is stylish and modern, and reminiscent of a wine bar.
name: Rosehill

desc_l10n.en: The house specialities are tangsuyuk (sweet and sour pork) and jjamppong (spicy seafood noodle soup). As dongpayuk (steamed and braised pork) takes quite a while to prepare, advance reservations are advisable.
desc_l10n.ja: 中華料理店。韓国風にアレンジされた料理と本場の料理の両方を楽しむことができるところだ。どれもおいしいが、特にタンスユクク(酢豚)とチャンポンがおすすめ。
desc_l10n.ko: 블로거들 사이에서 큰 인기를  끄는 중식당으로 동파육이 유명
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为装潢古色古香的中式料理店，糖醋肉和辣海鲜汤面的口味相当出色，而费时费工的东坡肉最好能事先预订。店内的每一道料理皆相当美味。

description: The house specialities are tangsuyuk (sweet and sour pork) and jjamppong (spicy seafood noodle soup). As dongpayuk (steamed and braised pork) takes quite a while to prepare, advance reservations are advisable.
name: Mongnan

desc_l10n.en: Philkyungjae is a centuries-old hanok that was once home to members of Korean nobility and is now an acclaimed hanjeongsik restaurant. The building holds the designation of Traditional Structure No. 1. In 1999, a hanjeongsik (Korean table d'hote) was established at Philkyungjae and the restaurant has won plaudits ever since its opening.
desc_l10n.ja: ピルギョンジェ(必敬斎)はソウル市カンナム(江南)区スソドン(水西洞)にある朝鮮王朝時代の伝統家屋で、チョンジュ(全州)イ(李)氏定案副正公の宗家として続いている本家で、伝統建造物第1号に指定されています。1999年からは宮中料理の専門店として営業されています。
desc_l10n.ko: 필경재는 서울 강남구 수서동에 있는 조선시대 전통가옥 한식당.
desc_l10n.zh: 首尔屈指可数的韩定食店。欣赏着古香古色的韩屋与宽敞的庭院风景，食物也变得更加美味。采用餐桌和椅子的方式，不习惯席地而坐的外国人也可以舒适地进餐。各个系列的传统韩定食均深受好评，很值得推荐。

description: Philkyungjae is a centuries-old hanok that was once home to members of Korean nobility and is now an acclaimed hanjeongsik restaurant. The building holds the designation of Traditional Structure No. 1. In 1999, a hanjeongsik (Korean table d'hote) was established at Philkyungjae and the restaurant has won plaudits ever since its opening.
name: Philkyungjae

name_l10n.ja: ピルギョンジェ(必敬斎)

desc_l10n.en: Vicolo is an affordable Italian restaurant. Here the most popular dish is the seafood cream spaghetti covered with a dough crust. Break through the crust to reveal spaghetti with a cream sauce and a nice mix of mussels, clams, shrimps, and squid. Their light-tasting pizza and soft tiramisù are also good.
desc_l10n.ja: 手頃な価格で楽しめるイタリアンレストラン。ピザの生地に包まれて出されるシーフードクリームスパゲッティが人気メニューだ。あっさりしたピザとティラミスもおすすめ。
desc_l10n.ko: 명동에서 제대로 된 파스타를 맛볼 수 있는 곳
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为价格实惠的意式餐厅。以面皮覆盖住的奶油海鲜意大利面为人气料理，掀开面皮后，会看见淡菜、蛤蜊、鲜虾、鱿鱼与奶油意大利面完美的结合在一起，清爽的披萨和柔软的提拉米苏也相当美味。

description: Vicolo is an affordable Italian restaurant. Here the most popular dish is the seafood cream spaghetti covered with a dough crust. Break through the crust to reveal spaghetti with a cream sauce and a nice mix of mussels, clams, shrimps, and squid. Their light-tasting pizza and soft tiramisù are also good.
name: Vicolo

desc_l10n.en: The Green Table is a "semi-bistro" run by three sisters. Here you can enjoy casual bistro-style French cuisine. The interior is uniquely decorated with various plates and pastel colors.
desc_l10n.ja: 三姉妹が営むビストロ。カジュアルなフレンチビストロ。1階と2階があり、2階は静かに食事を楽しめる空間となっています。パステルトーンのインテリアが印象的。
desc_l10n.ko: 캐주얼한 비스트로 스타일의 프랑스 음식점
desc_l10n.zh: 此店才开业不久，为三姐妹共同经营的精致小餐馆，在此可以品尝到悠闲小餐馆风格的法式料理。店内共2层楼，顾客可以在2楼安静的用餐。各种餐具以及柔和色调的室内装修为此店的特色。

description: The Green Table is a "semi-bistro" run by three sisters. Here you can enjoy casual bistro-style French cuisine. The interior is uniquely decorated with various plates and pastel colors.
name: The Green Table

desc_l10n.en: Following a 30-year stint at Myeongdong Gyoja, a famous kalguksu (noodle soup) restaurant in Myeongdong, the chef opened this second branch in Gangnam. Here the kalguksu broth is made from chicken bones. Noodles and rice are unlimited here. The mandu (Korean dumplings) and bibim guksu (noodles mixed in a spicy sauce) are also recommended. Take-out is available.
desc_l10n.ja: 明洞(ミョンドン)の有名なカルグクス(韓国式うどん)の明洞餃子(ミョンドンギョジャ)に30年勤めた料理長が独立して新たに出したカルグクス専門店。鶏がらの出汁をベースにしたカルグクスを味わうことができる。 麺とご飯はお替り自由だ。マンドゥ(餃子)とビビングクス(スープなしのピリ辛冷やし素麺)もおすすめメニューだ。テイクアウトも可。
desc_l10n.ko: 명동교자에서 30년간 근무한 조리장이 독립하여 낸 칼국수 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为曾在明洞的知名刀切面店明洞饺子任职将近30年的主厨，独立门户后所开设的刀切面专卖店。在此可以品尝到以鸡骨高汤为汤底制作而成的刀切面，面条和白饭无限供应，饺子和拌面亦相当值得推荐。也提供外带。

description: Following a 30-year stint at Myeongdong Gyoja, a famous kalguksu (noodle soup) restaurant in Myeongdong, the chef opened this second branch in Gangnam. Here the kalguksu broth is made from chicken bones. Noodles and rice are unlimited here. The mandu (Korean dumplings) and bibim guksu (noodles mixed in a spicy sauce) are also recommended. Take-out is available.
name: Gangnam Gyoja

desc_l10n.en: The terrific views from Baengnihyang, situated on the top floor, and the luxurious décor of the restaurant create a nice dining atmosphere. Serving authentic Chinese-style cuisine, the restaurant has become a popular setting for business meetings and family get-togethers.
desc_l10n.ja: 正統中華料理の店。超高層からの景色と豪華なインテリア、そして行き届いたサービスで格式あるレストランだ。ビジネスや結納の場所としても人気が高い。
desc_l10n.ko: 초고층 전망과 고급스러운 실내 장식. 정중한 서비스의 정통 스타일 중식.
desc_l10n.zh: 超顶级的视野景观和高级的室内装潢，加上谨慎的服务，成功提升用餐的气氛。在此可以品尝到正宗的中式料理，因此也非常适合作为商业聚餐等正式场合的接待地。

description: The terrific views from Baengnihyang, situated on the top floor, and the luxurious décor of the restaurant create a nice dining atmosphere. Serving authentic Chinese-style cuisine, the restaurant has become a popular setting for business meetings and family get-togethers.
name: Baengnihyang

desc_l10n.en: Michiru Sushi is quickly gaining popularity due to their reasonably priced sushi. Their neta-style sushi is made with generous portions of fish. Sake makes a great accompaniment. Reservations are required due to limited seating.
desc_l10n.ja: 手頃な価格で寿司を味わえることで人気の寿司屋。寿司のネタが縦にも横にも大きいのが特徴。日本酒と一緒に寿司を味わうことができる。席が少ないため予約必須。
desc_l10n.ko: 가격대비 만족도 높은 스시를 내놓는 곳으로 인기가 올라가고 있는 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店提供的寿司物美价廉，因此人气正逐渐往上攀升中，握寿司上的食材皆又大又长，搭配清酒一起享用亦是不错的选择。店内座位不多，因此须事先预约。

description: Michiru Sushi is quickly gaining popularity due to their reasonably priced sushi. Their neta-style sushi is made with generous portions of fish. Sake makes a great accompaniment. Reservations are required due to limited seating.
name: Michiru Sushi

desc_l10n.en: At Jangwonjip, you can enjoy jokbal (pigs' feet) and bindae-tteok (mung bean pancake). It was a very popular restaurant in the Pimatgol area for a very long time, but it had to move because of redevelopment in the area. The restaurant's current atmosphere is pleasant and less gritty than the previous location's atmosphere.
desc_l10n.ja: 豚足とピンデトク(緑豆チヂミ)が味わえるお店。グルメ街のピマッコルで長らく人気を博したお店で、街の再開発とともに移転した。豚足メニューのうち、甘辛い味付けの味付け豚足が一番人気。
desc_l10n.ko: 족발과 빈대떡을 맛볼 수 있는 곳. 회사원들이 많아 점심 메뉴 추가.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店提供猪蹄和绿豆煎饼。当初在避马巷时，客人络绎不绝，后来搬至Le Meilleur分店时以上班族居多，另外增加了商业午餐。

description: At Jangwonjip, you can enjoy jokbal (pigs' feet) and bindae-tteok (mung bean pancake). It was a very popular restaurant in the Pimatgol area for a very long time, but it had to move because of redevelopment in the area. The restaurant's current atmosphere is pleasant and less gritty than the previous location's atmosphere.
name: Jangwonjip (Jangwon Jokbal)

desc_l10n.en: At Baegwon, you can enjoy four regional styles of Chinese cuisine, which are equally represented on the menu, including such famous dishes as steamed abalone with shark's fin, steamed shark's fin, Beijing-style duck skin dishes, sautéed assorted seafood and vegetables, and bird's nest soup. The restaurant boasts excellent views of the river and Yeouido Park. Also available are private rooms of various sizes, ideally suited for business meetings.
desc_l10n.ja: フカヒレ、北京ダック、ツバメの巣などの中国の四大地方の高級料理が味わえる中華レストラン。店内からはヨイド(汝矣島)公園とハンガン(漢江)の眺めも楽しめる。様々な大きさの個室もあり、ビジネスにも利用しやすい。
desc_l10n.ko: 중국 4대 지방의 요리를 골고루 맛볼 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以一次品尝到佛跳墙、煨鱼翅、北京片皮鸭、全家福和竹笙燕窝等中国4大地区的名菜。店家以拥有可以欣赏汝矣岛公园和汉江的绝佳视野而感到自豪。店内备有各种规模的包厢，因此也很适合在此举办商业聚餐。

description: At Baegwon, you can enjoy four regional styles of Chinese cuisine, which are equally represented on the menu, including such famous dishes as steamed abalone with shark's fin, steamed shark's fin, Beijing-style duck skin dishes, sautéed assorted seafood and vegetables, and bird's nest soup. The restaurant boasts excellent views of the river and Yeouido Park. Also available are private rooms of various sizes, ideally suited for business meetings.
name: Baegwon

desc_l10n.en: Hwangtogil specializes in hangari sujebi, which is hand-torn noodle soup, and sanchae bibimbap, which is a mixed-rice dish served with sautéed traditional Korean vegetables, seasoned bean sprouts, spicy julienned radish, sautéed zucchini, oak mushrooms, and deep-fried soy bean curd. The sujebi dough is made with bean flour and ground peanuts mixed with flour and aged for two or three days.
desc_l10n.ja: すいとんとサンチェ・ピビンバプ(山菜入りビビンバ)の専門店。焼き大豆の粉やピーナッツパウダーなどを小麦粉に交ぜて練ったすいとんを作っている。サンチェ・ピビンバプ(山菜入りビビンバ)には山菜、桔梗、わらび、大根の千切り、 かぼちゃ、 シイタケ、油揚げなど様々な食材が入っている。
desc_l10n.ko: 항아리 수제비와 산채비빔밥을 전문으로 하는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为一家坛子面片汤和野菜拌饭专门店。野菜拌饭将蔬菜叶、桔梗、豆芽、生拌萝卜、嫩南瓜、香菇等材料再加入腐乳拌着使用。春天的时候会添加荠菜、野蒜等。面片汤使用的面粉是由豆面和花生面混合而成，再经过2到3天发酵制成面团。

description: Hwangtogil specializes in hangari sujebi, which is hand-torn noodle soup, and sanchae bibimbap, which is a mixed-rice dish served with sautéed traditional Korean vegetables, seasoned bean sprouts, spicy julienned radish, sautéed zucchini, oak mushrooms, and deep-fried soy bean curd. The sujebi dough is made with bean flour and ground peanuts mixed with flour and aged for two or three days.
name: Hwangtogil

desc_l10n.en: Cheongjinok began in 1937 under the name "Pyeonghwagwan" as a small haejangguk (hangover soup) restaurant frequented by woodcutters. After liberation, it changed its name to Cheongjinok and established itself as the epitome of haejangguk in Seoul. Boasting a deep and savory taste by simmering beef bones for 24 hours and adding various ingredients like intestines, tripe and intestines, and seonji (beef blood pudding), the flavor is certainly guaranteed, having specialized in haejangguk for nearly 90 years. The interior is spacious and clean, with photos depicting the history of Cheongjinok displayed on the walls.
desc_l10n.ja: 清進屋は1937年に「平和館」という名前で始まり、木こりたちが通う小さな解腸スープの店でした。解放後、「清進屋」に名前を変え、ソウルで解腸スープの代名詞となりました。24時間かけて牛骨を煮込んだスープに、味噌、牛のホルモン、血豆腐などさまざまな材料を加え、深く香ばしい味わいが特徴です。約90年間、解腸スープ一筋で商売をしてきたため、その味は確実に保証されています。店内は広く清潔で、清進屋の歴史を描いた写真が壁に展示されています。
desc_l10n.ko: 청진동 골목의 해장국 대명사
desc_l10n.zh: 清进屋始于1937年，当时名为“平和馆”，是一家木匠们常去的小解酒汤店。解放后更名为“清进屋”，成为首尔解酒汤的代名词。其汤底采用牛骨熬制24小时，并加入大酱、牛肠、血豆腐等多种食材，味道浓郁香醇。清进屋凭借90年专注于解酒汤这一道菜的经验，保证了其独特的口味。店内宽敞整洁，墙上展示着清进屋的历史照片。

description: Cheongjinok began in 1937 under the name "Pyeonghwagwan" as a small haejangguk (hangover soup) restaurant frequented by woodcutters. After liberation, it changed its name to Cheongjinok and established itself as the epitome of haejangguk in Seoul. Boasting a deep and savory taste by simmering beef bones for 24 hours and adding various ingredients like intestines, tripe and intestines, and seonji (beef blood pudding), the flavor is certainly guaranteed, having specialized in haejangguk for nearly 90 years. The interior is spacious and clean, with photos depicting the history of Cheongjinok displayed on the walls.
name: Cheongjinok

desc_l10n.en: Cheongiljip is famous for crispy Bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes) and Jokbal (pigs' trotters cooked with soy sauce and spices). To make their Bindaetteok, ground mung beans are placed on the grill and then garnished with meat, kimchi, and other ingredients.
desc_l10n.ja: ピンデトク(綠豆チヂミ)とチョッパル(豚足の煮込み)が有名なところ。ひいた緑豆に肉やキムチを載せ、鉄板で焼いたピンデトクはサクッとした食感を楽しめます。時の流れを感じられる壁や椅子、また歪んだアルミ鍋に出される料理からは懐かしい雰囲気が感じられます。
desc_l10n.ko: 바삭바삭한 빈대떡과 족발이 유명.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的酥脆绿豆煎饼和猪脚相当有名。特色在于，将绿豆面糊放至铁板上后，会将猪肉和辛奇（kimchi）等配料铺在煎饼上。斑驳的壁纸和老旧的座椅，以及盛装在白铜锅里的料理，都充满了古典的风味。 (※原位于首尔市钟路区，光化门站与钟阁站之间)

description: Cheongiljip is famous for crispy Bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes) and Jokbal (pigs' trotters cooked with soy sauce and spices). To make their Bindaetteok, ground mung beans are placed on the grill and then garnished with meat, kimchi, and other ingredients.
name: Cheongiljip

desc_l10n.en: Seogung is famous for gunmandu (fried Korean dumplings). Here the gunmandu is stuffed with beef rather than pork, and there is a wonderful hint of ginger. A good variety of Chinese cuisine is also on the menu .
desc_l10n.ja: クンマンドゥ(揚げ餃子)がおいしいことで有名な中華料理店。30年の歴史を持つところだ。ここのマンドゥ(餃子)は豚肉ではなく牛肉を使っていて、しょうがの香りも適度に感じられる。
desc_l10n.ko: 군만두를 제대로 만들어 파는 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 最近制作地道煎饺的中式餐馆已经不多见，但此店却坚持制作销售地道的煎饺。店家不使用猪肉，而是使用牛肉，生姜的香气也有适当渗进肉馅中，因此口味相当出色。

description: Seogung is famous for gunmandu (fried Korean dumplings). Here the gunmandu is stuffed with beef rather than pork, and there is a wonderful hint of ginger. A good variety of Chinese cuisine is also on the menu .
name: Seogung

desc_l10n.en: Piyang Kong Halmoni specializes in dishes made with soybeans, like doenjang jjigae (soybean paste stew), kongbiji jjigae (puréed soybean stew), sundubu jjigae (spicy soft tofu stew), and kongguksu (noodles in chilled soybean soup). There are four kinds of soybean pulp stew; plain, kimchi, radish, and mushroom. The North Korean-style piyang mandu (Korean dumplings) are somewhat small but are handmade fresh daily and are available for take-out. Soybean liquid is also sold in 1.5 L plastic bottles, it's a bit like soy milk.
desc_l10n.ja: テンジャンチゲ(味噌鍋)、コンビジチゲ(おからチゲ)、スンドゥブチゲ(おぼろ豆腐のピリ辛鍋)、コングクス(冷たい豆乳スープうどん)など豆で作った料理を主に扱っているところ。ビジチゲには、キムチ入り、きのこ入り、大根入りなどの種類から選べる。マンドゥ(餃子)もあり、北朝鮮スタイルで小さめのサイズ。生餃子は持ち帰り可能で、豆乳も 1．5リットルのペットボトルで販売している。
desc_l10n.ko: 된장찌개, 콩비지찌개, 순두부찌개, 콩국수 등 콩으로 만든 음식을 취급.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店提供大豆酱锅、豆腐渣锅、豆腐锅和豆浆面等黄豆制品。豆腐渣锅分为纯豆腐渣锅、泡菜豆腐渣锅、萝卜豆腐渣锅和香菇豆腐渣锅4种。平壤饺子个头不大，以朝鲜风格制作而成。生饺子提供外带，还销售1.5公升装的豆浆。

description: Piyang Kong Halmoni specializes in dishes made with soybeans, like doenjang jjigae (soybean paste stew), kongbiji jjigae (puréed soybean stew), sundubu jjigae (spicy soft tofu stew), and kongguksu (noodles in chilled soybean soup). There are four kinds of soybean pulp stew; plain, kimchi, radish, and mushroom. The North Korean-style piyang mandu (Korean dumplings) are somewhat small but are handmade fresh daily and are available for take-out. Soybean liquid is also sold in 1.5 L plastic bottles, it's a bit like soy milk.
name: Piyang Kong Halmoni

desc_l10n.en: Haenghwachon is a Chinese restaurant run by a Chinese immigrant. Their food is the most authentic original Koreanized Chinese food in the alley. They are famous for their samseon jjamppong, a spicy white noodle soup with generous amounts of seafood.
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国式中華料理店。魚介類がたっぷりとはいった白いスープのサムソンチャンポン(三鮮チャンポン)で有名。一般的に韓国のチャンポンは赤いスープのため、ここの白いスープのチャンポンはペクチャンポン(白チャンポン)とも呼ばれている
desc_l10n.ko: 화상이 경영하는 중식당.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店是华商经营的中式料理店，在附近可谓较贴近地道韩式中国料理口味的店家。汤头为白汤，且添加丰富海鲜的三鲜辣海鲜汤面相当有名。

description: Haenghwachon is a Chinese restaurant run by a Chinese immigrant. Their food is the most authentic original Koreanized Chinese food in the alley. They are famous for their samseon jjamppong, a spicy white noodle soup with generous amounts of seafood.
name: Haenghwachon

desc_l10n.en: Geumhong is a small, Japanese-style Chinese restaurant with mainly black décor. The food is low fat and light-tasting. Among their most popular menu items are kansosaewu (chili shrimp) and sacheontangmyeon, a Szechuan-style clear and spicy noodle soup with Shiba shrimp.
desc_l10n.ja: 黒い内装の日本風チャイニーズレストラン。脂身が少なく淡泊な味が特徴だ。エビチリとサチョン・タンミョン(四川湯麺)が人気メニューだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 검은색으로 내부를 꾸민 일본풍의 작은 차이니스 레스토랑.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店以黑色为主色调，装修成日式风格的中国餐厅。料理特色清淡而不油腻，用明虾做成的干烧明虾和四川汤面是本店的人气菜单。

description: Geumhong is a small, Japanese-style Chinese restaurant with mainly black décor. The food is low fat and light-tasting. Among their most popular menu items are kansosaewu (chili shrimp) and sacheontangmyeon, a Szechuan-style clear and spicy noodle soup with Shiba shrimp.
name: Geumhong

desc_l10n.en: Sinheung Jeongyuk Sikdang, located in the butcher-restaurant alley near Daechi Intersection, is worth a visit. They specialize in Korean beef sirloin which they serve but also sell in their butcher shop. Interestingly, they grill the meat on iron plates that are heated up and greased with beef tallow.
desc_l10n.ja: テチ(大峙)交差点の精肉食堂が集まる路地に位置する焼き肉店。牛ヒレ肉を専門としている。鉄板を熱し、牛脂をひいた後、肉を焼くのがこの店の特徴だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 대치사거리 정육 식당 골목에서 가볼 만한 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为在大峙十字路口肉铺烤肉店巷中相当值得拜访的店家，专门提供牛里脊。特别的是铁板烧热后，放上牛油才能开始烤肉。

description: Sinheung Jeongyuk Sikdang, located in the butcher-restaurant alley near Daechi Intersection, is worth a visit. They specialize in Korean beef sirloin which they serve but also sell in their butcher shop. Interestingly, they grill the meat on iron plates that are heated up and greased with beef tallow.
name: Sinheung Jeongyuk Sikdang

name_l10n.ja: シンフン・ジョンユク・シクタン

desc_l10n.en: Sinmi Sikdang has been in operation for 20 years. Their gamjatang (pork backbone stew), samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly), and chargrilled spicy pork ribs are excellent. The portion of ribs is generous and quite satisfying. On weekdays, they can get very busy, making it difficult to find a seat.
desc_l10n.ja: カムジャタン(じゃがいもと豚の背骨肉のピリ辛鍋)とサムギョプサル(豚の三枚肉の焼肉)、メウンデジカルビスッブルクイ(ピリ辛豚カルビの炭火焼き)がおいしいところ。カルビはボリュームたっぷり。いつも多くの人で賑っているお店だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 20여 년의 역사. 감자탕과 삼겹살, 매운 돼지갈비 숯불구이.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店拥有20多年的历史，招牌菜色为土豆汤、五花肉和炭烤辣味猪排骨，份量十足的猪小排非常令人心满意足。平常日也经常是座无虚席。

description: Sinmi Sikdang has been in operation for 20 years. Their gamjatang (pork backbone stew), samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly), and chargrilled spicy pork ribs are excellent. The portion of ribs is generous and quite satisfying. On weekdays, they can get very busy, making it difficult to find a seat.
name: Sinmi Sikdang

desc_l10n.en: Korean beef bulgogi (marinated thinly-sliced beef) and gomguksu (wheat flour noodles in a thick beef bone soup) are the most popular items here. Another popular menu item is the North Korean-style wangmandu (large dumpling). Because they serve simple main dishes and elaborate side dishes, this place is a favorite with many.
desc_l10n.ja: ブランド韓国産牛のハヌ(韓牛)を使ったプルコギとコムグクス(牛骨スープのうどん)がおいしいところ。北朝鮮式のマンドゥ(餃子)も人気メニューだ。店内は一般家庭のようなこじんまりとした雰囲気。
desc_l10n.ko: 한우 생불고기와 곰국수(사골 국물 칼국수).
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到新鲜韩牛烤肉和大骨汤面，朝鲜风的巨无霸饺子亦为人气料理。顾客可以在传统韩屋的氛围中，品尝清爽的主菜和简单美味的小菜，因此人潮络绎不绝。

description: Korean beef bulgogi (marinated thinly-sliced beef) and gomguksu (wheat flour noodles in a thick beef bone soup) are the most popular items here. Another popular menu item is the North Korean-style wangmandu (large dumpling). Because they serve simple main dishes and elaborate side dishes, this place is a favorite with many.
name: Songane Noodles

name_l10n.ja: ソンガネ・コムグクス

desc_l10n.en: At Busan Yanggopchang, you can enjoy small intestines at a relatively low price. One big plus is that they grill the food over charcoals. The plump small intestines seasoned with fresh garlic are quite nice. Another favorite is the tripe hot pot with generous portions of small and large intestines.
desc_l10n.ja: 手頃な価格でホルモンを楽しむことができるところ。炭火で焼いたホルモンを味わえる。ニンニク味付けの新鮮なコプチャン(小腸)がおいしい。コプチャンとテチャン(大腸)がたっぷり入ったコプチャンジョンゴル(牛もつ辛味鍋)も人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 비교적 저렴한 곱창, 숯불구이.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到价格合理的烤牛小肠，优点是以炭火烧烤。以大蒜腌渍过的新鲜肥美牛小肠口味不错。放入大量牛小肠和大肠的牛小肠锅也是人气料理

description: At Busan Yanggopchang, you can enjoy small intestines at a relatively low price. One big plus is that they grill the food over charcoals. The plump small intestines seasoned with fresh garlic are quite nice. Another favorite is the tripe hot pot with generous portions of small and large intestines.
name: Busan Yanggopchang

desc_l10n.en: Urang is an izakaya (Japanese pub) where you can have yakiniku (grilled thinly-sliced marinated beef) and sashimi. The yakiniku is served with its own small brazier, so that you can grill the meat, vegetables, and onigiri (rice balls) right at the table. Food here greatly complements the sake.
desc_l10n.ja: おしゃれな日本居酒屋。焼肉や刺身など様々な居酒屋メニューを楽しめる。焼肉を注文すると小さな七輪で肉や野菜、お握りなどを焼いて食べることができる。
desc_l10n.ko: 야키니쿠, 사시미 등과 이자카야 메뉴를 즐길 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到烤肉、生鱼片和居酒屋料理等。若是点用烤肉，则店家会端上小火炉，顾客可以在火炉上烤肉、蔬菜和三角饭团等，搭配一杯清酒也是不错的选 择。

description: Urang is an izakaya (Japanese pub) where you can have yakiniku (grilled thinly-sliced marinated beef) and sashimi.
