The yakiniku is served with its own small brazier, so that you can grill the meat, vegetables, and onigiri (rice balls) right at the table. Food here greatly complements the sake.
name: Urang

desc_l10n.en: Sinseonggak is a Chinese restaurant that uses only handmade noodles in their jajangmyeon (noodles with black soybean sauce). Although their menu doesn't offer the usual main dishes that can be found at Chinese restaurants in Korea, but there are a few noodle dishes, tangsuyuk (sweet and sour pork or beef), and japchae (clear noodles stir-fried with meat and vegetables). Their jjamppong (spicy seafood noodle soup) is made with mussels, clams, zucchini, napa cabbage, cabbage, and shitake mushrooms, and has a nice spiciness that enhances the flavor of the ingredients. Alcohol is not served here.
desc_l10n.ja: 手打ち麺で作ったチャジャンミョン(ジャージャー麺)が味わえる。中華料理屋だがお酒は置いていない。メニューはなく、いくつかの麺料理とタンスユク(酢豚)、チャプチェ(春雨炒め)だけを置いているところだ。チャンポンにはムール貝が入っており、少しピリ辛。
desc_l10n.ko: 수타면으로 만든 짜장면을 맛볼 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店可以品尝到手工面烹制的炸酱面。虽然是中餐店但是不销售酒水。没有菜单，只提供几种面食和糖醋肉、杂烩菜。辣汤面里放入红蛤、蛤蜊、南瓜、白菜、洋白菜、香菇等材料，口感微辣。

description: Sinseonggak is a Chinese restaurant that uses only handmade noodles in their jajangmyeon (noodles with black soybean sauce). Although their menu doesn't offer the usual main dishes that can be found at Chinese restaurants in Korea, but there are a few noodle dishes, tangsuyuk (sweet and sour pork or beef), and japchae (clear noodles stir-fried with meat and vegetables). Their jjamppong (spicy seafood noodle soup) is made with mussels, clams, zucchini, napa cabbage, cabbage, and shitake mushrooms, and has a nice spiciness that enhances the flavor of the ingredients. Alcohol is not served here.
name: Sinseonggak

desc_l10n.en: Ouga is a Korean barbecue restaurant that offers both pork and beef. Various vegetable side dishes are served along with the main meal, so it's quite healthy. The rice is served in a bamboo container that you can take with you when you are finished with your meal.
desc_l10n.ja: 焼肉専門店。豚肉と牛肉両方の焼き肉を楽しめる。焼き肉を注文すると肉に巻いて食べるための様々な野菜が出される。また、おかずの小皿は野菜をたっぷり使ったものが多くヘルシーだ。さらに、竹の筒に入ったご飯も特徴的で、竹の香りがほのかに感じられるご飯もおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 고기구이 전문점. 돼지고기와 소고기.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为烤肉专卖店，在此可以同时享用到猪肉和牛肉，小菜则是使用大量蔬菜制成的健康菜色。用餐完毕后，还能将装饭的竹筒带回家作纪念。

description: Ouga is a Korean barbecue restaurant that offers both pork and beef. Various vegetable side dishes are served along with the main meal, so it's quite healthy. The rice is served in a bamboo container that you can take with you when you are finished with your meal.
name: Ouga

desc_l10n.en: This simple handmade noodle restaurant has been around for 20 years. At Gohyangjip, there are no secret recipes or elaborate garnishings on their food, just great-tasting kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup)—the kind that Korean grandmas would cookfor you at home. Their manduguk (Korean dumpling soup) is also popular.
desc_l10n.ja: 20年の歴史を誇る素朴なカルグクス(韓国式うどん)のお店。韓国の家庭で食べるようなカルグクスを味わえる。マンドゥクク(餃子入りスープ)も人気メニューだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 20년 내력의 소박한 청국장 집.  보쌈, 청국장, 제육 등 노포 분위기의 동네 맛집.
desc_l10n.zh: 拥有20年历史的手工刀切面专卖店，汤饺是人气商品之一。汤面的汤汁虽然没有特制秘方，但味道简单朴实。

description: This simple handmade noodle restaurant has been around for 20 years. At Gohyangjip, there are no secret recipes or elaborate garnishings on their food, just great-tasting kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup)—the kind that Korean grandmas would cookfor you at home. Their manduguk (Korean dumpling soup) is also popular.
name: Gohyangjip

desc_l10n.en: Myeongpum Janchiguksu specializes in noodles, but they are especially famous for their refreshing janchi guksu (vermicelli-style noodles in anchovy broth seasoned with soy sauce) and slightly sour-tasting bibim guksu (noodles mixed with assorted vegetables in a spicy sauce). The prices are low and and the portions are generous, so expect long lines at mealtime.
desc_l10n.ja: プなしのピリ辛冷やし素麺)が人気の麺専門店。安くて量が多いのが人気の秘訣。食事の時間になると必ず行列ができる。 すっきりしたスープのチャンチグクス(韓国式にゅうめん)とピビムグクス(スー
desc_l10n.ko: 시원한 국물의 잔치국수와 새콤한 맛의 비빔국수가 인기인 국수전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 该店是一家面条专门店，汤爽口的宴会汤面和酸酸的荞麦拌面备受顾客喜爱。价格便宜，份量十足。就餐高峰期，经常需要排队等位。

description: Myeongpum Janchiguksu specializes in noodles, but they are especially famous for their refreshing janchi guksu (vermicelli-style noodles in anchovy broth seasoned with soy sauce) and slightly sour-tasting bibim guksu (noodles mixed with assorted vegetables in a spicy sauce). The prices are low and and the portions are generous, so expect long lines at mealtime.
name: Myeongpum Janchiguksu

name_l10n.ja: ミョンプム・チャンチグクス

desc_l10n.en: Potala specializes in Tibetan cuisine made by Tibetans. Thukpa is a Tibetan noodle soup, and momo is akin to dumplings. The interior is decorated in traditional Tibetan style . You can download discount coupons from the website
desc_l10n.ja: チベット料理店。チベット人シェフによる本場の味を楽しめる。トゥクパはすいとんに似ている麺料理。モモは餃子に似た料理だ。チベット伝統の装飾がされている店内が印象的だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 티베트인이 만드는 티베트 음식을 전문으로 하는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店专门提供由西藏人制作的西藏料理。Thukpa是类似面疙瘩的面料理，Momo则是类似饺子的料理。室内设计采传统西藏风格。在店家的官网上，还能下载打印. 您可以从网站下载优惠券

description: Potala specializes in Tibetan cuisine made by Tibetans. Thukpa is a Tibetan noodle soup, and momo is akin to dumplings. The interior is decorated in traditional Tibetan style . You can download discount coupons from the website
name: Potala

desc_l10n.en: Itaewon Sutbulgui is a premium Korean barbeque restaurant and butcher shop. The prices here are quite high, but that is expected for high-quality fresh meat. They grill the beef over charcoals in a gridiron. If you plan on ordering premium sirloin, advanced booking is required since quantities are limited.
desc_l10n.ja: 精肉屋の焼肉店。質のよいハヌソゴギグイ(ブランド韓国産牛のハヌ(韓牛)焼肉)を味わえる。トゥクトゥンシム(特牛ロース)は量が少ないので、電話で前もって注文しておかなければいけない。お昼にはコムタン(牛肉や内臓を煮込んだスープ)の注文が可能。焼肉店だが添えて食べるパジョリ(ネギの塩漬け)もおいしいと人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 가격은 비싸지만 질 좋은 한우 소고기구이를 먹을 수 있는 정육점식당.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为肉铺烤肉店，虽然价格偏高，但却可以品尝到优质的烤韩牛肉。在炭火上架上铁往后，便可以开始烤肉。特级牛里脊的数量不多，因此必须提前电话预约。

description: Itaewon Sutbulgui is a premium Korean barbeque restaurant and butcher shop. The prices here are quite high, but that is expected for high-quality fresh meat. They grill the beef over charcoals in a gridiron. If you plan on ordering premium sirloin, advanced booking is required since quantities are limited.
name: Itaewon Sutbulgui

desc_l10n.en: Goo STK 528 has become famous for their aged beef steak. The storeroom here is located right near the entrance so as soon as you come in, you'll be able to see where the meat is being aged. The price depends on how well-aged the available meat is, so you should be prepared to sometimes pay more than you were expecting.
desc_l10n.ja: ドライエイジング(乾燥熟成)させたステーキで有名なレストラン。店内に入ると貯蔵庫で熟成中の肉が見えるようディスプレイされている。熟成された肉をその日の状態により価格を決めるため、予算は大目にみておくのがよい。
desc_l10n.ko: 숙성한 소고기 스테이크를 먹을 수 있는 곳
desc_l10n.zh: 此店有名的地方在于可以品尝到干式熟成的牛排。进到店内后，便能看到正在贮藏柜中进行熟成的牛肉。经适当熟成的牛肉，则会根据当天的状态好坏而决定价格，因此必须要有价格可能会比预期高出许多的心理准备。

description: Goo STK 528 has become famous for their aged beef steak. The storeroom here is located right near the entrance so as soon as you come in, you'll be able to see where the meat is being aged. The price depends on how well-aged the available meat is, so you should be prepared to sometimes pay more than you were expecting.
name: Goo STK 528

desc_l10n.en: Mano di Chef is an Italian bistro where you can enjoy pizza and pasta comfortably. Their cranberry pizza is well-known, as is their unique gorgonzola pizza, with its black squid ink crust. Enhance your meal with one of their 250 varieties of wine.
desc_l10n.ja: ピザやパスタを気軽に楽しむことのできるイタリアンビストロ。ブルーベリーピザが人気だ。イカ墨を練り込んだ生地を使ったゴルゴンゾーラピザも独特なメニューの一つ。ワインも250種以上取り揃えているのでワインと一緒に楽しむのも良い。
desc_l10n.ko: 피자와 파스타를 부담없이 즐길 수 있는 이탈리안 비스트로.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为可以轻松享用批萨和意大利面的意式小餐馆。店内的蓝莓披萨相当有名，在饼皮中添加墨鱼汁的戈根索拉奶酪披萨亦为特色料理之一。 另备有250余种的葡萄酒，因此亦很适合以葡萄酒搭配美食。

description: Mano di Chef is an Italian bistro where you can enjoy pizza and pasta comfortably. Their cranberry pizza is well-known, as is their unique gorgonzola pizza, with its black squid ink crust. Enhance your meal with one of their 250 varieties of wine.
name: Mano di Chef

desc_l10n.en: The name of this Italian restaurant, Herzia, means sunflowers in Spanish. Also good is their dish of fried sirloin, seafood, and vegetables seasoned with sauce. The basement floor has special seating for couples with a blind that can be lowered so you can enjoy your meal without interruption. You can enjoy a nice view of Myeongdong and Namsan (Mt.) at night from the second floor.
desc_l10n.ja: スペイン語でひまわりという意味のイタリアンレストラン。サーロイン、魚介類、野菜をソースと炒めた鉄板焼きもおいしい。地下1階はカップル席になっており、ロールスクリーンを下ろせば、他に気兼ねなく食事をすることも可能。
desc_l10n.ko: 스페인어로 해바라기라는 뜻의 이탈리안 레스토랑.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为意式餐厅，店名〝Herzia〞在西班牙语中意指向日葵。人气料理 将牛里脊、海鲜和蔬菜一起搭配酱汁拌炒的铁板烧，亦相当受到欢迎。店家在地下1楼设有情侣席，将纱幔放下后，便能不受打扰的用餐，2楼则能欣赏到明洞和南山的夜景。

description: The name of this Italian restaurant, Herzia, means sunflowers in Spanish. Also good is their dish of fried sirloin, seafood, and vegetables seasoned with sauce. The basement floor has special seating for couples with a blind that can be lowered so you can enjoy your meal without interruption. You can enjoy a nice view of Myeongdong and Namsan (Mt.) at night from the second floor.
name: Herzia

address: 서울 강남구 도산대로49길 10-8 (신사동, 신사동 K 빌딩)

desc_l10n.en: Gulbi Maeul's specialty is gulbi, grilled dried yellow croaker, although all kinds of seafood are available here, including stingray. Highly recommended is the barley-aged yellow croaker; the dried fish, which are buried in barley and matured for a month,are served with rice soaked in cool green tea.
desc_l10n.ja: クルビグイ(焼き干しイシモチ)の専門店。他の海産物類やホンオフェ(ガンギエイの刺身)なども味わうことができる。 干したイシモチを麦の中で1ヶ月熟成させたものを冷たいお茶漬けと一緒に食べるポリグルビジョンシク(麦イシモチ定食)がおすすめ。ムグンジ(長期熟成キムチ)に包んで食べるホンオフェやホンオエタン(ガンギエイの肝のスープ)もおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 굴비구이를 전문으로 하며, 해산물, 홍어 등도 맛볼 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店主要提供烤咸黄鱼，另有海鲜、魟鱼等料理。值得推荐的料理为大麦咸黄鱼定食，将埋在大麦里，经过一个月熟成的咸黄鱼和绿茶泡饭一起享用风味绝佳。以陈年辛奇（kimchi）包着腌渍魟鱼一起吃的魟鱼生鱼片和魟鱼肝汤也值得一尝。

description: Gulbi Maeul's specialty is gulbi, grilled dried yellow croaker, although all kinds of seafood are available here, including stingray. Highly recommended is the barley-aged yellow croaker; the dried fish, which are buried in barley and matured for a month,are served with rice soaked in cool green tea.
name: Gulbi Maeul

desc_l10n.en: This restaurant has been serving large Pyeongyang-style stuffed mandu (Korean dumplings) from the same location for more than 20 years. The original owner hailed from Pyeongyang, and now her children continue to offer the same great-tasting food. Their menu is simple, but the mandu jeongol (mandu hot pot) and the manduguk (mandu soup) they serve are full of nutritious ingredients and quite filling.
desc_l10n.ja: 大きくて中身がぎっしりつまったピョンヤン(平壌)式餃子のお店。20年以上同じところで営業しています。平壌出身のお婆さんが開店し、現在2代目が先代の味を受け継いでいる。マンドゥ(餃子)とマンドゥチョンゴル(餃子入り鍋)が特に人気。冬や正月には自宅用に餃子を持ち帰る人も多い。
desc_l10n.ko: 큼직한 크기의, 속이 꽉 찬 평양식 만두로 20년 넘게 한 곳에서 장사
desc_l10n.zh: 偌大的体积和内馅饱满的平壤饺子，已经有20多年的历史。来自平壤老奶奶的好手艺，现在已交由第2代继续传承下去。虽然菜色选择不多，但饺子锅和汤饺都相当物美价廉，到冬天或者重大节日的时候，许多顾客都会来此购买冷冻饺子。开店初期原本没有招牌，顾客简称为饺子店，但现在已挂上大大的招牌。

description: This restaurant has been serving large Pyeongyang-style stuffed mandu (Korean dumplings) from the same location for more than 20 years. The original owner hailed from Pyeongyang, and now her children continue to offer the same great-tasting food. Their menu is simple, but the mandu jeongol (mandu hot pot) and the manduguk (mandu soup) they serve are full of nutritious ingredients and quite filling.
name: Mandujip

desc_l10n.en: Authentic sushi prepared with pride by Yamamoto Tsudao, a master of sushi with 40 years of experience can be enjoyed at this sushi restaurant. They carefully select only the best pieces of bluefin tuna every day. One item on the menu that they take particular pride in is their negitoro, thinly sliced otoro (the front part of the bluefin tuna belly) garnished with chopped leeks and seaweed and eaten with genuine wasabi.
desc_l10n.ja: 40年の経歴を誇る、寿司職人の山本氏が作る寿司を味わうことができるところ。本マグロの最高の部位を厳選して熟成させ、お客に出している。大トロのネギトロが人気メニューだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 경력 40년 스시 명인 야마모토 스다오 씨가 만드는 정통 스시.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到拥有40年厨师经验的寿司达人山本先生制作的正宗寿司。店家每天会挑选出真鲔鱼最高级的部位进行加工，将黑鲔鱼肉剁碎后，搭配细葱、海苔和新鲜芥末的葱鲔鱼寿司等，也是店家引以为荣的菜式。

description: Authentic sushi prepared with pride by Yamamoto Tsudao, a master of sushi with 40 years of experience can be enjoyed at this sushi restaurant. They carefully select only the best pieces of bluefin tuna every day. One item on the menu that they take particular pride in is their negitoro, thinly sliced otoro (the front part of the bluefin tuna belly) garnished with chopped leeks and seaweed and eaten with genuine wasabi.
name: Yamamoto Sushi

desc_l10n.en: Grand Ciel serves open-faced sandwiches on German-style yeast bread, herb salads, various pasta dishes, and other western fare. The yellow exterior wall and open terrace make you feel as though you are at a European cafe. It's packed with young people on the weekends who come for brunch.
desc_l10n.ja: イタリアンカジュアルレストラン。酵母パンを使ったオープンサンドやハーブサラダ、また多様なパスタメニューを取り揃えている。黄色い外壁とオープンテラスがヨーロッパの露天レストランのよう。 週末にはブランチを楽しむ人が多く訪れる。
desc_l10n.ko: 이탈리아 가정식을 표방는 샌드위치와 허브 샐러드, 다양한 파스타, 브런치
desc_l10n.zh: 此店提供意式家庭料理，有使用德国酵母面包的外馅三明治、草本色拉以及口味多样的意大利面。黄色的外墙和开放式的阳台，令人彷佛有来到欧洲露天餐厅的感觉。一到周末便会涌进许多想要悠闲品尝早午餐的年轻人。

description: Grand Ciel serves open-faced sandwiches on German-style yeast bread, herb salads, various pasta dishes, and other western fare. The yellow exterior wall and open terrace make you feel as though you are at a European cafe. It's packed with young people on the weekends who come for brunch.
name: Grand Ciel

desc_l10n.en: This restaurant in the Apgujeong area has been famous for a long time, primarily for their budae jjigae, a spicy sausage stew with ham and kimchi, which is very popular. Because they use mature, spicy kimchi to make their budae jjigae, it`s a bit on the spicy side. Enjoy it with modum-gui, a combination of steak, bacon, ham, sausage, and vegetables all grilled together on an iron griddle, for a savoury meal.
desc_l10n.ja: 狎鴎亭洞(アプクジョンドン)一帯の人気店。デウ食堂、キムシネとともに江南(カンナム)エリアの三大プデチゲ(ソーセージのピリ辛寄せ鍋)店の一つだ。ムグンジ(長期熟成キムチ)を使って作るブデチゲは少し辛めだが、味付けはさっぱり。モドゥングイ(グリル盛り合わせ)もおすすめだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 압구정 일대에서 햄, 소시지, 김치 등을 넣어서 끓이는 부대찌개가 유명한 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在狎鸥亭附近一直是知名的部队锅专卖店，并且与Daeu餐厅和金家在江南地区形成三强鼎立的局面。这里的部队锅使用陈年辛奇（kimchi）入锅炖煮，因此口味较为辛辣，若是再搭配烤物拼盘则更是完美。

description: This restaurant in the Apgujeong area has been famous for a long time, primarily for their budae jjigae, a spicy sausage stew with ham and kimchi, which is very popular. Because they use mature, spicy kimchi to make their budae jjigae, it`s a bit on the spicy side. Enjoy it with modum-gui, a combination of steak, bacon, ham, sausage, and vegetables all grilled together on an iron griddle, for a savoury meal.
name: Geumseong Steak

desc_l10n.en: Rossini is a restaurant that features many different kinds of northern Italian style pasta and steak. Here, the flavors are authentic and not flashy. The restaurant itself is very quiet as well.
desc_l10n.ja: 多種類のパスタとステーキをイタリア北部地方のスタイルで味わえるお店。派手な味ではないが、本場のイタリア料理が楽しめる。店内の雰囲気も静かで落ち着いている。
desc_l10n.ko: 여러 가지 파스타와 스테이크를 이탈리아 북부 지방 스타일로 맛볼 수 있는 곳
desc_l10n.zh: 可以品尝到意大利北部地区正宗口味的各式意大利面和牛排。去掉了北方油腻厚重的口味，保留传统意大利美食的风味。店内的气氛也颇为恬静。

description: Rossini is a restaurant that features many different kinds of northern Italian style pasta and steak. Here, the flavors are authentic and not flashy. The restaurant itself is very quiet as well.
name: Rossini

desc_l10n.en: Although the styles of Jeollanam-do (the southern province of the region of Jeolla) cuisine are varied, Yeosu Dongchon features the traditional cooking of the Yeosu area. The representative dish at this restaurant is the local variation of samhap (a dish of pork neck, aged kimchi, and cockle shellfish), and shellfish like cockles and comb pens. In the summer, hamo (pike eel) shabu shabu is recommended. For lunch, you can enjoy meongge bibimbap (a bowl of rice topped with fresh chopped sea squirt, sautéed and seasoned vegetables, and chili paste), and raw crabs marinated in soy sauce, in addition to many other dishes.
desc_l10n.ja: 全羅南道(チョルラナムド)麗水(ヨス)地方の料理専門店。麗水式のサムハプ(ガンギエイとゆで豚肉の熟成キムチ包み)やトリガイ、平貝が代表メニューだ。夏にはハモのしゃぶしゃぶがおすすめ。お昼にはモンゲピビンバ(ホヤのピビンバ)、カンジャンケジャン(カニの醬油漬け)などのメニューがある。値段は少し高めだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 여수식을 표방하는 해산물집.  새조개, 키조개가 대표 메뉴.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店标榜提供南道料理中的丽水料理，招牌料理为丽水风格的三合、鸟蛤和牛角蛤。若是夏天，则推荐海鳗涮涮锅，午餐时段也可以享用到海鞘拌饭和酱石蟹等料理。此店价格略高。

description: Although the styles of Jeollanam-do (the southern province of the region of Jeolla) cuisine are varied, Yeosu Dongchon features the traditional cooking of the Yeosu area. The representative dish at this restaurant is the local variation of samhap (a dish of pork neck, aged kimchi, and cockle shellfish), and shellfish like cockles and comb pens. In the summer, hamo (pike eel) shabu shabu is recommended. For lunch, you can enjoy meongge bibimbap (a bowl of rice topped with fresh chopped sea squirt, sautéed and seasoned vegetables, and chili paste), and raw crabs marinated in soy sauce, in addition to many other dishes.
name: Yeosu Dongchon

desc_l10n.en: The concept behind Vitamin Cafe is health and beauty, and so all of the beverages on offer here are enriched with vitamins. The interior décor is brightly colored and full of vitality, so the atmosphere here is energizing as well.
desc_l10n.ja: 健康と美容をコンセプトにしたカフェ。すべてのドリンク類にはビタミンが入っている。店内のインテリアもビタミンを連想させる爽やかなイメージだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 상호와 노란색으로 칠해진 외관부터 상큼한 느낌의 펍.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店以健康和美容为经营理念，因此在所有饮品内都会添加维他命，室内装潢也会令人联想到维他命充满活力的感觉

description: The concept behind Vitamin Cafe is health and beauty, and so all of the beverages on offer here are enriched with vitamins. The interior décor is brightly colored and full of vitality, so the atmosphere here is energizing as well.
name: Vitamin Cafe&Pub

desc_l10n.en: Mongno specializes in Pyeongyang-style mandu (Korean dumplings). In addition to mandu they also serve manduguk, a soup in which these dumplings are cooked in a clear beef broth made from slowly boiled beef bones. The soup is a hearty and clear. Also recommendedis the nokdujeon (Korean pancakes made with mung bean) and their various other noodle and rice dishes.
desc_l10n.ja: 平壌(ピョンヤン)式マンドゥ(餃子)の専門店。 牛の肩バラで取った透き通ったスープに大ぶりの餃子が盛られて出されるマンドゥクク(餃子入りスープ)は、あっさりしていておいしい。ピンデトク(緑豆のチヂミ)も美味だ。その他、麺類やピビンバなどのメニューも揃っている。
desc_l10n.ko: 평양만두 전문점.  맑고 시원한 국물과 커다람 만두.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为平壤饺子专卖店。汤饺的作法是将偌大的平壤饺子，放进以牛熬制而成的高汤中，再放上调味过的碎牛排骨肉作为点缀，高汤清爽可口。绿豆煎饼也是值得推荐的好味道，店家另备有汤面、拌饭等各式料理。

description: Mongno specializes in Pyeongyang-style mandu (Korean dumplings). In addition to mandu they also serve manduguk, a soup in which these dumplings are cooked in a clear beef broth made from slowly boiled beef bones. The soup is a hearty and clear. Also recommendedis the nokdujeon (Korean pancakes made with mung bean) and their various other noodle and rice dishes.
name: Mongno

desc_l10n.en: Yeongdong Seolleongtang has been developing their expertise at cooking for 30 years. Their best dish is seolleongtang, a milky-white soup made by slowly simmering oxtails and bones. The only other dish on the menu is suyuk (steamed meat). If you're trying to eat less fat or are on a diet, you can order a lighter version of seolleongtang that contains less fat.
desc_l10n.ja: 30年伝統の味を誇るソルロンタン(牛の肉や骨を煮込んだスープ)のお店。ソルロンタン以外のメニューはスユク(茹で肉)のみ。脂っこいのが苦手な人は注文するときに脂抜きも注文できる。
desc_l10n.ko: 30년 전통 손맛을 자랑하는 집. 설렁탕 한 그릇으로 승부하는 곳으로, 설렁탕 외의 메뉴는 수육 한 가지. 기름기가 싫거나 다이어트 중인 사람은 주문할 때 기름빼기 설렁탕을 주문.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店以拥有30年的传统手艺而感到自豪。店家以一碗牛杂碎汤定胜负，因此除了牛杂碎汤外，仅提供白煮肉。若是不喜欢油腻或是正在瘦身中的人，则可以选择去油牛杂碎汤。

description: Yeongdong Seolleongtang has been developing their expertise at cooking for 30 years. Their best dish is seolleongtang, a milky-white soup made by slowly simmering oxtails and bones. The only other dish on the menu is suyuk (steamed meat). If you're trying to eat less fat or are on a diet, you can order a lighter version of seolleongtang that contains less fat.
name: Yeongdong Seolleongtang

name_l10n.ja: ヨンドン・ソルロンタン

desc_l10n.en: Chez Flo is a French pub recently opened by Kitchen Flo, a well-known French fusion restaurant in Seorae Maeul. They offer French and Japanese cuisine. It is a good place to go for a drink as the prices are relatively low.
desc_l10n.ja: フランス人が多く住むソレマウル地域で有名な「キッチンフロー」が新しくオープンしたフレンチレストラン。フレンチスタイルの料理と一緒に日本スタイルの料理も楽しめる。手頃な値段で軽くお酒飲むにもぴったりだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 서래마을에서 프렌치 퓨전으로 이름을 알린 키친 플로에서 새로 오픈한 프렌치 선술집.
desc_l10n.zh: 瑞来村里以法国时尚闻名的kitchen flow里新开张的french pub，在这里可以找到法式料理和日式料理。以实惠的价格享受优质的料理。

description: Chez Flo is a French pub recently opened by Kitchen Flo, a well-known French fusion restaurant in Seorae Maeul. They offer French and Japanese cuisine. It is a good place to go for a drink as the prices are relatively low.
name: Chez Flo

desc_l10n.en: This is the Samseong-dong branch of Inamjang in Euljiro that, for 30 years, has been maintaining the same great taste of their seolleongtang (ox bone soup). The broth is simmered for two days, making it thick and flavorful, and to this they add thick slices of high-quality meat. If you order a large bowl, they add slices of very tender beef tongue. The kimchi and radish kimchi that is served at the restaurant is available for purchase to take home.
desc_l10n.ja: ウルチロ(乙支路)で30年の間、同じ味を守り続けているソルロンタン(牛の肉や骨を煮込んだスープ)専門店のサムソンドン(三成洞)支店。丸二日煮込んだスープは濃厚な味わいだ。特ソルロンタンには牛舌が入っており、柔らかくておいしい。自家製のキムチとカクトゥギ(大根キムチ)は販売も行っている。
desc_l10n.ko: 을지로 뒷골목에서 30년 동안 똑같은 맛을 지켜오고 있는 설렁탕 전문점의 삼성동 분점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为30年来在乙支路后巷始终维持相同口味的牛杂碎汤专卖店在三成洞的分店。整整熬制两天的肉汤，味道香醇浓厚，牛肉也相当厚实。点用特级牛杂碎汤才有的牛舌也是肉质软嫩。另有销售店家自行腌渍的泡菜和萝卜泡菜。

description: This is the Samseong-dong branch of Inamjang in Euljiro that, for 30 years, has been maintaining the same great taste of their seolleongtang (ox bone soup). The broth is simmered for two days, making it thick and flavorful, and to this they add thick slices of high-quality meat. If you order a large bowl, they add slices of very tender beef tongue. The kimchi and radish kimchi that is served at the restaurant is available for purchase to take home.
name: Inamjang (Samseong-dong Branch)

name_l10n.ja: イナムジャン 三成洞店

desc_l10n.en: Just Steak specializes in dry-aged Korean steaks. The prices are attractively low. Reasonably-priced wine is also available to enjoy with your steak.
desc_l10n.ja: ブランド韓国産牛のハヌ(韓牛)で作ったドライエイジング(乾燥熟成)ステーキ専門店。ステーキ・ワインともに手頃な価格で楽しめる。
desc_l10n.ko: 한우로 만든 드라이 에이징 스테이크를 전문으로 하는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 以韩牛制作的干式熟成排专门店，实惠的价格让人眼睛一亮，也可搭配价格合理的红酒一起享用 。

description: Just Steak specializes in dry-aged Korean steaks. The prices are attractively low. Reasonably-priced wine is also available to enjoy with your steak.
name: Just Steak

desc_l10n.en: Samseong Wonjo Yanggopchang is famous for their stuffed gopchang-gui (grilled intestines). After your main meal is done, delicious fried rice is prepared on the same griddle. The cheonggukjang (soup prepared with fermented whole and ground soy beans) with the fried rice is thick, and consistently delicious.
desc_l10n.ja: ホルモン焼きの専門店。良質のコプチャン(小腸)を味わうことができるとして有名だ。コプチャンを食べた後、最後にご飯を混ぜて食べるピビンバもおいしい。また、ピビンバと一緒に深い味わいのチョングクチャン(納豆味噌鍋)もおすすめだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 속이 꽉 찬 곱창구이를 맛볼 수 있는 집.  볶음밥이 일품.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到饱满的烤牛小肠。享用完烤牛小肠后，还能在铁盘上炒饭，风味绝佳。搭配烤牛小肠一起享用的浓郁清曲酱汤，美味依旧。美中不足的是，室内空间狭小。

description: Samseong Wonjo Yanggopchang is famous for their stuffed gopchang-gui (grilled intestines). After your main meal is done, delicious fried rice is prepared on the same griddle. The cheonggukjang (soup prepared with fermented whole and ground soy beans) with the fried rice is thick, and consistently delicious.
name: Samseong Wonjo Yanggopchang

name_l10n.ja: サムソン・ウォンジョ・ヤンコプチャン
name_l10n.zh: 三成元祖烤牛肚肠(Samseong Wonjoyanggopchang)

desc_l10n.en: This is the Bangi branch of Bongpiyang, which is famous for dwaeji galbi (spareribs) operated by the same owner as Byeokje Galbi, a beef galbi restaurant. Though the prices are not cheap, the taste and quality of the food here is excellent. Their naengmyeon (cold buckwheat noodles served either in a tangy iced broth or mixed with spicy red chili sauce) is very popular and said to be true to the way it is made in Pyeongyang. They have a savoury lunch set that includes galbi and your choice of naengmyeon or doenjang jjigae (soybean paste stew).
desc_l10n.ja: テジカルビ(味付け豚カルビの焼肉)で有名なボンピヤンのパンイドン(芳夷洞)支店。上質の牛カルビで有名なピョクチェ(碧蹄)カルビが直営するテジカルビの専門店だ。テジカルビとしては高めだが、納得のいく味わい。カルビとネンミョン(冷麺)またはテンジャンチゲ(味噌鍋)が出るランチセットがお得だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 돼지갈비로 유명한 봉피양의 방이동 분점. 소갈비로 유명한 벽제갈비에서 운영하는 브랜드. 돼지갈비치고는 가격대가 높은 편이지만 맛은 보장.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为以烤猪小排而闻名的本平壤在芳荑洞的分店，是由知名烤牛小排专卖店碧帝排骨所经营的品牌。就烤猪小排而言，此店的价格虽然偏高，但口味也相对的较有保障。获评口味十分接近正宗平壤冷面的冷面也相当受到欢迎。除烤排骨外，内容包含冷面和大豆酱锅的午间套餐也相当经济实惠。

description: This is the Bangi branch of Bongpiyang, which is famous for dwaeji galbi (spareribs) operated by the same owner as Byeokje Galbi, a beef galbi restaurant. Though the prices are not cheap, the taste and quality of the food here is excellent. Their naengmyeon (cold buckwheat noodles served either in a tangy iced broth or mixed with spicy red chili sauce) is very popular and said to be true to the way it is made in Pyeongyang. They have a savoury lunch set that includes galbi and your choice of naengmyeon or doenjang jjigae (soybean paste stew).
name: Bongpiyang (Bangi Branch)

name_l10n.ja: ポンピヤン 芳荑店

desc_l10n.en: Gran Gusto has gained popularity for its innovative approach to Italian cuisine, especially with its mackerel and anchovy pasta. They also cater to those with a taste for more traditional Italian fare. A very pleasant dining experience for the price
desc_l10n.ja: さばパスタやいわしパスタなど独創的なパスタで人気の店。パスタだけではなく正統なイタリアコース料理も味わうことができるところ。 価格の割りに満足度が高く、好評だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 이탈리아 레스토랑의 역사가 길지 않은 서울에서 오랫동안 맛을 유지
desc_l10n.zh: 创新口味的鲭花鱼和鳀鱼意大利面受到顾客的青睐，店内不仅提供意大利面，还有正宗意式料理套餐。

description: Gran Gusto has gained popularity for its innovative approach to Italian cuisine, especially with its mackerel and anchovy pasta. They also cater to those with a taste for more traditional Italian fare. A very pleasant dining experience for the price
name: Gran Gusto

desc_l10n.en: At Gisoya specializes in home-style Japanese food. The chefs here create an exquisite harmony of flavors with Japanese udon (thick noodles) and Korean kimchi or chili powder. Various bento set meals are available, including tonkatsu (breaded, deep-fried pork cutlet) and katsunabe (breaded, deep-fried pork cutlet in broth with beaten egg), all of which include a bowl of udon.
desc_l10n.ja: 多くのチェーンを持つ韓国風日本料理の店。サムソンドン(三成洞)の木曽屋が本店だ。日本のうどんにキムチや唐辛子粉など韓国的な味を絶妙に調和させている。様々な種類の定食があり、全てにうどんがセットになっている。
desc_l10n.ko: 삼성동 본점 일식 우동.소바 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 木曾屋曾经一度在首尔掀起流行话题，并且拥有许多分店，但还是以三成洞总店的口味最佳，总店拥有不同于其他分店的独特韵味。店家在日式乌龙里加入辛奇（kimchi）或辣椒粉等韩式食材，巧妙地融合日式与韩式的味道。种类丰富的套餐，皆可与乌龙搭配享用。

description: At Gisoya specializes in home-style Japanese food. The chefs here create an exquisite harmony of flavors with Japanese udon (thick noodles) and Korean kimchi or chili powder. Various bento set meals are available, including tonkatsu (breaded, deep-fried pork cutlet) and katsunabe (breaded, deep-fried pork cutlet in broth with beaten egg), all of which include a bowl of udon.
name: Gisoya

desc_l10n.en: Mi Piace is one of the oldest restaurants in Cheongdam-dong. offers a combination of homemade authentic French and Italian styles. The décor, tableware, and accessories are quaint, and their appetizers, entrées, and desserts are comparable with the very best. The menu changes every season, revealing new delights. Mi Piace Vino on the second floor is a nice place to enjoy wine until late at night.
desc_l10n.ja: チョンダムドン(清潭洞)の有名レストランの一つ。正統イタリアンにフレンチを融合させたホームメードスタイルの料理を味わえるところ。季節によってメニューが変わるコースは前菜からデザートまで華やかで充実。2階では遅い夜までワインを楽しむことも可能。予約は必須。
desc_l10n.ko: 청담동에서 가장 오래된 레스토랑 중의 하나로, 오랫동안 변함없는 맛을 유지
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为清潭洞地区历史悠久的意式餐厅，提供添加法式风味的意式家常料理。室内装修、餐具和装饰品都相当漂亮。前菜、主餐和甜点也都非常出色，菜单会随季节改变，提供顾客多样化的美味。2楼的mi piace vino可以享用美酒到深夜。此店须事先预约。

description: Mi Piace is one of the oldest restaurants in Cheongdam-dong. offers a combination of homemade authentic French and Italian styles. The décor, tableware, and accessories are quaint, and their appetizers, entrées, and desserts are comparable with the very best. The menu changes every season, revealing new delights. Mi Piace Vino on the second floor is a nice place to enjoy wine until late at night.
name: Mi Piace

desc_l10n.en: This famous kalguksu restaurant in Gangnam has a proud 20-year history. The guljeon, savoury pancakes made with fresh oysters, are fantastic in the colder months. The kalguksu (handmade, knife-cut noodle soup) is served in beef broth is worth trying. This is a good place to have a drink because there is a good selection of side dishes, such as jeyuk (spicy beef with vegetables) and bindae-tteok (mung bean pancakes).
desc_l10n.ja: カンナム(江南)エリアで有名なカルグクス(韓国式うどん)の専門店で、20年の伝統を誇る。牛骨でとったスープは味わい深い。全般的にメニューはどれもあっさりとして淡泊だ。肉料理やピンデトク(緑豆チヂミ)、クルジョン(牡蠣のチヂミ)など気軽につまめるメニューも多く、お酒の席としても多く利用される店だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 강남에서는 꽤 오래된 유명한 칼국숫집으로, 20년 전통을 자랑.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为在江南地区一直享有盛名的刀切面店，店家以拥有20年的历史为荣，料理清爽可口。若是天气转凉，鲜美的牡蛎煎饼也相当美味。一定要尝尝汤头为大骨汤的刀切面，还有很多适合当作下酒菜的料理，如猪肉、绿豆煎饼和牡蛎煎饼等，因此也有许多人会在此小酌一杯。

description: This famous kalguksu restaurant in Gangnam has a proud 20-year history. The guljeon, savoury pancakes made with fresh oysters, are fantastic in the colder months. The kalguksu (handmade, knife-cut noodle soup) is served in beef broth is worth trying. This is a good place to have a drink because there is a good selection of side dishes, such as jeyuk (spicy beef with vegetables) and bindae-tteok (mung bean pancakes).
name: Hanseong Kalguksu

name_l10n.ja: ハンソン・カルクグス

desc_l10n.en: Cavallo Bianco is an Italian restaurant that specializes in set-menu meals. The restaurant has several private rooms to suit your individual needs, however, an advanced reservation is advisable. Both the first and second floors have a terrace, and there is a live concert performed on the first floor every day (except on Sundays).
desc_l10n.ja: イタリアンレストラン。イタリアンをコース料理で味わうところ。プライベートルームも備えています。ライブ演奏もおこなっていて、食事をしながら音楽も楽しめる。ただし、日曜日の公演は行っていません。
desc_l10n.ko: 이탈리안 코스요리를 전문점, 펍도 함께 운영
desc_l10n.zh: 此店专门提供意式料理套餐，店家备有多间包厢，顾客最好事先预约。1、2楼皆有阳台，1楼还有现场演出，但星期日不提供。

description: Cavallo Bianco is an Italian restaurant that specializes in set-menu meals. The restaurant has several private rooms to suit your individual needs, however, an advanced reservation is advisable. Both the first and second floors have a terrace, and there is a live concert performed on the first floor every day (except on Sundays).
name: Cavallo Bianco

desc_l10n.en: Myeong-dong Hamheung Myeonok is a naengmyeon specialty restaurant that was established in Myeong-dong in the late 1970s. Featuring luxurious interior decorations and air conditioning, along with outstanding food quality, it gained popularity among professionals and artists, who referred to it as "Myeong-dong crowd." The first-generation owners, a married couple from Hwanghae Province, are renowned for their Hamgyong-style hoe naengmyeon. The restaurant is characterized by its spicy sashimi and mixed sauces made with over 30 fresh ingredients, seamlessly blending modern sensibilities with traditional flavors
desc_l10n.ja: ミョンドン咸興麺屋は、1970年代後半に明洞で始まった冷麺専門店で、高級感のある内装とエアコンを備え、料理の味も素晴らしかったため、「ミョンドン派」と呼ばれる専門家や芸術家の間で人気を集めました。初代の社長夫婦は黄海道出身で、咸鏡道風の刺身冷麺が有名です。ピリ辛の刺身と30種類以上の新鮮な食材で作られた和えソースが特徴で、現代的な感覚と伝統の味が融合したお店です。
desc_l10n.ko: 고구마 전분을 사용해 보드라운 식감의 함흥냉면
desc_l10n.zh: 明洞咸兴面屋是1970年代末在明洞开业的冷面专门店，因其高档的室内装饰和空调设备，以及美味的食物，曾在被称为“明洞派”的专家和艺术家中备受欢迎。第一代店主夫妇来自黄海道，以咸镜道风格的生鱼冷面闻名。其特色在于辛辣的生鱼片和由30多种新鲜食材制成的拌酱，完美结合了现代感和传统风味。

description: Myeong-dong Hamheung Myeonok is a naengmyeon specialty restaurant that was established in Myeong-dong in the late 1970s. Featuring luxurious interior decorations and air conditioning, along with outstanding food quality, it gained popularity among professionals and artists, who referred to it as "Myeong-dong crowd." The first-generation owners, a married couple from Hwanghae Province, are renowned for their Hamgyong-style hoe naengmyeon. The restaurant is characterized by its spicy sashimi and mixed sauces made with over 30 fresh ingredients, seamlessly blending modern sensibilities with traditional flavors
name: Myeongdong Hamheung Myeonok

desc_l10n.en: Kkotji uses blue crabs delivered from Seosan to make their ganjang gejang (crabs marinated in soy sauce) and other crab dishes. You can also enjoy specialty dishes local to the west coast of Korea, such as steamed blue crabs, live octopus, and octopus soup with gourds. They offer a set menu for two people which includes half a crab per person, making it an affordable way to try ganjang gejang.
desc_l10n.ja: カンジャンケジャン(カニの醤油漬け)などのカニ料理を味わえるところ。醤油を使わず牡蠣の塩辛を使って発酵させたケジャンが特徴だ。ケジャン以外にもコッケチム(カニ蒸し)、サンナッチ(活たこ)、バクソクナッチタン(瓜の身とたこのスープ)のような西海岸の名物を味わうことができる。オリグルジョッ(牡蠣の塩辛)も絶品だ。1人当りカニが半尾出てくる 2人用セットメニューもある。
desc_l10n.ko: 서산에서 가져온 꽃게로 만든 게장과 꽃게 요리가 정갈하게 나오는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 店家使用产自瑞山的花蟹来制作酱油腌螃蟹和其他花蟹料理。此店的酱螃蟹不使用酱油，而是使用熟成后的酱牡蛎汤汁腌渍而成，风味相当独特。另还能享用到蒸花蟹、活章鱼和章鱼汤等西海岸有名的海鲜料理，酱牡蛎也是绝品好味道。店家还有提供2人一只花蟹的套餐组合，因此能以低廉的价格品尝到酱螃蟹的美味。

description: Kkotji uses blue crabs delivered from Seosan to make their ganjang gejang (crabs marinated in soy sauce) and other crab dishes. You can also enjoy specialty dishes local to the west coast of Korea, such as steamed blue crabs, live octopus, and octopus soup with gourds. They offer a set menu for two people which includes half a crab per person, making it an affordable way to try ganjang gejang.
name: Kkotji

desc_l10n.en: Jeonju Sikdang Cheonggukjangjip is famous for cheonggukjang (fermented soybean paste stew). Their cheonggukjang doesn't have the usual strong distinctive smell, but it still has plenty of flavor. The cheonggukjang also tastes great with the accompanying side dishes, like kongnamul (cooked soybean sprouts flavored with sesame oil) and musaengchae (julienned white radish in sweetened vinegar). Their raw crab marinated in soy sauce is also famous.
desc_l10n.ja: チョングクチャン(納豆味噌)の店。匂いが気にならない特有の香ばしさが生きているチョングクチャン(納豆味噌)は味わい深い。一緒に出されるもやしや大根の和え物などと一緒に混ぜて食べるのもおすすめ。チョングクチャン(納豆味噌)の他、カンジャンゲジャン(カニの醤油漬け)も有名 。
desc_l10n.ko: 청국장 냄새가 진하지 않으면서도 특유의 구수함이 살아 있는 청국장 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的清曲酱汤，味道不仅不呛鼻，甚至还有一股特殊的香气。将清曲酱汤和黄豆芽、凉拌生萝卜等其他小菜拌在一起吃，滋味绝佳，酱油腌螃蟹也相当有名。

description: Jeonju Sikdang Cheonggukjangjip is famous for cheonggukjang (fermented soybean paste stew). Their cheonggukjang doesn't have the usual strong distinctive smell, but it still has plenty of flavor. The cheonggukjang also tastes great with the accompanying side dishes, like kongnamul (cooked soybean sprouts flavored with sesame oil) and musaengchae (julienned white radish in sweetened vinegar). Their raw crab marinated in soy sauce is also famous.
name: Jeonju Sikdang Cheonggukjangjip

name_l10n.ja: チョンジュ・チョングクチャンジプ
name_l10n.zh: 全州食堂清曲酱汤家(Jeonjusikdang Chunggukjangjip)

desc_l10n.en: It was Baetgodong that first introduced ojingeo bulgogi (spicy marinated squid) to Seoul, so you can imagine this restaurant is quite popular. Expect to wait in line, even on weekdays. The octopus and squid are quite spicy, but also have a pleasant sweetness.
desc_l10n.ja: オジンオブルゴギ(ピリ辛イカ炒め)の元祖格で、平日にも並んで待たなければならないほどに人気のあるところ。 甘辛いイカや蛸がおいしい。食べ終わったら残ったソースにご飯を炒めて食べるポックンバプもおすすめだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 오징어 불고기의 원조격으로, 평일에도 줄 서서 기다려야 할 정도로 인기 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店可说是铁板辣炒鱿鱼的始祖，就算是平日也都必须排队等候，人气居高不下。又甜又辣的章鱼和鱿鱼滋味绝佳，享用完鱿鱼后还可以品尝铁板炒饭。

description: It was Baetgodong that first introduced ojingeo bulgogi (spicy marinated squid) to Seoul, so you can imagine this restaurant is quite popular. Expect to wait in line, even on weekdays. The octopus and squid are quite spicy, but also have a pleasant sweetness.
name: Baetgodong

desc_l10n.en: This luxurious restaurant specializes in pufferfish. The pufferfish sashimi set menu comes with pufferfish sashimi, "konee" ribs, pufferfish bulgogi, pufferfish tempura, and clear pufferfish soup with watercress and mung bean sprouts, followed by pufferfish rice porridge and dessert. Only fresh pufferfish is used, so prices are quite high.
desc_l10n.ja: 高級ふぐの専門店。 ボクサシミコース(ふぐ刺コース)には刺身、ポクブルゴギ(ふぐのピリ辛炒め)、ポグティギム(ふぐ天)、ちりなどが出される。価格は若干高めだが、活ふぐを使用しているため、新鮮なふぐを味わうことができる。
desc_l10n.ko: 고급스러운 복 전문점. 복 사시미 코스가 있음. 활복을 쓰는 것이 맛의 비결이며 다른 집보다 가격이 높은 편.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为高级河豚专卖店。如果选择河豚生鱼片套餐，店家会依序送上河豚生鱼片、鱼白 鱼肚、烤河豚、炸河豚、河豚清汤、河豚粥和餐后点心。店家美味的秘诀在于使用活河豚，由于使用高价食材，因此价格也比其他店家昂贵。

description: This luxurious restaurant specializes in pufferfish. The pufferfish sashimi set menu comes with pufferfish sashimi, "konee" ribs, pufferfish bulgogi, pufferfish tempura, and clear pufferfish soup with watercress and mung bean sprouts, followed by pufferfish rice porridge and dessert. Only fresh pufferfish is used, so prices are quite high.
name: Cheongdam Bokjip

name_l10n.ja: チョンダム・ボッチブ

desc_l10n.en: Daechi Jeongyuk Sikdang is a meat barbeque restaurant that also operates a butcher shop. They serve many cuts of beef, like beef from the inside ribs, thin skirt, and thick skirt, all of which you can barbecue over charcoal. Their pork is also good, including gabeurisal (cheek meat) and hangjeongsal (meat from the back of the neck). The house speciality is their meat, so there are few side dishes.
desc_l10n.ja: 精肉店を兼ねた焼き肉店。なか落ちカルビやハラミなど特殊部位も味わうことができる。ここのハラミの味は絶品。豚肉ではカブリサル(首筋と肩の間の肉)、首筋の肉などがおいしい。韓国では珍しくサービスで出されるおかずはほとんどないが、良質な特殊な部位の肉を味わえるところだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 정육점을 겸한 식당으로, 제비추리, 안창살, 토시살과 치마살이나 안창살 맛이 일품.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店提供的牛肋骨肉、牛横膈膜和牛脾脏附近的肉等特殊部位的牛肉，都相当值得推荐。此外，骨边肉或牛横膈膜的滋味也是一绝。除此以外，松板猪肉和猪颈肉等也非常美味。

description: Daechi Jeongyuk Sikdang is a meat barbeque restaurant that also operates a butcher shop. They serve many cuts of beef, like beef from the inside ribs, thin skirt, and thick skirt, all of which you can barbecue over charcoal. Their pork is also good, including gabeurisal (cheek meat) and hangjeongsal (meat from the back of the neck). The house speciality is their meat, so there are few side dishes.
name: Daechi Jeongyuk Sikdang

name_l10n.ja: テチ・ジョンユク・シクタン

desc_l10n.en: This place is well known for its noodles in soybean soup. Other than the rich soybean soup noodles, there is also spicy noodles and noodle soup with chicken. Jinjujip is a favorite with nearby office workers.
desc_l10n.ja: 豆乳素麺が有名なレストラン。濃厚であっさりした深みのある味が自慢だ。豆乳素麺の他にも混ぜ冷麺(スープなしのピリ辛冷やし素麺)、タッ・カルグクス(鶏肉きしめん)も人気メニュー。近くの会社員が多く訪れる庶民的な雰囲気のレストランだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 콩국수가 유명한 집. 진하고 담백하면서도 깊이 있는 맛. 콩국수 외에도 비빔국수, 닭칼국수도 인기메뉴. 인근의 회사원들이 많이 찾는, 서민적인 분위기의 음식점.
desc_l10n.zh: 以味浓爽口的豆浆面而闻名。除此之外，拌面和鸡肉刀切面也深受好评。附近的上班族经常光顾，大众化的气氛亲切而温馨。

description: This place is well known for its noodles in soybean soup. Other than the rich soybean soup noodles, there is also spicy noodles and noodle soup with chicken. Jinjujip is a favorite with nearby office workers.
name: Jinjujip

name_l10n.ja: チンジュチプ 汝矣島店

desc_l10n.en: Opened by an ambitious chef who studied and worked in Spain, the United States, and elsewhere, Jungsik Seoul is the pioneer of a new style of cuisine: New Korean. Although still not fully formed, the style re-approaches Korean dishes from a French perspective. The plating is avant-garde, and the blending of Korean and Western cuisine is evident in their choice of ingredients and menu. Lunch and dinner are both served in one full-course set menu which changes every two or three months.
desc_l10n.ja: アメリカとスペインで学んできたシェフによるニューコリアンという新しいコンセプトのレストラン。韓国料理をフレンチ風にアレンジしている。ランチおよびディナーともに一つのコースメニューのみ。メニューは2･3ヶ月ごとに変わる。
desc_l10n.ko: 뉴코리안이라는 새로운 콘셉트로 오픈하자마자 유명세를 탄 레스토랑. 뉴코리안이란 한식을 프렌치적인 시각에서 해석. 비주얼은 아방 가르드하면서도 식재료와 한식과 양식을 넘나드는 조리기법.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的主厨曾经在美国和西班牙等地学习厨艺，并且担任厨师，回国后，满怀野心地以新韩风为概念开设此家餐厅。新韩风的定义虽尚未确立，但可说是将韩式料理以法式的料理手法重新诠释。不仅视觉艺术前卫，食材和料理手法界于韩式和法式中间，也有运用到类似低温烹调的分子料理手法。午餐和晚餐时段皆只提供一种套餐，但每隔2至3个月便会调整一次菜单。此店预计于2009年 11月中迁店至岛山公园附近。

description: Opened by an ambitious chef who studied and worked in Spain, the United States, and elsewhere, Jungsik Seoul is the pioneer of a new style of cuisine: New Korean. Although still not fully formed, the style re-approaches Korean dishes from a French perspective. The plating is avant-garde, and the blending of Korean and Western cuisine is evident in their choice of ingredients and menu. Lunch and dinner are both served in one full-course set menu which changes every two or three months.
name: Jungsik Seoul

desc_l10n.en: Serving a varied menu featuring grilled beef, haejangguk (a spicy soup), and shabu shabu, Saebyeokjip is open 24 hours and is often crowded with people. The ddarogukbap (a kind of soup made with meat, coagulated ox blood, and bean sprouts) tastes great and is the recommended remedy for curing a hangover. An order of yukhoe bibimbap (white rice topped with garnished raw beef) includes a bowl of seonjitguk (soup made with coagulated ox blood). The shabu shabu is quite satisfactory for the price, so it is popular. The restaurant is packed in the morning, with people sobering up, and in the evening, with people who come for the grilled meat.
desc_l10n.ja: 牛肉やソンジ(固めた牛の血)、 モヤシなどが入ったスープのタロ・グクパプ(タロクッパ)がおいしいお店。二日酔いによいとされているへジャンクク(酔い覚ましスープ)だ。ユッケビビンバを注文するとソンジクク(固めた牛の血のスープ)が付いてくる。しゃぶしゃぶも人気の高いメニュー。24時間営業しており朝は二日酔い解消のためへジャンククを食べに来る人、夜は焼き肉を食べに来る人で賑う。
desc_l10n.ko: 다양한 메뉴. 고기나 선지, 콩나물 등이 들어간 따로국밥  해장.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店具有各式各样的菜色，因此24小时人皆声鼎沸。加入牛肉、牛血、黄豆芽等食材的牛肉汤饭，汤头相当美味，也适合拿来解酒。若是点用生牛肉拌饭，店家会附上牛血汤，涮涮锅也是物美价廉，因此也相当受到欢迎。许多顾客早上会来此解酒，晚上则来此享用烤肉。

description: Serving a varied menu featuring grilled beef, haejangguk (a spicy soup), and shabu shabu, Saebyeokjip is open 24 hours and is often crowded with people. The ddarogukbap (a kind of soup made with meat, coagulated ox blood, and bean sprouts) tastes great and is the recommended remedy for curing a hangover. An order of yukhoe bibimbap (white rice topped with garnished raw beef) includes a bowl of seonjitguk (soup made with coagulated ox blood). The shabu shabu is quite satisfactory for the price, so it is popular. The restaurant is packed in the morning, with people sobering up, and in the evening, with people who come for the grilled meat.
name: Saebyeokjip

desc_l10n.en: This Vietnamese restaurant specializes in authentic pho (rice noodle soup) and banh xeo (savory stuffed pancakes). You can enjoy Vietnamese food in a comfortable atmosphere at reasonable prices. Another recommendable dish is the deep-fried crispy rice wrapper "chajo", stuffed with minced pork, black mushrooms, and cellophane noodles.
desc_l10n.ja: ベトナム伝統のフォーとバンセオ(ベトナム風のお好み焼き)の専門店。安い価格でベトナム料理を味わうことができます。牛肉と香辛料の入ったスープが味わい深いフォーとカリッとしたベトナム風揚げ春巻きがおすすめメニュー。
desc_l10n.ko: 정통 베트남 쌀국수와 반세오 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为正宗越南米线和越南煎饼专卖店，顾客可以在放松的气氛中品尝到越南料理。推荐菜色为在美味的高汤内加入牛肉和各式香料的越南米线，将炒过的猪肉片、木耳和粉丝包进薄米纸后，下锅油炸的酥炸春卷等。

description: This Vietnamese restaurant specializes in authentic pho (rice noodle soup) and banh xeo (savory stuffed pancakes). You can enjoy Vietnamese food in a comfortable atmosphere at reasonable prices. Another recommendable dish is the deep-fried crispy rice wrapper "chajo", stuffed with minced pork, black mushrooms, and cellophane noodles.
name: Papaho

desc_l10n.en: Cheongdamgol became famous for its savory Nurungji Baekban (scorched rice set meal). It is served with Kimchi Jjigae (Kimchi stew), a main dish, and at least ten excellent side dishes, such as steamed eggs with chopped vegetables, crabs marinatedin soy sauce, and seasoned vegetables. It is hard to find this kind of comfortable Baekban restaurant in the Cheongdam area.
desc_l10n.ja: 香ばしいヌルンジ(お焦げの粥)定食で有名なところ。大きな鉢に出されるヌルンジは胃にやさしい味だ。キムチチゲ(キムチ鍋)、ケランチム(韓国式茶碗蒸し)、カンジャンケジャン(カニの醤油漬け)、ナムルなど10種類以上のおかずもおいしい。定食屋が少ない清潭洞(チョンダムドン)エリアで気楽に食事できるところだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 구수한 누룽지 백반으로 이름난 곳.  김치찌개와 10가지가 넘는 밑반찬.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为以香气扑鼻的锅巴汤饭定食闻名的韩式料理店。店家将经适当滚煮的锅巴汤饭盛装在偌大的碗中提供给顾客，辛奇（kimchi）锅、蒸蛋、酱螃蟹和凉拌野菜等，超过10种以上的小菜，味道也相当出色。此店为在不易找到平价餐馆的清潭洞地区，可以轻松用餐的地方。

description: Cheongdamgol became famous for its savory Nurungji Baekban (scorched rice set meal). It is served with Kimchi Jjigae (Kimchi stew), a main dish, and at least ten excellent side dishes, such as steamed eggs with chopped vegetables, crabs marinatedin soy sauce, and seasoned vegetables. It is hard to find this kind of comfortable Baekban restaurant in the Cheongdam area.
name: Cheongdamgol

desc_l10n.en: Keungiwajip is a hanjeongsik (Korean table d'hote) restaurant that specializes in set menu meals that feature Jeolla-do-style side dishes and Pyeongyang-do main dishes made with seasonal ingredients. Their most famous dish is ganjang gejang (crab marinated in soy sauce). The restaurant was created from a traditional Korean tile-roofed house.
desc_l10n.ja: おかずはチョルラド(全羅道)式で、コース料理はピョンヤン(平壌)式を用意している韓定食のお店。季節ごとに新鮮な材料を使っていて、多彩なメニューを揃えている。一番の人気はカンジャンケジャン(カニの醤油漬け)。韓国式家屋を改造した外観と店内の雰囲気も情緒があって良い。
desc_l10n.ko: 반찬은 전라도식으로, 코스 요리는 평양도식으로 맛을 내는 한정식집. 계절의 신선한 재료들을 이용하여 다양하게 메뉴를 변화. 가장 유명한 것은 간장게장. 전통 한옥 기와집을 개조한 분위기도 고풍.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为韩式套餐店，小菜为全罗道风味，套餐料理则为平壤道风味。店家会利用当季的新鲜蔬菜变化出各式料理，其中最有名的为酱蟹。本店由传统韩屋改建而成，古色古香，夺人眼目。

description: Keungiwajip is a hanjeongsik (Korean table d'hote) restaurant that specializes in set menu meals that feature Jeolla-do-style side dishes and Pyeongyang-do main dishes made with seasonal ingredients. Their most famous dish is ganjang gejang (crab marinated in soy sauce). The restaurant was created from a traditional Korean tile-roofed house.
name: Keungiwajip

desc_l10n.en: This butcher shop/restaurant carries premium-grade beef. Here, you can grill quality Korean-bred beef on copper grills over oak charcoal. The meat is purchased directly from the butcher, and then grilled at your table. Vegetables are an additional 3,000 won.
desc_l10n.ja: 最上級のブランド韓国産牛のハヌ(韓牛)を取り扱う精肉店が運営する焼き肉店。良質の炭と銅の焼き網を使用し、牛肉のうまみを引き出しています。まず肉を精肉店で購入し、野菜とおかず代の₩30,000を別途払うシステムです。
desc_l10n.ko: 한우 1++ 등급 전문업소를 표방하고 있는 정육점 식당.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为标榜提供1++等级韩牛的肉铺烤肉店，将铜网置于顶级炭火上后，便可以开始烤肉。店内提供烤肉的方式为，顾客先在肉铺购买肉类后，再额外支付300元的蔬菜钱，便可以开始享用烤肉。

description: This butcher shop/restaurant carries premium-grade beef. Here, you can grill quality Korean-bred beef on copper grills over oak charcoal. The meat is purchased directly from the butcher, and then grilled at your table. Vegetables are an additional 3,000 won.
name: Dukkeobi Jeongyukjeom Sikdang

name_l10n.ja: トゥッコビ・ジョンユクジョム・シクタン
name_l10n.zh: 癞蛤蟆精肉店食堂(Dukkeobi Jeongyukjeomsikdang)

desc_l10n.en: Named one of the five best restaurants in Asia by Wall Street Journal Asia, this restaurant has also been called one of the 50 best restaurants in a major metropolis. Come here to try domestic Seolhwa beef and delicious beef stock.
desc_l10n.ja: ウォールストリートジャーナル(アジア版)でアジア5大レストランに選ばれた焼肉店。世界27の大都市のうちの代表レストラン50選にも選ばれたことがあるところだ。ジューシーなうまみのある上質の牛肉を味わうことができる。
desc_l10n.ko: 세계 최고의 맛 아시안 월스트리트 저널 신문에서 아시아 5대 음식점으로 선정, 세계 27대 대도시 대표 음식점 50선. 맛있는 육즙을 가진 벽제 갈비의 설화한우를 .
desc_l10n.zh: 亚洲一流的韩牛专营店 碧帝Tower Palace被《Asian Wall Street Journal》评选为亚洲五大餐厅之一，位列世界50强餐厅之列。本店为韩牛专营店，提供的韩牛肉质嫩滑，鲜美可口。

description: Named one of the five best restaurants in Asia by Wall Street Journal Asia, this restaurant has also been called one of the 50 best restaurants in a major metropolis. Come here to try domestic Seolhwa beef and delicious beef stock.
name: Byeokje Galbi Tower Palace

name_l10n.ja: ピョクチェ・カルビ タワーパレス店
name_l10n.zh: 碧帝排骨 塔宫(Byeokje Galbi Tower Palace)

desc_l10n.en: Cafe Monday To Sunday is decorated with chairs from famous furniture designers. The exterior brick walls are painted white, which gives the place a clean appearance and a vintage look. In addition to the usual cafe beverages, waffles, pasta dishes, andwine are also available. Brunch is available as well.
desc_l10n.ja: 有名な家具デザイナーの椅子が並べられたカフェ。白く塗られた煙瓦の外壁が小奇麗でビンテージ感を醸し出している。コーヒーなどのドリンク類だけではなくワッフルやパスタ、ワインなども用意されている。
desc_l10n.ko: 유명 가구 디자이너들의 의자를 만나볼 수 있는 카페. 벽돌 외벽을 하얗게 칠해 깔끔하고 빈티지한 느낌. 커피와 음료뿐 아니라 와플, 브런치, 파스타, 와인도 준비.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为咖啡厅，在此可以见到知名家具设计师所设计的椅子。漆成白色的砖头外墙，给人一种洁净古典的感觉。店内不仅备有咖啡和饮品，松饼、早午餐、意大利面和葡萄酒也兼备。

description: Cafe Monday To Sunday is decorated with chairs from famous furniture designers. The exterior brick walls are painted white, which gives the place a clean appearance and a vintage look. In addition to the usual cafe beverages, waffles, pasta dishes, andwine are also available. Brunch is available as well.
name: Cafe Monday To Sunday

desc_l10n.en: This bakery is over 20 years old and sells old-style Korean breads. A popular menu item is the monaka ice cream sandwich, originally from Japan.
desc_l10n.ja: 20年以上の歴史を持つ店で、韓国の昔のパンが味わえる。アイスクリームモナカも人気
desc_l10n.ko: 20년 넘은 역사를 지닌 한국의 옛날 빵들을 맛볼 수 있는 가게.
desc_l10n.zh: 至今已有20余年传统，专营各种韩国传统点心。其中以莫纳卡冰淇淋最具人气 。

description: This bakery is over 20 years old and sells old-style Korean breads. A popular menu item is the monaka ice cream sandwich, originally from Japan.
name: Cake House Wien

desc_l10n.en: Lisian is an American-style Chinese restaurant, like the ones you would find in Chinatowns back at home. Seafood is picked out fresh directly from their fish tank. One popular dish is the shrimp in wasabi cream sauce.
desc_l10n.ja: アメリカのチャイナタウンスタイル中華のお店。 生け簀があり新鮮でおいしい海鮮を選んで食べることができる。海老のわさびクリームソースが人気メニューだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 미국 차이나타운 스타일의 퓨전 중식을 하는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为新潮的中式餐厅兼酒吧，提供美国中国城风格的融合中式料理。店家备有水族箱供顾客挑选鲜美的海鲜，招牌菜色为芥末奶油鲜虾。

description: Lisian is an American-style Chinese restaurant, like the ones you would find in Chinatowns back at home. Seafood is picked out fresh directly from their fish tank. One popular dish is the shrimp in wasabi cream sauce.
name: Lisian

desc_l10n.en: This is a casual French bistro. The course menu is a little pricy, but comes with a dessert of your choice. Individual dishes are reasonably priced.
desc_l10n.ja: 正統フレンチビストロとして楽しめるカジュアルな雰囲気のフレンチレストラン。コースメニューはやや高めだが、素晴らしいアラカルトメニューも充実している。コースを注文する場合は、好きなデザートが食べられる。
desc_l10n.ko: 캐주얼한 분위기의 프렌치 레스토랑. 정통 프렌치 비스트로를 즐길 수 있는 곳
desc_l10n.zh: 轻松休闲的法式小餐馆。除高价的全餐之外，也备有相对实惠的美味单品。选择全餐的客人可以任选餐后甜品。

description: This is a casual French bistro. The course menu is a little pricy, but comes with a dessert of your choice. Individual dishes are reasonably priced.
name: Bistro de Yountville

desc_l10n.en: Hongneung Galbijip boasts 30 years of tradition. Their grilled galbi (short ribs) is very famous in the Hongneung area for its mild and delicious flavor. Their marinated beef galbi is made with 20 different kinds of ingredients. Bones from the galbi and four leg bones are reduced to make naengmyun yuksu (meat broth), which is rich and flavorful.
desc_l10n.ja: ホンヌン(洪陵)で30年の歴史を持つカルビ焼きはやわらかくてとてもおいしいと評判。ヤンニョムソカルビ(味付け牛カルビ)は20種類の各種材料を使って味付けしている。カルビから取ったダシで作るネンミョン(冷麺)のスープも味わい深い。
desc_l10n.ko: 홍릉 일대에서 유명했던 30년 관록의 갈비구이. 양념 소갈비는 20여 가지의 각종 재료로 양념. 갈비에서 나온 뼈와 사골 등을 고아 만든 냉면 육수.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店在洪陵一带拥有30年历史的馆禄烤排骨既柔软又美味。调味牛排骨的调味酱是由20多种材料调汁而成的。排骨中剔出得骨头和筛骨一起，经过高温熬制的汤汁做冷面汤也非常不错。

description: Hongneung Galbijip boasts 30 years of tradition. Their grilled galbi (short ribs) is very famous in the Hongneung area for its mild and delicious flavor. Their marinated beef galbi is made with 20 different kinds of ingredients. Bones from the galbi and four leg bones are reduced to make naengmyun yuksu (meat broth), which is rich and flavorful.
name: Hongneung Galbijip

name_l10n.ja: ホンヌン・カルビチプ

desc_l10n.en: This café surrounds a garden in the middle of the Hermès Dosan Park building. At this high-class café, you can expect premium service and quality, offered in an elegant atmosphere featuring Hermès tableware and accessories. Madang is a joint operationof Hermès and the Shilla Hotel.
desc_l10n.ja: エルメス島山(トサン)パーク内にあるカフェ。建物内にある庭園を囲むようにカフェがある。エルメスの食器を使っていて格調高い雰囲気の中で食事やお茶をたのしめるところだ。最高のサービスで食事ができる空間。 エルメスと新羅ホテルが共同運営しており、エルメスカフェとも呼ばれている。
desc_l10n.ko: 에르메스 도산파크 건물 내의 중심부에 위치. 에르메스의 식기와 소품들을 사용하여 격조 있는 분위기에서 최상의 서빙을 받으면서 식사할 수 있는 품격 있는 공간. 마당이라는 이름이 있지만, 에르메스 카페라고도 불림.
desc_l10n.zh: 爱马仕岛山公园店内中间有个庭园，而本咖啡厅便是围绕此庭园而建。店家利用爱马仕的餐具和装饰品营造出高格调的环境，顾客在此可以享受到最顶级的服务和美食。店名为Café Madang但也有人称为Hermes Café，由爱马仕和新罗饭店共同经营。

description: This café surrounds a garden in the middle of the Hermès Dosan Park building. At this high-class café, you can expect premium service and quality, offered in an elegant atmosphere featuring Hermès tableware and accessories. Madang is a joint operationof Hermès and the Shilla Hotel.
name: Madang

desc_l10n.en: Hadongkwan is a gomtang (beef soup) restaurant that opened in Suha-dong in 1939 and has been passed down for three generations. Upholding the founding owner's philosophy, they do not operate in the evenings or offer delivery, strictly adhering to the principle of closing the restaurant once all the prepared food is sold out. Even after relocating to Myeong-dong, they continue to use high-quality beef simmered for a long time to provide a light and clean Seoul-style gomtang. They insist on offering only two menu items: gomtang and suyuk (boiled beef). By maintaining the practice of serving food in traditional brass bowls, they continue their consistent taste and tradition.
desc_l10n.ja: ハドンガンは1939年に水滸洞で開業し、3代続くコムタン専門店で、創業者の哲学を守り、夜間の営業や配達は行わず、準備した料理がすべて売れたら閉店するという原則を守っています。明洞に移転した後も、良質の牛肉を使用して長時間煮込んだ淡白であっさりとしたソウル式コムタン(コムタン)を提供し、コムタンとスユク(水炊き)の2つのメニューだけにこだわっている。伝統的な真鍮の器に料理を盛り付ける方式も維持し、変わらぬ味と伝統を受け継いでいる。
desc_l10n.ko: 오랜 세월의 내공이 담겨 담백하고 깊은 곰탕 맛
desc_l10n.zh: 河东馆 已有80余年传统的韩牛骨汤专营店。牛骨汤是韩国经典大众料理，河东馆的牛骨汤加入了多个部位的牛肉，汤汁格外浓郁鲜美。用来佐汤的辛奇（kimchi）也十分美味，甚至有人专为了辛奇（kimchi）而一再光顾。作为一家老字号，顾客也是从老到小遍布各个年龄层。老顾客们通常喜欢在牛骨汤中加上一些辛奇（kimchi）的汤汁再食用。

description: Hadongkwan is a gomtang (beef soup) restaurant that opened in Suha-dong in 1939 and has been passed down for three generations. Upholding the founding owner's philosophy, they do not operate in the evenings or offer delivery, strictly adhering to the principle of closing the restaurant once all the prepared food is sold out. Even after relocating to Myeong-dong, they continue to use high-quality beef simmered for a long time to provide a light and clean Seoul-style gomtang. They insist on offering only two menu items: gomtang and suyuk (boiled beef). By maintaining the practice of serving food in traditional brass bowls, they continue their consistent taste and tradition.
name: Hadonggwan

desc_l10n.en: This galbi specialty restaurant consistently serves up the highest quality meat.
desc_l10n.ja: カルビ専門店。最高の品質が認められた最上級のカルビのみを使用している。上質のカルビの味を楽しめるところだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 갈비 전문점으로, 최고 품질이 인증된 최상급 갈비만을 엄선하여 변함없는 최고의 고기 맛.
desc_l10n.zh: 想到排骨，就会想到李相！ 本店是江北地区的著名排骨专营店，我们用最高的品质，为顾客提供最美味的排骨料理。

description: This galbi specialty restaurant consistently serves up the highest quality meat.
name: Galbi Myeongga Yisang

name_l10n.ja: カルビ･ミョンガ･イサン

desc_l10n.en: Enjoy Indian and Nepalese food at affordable prices at Shanti. Nepalese food is generally milder than Indian food, and as the owner of this restaurant is from Nepal, the food here is milder on the whole.
desc_l10n.ja: インド、ネパール料理が楽しめるお店。ネパール料理のほうが、インド料理よりも優しい味をしている。同店の社長はネパール出身で、料理の味は全体的にやさしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 인도, 네팔 음식을 저렴하게 즐길 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 能够以实惠的价格享用印度、尼泊尔料理的地方。老板是尼泊尔出身，料理地道正宗。

description: Enjoy Indian and Nepalese food at affordable prices at Shanti. Nepalese food is generally milder than Indian food, and as the owner of this restaurant is from Nepal, the food here is milder on the whole.
name: Shanti

desc_l10n.en: Serving the highest-quality Korean beef The Insadong branch of Hanuso exclusively serves beef from cows raised in the Jeonnam Hampyeong region. They offer a wide variety of dishes as well as set courses.
desc_l10n.ja: 最上級の韓国産牛肉を味わうことのできるところ。上質の焼肉から、一品料理、伝統韓定食など多様な韓国料理を味わうことができる。
desc_l10n.ko: 전남 함평 초원에서 자란 최상등급의 한우 암소로 만든 요리를 중심으로 다양한 일품요리와 정통 한정식 코스요리.
desc_l10n.zh: 特级韩牛专营店 本店的食材是来自全罗南道咸平郡草原的顶级韩牛。拥有20年经验的厨师，用精湛的手艺为顾客带来美味韩牛和韩式套餐。餐厅的宽敞停车场有100多个停车位，为顾客带来无限便利。

description: Serving the highest-quality Korean beef The Insadong branch of Hanuso exclusively serves beef from cows raised in the Jeonnam Hampyeong region. They offer a wide variety of dishes as well as set courses.
name: Hanuso (Insadong Branch)

desc_l10n.en: The juicy, homemade dumplings here are fried or steamed, and you can choose from various assorted filings, including meat, shrimp, or even vegetarian.
desc_l10n.ja: 口の中で肉汁がはじけるおいしい餃子専門店。片面は焼いてもう片面は蒸した揚げ餃子、エビと肉がたっぷり入ったエビ水餃子など、様々な手作り餃子が味わえ、ベジタリアンのための餃子メニューもある。
desc_l10n.ko: 입안에 육즙이 가득 터지는 맛있는 만두전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 好吃的饺子店，放在嘴里轻轻一咬，口中就溢满美味的肉汁。经营各式手工饺子，有蒸一面煎一面的“蒸煎饺”，也有塞满了虾肉和猪肉的“鲜虾水饺”，还有专门为素食者提供的素菜饺子。

description: The juicy, homemade dumplings here are fried or steamed, and you can choose from various assorted filings, including meat, shrimp, or even vegetarian.
name: Jony Dumpling

desc_l10n.en: Formerly located in the basement of the Westin Chosun, Sushi Cho was newly opened on the 18th floor. They have a reputation for using fresh ingredients delivered from Japan and for having the longest Japanese "hinoki dai" table in Korea. The chef is Japanese and comes from the legendary sushi restaurant Kyubi in Tokyo. This place is currently one of the best sushi restaurants in Seoul.
desc_l10n.ja: 東京の名店「久兵衛」出身の日本人が調理長を務めている寿司屋。日本から仕入れた新鮮な材料と韓国最大の長さを誇るヒノキ台があることで有名だ。現在ソウルにある寿司屋の中でも最高峰と言われている。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울 최고의 일식당 중의 하나로 꼽히는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店原位于Westin朝鲜饭店的地下，后搬至18楼，经过重新装修后重新开业。店内最出名的是从日本空运而来的新鲜食材，和韩国最长的桧木吧台。由来自于东京传说中的寿司名店“久兵卫”的日籍主厨负责料理。堪称首尔最顶级的寿司店之一。

description: Formerly located in the basement of the Westin Chosun, Sushi Cho was newly opened on the 18th floor. They have a reputation for using fresh ingredients delivered from Japan and for having the longest Japanese "hinoki dai" table in Korea. The chef is Japanese and comes from the legendary sushi restaurant Kyubi in Tokyo. This place is currently one of the best sushi restaurants in Seoul.
name: Sushi Cho

desc_l10n.en: Mao is one of the few Peking duck restaurants that exist in Seoul. In addition to peking duck, there are also a wide range of Cantonese dishes. The trendy interior is decorated with a portrait of Chairman Mao. The atmosphere here is a lot like what you'd find in a restaurant in mainland China. Prices are relatively low.
desc_l10n.ja: ソウルでは数少ない手頃な価格で北京ダックを味わえる店。店内はポップアート的な毛沢東の肖像画が飾られている。
desc_l10n.ko: 트렌디한 중국 본토의 분위기. 저렴한 가격의 북경 오리.
desc_l10n.zh: 室内装潢采普普风设计，墙上挂有毛泽东的肖像画，使店内充满浓郁的中国气息。此店为在首尔，少数能较低廉的价格品尝到北京烤鸭的店家。

description: Mao is one of the few Peking duck restaurants that exist in Seoul. In addition to peking duck, there are also a wide range of Cantonese dishes. The trendy interior is decorated with a portrait of Chairman Mao. The atmosphere here is a lot like what you'd find in a restaurant in mainland China. Prices are relatively low.
name: MAO

desc_l10n.en: This is a chilled buckwheat noodles (naengmyeon) restaurant well known for its sweet and spicy sauce. The dish is so popular that long lines at lunchtimes are the norm. The dumplings and bulgogi are also recommended.
desc_l10n.ja: 甘辛いタレとコシが強い麺で人気の冷麺専門店。病み付きになる味で常連客が多く、ランチタイムには行列ができることもある。ボリュームたっぷりのマンドゥ(餃子)とプルコギもおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 매콤달콤한 양념과 쫄깃한 면발로 사랑받는 냉면 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 辣中带甜的调味酱配上筋道口感的面条，本店的拌冷面一直深受好评。令人上瘾的好味道为本店赢得了不少回头客，在午餐时间通常要排队等位。不仅冷面，饺子和烤肉的味道也是一流。

description: This is a chilled buckwheat noodles (naengmyeon) restaurant well known for its sweet and spicy sauce. The dish is so popular that long lines at lunchtimes are the norm. The dumplings and bulgogi are also recommended.
name: Sinsa Myeonok

desc_l10n.en: Mapo Sutbulgalbi offers pork galbi (short ribs), served properly with the bone attached. Also worth trying are the samgyeopsal (pork belly) and boneless beef ribs. The restaurant is big enough to accommodate large groups.
desc_l10n.ja: テジカルビ(味付け豚カルビの焼肉)のお店。骨付きのテジカルビがおいしい。テジカルビ以外にもサムギョプサル(豚の三枚肉の焼肉)やソカルビ(牛カルビの焼肉)も味わえる。
desc_l10n.ko: 돼지뼈가 붙어 있는, 제대로 된 돼지갈비. 삼겹살, 소고기갈비살.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的烤带骨猪小排美味无比，除猪小排外，五花肉和去骨牛小排也值得一尝。室内空间宽敞，因此也很适合亲朋好友聚餐。

description: Mapo Sutbulgalbi offers pork galbi (short ribs), served properly with the bone attached. Also worth trying are the samgyeopsal (pork belly) and boneless beef ribs. The restaurant is big enough to accommodate large groups.
name: Mapo Sutbulgalbi

name_l10n.ja: マポ・スップルガルビ

desc_l10n.en: Here you can taste true French cuisine. The Duck Confit and Onion Soup are specially recommended by the chef. Half bottles of wine are available, and there is also a delicious dessert menu.
desc_l10n.ja: フランス本土の味が楽しめるレストラン。特に鴨の足コンフィとオニオンスープは、シェフおすすめの代表メニューだ。ワインはハーフボトルで用意されており、気軽に楽しめる。広い店内でゆったりと食事ができ、デザートメニューも素晴らしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 프랑스 본토의 맛을 즐길 수 있는 레스토랑.
desc_l10n.zh: 经营正宗法国料理的西餐厅，招牌菜是由主厨特别推荐的脆皮油封鸭腿和洋葱浓汤。佐餐的红酒可以只点半瓶，因此不必感到负担。宽敞的店面令人心旷神怡，餐后甜点也十分值得期待。

description: Here you can taste true French cuisine. The Duck Confit and Onion Soup are specially recommended by the chef. Half bottles of wine are available, and there is also a delicious dessert menu.
name: L'Espoir du Hibou

desc_l10n.en: Kuai 19 is a fusion-style Chinese restaurant that prepares their food with minimal use of oil. The mainly peach-colored interior is impressive.
desc_l10n.ja: 油をほとんど使っていない料理を味わうことができるところ。新鮮なアワビと竹の子のが入ったスープのチョンボスープはあっさりしていながらも深い味わい。また、カリカリに揚げた鶏肉に唐辛子ソースをかけたユリンギ(油淋鶏)もおすすめ。
desc_l10n.ko: 기름을 최소화하여 요리. 전복수프와 유린기를 추천.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的料理特色为将油的使用量降到最少。推荐菜色为，使用新鲜鲍鱼和竹笋烹煮的清爽鲍鱼羹汤，以及将炸得酥脆的鸡腿摆在莴苣上，再淋上辣味酱汁的油淋鸡。以水蜜桃颜色为主的室内设计令人印象相当深刻。

description: Kuai 19 is a fusion-style Chinese restaurant that prepares their food with minimal use of oil. The mainly peach-colored interior is impressive.
name: Kuai 19

desc_l10n.en: A Korean beef restaurant, in which traditional Korean beauty and warm hearts are abundant, by using Giwa (roofing tile) and raw lumber for interior. The beef at Gang gang sullai satisfies a customer’s eyes, ears and mouths because of its freshness. You will have a good time while appreciating the installation works and pictures surrounding the interior beautifully.
desc_l10n.ja: 瓦とウッドを用いたインテリアで伝統的な韓国の趣が漂っている韓国産牛肉の専門店。ハヌ(韓牛)料理は最も新鮮で美味しい部分だけを厳選している。余裕あるひと時を過ごせる店だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 기와와 원목을 이용한 인테리어로 전통적인 한국의 미(美)와 정감이 살아 숨 쉬는 한우 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是通过瓦片和原木的装饰表现了韩国传统之美，是有着无限情趣的韩牛专门店。韩牛拼盘选取的是牛的最新鲜和最好吃的部位，使客人耳目一新。室内还摆设了美术品和照片等，供客人欣赏。

description: A Korean beef restaurant, in which traditional Korean beauty and warm hearts are abundant, by using Giwa (roofing tile) and raw lumber for interior. The beef at Gang gang sullai satisfies a customer’s eyes, ears and mouths because of its freshness. You will have a good time while appreciating the installation works and pictures surrounding the interior beautifully.
name: Ganggangsullae (Yeoksam)

name_l10n.ja: カンガンスルレ 駅三店

desc_l10n.en: The main menu item here is fried chicken, although Han Chu is especially crowded at dinnertimes by people wanting a cool beer after a long day at work. Although the fried chicken and seasoned chicken are the most popular, spicy fried peppers are alsohighly recommended.
desc_l10n.ja: 外国人に一番人気の韓国料理のひとつ、チキンが代表メニューの店。庶民的な雰囲気で、夜になると会社帰りに軽くビール一杯を楽しむ人々でにぎわいを見せる。フライドチキン、ヤンニョム(味付け)チキンがメインメニューだが、サクサクでピリっとした唐辛子の天ぷらも是非チャレンジしてほしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 외국인들이 가장 좋아하는 한국 음식 중의 하나인 치킨이 대표 메뉴. 서민적인 분위기로 퇴근 후 가볍게 맥주를 즐기는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店的招牌料理就是外国人最爱的韩国美食之一——炸鸡。大众化的氛围温馨随意，每到傍晚就会拥满下班后前来喝上一杯的上班族。虽然原味炸鸡和酱香炸鸡是主打，但是炸得脆脆香香的酿辣椒也不容错过。

description: The main menu item here is fried chicken, although Han Chu is especially crowded at dinnertimes by people wanting a cool beer after a long day at work. Although the fried chicken and seasoned chicken are the most popular, spicy fried peppers are alsohighly recommended.
name: Hanchu

desc_l10n.en: This fine dining restaurant has an ambiance like Shanghai in the 1930's. They serve mainly Cantonese and spicy Szechuan cuisine, Chaozhou-style cuisine with fresh live fish and seafood quickly stir-fried over high heat, as well as Thai- and Malaysian-influenced cuisine. Dinner set menus are also available for business meetings.
desc_l10n.ja: 上海の高級レストランの雰囲気を思わせる中華レストラン。広東料理と四川料理をメインに取り扱っている。新鮮な活魚と海鮮物を強火でさっと炒める広東省の潮州式料理や、タイやマレーシアの影響を受けたオリエンタル料理も味わうことができる。夜にはコースメニューも準備されている。
desc_l10n.ko: 1930년대 상하이의 고급 레스토랑 분위기를 주는 곳, 광동식 사천요리.
desc_l10n.zh: 店内充满1930年代上海高级餐厅的气氛，主要提供广式料理和麻辣的四川料理，还能品尝到将新鲜活鱼和海鲜大火快炒的潮州料理，以及受到泰国和马来西亚影响的东方料理。晚餐时段亦备有为商业聚餐设计的套餐料理。

description: This fine dining restaurant has an ambiance like Shanghai in the 1930's. They serve mainly Cantonese and spicy Szechuan cuisine, Chaozhou-style cuisine with fresh live fish and seafood quickly stir-fried over high heat, as well as Thai- and Malaysian-influenced cuisine. Dinner set menus are also available for business meetings.
name: Xingkai

desc_l10n.en: This restaurant is famous for their delicious kimchi maribap (kimchi-wrapped rice). Their light-tasting and savory mandu (Korean dumplings), served either on a platter or as part of a soup, are also popular. Their fist-size dumplings are stuffed with seasoned bean sprouts and different kinds of meat, for a delicious filling meal. Expect lines at lunchtime.
desc_l10n.ja: 冷たいキムチ汁のなかにご飯が入ったキムチマリパブで有名なところ。あっさりしたマンドゥ(餃子)やマンドゥクク(餃子スープ)も人気メニューだ。大人の拳ほどの大きさの餃子が3つで1人前。様々な野菜や肉が入ったマンドゥは味わい深いながらもあっさりしている。昼食時には行列ができるほどの人気店だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 시원하고 깔끔한 김치말이밥, 접시만두, 만둣국이 유명한 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的招牌料理为凉快清爽的辛奇（kimchi）汤饭，清香的盘装饺子和汤饺也相当受到欢迎，1人份有3个如成人拳头般大的饺子。内馅包进绿豆芽和多种肉的饺子，既丰盛又爽口。午餐时段经常需要排队等位。

description: This restaurant is famous for their delicious kimchi maribap (kimchi-wrapped rice). Their light-tasting and savory mandu (Korean dumplings), served either on a platter or as part of a soup, are also popular. Their fist-size dumplings are stuffed with seasoned bean sprouts and different kinds of meat, for a delicious filling meal. Expect lines at lunchtime.
name: Ribuk Sonmandu

name_l10n.ja: リブクソン・マンドゥ

desc_l10n.en: Serim is famous for noodle hot pot. Your choice of mugwort or bean noodles are boiled with par-boiled meat and vegetables. If the noodles don't fill you up, you can have rice porridge at the very end.
desc_l10n.ja: クグスジョンゴル(うどん入り寄せ鍋)が有名なお店。肉と野菜に軽く火を通して食べた後、麺をゆでて食べる鍋料理だ。麺は、ヨモギかきな粉入りのどちらかを選べる。麺を食べても量が足りない場合はおじやにもできる。
desc_l10n.ko: 고기와 채소를 살짝 데쳐 먹은 후 국수를 끓여 먹는 국수전골이 유명한 집
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的面条锅相当有名。将肉和蔬菜稍微川烫食用后，便可以开始煮面条，面条有艾草和黄豆口味供顾客选择。吃完面条后，若是还没有饱足感，则还可以煮粥吃。

description: Serim is famous for noodle hot pot. Your choice of mugwort or bean noodles are boiled with par-boiled meat and vegetables. If the noodles don't fill you up, you can have rice porridge at the very end.
name: Serim

desc_l10n.en: is well known for its barbecued beef, especially the rib eye. Top quality beef is served with many side dishes, and the chilled buckwheat noodles (naengmyeon) served afterward are also delicious.
desc_l10n.ja: 牛肉で有名な焼き肉店。メニューが豊富で全体的に美味だが、特にコットゥンシム(霜降り牛ロース)が人気だ。質の良い肉を厳選し、柔らかい肉の味を維持することが人気の秘訣。おかずと冷麺もおいしく、雰囲気も良い。
desc_l10n.ko: 소고기 구이로 유명한 고기집. 메뉴가 다양하고 전체적으로 맛이 좋지만 특히 꽃등심이 인기.
desc_l10n.zh: 以烤牛肉而盛名远传。菜品丰富而美味，其中以烤花里脊最具人气。本店严选优质牛肉以保证鲜嫩口感。搭配的小菜和冷面都别有风味，室内装潢也很考究。

description: is well known for its barbecued beef, especially the rib eye. Top quality beef is served with many side dishes, and the chilled buckwheat noodles (naengmyeon) served afterward are also delicious.
name: Moodeungsan

desc_l10n.en: When Chungmu Gimbap first introduced Halmae gimbap (seaweed rolls), a style of gimbap that originated in Chungmu (present-day Tongyeong), it became a sensation throughout Seoul. These little seaweed rolls filled only with rice are served with roughly-cubed radish kimchi and seasoned squid. The seasoned squid and radish kimchi are the only side dishes, but they can be replenished as often as you'd like.
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国南東部にある慶尚南道(キョンサンナムド)のキムパブ(海苔巻き)をソウルに紹介した元祖の忠武(チュンム)キムパブのお店。一般的なキムパブとは違い、ご飯だけをまいた小さな海苔巻きをカットゥギ(大根キムチ)とオジンオムチム(イカの和え物)で食べるのが独特だ。カットゥギとイカの和え物はお替り自由。
desc_l10n.ko: 통영의 할매김밥을 서울에 소개하여 충무김밥의 열풍을 몰고 왔던 원조집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店经营了老奶奶紫菜包饭，并且掀起一股忠武紫菜包饭的潮流。馅只有白饭的小巧紫菜包饭，搭配萝卜辛奇（kimchi）和凉拌鱿鱼一起食用，别有一番风味。凉拌鱿鱼和萝卜辛奇（kimchi）可续点 。

description: When Chungmu Gimbap first introduced Halmae gimbap (seaweed rolls), a style of gimbap that originated in Chungmu (present-day Tongyeong), it became a sensation throughout Seoul. These little seaweed rolls filled only with rice are served with roughly-cubed radish kimchi and seasoned squid. The seasoned squid and radish kimchi are the only side dishes, but they can be replenished as often as you'd like.
name: Chungmu Gimbap

desc_l10n.ko: 당일 공수하는 신선한 키조개, 전복, 가리비 등 30가지의 조개류 무한리필

desc_l10n.en: Munhwaok is a seolleongtang (ox bone soup) restaurant with a 50 year tradition. Their seolleongtang broth is thick and delicious, made from beef leg bones and ribs. Their joktang (ox foot soup) includes well boiled cow knee bones and tastes similar totheir seolleongtang.
desc_l10n.ja: 50年伝統の ソルロンタン(牛の肉や骨を煮込んだスープ)専門店。牛骨と肩ばら肉でとったスープは白濁色で濃厚な味わいだ。ソルロンタンのスープによく煮込んだ牛の足と膝の軟骨が入ったチョクタンもおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 3대가 대를 잇는 50년 전통의 설렁탕 전문집. 사골과 양지로 낸 육수.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为拥有50年传统，且已传承3代的牛杂碎汤专卖店。以牛骨和牛排骨肉熬煮而成的高汤，使牛杂碎汤的汤色浓郁。牛杂碎汤分为普通和特级，加入大量牛排骨的特级牛杂碎汤令人相当心满意足。牛脚汤中有加入以牛杂碎汤的高汤炖煮过的牛膝，因此味道与牛杂碎汤相似。

description: Munhwaok is a seolleongtang (ox bone soup) restaurant with a 50 year tradition. Their seolleongtang broth is thick and delicious, made from beef leg bones and ribs. Their joktang (ox foot soup) includes well boiled cow knee bones and tastes similar totheir seolleongtang.
name: Munhwaok

desc_l10n.en: Also called, "Johnson Stew," Ocean’s sausage stew is different from other varieties in that aside from the basic ingredients of meat and vegetables, it also contains cheese. Another recommendable dish is the steak and sausage grill.
desc_l10n.ja: プデチゲ(ソーセージの辛味鍋)の有名店。「ジョンソンタン」と呼ばれるこのレストランのユニークなプデチゲは、スープにソーセージ、ジャガイモ、キャベツ、肉などと一緒に最後にチーズを入れ、柔らかくて香ばしい味が自慢 だ。ステーキとソーセージ焼きもおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 부대찌개가 유명한 집. ‘존슨탕’이라 불리는 이 식당의 고유한 부대찌개는 육수에 소시지, 감자, 양배추, 고기 등과 함께 마지막에 치즈를 넣어 부드럽고 고소한 맛. 스테이크와 소시지 구이.
desc_l10n.zh: 有名的辛奇（kimchi）香肠火锅店。这家店的辛奇（kimchi）香肠火锅不仅有一个特别的名字“强生汤”，而且味道也是独一无二的。在高汤中加入香肠、土豆、圆白菜和肉类一起炖煮，最后再放上芝士，令整体味道更加柔和香浓。同时也供应牛排和烤肠。

description: Also called, "Johnson Stew," Ocean’s sausage stew is different from other varieties in that aside from the basic ingredients of meat and vegetables, it also contains cheese. Another recommendable dish is the steak and sausage grill.
name: Bada Sikdang

name_l10n.ja: パダ・シクタン (海食堂)

desc_l10n.en: Chungmu Sanghoe has been in the same location for 20 years and specializes in the regional cuisine of Tongyeong. Main dishes on the menu include sekkosi (shredded raw fish) and grilled fish. In addition, they serve grilled dried sole, Chungmu-style steamed ray, and raw anchovies. Another popular dish, spicy freshwater catfish stew, is a savory remedy for a hangover. All of the dishes come with seodeol seaweed soup made from small fish boiled in a fish broth.
desc_l10n.ja: 20年の歴史を持つ慶尚南道(キョンサンサムド)の統営(トンヨン)地方の郷土料理を味わうことができるお店。主なメニューはセコシ(背越、魚を骨ごと刺身にする調理法)と焼き魚。 その他にもカジャミグイ(干しカレイの焼き物)、カオリチム(エイの煮物)、ミョルチフェ(いわしの刺身)などがある。ムルメギタン(クサウオのスープ)もへジャンクク(二日酔いによいとされるスープ)として人気だ。すべての料理にあらの入ったミヨグク(わかめスープ)が付いてくる。
desc_l10n.ko: 강남에서 20년간 한자리를 지키고 있는 통영 향토 음식점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此地为拥有20年悠久历史的东洋乡土料理店，招牌菜色为带骨生鱼片和烤鲜鱼，以及烤高眼鲽鱼干、忠武蒸鳐鱼和鳀鱼生鱼片等料理。在此也能品尝到可当作解酒汤享用的人气料理，美味方斑狮子鱼汤。所有餐点皆附有以鱼骨炖煮，并且加入杂鱼肉的鱼骨海带汤。

description: Chungmu Sanghoe has been in the same location for 20 years and specializes in the regional cuisine of Tongyeong. Main dishes on the menu include sekkosi (shredded raw fish) and grilled fish. In addition, they serve grilled dried sole, Chungmu-style steamed ray, and raw anchovies. Another popular dish, spicy freshwater catfish stew, is a savory remedy for a hangover. All of the dishes come with seodeol seaweed soup made from small fish boiled in a fish broth.
name: Chungmu Sanghoe

desc_l10n.en: Lanna Thai is the place to go for inexpensive and nicely presented Thai food. The chef is from Thailand, and the interior is simple and neat.
desc_l10n.ja: 手頃な価格でおいしいタイ料理を楽しむことができるレストラン。タイ人シェフによる本場の味を楽しめる。店内のインテリアもこぎれいな感じだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 저렴하면서도 깔끔한 태국 음식을 즐길 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以享用到既便宜又清爽的泰式料理。由泰国人负责掌厨，室内装潢亦相当利落大方。

description: Lanna Thai is the place to go for inexpensive and nicely presented Thai food. The chef is from Thailand, and the interior is simple and neat.
name: Lanna Thai

desc_l10n.en: Hwangtae Bonga is famous for dishes made with hwangtae (dried pollack). The most popular items on the menu are hwangtae-gui (grilled dried pollack), hwang taeguk (dried pollack soup), and siraegit guk (dried radish soup). To make the scrumptious hwangtae-gui,dried pollack is marinated in red chili paste for about a day, grilled, and served appetizingly garnished with sliced green onion and sesame seeds. The hwangtae-gui set menu comes with a variety of tantalizing side dishes, like ojingeo muchim (squid andvegetables) and myeolchi bokkeum (fried anchovies).
desc_l10n.ja: ファンテ(干しスケトウダラ)の料理で有名なお店。メニューはファンテグイ(干しスケトウダラ焼き)とファンテグク(干しスケトウダラのスープ)、シレギグク(干した大根葉入り味噌汁)がある。コチュジャン(唐辛子味噌)の薬味タレに一日程度漬けておいたスケトウダラを鉄板で焼いたファンテグイはご飯とよく合う。
desc_l10n.ko: 황태 요리로 유명한 집. 메뉴는 황태구이와 황태국, 시래깃국. 황태구이 정식에는 고추장 양념에 하루 정도 재워둔 황태를 불판에 올려놓고 알맞게 구운 다음, 파와 깨를 골고루 뿌려 먹음직스러움.
desc_l10n.zh: span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: NotoSansCJKkr-Regular; font-size: 12pt; line-height: 1.6; color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">店为以明太鱼干料理而闻名的店家，菜单内容有烤明太鱼干定食、明太鱼干汤和干菜汤等。烤明太鱼干的作法，是先将以辣椒酱腌渍一天左右的明太鱼干放在铁板上适当煎熟后，再均匀洒上葱和芝麻，看起来相当令人垂涎欲滴。凉拌鱿鱼和炒鳀鱼等小菜也相当清爽可口。

description: Hwangtae Bonga is famous for dishes made with hwangtae (dried pollack). The most popular items on the menu are hwangtae-gui (grilled dried pollack), hwang taeguk (dried pollack soup), and siraegit guk (dried radish soup). To make the scrumptious hwangtae-gui,dried pollack is marinated in red chili paste for about a day, grilled, and served appetizingly garnished with sliced green onion and sesame seeds. The hwangtae-gui set menu comes with a variety of tantalizing side dishes, like ojingeo muchim (squid andvegetables) and myeolchi bokkeum (fried anchovies).
name: Hwangtae Bonga

desc_l10n.en: Garam Guksi specializes in Gyeongsang-do-style noodles. The sogogi guksi (a noodle dish served in beef broth) and the myeolchi guksi (a noodle dish served in anchovy broth) are popular, and the kongguksu (a seasonal Korean noodle dish served in a coldwhite soybean broth) and the dumplings are good, too.
desc_l10n.ja: さっぱりしている慶尚道(キョンサンド)式のうどんを味わえるところ。ソコギククシ(牛肉入りのうどん)とミョルチククシ(干したカタグチいわしで出しをとったうどん)が人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 깔끔한 경상도식 국수(국시)를 전문으로 하는 곳.. 소고기국시와 멸치국시.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为专门提供地道的庆尚道面食料理，招牌菜色为牛肉汤面和鳀鱼汤面，另有豆浆面和水饺，味道亦不错。

description: Garam Guksi specializes in Gyeongsang-do-style noodles. The sogogi guksi (a noodle dish served in beef broth) and the myeolchi guksi (a noodle dish served in anchovy broth) are popular, and the kongguksu (a seasonal Korean noodle dish served in a coldwhite soybean broth) and the dumplings are good, too.
name: Garam Guksi

desc_l10n.en: Baekje Samgyetang has been serving samgyetang, ginseng chicken soup, for over 40 years. Their tongdak (whole chicken) is equally popular.
desc_l10n.ja: 約40年の歴史を誇るサムゲタン(若鶏のスープ)のお店。肉質が柔らかい幼い雌鳥のみを厳選し、ニンニクや葱、栗、高麗人参、ナツメなどを入れて長時間じっくり煮こんだスープだ。サムゲタンと一緒に出されるキムチやカットゥギ(大根キムチ)もおいしい。トンダック(鶏の丸焼き)も人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 40여 년 동안 대를 이어 한결같은 전통의 맛을 지켜온 삼계탕집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店拥有40多年历史，经过世代相传，传统口味却始终如一。店家仅挑选肉质软嫩的小公鸡，搭配大蒜、葱、新鲜栗子、人参和红枣等食材，一起经过长时间的炖煮。搭配参鸡汤一起享用的辛奇（kimchi）、萝卜辛奇（kimchi）和糯米饭也相当美味，炸鸡也是人气餐点。店内的顾客有一半以上都是日本观光客。

description: Baekje Samgyetang has been serving samgyetang, ginseng chicken soup, for over 40 years. Their tongdak (whole chicken) is equally popular.
name: Baekje Samgyetang

desc_l10n.en: This restaurant specializes in medicinal foods made with wild vegetables and natural seasonings. Recommended dishes include geunchaessam, or vegetables wrapped in potato slices marinated with enzymes, and bburi beombeok, ground lotus root, sweet potato and pumpkin wrapped in mulberry leaf.
desc_l10n.ja: 化学調味料を使わずに調理する薬膳料理専門店。各種ナムルを酵素に漬け、生のじゃがいもに包んで食べるクンチェサム、レンコン、サツマイモ、カボチャを挽いて桑の葉に包んで食べるプリボムボクなどのメニューがある。
desc_l10n.ko: 야생초에 화학조미료를 쓰지 않고 요리하는 약선음식 전문점
desc_l10n.zh: 不使用化学调味料，特别添加了野生药草的药膳专营店。菜品包括将生土豆用酵素腌制后卷着各种蔬菜食用的“根菜卷”和将莲藕、红薯和南瓜绞碎后用桑叶包着吃的“拌根茎”等等。

description: This restaurant specializes in medicinal foods made with wild vegetables and natural seasonings. Recommended dishes include geunchaessam, or vegetables wrapped in potato slices marinated with enzymes, and bburi beombeok, ground lotus root, sweet potato and pumpkin wrapped in mulberry leaf.
name: Nwijo

desc_l10n.en: Changgo 43 is a high-quality meat barbeque restaurant. When you're done with your meat, they prepare savory fried rice flavored with the sauce from ggakdugi (spicy pickled radish). Most customers make a reservation, so it is advisable to do so as well.
desc_l10n.ja: ブランド韓国産牛の韓牛(ハヌ)の焼き肉店。良質な牛肉を比較的手頃な価格で味わうことができる。ねぎのピリ辛和えとと一緒に食べるとあっさりしておすすめだ。肉を全て食べた後、カットゥギ(大根キムチ)の汁で炒めたご飯がおいしい。予約をしていったほうが良い。
desc_l10n.ko: 부드러운 파 채 무침과 함께 먹는 질 좋은 소고기의 맛이 일품인 곳. 고기를 다 먹은 후 깍두기 국물에 볶은 밥이 인기. 예약 필수.
desc_l10n.zh: 搭配顺口的酱拌葱丝一起享用的优质牛肉，简直是顶级美味。享用完烤肉后，以萝卜辛奇（kimchi）的汤汁拌炒的炒饭也相当可口。建议事先预约。

description: Changgo 43 is a high-quality meat barbeque restaurant. When you're done with your meat, they prepare savory fried rice flavored with the sauce from ggakdugi (spicy pickled radish). Most customers make a reservation, so it is advisable to do so as well.
name: Changgo 43

desc_l10n.en: At Tenkai, which specializes in authentic Japanese yakitori, you can enjoy grilled skewers. All of the tables are covered with tatami, so the rooms are cozy and comfortable. More than 40 different kinds of skewers are available, featuring seasonal ingredients such as meat, poultry, kinds of seafood, and vegetables, and they also feature a variety of liquor, including sake, soju, and fruit wines.
desc_l10n.ja: 日本式の焼き鳥を楽しむことができるお店。全てのテーブルが畳敷きになっておりこじんまりとしていてくつろげる。肉類、魚介類と野菜類など季節の材料を使った約40種類の焼き物を味わうことができる。アルコール類は日本酒から焼酎、果実酒まで多様にそろえている。閉店時間は早めだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 꼬치구이를 즐길 수 있는 일본식 정통 야키도리 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为可以享用到串烧的正宗日式烤鸡串专卖店。店内所有的座位皆为榻榻米，因此令人感觉安静自在。在此可以品尝到超过40多种口味的串烧，食材内容包含肉类、家禽类、海鲜和蔬菜等当季食材。店内从日本清酒到烧酒，甚至是水果酒皆一应俱全。

description: At Tenkai, which specializes in authentic Japanese yakitori, you can enjoy grilled skewers. All of the tables are covered with tatami, so the rooms are cozy and comfortable. More than 40 different kinds of skewers are available, featuring seasonal ingredients such as meat, poultry, kinds of seafood, and vegetables, and they also feature a variety of liquor, including sake, soju, and fruit wines.
name: Tenkai

desc_l10n.en: At Mazue Ramen, they make matsu ramen, a variation of the classic Japanese noodle soup in a broth made from freshwater clams. Here, they use fresh noodles that they make themselves. Their yaki gyoja (pan-fried pork and vegetable dumplings) are also excellent. Japanese-style izakaya bar food is also served at dinnertime.
desc_l10n.ja: シジミでスープをとる松江式ラーメンの店。麺も自家製を使っているのが特徴だ。自家製の焼き餃子もメニューにある。夜は、居酒屋メニューも用意されている。
desc_l10n.ko: 재첩으로 육수를 내는 일본 마쯔에 지방식 라멘을 하는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店提供日本松江风味的拉面，汤头是用环纹蚬熬制而成。此店特色在于使用手工揉制的，而店家亲制的手工煎饺味道也在水平之上，晚上则另备有居酒屋料理。

description: At Mazue Ramen, they make matsu ramen, a variation of the classic Japanese noodle soup in a broth made from freshwater clams. Here, they use fresh noodles that they make themselves. Their yaki gyoja (pan-fried pork and vegetable dumplings) are also excellent. Japanese-style izakaya bar food is also served at dinnertime.
name: Mazue Ramen

desc_l10n.en: Busan Bokjip has a reputation for being an affordable place to enjoy great-tasting bokguk (pufferfish soup). This spicy soup is made with pufferfish, and a generous amount of dropwort, bean sprouts, and garlic, making it loaded with flavor. At dinnertime, the pufferfish bulgogi is good to have with a glass of soju. Busan Bokjip is proud of its 30-year history.
desc_l10n.ja: 30年の歴史を持つふぐスープのお店。せりと豆もやしをたっぷり入れニンニクを効かしたピリ辛スープが味わい深い。手頃な価格で最高の味が楽しめるとして評判だ。夕食にポクプルコギ(ピリ辛のふぐ炒め)と焼酎もおすすめ。
desc_l10n.ko: 저렴하면서도 각별한 맛을 내는 곳으로 소문이 난 복집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店不仅价格低廉，且口味特别，因此声名大噪。加入大量水芹、黄豆芽和大蒜的呛辣汤头，滋味绝佳。晚上到此享用烤河豚，再搭配一杯烧酒也是不错的选择。店家以有30年传统而感到自豪。

description: Busan Bokjip has a reputation for being an affordable place to enjoy great-tasting bokguk (pufferfish soup). This spicy soup is made with pufferfish, and a generous amount of dropwort, bean sprouts, and garlic, making it loaded with flavor. At dinnertime, the pufferfish bulgogi is good to have with a glass of soju. Busan Bokjip is proud of its 30-year history.
name: Busan Bokjip

desc_l10n.en: Jinachun, established in 1925, is the oldest Chinese restaurant in Seoul and a place rich in history dating back to the Japanese colonial period. Located in Daehak-ro, it was popular among Seoul National University students in the 1960s and 1970s; students who lacked money would even pawn their wristwatches just to enjoy a bowl of jajangmyeon. The signature dish is a classic jajangmyeon (noodles in black bean sauce) that stays true to tradition, featuring an excellent harmony of chewy noodles and sauce. Inside the restaurant, photos related to its long history are displayed, allowing diners to glimpse stories of the past even during their meals.
