desc_l10n.ja: 進雅春は1925年に開業した、ソウルで最も古い中華料理店であり、日帝強占期から続く歴史ある場所です。大学路に位置し、1960～1970年代にはソウル大学の学生たちに人気があり、お金が足りなかった学生たちは、ジャージャー麺を食べるために腕時計を担保にするほどでした。代表メニューは基本に忠実なジャージャー麺で、もちもちした麺とソースの調和が絶品です。店内には長い歴史に関連する写真が展示されており、食事中にも過去の物語を垣間見ることができます。
desc_l10n.ko: 옛 서울대의 추억이 깃든 혜화동 대표 중식당
desc_l10n.zh: 进雅春是1925年开业的首尔最古老的中餐馆，历史可以追溯到日本殖民时期。它位于大学路，曾在1960-1970年代深受首尔大学学生的喜爱，甚至有些缺钱的学生为了吃上一碗炸酱面，把手表作为抵押。招牌菜是忠于传统的炸酱面，劲道的面条与酱汁的结合堪称一绝。店内还展示了许多与悠久历史相关的照片，顾客在用餐时也能一窥过去的故事。

description: Jinachun, established in 1925, is the oldest Chinese restaurant in Seoul and a place rich in history dating back to the Japanese colonial period. Located in Daehak-ro, it was popular among Seoul National University students in the 1960s and 1970s; students who lacked money would even pawn their wristwatches just to enjoy a bowl of jajangmyeon. The signature dish is a classic jajangmyeon (noodles in black bean sauce) that stays true to tradition, featuring an excellent harmony of chewy noodles and sauce. Inside the restaurant, photos related to its long history are displayed, allowing diners to glimpse stories of the past even during their meals.
name: Jinachun

desc_l10n.en: Sandeulhae is a hanjeongsik (Korean table d'hôte) restaurant converted from a two-story traditional Korean tiled-roof house. The dishes for the set meals here fill up the entire table and include dolsotbap (stone-pot rice) made with rice from Icheon, well-known for good-tasting rice; ganjang gejang (crab marinated in soy sauce); assorted grilled fish; buchimgae (pan-fried vegetable pancakes); bossam (Chinese cabbage wraps with pork; and japchae (cellophane noodles stir-fried with vegetables) among many other dishes. On the second floor, you can sit on the floor, as is customary in Korea, or at a table with chairs as is customary in Western countries, on the first floor. They also have Icheon rice and seaweed available for purchase.
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国の伝統的な2階建て瓦屋根の家屋で食事ができる韓定食の店。お米で有名なイチョン(利川)米で作った釜飯とカンジャンケジャン(カニの醤油漬け)、焼き魚、チヂミ、ポサム(ポッサム)など約20種類のおかずがお膳いっぱいに出できます。イチョン(利川)米と海苔は販売も行っています。
desc_l10n.ko: 한옥 기와 모양의 1, 2층 한정식집. 이천 쌀로 지은 돌솥밥과 간장게장, 생선모둠구이, 부침개, 보쌈, 잡채 등 20여 가지 반찬. 1층은 입식, 2층은 좌식으로 되어 있으며 이천 쌀과 김 판매.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为外观为2层楼韩屋建筑的韩式套餐店。定食内容相当丰盛，包含以利川米炊煮的石锅饭和酱油腌螃蟹、综合烤鱼、煎饼、辛奇（kimchi）包猪肉、凉拌冬粉等20多道小菜。1楼设有一般餐桌，2楼则设有矮桌。另有销售利川米和海苔。

description: Sandeulhae is a hanjeongsik (Korean table d'hôte) restaurant converted from a two-story traditional Korean tiled-roof house. The dishes for the set meals here fill up the entire table and include dolsotbap (stone-pot rice) made with rice from Icheon, well-known for good-tasting rice; ganjang gejang (crab marinated in soy sauce); assorted grilled fish; buchimgae (pan-fried vegetable pancakes); bossam (Chinese cabbage wraps with pork; and japchae (cellophane noodles stir-fried with vegetables) among many other dishes. On the second floor, you can sit on the floor, as is customary in Korea, or at a table with chairs as is customary in Western countries, on the first floor. They also have Icheon rice and seaweed available for purchase.
name: Sandeulhae

desc_l10n.en: Biyangdo specializes in hoe (sashimi) set menus and regional Jeju food. One unique item on the menu is dombe pork, which pork belly meat of Jeju native black pig steamed over pine needles with oriental ingredients and served on a chopping board.
desc_l10n.ja: チェジュド(済州島)料理をメインに扱っている韓国料理のお店。刺身の定食コースも人気だ。済州島名物の黒豚を漢方と一緒に松葉で蒸して作った独特なメニュー、ドンベゴギ(茹で豚肉)は美味。雰囲気のよい庭で食事もできる。
desc_l10n.ko: 생선회 정식코스와 제주도 토속 음식을 전문으로 하는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店专门提供生鱼片套餐和济州岛特色料理。特色料理为砧板猪肉，作法是将济州岛当地产的黑猪带皮五花肉、韩药材和松叶一起下锅蒸熟。在庭院用餐也相当有情调。

description: Biyangdo specializes in hoe (sashimi) set menus and regional Jeju food. One unique item on the menu is dombe pork, which pork belly meat of Jeju native black pig steamed over pine needles with oriental ingredients and served on a chopping board.
name: Biyangdo

desc_l10n.en: Jeonju Seolleongtang has been serving seolleongtang (ox bone soup) made with Korean beef for over 30 years.
desc_l10n.ja: 創業30年のブランド韓国産牛の韓牛(ハヌ)を使ったソルロンタン(牛の肉や骨を煮込んだスープ)のお店。ソルロンタンの他、トガニタン(牛肉や膝を煮込んだスープ)も人気メニューだ。24時間営業のため、早朝から訪れる人も多い。
desc_l10n.ko: 30년 전통의 한우 설렁탕집. 설렁탕, 도가니탕, 수육, 선지해장국.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为拥有30年传统的韩牛牛杂碎汤店，除牛杂碎汤外，牛膝汤亦相当受到欢迎，若是再搭配一碟白煮肉则更佳。此店为24小时营业，且另备有牛血解酒汤，因此有许多顾客会来此解酒。

description: Jeonju Seolleongtang has been serving seolleongtang (ox bone soup) made with Korean beef for over 30 years.
name: Jeonju Seolleongtang

name_l10n.ja: チョンジュ・ソルロンタン

desc_l10n.en: p { text-align: justify; word-spacing: 2px; } HANS specializes in Korean-style cakes, famous for the excellent design and taste. Their creative yet simple look also draw significant appeal as a premium quality product. While these classy customized cakes are available for order, mousse cake and cheese cake stand out as their most signature cakes.
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国スタイルのケーキ専門店。独創的かつシンプルなケーキが特徴。目的に合わせたオーダーメイドケーキも注文可能。濃いチーズの香りがするチーズケーキとムースケーキが人気。
desc_l10n.ko: 모양과 맛이 뛰어나 인지도를 높이고 있는 한국형 케이크 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为因色香味俱全而广受好评的韩风蛋糕专卖店，店家以简单独创的设计，制作出受到大众喜爱的高级蛋糕。亦有提供配合顾客喜好制作的订制蛋糕。主力商品为以浓厚的奶酪香而广受好评的奶酪蛋糕和慕斯蛋糕。

description: p { text-align: justify; word-spacing: 2px; } HANS specializes in Korean-style cakes, famous for the excellent design and taste. Their creative yet simple look also draw significant appeal as a premium quality product. While these classy customized cakes are available for order, mousse cake and cheese cake stand out as their most signature cakes.
name: HANS

desc_l10n.en: Dongpyo Golbaengi in the Myeongdong area offers golbaengi muchim (spicy salad with sea snail). This restaurant is famous for generous portions and kind service. The strong flavor comes from a mix of red chili pepper powder, minced garlic, and fresh scallions.All golbaengi dishes come with complimentary pan-fried vegetable egg rolls.
desc_l10n.ja: ミョンドン(明洞)のコルベンイムチム(つぶ貝の和え物)店が立ち並ぶ通りで元祖とされているお店。つぶ貝をネギなどピリ辛に合えた味がお酒にぴったり。量が多く、お店の人の情でも有名なところだ。コルベンイムチムを注文すると玉子焼きがついてくる。
desc_l10n.ko: 명동 골뱅이 골목에서 동해골뱅이와 함께 원조격인 집
desc_l10n.zh: 此店在明洞海螺巷中与东海海螺皆称为老字号店家，以丰富的酱料闻名。将辣椒粉、蒜末和青葱等食材搅拌完成后的拌料，口味相当刺激。若是点用海螺，店家会基本赠送煎蛋卷。使用东标海螺为此店的优点。

description: Dongpyo Golbaengi in the Myeongdong area offers golbaengi muchim (spicy salad with sea snail). This restaurant is famous for generous portions and kind service. The strong flavor comes from a mix of red chili pepper powder, minced garlic, and fresh scallions.All golbaengi dishes come with complimentary pan-fried vegetable egg rolls.
name: Dongpyo Golbaengi

name_l10n.ja: トンピョ・ゴルベンイ

desc_l10n.en: Headquartered in Jeju-do Island, this restaurant specializes in black pork. Black pork is chunkier and meatier than regular pork. Black pork at Heukdonga is dipped in a special Jejudo-style salted anchovy sauce.
desc_l10n.ja: チェジュ(済州)に本店がある黒豚専門店。黒豚は、一般的なサムギョプサルよりもはるかに弾力性があって香ばしくあっさりした味。厚切りの肉を焼き、コクのある濃厚な済州式いわし塩辛ソースにつけて食べるスタイル。
desc_l10n.ko: 제주에 본점이 있는 흑돼지 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 黑猪肉烧烤专营店，总店设在济州岛，首尔的是分店。黑猪肉比一般的五花肉更有嚼劲，肉香也更浓，且肥而不腻。厚厚的烤肉蘸上济州带鱼酱调成的酱汁，味道十分正宗。

description: Headquartered in Jeju-do Island, this restaurant specializes in black pork. Black pork is chunkier and meatier than regular pork. Black pork at Heukdonga is dipped in a special Jejudo-style salted anchovy sauce.
name: Heukdonga

desc_l10n.en: Nariuijip is famous for their delicious samgyeopsal (pork belly) and cheongjukjang jjigae (fermented soybean paste stew). The pajeori (green onion salad), when eaten with the samgyeopsal, is especially great. It is very crowded at lunch and dinner time, so you should avoid these times if you want to relax while eating.
desc_l10n.ja: サムギョプサル(豚の三枚肉の焼肉)とチョングクチャン(納豆味噌鍋)がおいしいことで有名なところ。特にサムギョプサルと一緒に食べるパジョリ(葱の和え物)は逸品だ。24時間営業なので、いつでも立ち寄れる。昼食･夕食の時間にはいつも混雑するのでゆっくり食べたい場合は食事時間を避けるのがおすすめだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 삼겹살과 청국장이 맛있기로 유명한 곳. 특히 삼겹살과 함께 먹는 파절이의 맛이 일품.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店以五花肉和清曲酱汤而闻名，搭配五花肉一起享用的酱拌葱丝更是美味。午餐和晚餐时间总是人潮不断，因此店家经常忙得不可开交，若是想要悠闲的用餐，则最好尽量避免于在用餐高峰时段造访。

description: Nariuijip is famous for their delicious samgyeopsal (pork belly) and cheongjukjang jjigae (fermented soybean paste stew). The pajeori (green onion salad), when eaten with the samgyeopsal, is especially great. It is very crowded at lunch and dinner time, so you should avoid these times if you want to relax while eating.
name: Nariuijip

desc_l10n.en: Manbal specializes in Korean-bred beef delivered from Hampyeong of the Jeolla region and Hongseong of the Chungcheong region. The sirloin is vacuum-sealed and matured on site and thus tastes great when grilled over charcoals. The side dishes are neatlypresented and also excellent. The restaurant was converted from a house, and has a small garden which is quite cozy.
desc_l10n.ja: 焼肉店。ブランド韓国産牛の韓牛(ハヌ)で有名な全羅道(チョルラド)の咸平(ハムピョン)と忠清道(チュンチョンド)の洪城(ホンソン)から仕入れた肉を使っている。上質のサーロインを炭火で焼いて食べる味は格別だ。一緒に出されるおかず類もおいしく、見た目にも美しい。住宅をリモデリングしたところで、小さな庭園もある。
desc_l10n.ko: 전라도 함평과 충청도 홍성에서 가져오는 한우 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为韩牛专卖店，使用来自全罗道咸平和忠清道洪城的韩牛，店家会将真空包装的牛里脊置于水槽中静待熟成。以炭火烧烤的优质牛里脊相当美味，精致的小菜亦在水平之上。此店是由一般住家改建而成，是拥有小巧庭院的淡雅空间。

description: Manbal specializes in Korean-bred beef delivered from Hampyeong of the Jeolla region and Hongseong of the Chungcheong region. The sirloin is vacuum-sealed and matured on site and thus tastes great when grilled over charcoals. The side dishes are neatlypresented and also excellent. The restaurant was converted from a house, and has a small garden which is quite cozy.
name: Manbal

desc_l10n.en: Sinanchon is a traditional cuisine specialty restaurant that reflects the traditional dishes and food culture of the Shinan region in Jeollanam-do. Founder Lee Geum-shim developed signature dishes like Nakji Kkuri and yeonpotang using ingredients from her hometown. Nakji-kuri features fresh live octopus grilled with sesame oil seasoning, boasting a light and savory taste, and they also offer yeonpotang, known for its refreshing broth. They offer course meals that include sashimi and soups, making it a place where you can enjoy Korean food along with the warm atmosphere of a traditional Korean house.
desc_l10n.ja: シナンチョン は全羅南道の新安地域の伝統料理と食文化を反映した郷土料理専門店で、創業者イ・グムシムが故郷の食材を活用して開発したナクジクリとヨンポタンが代表メニューです。ナクジクリは新鮮な生タコをゴマ油のタレで焼き、淡白で香ばしい味わいが自慢です。また、さっぱりしたスープが魅力のヨンポタンも提供されます。刺身とスープが含まれたコース料理もあり、韓国料理と韓屋の温かい雰囲気を一緒に楽しむことができる場所です。
desc_l10n.ko: 대통령 단골집으로 유명한 전라도 토속 음식 전문점
desc_l10n.zh: 新安村 是一家反映全罗南道新安地区传统料理和饮食文化的土著美食专门店，创始人李金心利用家乡的食材开发了代表菜品章鱼烤肉和涮章鱼汤。章鱼烤肉使用新鲜的活章鱼配上香油调料烤制，味道清淡而香浓；涮章鱼汤则以清爽的汤汁为特色。餐厅还提供包含生鱼片和汤品的套餐，顾客可以在温暖的韩屋氛围中享受正宗的韩国料理。

description: Sinanchon is a traditional cuisine specialty restaurant that reflects the traditional dishes and food culture of the Shinan region in Jeollanam-do. Founder Lee Geum-shim developed signature dishes like Nakji Kkuri and yeonpotang using ingredients from her hometown. Nakji-kuri features fresh live octopus grilled with sesame oil seasoning, boasting a light and savory taste, and they also offer yeonpotang, known for its refreshing broth. They offer course meals that include sashimi and soups, making it a place where you can enjoy Korean food along with the warm atmosphere of a traditional Korean house.
name: Sinanchon

desc_l10n.en: For over 20 years, Seogeulleongtang has been a popular place for charcoal-grilled samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly). The samgyeosal is marinated in soy sauce seasoned with oriental herbal medicine and then grilled over charcoal, giving it a unique, delicious flavor that eliminates the strong pork taste. To make their popular haejangguk (hangover soup), they add coagulated ox blood, dried Chinese cabbage leaves, and bean sprouts to a delicious broth made from beef bones. It is quite popular, so much so that getting a table at dinner time can be difficult.
desc_l10n.ja: 汝矣島(ヨイド)で20年以上人気を博してきた炭火サムギョプサル(豚の三枚肉の焼肉)店。漢方薬の入った醤油のタレに漬けて炭火で焼く三枚肉は臭みもなく、独特な味を楽しめる。牛の骨からとったスープにソンジ(固めた牛の血)やもやしなどを入れたへジャンクク(二日酔いによいとされるスープ)も人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 여의도에서 20여 년이 훨씬 넘게 인기를 누려 온 숯불 소스 삼겹살 구이점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为碳烤酱料五花肉专卖店，在汝矣岛开店20多年以来一直享有高人气。抹上添加韩药材的酱油酱料后，再放至炭火上烧烤的五花肉，不仅没有猪腥味，反而有种独特的香味。在以牛骨熬煮的高汤中加入牛血、辛奇（kimchi）叶、干菜和黄豆芽后滚煮的解酒汤，也相当受到欢迎。晚餐时段经常是一位难求，店家忙得不可开交。

description: For over 20 years, Seogeulleongtang has been a popular place for charcoal-grilled samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly). The samgyeosal is marinated in soy sauce seasoned with oriental herbal medicine and then grilled over charcoal, giving it a unique, delicious flavor that eliminates the strong pork taste. To make their popular haejangguk (hangover soup), they add coagulated ox blood, dried Chinese cabbage leaves, and bean sprouts to a delicious broth made from beef bones. It is quite popular, so much so that getting a table at dinner time can be difficult.
name: Seogeulleongtang

desc_l10n.en: Home Sukki combines two styles of hot pot, Thai suki and Japanese shabu shabu. Enjoy set menus served with vegetables, beef shabu shabu, and haemul juk (seafood rice porridge). After shabu shabu, you can have kalguksu (knife-cut noodles) and juk (rice porridge).
desc_l10n.ja: タイすきと日本のしゃぶしゃぶをミックスしたレストラン。コース料理を頼むと野菜と牛肉のしゃぶしゃぶを味わうことができる。しゃぶしゃぶの後にうどんやご飯をいれて食べてもおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 태국의 수키와 일본의 샤부샤부를 혼합한 음식점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为结合泰式火锅和日式涮涮锅的料理店。若是点用套餐，则可以享用到蔬菜、牛肉涮涮锅和海鲜粥，享用完涮涮锅后，还能以剩下的汤底烹煮刀切面和粥。

description: Home Sukki combines two styles of hot pot, Thai suki and Japanese shabu shabu. Enjoy set menus served with vegetables, beef shabu shabu, and haemul juk (seafood rice porridge). After shabu shabu, you can have kalguksu (knife-cut noodles) and juk (rice porridge).
name: Home Sukki

desc_l10n.en: Hanujib Wi built its reputation by using only premium-quality Korean beef. The special lunch set menu is popular because they serve a nicely-balanced.
desc_l10n.ja: 最上級のブランド韓国産牛の韓牛(ハヌ)のみを扱っていることで有名な焼き肉店。丸い鉄板に牛脂をひいて肉を焼くスタイルだ。焼肉の後に鉄板で炒めて食べるご飯とカットゥギ(大根キムチ)の炒飯もおいしい。サーロイン、テンダーロイン、テンジャンチゲ(味噌鍋)がセットになったお昼特選メニューも人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 한우 1+, 1++ 만을 사용. 한우등심, 안심, 된장찌개, 깍두기밥
desc_l10n.zh: 此店以仅使用韩牛1+、1++等级的牛肉而闻名，内容包含韩牛里脊、菲力、大豆酱锅和萝卜辛奇（kimchi）炒饭的午间特餐也相当受到欢迎。此店享用烤肉的方式，是先将牛油均匀涂抹在圆形铁板上后，再将牛肉放进去烧烤。享用完烤肉后，则可以将萝卜辛奇（kimchi）和白饭放进去翻炒食用。

description: Hanujib Wi built its reputation by using only premium-quality Korean beef. The special lunch set menu is popular because they serve a nicely-balanced.
name: Hanujib Wi

desc_l10n.en: Namdo Mirak specializes in the cuisine of Jeollanam-do (the southern province of the region of Jeolla). Popular choices are the hongeo samhap (a combination of three ingredients: aged skate, boiled pork, and fermented kimchi) and galchi jorim (braisedhairtail). The mustard leaf kimchi served as a side dish, is also very good. The restaurant has a 20-year history and is a good place to treat your guests as it was recently renovated and now features a modern and neat interior.
desc_l10n.ja: 全羅道(チョルラド)の郷土料理を味わうことができるお店。ホンオサムハプ(醗酵させたガンギエイと茹で豚肉、完熟キムチを一緒に食べる料理)とカルチジョリム(太刀魚の煮付け)が人気メニューだ。20年以上の歴史を持つ店だが、数年前にリフォームをし店内はモダンで爽やかなスタイル 。
desc_l10n.ko: 전라도식 음식을 맛볼 수 있는 곳. 홍어삼합과 갈치 조림이 인기.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到全罗道料理，人气料理为魟鱼三合和炖白带鱼，而雪里蕻等小菜亦能感受到店家的功力。店家以拥有超过20多年的历史而感到自豪，几年前将店内重新整修后，室内环境变得利落现代，因此亦很适合在此招待贵宾。

description: Namdo Mirak specializes in the cuisine of Jeollanam-do (the southern province of the region of Jeolla). Popular choices are the hongeo samhap (a combination of three ingredients: aged skate, boiled pork, and fermented kimchi) and galchi jorim (braisedhairtail). The mustard leaf kimchi served as a side dish, is also very good. The restaurant has a 20-year history and is a good place to treat your guests as it was recently renovated and now features a modern and neat interior.
name: Namdo Mirak

desc_l10n.en: Seongbukdong Nurungji Baeksuk is famous for their memil sujebi (buckwheat hand-torn noodle soup). The popular dishes here are deulggae memil sujebi (sujebi with perilla seed powder) and nurungji baeksuk (scorched rice in chicken broth). Dessert can be enjoyed on the small second-floor terrace with its panoramic view of the whole Seongbuk-dong area.
desc_l10n.ja: トㅁゥルケメミルスジェビ(ゴマのそば粉すいとん)とヌルンジペクスッ(おこげの入った鶏の水煮)で有名なところ。白い外観のこじんまりとしたお店だ。食事が終わったあとは2階にある小さなテラスで城北洞(ソンブクドン)の景色を見ながらデザートを楽しめる。
desc_l10n.ko: 메밀수제비 집으로 시작한 곳으로, 들깨 메밀수제비와 누룽지 백숙이 인기
desc_l10n.zh: 此店原为荞麦面疙瘩店，人气料理为紫苏荞麦面疙瘩和锅巴白煮鸡。白色的外观，给人利落大方的感觉。用餐完毕后，还能至2楼的小阳台，一边欣赏城北洞的全景，一边享用饭后甜点。

description: Seongbukdong Nurungji Baeksuk is famous for their memil sujebi (buckwheat hand-torn noodle soup). The popular dishes here are deulggae memil sujebi (sujebi with perilla seed powder) and nurungji baeksuk (scorched rice in chicken broth). Dessert can be enjoyed on the small second-floor terrace with its panoramic view of the whole Seongbuk-dong area.
name: Seongbukdong Nurungji Baeksuk

name_l10n.ja: ソンブクドン・ヌルンジベクスク

desc_l10n.en: The well-known swellfish restaurant of Korean-first swellfish course. The theme of swellfish is sublimated in a total cooking culture here. Its R&D of menu is actively performed in cooperation with Japanese famous restaurants. Live swellfish are served in sasimi, in 5minutes after removing its poison.
desc_l10n.ja: フグ料理の最高峰 フグのコース料理を、韓国内で定着化させることに初めて成功したフグのお店。生きたフグを５分以内に処理してすぐ味わえるなど、新鮮なフグ料理を堪能できるところ。日本人に馴染みのあるフグを韓国風で味わえる。
desc_l10n.ko: 국내 최초 복코스요리 정착화에 성공한 소문난 복집 .
desc_l10n.zh: 腹部的最高的山峰的表达 本店是以河豚套餐料理为主的专门店。本店将单一的用餐槪念提升为综合性的料理槪念。本店与日本芎地的有名料理店共同开发，积极参与促进硏究方面的活动。本店还为顾客表演５分钟内对河豚进行除毒处理后，即时品尝河豚料理的失传技术。

description: The well-known swellfish restaurant of Korean-first swellfish course. The theme of swellfish is sublimated in a total cooking culture here. Its R&D of menu is actively performed in cooperation with Japanese famous restaurants. Live swellfish are served in sasimi, in 5minutes after removing its poison.
name: Samjungbokjip

desc_l10n.en: Mami Cheonggukjang is famous for cheonggukjang (fermented soybean paste soup). This restaurant recently underwent renovations, so the interior is pristine.
desc_l10n.ja: 大学路(テハンノ)エリアのチョングクチャン(納豆味噌鍋)で有名なお店。一緒に出されるおかずもおいしい。劇場が多い大学路らしく役者やその噂を聞きつけたお客で有名なところだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 대학로에서 청국장으로 유명한 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店在大学路以清曲酱汤而闻名。和清曲酱汤一起端上桌的各式小菜也相当可口。曾经参与演出的舞台剧演员和慕名而来的顾客也非常多。

description: Mami Cheonggukjang is famous for cheonggukjang (fermented soybean paste soup). This restaurant recently underwent renovations, so the interior is pristine.
name: Mami Cheonggukjang

name_l10n.ja: マミ・チョングクチャン

desc_l10n.en: Seongbukdong Dwaejigalbijip is a famous dwaeji galbi (pork short ribs) restaurant that has been in operation in the Seongbuk-dong area for over 30 years. The set menu of chargrilled dwaeji galbi is excellent. Since it is grilled over charcoal briquettes,the pork is enfused with a smoky flavor and loses most of its fat.
desc_l10n.ja: 30年以上も城北洞(ソンブクドン)一帯で有名なテジカルビ(味付け豚カルビの焼肉)のお店。味付けされた豚カルビは柔らかく、適度に脂が落ちて食べやすい。豚カルビ定食が人気メニューだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 30년이 넘은, 성북동 일대에서 유명한 연탄불 돼지갈비집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为在城北洞一带相当知名的烤猪小排专卖店，拥有超过30年的历史。经炭火烧烤的烤猪小排套餐相当可口。这里的烤猪小排略带炭火的香气，且油脂已充分去除，充满嚼劲的口感相当美味。

description: Seongbukdong Dwaejigalbijip is a famous dwaeji galbi (pork short ribs) restaurant that has been in operation in the Seongbuk-dong area for over 30 years. The set menu of chargrilled dwaeji galbi is excellent. Since it is grilled over charcoal briquettes,the pork is enfused with a smoky flavor and loses most of its fat.
name: Seongbukdong Dwaejigalbijip

name_l10n.ja: ソンブクトン・テジガルビチブ
name_l10n.zh: 城北洞烤猪小排店(Seongbukdong Dwaejigalbijip)

desc_l10n.en: Yeouido Yangjitang is famous for yangji seolleongtang, ox-bone soup made with beef brisket and flank. Their kimchi is delicious, and they will repleni.
desc_l10n.ko: 양지 고기를 넣고 끓인 양지설렁탕이 유명한 집. 김치 맛도 일품.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的招牌料理为加入牛排骨肉一起滚煮的骨肉牛杂碎汤，辛奇（kimchi）也是滋味可口，面条则可无限续点。若是搭配白煮肉一起享用，则美味加倍，烤五花肉也是不错的选择。

description: Yeouido Yangjitang is famous for yangji seolleongtang, ox-bone soup made with beef brisket and flank. Their kimchi is delicious, and they will repleni.
name: Yeouido Yangjitang

desc_l10n.en: Three generations have been running this Chinese restaurant for over 40 years. Gaehwa is famous for its delicious noodle dishes. The jajangmyeon, handmade noodles topped with black soybean sauce, potatoes, onions, carrots, and pork is very good; the honghap jjamppong, a spicy noodle soup, comes loaded with mussels; and the chili shrimp and the pan-fried pork balls with vegetables are also worthy of a recommendation.
desc_l10n.ja: 40年の歴史を持つ中華料理店。チャジャンミョン(ジャージャー麺)がおいしいことで有名なところだ。手打ちの麺にジャガイモとたまねぎ、にんじん、豚肉を入れて炒めた味噌がたっぷりとのっている。ムール貝をたっぷり入れたホンハプチャンポン(ムール貝入りちゃんぽん)、カンソセウ(エビチリ)などもおすすめだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 3대째 40여 년 전통을 이어오는 중식집. 짜장면이 맛있는 집으로도 유명
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为拥有40多年历史，现已传承至第3代的中式餐馆，以美味的炸酱面闻名。将土豆、洋葱、红萝卜和猪肉加在一起爆炒的炸酱，搭配上手工面条滋味绝佳。加入大量淡菜的淡菜辣海鲜汤面、干烧虾仁和南煎丸子等，也相当值得推荐。

description: Three generations have been running this Chinese restaurant for over 40 years. Gaehwa is famous for its delicious noodle dishes. The jajangmyeon, handmade noodles topped with black soybean sauce, potatoes, onions, carrots, and pork is very good; the honghap jjamppong, a spicy noodle soup, comes loaded with mussels; and the chili shrimp and the pan-fried pork balls with vegetables are also worthy of a recommendation.
name: Gaehwa

desc_l10n.en: Hampyeong Myeonok is popular for their jeongol (hot pot) varieties and is famous for their generous portions. The scrumptious beosot mandu jeongol (mushroom dumpling hot pot) with meat and noodles is made with a variety of mushrooms and kimchi dumplings in beef broth. Their other popular dish, kimchi mari guksu, is noodles in cold kimchi soup served in an earthenware bowl.
desc_l10n.ja: ボリュームあるマンドゥジョンゴル(餃子入り鍋)とキムチマリ(冷たい水キムチのそうめん)が有名なところ。牛肉でとったスープに様々なきのこ類とマンドゥを入れたボソマンドゥジョンゴルチゲ(きのこと餃子入り鍋)は美味。麺と一緒に食べるとさらにおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 푸짐한 만두전골과 김치말이 국시로 유명한 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店以料多味美的饺子锅和辛奇（kimchi）汤面出名。香菇饺子锅，是在牛肉高汤中加入各种菇类和辛奇（kimchi）饺子后炖煮而成，搭配肉和面条一起享用，美味不在话下。而招牌料理辛奇（kimchi）汤面，则是在砂锅中加入爽口的辛奇（kimchi）汤后，再将面条放入便完成。

description: Hampyeong Myeonok is popular for their jeongol (hot pot) varieties and is famous for their generous portions. The scrumptious beosot mandu jeongol (mushroom dumpling hot pot) with meat and noodles is made with a variety of mushrooms and kimchi dumplings in beef broth. Their other popular dish, kimchi mari guksu, is noodles in cold kimchi soup served in an earthenware bowl.
name: Hampyeong Myeonok

name_l10n.ja: ハムピョン・ミョノク

desc_l10n.en: At this Korean pub, you can enjoy assorted jeon (Korean-style pancakes) such as haemulyachae jeon (seafood vegetable pancakes) and makgeolli (Korean rice wine). The restaurant interior is tastefully decorated all in wood and bamboo. The dongdongju (anotherkind of Korean rice wine) and gyeranjjim (steamed scrambled eggs with chopped vegetables) are also served in bamboo containers. The modeum jeon (assorted pancakes) are popular, but only 11 plates a day are served.
desc_l10n.ja: モドゥムジョン(チヂミの盛り合わせ)とマッコリを楽しめる飲み屋。店内は天井、床、壁全てに木や竹が使われており風情がある。ドンドンジュ(どぶろく)やゲランチム(韓国式の茶碗蒸し)も竹の器に入れて出される。1日に11食限定のチモドゥムジョンが人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 모둠전, 해물야채전과 막걸리를 즐길 수 있는 한식 주점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为可以享用到综合煎饼、海鲜蔬菜煎饼和小米酒的酒馆。店内的天花板、地板和墙壁全都是用木头和竹子装饰而成，因此充满雅致的气息，咚咚酒和蒸蛋也是盛装在竹筒里后才端给顾客。一天限量供应11盘的综合煎饼相当受到欢迎。

description: At this Korean pub, you can enjoy assorted jeon (Korean-style pancakes) such as haemulyachae jeon (seafood vegetable pancakes) and makgeolli (Korean rice wine). The restaurant interior is tastefully decorated all in wood and bamboo. The dongdongju (anotherkind of Korean rice wine) and gyeranjjim (steamed scrambled eggs with chopped vegetables) are also served in bamboo containers. The modeum jeon (assorted pancakes) are popular, but only 11 plates a day are served.
name: Songajeossi Bindaetteok

name_l10n.ja: ソンアジョッシ・ビンデトク

desc_l10n.en: Naegohyang Sikdang is one of the best galchi jorim (braised hairtail fish) restaurants in Namdaemun. Hairtail is garnished with several different kinds of seasoning and is boiled down in an earthenware pot over high heat, yielding a dish with a rich and rather spicy flavor. The complimentary deep-fried hairtail tails taste excellent. Although this little place is a bit shabby, it is popular enough that you have to wait in line to be seated.
desc_l10n.ja: ナムデムン(南大門)にあるカルチジョリム(太刀魚の煮物)通りにある中でもおいしいと人気のお店。熱々の土鍋に出されるピリ辛のカルチジョリムは、ご飯がすすむ。サービスで出される太刀魚の尻尾のから揚げも美味。狭くお世辞にも綺麗とは言えない店内だがお昼時ともなれば行列できる人気店だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 남대문 갈치조림 전문점 중 대표적 맛집. 뚝배기에 담아 갖은 양념과 함께 센 불에 끓여 내는 갈치조림이 얼큰. 갈치 꼬리 부분을 튀겨 서비스로 올리는 것도 별미.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为南大门的炖白带鱼专卖店中最具代表性的店家。在砂锅中加进各式调味料后，以大火滚煮的炖白带鱼，口味相当辛辣。店家会将白带鱼的尾巴酥炸后免费提供给顾客，其滋味也相当美味。虽然店内空间狭小老旧，但一到午餐时段，经常必须要排队才能享用到美食。

description: Naegohyang Sikdang is one of the best galchi jorim (braised hairtail fish) restaurants in Namdaemun. Hairtail is garnished with several different kinds of seasoning and is boiled down in an earthenware pot over high heat, yielding a dish with a rich and rather spicy flavor. The complimentary deep-fried hairtail tails taste excellent. Although this little place is a bit shabby, it is popular enough that you have to wait in line to be seated.
name: Naegohyang Sikdang

name_l10n.ja: ネ・コヒャン・シクタン

desc_l10n.en: Fresh pufferfish is grilled in a rectangular grilling basket to make Cheolcheol Bokjip's unique pufferfish bulgogi. Also available is bokguk (pufferfish soup), which is a good remedy for a hangover. Because they use fresh pufferfish, the prices are somewhat high.
desc_l10n.ja: 生のふぐを焼き網の上にのせ直火で焼いて食べるボクブルコギがおいしいところ。酔い覚ましによいとされるポックク(ふぐのスープ)も美味だ。活きの良いふぐを使っているため価格は多少高め。
desc_l10n.ko: 생 복을 석쇠 위에 올려 직화로 구워 먹는 복불고기
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的特色料理为将新鲜河豚肉置于铁网上，以直火烧烤的烤河豚，河豚汤对于醒酒也相当有效。店家使用的都是新鲜河豚，因此价格也偏高。

description: Fresh pufferfish is grilled in a rectangular grilling basket to make Cheolcheol Bokjip's unique pufferfish bulgogi. Also available is bokguk (pufferfish soup), which is a good remedy for a hangover. Because they use fresh pufferfish, the prices are somewhat high.
name: Cheolcheol Bokjip

name_l10n.ja: チォルチォル・ボッチブ

desc_l10n.en: Banpo Chicken as its name states, specializes in chicken. Their representative dish, maneul chicken (garlic chicken) is rotisserie-baked, greatly reducing fat content. Because the fresh chicken is stuffed with garlic, it has a strong garlic flavor. You can also have regular roasted chicken here. Only bottled beer is available.
desc_l10n.ja: 昔から営業しているフライドチキン専門店。代表メニューのマヌルチキンは焼いて油を抜いたあと、その上に薬味にしたニンニクを塗ってオーブンで焼く料理だ。生鶏にニンニクを入れて焼くので、ニンニクの味と香りが豊か。普通のフライドチキンも味わえる。 生ビールはなく、瓶ビールのみ販売。
desc_l10n.ko: 오래된 치킨 전문점으로, 대표 메뉴인 전기구이 마늘치킨.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为历史悠久的鸡肉料理专营店。招牌菜香蒜鸡是用电烤去掉油以后，再涂上调料放入烤箱烤制。因为将大蒜放在生鸡上烤制，所以大蒜的味道和香气非常浓烈。当然也可以吃到一般的电烤鸡。

description: Banpo Chicken as its name states, specializes in chicken. Their representative dish, maneul chicken (garlic chicken) is rotisserie-baked, greatly reducing fat content. Because the fresh chicken is stuffed with garlic, it has a strong garlic flavor. You can also have regular roasted chicken here. Only bottled beer is available.
name: Banpo Chicken

desc_l10n.en: At this German pub you can enjoy a variety of European beers alongside eisbein (ham hocks) or cordon bleu schnitzel (tonkatsu) at reasonable prices. They offer a variety of sausages like bratwurst, grilled sausages, pork sausages, fresh sausages, and white sausages, all imported directly from Germany.
desc_l10n.ja: ドイツの生ビールをはじめソーセージ、アイスバイン(ドイツ風豚足)、コルドンブルー(チーズ入りとんかつ)などを味わえるレストラン。黒ビールの他、様々なヨーロッパのビールを楽しむことができる。また、ソーセージはドイツから直輸入したグリルソーセージ、ポークソーセージ、フレッシュソーセージ、ホワイトソーセージなど。
desc_l10n.ko: 독일 풍의 소시지 요리, 아이스바인(족발), 코돈브로(돈가스)와 함께 흑맥주를 비롯한 다양한 유럽 맥주가 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 德國生啤酒酒吧, 在這裡可以品嚐德國香腸、德國豬腳和德國豬排等美食, 還可以搭配黑啤酒和各式歐洲啤酒呢! 店內的燒烤香腸、煎烤香腸、帶骨香腸、煙燻香腸和白香腸等都是直接從德國進口。許多想體驗德國風情的外國人經常造訪此店。

description: At this German pub you can enjoy a variety of European beers alongside eisbein (ham hocks) or cordon bleu schnitzel (tonkatsu) at reasonable prices. They offer a variety of sausages like bratwurst, grilled sausages, pork sausages, fresh sausages, and white sausages, all imported directly from Germany.
name: Deutsch House

desc_l10n.en: Donga Naengmyeon is a naengmyeon (buckwheat noodles in an iced tangy broth) restaurant with a 30-year history. Naengmyeon here is typically served spicy but can be ordered less spicy, more sweet or more sour according to taste. Takeout is possible.
desc_l10n.ja: 30年の歴史を誇るネンミョン(冷麺)専門店。辛さがくせになるピビムネンミョン(ピリ辛のスープなし冷麺)が人気だ。注文する時、辛さも指定できる。持ち帰りも可能だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 30여 년 전통의 냉면 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为拥有30多年传统的冷面专卖店，点餐完毕后，通常店家会送上辣味冷面，但顾客可以根据喜好选择冷面口味。本店也提供外带，也同样可以指定已经煮熟或是尚未煮熟的冷面。虽然是路边摊风格的冷面，但顾客可以自行选择喜爱的口味。

description: Donga Naengmyeon is a naengmyeon (buckwheat noodles in an iced tangy broth) restaurant with a 30-year history. Naengmyeon here is typically served spicy but can be ordered less spicy, more sweet or more sour according to taste. Takeout is possible.
name: Donga Naengmyeon

desc_l10n.en: Baengnyeonok specializes in tofu. Tofu is a high-protein ingredient made by soaking beans, grinding them, and squeezing them to form a curd. This restaurant offers representative dishes such as kongbiji baekban (puréed soybean soup, a bowl of rice, and side dishes), all-natural soft tofu, and vegetable-tofu bibimbap (mixed rice). The all-natural soft tofu baekban comes with unflavored chunks of tofu served in warm broth with a seasoning sauce. They also offer soft tofu which is sprinkled with red pepper powder for a spicy kick and served in an earthenware bowl.
desc_l10n.ja: 豆腐料理専門店。コンビジペッパン(おから鍋の定食)、スンドゥブ(おぼろ豆腐のピリ辛鍋)、ヤチェ・ドゥブピビンバプ(野菜豆腐ピビンパ)などが代表メニューだ。スンドゥブは湯の中に入った豆腐が出されるので、それにタレをかけて食べる。夏は冷たい豆乳素麺が人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 두부로 만든 음식 전문으로 유명. 콩비지백반, 자연식순두부, 야채두부비빔밥.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店以豆腐料理而闻名。豆腐渣定食、天然豆腐定食和蔬菜豆腐拌饭等，都是招牌菜。天然豆腐定食，是将原味豆腐块放进开水中烹煮后，再搭配酱料食用。砂锅豆腐定食便是辣豆腐锅。夏天时，豆浆面也很受欢迎。

description: Baengnyeonok specializes in tofu. Tofu is a high-protein ingredient made by soaking beans, grinding them, and squeezing them to form a curd. This restaurant offers representative dishes such as kongbiji baekban (puréed soybean soup, a bowl of rice, and side dishes), all-natural soft tofu, and vegetable-tofu bibimbap (mixed rice). The all-natural soft tofu baekban comes with unflavored chunks of tofu served in warm broth with a seasoning sauce. They also offer soft tofu which is sprinkled with red pepper powder for a spicy kick and served in an earthenware bowl.
name: Baengnyeonok

desc_l10n.en: Listen to a solo musical performance played on a gayageum (Korean zither) while you enjoy dishes like gondre sotbap (rice steamed with a rare mountain vegetable in a traditional cast-iron cauldron), jellied acorn salad, and soup with pulled dough morsels topped with powdered perilla. One unique item at Jangsarang is the black bean makgeolli (thick rice wine).
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国料理店。カヤグム(韓国琴)の演奏を聞きながらゴンドゥレソッパブ(キク科アザミ属の江原道の高地に自生する山菜入りの釜飯)やトゥルケスジェビ(エゴマスープのすいとん)などを味わうことができる店だ。ゴンドゥレソッパブは注文を受けてからご飯を炊くので出来上がるのに多少時間が掛かる。黒豆のマッコリ(にごり
desc_l10n.ko: 가야금 산조를 들으면서 곤드레 솥밥, 묵사발, 들깨 수제비 등을 맛볼 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以一边聆听伽倻琴散调，一边享用韩国石锅拌饭、辛奇（kimchi）和面疙瘩等。但必须注意的是，韩国石锅拌饭是在顾客点餐后才开始烹饪，因此会较花费时间。黑豆小米酒亦为此店独家的特色酒品。

description: Listen to a solo musical performance played on a gayageum (Korean zither) while you enjoy dishes like gondre sotbap (rice steamed with a rare mountain vegetable in a traditional cast-iron cauldron), jellied acorn salad, and soup with pulled dough morsels topped with powdered perilla. One unique item at Jangsarang is the black bean makgeolli (thick rice wine).
name: Jangsarang

desc_l10n.en: Akasaka is one of the leading Japanese restaurants in downtown Seoul. There is a separate teppanyaki bar and sushi bar, and they have a reputation for their extensive selection of sake. They have a great view of the pool at the Hyatt Hotel and of the Hangang (River).
desc_l10n.ja: ソウル市内で屈指の日本料理店のうちの一つ。鉄板焼きバーと寿司バーが別々に設けられている。日本酒の種類が豊富なことでも有名だ。ハンガン(漢江)の眺めを楽しみながら食事ができる。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울 시내에서 손꼽히는 일식집 중의 하나.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为首尔市内首屈一指的日式料理店之一。店内另设有铁板烧吧台和寿司吧台。因清酒的种类众多而相当有名。店内的视野极佳，可以眺望到Hyatt饭店的游泳池和汉江景致。

description: Akasaka is one of the leading Japanese restaurants in downtown Seoul. There is a separate teppanyaki bar and sushi bar, and they have a reputation for their extensive selection of sake. They have a great view of the pool at the Hyatt Hotel and of the Hangang (River).
name: Akasaka

desc_l10n.en: At Baegam Sundae, you can try Pyeongando-style sundae, a Korean blood sausage made with dried cellophane noodles. Instead of the North Korean recipe which includes coagulated ox blood, these sausages are made from a mixture of tofu, ferns, and more than 30 different vegetables in a natural casing.
desc_l10n.ja: ピョンアンド(平安道)式のスンデ(豚の腸詰)が味わえるお店。北方でスンデを作る時によく使うソンジ(固めた牛の血)の代わりに豆腐やワラビなど、30種類の野菜を入れる。一匹の豚に一皿分しかないマクチャン(ギャラ)を使ったワンスンデ、小腸を使ったトジョンスンデは牛もつを使っているので皮が薄くて細い。スンデの盛り合わせは酒のつまみに最適だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 평안도식 순대를 맛볼 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店可以品尝到平安道风味韩式米肠。北部地区制作韩式米肠的时候不用猪血，而是放入粉条、豆腐、蕨菜等30余种蔬菜。我们有大肠制作的大米肠，也有用小肠制作的皮薄纤细的本地韩式米肠。大米肠加上猪头肉混合而成的什锦米肠是非常不错的下酒菜。

description: At Baegam Sundae, you can try Pyeongando-style sundae, a Korean blood sausage made with dried cellophane noodles. Instead of the North Korean recipe which includes coagulated ox blood, these sausages are made from a mixture of tofu, ferns, and more than 30 different vegetables in a natural casing.
name: Baegam Wang Sundae

desc_l10n.en: At Maple Tree House, you can enjoy grilled pork or beef in a Western-style atmosphere. The interior is luxuriously decorated with trees.
desc_l10n.ja: ワインバーの様な雰囲気の中で味わえる焼き肉店。多くの木々を使ったインテリアは高級感を感じさせます。チョンギョブという代表メニューは豚の首筋の肉で、炭火で焼いた肉をエゴマの葉の漬物に包んで食べる味は格別。サムチョンドン(三清洞)にあるタンプンナムチブのイテウォン(梨泰院)店。
desc_l10n.ko: 와인바 같은 분위기에서 돼지고기나 소고기를 구워 먹을 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 顾客可以在宛如葡萄酒吧的氛围中享用烤猪肉或烤牛肉，布满树木的室内装潢，令人感觉相当高级。招牌料理〝天夹(Cheongyeop)〞指的便是猪颈肉。将肉品置于火力十足的顶极炭火上烧烤后，以芝麻叶包裹享用风味绝佳。

description: At Maple Tree House, you can enjoy grilled pork or beef in a Western-style atmosphere. The interior is luxuriously decorated with trees.
name: Maple Tree House Itaewon Branch

name_l10n.ja: タンプンナムチブ(Maple Tree House) 梨泰院店
name_l10n.zh: 枫树家(梨泰院分店)(Maple Tree House(Itaewon branch))

desc_l10n.en: This French cuisine restaurant is set in a traditional Korean house. It is located in the backyard of Gallery Hyundai, so you can soak in the culture afterward. Especially popular at Dogahun is the steak.
desc_l10n.ja: 古風な韓国の伝統家屋で本格的なフランス料理が楽しめるレストラン。現代ギャラリーの裏庭に位置しており、美術作品も鑑賞できる。ステーキが特に有名だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 고풍스러운 한옥에서 정통 프랑스 요리를 즐길 수 있는 레스토랑.
desc_l10n.zh: 可以在古香古色的韩屋中享用正统法国料理。本店位于现代画廊的后院，在用餐之余还可以欣赏美术作品。在诸多菜品中，以牛排最富盛名。

description: This French cuisine restaurant is set in a traditional Korean house. It is located in the backyard of Gallery Hyundai, so you can soak in the culture afterward. Especially popular at Dogahun is the steak.
name: Dugahun

desc_l10n.en: One of the top 5 bakeries in Korea and one of the top 3 bakeries in Seoul. It was founded in 1968 in Seongbuk-gu, Seoul, and has been in the family for two generations. It is a long-established bakery that has influenced the Korean baking industry, with many people learning the art of baking here. Napoleon Confectionery, which first opened in Samsungyo, Dongsoomun-dong, Seongbuk-gu, Seoul, reopened in 2007 at the entrance to Seongbuk-dong after moving its location 100 meters due to the reconstruction of Seongbukcheon River, and operates as a bakery-cafe consisting of a bakery on the first floor and a cafe on the second floor. This place has been selected as a 'Seoul Future Heritage'. Among Seoul's modern and contemporary cultural heritage, Seoul Future Heritage is a tangible and intangible asset that is worth passing on to future generations.(https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr)
desc_l10n.ja: 全国5大パン屋であり、ソウル3大パン屋。1968年にソウル城北区で開業し、2代目の家業を受け継いでいる菓子店です。多くの人がここで製菓技術を学び、韓国製菓業界に多くの影響を与えた伝統あるベーカリーです。ソウル城北区東小門洞サムソンソン(三線)通りに最初にオープンしたナポレオン菓子店は、2007年に城北川(ソンブクチョン:성북천)の堤防工事により本店の位置を100m移動し、城北洞(ソンブクドン:성북동)入口にリニューアルオープンし、1階は菓子店、2階はカフェで構成されたベーカリーカフェとして運営しています。 - ここは「ソウル未来遺産」に選定された場所です。ソウルの近・現代文化遺産の中で、未来世代に伝える価値のある有形・無形の資産であるソウル未来遺産を永続的な旅行でご覧ください( https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr)
desc_l10n.ko: 신안 천일염과 잣으로 유럽식 빵을 만드는 가게
desc_l10n.zh: 韩国五大面包店之一，首尔前三大面包店。它于1968年在首尔城北区成立，已经在家族中传承了两代。它是一家历史悠久的面包店，影响了韩国的烘焙业，许多人在这里学习烘焙艺术。拿破仑糖果店最初在首尔城北区东苏门洞三生桥开业，由于城北川的重建，从原址迁出100米后，于2007年在城北洞入口处重新开业，以面包店-咖啡厅的形式经营，一楼是面包店，二楼是咖啡厅。 这里被选为"首尔未来遗产"。 在首尔近现代文化遗产中，可以在老圃旅行中了解一下首尔未来遗产，这是值得传给下一代的有形和无形资产（ https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr ）

description: One of the top 5 bakeries in Korea and one of the top 3 bakeries in Seoul. It was founded in 1968 in Seongbuk-gu, Seoul, and has been in the family for two generations. It is a long-established bakery that has influenced the Korean baking industry, with many people learning the art of baking here. Napoleon Confectionery, which first opened in Samsungyo, Dongsoomun-dong, Seongbuk-gu, Seoul, reopened in 2007 at the entrance to Seongbuk-dong after moving its location 100 meters due to the reconstruction of Seongbukcheon River, and operates as a bakery-cafe consisting of a bakery on the first floor and a cafe on the second floor. This place has been selected as a 'Seoul Future Heritage'. Among Seoul's modern and contemporary cultural heritage, Seoul Future Heritage is a tangible and intangible asset that is worth passing on to future generations.(https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr)
name: Napoleon Bakery

desc_l10n.en: From the Korean table d’hote, steamed beef ribs, and seasoned beef ribs, you can taste the best meat in the Republic of Korea. The cook uses yeast instead of artificial seasoning so that the taste of the food is refreshing and rich. When you place an order of table d’hote, you can also enjoy at least six different kinds of kimchi as well.
desc_l10n.ja: カルビの蒸し物や味付けカルビなど、最上質の肉料理が味わえるお店。調味料の代わりに発酵酵素を使って、深い味を引き出した料理だ。5、６品のキムチがつく定食コースも人気。
desc_l10n.ko: 시골 고향 같은 정겨움을 맛볼 수 있는 한정식과 갈비찜, 양념 갈비 등 최상의 고기.
desc_l10n.zh: 在这里可以品尝乡村味道浓郁的韩式套餐，也可以尝到各种美味的排骨。所有的料理不含调味料，而是添加发酵的酵素，这样保持了爽口的味道。如果选择丰富的定食菜肴，仅辛奇（kimchi）的种类就达五种之多。

description: From the Korean table d’hote, steamed beef ribs, and seasoned beef ribs, you can taste the best meat in the Republic of Korea. The cook uses yeast instead of artificial seasoning so that the taste of the food is refreshing and rich. When you place an order of table d’hote, you can also enjoy at least six different kinds of kimchi as well.
name: Songlimga

desc_l10n.en: At Seocho Galbi, you can enjoy chargrilled wanggalbi (king-sized short ribs) and fresh sirloin. Although the restaurant expanded into a Western-style 5-story building, but they've retained their original taste. Service is very good here.
desc_l10n.ja: 炭火で焼いたワンカルビ(カルビの焼肉)、センドゥンシム(生ロースの焼き肉)が味わえるところ。店内は5階建てで大型化したが、創業からの味を維持している。親切な接客もうれしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 숯불에 구운 왕갈비, 생등심 구이.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店可以品尝到碳烤大排骨、里脊。虽然扩建成了5层洋房，但是味道依旧没变。

description: At Seocho Galbi, you can enjoy chargrilled wanggalbi (king-sized short ribs) and fresh sirloin. Although the restaurant expanded into a Western-style 5-story building, but they've retained their original taste. Service is very good here.
name: Seocho Galbi

desc_l10n.en: This is a European-style bakery popular for its breads and dinner rolls. The fewest ingredients possible are used in order to leaven the bread slowly. You can sample breads before buying.
desc_l10n.ja: ヨーロピアンスタイルのパン屋で、食事にぴったりのあっさりして香ばしいパンを作っている。最小限の材料で長時間発酵させた健康パンだ。試食用のパンがあるので、味を見てから選べるのがポイント。
desc_l10n.ko: 유럽식 빵집으로 식사용으로 좋은 담백하고 고소한 빵.
desc_l10n.zh: 欧式面包房，主营清淡香酥的主食面包。尽量少地添加配料，且用长时间进行发酵，因此非常有益于健康。店内备有小块面包供顾客品尝，可以选择最合自己口味的面包来购买。

description: This is a European-style bakery popular for its breads and dinner rolls. The fewest ingredients possible are used in order to leaven the bread slowly. You can sample breads before buying.
name: Paul & Paulina

desc_l10n.en: This is the Dosan Park branch of Artise, a European café and bakery. Here you can enjoy European-style breads, simple salads and pasta dishes. Sandwiches made on Italian panini, ciabatta, and French baguette are also available.
desc_l10n.ja: ヨーロッパ風のカフェベーカリーアティジェのサムスンタウン店。ヨーロピアンスタイルのパンや簡単なサラダ、パスタを楽しむことができる。イタリアのパニーニやチャバタサンドイッチなどもある。
desc_l10n.ko: 유럽형 카페 베이커리 아티제의 도산공원 분점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为欧式咖啡烘焙坊Artise在岛山公园的分店。在此可以品尝到欧风面包，以及简单的色拉和意大利面。另有意式三明治、拖鞋面包三明治和法国面包三明治等餐点。

description: This is the Dosan Park branch of Artise, a European café and bakery. Here you can enjoy European-style breads, simple salads and pasta dishes. Sandwiches made on Italian panini, ciabatta, and French baguette are also available.
name: Artise

name_l10n.ja: Artise サムスンタウン店

desc_l10n.en: Tumbler Beer is a western-style pub where you can enjoy beer and snacks like nachos. The crowd here is predominantly young because the draft beer is all-you-can-drink between 5 p.m. and 8 p.m. (Fridays and weekends excluded).
desc_l10n.ja: ヨーロッパのパブのような雰囲気でビールとナチョスなどのおつまみを楽しめるところ。午後5時から8時までは生ビール飲み放題も行っており、若者に人気だ。 (ただし、金･土･日は飲み放題なし)
desc_l10n.ko: 유럽식 펍 같은 분위기. 오후 5시에서 8시까지는 생맥주 무한리필 행사. (단, 금, 토, 일 제외)
desc_l10n.zh: 顾客可以在宛如欧风酒吧的气氛中享用啤酒，以及玉米片等下酒菜。下午5点至8点另有举行生啤酒无限畅饮的活动，因此相当受到年轻人的喜爱(星期五、六、日除外)。

description: Tumbler Beer is a western-style pub where you can enjoy beer and snacks like nachos. The crowd here is predominantly young because the draft beer is all-you-can-drink between 5 p.m. and 8 p.m. (Fridays and weekends excluded).
name: Tumbler Beer

desc_l10n.en: Jubilee Chocolatier is a homemade chocolate shop. You can enjoy chocolates, cakes, and espresso. Chocolate beverages also go nicely with the chocolates and cakes. They will make your chocolate beverage as rich as you'd like.
desc_l10n.ja: 手作りチョコレートの専門店。チョコレートの他、ケーキ、またエスプレッソなどのドリンク類を楽しむことができる。チョコレートドリンクの濃度は好みに合わせて選択することができるようになっている。
desc_l10n.ko: 수제 초콜릿 전문점. 초콜릿과 케이크 와 에스프레소. 초콜릿 음료와함께. 초콜릿 음료의 농도는 취향에 따라 선택.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为手工巧克力专卖店，在此可以享用到巧克力、蛋糕和意式浓缩咖啡。搭配巧克力饮品也相当不错，且可以依自己的喜好选择巧克力饮品的浓度。

description: Jubilee Chocolatier is a homemade chocolate shop. You can enjoy chocolates, cakes, and espresso. Chocolate beverages also go nicely with the chocolates and cakes. They will make your chocolate beverage as rich as you'd like.
name: Jubilee Chocolatier

desc_l10n.en: For a long time, this Apgujeong-area restaurant has been serving up robatayaki (Japanese-style grilled dishes). Grilled delicacies, like chicken wings and gaibashira (shellfish adductor muscle), make good accompaniments for drinks. Another popular dish is yaki onigiri (grilled rice balls).
desc_l10n.ja: アプクジョンドン(狎鴎亭洞)で長い間営業している炉端焼きの店。鳥手羽や貝柱などの串焼きと一緒にお酒を楽しむのにぴったりのところだ。焼きおにぎりもこの店の人気メニュー。
desc_l10n.ko: 압구정동에서 오랫동안 자리를 지키는 로바다야키.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为在狎鸥亭一直占有一席之地的炉端烧店。鸡翅和贝柱等串烧，相当适合搭配酒品一起享用，烤三角饭团也是店内的人气料理。

description: For a long time, this Apgujeong-area restaurant has been serving up robatayaki (Japanese-style grilled dishes). Grilled delicacies, like chicken wings and gaibashira (shellfish adductor muscle), make good accompaniments for drinks. Another popular dish is yaki onigiri (grilled rice balls).
name: Gilson

desc_l10n.en: Yeolhae is a small Japanese restaurant where you can enjoy authentic sashimi. Unlike many other sashimi restaurants, they use fresh fish rather than live fish. A unique thing about this restaurant is its graceful and rustic Japanese-style atmosphere.
desc_l10n.ja: 刺身がおいしいこじんまりとした日本料理店。 韓国の一般的な刺身のお店とは違い、鮮魚を使っている。素朴な雰囲気でどこか懐かしくなるところだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 정통 사시미를 맛볼 수 있는 아담한 일식집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为可以品尝到正宗生鱼片的淡雅日式料理店。和一般生鱼片店不同的地方在于，此店不使用活鱼，而是使用冷藏鲜鱼。优雅简朴的日式氛围为此店的特色。

description: Yeolhae is a small Japanese restaurant where you can enjoy authentic sashimi. Unlike many other sashimi restaurants, they use fresh fish rather than live fish. A unique thing about this restaurant is its graceful and rustic Japanese-style atmosphere.
name: Yeolhae

desc_l10n.en: Jaha Sonmandu is well-known as a handmade mandu (Korean dumpling) house offering somandu, mandu stuffed with walnuts and pine nuts; and pyeonsu, mandu stuffed with mushrooms. When you order the manduguk (dumpling soup), you'll notice it contains rainbow mandu, with pink, yellow, and blue stripes. The most popular items on the menu are ddeokmanduguk (sliced rice cake and dumpling soup), which is made with fresh tricolor mandu, and their mandu jeongol (dumpling hot pot).
desc_l10n.ja: 主に蒸して食べる餃子を出すお店で、くるみと松の実を入れて作ったソマンドゥ、きのこなどを入れたピョンスが味わえる。餃子入りスープを注文するとピンクと黄色、緑の色の付いた餃子を入れてくれる。淡泊な味の三色マンドゥで作った餃子と韓国餅入りスープや餃子の寄せ鍋などが人気メニューだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 손만두 집이라고도 불리는 호두와 잣을 넣어 빚은 소만두, 버섯을 넣은 편수
desc_l10n.zh: 也有人称此店为手工饺子店，在此可以品尝到加入核桃和松子揉制而成的面皮，以及添加香菇的四角形饺子。若是点用汤饺，则可以享用到粉红色、黄色和绿色的彩色饺子。人气商品为使用口味清爽的三色饺子烹煮而成的年糕饺子汤和饺子锅。

description: Jaha Sonmandu is well-known as a handmade mandu (Korean dumpling) house offering somandu, mandu stuffed with walnuts and pine nuts; and pyeonsu, mandu stuffed with mushrooms. When you order the manduguk (dumpling soup), you'll notice it contains rainbow mandu, with pink, yellow, and blue stripes. The most popular items on the menu are ddeokmanduguk (sliced rice cake and dumpling soup), which is made with fresh tricolor mandu, and their mandu jeongol (dumpling hot pot).
name: Jaha Sonmandu

name_l10n.ja: ジャハ・ソンマンドゥ

desc_l10n.en: To make the broth for their sundubu jjigae (soft tofu stew), Gamchon boils beef leg bones for 24 hours, yielding a broth that is thicker than you'll usually find in sundubu jjigae. Their loyal clientelle is made up of many foreign customers as well aslocal office workers.
desc_l10n.ja: スンドゥブチゲ(おぼろ豆腐のピリ辛鍋)のお店。24時間じっくり煮込んだ牛骨スープを使っているため、他のスンドゥブの店に比べて、スープにとろみがあり濃厚なのが特徴だ。近隣の会社員たちだけではなく外国人も多く訪れている。
desc_l10n.ko: 24시간 푹 고아 끓여낸 사골국물을육수로 사용하여, 다른 순두부찌개에 비해 국물이 걸쭉하고 힘이 있는 것이 특징. 인근 직장인들 뿐 아니라 외국인 단골이 굉장히 많은 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 店家使用经过24小时熬煮的大骨高汤作为汤头，因此这里的豆腐锅汤头比起其他店家质地更浓稠、味道更浓厚。不仅是附近上的班族经常造访，此店也拥有许多外国常客。

description: To make the broth for their sundubu jjigae (soft tofu stew), Gamchon boils beef leg bones for 24 hours, yielding a broth that is thicker than you'll usually find in sundubu jjigae. Their loyal clientelle is made up of many foreign customers as well aslocal office workers.
name: Gamchon

desc_l10n.en: Sabal specializes in noodles, but the interior is like that of a café. Here, traditional noodle dishes are transformed into fusion creations. Popular dishes are noodles in chicken broth topped with chicken, and hwangtae bibimguksu (spicy mixed noodles topped with winter-dried pollack). The bowls and plates are very attractive, as well.
desc_l10n.ja: カフェのようなインテリアの麺専門店。伝統麺料理を現代的にアレンジさせたフュージョンスタイルだ。代表メニューは鶏ガラスープヌードルに鶏肉をのせたタッククスと干しスケトウダラをのせたスープなしのピリ辛麺のファンテビビムグクス。
desc_l10n.ko: 카페 같은 인테리어의 국수 전문점. 전통 국수를 현대적으로 변형시킨 퓨전 스타일.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为室内装潢彷佛咖啡厅的面条专卖店，店家提供将正宗面条付予现代感的无国界面条。招牌料理为在鸡高汤中添加鸡肉的鸡汤面，以及放上干明太鱼的干明太鱼拌面。店内所使用的餐具也相当精致利落。

description: Sabal specializes in noodles, but the interior is like that of a café. Here, traditional noodle dishes are transformed into fusion creations. Popular dishes are noodles in chicken broth topped with chicken, and hwangtae bibimguksu (spicy mixed noodles topped with winter-dried pollack). The bowls and plates are very attractive, as well.
name: Sabal

desc_l10n.en: At Son Kalguksu, you can enjoy humble homemade kalguksu (knife-cut noodle soup). The kalguksu is served in a rich beef broth, and jeon, a Korean-style pancake, is included with your order as a plus. Dinner service ends at 6 p.m, so you should call ahead to find out whether they can accommodate you.
desc_l10n.ja: 家庭で食べるようなきしめんが味わえるところ。牛骨スープをベースにしたきしめんにチョン(チヂミ：卵・小麦粉を付けて焼いたもの)もおすすめだ。18時以降は閉店するので要注意。
desc_l10n.ko: 허름한 가정집 방안에 앉아 집에서 만든 듯한 칼국수를 맛보는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 顾客可在古老的家宅中，品尝到具家常口味的刀切面。以牛大骨汤为基底刀切面，若是搭配煎饼一起享用风味更佳。晚上6点后不营业，因此来访前最好先向店家确认。

description: At Son Kalguksu, you can enjoy humble homemade kalguksu (knife-cut noodle soup). The kalguksu is served in a rich beef broth, and jeon, a Korean-style pancake, is included with your order as a plus. Dinner service ends at 6 p.m, so you should call ahead to find out whether they can accommodate you.
name: Son Kalguksu

desc_l10n.en: The popular item to order at Daeryeonjip is kalguksu, handmade knife-cut noodles in a broth made from beef leg bones; but they also offer a variety of other Korean dishes, such as bossam (boiled pork eaten with a salty sauce and wrapped in greens), steamedskate, and pajeon (savory green onion pancakes). The restaurant is popular with both Koreans and foreigners. After you've had some drinks and eaten some side dishes, kalguksu is a nice way to end your meal.
desc_l10n.ja: 牛骨からしっかり出汁をとったカルグクス(韓国式うどん)がメインメニューだがポッサム(ゆで豚肉の葉野菜包み)やパジョン(ねぎのチヂミ)などの様々な韓国料理もある。韓国人また外国人ともに人気が高いところだ。酒とおつまみを楽しんだ後、カルグクスで締めるのが定番のコース。
desc_l10n.ko: 사골로 우려낸 진한 칼국수가 주메뉴이지만 보쌈, 홍어찜, 파전 등 다양한 한식 . 내국인, 외국인 모두에게 인기.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店虽然主要提供拥有浓郁大骨汤头的刀切面，但亦备有辛奇（kimchi）包猪肉、蒸魟鱼和煎饼等各式韩式料理，无论市韩国人或是外国人皆相当喜爱此店。享用完酒品和各式下酒菜后，最后以清爽的刀切面作为结尾的组合是最完美的。

description: The popular item to order at Daeryeonjip is kalguksu, handmade knife-cut noodles in a broth made from beef leg bones; but they also offer a variety of other Korean dishes, such as bossam (boiled pork eaten with a salty sauce and wrapped in greens), steamedskate, and pajeon (savory green onion pancakes). The restaurant is popular with both Koreans and foreigners. After you've had some drinks and eaten some side dishes, kalguksu is a nice way to end your meal.
name: Daeryeonjip

desc_l10n.en: With a long tradition of over 30 years, Myeonghwadang is legendary for their gimbap (Korean rolls). They also make a fantastic tteokbokki (spicy stir-fried rice cakes) and bibim jjolmyeon (cold wheat noodles served with vegetables in a spicy sauce). Inthe early days their menu was limited to just tteokbokki and gimbap, but they have since added a variety of other dishes, such as mandu (Korean dumplings) and udon noodles. Prices are reasonable.
desc_l10n.ja: 30年以上の長い歴史を誇る伝説的なキムバプ(海苔巻き)のお店。キムバプの他にもトッポッキ(餅のピリ辛炒め)がおいしい。マンドゥ(餃子)やうどんなどのメニューもある。価格は手頃だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 30년이 넘는 오랜 전통을 자랑하는 전설적인 김밥집. 떡볶이와 비빔쫄면.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为传说中的海苔饭卷店，店家以拥有超过30年的传统而感到自豪。除海苔饭卷外，辣炒年糕和弹面口味也相当梦幻。不同于主要销售辣炒年糕和海苔饭卷的早创期，现在已新增许多菜单，如饺子和乌龙面等。价格亦相当令人满意。

description: With a long tradition of over 30 years, Myeonghwadang is legendary for their gimbap (Korean rolls). They also make a fantastic tteokbokki (spicy stir-fried rice cakes) and bibim jjolmyeon (cold wheat noodles served with vegetables in a spicy sauce). Inthe early days their menu was limited to just tteokbokki and gimbap, but they have since added a variety of other dishes, such as mandu (Korean dumplings) and udon noodles. Prices are reasonable.
name: Myeonghwadang

desc_l10n.en: Cheombeong Agujjim is very famous for its soft and chewy agujjim, a spicy dish made from monkfish and bean sprouts. Another specialty here is the rice balls topped with crumbled seaweed, which goes very nicely with the spicy agujjim. There are also quitea lot of people who come for the ganjang gejang (crab marinated in soy sauce).
desc_l10n.ja: モヤシがたっぷり入ったぷりぷりとしたアグチム(ピリ辛アンコウの煮物)の専門店。小さく刻んだ海苔を丸いおにぎりにふったモンナンイジュモクパブ(不細工おにぎり)も名物だ。カンジャンケジャン(カニの醤油漬け)を目当てにくる人も多い
desc_l10n.ko: 콩나물이 듬뿍 들어간 쫄깃한 아귀찜.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的招牌料理为添加大量黄豆芽，且口感弹牙的蒸安康鱼。将米饭揉成圆状后，沾上碎海苔片的〝丑八怪饭团〞也相当有名，适合搭配香辣的蒸安康鱼一起享用。也有许多顾客是来此一尝口味清爽的酱油腌螃蟹。

description: Cheombeong Agujjim is very famous for its soft and chewy agujjim, a spicy dish made from monkfish and bean sprouts. Another specialty here is the rice balls topped with crumbled seaweed, which goes very nicely with the spicy agujjim. There are also quitea lot of people who come for the ganjang gejang (crab marinated in soy sauce).
name: Cheombeong Agujjim

name_l10n.ja: チョムボン・アグチム

desc_l10n.en: This is a take-out coffee shop famed for its great coffee beans. Standing Coffee’s ‘blue lemonade,’ made with blue curacao syrup, is a popular drink with customers during the summer.
desc_l10n.ja: テイクアウトコーヒー専門店。良い豆を使うのがコーヒー味の秘訣。夏にはブルーキュラソーシロップを入れてエメラルド色を出すレモネードが断然人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 테이크아웃 커피전문점. 좋은 원두를 쓰는 것이 커피 맛의 비법.
desc_l10n.zh: 外带咖啡专营店。使用优质的咖啡豆，保障了咖啡的美味。在夏季，用蓝橙糖浆调配出来的炫蓝色的柠檬苏打汽水最具人气。

description: This is a take-out coffee shop famed for its great coffee beans. Standing Coffee’s ‘blue lemonade,’ made with blue curacao syrup, is a popular drink with customers during the summer.
name: Standing Coffee

desc_l10n.en: Daemun table d’hote consists of delicious Mung bean jelly cake mixed with beef and vegetables, sweet vegetable salads with fruit sauce, five colors of pan-fried flour dough with duck and cold jellyfish salad with mustard dressing. Tasty side dishes such as bulgogi and outer leaf of cabbage mixed with soybean paste with rice in hot stone pot and soybean paste stew come right after the main course.
desc_l10n.ja: そば、緑豆、どんぐりなどの澱粉を煮て固めた緑豆ムクを細長く切り、春の野菜と肉を加えて酢醤油味で調理したところてんの和え物やサラダ、鴨の5色チヂミ、クラゲの冷菜などが味わえるテムン(大門)コースが人気。最後に出る郷土風の和え物やテンジャンチゲ(味噌汁)と釜飯も美味だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 정갈하고 맛있는 음식이 가득한 쾌적한 한정식집.
desc_l10n.zh: 香喷喷的荡平菜上拌有水果调味汁，像蔬菜沙拉一样爽口。这里还提供使用天然色素的鲜花五色煎饼和凉拌海蜇。吃完主菜后还有烤牛肉、大酱鱼干等小菜，顾客可以与大酱汤和石锅饭一起享用。

description: Daemun table d’hote consists of delicious Mung bean jelly cake mixed with beef and vegetables, sweet vegetable salads with fruit sauce, five colors of pan-fried flour dough with duck and cold jellyfish salad with mustard dressing. Tasty side dishes such as bulgogi and outer leaf of cabbage mixed with soybean paste with rice in hot stone pot and soybean paste stew come right after the main course.
name: Daemun

desc_l10n.en: Located inside 63City, Walking On The Cloud provides fine European dining. It offers a superb view of the Hangang (River), and Seoul.
desc_l10n.ja: ソウルで一番高いところにあるレストラン。63シティ内にあるヨーロピアンスタイルレストランで、食事とアラカルトが味わえる。おいしい料理と共に、ハンガン(漢江)と広がるソウルの風景が観賞できる。
desc_l10n.ko: 63빌딩 내에 자리한 유럽식 레스토랑으로 정찬 및 일품요리
desc_l10n.zh: 位于63大厦内，首尔海拔最高的餐厅。本店经营欧式西餐，提供全餐和各种单品。一边俯瞰首尔的汉江美景，一边享用美食，美妙的感觉不可言喻。。

description: Located inside 63City, Walking On The Cloud provides fine European dining. It offers a superb view of the Hangang (River), and Seoul.
name: Walking On The Cloud

desc_l10n.en: This is the Yangjae-dong branch of Pyeonggaok, a restaurant in Bundang specializing in North Korean cuisine. Two of the most popular items are the eobok jaengban (pressed beef served on a brass plate) and the Pyeongyang naengmyeon (cold buckwheat noodles served either in a tangy iced broth or mixed with spicy red chili sauce). The naengmyeon here is decadent: it's topped with slices of beef, pork, chicken, and pheasant meatballs, and the rich broth is made from beef and pheasant. The Pyeongyang-style dumplings and mung bean pancakes are also quite popular.
desc_l10n.ja: 北朝鮮料理の専門店。平安道(ピョンアンド)の郷土料理であるオボクチェンバン(牛肉、野菜などの寄せ鍋)と平壌(ピョンヤン)式ネンミョン(冷麺)が人気メニューだ。ネンミョンには牛肉、豚肉、鶏肉、キジ肉団子が入っていて豪華。牛肉とキジ肉でとった出し汁はコクがある。平壌式のマンドゥ(餃子)もおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 이북 음식 전문점인 분당 평가옥의 양재동 분점. 어복쟁반, 평양냉면이 인기 메뉴.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为朝鲜料理专卖店盆唐平家屋在蚕室洞的分店，人气料理为朝鲜风味什锦面和平壤冷面。冷面的扮相十分华丽，店家会将牛肉、猪肉、鸡肉和雉鸡肉丸摆放于面上，以牛肉和雉鸡肉熬制而成的高汤也相当美味。平壤饺子和绿豆煎饼亦非常受到欢迎。

description: This is the Yangjae-dong branch of Pyeonggaok, a restaurant in Bundang specializing in North Korean cuisine. Two of the most popular items are the eobok jaengban (pressed beef served on a brass plate) and the Pyeongyang naengmyeon (cold buckwheat noodles served either in a tangy iced broth or mixed with spicy red chili sauce). The naengmyeon here is decadent: it's topped with slices of beef, pork, chicken, and pheasant meatballs, and the rich broth is made from beef and pheasant. The Pyeongyang-style dumplings and mung bean pancakes are also quite popular.
name: Pyeonggaok(Yangjae Branch)

desc_l10n.en: The noodles from Gangseomyeonok are famous in part because they were served to representatives of North Korea at the time of the South Korea-North Korea Red Cross Conference. This restaurant has successfully carried on the tradition of Pyeongyang noodles for over 50 years. Domestic buckwheat from Gangwon-do Province is mixed with starch to make the delicious noodles, and the broth is made from beef brisket and white radish kimchi for a light and refreshing savory flavor.
desc_l10n.ja: 南北赤十字会談当時、北側の代表に提供された冷麺として有名なところ。カンウォンド(江原道)の蕎麦と澱粉を混ぜて作られた麺と牛の胸肉をじっくりと煮込んだスープにトンチミ(大根の水キムチ)が入っており、さっぱりと澄んだ味わいを楽しめる。
desc_l10n.ko: 남북 적십자 회담 당시 북측 대표들에게 제공된 냉면으로 유명. 50년 동안 평양냉면의 전통계승.
desc_l10n.zh: 这里保持着平壤冷面的传统做法，用江原道的荞麦和淀粉来和面，做出香飘飘的面粉，优质的牛胸肉汤和萝卜辛奇（kimchi）一起制成的肉汤是一流的。

description: The noodles from Gangseomyeonok are famous in part because they were served to representatives of North Korea at the time of the South Korea-North Korea Red Cross Conference. This restaurant has successfully carried on the tradition of Pyeongyang noodles for over 50 years. Domestic buckwheat from Gangwon-do Province is mixed with starch to make the delicious noodles, and the broth is made from beef brisket and white radish kimchi for a light and refreshing savory flavor.
name: Gangseomyeonok

desc_l10n.en: Joseonok makes their sogalbi (beef short ribs) in the traditional way, marinating the meat for a full day in a sauce of aged soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and sugar, and then grilling it over charcoals. This sweet marinade is not too strong, allowing the original flavor of the meat to come through. The restaurant opened before the Korean War and was one of the top three restaurants in the Euljiro area, even up till the mid-1970s.
desc_l10n.ja: 牛カルビを濃い醤油、ゴマ油、ニンニク、砂糖などで味つけしたタレで一日熟成させ、それを炭火で焼くという昔ながらの方式を採用している焼肉店。甘いタレが昔ながらのカルビの味を思い出させてくれる。朝鮮戦争前から営業を開始し、1970年代中盤まで中華料理店のアンドンジャン(安東荘)、ソルロンタン店のイナムジャンとともにウルチロ(乙支路)の3大食堂と呼ばれる伝統の焼肉屋だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 소갈비를 진간장, 참기름, 마늘, 설탕 등으로 맛을 낸 양념장에 하루 동안 재웠다가 연탄불에 굽는 옛날식 갈비구이.
desc_l10n.zh: 在朝鲜战争之前开业的朝鲜屋为复古风的烤排骨专卖店，先将肉放至用浓酱油、麻油、大蒜、砂糖等调配而成的酱料中腌渍1天后，再放在炭火上烤，清爽不油腻的偏甜酱料令人回想起以前烤排骨的味道。

description: Joseonok makes their sogalbi (beef short ribs) in the traditional way, marinating the meat for a full day in a sauce of aged soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and sugar, and then grilling it over charcoals. This sweet marinade is not too strong, allowing the original flavor of the meat to come through. The restaurant opened before the Korean War and was one of the top three restaurants in the Euljiro area, even up till the mid-1970s.
name: Joseonok

desc_l10n.en: Hwangsojip has been specializing in doganitang (ox knee soup) for 40 years. They simmer it for a long time in a Korean cast-iron cauldron, and it is so popular that there are usually lines to be seated. For dinner, many people have dogani jjim, braised ox-knee served on the stone plate, along with some soju. The stone plate is heated over charcoal, so the food stays hot throughout the entire meal.
desc_l10n.ja: 40年以上の伝統を誇るトガニタン(牛肉や膝を煮込んだスープ)の専門店。いつも行列ができるほどの人気だ。夕食時には石鍋に盛られて出されるトガニチム(牛肉の膝の煮物)と焼酎を楽しむ人が多い。
desc_l10n.ko: 40여 년 전통의 도가니탕 전문점. 무쇠솥에 끓인 도가니탕을 먹기 위해서는 줄을 서야 할 정도. 저녁 때는 돌판에 나오는 도가니찜에 소주를 곁들임. 돌판 밑 숯불이 온도유지.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为拥有40多年传统的牛膝汤专卖店，若想一尝在铁锅中沸腾的牛膝汤，则经长必须排队等候。晚上有许多人会来此品尝盛装于石锅中的蒸牛膝，再搭配一杯烧酒，且石锅底下的炭火会一直燃烧至用餐完毕为止，因此到最后都能享用到热腾腾的牛膝。

description: Hwangsojip has been specializing in doganitang (ox knee soup) for 40 years. They simmer it for a long time in a Korean cast-iron cauldron, and it is so popular that there are usually lines to be seated. For dinner, many people have dogani jjim, braised ox-knee served on the stone plate, along with some soju. The stone plate is heated over charcoal, so the food stays hot throughout the entire meal.
name: Hwangsojip

desc_l10n.en: Neulpureun Mokjang specializes in boneless ribs and only offers two things on their menu: boneless ribs and yukhoe (sliced raw beef seasoned with various spices and sauces). The boneless ribs are lightly marinated and grilled over oak charcoals. It'sbusy enough that you'll likely have to wait in line to be seated. Prices are reasonable.
desc_l10n.ja: メニューがカルビの焼肉とユッケの二種類だけの人気店。 味付けカルビを炭火で焼いて食べる味は絶品だ。価格満足度も高い。行列ができるほどの人気があるところだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 갈빗살을 전문으로 하는 곳. 메뉴는 갈비살과 육회.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店专门提供去骨牛小排，店内仅提供去骨牛小排和生牛肉2种料理。使用顶级炭火烧烤略为腌渍过的去骨牛小排，美味不在话下，价格亦相当令人满意，因此顾客多到经常必须排队等待。

description: Neulpureun Mokjang specializes in boneless ribs and only offers two things on their menu: boneless ribs and yukhoe (sliced raw beef seasoned with various spices and sauces). The boneless ribs are lightly marinated and grilled over oak charcoals. It'sbusy enough that you'll likely have to wait in line to be seated. Prices are reasonable.
name: Neulpureun Mokjang

name_l10n.ja: ヌル・プルン・モッチャン

desc_l10n.en: Florian specializes in fresh coffee beans. On the board, they write which coffee was roasted that day, so you can enjoy fresh coffee made with freshly-roasted coffee beans. There is a bit of a wait after you order your coffee because it is made to order and the beans are ground just before brewing. The toast set meal that includes thickly-sliced toast is also recommended. The owner's attention to detail is evident in the charmingly-decorated atmosphere and the high-quality coffee cups they use.
desc_l10n.ja: コーヒーショップ。その日煎った香り高いコーヒーを味わうことができる。分厚めの食パンが出てくるトーストセットもおすすめだ。コーヒーカップなどの食器類も高級品が使われていて、店主の繊細さが感じられる。
desc_l10n.ko: 원두커피 전문점. 그 날 볶은 커피는 따로 칠판에 적어 놓기 때문에 신선한 원두를 맛볼 수 있음. 커피를 시키면 즉석에서 원두를 갈아서 내리기 때문에 조금 기다려야 함.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为原豆咖啡专卖店。店家会将当日烘焙的咖啡另外抄在黑板上，因此顾客可以品尝到最新鲜的原豆咖啡。点好咖啡后，店家便会立刻研磨原豆并且萃取咖啡液，因此必须稍加等待。推荐餐点为使用厚实面包制作而成的吐司套餐。店内环境十分生动活泼，咖啡杯等餐聚亦相当高级，由此可见老板的品味。

description: Florian specializes in fresh coffee beans. On the board, they write which coffee was roasted that day, so you can enjoy fresh coffee made with freshly-roasted coffee beans. There is a bit of a wait after you order your coffee because it is made to order and the beans are ground just before brewing. The toast set meal that includes thickly-sliced toast is also recommended. The owner's attention to detail is evident in the charmingly-decorated atmosphere and the high-quality coffee cups they use.
name: Florian

desc_l10n.en: The proprieter and cook of 40 years uses 100% domestic Korean beans to make her tofu (podubu and gundubu). Her dishes are healthy and served in beautiful dishes made by Lee Bong-ju, who was named a Korean intangible cultural asset.
desc_l10n.ja: 豆料理40年のノウハウを持つところ。100％韓国産の豆を使用し「包み豆腐」や「乾豆腐」などのヘルシー料理を提供している。重要無形文化財77号のイ･ボンジュ工房で作られた真鍮の器に盛られ目でも楽しめるお店だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 100% 국산콩을 사용. [포두부, 건두부]로 웰빙식탁. 방자유기그릇.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店40年来人气旺盛的秘诀在于100%使用国产豆类，推荐菜式为包豆腐、干豆腐等健康食品。盛菜的盘子是由重要无形文化遗产77号李凤柱制作的方字鍮器，这也传达了追求健康的理念。

description: The proprieter and cook of 40 years uses 100% domestic Korean beans to make her tofu (podubu and gundubu). Her dishes are healthy and served in beautiful dishes made by Lee Bong-ju, who was named a Korean intangible cultural asset.
name: Gomone Restaurant

name_l10n.ja: コモネ元祖コンタンブゴタン
name_l10n.zh: 姑母元祖豆汤蒸干明太鱼

desc_l10n.en: Gaon opened in April 2008, and their reputation for handmade mandu (dumplings) and gomguk (noodles in thick beef soup) has been growing ever since. This Korean restaurant is situated in front of the Han River, perfect for watching a lovely scenery unfold.
desc_l10n.ja: コムタンククス(牛テールを煮込んだスープの素麺)とマンドゥ(餃子)の専門店として2008年にオープン後、クチコミで広がってる韓国料理店。目の前に漢江(ハンガン)が広がり、美しい風景を眺めながら食事を楽しめる。
desc_l10n.ko: 가온은 곰국시, 손만두 전문점으로 2008년 4월 오픈한 이래 맛집으로 입소문이 자자. 식당 바로 앞에 자리한 한강의 아름다운 풍경이 펼쳐지는 한식 레스토랑.
desc_l10n.zh: 家温是专营牛肉汤面和手工饺子的美食店，从2008年4月开业以来，一直受到顾客的好评。餐厅正面对汉江，在就餐的同时也可以欣赏美丽的风景。

description: Gaon opened in April 2008, and their reputation for handmade mandu (dumplings) and gomguk (noodles in thick beef soup) has been growing ever since. This Korean restaurant is situated in front of the Han River, perfect for watching a lovely scenery unfold.
name: Gwangjang-dongGaon

desc_l10n.en: Come here to taste beef and pork that’s been personally procured by the owner and aged, along with slices of fresh apple and pear, with various ground vegetables and fruit. They serve galbi, pork ribs, pork belly, and galbitang (beef rib soup).
desc_l10n.ja: 厳選した豚肉に新鮮な梨やリンゴ、玉ネギなど様々な野菜や果物をすって味付けしたテジカルビ(味付け豚カルビの焼肉)が美味。その他、センオギョプサル(豚肉の焼肉)やカルビタン(カルビのスープ)なども味わえる。
desc_l10n.ko: 생고기를 양념에 숙성시켜 갈비의 맛을 살린 숯불갈비와 생오겹살, 갈비탕.
desc_l10n.zh: 老板亲自去采购新鲜的猪肉，并且只选用国内的新鲜食材。亲切的服务、卫生的环境加上老板夫妇热情的招待，成为本店的营业招牌，顾客络绎不绝。

description: Come here to taste beef and pork that’s been personally procured by the owner and aged, along with slices of fresh apple and pear, with various ground vegetables and fruit. They serve galbi, pork ribs, pork belly, and galbitang (beef rib soup).
name: Burimjeong Sutbulgalbi

name_l10n.ja: プリムジョン･スッブルカルビ

desc_l10n.en: Taste the highest quality meat at a low price at Geukrakdon, which has the best hygiene management system certification HACCP, which raises and slaughters directly with antibiotic-free feed and delivers directly
desc_l10n.ja: 無抗生物質飼料で直接育て、直接屠殺加工して配送する 最高の衛生管理システム認証HACCPを持つ極楽お金で最高品質の肉を低価格で味わう
desc_l10n.ko: 편백찜이 무료인 프리미엄 정육식당 극락돈
desc_l10n.zh: 草牛村是位于徽庆洞十字路口的著名烤牛肉店，本店最出名的要数五花里脊肉，在高档的氛围下，最适合家庭聚会或者同事聚餐，是东大门的代表美食店。

description: Taste the highest quality meat at a low price at Geukrakdon, which has the best hygiene management system certification HACCP, which raises and slaughters directly with antibiotic-free feed and delivers directly
name: geukrakdon

desc_l10n.en: Enjoy all-you-can-eat, self-service meals and made-to-order meals at the Seoul National University cafeteria. ​
desc_l10n.ja: 食 べ 放題 の 自律排食 とオーダーメイドの 食事 が 楽 しめるソウル 大構内 レストラン
desc_l10n.ko: 양껏 먹을 수 있는 자율 배식의 매력
desc_l10n.zh: 首尔国立大学食堂提供无限量自助餐和现点现做的餐食 。

description: Enjoy all-you-can-eat, self-service meals and made-to-order meals at the Seoul National University cafeteria. ​
name: Duremidam (Seoul National University Branch)

name_l10n.ja: トゥレミダム（ソウル大店）

desc_l10n.en: This is an ox bone soup restaurant with a 60- year history and tradition. The ox bone soup here is very meaty and is served with many different kinds of kimchi, including cabbage kimchi, radish kimchi and green onion kimchi.
desc_l10n.ja: 60年の伝統のソルロンタン(牛骨肉の煮込みスープ)屋。チャドルバギ(牛のともばら肉)が入った濃厚スープにヤンジ(牛胸肉)などがたっぷり入ったソルロンタンが代表メニュー。ペチュキムチ(白菜キムチ)、カットゥギ(角切り大根キムチ)、パキムチ(ネギキムチ)など各種キムチが一緒に出てくるのも特徴だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 60년 전통의 설렁탕집. 차돌박이 진한 국물에 양지 등의 고기가 푸짐한 설렁탕.
desc_l10n.zh: 已有60年传统的雪浓汤专营店。用肥牛片熬成的雪浓汤中加入各个部位的牛肉，用料足实。配有白菜辛奇、萝卜块辛奇和葱辛奇等多种辛奇（kimchi），是本店的一大独到之处。

description: This is an ox bone soup restaurant with a 60- year history and tradition. The ox bone soup here is very meaty and is served with many different kinds of kimchi, including cabbage kimchi, radish kimchi and green onion kimchi.
name: Mapo-ok

desc_l10n.en: "Seoseokdae" is originally the name of a rock on Mudeungsan (mountain) in Gwangju. The restaurant buys beef directly from Jeolla-do (province) and grills the meat on fiery charcoal to bring out the beef's unique flavor and scent.
desc_l10n.ja: 炭火焼肉店。韓国の南西部に位置するチョルラド(全羅道)産牛を仕入れています。炭火で焼く香ばしい焼肉を楽しむことができるところ。
desc_l10n.ko: '서석대'는 광주 무등산 정상에 있는 바위이름. 전라도 한우 생고기 참숯불 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 餐厅的名字来源于无等山上的“瑞石台”。使用的牛肉从全罗道直接采购，风味更佳。此外，炭烧牛肉保留了牛肉的原汁，烤好的牛肉会散发一种独特的香味，令人垂涎欲滴。

description: "Seoseokdae" is originally the name of a rock on Mudeungsan (mountain) in Gwangju. The restaurant buys beef directly from Jeolla-do (province) and grills the meat on fiery charcoal to bring out the beef's unique flavor and scent.
name: Seoseokdae

desc_l10n.en: From 1929 to 1958, this restaurant operated under the name Hosam Restaurant in Yeong-dong in the city of Suncheon. In 1962, the family moved the restaurant to its present location in Yongsan, Seoul, renaming it Yeokjun Restaurant. Now in itsthird generation of family ownership, Yukjun Hoegwan has well-preserved their family's original taste and history.
desc_l10n.ja: 1929年、全羅南道(チョルラナムド)の順天市(スンチョンシ)で開業し、1962年2代目がソウルへ移転。そして、現在3代目がその味を引き継いでいるお店。焼かれて出されるブルゴギ、パサッブルゴギとピリ辛の手長タコ炒め、ナッチグイがオススメメニューだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울의 역사가 오래된 가족과 외식하기 좋은 50년 전통의 한식 레스토랑
desc_l10n.zh: 1929年到1958年，29年间在顺天容洞金莫童奶奶开了一家名为“好三餐厅”。此后第二代申智羽和洪钟烨于1962年在首尔龙山开了一家“站前餐厅”。1990年由第三代改名为现在的“站前会馆”。本店传承了历史和传统，性价比高，是家庭聚会和同事聚餐的首选场所。

description: From 1929 to 1958, this restaurant operated under the name Hosam Restaurant in Yeong-dong in the city of Suncheon. In 1962, the family moved the restaurant to its present location in Yongsan, Seoul, renaming it Yeokjun Restaurant. Now in itsthird generation of family ownership, Yukjun Hoegwan has well-preserved their family's original taste and history.
name: [Baeknyeon-gage] Yukjeon Hoegwan

name_l10n.ja: [百年の店]  龍山ヨクジョンフェグァン(1962)
name_l10n.zh: [百年老店] 龙山站前会馆(1962)

desc_l10n.en: This restaurant serves up nostalgia and the kind of delicious, homemade food that your mother fed you when you were little.
desc_l10n.ja: 丹精込めた韓定食を味わえるところ。店名のオソンチェにはおいしい味「美食味」、情が感じられる味「人情味」、新鮮さが生きた味「新鮮味」、清潔さを大切にする味「清潔味」、親切が感じられる味「親切味」の5つの想いが込められている。
desc_l10n.ko: 어릴 적 어머니가 해주시던 그 맛 그대로 담아낸 오선채의 맛깔나는 한정식은 추억을 떠올리게 하는 맛.
desc_l10n.zh: 五味家涵盖了“美食味”、“人情味”、“新鲜味”、“清洁味”、“亲切味”等五种含义。本店一直秉承着“五味”的原则向顾客提供美味佳肴，使顾客仿佛回到了童年。

description: This restaurant serves up nostalgia and the kind of delicious, homemade food that your mother fed you when you were little.
name: Omiga (Yangjae Branch)

desc_l10n.en: The restaurant specialties are the tteokgalbi and the crabs marinated in soy sauce, but every item is made with the best ingredients and served with plentiful side dishes, including homemade kimchi.
desc_l10n.ja: トッカルビ(韓国式ハンバーグ)やカンジャンケジャン(ワタリガニの醤油漬け)などを味わえる韓国料理店。化学調味料を使わない伝統の味を楽しめる。手作りのキムチ、季節の味を楽しめるナムルなどの小皿のおかずも深い味わいだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 떡갈비와 간장게장 등 주 메뉴를 비롯한 나물과 반찬은 계절별 재료 사용
desc_l10n.zh: 供应年糕排骨和酱香蟹酱等，根据季节来更换提供的辛奇（kimchi）都是店家亲自腌制，保持了韩餐的传统味道。

description: The restaurant specialties are the tteokgalbi and the crabs marinated in soy sauce, but every item is made with the best ingredients and served with plentiful side dishes, including homemade kimchi.
name: Subin Tteokgalbi

desc_l10n.en: The restaurant carefully selects the beef and beef brisket that goes into their soups and and stews, cures it for at 6 hours, then finally cooks it for a minimum of 12 hours to achieve that clean, flavorful taste. Instead of thinly slicing theiroxtail, they serve it in small chunks for a unique taste.
desc_l10n.ja: 奥深いソルロンタン(牛の肉や骨などを煮込んだスープ)を味わえるところ。牛のむな肉と脚骨を12時間以上ゆっくりと煮込み、その後、むねの三枚肉の部位を熟成。さらに6時間丁寧に煮たスープはすっきりとした味わいだ。ぶつ切りで出されるテールの味も逸品。
desc_l10n.ko: 국내산 냉장 양지와 사골을 12시간 이상 우려낸 후 양지 삼겹을 고아 맛이 부드럽고 깔끔.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店精心选用韩国冷藏的牛腩肉浸泡6小时，再用牛腩肉和牛骨熬制12个小时，所以牛骨汤香浓美味。由于所有料理都用最高级的食材烹饪，并且服务态度周到体贴，顾客都赞不绝口。

description: The restaurant carefully selects the beef and beef brisket that goes into their soups and and stews, cures it for at 6 hours, then finally cooks it for a minimum of 12 hours to achieve that clean, flavorful taste. Instead of thinly slicing theiroxtail, they serve it in small chunks for a unique taste.
name: Cham Seolnongtang

desc_l10n.en: The restaurant grinds the buckwheat in-house to make their Pyongyang-style noodles. It produces a savory flavor in the noodles, which perfectly complements the deep, rich flavors of the broth.
desc_l10n.ja: ピョンヤン(平譲)ネンミョン(冷麺)の専門店。そば粉で練った風味のある麺と深い味のスープの組み合わせが絶妙です。ネンミョンの他、マンドゥ(餃子)や豚肉のチェユク(茹で肉)メニューもあります。
desc_l10n.ko: 메밀을 직접 빻아서 은은하고 구수한 풍미가 입 안 가득 감돌고 삼삼하지만 깊은 맛의 육수.
desc_l10n.zh: 平壤面屋冷面用荞麦和淀粉合面，面条筋道，面汤爽口。先喝一杯烧酒，再品尝辣炒猪肉，最后吃一碗平壤面屋冷面，味道堪称一绝，深受顾客的好评。

description: The restaurant grinds the buckwheat in-house to make their Pyongyang-style noodles. It produces a savory flavor in the noodles, which perfectly complements the deep, rich flavors of the broth.
name: Bonga Pyongyang Myeonok

desc_l10n.en: Wangga is scenically located at the bottom of Samgaksan (mountain) and offers high-quality Korean beef at reasonable prices.
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国産牛肉を専門に扱う焼肉店。三角山(サムガクサン)の麓に位置し美しい自然景観を楽しめる。上質の肉を手頃な価格で味わえるところだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 왕가는 자연경관이 수려한 삼각산 밑에 위치한 한우전문 음식점이다.
desc_l10n.zh: 韩牛专营店王家位于风景秀丽的三角山下，高级品质和实惠价格是本店吸引顾客的最大魅力。王家会秉着认真诚恳的态度，迎接每一位顾客。

description: Wangga is scenically located at the bottom of Samgaksan (mountain) and offers high-quality Korean beef at reasonable prices.
name: Wangga

desc_l10n.en: Yisang is a restaurant to taste the finest selection of meat, fresh ingredients, and unique spices.
desc_l10n.ja: カルビ専門店。最高の品質が認められた最上級のカルビのみを使用している。上質のカルビの味を楽しめるところだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 갈비 전문점으로, 최고 품질이 인증된 최상급 갈비만을 엄선하여 변함없는 최고의 고기 맛.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是江北地区的著名排骨专营店，我们用最高的品质，为顾客提供最美味的排骨料理。

description: Yisang is a restaurant to taste the finest selection of meat, fresh ingredients, and unique spices.
name: Galbi Myeongga Yisang (Gireum Branch)

name_l10n.ja: カルビ･ミョンガ･イサン（吉音新館）
name_l10n.zh: 排骨名家李相(吉音新馆)

desc_l10n.en: This izakaya (Japanese-style pub) specializes in tofu dishes. Typical dishes are Goma Tofu made with black sesame seeds, and mochi tofu made with cheese.
desc_l10n.ja: 豆腐料理を専門とする日本居酒屋。ゴマ豆腐、もち豆腐などが代表メニューだ。 つくねや手羽先など串焼きも取り揃えている。日本のウイスキーや日本式カクテルも楽しめる。
desc_l10n.ko: 두부요리를 전문으로 하는 이자카야로, 가볍게 사케를 즐길 수 있는 곳
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为专门提供豆腐料理的居酒屋，招牌料理为芝麻豆腐和麻糬豆腐等，另有提供鸡肉丸串和鸡翅串等各式串烧料理，搭配三多利等日本威士忌、日本鸡尾酒和日本清酒等一起享用也是不错的选择。店内展示的各式各样可爱有趣的日本漫画人物模型，令人印象深刻。

description: This izakaya (Japanese-style pub) specializes in tofu dishes. Typical dishes are Goma Tofu made with black sesame seeds, and mochi tofu made with cheese.
name: Marimo

desc_l10n.en: Uldolmok Ganeungil prides itself on making traditional Korean dishes with fresh seafood. One look at at the stir-fried noodles made with finely sliced burdock and steamed pollack will be enough to get your taste buds rolling.
desc_l10n.ja: 新鮮な海の幸を味わうことのできる韓定食のお店。海鮮と郷土料理が合わさった韓定食専門店だ。ビタミン、ミネラル、食物繊維が豊富なアワビやタコなどすべて産地直送で仕入れている。
desc_l10n.ko: 싱싱한 바다 음식과 토속음식이 어우러진 한정식전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 海洋風味的韓式套餐 本店是提供新鲜，并带有土俗风味的韩式套餐专营店。富含维生素、钙质、纤维素的鲍鱼和章鱼等都直接从产地采购，保证了所有食材的新鲜和美味。另外，牛蒡和明太鱼也是值得推荐的菜式。

description: Uldolmok Ganeungil prides itself on making traditional Korean dishes with fresh seafood. One look at at the stir-fried noodles made with finely sliced burdock and steamed pollack will be enough to get your taste buds rolling.
name: Wooldolmok

name_l10n.ja: ウルドルモクカヌンキル
name_l10n.zh: 通往鸣梁海峡之路(三成分店)

desc_l10n.en: The noodles at this udon restaurant are made on-site, and the broth is especially tasty. The fried chicken and udon set is very filling and recommended. The décor is modern and simple.
desc_l10n.ja: 自家製手打ちうどん専門店。手打ち麺のコシが強い食感とさわやかなスープの味で有名だ。カリカリの鶏のから揚げとうどんが一緒に出てくるセットはボリュームたっぷり。室内はすっきりしていてモダンだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 가게에서 직접 손으로 우동면을 뽑아서 쓰는 우동전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 现抻现煮的乌冬面专营店。手抻面的筋道口感和爽口的面汤极富盛名。香脆的炸鸡搭配乌冬面的套餐带给人们满足的一餐。店内装潢简约整洁，体现出现代感觉。

description: The noodles at this udon restaurant are made on-site, and the broth is especially tasty. The fried chicken and udon set is very filling and recommended. The décor is modern and simple.
name: Gami Udon

desc_l10n.en: Samcheonggak is a traditional arts and cultural complex used as a meeting place for high-ranking politicians from the ruling and opposition parties, inter-Korean Red Cross, and Korean-Japan talks. Comprising a performance hall, Korean restaurant, tea house, and guest rooms, Samcheonggak hosts traditional performances throughout the year, except on Mondays. The buildings in Samcheonggak are Hanoks, where you can feel the architectural beauty of Korea, and are made up of the main building, Ilhwadang, and five separate buildings, including Dongbaekheon, Yuhajeong, Chuwidang, Cheonchudang, and Cheongcheondang. Among these is the Samcheonggak Korean restaurant on the first floor of Ilhwadang. The restaurant is a great place to enjoy high-quality Korean food with the elegance of nature.
desc_l10n.ja: サムチョンガク(三青閣)は、与野党の高位政治家の会合と南北赤十字会談、韓日会談の交渉場所として利用された伝統芸術複合文化空間です。公演場、韓国料理店、喫茶店、客室などで構成されており、月曜日を除き年中伝統公演が開かれています。サムチョンガク(三青閣)にある建物は、韓国の建築美を感じることができるハノク(韓屋)で作られており、母屋の一和堂と東白軒、幽霞亭、翠寒堂、千秋堂、聴泉堂の5つの離れで構成されています。このうち、一和堂の1階にサムチョンガク(三青閣)の韓国料理店があります。サムチョンガク(三青閣)の韓国料理店は、高級韓国料理を自然の風流とともに楽しめる素晴らしい場所です。
desc_l10n.ko: 삼청각은 전통예술복합문화공간. 한국의 유명한 대목장 박광석과 대목수 조승원이 참가해서 지은 곳으로 1972년 7.4남북공동성명 대표단 만찬장소이자 서울시에서 지정한 근대문화유산 . 공연장, 한식당, 찻집, 객실 등으로 구성되어있으며 월요일을 제외하고는 연중 전통공연.
desc_l10n.zh: 三清阁是执政党和在野党高层政治家们的会面、南北红十字会谈、韩日会谈协商的场所，同时还是传统艺术综合文化空间。由表演场地、韩餐厅、茶馆、客房等组成，除周一外，全年都会举行传统演出，三清阁的建筑是能够感受到韩国建筑美的韩屋，一和堂、东白轩、幽霞亭、翠寒堂、千秋堂、听泉堂等5个别院构成。其中一和堂中设有三清阁的韩餐厅，三清阁韩餐厅是可以同时享用高级韩国料理和欣赏自然风光的场所。

description: Samcheonggak is a traditional arts and cultural complex used as a meeting place for high-ranking politicians from the ruling and opposition parties, inter-Korean Red Cross, and Korean-Japan talks. Comprising a performance hall, Korean restaurant, tea house, and guest rooms, Samcheonggak hosts traditional performances throughout the year, except on Mondays. The buildings in Samcheonggak are Hanoks, where you can feel the architectural beauty of Korea, and are made up of the main building, Ilhwadang, and five separate buildings, including Dongbaekheon, Yuhajeong, Chuwidang, Cheonchudang, and Cheongcheondang. Among these is the Samcheonggak Korean restaurant on the first floor of Ilhwadang. The restaurant is a great place to enjoy high-quality Korean food with the elegance of nature.
name: Samcheonggak

name_l10n.ja: サムチョンガク(三青閣)

desc_l10n.en: At Geumgang Barbecue Chicken, you can have draft beer and chicken without paying a lot. There are a variety of chicken dishes on the menu, and their barbecued chicken and garlic chicken are representative.
desc_l10n.ja: 生ビールとフライドチキンを安い価格で楽しめるお店。色々な種類のフライドチキンがあるがその中でも、バーベキューチキンとマヌルチキン(ニンニク味のフライドチキン)が代表的なメニューだ。炭火で焼くバーベキューチキンは炭火の香りがほのかにしておいしい。玉子焼きがサービスで出される。
desc_l10n.ko: 바비큐 치킨과 마늘 치킨이 대표 메뉴. 숯불에 굽는 바비큐 치킨은 숯향이 배어 있어 별미.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店能以低廉的价格享用到生啤酒和烤鸡。虽然店内备有众多口味的烤鸡，但最具代表性的为BBQ烤鸡和蒜味烤鸡。经炭火烧烤的BBQ烤鸡充满炭火香，滋味非常迷人。消费还附赠鸡蛋卷。

description: At Geumgang Barbecue Chicken, you can have draft beer and chicken without paying a lot. There are a variety of chicken dishes on the menu, and their barbecued chicken and garlic chicken are representative.
name: Geumgang Barbecue Chicken

name_l10n.ja: クムガン・バーベキューチキン

desc_l10n.en: Hanaro Hwaegwan has been preserving Korea's traditional tastes for 28 years in Insadong.
desc_l10n.ja: 約30年の伝統を誇る韓定食のお店。伝統の味を守り続けています。韓定食の他、ランチ向けの韓定食やプルゴギなどのメニューあります。
desc_l10n.ko: 우리민족 고유의 전통 음식을 지켜가고자 하는 하나로회관은 종로구 인사동에서 2대째 이어온 28년 전통의 한정식집.
desc_l10n.zh: 位于仁寺洞的Hanaro会馆拥有28年的历史，一直努力保持着韩国的饮食传统，现在由第二代继承经营。为了给顾客提供舒适的就餐环境，餐厅内的190多个座位被划分成不同的独立房间。此外，宽敞的停车场也为顾客带来不少的方便。

description: Hanaro Hwaegwan has been preserving Korea's traditional tastes for 28 years in Insadong.
name: Hanaro Hwaegwan

desc_l10n.en: This is the Gangnam branch of Bulia, a restaurant in front of Hongik University that is famous for huǒ guō (Chinese hotpot). Unlike the main branch, which specializes only in huǒ guō, this branch serves other neatly-presented Chinese dishes. The interior is quite sleek, as well.
desc_l10n.ja: ホンデ(弘大)エリアで中華の火鍋で有名なブリアのカンナム(江南)支店。火鍋のみを専門とする本店とは違って、他の中華料理も味わえる。店内は高級な雰囲気に飾られている。
desc_l10n.ko: 홍대앞에서 훠궈로 유명한 불이아의 강남 분점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为在弘大前以火锅而闻名的〝弗二我〞在江南的分店，和仅提供火锅的总店不同，分店另有提供中式料理。室内装潢亦相当高级。

description: This is the Gangnam branch of Bulia, a restaurant in front of Hongik University that is famous for huǒ guō (Chinese hotpot). Unlike the main branch, which specializes only in huǒ guō, this branch serves other neatly-presented Chinese dishes. The interior is quite sleek, as well.
name: Bulia (Gangnam branch)

desc_l10n.en: The motto of this restaurant, known for its Dwaeji-gukbap (pork soup with rice), is: "Let's eat well-cooked pork, enjoy life, and live to be 100 years old."
desc_l10n.ja: 30年伝統のテジクッパブ(豚のスープご飯)専門店。トンスベク(豚寿百)という店名には「豚肉を食べて100歳まで長生きしよう」という意味が込められている。
desc_l10n.ko: 부산 정통 돼지국밥 전문점
desc_l10n.zh: 豚寿百是汤饭专营店，意思是“本店的料理值得相信，愿顾客都长命百岁”，本店一直为顾客提供最健康的美食料理。

description: The motto of this restaurant, known for its Dwaeji-gukbap (pork soup with rice), is: "Let's eat well-cooked pork, enjoy life, and live to be 100 years old."
name: Donsoobaek

desc_l10n.en: Jinsadaek is located inside a hanok, surrounded by the hustle and bustle of the city, and harmoniously brings together the traditional foods of each of Korea's regions.
desc_l10n.ja: 各地方の伝統料理を味わうことのできる韓国料理店。ビルが立ち並ぶ明洞(ミョンドン)の中心にありながら、静かな韓国伝統家屋の佇まいだ。様々なコース料理を味わえる。
desc_l10n.ko: 번화가의 분주함들 사이에 한옥을 머리에 이고 하늘과 조화를 이루고 있는 진사댁은, 각 지방의 대표적인 전통 음식을 경험할 수 있는 한국 전통음식점.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是位于明洞的优秀美食店，在这里可以品尝到韩国各地的传统美食。进士宅是喧闹繁华中的一处清静之地，顾客可以一边品尝美味佳肴，一边享受短暂的休闲时光。

description: Jinsadaek is located inside a hanok, surrounded by the hustle and bustle of the city, and harmoniously brings together the traditional foods of each of Korea's regions.
name: Jinsadaek

desc_l10n.en: A hot pot of Seolleongtang in Sul Dam Je warms you up on cold days. This hot soup made from slow cooked boiled ox bones served with steamed rice and fresh kimchi is amazingly delicious. Generous servings and warm hospitality make the visit enjoyable.
desc_l10n.ja: 濃厚な牛骨からとったスープで、深い味わいが楽しめるソルロンタン（牛肉、骨、内臓などのスープ）のお店。炊きたてのご飯とキムチをスープに入れて食べると絶品だ。行き届いたサービスで気持ちよく食事ができる。
desc_l10n.ko: 진한 사골국물에 갓 지은 밥과 칼칼한 김치의 조합. 3대를 이어온 설렁탕 맛집.
desc_l10n.zh: 想喝热腾腾的汤时请到Sul Dam Je，暖透心扉的牛杂碎汤，香醇浓郁的排骨汤饭，爽口怡人的辛奇（kimchi）！体贴周到的服务让客人感到宾至如归。

description: A hot pot of Seolleongtang in Sul Dam Je warms you up on cold days. This hot soup made from slow cooked boiled ox bones served with steamed rice and fresh kimchi is amazingly delicious. Generous servings and warm hospitality make the visit enjoyable.
name: Suldamje Seolleongtang

name_l10n.ja: ソルダムジェソルロンタン
