description: Yeongcheon Yeonghwa Sigyuk Sikdang is the Seoul branch of the famous Daegu restaurant, Yeongcheon Yeonghwa. Here you can chargrill properly-matured Korean beef. The side dishes served with the beef are quite tasty.
name: Yeongcheon Yeonghwa Sigyuk Sikdang

name_l10n.ja: ヨンチョンヨンファ・シクユク・シクタン
name_l10n.zh: 永川永化食肉食堂(Yeongcheonnyeonghwa Sigyuksikdang)

desc_l10n.en: Enjoy authentic Japanese kushiyaki (grilled meat skewers) at Waraku. The skewers make a great accompaniment for drinks. Rumor has it that, among the izakaya (Japanese bars) that have sprung up recently, this place serves the most authentic-tasting grilled skewers.
desc_l10n.ja: 串焼きのお店。多様な串類があり、お酒のおつまみとして楽しむのもよい。日本居酒屋が多いなか、串焼きのおいしさで評判のところだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 정통 일본식 쿠시야키를 맛볼 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到正宗的日式串烧，种类丰富的串烧也很适合当作下酒菜。虽然最近有许多间居酒屋如雨后春笋般冒出来，但家依然坚持提供正宗的日式串烧。

description: Enjoy authentic Japanese kushiyaki (grilled meat skewers) at Waraku. The skewers make a great accompaniment for drinks. Rumor has it that, among the izakaya (Japanese bars) that have sprung up recently, this place serves the most authentic-tasting grilled skewers.
name: Waraku

desc_l10n.en: Bogeonok is famous for kimchi jjigae (a stew made with mainly kimchi, pork, and tofu). However, it is only served at lunch time. In addition, they offer high-quality beef bulgogi (marinated thinly-sliced beef).
desc_l10n.ja: キムチチゲ(キムチ鍋)とサムギョプサル(豚の三枚肉の焼肉)で有名なお店で、乙支路4街(ウルチロサガ)のパンサン市場にある隠れた名店。他にも安くておいしいと評判のプルコギも人気。 キムチチゲはお昼の時間のみだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 김치찌개와 삼겹살로 유명한 을지로4가 방산시장에 있는 숨은 맛집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为位于乙支路4街芳山市场内的隐蔽美味，人气料理为辛奇（kimchi）炖汤和五花肉，另外还可以品尝到物超所值的烤牛肉。辛奇（kimchi）锅仅在午餐时提供。

description: Bogeonok is famous for kimchi jjigae (a stew made with mainly kimchi, pork, and tofu). However, it is only served at lunch time. In addition, they offer high-quality beef bulgogi (marinated thinly-sliced beef).
name: Bogeonok

desc_l10n.en: Busan Galmaegi takes pride in their saengtaetang (fresh pollack soup), which is quite thick and rich-tasting, due to the generous portion of fish organs such as egg sacks, milt, and hard roe they add to their soup, giving it a rich and meaty flavor. The combination of soft pollack flesh and fish organs is excellent.
desc_l10n.ja: 濃厚な味のセンテタン(生スケトウダラ鍋)が自慢の一品。肝、卵、白子など内臓がたっぷり入っていて、スープが味わい深い。やわらかいスケトウダラの身と内蔵の調和が絶品だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 걸쭉하고 진한 맛의 생태탕. 애, 알, 곤이 등 내장이 듬뿍 들어가 국물.
desc_l10n.zh: 味道香浓的鲜明太鱼汤是此店的招牌菜。汤中放入了大量明太鱼的肝、肠、卵子等内脏，味道香浓，是明太鱼鱼肉和内脏搭配出的绝佳美味。

description: Busan Galmaegi takes pride in their saengtaetang (fresh pollack soup), which is quite thick and rich-tasting, due to the generous portion of fish organs such as egg sacks, milt, and hard roe they add to their soup, giving it a rich and meaty flavor. The combination of soft pollack flesh and fish organs is excellent.
name: Busan Galmaegi

desc_l10n.en: Busan Sikdang serves simple home-style baekban (a simple set meal of rice, soup or stew, and side dishes). The owner, who is originally from Busan, makes the fermented soybean paste with which the soup broth is made from. Freshly steamed kongbap (rice with beans) is served about half an hour after your order has been taken. Their saengtae jjigae (pollack soup) and tofu are also very famous.
desc_l10n.ja: 家庭で食べる料理のように簡単な定食が食べられるお店。釜山(プサン)出身の社長の自家製味噌でスープの味を出す。注文をしてから30分待つと、炊きたての豆ご飯を持ってきてくれる。
desc_l10n.ko: 집에서 먹는 음식 같이 간편한 백반이 나오는 집. 생태탕 추천.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店提供家常口味的套餐。釜山出身的老板使用自家发酵的大豆酱熬煮汤汁，顾客点餐后等待30分钟，便可以享用到刚煮好的大豆饭。人气料理为明太鱼汤，豆腐的口味也不错。

description: Busan Sikdang serves simple home-style baekban (a simple set meal of rice, soup or stew, and side dishes). The owner, who is originally from Busan, makes the fermented soybean paste with which the soup broth is made from. Freshly steamed kongbap (rice with beans) is served about half an hour after your order has been taken. Their saengtae jjigae (pollack soup) and tofu are also very famous.
name: Busan Sikdang

desc_l10n.en: Bulia specializes in Chinese-style hot pot made a little less spicy to suit Korean tastes. The set menu with beef, lamb and assorted vegetables is the most popular menu item.
desc_l10n.ja: 中国式火鍋が食べられるレストラン。韓国人の味覚に合わせ、中国本土の火鍋よりも辛さ控えめだ。牛肉、羊肉、各種野菜、キノコなど様々なトッピングがたっぷり入った定食が代表的なメニュー。
desc_l10n.ko: 중국 본토 훠궈보다는 덜 맵게 중국식 훠궈를 먹을 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 中国式火锅店。为了迎合韩国人的口味而适当降低了麻辣的程度。包含牛肉、羊肉和各种蔬菜及菌类的套餐最受欢迎 。

description: Bulia specializes in Chinese-style hot pot made a little less spicy to suit Korean tastes. The set menu with beef, lamb and assorted vegetables is the most popular menu item.
name: Bulia

desc_l10n.en: Daedongmun, run by a woman from Pyeongyang, her son, and her daughter-in-law, has been faithfully reproducing Pyeongyang traditional cuisine for over 20 years. Menu items include eobok jaengban (pressed beef served on a brass plate), manduguk (Korean dumpling soup), kongbiji (puréed soybean soup), and nokdu jijim (mung bean pancakes).
desc_l10n.ja: ピョンヤン(平壌)料理を味わえるところ。オボクチェンバン(牛肉、野菜などの寄せ鍋)、餃子入りスープ、コンビジ(おから鍋)、ピンデトク(緑豆チヂミ)など昔そのままの味を再現している。
desc_l10n.ko: 고향이 평양인 할머니와 아들, 며느리가 운영하는 20여 년 역사의 음식점으로, 어복쟁반, 만둣국, 콩비지, 녹두지짐 등의 평양 전래음식을 옛날 그대로 재현.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店由故乡为平壤的老奶奶、儿子和媳妇共同经营，是拥有20多年历史的餐馆。店家将朝鲜风味什锦面、汤饺、豆腐渣和绿豆煎饼等平壤料理的传统味道完整再现。

description: Daedongmun, run by a woman from Pyeongyang, her son, and her daughter-in-law, has been faithfully reproducing Pyeongyang traditional cuisine for over 20 years. Menu items include eobok jaengban (pressed beef served on a brass plate), manduguk (Korean dumpling soup), kongbiji (puréed soybean soup), and nokdu jijim (mung bean pancakes).
name: Daedongmun

desc_l10n.en: Espresso is freshly brewed from Italian Molinari beans and poured over vanilla ice cream to produce B-hind's unique affogato al caffè. This café is well-known for its comfortable atmosphere, ideal for couples. They often hold a flea market.
desc_l10n.ja: オンライン・オフラインでのフリーマーケットや展示会も開かれている弘大(ホンデ)エリアらしいお店。イタリア・モリナーリ社製のコーヒーを使用し、コクの深いエスプレッソをバニラアイスクリームにかけて食べるアフォーガトーがおすすめだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 온, 오프라인으로 프리 마켓도 열고 종종 전시회도 여는 홍대앞스러운 카페
desc_l10n.zh: 此店不仅利用线上和线下举办利伯维尔集，并且还举行各种展示会，相当具有弘大前的风格。将使用意大利Molinari原豆刚冲泡完成的意式浓缩咖啡，淋在香草冰淇淋上的Affogato Al Caffe，口味相当独特。店内的气氛优美，因此亦是情侣们的约会胜地。

description: Espresso is freshly brewed from Italian Molinari beans and poured over vanilla ice cream to produce B-hind's unique affogato al caffè. This café is well-known for its comfortable atmosphere, ideal for couples. They often hold a flea market.
name: B-hind

desc_l10n.en: Odarizip is a unique restaurant in Myeong-dong that combines Korean cuisine with live musical performances. Odarizip specializes in ganjang-gejang (soy-marinated crab), but there are many other tasty menu items like Odarizip's Korean beef andKorean pork dishes. The restaurant has live performances of K-pop every evening starting at 19:00 on the restaurant's 3rd floor. Odarizip is especially popular with Chinese and Japanese tourists.
desc_l10n.ja: Odarizipはミョンドン(明洞)にあるカンジャンケジャン店で、中国人観光客や日本人観光客が一番よく訪れる店にも選ばれました。オリジナリティを活かすため味付けケジャンではないカンジャンケジャンだけを取り扱い、その他にハヌ(韓牛)や韓国産サムギョプサルもあります。夜7時からはk-popのライブを聴きながら食事ができます。
desc_l10n.ko: 오다리집은 명동에 위치한 간장게장 맛집으로, 중국인 관광객과 일본인 관광객의 가장 많이 즐겨 찾는 맛집
desc_l10n.zh: 一边享用韩式料理，一边欣赏K-Pop表演的新概念餐厅。二层主推冷面、包饭、汤饭、嫩豆腐大酱汤等美味料理，在三层可一边享用包括蟹酱、肉类的套餐，一边欣赏K-Pop表演，已成为众多游客的必游之地。在演出结束后还可以与韩流明星合影留念并获得明星签名。

description: Odarizip is a unique restaurant in Myeong-dong that combines Korean cuisine with live musical performances. Odarizip specializes in ganjang-gejang (soy-marinated crab), but there are many other tasty menu items like Odarizip's Korean beef andKorean pork dishes. The restaurant has live performances of K-pop every evening starting at 19:00 on the restaurant's 3rd floor. Odarizip is especially popular with Chinese and Japanese tourists.
name: Odarizip

desc_l10n.en: Before pasta was commonplace in Korea, Pomodoro was already a spaghetti house so famous that you had to wait in line for an hour to get in. Their pasta sauce, which is made to order, is still very popular.
desc_l10n.ja: パスタがさほど一般的でなかった頃、一時間も並んで待たなければいけなかったパスタ屋として有名になった店。パスタソースは今も変わらず人気だ。価格が手頃なのもうれしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 광화문에서 한 시간씩 줄 서서 먹어야 하는 스파게티집
desc_l10n.zh: 意大利面不是很出名的时节，在光化门地区要想吃到意大利面就要排队一个小时，本店以此闻名。现场制作的意大利面酱依旧如此受欢迎。

description: Before pasta was commonplace in Korea, Pomodoro was already a spaghetti house so famous that you had to wait in line for an hour to get in. Their pasta sauce, which is made to order, is still very popular.
name: Pomodoro

desc_l10n.en: Here, you’ll find the freshest and finest yang, or tripe, in Seoul. The dish is marinated in a special sauce for 24 hours and then grilled. Other cuts are also available.
desc_l10n.ja: 牛の胃を意味するヤンが食べられるレストラン。鮮度と肉質が特に優れている。独自開発したソースに24時間漬けておいて焼いて食べ、あっさりと香ばしい味が絶品だ。ヤンのほかにも韓牛やチョンゴル(寄せ鍋)が味わえる。
desc_l10n.ko: 소의 위를 뜻하는 양을 먹을 수 있는 곳. 신선도와 육질이 특히 뛰어남. 자체 개발한 소스에 24시간 재웠다가 구워먹는데 담백하고 고소한 맛이 일품.
desc_l10n.zh: 牛肚烧烤专营店。本店的食材以新鲜和优质而闻名。将牛肚放在秘制调味汁中腌制24小时后再精心烤熟，味道鲜美爽口，不肥不腻。除牛肚外，也供应韩牛烧烤和火锅。

description: Here, you’ll find the freshest and finest yang, or tripe, in Seoul. The dish is marinated in a special sauce for 24 hours and then grilled. Other cuts are also available.
name: Yangmani

desc_l10n.en: Sadong Myeonok specializes in Hwanghae-style mandu (Korean dumplings) that are bigger that an adult fist. The special characteristic of this dumpling is that it is boiled, not steamed. Other items on the menu include doganitang, a special beef broth made by slowly boiling beef bones; nokdujeon, Korean style pancakes made with mung bean; and pajeon, Korean style pancakes made with green onions, all of which come with high recommendations. The interior of the restaurant is decorated in traditional Korean style and is very elegant.
desc_l10n.ja: 黄海道(ファンヘド)式マンドゥ(餃子)専門店。マンドゥを蒸さないで茹でることが特徴。マンドゥ以外にもトガニタン(牛の膝軟骨煮込みスープ)とノッドゥジョン(緑豆のチヂミ)、パジョン(ねぎチヂミ)もおすすめだ。風情ある韓国式家屋の店内も印象的。
desc_l10n.ko: 어른 주먹보다 큰 황해도식 만두는 만두를 찌지 않고 삶아내는 황해도식 만두.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为提供黄海道式饺子的店家。比成人拳头还要大的饺子，直接用开水煮熟。牛膝骨汤、绿豆煎饼和葱煎饼是不可错过的推荐美食。室内的气氛宛如怀旧的传统韩屋，许多人可以在此找到故乡的味道。

description: Sadong Myeonok specializes in Hwanghae-style mandu (Korean dumplings) that are bigger that an adult fist. The special characteristic of this dumpling is that it is boiled, not steamed. Other items on the menu include doganitang, a special beef broth made by slowly boiling beef bones; nokdujeon, Korean style pancakes made with mung bean; and pajeon, Korean style pancakes made with green onions, all of which come with high recommendations. The interior of the restaurant is decorated in traditional Korean style and is very elegant.
name: Sadong Myeonok

desc_l10n.en: Malta Chamchi specializes in tuna. The prices are reasonable, but cuts like otoro (front part of tuna abdomen), beggop (the underside of the chutoro cut) , and kamatoro (abdomen part around the gills of tuna) are of quite good quality.
desc_l10n.ja: テチドン(大峙洞)に位置するまぐろの刺身専門店。価格帯は高めだが、大トロ、へそ、かまトロなど上質のまぐろを味わうことができるところだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 참치를 전문으로 내는 곳. 오도로와 참치배꼽살, 가마도로
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为鲔鱼专卖店，虽然价格偏高，但在此可以尽享用质量顶级的黑鲔鱼、鲔鱼大腹肉和鲔鱼下巴等鲔鱼料理 。

description: Malta Chamchi specializes in tuna. The prices are reasonable, but cuts like otoro (front part of tuna abdomen), beggop (the underside of the chutoro cut) , and kamatoro (abdomen part around the gills of tuna) are of quite good quality.
name: Malta Chamchi

desc_l10n.en: Songok has specialized in Memil Guksu (buckwheat noodles) for over 40 years. Their pleasing broth is made with bold-tasting katsuobushi (a traditional Japanese soup base) and soy sauce. The restaurant demonstrates their expertise with udon (thick wheat-flour noodles) that are chewy and delicious.
desc_l10n.ja: 40年の歴史を誇るメミルククス(そば)専門店。かつおぶしと醤油の味がとても香ばしい。麺を専門にしているお店だけあって、うどんの麺はコシがあってとてもおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 40여 년 전통의, 메밀국수를 전문으로 하는 집
desc_l10n.zh: 拥有40多年历史的荞麦面条专卖店，浓郁的柴鱼汤汁和酱油汤汁令人口齿留香，且口味较偏向韩式。店内的乌冬面也十分劲道有嚼劲。

description: Songok has specialized in Memil Guksu (buckwheat noodles) for over 40 years. Their pleasing broth is made with bold-tasting katsuobushi (a traditional Japanese soup base) and soy sauce. The restaurant demonstrates their expertise with udon (thick wheat-flour noodles) that are chewy and delicious.
name: Songok

desc_l10n.en: Sandong Gyoja looks a bit run down, but the Chinese couple that runs it makes true, authentic Chinese food. They are famous for their steamed dumplings, which are wrapped with very thin dough so that the savory stuffing of Chinese leeks and braised pork is front and center.
desc_l10n.ja: 少し古い外観だが、正統派の中華料理が楽しめる。華僑出身の夫婦が厨房に入り、すべて手作りしている。中国産のニラと牛肉の具が入ったムルマンドゥ(水餃子)とオヒャンジャンユク(五香醤肉：焼豚)が有名だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 허름한 외관을 하고 있으나 정통 중국 음식의 맛.
desc_l10n.zh: 虽然外观不起眼，但在此可以品尝到正宗的中华料理。由华侨夫妇亲自掌厨，为顾客制作每道料理。招牌料理为内馅为青江菜的劲道水饺，和五香酱肉。

description: Sandong Gyoja looks a bit run down, but the Chinese couple that runs it makes true, authentic Chinese food. They are famous for their steamed dumplings, which are wrapped with very thin dough so that the savory stuffing of Chinese leeks and braised pork is front and center.
name: Sandong Gyoja

desc_l10n.en: Songjuk is a great place to try out several kinds of juk (porridge). What sets the juk here apart from other places is that they use short grain rice that has been cooked in sesame oil and beef bone soup. Mushroom oyster juk and oyster intestine cookedoyster juk are some of their most popular dishes.
desc_l10n.ja: 色々な種類のおかゆが味わえるお店。ごま油で炒めたうるち米に牛骨を煮込んだダシを入れて作るのが特徴。 きのこと牡蠣の粥、内臓も一緒に入れて作ったチョンボッジュク(あわびのお粥)が人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 참기름에 볶은 멥쌀을 푹 삶은 사골 국물에 넣고 끓여 만든 죽.
desc_l10n.zh: 提供将用麻油炒过的粳米放入牛大骨高汤中炖煮而成的粥品。从香菇牡蛎粥，到加入鲍鱼内脏一起炖煮的鲍鱼粥等粥品皆相当受到欢迎。

description: Songjuk is a great place to try out several kinds of juk (porridge). What sets the juk here apart from other places is that they use short grain rice that has been cooked in sesame oil and beef bone soup. Mushroom oyster juk and oyster intestine cookedoyster juk are some of their most popular dishes.
name: Songjuk

desc_l10n.en: Forest of Music is a music-themed cafe with a large archive of old vinyl records. The owner DJs at the cafe and takes song requests. Every object in the shop is a reminder of the analog past. The walls are covered with autographs from celebrities who have visited the shop in the past. Forest of Music was featured in the Korean movie "Sunny" and the Jayuro Gayoje episode of Infinite Challenge featuring G-Dragon.
desc_l10n.ja: 音楽の森カフェに入ると、まず壁一面を飾るLPレコードが目にとまります。それから壁に描かれたビートルズの絵とターンテーブルを回しているDJでありオーナーが目に入ります。昔のようにメモに書いたリクエスト曲を受け取って聴かせてくれます。映画｢サニー永遠の仲間たち｣のロケ地でもあります。
desc_l10n.ko: 음악의 숲 카페  한쪽 벽면을 가득 채운 LP판들.
desc_l10n.zh: 音乐之林是一家不仅可以欣赏怀旧老唱片，还能点歌的主题咖啡店。布满空间的每一个装饰品都蕴含着旧时的情感，藉由挂在牆上的签名还能追踪韩流明星的轨迹。电影《阳光姐妹淘（Sunny）》中的复古咖啡店就是取景于此。在综艺节目《无限挑战》的“无限挑战自由路歌赛”一集中，G-Dragon曾在这里拍摄了部分片段。

description: Forest of Music is a music-themed cafe with a large archive of old vinyl records. The owner DJs at the cafe and takes song requests. Every object in the shop is a reminder of the analog past. The walls are covered with autographs from celebrities who have visited the shop in the past. Forest of Music was featured in the Korean movie "Sunny" and the Jayuro Gayoje episode of Infinite Challenge featuring G-Dragon.
name: Forest of Music

desc_l10n.en: Daeryeodo serves authentic Beijing cuisine, a favorite among Koreans. For 40,000 - 50,000 won, you can enjoy set menus of ten different dishes, including seasoned cold vegetables, shark's fin, stir-fried bamboo shoots and sea cucumber, shrimp, and other Beijing delicacies.
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国風にアレンジされた北京料理のお店。冷菜をはじめ、フカヒレ、ナマコ、海老などを使った10種類の料理を4～5万ウォン台で味わうことができる。
desc_l10n.ko: 한국인의 입맛에 맞는 정통 북경요리를 하는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店提供符合韩国人口味的正宗北京料理，在此能以4至5万元的价格享用到凉拌菜、鱼翅、竹笋海参、鲜虾、北京料理和主食等10道料理。

description: Daeryeodo serves authentic Beijing cuisine, a favorite among Koreans. For 40,000 - 50,000 won, you can enjoy set menus of ten different dishes, including seasoned cold vegetables, shark's fin, stir-fried bamboo shoots and sea cucumber, shrimp, and other Beijing delicacies.
name: Daeryeodo

desc_l10n.en: Samo Jjukkumi has specialized in jjukkumi (small octopus) for over 30 years. Jjukkumi here prepared in a special way, by grilling it and also frying it with a unique red chili pepper paste and other spices, giving it a delicate flavor to go along with the octopus’s natural chewyness. Prices are low and customer satisfaction is high.
desc_l10n.ja: 創業25年目で、チュクミ(イイダコ焼き)がおいしいと評判のお店。網で焼くコチュジャン(唐辛子味噌)味付けのチュクミはとても歯ごたえがあっておいしい。手頃な値段なのもうれしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 30년 넘은 주꾸미 요리. 고추장 양념에 버무려 불판에 구워 먹는 주꾸미.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为拥有近30年历史的小章鱼料理专卖店，小章鱼是筏桥出身的老板亲自从南海岸带回来的。和辣椒酱搅拌过后放至铁板上烤熟的小章鱼，清爽劲道且价格实惠。

description: Samo Jjukkumi has specialized in jjukkumi (small octopus) for over 30 years. Jjukkumi here prepared in a special way, by grilling it and also frying it with a unique red chili pepper paste and other spices, giving it a delicate flavor to go along with the octopus’s natural chewyness. Prices are low and customer satisfaction is high.
name: Samo Jjukkumi

desc_l10n.en: At Yangmani, you can enjoy intestines in a clean, comfortable atmosphere. Here the grilled ox stomach and large intestines are especially popular. They use New Zealand ox stomach and Korean ox large intestines. Also worth trying is their yangwutang (ox tripe simmered in a broth made from dried cabbage leaves). The main branch is located in Yeouido.
desc_l10n.ja: ホルモンがおいしいお店。こぎれいで快適な雰囲気の中でホルモンを味わえるところだ。ヤングイ(牛ミノ焼き)とテチャン(大腸焼き)が人気。ニュージーランド産の牛のヤン(牛ミノ)と韓国産牛の大腸を使っている。ウゴジスープ(白菜の菜っ葉を煮込んだスープ)にミノを入れたヤンウタンも美味だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 깔끔하고 쾌적한 분위기에서 곱창을 즐길 수 있는 곳. 양과 대창구이가 인기. 뉴질랜드산 소의 양과 국내산 한우의 대창을 사용.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店顾客可以在干净舒适的环境中享用烤牛小肠，烤牛肚和烤牛大肠也相当受到欢迎。店家使用的是纽西兰牛只的牛肚和韩国牛只的大肠。在辛奇（kimchi）叶汤加入牛肚的牛肚叶菜汤也值得一尝。总店位于汝矣岛。

description: At Yangmani, you can enjoy intestines in a clean, comfortable atmosphere. Here the grilled ox stomach and large intestines are especially popular. They use New Zealand ox stomach and Korean ox large intestines. Also worth trying is their yangwutang (ox tripe simmered in a broth made from dried cabbage leaves). The main branch is located in Yeouido.
name: Yangmani (Cheongdam branch)

desc_l10n.en: At Yeolchajip, you can enjoy a bowl of makgeolli (Korean rice wine) with bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes), guljeon (oyster pancakes), or one of their other delicacies. They grind mung beans in a millstone and place the mixture on a hot plate topped with a few pieces of pork, which yields mung bean pancakes that are crispy and delicious. At dinnertime, the place is packed with people who come to have the pancakes with makgeolli.
desc_l10n.ja: ピンデトク(綠豆のチヂミ)やクルジョン(牡蠣を卵や小麦粉を付けてやいたもの)等と相性のいいマッコルリ(どぶろく)を楽しめるお店。緑豆を臼でひいた後、鉄板でカリッとするまで焼いたピンデトク(綠豆のチヂミ)は病み付きになる味だ。夜になると、ピンデトク(綠豆のチヂミ)とマッコルリを求め多くの人で賑う。
desc_l10n.ko: 빈대떡, 굴전 등과 막걸리 한 사발을 걸치는 대포집
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为享用绿豆煎饼和牡蛎煎饼等料理，以及小米酒的酒馆。将绿豆用石磨磨成浆后放至铁板上，再放上几片猪肉煎熟的绿豆煎饼，香酥味美。一到晚上，店内便充满喝小米酒搭配绿豆煎饼的餐客。

description: At Yeolchajip, you can enjoy a bowl of makgeolli (Korean rice wine) with bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes), guljeon (oyster pancakes), or one of their other delicacies. They grind mung beans in a millstone and place the mixture on a hot plate topped with a few pieces of pork, which yields mung bean pancakes that are crispy and delicious. At dinnertime, the place is packed with people who come to have the pancakes with makgeolli.
name: Yeolchajip

desc_l10n.en: This Chinese restaurant has been run by a hotel for 30 years, so you can expect high standards. Their menu features a balanced selection of the four main Chinese regional cuisines, ensuring a dining experience with a variety of different flavors. It's not uncommon to spot heads of large corporations and politicians dining here.
desc_l10n.ja: 30年の歴史を誇る中華レストラン。安定した味を提供し続けている。中国の四大料理を取り揃えており、様々な料理を味わえる。財閥の総帥や政治家もたびたび訪れることでも有名なところだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 30여 년 역사의 호텔 중식당으로, 재벌 총수, 정치인들이 자주 찾는 곳으로도 유명.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店拥有30多年的历史，料理如同饭店内的中式餐厅一般质量上乘。在这里可以体验到各式各样的中国料理口味，政经界的大人物经常造访于此，因而享有盛名。

description: This Chinese restaurant has been run by a hotel for 30 years, so you can expect high standards. Their menu features a balanced selection of the four main Chinese regional cuisines, ensuring a dining experience with a variety of different flavors. It's not uncommon to spot heads of large corporations and politicians dining here.
name: Tao Yuen

desc_l10n.en: The traditional Chinese confections served in this shop are all-natural, with the distinctive aromas and rich flavors of Chinese sweets. Their jasmine tea, which includes 16 ingredients, goes very well with the variety of Chinese sweets they offer, particularly the moon cakes.
desc_l10n.ja: 天然の材料で作られている中国の伝統菓子のお店。中国菓子特有の香りと深い味わいを感じることができる。月餅をはじめとする様々な中国の菓子は、16種類の材料が入ったジャスミン茶を飲みながら食べるとさらに美味しい。10種類のフルーツが入っているという十経月餅が有名だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 천연 재료로 만들어진 중국전통과자점. 중국과자 특유의 향과 깊은 맛
desc_l10n.zh: 本店为使用天然食材制作的中国传统糕点专卖店，在此可以感受到中国糕点特有的香气和浓郁的味道。将月饼等各式中国糕点，搭配添加16种材料的茉莉花茶一起享用风味更佳。内馅包含10种水果的什锦月饼相当有名。

description: The traditional Chinese confections served in this shop are all-natural, with the distinctive aromas and rich flavors of Chinese sweets. Their jasmine tea, which includes 16 ingredients, goes very well with the variety of Chinese sweets they offer, particularly the moon cakes.
name: Dohyangchon

desc_l10n.en: As a classy restaurant with a view of Hangang。Seogang 8-gyeong offers a wide selection of beverages during the day and whiskey and wine at night. Their motto is to entice the diner’s taste buds with French cuisine and offer an eyeful of Hangang. Seogang 8-gyeong was featured on King of Ambition, Incarnation of Money, and My Love from the Star. The restaurant is sectioned into six-themed private rooms where guests can enjoy a full French course meal while taking in the view of the river. The 9th floor is a sky lounge that serves wine, cocktails, and whiskey. Seogang 8-gyeong is a reservation-only restaurant.
desc_l10n.ja: ハンガン(漢江)の美しい景色を楽しみながら、昼は様々な飲み物を、夜はワインやウィスキーなどを楽しむことのできる上品な雰囲気のレストラン。味覚にはフランスを、目にはハンガン(漢江)の景色をプレゼントするというモットーをもって運営され、観光客を魅了しています。「夜王」、「お金の化身」、「星から来たあなた」などのドラマの中で、ここから眺める美しいハンガン(漢江)の夜景が映りました。8階は6室のテーマ別プライベートルームがあり、ハンガン(漢江)の夜景を見下ろしながらフレンチのコース料理が堪能できます。9階はワイン、コクテール、ウィスキーなどが飲めるスカイラウンジ。すべて予約制。
desc_l10n.ko: 한강의 빼어난 경치와 함께하는 품격 있는 프렌치 레스토랑
desc_l10n.zh: 在汉江秀丽风光的衬托下，白天可享饮品，晚上可享葡萄酒、威士忌等酒类的顶级餐厅。以用嘴巴享受来自法国的礼物，用眼睛享受汉江之理念来吸引顾客。《欲望女王》、《钱的诱惑》和《来自星星的你》等电视剧中常出现的汉江美景都是在这里拍摄的。八层设有8个主题单间，可以伴着汉江夜景享用法国正餐；九层是提供葡萄酒、鸡尾酒和威士忌等酒类的空中酒廊。须事先预约。

description: As a classy restaurant with a view of Hangang。Seogang 8-gyeong offers a wide selection of beverages during the day and whiskey and wine at night. Their motto is to entice the diner’s taste buds with French cuisine and offer an eyeful of Hangang. Seogang 8-gyeong was featured on King of Ambition, Incarnation of Money, and My Love from the Star. The restaurant is sectioned into six-themed private rooms where guests can enjoy a full French course meal while taking in the view of the river. The 9th floor is a sky lounge that serves wine, cocktails, and whiskey. Seogang 8-gyeong is a reservation-only restaurant.
name: Seogang 8-gyeong

desc_l10n.en: Encore Kalguksu is a Kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup) restaurant affiliated with Baengnyeonok, a very famous tofu restaurant. Here you can enjoy Baeknyeonok's most popular dishes, like the Maesaengyi Kalguksu (soup with noodles made with a type of seaweed) and Pat Kalguksu, which is Kalguksu with red beans.
desc_l10n.ja: 豆腐料理で有名な「百年屋(ベンニョンオク」が作った百年屋別館兼カルグクス(韓国式うどん)のお店。百年屋の人気メニューだったメセンイカルグクス（スジアオノリのスープに入れたカルグクス)とパットカルグクス(小豆粥に入れたカルグクス)が味わえる。百年屋のメニューを注文することも可能だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 두부로 유명한 백년옥에서 낸 백년옥 별관 겸 칼국수집.  매생이칼국수와 팥칼국수.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为豆腐名店百年屋的分店兼刀切面店，在此可以品尝到百年屋的招牌菜——海藻刀切面和红豆刀切面。加入海藻与牡蛎煮成的海藻刀切面，适合搭配海藻牡蛎煎饼一起享用。在百年屋能享用到此店的餐点，而在此也能享用到百年屋的餐点。

description: Encore Kalguksu is a Kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup) restaurant affiliated with Baengnyeonok, a very famous tofu restaurant. Here you can enjoy Baeknyeonok's most popular dishes, like the Maesaengyi Kalguksu (soup with noodles made with a type of seaweed) and Pat Kalguksu, which is Kalguksu with red beans.
name: Encore Kalguksu

name_l10n.ja: アンコール・カルグクス

desc_l10n.en: Saemban Makguksu is the Seoul branch of Sambat Makguksu in Chuncheon. They use noodles made of 80% buckwheat flour. In addition to the popular representative dish Makguksu (buckwheat noodles in a spicy sauce), gamjajeon (Korean-style potato pancakes), and bossam (steamed pork with fresh unfermented kimchi) are also recommended. The assorted Korean-style pancakes, made with shrimp, king oyster mushrooms, meat and vegetable skewers, zucchini, and fish are good, too.
desc_l10n.ja: 営業開始から3代目まで続く春川(チュンチョン)の「セムパッマッククス」のソウル店。そば粉が80％入った麺を使用。麺は冷麺に比べてコシが強くはないが、やわらかい食感が良い。カムジャジョン(じゃがいものチヂミ)、テジコギポッサム(ゆで豚肉の葉野菜包み)もおすすめ。海老、エリンギ、カボチャ、魚などのジョン(卵・小麦粉を付けて焼いたもの)がセットになったモドゥムジョンがお得だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 3대째 이어 오는 춘천의 샘밭막국수의 서울 분점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店是传承3代的春川泉田荞面首尔分店。使用80%的荞面，口感柔软。招牌料理还有土豆饼和白切猪肉生菜包饭。加入虾、松茸、烤肉串、南瓜和生鲜等做成的什锦煎饼也非常不错。

description: Saemban Makguksu is the Seoul branch of Sambat Makguksu in Chuncheon. They use noodles made of 80% buckwheat flour. In addition to the popular representative dish Makguksu (buckwheat noodles in a spicy sauce), gamjajeon (Korean-style potato pancakes), and bossam (steamed pork with fresh unfermented kimchi) are also recommended. The assorted Korean-style pancakes, made with shrimp, king oyster mushrooms, meat and vegetable skewers, zucchini, and fish are good, too.
name: Saemban Makguksu

name_l10n.ja: セムパッ・マックッス

desc_l10n.en: Pungyoram has been in operation in the same location, specializing in beef loin and pork ribs for nearly 35 years. An order of diced beef loin also comes with a sampling of 3 or 4 pieces of chadolbagi (brisket). After you are done with the meat, they fry a generous serving of rice on the same hot plate, a delicious way to end your meal.
desc_l10n.ja: 35年間の歴史を持つ焼き肉店。トゥンシムチプ(牛ロースのお店)とも呼ばれるところで、ソトゥンシム(牛ロース)が専門。ソトゥンシムを注文すると、サービスとしてチャドルバギ(牛あばら肉の薄切り)も一緒に出される。最後の締めには鉄板で炒めたご飯がおすすめだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 한자리에서 30년이 넘게 운영하고 있는 고깃집.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店名原是“西大门店”，已有30年的悠久历史，是牛脊肉、烤猪肉等的专卖店。点牛脊肉的话，就会发现在切成块状的牛脊肉中，会有3~4块让客人试吃的霜降牛排。吃完肉后在铁板上炒饭，香味扑鼻，份量十足。

description: Pungyoram has been in operation in the same location, specializing in beef loin and pork ribs for nearly 35 years. An order of diced beef loin also comes with a sampling of 3 or 4 pieces of chadolbagi (brisket). After you are done with the meat, they fry a generous serving of rice on the same hot plate, a delicious way to end your meal.
name: Pungyoram

desc_l10n.en: Cafe Noshi is a dessert cafe that serves desserts in artisanal brassware. The brassware used at the cafe is made by master craftsmen at the Dubooja Workshop. Popular menu items are watermelon sherbet, persimmon-flavored ice cream, and red bean-flavored ice cream. The beautiful brassware makes the delicious menu items even more delectable. Visitors can purchase brassware at the cafe's gallery or online at the official Cafe Noshi website.
desc_l10n.ja: カフェ、ノックルッ カジロニ ノシでは、二父子工房の匠が作った真鍮の器にデザートが盛られて出てきます。代表メニューにはスイカシャーベットや熟柿あんなどがあります。真鍮の器に盛られたかわいらしくヘルシーなデザートはとてもおいしそう。真鍮の器は、カフェとオンライン際とで購入できます。
desc_l10n.ko: 카페 놋그릇 가지런히 놋이에서는 두부자공방의 장인이 만든 유기그릇에 디저트가 담겨 나옴
desc_l10n.zh: 这是一家咖啡馆兼艺廊，制做蕴含传统及匠人精神的铜碗，努力传承韩国传统文化。在一层的咖啡馆可品尝用铜碗盛装的各种饮品，在二层的艺廊可欣赏用铜碗盘装饰的餐桌摆设。电视剧《来自星星的你》的男女主角都敏俊（金秀贤饰）和千颂伊（全智贤饰）吃饭时用的餐具都出自这家店。

description: Cafe Noshi is a dessert cafe that serves desserts in artisanal brassware. The brassware used at the cafe is made by master craftsmen at the Dubooja Workshop. Popular menu items are watermelon sherbet, persimmon-flavored ice cream, and red bean-flavored ice cream. The beautiful brassware makes the delicious menu items even more delectable. Visitors can purchase brassware at the cafe's gallery or online at the official Cafe Noshi website.
name: Cafe Noshi

name_l10n.ja: ノックルッカジロンヒノッチ

desc_l10n.en: Those who like spicy foods should definitely try out this place. If the stir-fried octopus looks too spicy, try the Bacon Sausage, cooked on a hot plate with octopus broth. The jeon, egg roll, and clam soup are also recommended for countering the spiciness.
desc_l10n.ja: 辛い味が好きなら是非チャレンジしてみよう。ナッチポックム(たこのピリ辛炒め)が激辛なら、たこのスープにベーコンとソーセージを鉄板で煮て食べるベーコンソーセージがおすすめだ。パチョン(ねぎのチヂミ)、タルギャルマリ(韓国式卵焼き)、チョゲタン(貝スープ)など辛味を和らげてくれる各種メニューもある。
desc_l10n.ko: 매운 맛을 즐기는 사람이라면 도전해볼만한 낙지전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 推荐给嗜辣者来挑战！如果辣炒章鱼实在太辣的话，可以尝一尝加了章鱼高汤的铁板培根香肠。另外还提供葱饼、煎蛋卷和蛤蜊汤等可以缓解辣味的菜品。

description: Those who like spicy foods should definitely try out this place. If the stir-fried octopus looks too spicy, try the Bacon Sausage, cooked on a hot plate with octopus broth. The jeon, egg roll, and clam soup are also recommended for countering the spiciness.
name: Seorin Nakji

desc_l10n.en: ​Seogang Kkeopdegi is considered the best pork rinds place in Seoul. The restaurant specializes in pork dishes of all kinds and their roasted pork is also very popular. For K-pop fans, the restaurant is known as a favorite dining spot for the idolgroup BigBang; the group often ate here before their debut. It is a must-visit spot for BigBang fans.
desc_l10n.ja: ソウルで一番おいしい豚皮の店と言われるくらい有名な店であるソガンコプテギは、歌手のBIGBANGがデビュー前に常連になっていた店だとも言われています。いろいろな種類の豚肉と豚皮を専門に扱い、塩焼きも有名。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울에서 가장 맛있는 껍데기 집이라고 꼽힐 만큼 유명한 음식점인 서강껍데기는 가수 빅뱅이 데뷔 전 단골집으로 자주 찾던 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 专卖烤肉皮的餐厅，开店至今约20年。烤肉皮虽看起来陌生，感觉没什么味道，但将烤熟的肉皮放入口中的瞬间，香脆的味道立刻在口中散开。著名韩流明星Bigbang当练习生时常来这里，《Healing Camp》Bigbang篇也曾在此拍摄。快来这里感受一下Bigbang当年为梦想而努力的那段时光。

description: ​Seogang Kkeopdegi is considered the best pork rinds place in Seoul. The restaurant specializes in pork dishes of all kinds and their roasted pork is also very popular. For K-pop fans, the restaurant is known as a favorite dining spot for the idolgroup BigBang; the group often ate here before their debut. It is a must-visit spot for BigBang fans.
name: Seogang Kkeopdegi

desc_l10n.en: Some twenty years ago, Yeongdeokhoe Sikdang first introduced restaurant-goers in downtown Seoul to Makhoe (a few different kinds of sliced small fish) mixed with vegetables and vinegar chili paste. In the winter, the partly dried Pacific herring has anexquisite flavor, and Mulhoe (thinly sliced fish or squid seasoned with green onions, garlic, and chili pepper power) and hoedupbap (raw fish on rice) make for a good meal.
desc_l10n.ja: 刺身に野菜と酢入り唐辛子みそで和えたマクフェのお店。ソウル市内では元祖とも言えるお店だ。冬にはクァメギ(冬の潮風にサンマを干したもの)がおいしく、ほかにもムルフェ(水刺身)、フェトッパプ(刺身丼)なども人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 미주구리회로  막회의 원조 격인 된 20년 전통의 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 拥有20年历史的元祖酱拌生鱼片店，虫鲽生鱼片搭配蔬菜和醋辣酱搅拌后享用。冬天可以选择美味的秋刀鱼干，主餐方面则可以选择水生鱼片和生鱼片盖饭等。

description: Some twenty years ago, Yeongdeokhoe Sikdang first introduced restaurant-goers in downtown Seoul to Makhoe (a few different kinds of sliced small fish) mixed with vegetables and vinegar chili paste. In the winter, the partly dried Pacific herring has anexquisite flavor, and Mulhoe (thinly sliced fish or squid seasoned with green onions, garlic, and chili pepper power) and hoedupbap (raw fish on rice) make for a good meal.
name: Yeongdeokhoe Sikdang

name_l10n.ja: ヨンドク・フェ・シクタン

desc_l10n.en: Although the name of this restaurant translates to "famous loach soup", Somunnanjip Chueotang doesn't actually serve chueotang (loach soup). They have gained their reputation for haejangguk (a soup eaten as a remedy for hangover). They used to sell chueotang, but now, regardless of the name of the restaurant, they serve only haejangguk, a spicy soup made with dried napa cabbage. Here food is prepared without you needing to order; you only have to tell them how many people are in your group.
desc_l10n.ja: 店名に「チュオタン」とあるが、実際にはチュオタン（ドジョウのスープ)を置いていない。ウコジへジャングク(白菜や大根などの外の葉入りスープ)一つで約50年間も営業してきたところだ。以前はチュオタンもメニューにあったが、今は店の名前とは関係なく、ウコジへジャングクのみ。店に入ると注文しなくても、人数を伝えれば料理が出される。
desc_l10n.ko: 해장국 하나만으로 50여 년 동안 명성을 이어가는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是卖解酒汤的50年人气老店。以前虽然也卖过泥鳅汤，但现在只卖解酒汤——泡叶菜辣汤。进入店内后不需要点餐，只要告诉人数，服务员便会送上餐点。

description: Although the name of this restaurant translates to "famous loach soup", Somunnanjip Chueotang doesn't actually serve chueotang (loach soup). They have gained their reputation for haejangguk (a soup eaten as a remedy for hangover). They used to sell chueotang, but now, regardless of the name of the restaurant, they serve only haejangguk, a spicy soup made with dried napa cabbage. Here food is prepared without you needing to order; you only have to tell them how many people are in your group.
name: Somunnanjip Chueotang

name_l10n.ja: ソムンナンチプ・チュオタン(へジャングク)

desc_l10n.en: Yeongnak Golbaengi and the restaurant next door, Yeongdong Golbaengi, were the first to introduce golbaengi (freshwater snailsl) in Euljiro's famous Golbaengi Alley. Here, you'll find side dishes to have with beer, with generous portions at modest prices. Alongside the golbaengi, you'll also be served gyeranmari, a Korean omelet with chopped vegetables, which is also good.
desc_l10n.ja: ウルチロ(乙支路)のコルベンイ(つぶ貝の和え物)路地で隣のお店「ヨンドンコルベンイ」と元祖をして君臨しているお店。量が多いが値段は手頃だ。ビールのおつまみにぴったり。サービスでケランマリ(玉子焼き)が出されるのもうれしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 을지로 골뱅이 골목에서 옆집 영동골뱅이와 함께 원조집으로 군림하고 있는 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 位于乙支路田螺巷中，与隔壁的永东(译音)田螺并称元祖店家。价格实惠，份量十足，搭配啤酒更是锦上添花，附赠的蛋卷也相当美味。

description: Yeongnak Golbaengi and the restaurant next door, Yeongdong Golbaengi, were the first to introduce golbaengi (freshwater snailsl) in Euljiro's famous Golbaengi Alley. Here, you'll find side dishes to have with beer, with generous portions at modest prices. Alongside the golbaengi, you'll also be served gyeranmari, a Korean omelet with chopped vegetables, which is also good.
name: Yeongnak Golbaengi

name_l10n.ja: ヨンラク・コルベンイ

desc_l10n.en: Songpa Naru specializes in fish dishes, such as grilled hairtail, grilled mackerel, and braised sole. They offer gomchi haejangguk (a soup made with moray eel, commonly eaten as a remedy for hangovers), which is hard to find in other restaurants in Seoul, and the steamed sablefish also tastes fantastic. Even better are the delicious Haemulpajeon (seafood and green onion pancakes) and guljeon (oyster pancakes).
desc_l10n.ja: 魚料理を専門としているお店。カルチグイ(太刀魚焼き)やサバの塩焼き、カジャミジョリム(カレイの煮付け)などを味わえる。コムチヘジャングク(クサウオのスープ)などソウルではなかなか味わえない魚も扱っていて、特にウンデグチム(銀ダラの煮物)が珍味だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 갈치구이, 고등어구이, 가자미조림 등 생선 요리를 전문점.  곰치해장국 같이 서울에서 맛보기 어려운 생선도 취급, 은대구찜이 별미.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店专门提供烤白带鱼、烤鲭花鱼和炖高眼鲽等鱼料理，亦备有如海鳝解酒汤等，在首尔不易尝到的鱼类，其中蒸鲳鱼尤其美味，若是搭配海鲜煎饼或是牡蛎煎饼一起享用，则更加美味。

description: Songpa Naru specializes in fish dishes, such as grilled hairtail, grilled mackerel, and braised sole. They offer gomchi haejangguk (a soup made with moray eel, commonly eaten as a remedy for hangovers), which is hard to find in other restaurants in Seoul, and the steamed sablefish also tastes fantastic. Even better are the delicious Haemulpajeon (seafood and green onion pancakes) and guljeon (oyster pancakes).
name: Songpa Naru

desc_l10n.en: Ranju Ramien is famous for dosakmyeon, noodles made by holding the dough on the shoulder and slicing off long strips. The Szechuan dosakmyeon tastes a lot like jjamppong (spicy seafood noodle soup), and the Lanju dosakmyeon is topped with a sauce similar to black soybean paste. Also available are Korean dishes, such as kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup), bossam (steamed pork and kimchi), and shabu shabu (hot pot).
desc_l10n.ja: 小麦粉を練って、包丁でそぎ落としていく刀削麺で有名な中華料理店。四川刀削麺はピリ辛のちゃんぽん風、蘭州刀削麺はチャジャンミョン(ジャージャー麺)風だ。その他、きしめんやしゃぶしゃぶなど韓国風メニューもある。
desc_l10n.ko: 밀가루 반죽을 들고 칼로 썰어내는 도삭면으로 유명.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店以刀削面而闻名，刀削面的作法是将面团拿在手上，再以刀削成条状。四川刀削面的味道类似辣海鲜汤面，而兰州刀削面则会淋上类似炸酱的酱汁。此外，另备有刀切面、辛奇（kimchi）包猪肉、和涮涮锅等韩式料理。

description: Ranju Ramien is famous for dosakmyeon, noodles made by holding the dough on the shoulder and slicing off long strips. The Szechuan dosakmyeon tastes a lot like jjamppong (spicy seafood noodle soup), and the Lanju dosakmyeon is topped with a sauce similar to black soybean paste. Also available are Korean dishes, such as kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup), bossam (steamed pork and kimchi), and shabu shabu (hot pot).
name: Ranju Ramien

desc_l10n.en: There is no fixed menu at Sokcho Saengtaejip; what they offer depends on the available ingredients, so they decide on a new menu and prices every day. They typically serve saengtaetang (pollack soup) at lunchtime, and for dinner, you can enjoy hoe (sashimi) made from wild fish and maeuntang (spicy fish soup) prepared with various kinds of fish.
desc_l10n.ja: 固定メニューがなく、毎日仕入れる材料によって、その日の可能なメニューと価格が出される。お昼には主にセンテタン(タラ鍋)、夜には天然ものの刺身とメウンタン(ピリ辛海鮮鍋)を出す。臨淵水魚の刺身、サメの刺身、ニシン刺の和え物、カレイの刺身、クルマエビの刺身などの刺身類、そのほか多種類の魚を使ったメウンタンも味える。
desc_l10n.ko: 재료에 따라 그날 가능한 메뉴. 점심에는 주로 생태탕, 저녁에는 자연산 회와 매운탕.
desc_l10n.zh: 没有固定菜单，而是根据每日进的食材，将今日供应的菜单和价格抄在纸上通知顾客，午餐主要供应鲜明太鱼汤,晩餐主要供应野生生鱼片和辣鱼汤。在此可以品尝到花鲫鱼、灰貂鲛、鲱鱼、比目鱼、明虾等生鱼片，和方斑狮子鱼、鳍鱼、绒杜父鱼等鲜鱼滚煮的辣鱼汤。

description: There is no fixed menu at Sokcho Saengtaejip; what they offer depends on the available ingredients, so they decide on a new menu and prices every day. They typically serve saengtaetang (pollack soup) at lunchtime, and for dinner, you can enjoy hoe (sashimi) made from wild fish and maeuntang (spicy fish soup) prepared with various kinds of fish.
name: Sokcho Saengtaejip

name_l10n.ja: ソクチョ・センテチプ

desc_l10n.en: This place is the home of Korean-style rotisserie chicken. The outside of the chicken is crispy while the inside is moist and tender. Although good as a lunch or dinner, the chicken is also good as a side menu item for beer.
desc_l10n.ja: 電気焼きトンダッ(ローストチキン)の元祖とすべきレストラン。電気焼きで脂気を抜いたトンダッは、鶏の丸焼きは外はカリカリで香ばしく、中はあっさりして柔らかい。食事にも良いが、ビールと一緒に食べることをおすすめする。
desc_l10n.ko: 전기구이 통닭의 원조. 전기구이로 기름기를 뺀 통닭은 겉은 바삭하게 구워져 고소하고 속은 담백.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店可以称得上是烤钱鱼和烤全鸡的元祖了。电烤的鸡肉滤掉了多余的油脂，外酥里嫩，鲜嫩可口，不仅可以作为正餐，用来配啤酒也是妙不可言。

description: This place is the home of Korean-style rotisserie chicken. The outside of the chicken is crispy while the inside is moist and tender. Although good as a lunch or dinner, the chicken is also good as a side menu item for beer.
name: Yeongyang Center

desc_l10n.en: Songbaek Sikdang is famous for budae jjigae (spicy sausage stew). Their budae jjigae contains more ham and sausage than at most places, and they'll refill your rice and ramen noodles as often as you'd like. The addition of bean sprouts gives their budae jjigae a more refreshing taste. The kimchi, sausage, ham, and bacon fried with butter on the hot plate is especially delicious.
desc_l10n.ja: プデチゲ(ソーセージのピリ辛寄せ鍋)で有名なお店。ほかのプデチゲ食堂よりも、ハムとソーセージがたくさん入っており、ご飯、インスタントラーメンは何度もお替りが可能だ。もやしを入れることで、すっきりした味になる。バターを溶かした鉄板にソーセージ、ハム、ベーコンを酸っぱいキムチとともに炒め物メニューもおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 햄과 소시지가 푸짐하게 들어가 있는 부대찌개 맛집
desc_l10n.zh: 以部队锅出名的店家，不仅火腿和热狗的份量多于其他店家，白饭和泡面还可以无限续点，并且另外加入豆芽菜增加清爽的感觉。奶油在铁板上融化后，放入热狗、火腿、培根和新辛奇（kimchi）一起拌炒的方式，也别有一番风味。

description: Songbaek Sikdang is famous for budae jjigae (spicy sausage stew). Their budae jjigae contains more ham and sausage than at most places, and they'll refill your rice and ramen noodles as often as you'd like. The addition of bean sprouts gives their budae jjigae a more refreshing taste. The kimchi, sausage, ham, and bacon fried with butter on the hot plate is especially delicious.
name: Songbaek Sikdang

desc_l10n.en: The interior of Mugunghwa is decorated in a traditional Korean style, and a lot of foreign guests also visit the restaurant in the evening to listen to a live performance of Kayageum (a twelve-stringed Korean zither). All side dishes are neatly presented, and it's clear a lot of sincerity and care goes into making and serving the food.
desc_l10n.ja: プカンサン(北漢山)とソウル市内を一望できるロッテホテル38階に位置したモダンコリアンクジーン。朝鮮時代の貴族階級であるヤンバン(両班)が食べていたという班家料理をモダンにアレンジした料理を味わうことができる。ワインは韓国料理と合う43種類のコレクションを持ち、また、ティーソムリエによる数十種類の高級茶も堪能できる。
desc_l10n.ko: 한국적인 감각을 살린 모던한 디자인에 한국 정통 반가 음식을 한정식으로 새롭게 해석
desc_l10n.zh: 无穷花餐厅位于首尔乐天酒店38楼，能一眼尽览北汉山和首尔市内的美景。本店提供韩国传统的”班家饮食”，将传统的韩式套餐进行了再现，让顾客有种全新的感受。本店有着蕴含东方魅力的室内装修和传达韩国传统美的餐具。除了美味的韩食以外，还有43种红酒供顾客挑选。专业茶艺师还将为顾客亲自沏上由茶界第28号名人金东坤挑选的10余种名贵传统茶 。

description: The interior of Mugunghwa is decorated in a traditional Korean style, and a lot of foreign guests also visit the restaurant in the evening to listen to a live performance of Kayageum (a twelve-stringed Korean zither). All side dishes are neatly presented, and it's clear a lot of sincerity and care goes into making and serving the food.
name: Mugunghwa

desc_l10n.en: Yeongchunok is famous for their steamed ox tail, gomtang (a thin soup with a rich flavor from simmering ox bones), and haejangguk (a soup of congealed ox blood, napa cabbage, and vegetables in a hearty beef broth). Starting at 3 p.m., they serve their popular ddagwi, an earthenware bowl filled with meaty bones that have been boiled to prepare haejangguk broth. However, only 40 orders are available each day, so they quickly sell out.
desc_l10n.ja: 創業から60年が経つお店で、コリゴムタン(テールスープ)、コムタン(牛肉煮込みスープ)が有名な代表メニュー。骨付きの肉が入ったへジャンクク(二日酔いによいとされるスープ)も人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 소꼬리찜, 곰탕, 해장국이 유명한 집. 해방 직후 종로통 골목에서 시작함
desc_l10n.zh: 以蒸牛尾巴、牛骨汤、解酒汤而闻名的店家，从解放后便在钟路营业至今。牛骨肉是用熬煮解酒汤高汤的牛骨头，而且份量十足。所以每天下午3点开始卖牛骨肉，一天限量40份左右，不一会就被销售一空。

description: Yeongchunok is famous for their steamed ox tail, gomtang (a thin soup with a rich flavor from simmering ox bones), and haejangguk (a soup of congealed ox blood, napa cabbage, and vegetables in a hearty beef broth). Starting at 3 p.m., they serve their popular ddagwi, an earthenware bowl filled with meaty bones that have been boiled to prepare haejangguk broth. However, only 40 orders are available each day, so they quickly sell out.
name: Yeongchunok

desc_l10n.en: The specialty of Yennal Myeongdong Budaejjigae is a dish called budae jjigae, which is made with pork, ham, and sausage. Serving sizes are big and the broth is fantastic. This restaurant is also known for its samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly).
desc_l10n.ja: サムギョプサル(豚の三枚肉焼き)、ハム、ソーセージと一緒に入れて作るピリ辛の鍋、プデチゲがおいしいと評判のお店。辛くてさっぱり味のチゲ鍋はとてもボリュームがある。プデチゲだけでなく、サムギョプサルを焼いて食べてもおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 생삽겹을 햄, 소시지와 함께  얼큰하고 시원한 부대찌개가 유명한 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 放入新鲜五花肉、火腿和香肠一起煮的韩式乱炖是店家的美味秘诀，不仅汤汁香辣爽口，而且份量十足。虽然该店是以部队锅而闻名，但五花肉也相当美味。

description: The specialty of Yennal Myeongdong Budaejjigae is a dish called budae jjigae, which is made with pork, ham, and sausage. Serving sizes are big and the broth is fantastic. This restaurant is also known for its samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly).
name: Myeongdong Budae Jjigae

name_l10n.zh: 明洞部队火锅(Myeongdong Budae Jjigae)

desc_l10n.en: Osu specializes in tofu, and most of the dishes here are made with nutritious homemade tofu made of black sesame seeds and black soybeans. The popular favorite of Osu is heukdububossam, steamed pork and black sesame tofu that is eaten with rice served in a hot stone bowl and wrapped in seaweed and napa cabbage.
desc_l10n.ja: 黒ゴマと豆で作った健康食豆腐を使った料理が主流。温かい石焼釜に蒸し豚と黒豆腐をのせて海苔と白菜の葉で包むフッドゥブポッサムが絶品だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 검정깨와 콩을 이용해 손수 만든 건강식 두부를 이용한 요리.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店主要提供健康的豆腐料理，店家使用的豆腐是以黑芝麻和黄豆手工制成。用海苔和生菜包上热腾腾的石锅饭、猪肉片和黑豆腐，大快朵颐，风味俱佳。

description: Osu specializes in tofu, and most of the dishes here are made with nutritious homemade tofu made of black sesame seeds and black soybeans. The popular favorite of Osu is heukdububossam, steamed pork and black sesame tofu that is eaten with rice served in a hot stone bowl and wrapped in seaweed and napa cabbage.
name: Osuheugdubu

desc_l10n.en: Soseonjae offers healthy dishes prepared with wild plants. Their full-course set menu includes root vegetables with leafy green wraps, dandelion and wild herb salad, wild herb vegetable pancakes, boiled pork with soy-sauce kimchi wraps, stuffed tofu, plus chicken salad and grilled Patagonia toothfish at additional cost. This small restaurant, transformed from a hanok (traditional Korean house), has only about ten tables.
desc_l10n.ja: 野草を使った健康メニューが味わえるお店。定食コースには、根菜包み(クンチェサム)、ミンドゥレワヤソンチョサラダ(たんぽぽと野草サラダ)、ジョン(野草をを卵・小麦粉を付けて焼いたもの)などが出される。コースによってはタッコギサラダ(鶏肉サラダ)やメログイ(むつ焼き)なども付いてくる。店内は韓国伝統家屋を改造しており、10脚のテーブルのみの小さな空間だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 야생초를 사용한 건강 식단을 맛볼 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可享用到以野菜健康料理。正式套餐包括芹菜卷、蒲公英、野菜沙拉、野菜煎饼、酱辛奇（kimchi）卷、豆腐夹心和主食等料理。另外，依据价格的高低，也会额外增加鸡肉沙拉或烤圆鳕等。此店是利用传统韩屋改建而成，只有10张餐桌

description: Soseonjae offers healthy dishes prepared with wild plants. Their full-course set menu includes root vegetables with leafy green wraps, dandelion and wild herb salad, wild herb vegetable pancakes, boiled pork with soy-sauce kimchi wraps, stuffed tofu, plus chicken salad and grilled Patagonia toothfish at additional cost. This small restaurant, transformed from a hanok (traditional Korean house), has only about ten tables.
name: Soseonjae

desc_l10n.en: This place is popular for its Japanese style stone pot rice and udon noodles. There are three varieties of stone pot rice, of which the Jogeum Stone Pot Rice with seafood is the most popular. Dori King also has a clean Japanese style interior.
desc_l10n.ja: 和風釜飯とうどんで有名なレストラン。野菜、きのこ、銀杏などが入った3種類の釜飯のうち、海鮮をのせた鳥金釜飯が一番有名で、すっきりした和風インテリアと静かな雰囲気が特徴だ
desc_l10n.ko: 일본식 솥밥과 우동으로 유명한 일식집.
desc_l10n.zh: 因日式拌饭和乌冬面而闻名的店家。加入了蔬菜、蘑菇和银杏的拌饭共有3种口味，其中以海鲜味的“鸟金拌饭”最具人气。简约利落的日式装潢和宁静的氛围别具特色。

description: This place is popular for its Japanese style stone pot rice and udon noodles. There are three varieties of stone pot rice, of which the Jogeum Stone Pot Rice with seafood is the most popular. Dori King also has a clean Japanese style interior.
name: Jogeum

desc_l10n.en: Ojang-dong Hamheung Naengmyeon is a naengmyeon restaurant started by President Han Hye-seon in Ojang-dong after the Korean War. It became the place that introduced Hamheung Naengmyeon—a dish enjoyed by people from Hamgyong Province—to the entire country. Since the 1970s, many Hamheung-style naengmyeon restaurants in Ojang-dong have disappeared due to redevelopment and changing times. However, Ojang-dong Hamheung Naengmyeon has maintained its presence to this day by creating an appealing naengmyeon that deepens the flavor of thin noodles with spicy sauce and fresh raw fish toppings, adding savoriness through the harmonious blend of sugar, sesame oil, and vinegar.
desc_l10n.ja: オジャンドン咸興冷麺は、ハン・ヘソン社長が韓国戦争後にオジャンドンで始めた冷麺店で、咸鏡道の人々が好んで食べていた咸興冷麺を全国に広めた店です。1970年代以降、再開発や時代の流れにより、オジャンドンにあった多くの咸興式冷麺店が消えてしまいましたが、オジャンドン咸興冷麺は、ピリ辛のソース、新鮮な刺身のトッピング、細い麺の深い味わいに加え、砂糖、ごま油、酢の調和で旨味を加えた魅力的な冷麺を作り続け、現在もその地位を守っています。
desc_l10n.ko: 매콤 새콤한 회무침이 별미인 함흥냉면
desc_l10n.zh: 五壮洞咸兴冷面是由韩慧善社长在朝鲜战争后于五壮洞创办的冷面店，将咸镜道人们喜爱的咸兴冷面推广至全国。自1970年代以来，由于重建和时代变迁，许多位于五壮洞的咸兴冷面店已消失，但五壮洞咸兴冷面通过辛辣的酱料、新鲜的生鱼片配料、细面条的深厚味道，以及糖、香油和醋的完美结合，创造了令人垂涎的冷面，至今仍然屹立不倒。

description: Ojang-dong Hamheung Naengmyeon is a naengmyeon restaurant started by President Han Hye-seon in Ojang-dong after the Korean War. It became the place that introduced Hamheung Naengmyeon—a dish enjoyed by people from Hamgyong Province—to the entire country. Since the 1970s, many Hamheung-style naengmyeon restaurants in Ojang-dong have disappeared due to redevelopment and changing times. However, Ojang-dong Hamheung Naengmyeon has maintained its presence to this day by creating an appealing naengmyeon that deepens the flavor of thin noodles with spicy sauce and fresh raw fish toppings, adding savoriness through the harmonious blend of sugar, sesame oil, and vinegar.
name: Ojangdong Hamheung Naengmyeon

name_l10n.ja: オジャンドン咸興冷麺

desc_l10n.en: Pulhyanggi Sonkalguksu has been serving up kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup) for 20 years. The noodles here are very soft and chewy. Another recommended dish is their haemulpajeon (seafood and green onion pancakes), loaded with shrimp and clams. Also excellent is the bossam, thinly-sliced steamed pork with napa cabbage wraps served with wrapped kimchi that is made fresh daily.
desc_l10n.ja: 20年前に創業した手打ちきしめんのお店。麺はコシがあり、のどごしもよい。海老と貝がたっぷり入った海鮮とねぎのチヂミもおすすめメニューだ。一緒に出されるキムチがおいしい。ポッサム(ゆで豚肉の葉野菜包み)も絶品。
desc_l10n.ko: 20여 년 전통의 손칼국수 집. 손으로 직접 썰어서 만든 칼국수 면이 부들부들하면서도 쫄깃.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为拥有20多年传统的手工刀切面店，以手工切制而成的面条不仅弹牙又有嚼劲。加入大量虾肉和蛤蜊肉的海鲜煎饼亦为推荐料理，而搭配每日新鲜腌渍的泡菜一起享用的泡菜包猪肉，也别有一番风味。

description: Pulhyanggi Sonkalguksu has been serving up kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup) for 20 years. The noodles here are very soft and chewy. Another recommended dish is their haemulpajeon (seafood and green onion pancakes), loaded with shrimp and clams. Also excellent is the bossam, thinly-sliced steamed pork with napa cabbage wraps served with wrapped kimchi that is made fresh daily.
name: Pulhyanggi Sonkalguksu

name_l10n.ja: プルヒャンギ・ソンカルクグス

desc_l10n.en: At Yeoksamdong Bugeojip, you can enjoy mildly spicy bukeojjim (seasoned simmered dried pollack). At lunch time, they only serve bukeojjim with rice and side dishes. Many people come to cure their hangover by having bukeojjim and soup.
desc_l10n.ja: ピリ辛味のプゴチム(干しスケトウダラの蒸し物)がおいしいお店。お昼はプゴチム(干しスケトウダラの蒸し物)定食のみだ。他と比べ、汁が多いため、酔い覚ましとして人気。
desc_l10n.ko: 맵고 칼칼한 북어찜을 맛볼 수 있는 곳. 점심때는 북어찜 백반. 국물이 많은 북어찜 스타일로, 해장용.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到辣劲十足的蒸干明太鱼，午餐时段仅提供蒸干明太鱼白饭定食。此店的蒸干明太鱼汤汁丰富，因此也有许多人会拿它来解酒。

description: At Yeoksamdong Bugeojip, you can enjoy mildly spicy bukeojjim (seasoned simmered dried pollack). At lunch time, they only serve bukeojjim with rice and side dishes. Many people come to cure their hangover by having bukeojjim and soup.
name: Yeoksamdong Bugeojip

name_l10n.ja: ヨクサムドン・ブゴチブ
name_l10n.zh: 译三洞干明太鱼家(Yeoksamdong Bugeojip)

desc_l10n.en: Cafe Rosso is a quiet and beautiful cafe in Samcheong-dong with a quiet and luxe atmosphere. The cafe has a distinctive red sign. Cafe Rosso serves Brazil Fazenda drip coffee and delicious cakes. The cafe is well-known for its quality dessertsand visitors should also check out the cafe's wine menu.
desc_l10n.ja: カフェロッソはサムチョンドン(三清洞)にあるかわいい静かなカフェで、異国情緒が漂う。赤い色がポイントの看板がこのカフェのシンボル。ブラジルファゼンダのドリップコーヒーと甘いケーキがおいしい。静かにコーヒーやお茶を飲みながらデザートを楽しみたい人にはおすすめ。ワインも販売しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 카페 로쏘는 삼청동에 위치한 예쁘고 조용한 카페로 이국적인 분위기.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此品尝店家亲自烘培的香浓咖啡和甜甜的蛋糕，享受甜蜜的休闲时光。咖啡店呈现出一派悠闲怀旧的氛围，据说店内的小摆设和家具都出自店主之手。自韩流明星朴有天在这里接受采访后，众多粉丝蜂拥而至。甚至有些粉丝还将从三清洞到Cafe Rosso的步道命名为“朴有天朝圣之路”。在点餐记得要说“请用朴有天用过的杯子为我盛饮料！”

description: Cafe Rosso is a quiet and beautiful cafe in Samcheong-dong with a quiet and luxe atmosphere. The cafe has a distinctive red sign. Cafe Rosso serves Brazil Fazenda drip coffee and delicious cakes. The cafe is well-known for its quality dessertsand visitors should also check out the cafe's wine menu.
name: Café Rosso

desc_l10n.en: Omokjib serves pork hocks with homemade soybean paste. It is a great restaurant to visit in family units thanks to its wholesome and welcoming atmosphere. Omokjib pork hocks are known for its excellent texture, which is appreciated by all guests regardlessof age and gender. All pork hocks come with a seafood casserole.
desc_l10n.ja: 手作りの味噌つきの、健康によい豚足がイチオシメニューです。家族連れで食事を楽しむのに適しており、素朴で落ち着いたインテリアが温かい雰囲気を醸し出しています。オモクジプは温かい豚足をコンセプトに、柔らかさとモチモチ感を同時に味わえる、老若男女問わず人気が高いメニューです。代表的なメニューの豚足を注文すると海鮮鍋が無料に。
desc_l10n.ko: < 별에서 온 그대>의 천송이(전지현)가 늙지 않는 도민준(김수현)을 의식해 피부 관리 차원에서 찾아간 유명 족발집.
desc_l10n.zh: 主要经营自家熬制的大酱和炖煮的猪蹄，适合全家人一起享用，朴素而安逸的室内设计充满温馨气息。热腾腾的猪蹄软嫩而耐嚼，深受男女老少的喜爱。点猪蹄就免费赠送海鲜汤锅。

description: Omokjib serves pork hocks with homemade soybean paste. It is a great restaurant to visit in family units thanks to its wholesome and welcoming atmosphere. Omokjib pork hocks are known for its excellent texture, which is appreciated by all guests regardlessof age and gender. All pork hocks come with a seafood casserole.
name: Omokjib

desc_l10n.en: Wan Chai is a Chinese restaurant in the Sinchon area that is rather small, but it is famous enough that you'll see long lines in the alley to get into this restaurant in the evening. Their popularity is due to their unique dishes and low prices. The Hong Kong-style spicy mussel dishes are famous, and their spicy Szechuan-style dishes are very good as well.
desc_l10n.ja: 店の規模は小さいが、夕方になると路地まで並ぶシンチョン(新村)では有名な中華レストラン。独自のメニューと手ごろな価格が人気の秘訣。少し辛い香港式の貝料理が有名だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 저녁 무렵이면 골목까지 줄을 서는 신촌 일대에서는 유명한 중식당.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为新村附近知名的中华料理店。虽然店内规模不大，但一到晚餐时间，整条巷子便会充满排队的人潮。这里菜色特别价格实惠，尤其受到顾客青睐。招牌料理为香辣的港式淡菜和四川的辣味料理。

description: Wan Chai is a Chinese restaurant in the Sinchon area that is rather small, but it is famous enough that you'll see long lines in the alley to get into this restaurant in the evening. Their popularity is due to their unique dishes and low prices. The Hong Kong-style spicy mussel dishes are famous, and their spicy Szechuan-style dishes are very good as well.
name: Wan Chai

desc_l10n.en: The owner of Jineo has been in the tuna business for about 30 years, earning himself the moniker, "The Tuna Doctor". If you sit at the counter, you can get detailed descriptions of the various tuna varieties as you taste them. The quality is quite satisfactory for the price. Since there are only seven places at the counter, reservations are necessary for those seats.
desc_l10n.ja: まぐろとともに30年生きてきた同店の社長は、自他共に認めるまぐろ博士。カウンターで注文をすれば詳しい説明と共に色々なまぐろを味わえる。価格費満足度も高い。カウンター席は7つしかないので予約が必要。
desc_l10n.ko: 참치와 더불어 30여 년을 살아온 사장은 자타 공인 참치 박사.
desc_l10n.zh: 老板与与金枪鱼打了30年的交道，被公认为金枪鱼博士。在柜台点餐的时候，老板会作详细的说明，顾客在此能品尝到各种金枪鱼。该店的食物物超所值。店内只有7个座位，所以需要预定。

description: The owner of Jineo has been in the tuna business for about 30 years, earning himself the moniker, "The Tuna Doctor". If you sit at the counter, you can get detailed descriptions of the various tuna varieties as you taste them. The quality is quite satisfactory for the price. Since there are only seven places at the counter, reservations are necessary for those seats.
name: Jineo

desc_l10n.en: Koreans love their Galchi Jorim. Galchi(Cutlassfish) is a long, thin fish that tastes great when it is boiled in a spicy mixture of kelp and mixed vegetables. Wangseong Sikdang is famous for this dish, so expect long lines at lunch time. It is located in a narrow alley in Namdaemun Market.
desc_l10n.ja: トゥッベギカルチジョリム(太刀魚のピリ辛土鍋煮)で有名なお店。南大門(ナンデムン)市場の中の狭い路地にあるため、初めての人は事前に場所を確認してから行くのがおすすめだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 경상도 풍의 뚝배기 갈치조림으로 유명한 집
desc_l10n.zh: 以庆尚道风味的砂锅炖带鱼而闻名的店家，也是从南大门市场带鱼美食街中衍生出来的始祖店家。午餐时间总是大排长龙，最有名的菜便是在砂锅中炖煮的白带鱼。由于店家位于南大门市场的狭小巷弄内，出发前请事先确认位置。

description: Koreans love their Galchi Jorim. Galchi(Cutlassfish) is a long, thin fish that tastes great when it is boiled in a spicy mixture of kelp and mixed vegetables. Wangseong Sikdang is famous for this dish, so expect long lines at lunch time. It is located in a narrow alley in Namdaemun Market.
name: Wangseong Sikdang

desc_l10n.en: This place is famous for its noodles in cold soybean soup (kongguksu), one of Korea’s favorite summer meals. The dough for the noodles here is also noteworthy for containing assorted nuts and potato starch. Thick and savory kongguksu is popular in the summer while winter is the season for kimchi fried-rice. Expect to wait for a table during peak hours.
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国人の夏の珍味・コンクッス(豆乳素麺)で有名なレストラン。小麦粉にジャガイモ粉、ナッツなどを入れて作った麺を使用する。夏には、濃くて香ばしいコンクッスが人気で、冬にはキムチポックムパッ(キムチチャーハン)が人気だ。常連客が多く、いつも行列ができている。
desc_l10n.ko: 한국인들의 여름별미인 콩국수로 유명한 음식점.
desc_l10n.zh: 以韩国夏季风味豆浆面而闻名的店家。面条是以面粉加上土豆淀粉和各类坚果做成的。香浓的豆浆面是夏季的主角，而到了冬天，则由辛奇（kimchi）炒饭赢得头筹。本店的老顾客极多，经常需要排队等待。

description: This place is famous for its noodles in cold soybean soup (kongguksu), one of Korea’s favorite summer meals. The dough for the noodles here is also noteworthy for containing assorted nuts and potato starch. Thick and savory kongguksu is popular in the summer while winter is the season for kimchi fried-rice. Expect to wait for a table during peak hours.
name: Jinju Hoegwan

name_l10n.ja: チンジュ・フェグァン

desc_l10n.en: This Japanese-style bar offers a variety of side dishes and Japanese sake. At lunch time, they serve Nagasaki-style jjamppong, a seafood and vegetable soup made with a thick broth from simmered pork leg bones. The noodles, which are a little thicker than normal, and the savoury broth are what make this jjamppong so popular. Be sure to also try the homemade-style Japanese side dishes and sashimi.
desc_l10n.ja: 日本式居酒屋。素朴な日本の家庭風おつまみと刺身を味わえる。価格だけを聞くと少し高いと感じるが、ここの素材の良さを知っている人は安いと口をそろえるほど、クオリティに自信を持ったお店だ。豚骨をじっくり煮込んでだし汁をとり、海鮮と新鮮な野菜が入った長崎チャンポンはスープが絶品。一番人気のメニューだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 일본 가정식과 사시미, 안주류와 일본 사케를 맛볼 수 있는 일식집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店是一家日式酒家，在此可品尝到各式各样的下酒菜和日本清酒。午间供应的长崎辣汤面是在炖好的猪筛骨汤里放入海鲜和新鲜的蔬菜熬制而成的。在此还可以品尝到日式家庭风味的下酒菜和生鱼片。

description: This Japanese-style bar offers a variety of side dishes and Japanese sake. At lunch time, they serve Nagasaki-style jjamppong, a seafood and vegetable soup made with a thick broth from simmered pork leg bones. The noodles, which are a little thicker than normal, and the savoury broth are what make this jjamppong so popular. Be sure to also try the homemade-style Japanese side dishes and sashimi.
name: Tsukushi

desc_l10n.en: Urimil Guksi specializes in Sagol Kalguksu, handmade knife-cut noodle soup. The 'sagol' broth is made with four leg bones of Korean-bred cows for high quality taste, and the noodles, which are thinner than regular kalguksu, have a nice chewy texture. Kalguksu is best enjoyed garnished with beef brisket and zucchini and topped with spicy seasonings.
desc_l10n.ja: カルクグス(韓国式うどん)の専門店。牛骨でとったスープの味が最高だ。一般的なカルクグスよりも、麺にコシがあり、スープとの相性は抜群。牛の胸肉とカボチャが入ったカルクグスの中に、辛く味付けされた薬味のヤンニョムジャンを入れて食べる。
desc_l10n.ko: 사골칼국수 전문점으로, 한우 사골로 우려낸 국물 맛이 일품.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是牛骨刀切面专门店。用韩牛筛骨熬制的汤汁，味道非常鲜美。比一般刀切面更有韧性。放有牛肉和嫩南瓜的刀切面，再加上微辣的调味酱食用。 ​

description: Urimil Guksi specializes in Sagol Kalguksu, handmade knife-cut noodle soup. The 'sagol' broth is made with four leg bones of Korean-bred cows for high quality taste, and the noodles, which are thinner than regular kalguksu, have a nice chewy texture. Kalguksu is best enjoyed garnished with beef brisket and zucchini and topped with spicy seasonings.
name: Urimil Guksi

desc_l10n.en: At Chakraa you can enjoy tandoori chicken, lamb kebabs, and five different types of curry with an unlimited amount of naan bread and white rice. You can also try the pan-fried uttapam, and dosa (South Indian crepes made from rice and black lentils). Anotherpopular dish is the crispy sambar vada. A lunch buffet is also available.
desc_l10n.ja: タンドリーチキン、羊肉のケバブ、5種類のカレーと何度でもおかわりが自由のナンと米が味わえる。ウタパム(インド風お好み焼き)とトサ(甘くない薄焼きパンケーキ)をインド式で食べられる。サラリーマンのためのランチバイキングも用意されている 。
desc_l10n.ko: 탄두리 치킨, 양고기 케밥, 5가지 종류의 커리등 인도 정통식.
desc_l10n.zh: 在这里可以吃到正宗的印度料理鸡、土耳其羊肉串烧、5种咖哩和可无限续的印度烤饼和米饭，像绿豆饼般在平底锅上煎烤来吃的印度烤饼(uttapam)和tosa。有着脆实口感的Sambal Banda也是人气单品，还有专为上班族准备的自助午餐。

description: At Chakraa you can enjoy tandoori chicken, lamb kebabs, and five different types of curry with an unlimited amount of naan bread and white rice. You can also try the pan-fried uttapam, and dosa (South Indian crepes made from rice and black lentils). Anotherpopular dish is the crispy sambar vada. A lunch buffet is also available.
name: Chakraa

desc_l10n.en: If you like spicy foods, this is the place for you. The stir-fried octopus here is some of the spiciest you’ll find in Seoul. To help fan the flames, the octopus is served with bean sprouts and clam soup. At night, office workers fill the restaurant to unwind after a hard day’s work.
desc_l10n.ja: 辛い味が好きな人は是非食べてみて欲しい。ここのナッチポックム(たこの 甘辛炒め)は激辛と評判で、食べた後口の中がヒリヒリするので、辛さを和 らげるために、コンナムル(大豆もやし)とチョゲタン(貝スープ)を一緒に食べる。夕方になると、近くの会社員が食事や軽く一杯するために訪れる。
desc_l10n.ko: 감칠맛 나는 매운 낙지볶음. 매운 맛을 즐기는 사람이라면 꼭 한번 가봐야할 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 强烈推荐给各位嗜辣者！据说这里的辣炒章鱼辣到极致，吃过之后口舌会被完全麻痹！一般配上豆芽汤或蛤蜊汤来缓解辣味。每到傍晚，附近的上班族就会聚在店中享用晚餐或是轻松地喝上一杯。

description: If you like spicy foods, this is the place for you. The stir-fried octopus here is some of the spiciest you’ll find in Seoul. To help fan the flames, the octopus is served with bean sprouts and clam soup. At night, office workers fill the restaurant to unwind after a hard day’s work.
name: Ujeong Nakji

desc_l10n.en: Hangang Saengtae is famous for its spicy fresh pollack soup made with a broth from 14 different kinds of seafood, including blue crab and lobster. The soup is spiced up with chili paste, red pepper, and garlic. Besides pollack stew, samgyeopsal (grilledpork belly) is also famous. Reservations for lunch are advisable as the place gets quite busy.
desc_l10n.ja: 古くからある有名なお店。ワタリガニやコウライエビなど14の海鮮でとっただし汁にコチュジャン(唐辛子味噌)を入れたセンテメウンタン(ピリ辛生スケトウダラ鍋)が人気だ。その他、サムギョプサル(豚の三枚肉の焼肉)もおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 여러 가지 해물로 육수를 끓여낸 생태 매운탕이 유명한 곳. 삼겹살도 유명.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的鲜明太鱼汤用多种海鲜熬制而成，远近闻名。汤里加入辣椒酱、辣椒面和大蒜熬成辣味明太鱼汤。除了明太鱼锅以外，五花肉也非常有名。由于客人较多，午餐时段也需要预约。

description: Hangang Saengtae is famous for its spicy fresh pollack soup made with a broth from 14 different kinds of seafood, including blue crab and lobster. The soup is spiced up with chili paste, red pepper, and garlic. Besides pollack stew, samgyeopsal (grilledpork belly) is also famous. Reservations for lunch are advisable as the place gets quite busy.
name: Hangangjip

desc_l10n.en: Hyehwa Kalguksu is a kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup) restaurant that has been a fixture of Hyehwa-dong for almost 30 years and faithfully maintains its long-standing traditions. To their four-leg broth, they add beef brisket and simmer it for24 hours, so the finely-sliced noodles that they serve in it taste fantastic. Besides kalguksu they also serve thinly-sliced bulgogi-style beef flame broiled in a grid iron, fish tempura, and octopus.
desc_l10n.ja: 営業から30年が経つ恵化洞（ヘファドン)のカルグクス(韓国式うどん)店。昔ながら味を守り続けている。牛骨スープと羊肉を茹でたスープを交ぜたあと24時間煮込む。そのスープと細い麺が絶妙にからまったカルグクスは絶品。カルグクスの他にも、薄く切った牛肉に味付けをし、網の上で焼くパチャクプルコギ(網焼きプルゴギ)もおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 30년 가까이 운영되고 있는 혜화동 토박이 음식점으로, 옛날 그대로의 모습을 간직하고 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 惠化洞元老级的料理店，拥有近30年的历史，店内依旧保持着以前的模样。店家使用的是在牛大骨高汤中加入煮过牛排骨的高汤后，熬煮24小时的浓郁高汤，再加上切细的刀切面条，令人垂涎三尺。除刀切面外，还提供烤牛肉、酥炸鱼和章鱼等。

description: Hyehwa Kalguksu is a kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup) restaurant that has been a fixture of Hyehwa-dong for almost 30 years and faithfully maintains its long-standing traditions. To their four-leg broth, they add beef brisket and simmer it for24 hours, so the finely-sliced noodles that they serve in it taste fantastic. Besides kalguksu they also serve thinly-sliced bulgogi-style beef flame broiled in a grid iron, fish tempura, and octopus.
name: Hyehwa Kalguksu

desc_l10n.en: This is the Seorae Village branch of Ceci Cela, the main branch of which is in front of Dosan Park. This café offers mainly waffles. With its bright and cheerful Mediterranean-style interior, this cafe is a good place to enjoy weekend brunch. They also offer easy wireless Internet access.
desc_l10n.ja: トサン(島山)公園前に位置したセシセラのトサン(島山)公園店。ベルギー風ワッフルをメインメニューとしたブランチを楽しみに週末は多くの人が訪れている。地中海風のインテリアが明るい印象でおしゃれな雰囲気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 도산공원 앞에 위치한 세시 셀라의 분점.  벨기에식 와플이 주 메뉴.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为位于岛山公园前的Ceci Cela在Seorae Maeul的分店，主要提供比利时松饼。欧洲地中海风的室内装潢，使店内充满活泼的气息，因此亦很适合在此享用周末早午餐。店家还免费提供无线上网。

description: This is the Seorae Village branch of Ceci Cela, the main branch of which is in front of Dosan Park. This café offers mainly waffles. With its bright and cheerful Mediterranean-style interior, this cafe is a good place to enjoy weekend brunch. They also offer easy wireless Internet access.
name: Ceci Cela (Seorae Village branch)

desc_l10n.en: Yurim Myeon is a noodle specialty shop that opened in 1960 and is now operated by the third generation. Located in Seosomun-dong, it is a place where you can feel the tradition and history of Korea. At the time of its opening, when flour came in as relief supplies, they started a noodle shop where many people could enjoy a meal at an affordable price. Now, with the know-how accumulated over generations, it has grown into a shop loved by many. To achieve a chewy texture, the noodles are aged in advance, and as soon as an order comes in, they are immediately boiled. The signature dish is bibim buckwheat noodles, where the chewy noodles and sweet and spicy sauce harmonize, and fresh toppings and a sprinkle of sesame enhance the flavor.
desc_l10n.ja: ユンリムミョンは1960年に開業して3代目になる麺専門店で、西小門洞(ソソムンドン:서소문동)に位置し、韓国の伝統と歴史を感じることができるお店です。開業当時、救援物資として小麦粉が入ったため、多くの人が安い値段で一食を楽しめる麺屋を始め、今では家族代々培ってきたノウハウで多くの人に愛される店に成長しました。モチモチとした食感のために麺をあらかじめ熟成させておき、注文が入るとすぐに茹でて麺を作る。代表的なメニューはビビンソバで、モチモチした麺と甘酸っぱいタレが調和し、新鮮なゴマと香ばしいピーナッツの粉が風味を引き立てます。
desc_l10n.ko: 신안 소금과 봉평 메밀만을 사용해 맛있는 메밀국수
desc_l10n.zh: 儒林面馆 面馆是一家第三代面馆，开业于 1960 年，位于可以感受到韩国传统和历史的西小门洞。当面粉作为救济品被运到这里时，许多人开始制作面条，以享受廉价美食。为了保证面条的嚼劲，面条都是预先老化的，点餐后立即煮熟。招牌菜是拌荞麦面，它将有嚼劲的面条与酸甜的调味料结合在一起，再配上新鲜的配菜和坚果花生粉。

description: Yurim Myeon is a noodle specialty shop that opened in 1960 and is now operated by the third generation. Located in Seosomun-dong, it is a place where you can feel the tradition and history of Korea. At the time of its opening, when flour came in as relief supplies, they started a noodle shop where many people could enjoy a meal at an affordable price. Now, with the know-how accumulated over generations, it has grown into a shop loved by many. To achieve a chewy texture, the noodles are aged in advance, and as soon as an order comes in, they are immediately boiled. The signature dish is bibim buckwheat noodles, where the chewy noodles and sweet and spicy sauce harmonize, and fresh toppings and a sprinkle of sesame enhance the flavor.
name: Yurimmyeon

desc_l10n.en: Even though Andongjang is one of the oldest Chinese restaurants in Seoul, it has maintained the same classic tastes since 1948. It is famous for their delicious guljjamppong (spicy noodle soup with oysters), and you can choose either the mild or the spicy variation according to your taste.
desc_l10n.ja: ソウルで最も古い中華料理店で、1948年から伝統の味を守っている。クルチャンポン(牡蠣チャンポン)がおいしいことで有名。あっさり味とピリ辛味のクルチャンポンがあり、好みによって選べる。
desc_l10n.ko: 현존하는 가장 오래된 중식당, 1948년부터 내려오는 옛 맛.
desc_l10n.zh: 从1948年起保留至今的古老味道，是目前历史最悠久的中华料理店。最知名的料理为牡蛎辣汤面。牡蛎辣汤面分为辣和不辣，顾客可根据自己的喜好选择。

description: Even though Andongjang is one of the oldest Chinese restaurants in Seoul, it has maintained the same classic tastes since 1948. It is famous for their delicious guljjamppong (spicy noodle soup with oysters), and you can choose either the mild or the spicy variation according to your taste.
name: Andongjang

desc_l10n.en: Imun Seollongtang is one of the oldest Seolleongtang (ox bone soup) restaurants in Seoul with over 100 years of proud history. The family that owns it has passed it down from one generation to the next since the beginning of the 1900s. The current chef has been making Seolleongtang made from slowly simmered meat and beef bones for the last 20 years.
desc_l10n.ja: ソルロンタン(牛の肉や骨を煮込んだスープ)のお店。ソウルで現存する食堂の中で一番古く、百年余りの歴史を誇る店だ。1900年代から代を継いで経営している。たっぷりの肉と牛骨を煮込んだ味わいソルロンタンを楽しめる。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울에서 현존하는 식당 중 가장 오래된 설렁탕집
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为首尔市现有餐馆中最为古老的店家之一，是经过世代传承的百年老年。1984年开始,现任主厨开始推出牛骨炖汤。无论是肉或者牛大骨的份量都很充足。

description: Imun Seollongtang is one of the oldest Seolleongtang (ox bone soup) restaurants in Seoul with over 100 years of proud history. The family that owns it has passed it down from one generation to the next since the beginning of the 1900s. The current chef has been making Seolleongtang made from slowly simmered meat and beef bones for the last 20 years.
name: [Baeknyeon-gage] Imun Seollongtang

name_l10n.ja: [百年の店] イムン・ソルロンタン
name_l10n.zh: [百年老店] 里门洞牛骨炖汤(Imun Seollongtang)

desc_l10n.en: Yeouido Ttaro Gukbap specializes in ttarogukbap, a bowl of beef shank and rice in a thick broth. Kkori jjim, braised ox tail, is also popular. They've been in operation in the Yeouido area for about 30 years.
desc_l10n.ja: 大ぶりなサテ(牛の膝後ろの肉)ともやしが入っているスープのタロクッパブ専門店。あっさりしていながらも、味わい深い。30年余りの伝統ある店だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 진한 국물의 국밥과 큼직한 사태가 들어 있는 따로국밥전문점. 꼬리수육도 인기. 여의도에 자리 잡은 지 30여 년 전통.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为在香浓高汤中加入米饭和大块牛腱的牛肉汤饭专卖店，水煮牛尾巴也相当受到欢迎。此店为在汝矣岛拥有30年传统的店家。

description: Yeouido Ttaro Gukbap specializes in ttarogukbap, a bowl of beef shank and rice in a thick broth. Kkori jjim, braised ox tail, is also popular. They've been in operation in the Yeouido area for about 30 years.
name: Yeouido Ttaro Gukbap

name_l10n.ja: ヨイド・タロクッパブ

desc_l10n.en: Cheong offers fusion dishes based on Chinese cuisine but with a Western twist. Their black vinegar tenderloin steak is quite unique.
desc_l10n.ja: モダンな外観と格式高い雰囲気の中華料理店。中華料理をベースに、洋式を取り入れたフュージョン料理が楽しめる。黒酢ステーキなどが珍しいメニューだ。窓の外には、ウォルチョン美術館の韓国式庭園を眺めることもできる。
desc_l10n.ko: 중식을 기본으로 하고 서양식 터치를 가미한 퓨전 중식.
desc_l10n.zh: 中式餐饮为基础，融合了西式餐饮的复合式中式美食。 醋溜里脊牛排等是本店推出的独家菜色 。

description: Cheong offers fusion dishes based on Chinese cuisine but with a Western twist. Their black vinegar tenderloin steak is quite unique.
name: Cheong

desc_l10n.en: This restaurant is famous for their honghapbap, a dish of fried rice with sea mussels and dried clam, seasoned with soy sauce and sesame oil. The meal can also be purchased for takeout with three or four side dishes, all at a reasonable price. The restaurant version of the meal comes with more than 10 delicious side dishes.
desc_l10n.ja: 干した貝の身と炊いたご飯をごま油で炒めたホンハプパブが有名なところ。弁当容器にホンハプパブと3・4種類のおかずがついてくるとホンハブパブドシラクが手頃でおすすめだ。ホンハブパブジョンシク(ホンハプパブ定食)には10種類ほどのおかずが付いてくる。
desc_l10n.ko: 조갯살 말린 것을 넣고 간장으로 간을 해 밥을 한 후 밥을 다시 참기름에 볶아낸 홍합밥. 일식 도시락 용기에 반찬 서너 가지를 깔끔하게 담아 내주는 홍합밥 도시락도 별미. 홍합밥 정식에는 10가지가 넘는 반찬. 뽈데기탕도 유명.
desc_l10n.zh: 以淡菜饭而闻名的店家。淡菜饭的作法是先放入沥干的蛤蜊肉，再用酱油调味后炊煮，饭煮熟后必须再以麻油翻炒才算大功告成。在日式便当盒中装入3、4种配菜的淡菜饭盒饭也是不错的选择，淡菜饭套餐则有超过10种的小菜，鳕鱼头汤也相当有名。

description: This restaurant is famous for their honghapbap, a dish of fried rice with sea mussels and dried clam, seasoned with soy sauce and sesame oil. The meal can also be purchased for takeout with three or four side dishes, all at a reasonable price. The restaurant version of the meal comes with more than 10 delicious side dishes.
name: Cheongsujeong

desc_l10n.en: Canadian Lobster serves a variety of dishes that feature lobster prepared in a variety of ways, such as sashimi, grilled with butter, chili, steamed, and au gratin. Set menus come with your choice of sashimi, a steamed dish, and two grilled dishes. They import wild North-Atlantic lobsters caught off the coast of Nova Scotia, Canada.
desc_l10n.ja: ロブスター専門店。ロブスターの刺身、バター焼き、煮物、グラタンなど様々な料理を楽しめる。刺身と煮物の中から選べるコースには、2種類の焼物料理が付いてくる。
desc_l10n.ko: 바닷가재 사시미, 버터구이, 칠리, 찜, 그라탱 등 다양한 요리
desc_l10n.zh: 本店可以品尝到龙虾生鱼片、奶油烧烤、营养蒸菜、奶油烤菜等各种各样的美食。如果点套餐，可以在生鱼片和营养蒸菜中选其一。值得一提的是龙虾是从加拿大新斯科省前海进口的北大西洋里野生龙虾。

description: Canadian Lobster serves a variety of dishes that feature lobster prepared in a variety of ways, such as sashimi, grilled with butter, chili, steamed, and au gratin. Set menus come with your choice of sashimi, a steamed dish, and two grilled dishes. They import wild North-Atlantic lobsters caught off the coast of Nova Scotia, Canada.
name: Canadian Lobster

desc_l10n.en: Wasedaya specializes in Japanese-style charcoal barbecue, known as yakiniku. Yakiniku is Korean bulgogi (marinated thinly-sliced beef) that has been adapted for Japanese tastes. Recommended dishes are grilled beef tongue garnished with sliced green onions, sesame oil, and salt, and cheonyup sashimi (beef omasum). You can also enjoy rib eye roll, beef short ribs, fresh sirloin, and hangjeongsal (meat from the back of the neck).
desc_l10n.ja: 日本式の炭火焼肉専門店。焼肉は韓国のプルコギを日本人の口に合うように変えたもの。 みじん切りにしたネギにゴマ油、塩をのせた牛タン、そしてネギ、ゴマ油、塩をあえたセンマイ刺しがおすすめメニュー。コットゥンシム(リブロース)、カルビ、セントゥンシム(生牛サーロイン)なども味わえる
desc_l10n.ko: 일본식 숯불구이인 야키니쿠 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 日式炭烤烧肉专卖店。烧肉是韩国烤肉为符合日本人的口味所演变出来的。放点葱花、麻油和盐巴的牛舌，用葱、麻油和盐巴抓过的生牛肚是本店的最推荐的菜色。此外，这里还提供牛柳、排骨、新鲜牛背肉，颈肉等。

description: Wasedaya specializes in Japanese-style charcoal barbecue, known as yakiniku. Yakiniku is Korean bulgogi (marinated thinly-sliced beef) that has been adapted for Japanese tastes. Recommended dishes are grilled beef tongue garnished with sliced green onions, sesame oil, and salt, and cheonyup sashimi (beef omasum). You can also enjoy rib eye roll, beef short ribs, fresh sirloin, and hangjeongsal (meat from the back of the neck).
name: Wasedaya

desc_l10n.en: Hwangu Yanggopchang is a high-quality tripe and small intestine restaurant. Their menu has only this one dish, but you can order it with or without seasoning. The small intestines are cooked on a traditional oil drum grill in a grilling basket.
desc_l10n.ja: 上質な食材に手を加えることで、おいしいと評判のヤンコプチャン（ミノとホルモン）のお店。メニューはヤンコプチャンのみで、味付けした物とそうでない物から選べる。ドラム缶の形をしたテーブルの上で食べるホルモンは毎日、ホルモンで有名な馬場洞（マジャンドン）から仕入れる新鮮な食材を使用している。
desc_l10n.ko: 질 좋은 원재료를 잘 손질해서 내는 양곱창집. 메뉴는 양곱창 한 가지
desc_l10n.zh: 将优质食材细心处理后呈现给顾客的烤牛肚小肠店，菜单上虽然仅有烤牛肚小肠1种选择，但分为腌渍过和无腌渍过。店家是将牛小肠放在瓦斯桶桌的铁网上烧烤，且每天使用来自马场洞屠宰场的新鲜食材。

description: Hwangu Yanggopchang is a high-quality tripe and small intestine restaurant. Their menu has only this one dish, but you can order it with or without seasoning. The small intestines are cooked on a traditional oil drum grill in a grilling basket.
name: Hwangu Yanggopchang

name_l10n.ja: ファンウ・ヤンゴプチャン

desc_l10n.en: The main dish at Kkongsi Myeongwan is xiǎolóngbāo, dumplings steamed in a small bamboo basket. The boiled pork ribs are a special treat and have the authentic taste of Chinese spices. The delicious taste of garlic pork ribs is also famous. It is interesting to find omurice on the menu because it seems out of place, but it is very creative for its use of interesting ingredients like eggplant and shrimp.
desc_l10n.ja: 上海で有名なシャオロンバオ(小龍包)が有名なところ。その他、独特の中国香辛料の香りを楽しめる豚のカルビを蒸し油で揚げたマヌルカルビ(ニンニクカルビ)もおいしい。メニューにオムライスがあるのは珍しく、中国式のカジポクム(なすの炒め)、カンプンセウ(乾烹海老：エビの揚げ物)などを載せて食べるのが特徴。
desc_l10n.ko: 상해식 국물 만두인 샤오룽바오(소롱포)가 주력 메뉴.
desc_l10n.zh: 上海式的小笼包为主推商品。先将烤猪排蒸熟后，再裹上面衣下锅油炸，最后加入中国特有香料一起拌炒的香蒜猪肋条也相当受到欢迎。其中最特别的是蛋包饭，店家搭配的不是日式配料，而是中式的炒茄子、左宗棠鸡或干烹虾等。其优点为价格较其他小笼包专卖实惠。

description: The main dish at Kkongsi Myeongwan is xiǎolóngbāo, dumplings steamed in a small bamboo basket. The boiled pork ribs are a special treat and have the authentic taste of Chinese spices. The delicious taste of garlic pork ribs is also famous. It is interesting to find omurice on the menu because it seems out of place, but it is very creative for its use of interesting ingredients like eggplant and shrimp.
name: Kkongsi Myeongwan

desc_l10n.en: Eunseongjip is famous for Korean-style teppanyaki, and offer a selection of steak, sausages, and vegetables for broiling on the iron griddle. One of their specialities is an assorted sausage hot plate with ham, sausage, bacon, tenderloin, onions, and potatoes, sprinkled with pepper. Interestingly, young radish kimchi is substituted for the usual pickles. Also, they are famous for their budae jjigae (spicy sausage stew).
desc_l10n.ja: 1970年代にオープンした歴史あるステーキ専門店。手頃な値段で良質のステーキが味わえます。ソーセージモドゥムグイ(ソーセージの焼き盛り合わせ)も人気。ピクルスのかわりにアルタリム(大根キムチ)が出るのが特徴です。その他にプデチゲ(ソーセージのピリ辛寄せ鍋)でも有名。
desc_l10n.ko: 채소와 함께 볶아 먹는 스테이크, 소시지 요리.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店主要提供和蔬菜一起炒食的牛排和香肠料理。火腿、香肠、培根、里脊、洋葱、土豆等撒上胡椒粉的香肠什锦烧烤也别具风味。用小萝卜辛奇（kimchi）取代酸黄瓜也非常有意思。韩式部队锅也很有名。

description: Eunseongjip is famous for Korean-style teppanyaki, and offer a selection of steak, sausages, and vegetables for broiling on the iron griddle. One of their specialities is an assorted sausage hot plate with ham, sausage, bacon, tenderloin, onions, and potatoes, sprinkled with pepper. Interestingly, young radish kimchi is substituted for the usual pickles. Also, they are famous for their budae jjigae (spicy sausage stew).
name: Eunseongjip

desc_l10n.en: The dented tin pots they use are the hallmark of Huirak, a restaurant specializing in galchi jorim (braised hairtail). They roughly cut radishes into large rounds and place them in the bottom of a tin pot; then add water, sauce, and large pieces of hairtail.This is boiled down halfway and finished when you place your order. They also take a lot of pride in making their own red pepper paste made from chili peppers that they dry and grind themselves. Rice is refilled as many times as you'd like. This is theoriginal branch of Huirak in Namdaemun.
desc_l10n.ja: 南大門市場(ナムデムンシジャン)にあるカルチチョリム(太刀魚煮付け)のお店。大根と太刀魚をと粉唐辛子で煮付けたカルチチョリムは、太刀魚のおいしさはもちろん、うまみの染み込んだ大根も美味。ご飯ともよく合う。ご飯はお替りは自由
desc_l10n.ko: 찌그러진 양은냄비 집으로 유명한 남대문 갈치조림 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是以干瘪的白铜小锅而闻名的红烧刀鱼店。锅底稀疏的铺着一层萝卜，放入水和调料、刀鱼煮开以后，然后在煮一会会儿，量会减少一半左右。并且如果预定，会直接盛出做好的食物。引以为豪的自制辣椒粉，是把辣椒子取出后研磨而成。米饭可以无限制续点。南大门市场刀鱼小巷元祖店。

description: The dented tin pots they use are the hallmark of Huirak, a restaurant specializing in galchi jorim (braised hairtail). They roughly cut radishes into large rounds and place them in the bottom of a tin pot; then add water, sauce, and large pieces of hairtail.This is boiled down halfway and finished when you place your order. They also take a lot of pride in making their own red pepper paste made from chili peppers that they dry and grind themselves. Rice is refilled as many times as you'd like. This is theoriginal branch of Huirak in Namdaemun.
name: Huirak

desc_l10n.en: For three generations, Eunho Sikdang has been steadily maintaining the same taste of the original kkori gomtang, (oxtail soup) that they first made when they operated a street vendor stall in Namdaemun Market 70 years ago. In addition to oxtail soup, you can also have doganitang (ox knee and beef stew), seolleongtang (a thin, milky-white beef soup made from slowly simmered oxtails and bones), and suyuk (steamed pork).
desc_l10n.ja: 長い歴史を持つコリコムタン(テールスープ)専門店。牛のしっぽを煮込んで作るコリコムタンのほかにも、膝の軟骨で作るトガニタン、ソルロンタン(牛の肉や骨を煮込んだスープ)なども味わえる。
desc_l10n.ko: 70년 전 남대문시장에 좌판을 펴고 꼬리곰탕을 만들기 시작해  3대에 걸친 꾸준한  맛.
desc_l10n.zh: 70年前在南大门市场开始摆摊卖牛尾汤，至今已历经3代，但口味依旧保持不变。除了牛尾汤外，也可品尝到美味的牛膝骨汤、牛杂碎汤和水煮肉。

description: For three generations, Eunho Sikdang has been steadily maintaining the same taste of the original kkori gomtang, (oxtail soup) that they first made when they operated a street vendor stall in Namdaemun Market 70 years ago. In addition to oxtail soup, you can also have doganitang (ox knee and beef stew), seolleongtang (a thin, milky-white beef soup made from slowly simmered oxtails and bones), and suyuk (steamed pork).
name: Eunho Sikdang

desc_l10n.en: The most popular item of Myeongnyun Sonkalguksu is kalguksu, handmade knife-cut noodles in beef broth. The thick boiled brisket and flank and lightly boiled octopus are also good. You can order half portions of each and taste a bit of everything. Therestaurant closes relatively early in the evening and they often close early if ingredients run out.
desc_l10n.ja: 牛骨スープで作ったカルクグス(韓国式うどん)の味がおいしいと評判のお店。タコのスープもあり、肉とタコのスープを半分ずつ交ぜて注文することも可能。夜は営業せず、食材がなくなると閉店となる。
desc_l10n.ko: 사골 육수로 만든 칼국수의 맛이 일품인 곳. 양지 수육이 유명.
desc_l10n.zh: 刀切面专卖店，使用牛大骨肉制成的刀切面口味相当独特。这里的水煮肉也相当美味，厚实的牛排骨肉片远近驰名。煮至软烂的章鱼和水煮肉也相当美味，点餐时可选择水煮肉和章鱼各一半。晚上不营业，且若是提早卖光也会提早关门。

description: The most popular item of Myeongnyun Sonkalguksu is kalguksu, handmade knife-cut noodles in beef broth. The thick boiled brisket and flank and lightly boiled octopus are also good. You can order half portions of each and taste a bit of everything. Therestaurant closes relatively early in the evening and they often close early if ingredients run out.
name: Myeongnyun Sonkalguksu

name_l10n.ja: ミョンニュン・ソンカルクグス

desc_l10n.en: Pyeongando Mandujip is a home-style Pyeongyang mandu (Korean dumpling) shop. Besides dumplings, another popular item on the menu is bossam (sliced boiled pork wrapped in spiced napa cabbage), with generous amounts of fresh oysters and spring onion salad.Their pure mung bean pancakes made with finely-ground mung beans are another delicacy. The food here is subtle and light-tasting, and some would claim it doesn't suit young people, who are accustomed to stronger flavors.
desc_l10n.ja: 家庭で作ったような平壌(ピョンヤン)式マンドゥ(餃子)専門店。マンドゥ以外にも生牡蠣とねぎ、千切りの大根キムチと一緒に出るポッサム(ゆで豚肉の葉野菜包み)が人気だ。緑豆を使って作ったピンデトクもおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 집에서 직접 빚은 듯한 평양 만두 전문점.  생굴과 파무침의 보쌈.
desc_l10n.zh: 充满家常口味的平壤饺子专卖店。除饺子外，配料丰富，包括新鲜牡蛎和凉拌葱丝的生菜包馅也相当受到欢迎。将绿豆细磨后制成的绿豆煎饼也非常可口。口味偏淡。

description: Pyeongando Mandujip is a home-style Pyeongyang mandu (Korean dumpling) shop. Besides dumplings, another popular item on the menu is bossam (sliced boiled pork wrapped in spiced napa cabbage), with generous amounts of fresh oysters and spring onion salad.Their pure mung bean pancakes made with finely-ground mung beans are another delicacy. The food here is subtle and light-tasting, and some would claim it doesn't suit young people, who are accustomed to stronger flavors.
name: Pyeongando Mandujip

name_l10n.ja: ピョンアンド・マンドゥチプ

desc_l10n.en: At About Shabu, you can relax and enjoy Korean-style shabu shabu. Fresh vegetables, meat, and seafood are parboiled in one of three different pots (spicy red soup, milky beef broth, and skipjack tuna broth) and then eaten with chili or lemon sauce.
desc_l10n.ja: 軽く楽しめる韓国式しゃぶしゃぶ専門店。辛いダシの紅湯(ホンタン)、牛骨ダシの白湯(ペクタン)、カツオダシの海湯(ヘタン)の三つのダシに新鮮な野菜と肉、海鮮を入れ、チリソース、レモンソースと一緒に食べる
desc_l10n.ko: 가볍게 즐길 수 있는 한국식 샤브샤브 전문점. 홍탕, 백탕, 해탕의 3가지 육수.
desc_l10n.zh: 可轻松享用的韩式SHABU SHABU专门店，汤汁分为辣味的红汤、牛骨熬煮的白汤和鲣鱼海鲜汤，在汤里加入新鲜的蔬菜、肉类和海鲜，然后沾辣椒酱汁以及柠檬酱汁食用

description: At About Shabu, you can relax and enjoy Korean-style shabu shabu. Fresh vegetables, meat, and seafood are parboiled in one of three different pots (spicy red soup, milky beef broth, and skipjack tuna broth) and then eaten with chili or lemon sauce.
name: About Shabu

desc_l10n.en: The sundaeguk (blood sausage soup) at Seocho Namsunnam Sundaeguk doesn't exhibit the usual strong, distinctive smell of sundaeguk, so those who don't normally like this soup will find it pleasing. The soup is served with a generous amount of pork tripe. Salted and fermented shrimp, chopped seasonings, green perilla seed powder, and black pepper can be added to taste, making the soup savory and a bit spicy.
