desc_l10n.ja: スープから臭みが全くしないスンデクク(豚の腸詰め入りスープ)を味わえるところ。スンデ(豚の腸詰)に抵抗がある人でもおいしく食べることができる。あみの塩辛、ダデギ(醤油、塩、ニンニク、生姜、唐辛子、などを混ぜた合わせ調味料)、煎りエゴマ、胡椒などを入れて食べると風味がさらにます。
desc_l10n.ko: 국물에서 노린내가 나지 않아 평소 순댓국을 좋아하지 않는 사람도 거부감 없음. 순댓국 안의 돼지고기 양 푸짐.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的高汤完全无腥味，因此平时不爱吃猪血肠汤的人，也能轻易接受。猪血肠汤中的猪肉份量十足，若是搭配虾酱、辣椒酱、紫苏粉和胡椒粉一起享用，则会成为一碗香辣的猪血肠汤。

description: The sundaeguk (blood sausage soup) at Seocho Namsunnam Sundaeguk doesn't exhibit the usual strong, distinctive smell of sundaeguk, so those who don't normally like this soup will find it pleasing. The soup is served with a generous amount of pork tripe. Salted and fermented shrimp, chopped seasonings, green perilla seed powder, and black pepper can be added to taste, making the soup savory and a bit spicy.
name: Seocho Namsunnam Sundaeguk

name_l10n.ja: ソチョ・ナムスンナムスンデグク

desc_l10n.en: At Chungmuro Jjukkumi Bulgogi, you can have delicious baby octopus marinated in red pepper sauce and lightly chargrilled. They buy large quantities of baby octopus between October and February, when they taste the best, and freeze them for use throughoutthe year.
desc_l10n.ja: 唐辛子で味付けしたイイダコを炭火で焼くチュクミブルコギのお店。イイダコの足が縮んだときが食べごろ。おかずとして出されるムルキムチ(水キムチ)などと一緒に食べるとさっぱりしておいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 30여 년 동안 꾸준히 사랑을 받는 매콤한 양념 주꾸미를 숯불에 구워 먹는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 30多年来一直受到顾客喜爱的店家。将以香辣酱料腌渍过的小章鱼放到炭火上烧烤享用。包括小章鱼、章鱼、牛角蛤的综合拼盘非常划算。辣炒小章鱼吃完后，加入白饭拌炒的蔬菜炒饭也是一绝。

description: At Chungmuro Jjukkumi Bulgogi, you can have delicious baby octopus marinated in red pepper sauce and lightly chargrilled. They buy large quantities of baby octopus between October and February, when they taste the best, and freeze them for use throughoutthe year.
name: Chungmuro Jjukkumi Bulgogi

name_l10n.ja: チュンムロ・チュクミプルゴギ
name_l10n.zh: 忠武路小章鱼(Chungmuro Jjukkumi bulgogi)

desc_l10n.en: This is a Japanese-style pub where you can enjoy a drink with grilled chicken and pork belly shish-kebabs.
desc_l10n.ja: 鶏肉、サムギョッサルなどの材料を使った焼き鳥屋。焼き鳥をつまみに、酒一杯がスムーズに進む。居心地の良い居酒屋の雰囲気で、気軽に行けるのが特徴だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 닭고기, 삼겹살 등의 재료를 꼬치로 구워 내주는 집. 일본식 숯불 꼬치. 아늑한 선술집 .
desc_l10n.zh: 日本炭烤串烧店，经营鸡肉和五花肉等各式串烧。香气四溢的串烧是再好不过的下酒菜。安逸的居酒屋氛围让人感到毫无负担。

description: This is a Japanese-style pub where you can enjoy a drink with grilled chicken and pork belly shish-kebabs.
name: Muntaro

desc_l10n.en: Gitdaebong Naengmyeon is a naengmyeon restaurant with over 40 years of history. They are famous for spicy bibim naengmyeon (cold buckwheat noodles and vegetables mixed with spicy sauce). Compared to traditional North Korean naengmyeon, theirs is said to be like the naengmyeon served in snack bars, but they have a loyal following. You can choose the level of spiciness; not spicy, mildly spicy, and spicy.
desc_l10n.ja: 50年もの歴史を持つネンミョン(冷麺)専門店。メニューは、ムルネンミョン(冷麺)、ピビムネンミョン(ピリ辛のスープなし冷麺)、マンドゥ(餃子)の3種類のみ。どのメニューもボリューム満点です。ネンミョンの辛さは6段階に分かれており、好みで選べる。コシのある麺もおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 40여 년 전통의 냉면 전문점. 매콤한 비빔냉면으로 유명한 집
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是拥有40余年传统的冷面店。以辣辣的韩式辣拌冷面而闻名。虽然和北部冷面相比更像小吃店，但仍然有很多忠实的顾客。有辣、微辣、不辣等味道可以选择。

description: Gitdaebong Naengmyeon is a naengmyeon restaurant with over 40 years of history. They are famous for spicy bibim naengmyeon (cold buckwheat noodles and vegetables mixed with spicy sauce). Compared to traditional North Korean naengmyeon, theirs is said to be like the naengmyeon served in snack bars, but they have a loyal following. You can choose the level of spiciness; not spicy, mildly spicy, and spicy.
name: Gitdaebong Naengmyeon

name_l10n.ja: キッテボン・ネンミョン

desc_l10n.en: With its synthesis of antique and modern, what better place is there to enjoy authentic Chinese cuisine than in this beautiful restaurant? A great place for family gatherings and entertaining guests.
desc_l10n.ja: 現代的な雰囲気と古風な感覚が調和された店内で、本場の中国料理を楽しめます。家族での食事や接待にも使えます。
desc_l10n.ko: 현대적인 것과 고풍스러운 느낌이 잘 어우러진 분위기. 격조 있는 정통 중국 요리.
desc_l10n.zh: 顾客可以在融合古今的环境中，享用正宗的中华料理。这里非常适合家族聚餐或招待贵宾。

description: With its synthesis of antique and modern, what better place is there to enjoy authentic Chinese cuisine than in this beautiful restaurant? A great place for family gatherings and entertaining guests.
name: Park Ruan

desc_l10n.en: Seodaemun Gopchang is a gopchang (tripe) restaurant with a 30-year history. The gopchang grilled with potatoes and onions on the hot plate are excellent. When the gopchang is are fully grilled, restaurant workers add a finishing touch in the wayof a light sprinkle of soju for a fiery display.
desc_l10n.ja: 30年の伝統を誇るコプチャン(ホルモン焼き)店。ジャガイモ、玉ネギなどを一緒に鉄板で焼いて食べる小腸がとてもおいしい。小腸が焼きごろになると、最後に焼酎をかけて火あぶりのショーで仕上げをする。
desc_l10n.ko: 30년 전통의 철판구이 곱창집.
desc_l10n.zh: 拥有30年历史的烤牛小肠专卖店，和土豆、洋葱一起在铁板上烤得吱吱作响的牛小肠，令人垂涎三尺。牛小肠全都享用完毕后，店家还会淋上烧酒表演火焰秀，为这次用餐画下句号。

description: Seodaemun Gopchang is a gopchang (tripe) restaurant with a 30-year history. The gopchang grilled with potatoes and onions on the hot plate are excellent. When the gopchang is are fully grilled, restaurant workers add a finishing touch in the wayof a light sprinkle of soju for a fiery display.
name: Seodaemun Gopchang

name_l10n.ja: ソデムン・コプチャン

desc_l10n.en: The Indian chef at Taj reproduces the cuisine of northern India with ingredients flown in from India. All of the dishes are available in vegetarian and non-vegetarian variations. Because Indians are primarily vegetarian, they prepare a variety of excellent vegetable curries and tandoori dishes that are popular with vegetarians. The restaurant interior is very luxurious.
desc_l10n.ja: インド人のシェフによるインド北部の料理を味わえるところ。食材も現地から空輸している。すべてのメニューが菜食と菜食ではないメニューに分けられ、好みによって選べる。菜食主義のためのカレーとダンドゥー料理が多彩で人気が高い。高級インテリアの店内でインド料理が楽しめる。
desc_l10n.ko: 인도에서 공수된 재료와 인도인 셰프가 인도 북부의 음식을 재현
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为印度料理专卖店，店内的食材是由印度进口，主厨也是印度人，专门提供印度北部的料理。所有菜单皆分为素食和非素食，顾客可随自己的喜好选择。印度人主要吃素，因此专为素食主义者设计的咖哩和烧烤料理相当受到欢迎。顾客可在高档环境中享用印度美食。

description: The Indian chef at Taj reproduces the cuisine of northern India with ingredients flown in from India. All of the dishes are available in vegetarian and non-vegetarian variations. Because Indians are primarily vegetarian, they prepare a variety of excellent vegetable curries and tandoori dishes that are popular with vegetarians. The restaurant interior is very luxurious.
name: Taj

desc_l10n.en: Afternoon Tea offers a selection of four hundred varieties of tea brought in directly from ten different countries. Three tea masters are always on hand at the shop. One of the most popular teas is Tiangpang tea, the name of which means "the best of all"in Chinese. When hot water is poured in, the tea swells up like chrysanthemums blooming, and although it tastes similar to green tea, there is a light lingering fragrance of chrysanthemums.
desc_l10n.ja: 約10カ国から集めてきた400種類のお茶を扱っているティー専門店。3人のティーマスターが常駐している。ティアンパンは中国語で「錦上に花を添えるという意味」で、お湯を注げば菊の花が咲くように膨らみ、緑茶のようながらもほのかな菊の香りが漂う。
desc_l10n.ko: 10여 개국에서 직접 수집해 온 4백여 종의 차가 있는 차 전문점. 3명의 티 마스터 상주. 티앙팡은 중국말로 금상첨화란 뜻으로, 뜨거운 물을 부으면 국화꽃이 피어나듯 부풀어 오르고 녹차 같으면서도 은은한 국화 향이 감도는 맛이 남.
desc_l10n.zh: 老板从10多个国家里直接收集400多种茶的茶叶专卖店，有3位老板常驻店中。加入茶叶后倒上热水，仿佛菊花绽放的样子，看起来像绿茶但散发着隐隐的菊花香。

description: Afternoon Tea offers a selection of four hundred varieties of tea brought in directly from ten different countries. Three tea masters are always on hand at the shop. One of the most popular teas is Tiangpang tea, the name of which means "the best of all"in Chinese. When hot water is poured in, the tea swells up like chrysanthemums blooming, and although it tastes similar to green tea, there is a light lingering fragrance of chrysanthemums.
name: Afternoon Tea

name_l10n.ja: ティアンパン・オフエ・ホンチャ

desc_l10n.en: To produce their very thick broth, the cooks at Pajuok simmer beef leg and tail bones in a large cauldron for more than five hours. They are as famous for their geotjeori (fresh napa cabbage tossed with kimchi seasonings) as they are for their seolleongtang(a thin, milky-white soup made from slowly simmered oxtails and bones). The restaurant originally started in Pyeongtaek, but there are now branches in Seoul.
desc_l10n.ja: 牛の足やテールなどを釜に入れて5時間以上じっくり煮込んだソルロンタンのお店。スープが味わい深い。浅漬けキムチもソルロンタンとともに人気の一品だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 족과 꼬리 등을 대형 가마솥에 넣고 5시간 이상 푹 끓여낸 진한 국물 맛.
desc_l10n.zh: 汤是将牛蹄、牛尾等放入大铁锅中炖5个小时以上炖制而成的，味道香浓。此店的凉拌小菜跟牛骨炖汤一样有名。此店原来最先出现在平泽，现在分店已经开到了首尔。

description: To produce their very thick broth, the cooks at Pajuok simmer beef leg and tail bones in a large cauldron for more than five hours. They are as famous for their geotjeori (fresh napa cabbage tossed with kimchi seasonings) as they are for their seolleongtang(a thin, milky-white soup made from slowly simmered oxtails and bones). The restaurant originally started in Pyeongtaek, but there are now branches in Seoul.
name: Pajuok

desc_l10n.en: Pyeongnaeok is famous for its chogyetang, a kind of chicken soup. Their pheasant naengmyeon is made with the same broth as ordinary naengmyeon but comes topped with pheasant meatballs. The tasty nokdujeon (mung bean pancakes) and spicy stir-fried pork are also very good. Most of the clientele here tends to be a bit older. This restaurant moved from its former location when the area was re-developed, but ever since re-opening in its new location, they have been very popular.
desc_l10n.ja: 鶏ガラでスープを作る酢鶏湯(チョゲタン)が有名なお店。冷たいスープに麺や野菜、鶏肉などが入っている北朝鮮料理だ。クォンネンミョン(キジの冷麺)も美味でキジ肉の団子が入っているのが特徴。客層の平均年齢が高く、長く通う常連客が多いい。
desc_l10n.ko: 닭으로 육수를 내는 초계탕이 유명한 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 以醋鸡汤而闻名的店家，使用鸡肉熬煮的高汤。山鸡雉鸡冷面使用的高汤虽然和一般的冷面相同，但放入山鸡雉鸡肉丸。清爽的绿豆煎饼和猪肉片也是美味可口。

description: Pyeongnaeok is famous for its chogyetang, a kind of chicken soup. Their pheasant naengmyeon is made with the same broth as ordinary naengmyeon but comes topped with pheasant meatballs. The tasty nokdujeon (mung bean pancakes) and spicy stir-fried pork are also very good. Most of the clientele here tends to be a bit older. This restaurant moved from its former location when the area was re-developed, but ever since re-opening in its new location, they have been very popular.
name: Pyeongnaeok

desc_l10n.en: The chef at Beijingkoya presents traditional Peking duck, building on the skills gained at Jeonchiduck, the most famous duck restaurant in China. Having the bite-sized duck on a Chinese pancake and topping it off with sliced cucumber, shallot, and dark plum sauce, is highly recommended. Besides Peking duck, they also offer a variety of Chinese cuisine.
desc_l10n.ja: ソウルではめったに見られない北京ダック専門店。中国で技術を学んだシェフが本場の北京ダックを提供している。鴨を切って残った骨を一日ゆっくり煮込んだあと、漢方薬とイチゴ、クコの実を入れてさらに煮たスープは淡白でおいしい。北京ダック以外の一般的な中華料理もある。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울에서는 보기 드문 북경오리를 전문으로 하는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在首尔地区相当罕见的北京料理专卖店，店家师承北京全聚德，专门提供正宗的北京烤鸭。将鸭肉片放至烤饼上，再摆上小黄瓜和葱丝，最后抹上甜面酱，大口咬下滋味绝佳。将片完鸭肉的骨架炖一整天后，再加入汉药材、覆盆子和枸杞一起熬煮，便是甘甜可口的肉骨汤。除北京烤鸭外，店内的其他中华料理也都不错。

description: The chef at Beijingkoya presents traditional Peking duck, building on the skills gained at Jeonchiduck, the most famous duck restaurant in China. Having the bite-sized duck on a Chinese pancake and topping it off with sliced cucumber, shallot, and dark plum sauce, is highly recommended. Besides Peking duck, they also offer a variety of Chinese cuisine.
name: Beijingkoya

desc_l10n.en: Mokpojip is said to faithfully reproduce the cuisine of Jeollanam-do (the southern province of the region of Jeolla), including such dishes as hongeohoe (spicy skate sashimi in vinegar), hongeojjim (steamed skate), tteokgalbi (grilled minced ribs), octopus,yeonpotang (small octopus soup), and home-style meals with rice.
desc_l10n.ja: 全羅南道(チョルラナムド)料理の専門店。ホンオフェ(ガンギエイの刺身)、ホンオフェチム(ホンオの煮物)、トッカルビ(粗挽きカルビ焼き)、タコ料理など全羅南道の木浦(モッポ)地方の料理を味わえる。
desc_l10n.ko: 홍어회, 홍어찜, 떡갈비, 낙지요리, 연포탕, 가정식 백반 등 남도음식 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是以魟鱼生鱼片、蒸魟鱼、煎肉饼、章鱼料理、章鱼汤、家常套餐等南道饮食为主的专卖店，呈现正宗的木浦美味而深受好评。

description: Mokpojip is said to faithfully reproduce the cuisine of Jeollanam-do (the southern province of the region of Jeolla), including such dishes as hongeohoe (spicy skate sashimi in vinegar), hongeojjim (steamed skate), tteokgalbi (grilled minced ribs), octopus,yeonpotang (small octopus soup), and home-style meals with rice.
name: Mokpojip

desc_l10n.en: Ca'del Lupo is an Italian restaurant converted from a traditional Korean house. Enjoy a comfortable meal in a unique atmosphere. Their set menus are quite reasonably priced, and you can make a reservation to enjoy your meal in one of their cosy, detached buildings.
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国伝統家屋のイタリアンレストラン。パスタとサラダ、ワイン、コーヒーはすべて洗練されたおいしさだ。バジルなどのハーブ類はレストランの庭で栽培したものを使用。静かな伝統家屋で食事ができるとあって、ビジネスミーティングの場所としてよく利用されている。
desc_l10n.ko: 한옥집을 레노베이션하여 만든 이탈리아 레스토랑
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是由韩屋改造而成的意大利餐厅。在具有韩式风格的环境里舒适的享受美食。 价格适中，预约淡雅独立的别室，会更加舒适。

description: Ca'del Lupo is an Italian restaurant converted from a traditional Korean house. Enjoy a comfortable meal in a unique atmosphere. Their set menus are quite reasonably priced, and you can make a reservation to enjoy your meal in one of their cosy, detached buildings.
name: Ca'del Lupo

desc_l10n.en: N Grill is a fine dining restaurant in Namsan N Seoul Tower. They serve full-course set menus, and are known for their steaks. The restaurant is a high-end establishment, and this is reflected in the prices. However, in addition to delicious food, there is a beautiful panoramic night view of Seoul that is hard to beat. N Grill is a good place to have dinner with someone special on an anniversary or a special occasion. Reservations are required. One way to reach N Grill is via the Namsan cable car.
desc_l10n.ja: ナムサン(南山)のNソウルタワー内にある高級レストラン。コース料理を専門に、前菜とスープ、デザートなどを3～4種類のメニュー中から選ぶことができます。値段は少し高めだがソウルを一望できる夜景は美しく、記念日や特別な日に恋人と食事をするにはぴったりな場所です。予約必須。
desc_l10n.ko: 남산 N서울타워 내에 있는 고급 레스토랑. 코스식 요리 전문
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是位于南山N首尔塔内的高级餐厅，提供套餐式的料理,开胃菜、汤品到甜点有3~4种菜色可供选择。价位虽然偏高，但可以在本餐厅欣赏首尔的夜景，最适合您在特别的纪念日与爱人一边欣赏美景一边共进晚餐。必须预先订位。晚上交通有点不方便, 建议您乘坐南山观光缆车。

description: N Grill is a fine dining restaurant in Namsan N Seoul Tower. They serve full-course set menus, and are known for their steaks. The restaurant is a high-end establishment, and this is reflected in the prices. However, in addition to delicious food, there is a beautiful panoramic night view of Seoul that is hard to beat. N Grill is a good place to have dinner with someone special on an anniversary or a special occasion. Reservations are required. One way to reach N Grill is via the Namsan cable car.
name: N Grill

desc_l10n.en: With its tranquil atmosphere, this traditional tea house seems separate from the rest of the world. As soon as you enter, you'll hear the sounds of the many birds and animals that are kept here. Pretty multi-colored rice cakes are served with your tea. Everything is rustic and cozy, so that you feel like you're in a natural setting.
desc_l10n.ja: 幻想的な雰囲気の伝統茶のお店。入り口を入ると鳥のさえずる声が聞こえてくるところだ。自然に囲まれた田舎の茶屋に来たような気分になれる。色とりどりの華やかな餅がお茶と一緒に出される。
desc_l10n.ko: 속세를 벗어난 듯한 명상적인 분위기. 각종 동물과 새들이 카페를 지키고 있는 전통 찻집
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为茶馆，店内轻松的气氛，令人彷佛与世隔绝。店内有各种动物和鸟类，一进到店内，便会先听到鸟鸣。色彩丰富的美丽糕点会和茶品一起端上桌。宛若走进大自然的空间，充满乡村的幽静感。

description: With its tranquil atmosphere, this traditional tea house seems separate from the rest of the world. As soon as you enter, you'll hear the sounds of the many birds and animals that are kept here. Pretty multi-colored rice cakes are served with your tea. Everything is rustic and cozy, so that you feel like you're in a natural setting.
name: Sinyetchatjip

name_l10n.ja: シン・イェッチャッチブ

desc_l10n.en: The main menu item here is the cold kimchi noodles, which go well with the sweet beef rib patties or mung bean pancakes on offer. The clean and simple interior, moderate price range and delicious food keep the customers coming back for more.
desc_l10n.ja: メインメニューは、冷えたキムチマリクッス(キムチ入りそうめん)。甘くてさっぱりしたトッカルビ(粗挽きカルビ焼き)と、香ばしいピンデトッ(緑豆のチヂミ)と一緒に食べるとより美味しい。すっきりとした室内の雰囲気と手頃な価格、そして誰にでも好かれる味で常ににぎわっている。
desc_l10n.ko: 시원한 김치말이국수. 달콤하고 담백한 떡갈비와 고소한 녹두빈대떡과 함께.
desc_l10n.zh: 招牌料理是清爽的辛奇（kimchi）手卷面，与甜而不腻的煎碎肉排和香脆的绿豆煎饼非常搭调。室内整洁利落，价格合理适中，味道可口宜人，总是顾客盈门。

description: The main menu item here is the cold kimchi noodles, which go well with the sweet beef rib patties or mung bean pancakes on offer. The clean and simple interior, moderate price range and delicious food keep the customers coming back for more.
name: Nunnamujip

desc_l10n.en: La Stella is an authentic Italian restaurant serving a variety of steak and Italian pasta dishes. The wine bar also stocks two hundred varieties of wine. As an appetizer, the seafood platter, which includes lobster, mussels, clams, squid, and sea bream, is recommended.
desc_l10n.ja: 多様なステーキとパスタが味わえる本場イタリアンレストラン。200種類のワインも常備しているワインバーでもあります。ロブスター、ハマグリ、イカなどの海鮮を入ったモドゥム海鮮前菜料理がおすすめメニュー。ガーデンホテルで営業していた時代から、イタリア人のスタッフがパスタを作っています。
desc_l10n.ko: 한식, 중식, 일식, 양식 등의 고품격 요리를 맛볼 수 있는 뷔페 레스토랑
desc_l10n.zh: 此店既是可以品尝到牛排和意大利面的正宗意大利餐厅，并拥有200余种葡萄酒。推荐的开胃菜有龙虾肉、红蛤、大蛤、鱿鱼、鲷鱼肉等多种海鲜的什锦海鲜。此店从花园酒店时期开始，厨房所有员工都来自于意大利。意大利面也全部是由厨师现制的新鲜面条烹制而成的。

description: La Stella is an authentic Italian restaurant serving a variety of steak and Italian pasta dishes. The wine bar also stocks two hundred varieties of wine. As an appetizer, the seafood platter, which includes lobster, mussels, clams, squid, and sea bream, is recommended.
name: La Stella

desc_l10n.en: Hosu Samgyetang's samgyetang (chicken and ginseng soup) is characterized by its thick and aromatic broth due to the addition of perilla seeds. There are many restaurants with the same name in the neighbourhood, so be sure that you have the right one.
desc_l10n.ja: サムゲタン(若鶏のスープ)のお店。エゴマが入ったサムゲタンのスープは濃厚で味わい深い。近隣に同じ店名をかかげたお店も多いので、注意。
desc_l10n.ko: 들깨로 낸 삼계탕 국물이 걸쭉. 주변에 유사 호수삼계탕집이 많아  본점을 찾는 데 유의.
desc_l10n.zh: 用紫苏煮出来的参鸡汤汤汁比较浓稠，附近有很多店家都会打着湖水参鸡汤的名号，所以要找到本店就需要多加留心了。

description: Hosu Samgyetang's samgyetang (chicken and ginseng soup) is characterized by its thick and aromatic broth due to the addition of perilla seeds. There are many restaurants with the same name in the neighbourhood, so be sure that you have the right one.
name: Hosu Samgyetang

desc_l10n.en: Enjoy a soothing traditional tea at a cozy teahouse filled with the traditional flavors and atmosphere of Old Korea. Also recommended are the sweet steamed rice cakes made on the premises.
desc_l10n.ja: 静かな古宅で楽しむ伝統茶1杯。雰囲気も味も伝統そのままが感じられる。小腹が空いたら、その場で作ってくれる甘い蒸し餅を一緒に食べよう。
desc_l10n.ko: 고즈넉한 고택에서 즐기는 전통차 한 잔. 분위기도 맛도 전통 그대로.
desc_l10n.zh: 在古色古香的老房子里品一杯传统茶，不论是整体氛围还是茶的味道，都带着我们跌进过去的岁月。如果感觉有点饿了，不妨来一份现场制作的红豆糯米糕，甜甜糯糯非常美味。

description: Enjoy a soothing traditional tea at a cozy teahouse filled with the traditional flavors and atmosphere of Old Korea. Also recommended are the sweet steamed rice cakes made on the premises.
name: Chamasineun Tteul

name_l10n.ja: チャ・マシヌン･トゥル

desc_l10n.en: The chicken at Chamnamu Sutbure Dalgi Mannaneun Sungan is marinated for three days in a sauce made of more than ten ingredients, such as garlic, red pepper, ginger, sugar, and soy sauce, and grilled to order, so the chicken is very tender and full offlavor.
desc_l10n.ja: タッカルビ(鶏肉のピリ辛炒め)がおいしいお店。鉄板で炒める一般的な方法ではなく、炭火で焼く方式だ。10種類余りの材料が入ったソースに鶏肉を三日間漬けて作るため、肉がとてもやわらかい。チェンバングクス(野菜と蕎麦のお盆盛り)、マッククス(そば粉を用いた冷たい麺料理)、タクカルグクス(鶏肉煮込みうどん)などのメニューもある。
desc_l10n.ko: 철판에 볶아먹는 닭갈비가 아니라가 숯불에 직접 구워 먹는 방식.
desc_l10n.zh: 不是在铁板上烤，而是直接在炭火上烤着吃。把鸡肉浸渍在由大蒜、辣椒、生姜、砂糖、酱油等10 多种材料做成的酱料里3天，有客人点的话就即时烘烤，肉质非常柔软也很香。另外本店还提供端盘凉面, 春川凉面、鸡肉面、鸡肉冷面等选择。

description: The chicken at Chamnamu Sutbure Dalgi Mannaneun Sungan is marinated for three days in a sauce made of more than ten ingredients, such as garlic, red pepper, ginger, sugar, and soy sauce, and grilled to order, so the chicken is very tender and full offlavor.
name: Chamnamu Sutbure Dalgi Mannaneun Sungan

name_l10n.ja: チャムナムスップレ・タギマンナヌン・スンガン

desc_l10n.en: At Mapo Naru, which looks like a traditional Korean tavern, you can enjoy a variety of folk dishes such as jeongol (hot pot), bossam (steamed pork with kimchi), jeon (Korean pancakes), ssambap (rice wrapped in assorted vegetables), and generous amountof a variety of side dishes. They also serve alcohol, so it is a good place to have a family gatherings or all sorts of get-togethers.
desc_l10n.ja: ジョンゴル(鍋)、パジョン(ねぎのチヂミ)、サムパプ(野菜包みご飯)など多彩な料理とおかずが楽しめる韓国料理専門店。食事のメニューが多いので家族でも楽しめ、また、会社の集まりにも最適です。
desc_l10n.ko: 다양한 요리와 풍성한 안주를 즐길 수 있는 옛날 주막 분위기의 토속음식 전문점
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是一家拥有旧式酒家氛围的风味饮食专门店。在此可以品尝到火锅类、白切猪肉生菜包饭、葱煎饼、生菜包饭等各式各样的料理和丰盛的下酒菜。可供食用的菜色种类繁多，非常适合家庭聚会、聚餐等。

description: At Mapo Naru, which looks like a traditional Korean tavern, you can enjoy a variety of folk dishes such as jeongol (hot pot), bossam (steamed pork with kimchi), jeon (Korean pancakes), ssambap (rice wrapped in assorted vegetables), and generous amountof a variety of side dishes. They also serve alcohol, so it is a good place to have a family gatherings or all sorts of get-togethers.
name: Mapo Naru

desc_l10n.en: At Mangnae Hoe Center, you can have Korean-style sashimi, prepared from live fish. They offer a range of small wild fish that are not easy to find in other restaurants, such as perch, gizzard shad, yellowtail, tochigi, and mullet, among others. Full-courseset menus come with a diverse selection of delicacies, including mackerel, sea cucumber, prawn, kingfish, and various smaller fish.
desc_l10n.ja: スズキ、このしろ、ボラなど、普段はなかなか食べられない魚を楽しめるところ。コースで注文するとサバ、ナマコ、くるまエビ、ニベなどが味わえる。常連になれば色々なサービスが受けられるので足しげく通う客が多い。予約は必須。
desc_l10n.ko: 농어, 전어, 방어, 도치, 숭어 등 쉽게 접하기 어려운 자연산 잡어들을 제공.
desc_l10n.zh: 这里提供鲈鱼、钱鱼、鲂鱼、鳍鱼和乌鱼等稀有的天然鱼种，在这里还可以吃到炖鲐鱼、海参、水煮虾、民鱼、杂鱼等各种料理。如果成为常客，还会得到更多服务，所以有很多人会经常因此来消费。新搬的店址去宽阔舒适，要去此店消费之前必须先预约。

description: At Mangnae Hoe Center, you can have Korean-style sashimi, prepared from live fish. They offer a range of small wild fish that are not easy to find in other restaurants, such as perch, gizzard shad, yellowtail, tochigi, and mullet, among others. Full-courseset menus come with a diverse selection of delicacies, including mackerel, sea cucumber, prawn, kingfish, and various smaller fish.
name: Mangnae Hoe Center

name_l10n.ja: マンネ・フェセンター

desc_l10n.en: Cheongsongok is famous in Seosomun-dong for jangteogukbap, rice served with ox blood soup made from beef broth and radish, into which noodles are added. It is a good remedy for a hangover.
desc_l10n.ja: 西小門(ソソムン)の市場でクッパが有名なお店。牛肉と大根が入った牛骨スープで作ったクッパに麺を混ぜて食べる。二日酔いにも良い。
desc_l10n.ko: 서소문에서 장터 국밥으로 유명한 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 在西小门地区以市场汤饭而闻名的店家。汤汁是以牛肉和萝卜熬制，牛大骨汤汁中还会加入面条，对解酒也有很好的功效。

description: Cheongsongok is famous in Seosomun-dong for jangteogukbap, rice served with ox blood soup made from beef broth and radish, into which noodles are added. It is a good remedy for a hangover.
name: Cheongsongok

desc_l10n.en: Taschen is an art book café where you'll find various art books by Taschen, one of the most famous publishing companies. You can enjoy reading while having one of their various and wiches, a cup of coffee or tea. The Taschen art books are also available for purchase.
desc_l10n.ja: アートブックカフェ。ドイツの有名出版社「タッシェン」の芸術書籍を販売するほか、15種類のサンドイッチ、コーヒー、各種飲み物を読書しながら楽しめる。同社出版社の美術関連本も販売している。
desc_l10n.ko: 책과 샌드위치와 커피, 음료를 독서와 함께하는 아트 북카페 .
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为艺术书籍咖啡厅，店内陈列并销售德国知名出版社Taschen的各种艺术书籍，另备15种口味的三明治、咖啡和饮料供顾客享用。亦销售Taschen出版的美术相关书籍。

description: Taschen is an art book café where you'll find various art books by Taschen, one of the most famous publishing companies. You can enjoy reading while having one of their various and wiches, a cup of coffee or tea. The Taschen art books are also available for purchase.
name: Taschen

desc_l10n.en: Samho Bokjip has been very popular for bogeo (puffer fish) dishes for about 30 years. Their tang (soup), made with fresh puffer fish and fresh vegetables, has a delicious and refreshing taste. Another popular menu item is their bok 'shabu shabu', whichinvolves dipping thinly-sliced puffer fish wrapped around mushrooms and vegetables in boiling broth. Other delicious choices on the menu include the bok sushi, beoseot jjim (mushrooms steamed with seasonings), and doenjang ttukbaegi (soybean paste stewin an earthenware bowl).
desc_l10n.ja: ふぐ料理一つで30年間も愛され続けているお店。新鮮なふぐと新鮮な野菜、すっきりしたスープの鍋料理がおいしい。薄く切ったふぐの身とキノコと野菜を巻いてさっと湯に通すふぐしゃぶしゃぶも人気だ。そのほかポゴスシ(ふぐ寿司)、ポソッチム(キノコの煮物)も注文する価値あり。
desc_l10n.ko: 복어 하나로 30여 년 동안 변함없이 사랑받는 곳. 탕 요리가 일품.
desc_l10n.zh: 30年来一直受到大家青睐的河豚料理专门店。鲜活的河豚和新鲜的蔬菜熬制而成的汤，既清爽又开胃，极其美味。切成薄片的河豚与鲜蘑菇、蔬菜卷成卷，稍微涮一下就可以食用的河豚火锅也非常受欢迎。另外蒸蘑菇、砂锅韩式味增汤等也值得品尝。

description: Samho Bokjip has been very popular for bogeo (puffer fish) dishes for about 30 years. Their tang (soup), made with fresh puffer fish and fresh vegetables, has a delicious and refreshing taste. Another popular menu item is their bok 'shabu shabu', whichinvolves dipping thinly-sliced puffer fish wrapped around mushrooms and vegetables in boiling broth. Other delicious choices on the menu include the bok sushi, beoseot jjim (mushrooms steamed with seasonings), and doenjang ttukbaegi (soybean paste stewin an earthenware bowl).
name: Samho Bokjip

desc_l10n.en: Tower Chai specializes in shark's fin. They serve standard Chinese cuisine, but the main attractions are the various dishes made with shark's fin, such as soup and steamed shark's fin. One advantage of this place is that instead of the processed frozen shark's fin that is commonly used, they use processed white shark's fin shipped directly from the South Pacific.
desc_l10n.ja: ふかひれ専門の中華料理店。一般的な中華料理も出しているが、メインはフカヒレ。スープ、煮物などの様々なフカヒレ料理を味わえる。加工された冷凍のフカヒレではなく、南太平洋で獲れたホオジロザメを使用している。
desc_l10n.ko: 샥스핀 전문 중식당. 수프, 찜 등 샥스핀을 이용한 다양한 요리.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为专卖鱼翅的中式餐厅。虽然也提供一般的中华料理，但主打商品为鱼翅料理，在此可以品尝到鱼翅汤和煨鱼翅等各式鱼翅料理。店家使用的不是一般加工过的冷冻鱼翅，而是在南太平洋捕获后直接加工的进口白鲨鱼翅。

description: Tower Chai specializes in shark's fin. They serve standard Chinese cuisine, but the main attractions are the various dishes made with shark's fin, such as soup and steamed shark's fin. One advantage of this place is that instead of the processed frozen shark's fin that is commonly used, they use processed white shark's fin shipped directly from the South Pacific.
name: Tower Chai

desc_l10n.en: Persian Palace is an Iranian spicy curry restaurant run by an Iranian immigrant. Their best dish is curry made with lamb marinated in seasonings for three days. The smoked chicken curry is also recommended. Their Persian full-course set menus includevarious kinds of curries, six pieces of chicken, and Iranian-style rice cakes. In addition to curries, you can enjoy various kinds of exotic food, such as Iranian-style bread, yogurt, and alcoholic beverages.
desc_l10n.ja: 留学をきっかけに韓国を訪れたオーナーが長年運営するカレー専門店。ペルシャ風の華やかで異国情緒漂う飾りつけと音楽は、アラブに来たような気持ちにさせてくれる。カレーの辛さも調節できるので、辛いのが苦手な人でも安心して味わえる。香辛料のギフトセットも販売している。
desc_l10n.ko: 이란식 매운 커리 전문점. 현지인이 직접 조리하는 매운 커리.
desc_l10n.zh: 伊朗式辣味咖哩专卖店，在此可以品尝到由当地人所烹煮的辣味咖哩。招牌料理为放至酱料里腌渍3天的羊肉咖哩，使用烟熏鸡肉料理而成的咖哩鸡也非常值得推荐。波斯套餐的内容有各式咖哩酱、6块鸡块，和以波斯米制成的伊朗式年糕。除咖哩外，店内还提供伊朗面包、伊朗酸奶和伊朗酒等各种异国美食。

description: Persian Palace is an Iranian spicy curry restaurant run by an Iranian immigrant. Their best dish is curry made with lamb marinated in seasonings for three days. The smoked chicken curry is also recommended. Their Persian full-course set menus includevarious kinds of curries, six pieces of chicken, and Iranian-style rice cakes. In addition to curries, you can enjoy various kinds of exotic food, such as Iranian-style bread, yogurt, and alcoholic beverages.
name: Persian Palace

desc_l10n.en: This is a 3rd generation naengmyeon restaurant. The restaurant also has Eobokjaengban, beef slices served in a copper dish.
desc_l10n.ja: 3代目が伝統を受け継いでいる冷麺店。味付けはやや薄めながらも深い味わいが感じられる。牛肉のピョニュッ(茹で肉)を真鍮の皿に盛りつけ、複数の人が食べやすいオボクチェンバンも人気メニューだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 3대째 전통을 이어오는 냉면집.  어복쟁반도 인기 메뉴.
desc_l10n.zh: 已经延续到第三代接班人的冷面店。味道清淡却富有层次。将牛肉片放在铜盘中边煮边吃的御腹铮盘也很受欢迎。

description: This is a 3rd generation naengmyeon restaurant. The restaurant also has Eobokjaengban, beef slices served in a copper dish.
name: Pyeongyang Myeonok

name_l10n.ja: ピョンヤン・ミョノク

desc_l10n.en: The most popular dish of Pyeongyangjip is chadolbagi (beef brisket point cut) chargrilled in a rectangular steel grilling basket which comes with a delicious sweet and sour dipping sauce. The tripe and small intestines are also popular. Cabbage and raw garlic are the only side dishes. Fried rice with sliced tripe and cubed radish kimchi is the only rice dish, but it is also very popular. As soon as they open early in the morning, naejangtang (innards soup) is available for breakfast.
desc_l10n.ja: チャドルパギ(牛のあばらの焼肉)が人気のところ。肉をつけて食べるタレがおいしい。ヤンコプチャン(小腸)も人気だ。出てくる小皿はキャベツと生ニンニクだけとシンプル。ご飯にミノと大根キムチをいれて炒めたヤンパプ(ミノご飯)は絶品だ。早朝から営業を開始し、ネジャンタン(内蔵入りスープ)を朝から味わえる。
desc_l10n.ko: 숯불에 굵은 철근으로 된 석쇠를 올리고 구워 먹는 차돌박이가 인기 메뉴.
desc_l10n.zh: 在炭火上用粗铁网烤制的霜降牛排是人气餐点，用来沾肉来吃的酸甜酱料很美味，牛小肠也是人气单品。店开门时间很早，早上还可以吃到杂碎汤。

description: The most popular dish of Pyeongyangjip is chadolbagi (beef brisket point cut) chargrilled in a rectangular steel grilling basket which comes with a delicious sweet and sour dipping sauce. The tripe and small intestines are also popular. Cabbage and raw garlic are the only side dishes. Fried rice with sliced tripe and cubed radish kimchi is the only rice dish, but it is also very popular. As soon as they open early in the morning, naejangtang (innards soup) is available for breakfast.
name: Pyeongyangjip

desc_l10n.en: Pildong Myeonok features authentic Pyeongyang-style naengmyeon (cold buckwheat noodles in an iced broth). To properly enjoy naengmyeon, it should be eaten together with Pyeongan-style mandu (Korean dumplings) or jeyuk (steamed pork slices). Their bibimnaengmyeon (spicy mixed buckwheat noodles) is served with a bowl of the water used to cook the noodles rather than beef broth.
desc_l10n.ja: 平壌(ピョンヤン)式ネンミョン(冷麺)のお店。平安道(ピョンアンド)式マンドゥと一緒に注文するのがおすすめだ。ネンミョンのお店では熱いスープをお茶代わりに出すところが多いが、ここでは麺のゆで汁を出すのが特徴だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 정통 평양식 냉면. 평안도식 만두나 제육과 함께. 뜨거운 육수 대신 사리 삶은 물(면수)을 주는 것이 특징. 을지면옥과 비슷한 맛을 내면서도 이상하게 호불호가 많이 갈리는 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的冷面为正宗的平壤式冷面，若是搭配平安道式饺子或猪肉片一起享用，可以品尝到更棒的美味。

description: Pildong Myeonok features authentic Pyeongyang-style naengmyeon (cold buckwheat noodles in an iced broth). To properly enjoy naengmyeon, it should be eaten together with Pyeongan-style mandu (Korean dumplings) or jeyuk (steamed pork slices). Their bibimnaengmyeon (spicy mixed buckwheat noodles) is served with a bowl of the water used to cook the noodles rather than beef broth.
name: Pildong Myeonok

name_l10n.ja: ピルドン・ミョンノク

desc_l10n.en: Even in the Jangchung-dong area, where the dish originates, this restaurant has a good reputation for its jokbal (sliced pigs trotters in soy sauce). They serve their jokbal neatly sliced and arranged on a tray. It is very tender and chewy and tastes excellent. According to the staff, they only prepare enough jokbal each day to fill the day's orders.
desc_l10n.ja: チョッパル(豚足)で有名なチャンチュンドン(奨忠洞)で人気店の一つ。スライスした豚足が出される。噛み応えのあるチョッパルの味は最高。一日に販売する量の豚足だけを当日に調理して出す。
desc_l10n.ko: 족발로 유명한 장충동에서도 명성을 얻고 있는 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 在以猪蹄闻名的奖忠洞中享负盛名的店家。店家会将猪蹄切片后，整齐地摆在盘中端给顾客，肉质劲道的猪蹄滋味绝佳。而且这里的猪蹄不隔夜卖，店家只会烫煮当天要卖的份量。

description: Even in the Jangchung-dong area, where the dish originates, this restaurant has a good reputation for its jokbal (sliced pigs trotters in soy sauce). They serve their jokbal neatly sliced and arranged on a tray. It is very tender and chewy and tastes excellent. According to the staff, they only prepare enough jokbal each day to fill the day's orders.
name: Pyeongandojip

name_l10n.ja: ピョンアンド・ジョクパルジプ

desc_l10n.en: Seoncheon has served hanjeongsik (Korean set menu) meals for over 40 years. The full-course meal is based on cuisine from the province of Pyeongan-do and includes 10 to 13 different dishes, such as gujeolpan (a platter of nine colorful ingredients served with thin crepes), sashimi, soup, steamed meat or fish, jeon (Korean-style pancakes), skewered bulgogi (marinated thinly shredded beef), and spicy pork. At lunch time, they serve a popular lunch set menu of main dishes and side dishes selected from the full-course meal.
desc_l10n.ja: 営業開始から40年が経った韓定食専門店。北朝鮮の平安道（ピョンアンド)の料理を中心に、韓定食御膳が用意されている。九節板（クジョルパン：肉や野菜などを薄焼きの生地に巻いて食べる宮廷料理)や刺身、鍋、煮物など1～13種類の料理が出される。
desc_l10n.ko: 40여 년 전통의 한정식 전문점
desc_l10n.zh: 拥有40多年历史的韩式套餐专卖店。套餐内容以平安道料理为主，包括九折坂、生鱼片、汤类、蒸物、煎饼类、串烧和猪肉等，10~13道的美味料理。午餐时间的人气料理为，将套餐中出现的料理和小菜精简后提供的午间套餐。

description: Seoncheon has served hanjeongsik (Korean set menu) meals for over 40 years. The full-course meal is based on cuisine from the province of Pyeongan-do and includes 10 to 13 different dishes, such as gujeolpan (a platter of nine colorful ingredients served with thin crepes), sashimi, soup, steamed meat or fish, jeon (Korean-style pancakes), skewered bulgogi (marinated thinly shredded beef), and spicy pork. At lunch time, they serve a popular lunch set menu of main dishes and side dishes selected from the full-course meal.
name: Seoncheon

desc_l10n.en: Seopji Koji is dedicated to serving the regional cuisine of Jeju, particularly wild abalone. They use wild abalone delivered directly from Jeju. Also good is their sashimi such as rock bream, coral fish, and saw-edged perch. The interior is neat.
desc_l10n.ja: アワビ料理とチェジュ(済州)郷土料理が自慢のお店。チェジュド(済州島)で仕入れるアワビを使用しています。そのほかにもカットム(イシダイ)、タグムバリ(アラ)などチェジュ(済州)産の刺身が味わえることができます。店内の雰囲気は日本料理店風。
desc_l10n.ko: 제주도에서 직접 공수해 오는 자연산 전복요리와 제주 향토 음식 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为以野生鲍鱼料理和济州本土料理专门店。使用直接从济州岛空运来的野生鲍鱼。除此之外还可以品尝到济州产石雕、斑鳍光鳃鱼、石斑鱼等生鱼片。室内环境像日本料理店，干净整洁。

description: Seopji Koji is dedicated to serving the regional cuisine of Jeju, particularly wild abalone. They use wild abalone delivered directly from Jeju. Also good is their sashimi such as rock bream, coral fish, and saw-edged perch. The interior is neat.
name: Seopji Koji

desc_l10n.en: Taj Palace is an Indian restaurant that serves authentic cuisine made by Indian chefs. Recommended is the assortment of various tandoori barbecue dishes. There are also various dishes for vegetarians available at reasonable prices.
desc_l10n.ja: インド人が作るインド料理が味わえる。種類豊富なタンドリーバーベキューが味わえるモドゥムセット(盛り合わせセット)がおすすめ。ベジタリアンのための料理も手頃な値段で用意されている。
desc_l10n.ko: 인도인이 만드는 인도 음식. 다양한 탄두리 바비큐를 맛볼 수 있는 모둠세트를 추천. 채식주의자를 위한 음식도 저렴한 가격에 다양하게 마련.
desc_l10n.zh: 在这里可以吃到由印度人做的印度料理，有各种印度烤肉的综合料理是推荐餐点。这里也为素食主义的客人，推出各种价格实惠的料理。

description: Taj Palace is an Indian restaurant that serves authentic cuisine made by Indian chefs. Recommended is the assortment of various tandoori barbecue dishes. There are also various dishes for vegetarians available at reasonable prices.
name: Taj Palace

desc_l10n.en: This is a landmark of the Hannam-dong region. Although a bit expensive, the luxurious interior and great tasting desserts will make up for it.
desc_l10n.ja: ハンナムドン(漢南洞)のランドマーク。インテリア、味、内装まで満足できるもので、値段は高めだが、リッチな気分でパンが味わえる。
desc_l10n.ko: 한남동의 랜드마크. 인테리어, 맛, 데코까지 훌륭.
desc_l10n.zh: 汉南洞的地标建筑！不论是装潢还是味道全都可圈可点。价位虽然偏高，但是能品尝到高级面包的特权谁又舍得放弃呢？

description: This is a landmark of the Hannam-dong region. Although a bit expensive, the luxurious interior and great tasting desserts will make up for it.
name: Passion 5

desc_l10n.en: Oegojip Seolleongtang is famous for their authentic seolleongtang (a thin, milky-white soup made from slowly simmered oxtails and bones). What sets their seolleongtang apart is their use of Hoengseong-raised beef and domestic ingredients (napa cabbage,radish, chili pepper powder, and sun-dried salt). Selected for the Michelin Guide Seoul 2025.
desc_l10n.ja: カンナム(江南)で有名なソルロンタン(牛の肉や骨を煮込んだスープ)のお店。ブランド韓国産牛のハヌ(韓牛)で有名なフェンソン(横城)の牛を使ったソルロンタンとブランド韓国産牛のハヌ(韓牛)の材料(白菜、大根、トウガラシ、天日塩)を使用し、ほかのソルロンタンのお店とは差別化しています。 ミシュランガイドソウル2025に選ばれました.
desc_l10n.ko: 강남에서 유명한 설렁탕집. 횡성 한우와 국산재료 사용.
desc_l10n.zh: 江南地区有名的雪浓汤店，店里使用的是横城韩牛的雪浓汤和国产材料(白菜、萝卜、辣椒粉、海盐)，因此也不同于其他雪浓汤店。 搜索 复制 入选《2025首尔米其林指南》

description: Oegojip Seolleongtang is famous for their authentic seolleongtang (a thin, milky-white soup made from slowly simmered oxtails and bones). What sets their seolleongtang apart is their use of Hoengseong-raised beef and domestic ingredients (napa cabbage,radish, chili pepper powder, and sun-dried salt). Selected for the Michelin Guide Seoul 2025.
name: Oegojip Seolleongtang

name_l10n.ja: ウェゴチプ・ソルロンタン

desc_l10n.en: Go to Teumsae Ramyeon to enjoy various kinds of ramyeon, Korean-style instant noodles (also known as ramen). Most of the ramyeon here is spicy, and is even more delicious when eaten with either gimbap (Korean rolls) or tteok (broiled rice cakes). The smooth and sweet bbalgyetteok made with pepper flakes, egg and rice cakes is also popular. The cold ramen with crunchy young radish and ice is unique and delicious.
desc_l10n.ja: 多彩なラミョン(韓国式インスタントラーメン)が味わえるお店。主に辛い味のラーメンが多く、キムバプ(のり巻き)なども置いてある。卵や餅が入った辛いスープのパルゲトク、唐辛子の入っていないケトクが定番だ。大根と氷が入ったネンラミョン(冷やしラーメン)もおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 한국식 인스턴트 라면의 다양한 맛을 즐길 수 있는 곳. 주로 매운 맛 라면, 떡볶이, 김밥. 고춧가루와 계란, 떡 등을 넣은 얼큰한 국물의 빨계떡과 계란이 들어가 구수하고 부드러운 계떡이 인기.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此可以品尝到各种韩式方便面。主要提供辛辣方便面，也提供辣炒年糕或海苔寿司。加入辣椒面和鸡蛋、年糕的方便面里，飘着鸡蛋的香气，柔软的鸡蛋和年糕非常受欢迎。脆脆的小萝卜和浮有一层薄冰的冷方便面独具风味。明洞店只提供bar ge deok拉面。

description: Go to Teumsae Ramyeon to enjoy various kinds of ramyeon, Korean-style instant noodles (also known as ramen). Most of the ramyeon here is spicy, and is even more delicious when eaten with either gimbap (Korean rolls) or tteok (broiled rice cakes). The smooth and sweet bbalgyetteok made with pepper flakes, egg and rice cakes is also popular. The cold ramen with crunchy young radish and ice is unique and delicious.
name: Teumsae Ramyeon

desc_l10n.en: Jangsuwon serves excellent bulgogi (marinated thinly-sliced beef) and naengmyeon (noodles in chilled broth). The Pyeongyang-style noodles are rather thin, but are made with a high proportion of buckwheat flour. The broth is also very close to authentic Pyeongyang-style. The food is here is quite satisfactory for the price.
desc_l10n.ja: パンベドン(方背洞)のカフェ路地にあるプルコギ＆ネンミョン(冷麺)専門店。ピョンヤン(平壌)冷麺の麺は少し細いのが特徴。ヤンジモリ(牛の胸肉)でとったスープも平壌冷麺の味に近い。プルコギもおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 방배동 카페 골목에 있는 불고기&냉면 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店位于方背洞咖啡厅小巷里，是一家烤肉冷面专门店。平壤冷面里加入了很多燕麦，面比较薄。用牛排骨炖制而成的肉汤与平壤冷面很相配。烤肉也不失原本的风味。

description: Jangsuwon serves excellent bulgogi (marinated thinly-sliced beef) and naengmyeon (noodles in chilled broth). The Pyeongyang-style noodles are rather thin, but are made with a high proportion of buckwheat flour. The broth is also very close to authentic Pyeongyang-style. The food is here is quite satisfactory for the price.
name: Jangsuwon

desc_l10n.en: Anseong Ttosuni specializes in saengtae tang (pollack soup). The great-tasting soup comes in a pot filled with tofu, green onions, water dropwort, and pollack boiled in a spicy broth. Other popular dishes here are their jeyuk bossam (Napa wraps with stir-fried pork) and samhap (fermented skate and steamed pork slices served with kimchi).
desc_l10n.ja: センテチゲ(生スケトウダラ鍋)専門店。豆腐、ネギ、せり、スケトウダラの内蔵などを入れたスープがとてもおいしい。そのほか、チェユクポッサム(ゆでた豚肉をキムチなどと一緒に白菜で包んで食べる料理)、サムハプ(醗酵させたガンギエイと茹で豚肉、完熟キムチを一緒に食べる料理)などもよく出る人気メニューだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 생태찌개 전문점. 두부, 파, 미나리, 생태내장의 칼칼한 국물.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是明太鱼锅专卖店。将豆腐、葱、芹菜及明太鱼的内脏等放入锅内熬煮出来辣味汤汁味道鲜美。另外，本店的生菜包猪肉、三合等也是饕客们必点的人气菜肴。

description: Anseong Ttosuni specializes in saengtae tang (pollack soup). The great-tasting soup comes in a pot filled with tofu, green onions, water dropwort, and pollack boiled in a spicy broth. Other popular dishes here are their jeyuk bossam (Napa wraps with stir-fried pork) and samhap (fermented skate and steamed pork slices served with kimchi).
name: Anseong Ttosuni

desc_l10n.en: Ilsang is a hand-drip coffee shop where you can enjoy a cup of excellent cup of coffee while relaxing and reading one of the many domestic and foreign publications that take up one of the cafe's walls entirely. There are free lessons on hand-drip coffee given by the owner, who has a deep affection for coffee.
desc_l10n.ja: コーヒーへの深い愛情と知識を持つマスターがいるハンドドリップコーヒーショップ。マスターの入れたハンドドリップコーヒーを味わいながら、壁いっぱいに置かれている本を読み、ゆったりとした時間を過ごすことのできるところだ。ハンドドリップコーヒーの無料講座も開かれている。
desc_l10n.ko: 훌륭한 커피를 즐길 수 있는 핸드 드립 커피전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 手冲式滴漏咖啡专卖店。店内的墙上摆满了各种国内外书籍，顾客可以一边看书，一边品尝这美味的咖啡。对咖啡情有独钟的老板还免费开设了手冲式滴漏咖啡的讲座。

description: Ilsang is a hand-drip coffee shop where you can enjoy a cup of excellent cup of coffee while relaxing and reading one of the many domestic and foreign publications that take up one of the cafe's walls entirely. There are free lessons on hand-drip coffee given by the owner, who has a deep affection for coffee.
name: Ilsang

desc_l10n.en: Hong Yuan is a Cantonese restaurant that recently opened within the Chosun Hotel. The steamed live lobster with black soybean sauce is recommended. They also offer traditional Chinese tea, and the interior design, with its red carpet and black pillars and tables, makes for a strong impression.
desc_l10n.ja: 香港式(広東式)中華料理が味わえる。豆板醤ソースで混ぜたロブスター料理がおすすめメニュー。午後には入口に用意されるティーハウスで中国茶も楽しめる。店内は赤のカーペットと黒い柱があり、強烈なインパクトを与えてくれる。
desc_l10n.ko: 홍콩식(광동식) 중식을 맛볼 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到港式中华料理，推荐料理为豆豉炒龙虾。下午时段可以在入口处的茶屋品尝正宗中国茶。红色地毯搭配黑色梁柱和餐桌，颜色对比强烈，凸显品味。

description: Hong Yuan is a Cantonese restaurant that recently opened within the Chosun Hotel. The steamed live lobster with black soybean sauce is recommended. They also offer traditional Chinese tea, and the interior design, with its red carpet and black pillars and tables, makes for a strong impression.
name: Hong Yuan

desc_l10n.en: Halmeoni Kalguksu is famous for kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup) made using anchovy broth. They are also famous for their low prices. Uniquely, they add a little sujebi (hand-torn noodles) to their kalguksu. Also available is a dish called kaljebi,which is half kalguksu and half sujebi.
desc_l10n.ja: イワシのスープを使用したカルクグス(韓国式うどん)で有名なお店。値段が安いと評判だ。カルグクスにスジェビ(すいとん)を少し入れているのが特徴。「カルジェビ」というメニューはカルグクスとスジェビが一緒に入って出てくるメニューのこと
desc_l10n.ko: 멸치 육수를 사용한 칼국수로 유명한 집. 저렴한 가격. 칼국수에 수제비를 약간 넣어주는 것이 특징. 칼제비라고 칼국수와 수제비가 섞어서 나오는 메뉴.
desc_l10n.zh: 使用鳀鱼制作刀切面的人气店家，价格经济实惠，还会在刀切面中加入面疙瘩。另提供名为刀切面疙瘩的料理。

description: Halmeoni Kalguksu is famous for kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup) made using anchovy broth. They are also famous for their low prices. Uniquely, they add a little sujebi (hand-torn noodles) to their kalguksu. Also available is a dish called kaljebi,which is half kalguksu and half sujebi.
name: Halmeoni Kalguksu

name_l10n.ja: ハルモニ・カルクグス

desc_l10n.en: At Urban Garden, you can enjoy homestyle Italian food. They are proud of their rooftop garden with various herbs and fragrant flowers. The rooftop garden is charming, perhaps even more so than the main restaurant, and has two themes, the "healing garden", taking your blues away with its natural fresh scent, and the "kitchen garden", planted with lettuce and chicory.
desc_l10n.ja: 日本のイタリアレストラン出身のシェフによる家庭料理が味わえるお店。ハーブと花の香りが漂う屋上の庭園があり、疲れた心をいやしてくれる「ヒーリングガーデン」とレタスやチコリなどが植えてある「キッチンガーデン」がある。
desc_l10n.ko: 각종 허브와 꽃향기의 옥상 정원이 자랑거리인 이탈리아 정통 레스토랑
desc_l10n.zh: 充满各种香草和花香的空中花园是此店的骄傲。空中花园分为两个部分，一个是利用新鲜花香和绿色植物安抚疲惫心灵的“疗愈花园”，另一个是种植生菜和菊苣等蔬菜的“厨房花园”。主厨来自日本福冈的正宗意式餐厅，主要提供家庭式料理。

description: At Urban Garden, you can enjoy homestyle Italian food. They are proud of their rooftop garden with various herbs and fragrant flowers. The rooftop garden is charming, perhaps even more so than the main restaurant, and has two themes, the "healing garden", taking your blues away with its natural fresh scent, and the "kitchen garden", planted with lettuce and chicory.
name: Urban Garden

desc_l10n.en: Myeongdong Gomdori serves an excellent guksu jeongol (noodle hot pot) made with thinly-sliced shabu shabu meat and crown daisy leaves in a thick anchovy broth. Their fried chicken is also worth trying.
desc_l10n.ja: カタクチイワシでとった濃厚なスープに肉と春菊が入ったチャムグクス(韓国式うどん)がおいしいところ。約20年間、明洞(ミョンドン)で営業してきたが瑞草洞(ソチョドン)に移転。フライドチキンもおすすめだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 20여 년을 명동에서 영업하다가 서초동에 재오픈한 참국수와 치킨.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店已经在明洞经营了20多年，2000年又开始在瑞草洞重新营业。浓浓的鳀鱼汤汁里放入火锅用肉和茼蒿，煮出来的面条非常鲜美。鸡肉也值得品尝。

description: Myeongdong Gomdori serves an excellent guksu jeongol (noodle hot pot) made with thinly-sliced shabu shabu meat and crown daisy leaves in a thick anchovy broth. Their fried chicken is also worth trying.
name: Myeongdong Gomdori

desc_l10n.en: Danggojip specializes in a kind of Koreanized Japanese rice cake skewer called tanggo. Round rice cakes are put on skewers and garnished with sweet red beans, green tea-flavored red beans, or strawberry-flavored red beans. They also offer Japanese-style curry and onigiri (Japanese rice balls).
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国風にアレンジした日本の団子を味わえるところ。丸い餅を串でさし、あんこや緑茶のアメ、イチゴのアメなどをまぶしている。その他にも日本式のカレーとおにぎりもある。
desc_l10n.ko: 일본의 당고라는 떡꼬치의 일종을 한국식으로 만드는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: Dang go为日文串丸子的意思，此店将日本的串丸子改良成韩式口味。店家将丸状的年糕串上竹签后，会铺上红豆馅、绿茶红豆馅或是草莓红豆馅。此外，也能品尝到日式咖哩和三角饭团。

description: Danggojip specializes in a kind of Koreanized Japanese rice cake skewer called tanggo. Round rice cakes are put on skewers and garnished with sweet red beans, green tea-flavored red beans, or strawberry-flavored red beans. They also offer Japanese-style curry and onigiri (Japanese rice balls).
name: Danggojip

desc_l10n.en: Ju is a Chinese restaurant with a modern interior and is run by Chef Ju Deok-seong, one of founding members of Hogyeongjeon, a restaurant in the Westin Chosun Hotel. To properly bring out the best flavors of the ingredients, they cook over open flame. This is a small restaurant with one room and four tables.
desc_l10n.ja: 朝鮮ホテル創立メンバーであるシェフのチュ・ドクソン氏が運営するお店。素材の味を生かした料理が特徴だ。店内はテーブルが4脚、個室が1つだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 조선호텔 호경전 창립 멤버인 주덕성 셰프가 운영하는 중식당.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店由朝鲜酒店豪景殿创立人朱德成厨师经营。适当的火侯将材料的原味发挥得淋漓尽致。此店规模不大，只有一个房间四张桌子。

description: Ju is a Chinese restaurant with a modern interior and is run by Chef Ju Deok-seong, one of founding members of Hogyeongjeon, a restaurant in the Westin Chosun Hotel. To properly bring out the best flavors of the ingredients, they cook over open flame. This is a small restaurant with one room and four tables.
name: Ju

desc_l10n.en: Kkachine is famous for their dakbokkeumtang (braised chicken with potatoes). Because this dish takes a while to prepare, gyeranbeombeok, another one of this restaurant's delicacies, is a great starter. This dish is a kind of pancake made with sausages and eggs.
desc_l10n.ja: タッポックムタン(鶏とじゃがいもを甘辛く煮込んだ鍋)が有名。タッポックムタンは時間が少しかかるため、その前に同店のもう一つの人気メニューである卵にソーセージを入れてチヂミのように焼くケランポムボクもおすすめ。いつも多くの人で賑わうおいしいお店だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 닭볶음탕이 유명.이 집의 또 다른 별미인 계란범벅.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店的红烧鸡最为有名。由于红烧鸡需要一点时间，所以在此之前可以品尝到本店特别制作的小吃，加上香肠的鸡蛋糊也非常美味。

description: Kkachine is famous for their dakbokkeumtang (braised chicken with potatoes). Because this dish takes a while to prepare, gyeranbeombeok, another one of this restaurant's delicacies, is a great starter. This dish is a kind of pancake made with sausages and eggs.
name: Kkachine

desc_l10n.en: Inosisi, the Izakaya (Japanese-style pub), became famous in the Yeonnam-dong area for its fresh sashimi and low prices. Recently, they have adopted an Omakase approach (the selection being left up to the chef, rather than chosen a la carte) and now also have a 'reservation only' policy. You are advised to book well in advance because of the very limited seating.
desc_l10n.ja: 刺身の新鮮さと値段の安さでヨンナムドン(延南洞)では有名な居酒屋。最近は予約制に変わり午後6～7時の時間帯、9時からはおまかせで営業する。当日に予約なしで行く場合は、3万ウォンと5万ウォンの刺身コースの中から選べる。
desc_l10n.ko: 신선한 회와 저렴한 가격으로 연남동 일대에서 이미 유명해진 이자카야.
desc_l10n.zh: 在延南洞一带，一家因新鲜的生鱼片和实惠的价格而出名的居酒屋。最近此店改变了预约制度，预约时间分为6~7点、9点两个时段，在预约时间内只推出＂OMAKASE＂。如果没有预约，有3万元和5万元的生鱼片套餐可供选择。

description: Inosisi, the Izakaya (Japanese-style pub), became famous in the Yeonnam-dong area for its fresh sashimi and low prices. Recently, they have adopted an Omakase approach (the selection being left up to the chef, rather than chosen a la carte) and now also have a 'reservation only' policy. You are advised to book well in advance because of the very limited seating.
name: Inosisi

desc_l10n.en: Dongbingo makes great-tasting traditional patbingsu using only milk, red beans and rice cake. Many find the rather chunky and sweet red bean sauce to be very addictive.
desc_l10n.ja: 牛乳、小豆、餅などのシンプルな材料でも最高の味のパッピンスで有名な店。やや荒めに見えるが、大粒の小豆とすっきりした甘さがくせになるほどおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 우유, 팥, 떡 등의 심플한 재료로도 최상의 맛을 내는 곳. 투박해 보이지만 굵은 팥과 깔끔한 단 맛이 금세 중독될 정도.
desc_l10n.zh: 只选用牛奶、红豆和年糕等基础原料打造出最佳味道。看上去虽不起眼，但是大粒的红豆和清爽的甜味却会让人越吃越上瘾。

description: Dongbingo makes great-tasting traditional patbingsu using only milk, red beans and rice cake. Many find the rather chunky and sweet red bean sauce to be very addictive.
name: Dongbinggo

desc_l10n.en: Eunjujeong offers only two dishes: samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly) and kimchi jjigae (kimchi stew). You get a nice big helping of kimchi to have with your grilled pork. The vegetable side dishes are nice, and the kimchi is nicely made.
desc_l10n.ja: サムギョプサル(豚の三枚肉焼き)を注文するとキムチチゲ(キムチ鍋)が一緒に出されるのが特徴。メニューは2種類のみだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 삼겹살을 구워 먹으면 김치찌개를 푸짐하게 갖다 주는 것이 특징. 메뉴는 두 가지. 푸짐하게 나오는 쌈 채소와 칼칼한 김치.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的特色为若点烤五花肉，便会附赠份量十足的辛奇（kimchi）炖汤。虽然菜单只有2种，但生菜和香辣辛奇（kimchi）的口感也非常不错。

description: Eunjujeong offers only two dishes: samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly) and kimchi jjigae (kimchi stew). You get a nice big helping of kimchi to have with your grilled pork. The vegetable side dishes are nice, and the kimchi is nicely made.
name: Eunjujeong

desc_l10n.en: An authentic Turkish-owned eatery, offering a choice of chicken or lamb kebabs. You can eat in or take out.
desc_l10n.ja: トルコ人シェフによるトルコ式ケバブが味わえる。鶏肉、羊肉などの肉で作られるケバブは、食事にもぴったりだ。気軽に座って食べられる座席があり、テイクアウトもできる。
desc_l10n.ko: 터키인이 직접 만드는 터키식 케밥.
desc_l10n.zh: 由土耳其主厨亲自烹制正宗的土耳其烤肉卷饼。夹着牛肉或鸡肉的卷饼份量实在，足可以当作一顿正餐。店内设有简单的桌椅，也可以打包带走。

description: An authentic Turkish-owned eatery, offering a choice of chicken or lamb kebabs. You can eat in or take out.
name: Sultan Kebab

name_l10n.zh: 苏丹土耳其卡巴餐厅(Sultan Kebab)

desc_l10n.en: Jidaebang is a traditional tea shop in Insadong where you can chat over tea. There are more than 60 types of traditional teas to choose from, and they use only hand-harvested or naturally grown teas, so you're guaranteed to get a fresh cup of traditional tea. When you order tea, you'll be served a thermos with hot water in a tea set, and the owner will guide you through the process. The interior has a natural feel, and 40 years of tradition is evident. It is a quiet refuge in the bustling streets of Insadong, and is loved by locals and foreigners alike, young and old alike.
desc_l10n.ja: ジデバン ( 지대방 ) は 、 お 茶 を 飲 みながら 談笑 する 仁寺洞 の 伝統茶屋 です 。 ここで 楽 しめる 伝統茶 の 種類 はなんと 60 種類以上 あり 、 直接収穫 したり 、 自然栽培 されたお 茶 だけを 使用 しているので 、 新鮮 な 伝統茶 をしっかり 楽 しむことができます 。 お 茶 を 注文 すると 、 茶器 セットにお 湯 が 入 った 魔法瓶 を 出 してくれるので 、 自分 で 淹 れて 飲 めるように 店主 が 親切 に 案内 してくれます 。 店内 は 自然 な 雰囲気 で 、 40 年 の 伝統 を 感 じさせます 。 複雑 な 仁寺洞 ( インサドン : 인사동 ) 路地 で 静 かな 憩 いの 場 のようなここは 、 内外国人 、 老若男女問 わず 誰 にでも 愛 される 場所 です 。
desc_l10n.ko: 주인이 직접 재배한 차로 맛을 내는 전통차 전문점
desc_l10n.zh: Jidaebang 是一家位于仁寺洞的传统茶店 ， 在这里你可以边喝茶边聊天 。 这里有 60 多种传统茶叶可供选择 ， 他们只使用手工采摘或自然生长的茶叶 ， 所以你可以享受到最新鲜的传统茶 。 当你点茶时 ， 你会得到一个装在茶具里的热水保温瓶 ， 店主会很高兴地指导你完成这个过程 。 室内有一种自然的感觉 ， 40 年的传统也是显而易见的 。 它是仁寺洞繁华街道中的一个安静的避难所 ， 受到当地人和外国人的喜爱 ， 不管是年轻人还是老人 。

description: Jidaebang is a traditional tea shop in Insadong where you can chat over tea. There are more than 60 types of traditional teas to choose from, and they use only hand-harvested or naturally grown teas, so you're guaranteed to get a fresh cup of traditional tea. When you order tea, you'll be served a thermos with hot water in a tea set, and the owner will guide you through the process. The interior has a natural feel, and 40 years of tradition is evident. It is a quiet refuge in the bustling streets of Insadong, and is loved by locals and foreigners alike, young and old alike.
name: Jidaebang

desc_l10n.en: This is a Korean cuisine restaurant that specializes in food from the Joseon Dynasty. Poom has modified the cuisine of the Joseon upper-class to satisfy modern palates. Because it uses fresh seasonal ingredients and natural seasonings, the menu changeswith the season. The grilled sirloin steak is a popular dish, and reservations are required.
desc_l10n.ja: 朝鮮時代のヤンバン(両班、貴族階級)料理を現代的に再 解釈した韓定食レストラン。最高の食材をチョイスし、天然調味料だけで味をつける。旬の食材を使用するため、季節によってメニューが異なる。ロース炭火焼きが有名で、必ず事前に予約が必要だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 조선시대의 양반음식을 현대적으로 재해석해서 선보이는 한정식집. 최상의 식재료를 선택해서 천연양념 사용. 제철의 식재료를 사용하기 때문에 계절에 따라 메뉴가 상이. 채끝등심숯불구이가 유명하고, 반드시 사전 예약.
desc_l10n.zh: 将朝鲜时代的两班贵族饮食以现代手法重新诠释的韩定食店。选用最上等食材，配以天然调味料，烹调出至高美味。因为只使用当季食材，因此每个季节的菜单都有所不同。最有名的是炭烤西冷牛排。须事先预约。

description: This is a Korean cuisine restaurant that specializes in food from the Joseon Dynasty. Poom has modified the cuisine of the Joseon upper-class to satisfy modern palates. Because it uses fresh seasonal ingredients and natural seasonings, the menu changeswith the season. The grilled sirloin steak is a popular dish, and reservations are required.
name: Poom Seoul

desc_l10n.en: Hangang Chicken is a fried chicken restaurant that serves chicken in a delicious fried batter coating. Its the kind of place you'd find in your own neighborhood back home, so it's very comforting to have a beer here with a plate of hot fresh fried chicken.This restaurant is very popular so expect it to be busy when you go.
desc_l10n.ja: フライドチキンのころもが美味しいと評判の店。気軽にビールとフライドチキンを楽しめる近所のお店といった雰囲気で、ファンも多い 。
desc_l10n.ko: 프라이드 치킨의 튀김옷이 맛있는 집. 간단하게 맥주 한잔할 수 있는 동네 치킨집 분위기. 손님이 많아서 맥주의 소비율이 높아 생맥주가 신선.
desc_l10n.zh: 店内的气氛宛如隔壁的邻居家，让人可以简单地小酌一杯啤酒，炸鸡美味。客流量高，啤酒的消耗快，所以本店的生啤酒最新鲜。

description: Hangang Chicken is a fried chicken restaurant that serves chicken in a delicious fried batter coating. Its the kind of place you'd find in your own neighborhood back home, so it's very comforting to have a beer here with a plate of hot fresh fried chicken.This restaurant is very popular so expect it to be busy when you go.
name: Hangang Chicken

desc_l10n.en: Primo Bacio Baci is the best-known pasta restaurant in front of Hongik University. You always have to wait in line for about an hour to be seated. They do not take reservations. Prices are quite low.
desc_l10n.ja: ホンデ(弘大)エリアで最も有名なパスタ専門店。常に一時間以上は並ばないと食べられないほど。予約は受けつけていない。
desc_l10n.ko: 홍대 앞에서 가장 유명세를 타고 있는 파스타 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 弘大附近知名的意大利面专卖店，非常受欢迎，经常必须排队1小时以上才能吃到。这里不接受预约，价格也不算贵。

description: Primo Bacio Baci is the best-known pasta restaurant in front of Hongik University. You always have to wait in line for about an hour to be seated. They do not take reservations. Prices are quite low.
name: Primo Bacio Baci

desc_l10n.en: Star Chef makes delicious fusion-style Chinese cuisine. As there are only twelve tables, reservations are highly recommended, especially at dinner time. Popular dishes include their sweet and sour beef and sirloin steak salad made with premium beef.
desc_l10n.ja: 新羅ホテル出身のシェフが作る絶品の中華料理を味わえるところ。テーブル席が12脚しかないので、夜は予約するのおすすめだ。最上級の牛肉を使ったサーロインステーキザラダとソコギタンスユク(牛肉の酢豚風)が人気メニューだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 신라호텔 출신 오너 셰프의 맛깔스러운 퓨전음식.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到由新罗饭店出身的主厨所烹煮的美味中华料理。店内仅设有12个座位，因此晚餐时段最好能事先预约。人气餐点为纽约客牛排沙拉和糖醋牛肉。

description: Star Chef makes delicious fusion-style Chinese cuisine. As there are only twelve tables, reservations are highly recommended, especially at dinner time. Popular dishes include their sweet and sour beef and sirloin steak salad made with premium beef.
name: Star Chef

desc_l10n.en: Deogwon Kkorigomtang Bangchitang is famous for soups made with special cuts of beef, such as kkorigomtang (oxtail soup) and bangchitang (hip bone soup) The portions of meat are quite generous, and it's nice to just pick it up and eat it right off thebone.
desc_l10n.ja: パンチタン(牛の尻骨)、チュントマク(尻骨とテールの間)など牛の特殊部位で作ったスープが有名なところ。尻骨とテールの一部だけを入れてスープのダシを取っているのが特徴だ。骨にたっぷり付いている肉もおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 방치탕(소 엉덩이뼈), 중토막(엉덩이뼈와 꼬리 사이) 등 소의 특수부위로 만든 탕. 깔끔하게 엉덩이뼈와 꼬리 토막만 넣어서 끓인 것이 특징.
desc_l10n.zh: 用bang chi tang(牛尾骨)、jung to mak(尾骨跟尾巴中间)等牛的特殊部位制作的汤，远近闻名。只放入尾骨和尾巴切片，然后加以烹煮的方式是其特征。把骨头上的肉挑出来吃非常美味。

description: Deogwon Kkorigomtang Bangchitang is famous for soups made with special cuts of beef, such as kkorigomtang (oxtail soup) and bangchitang (hip bone soup) The portions of meat are quite generous, and it's nice to just pick it up and eat it right off thebone.
name: Deogwon Kkorigomtang Bangchitang

name_l10n.ja: トグォン・コリコムタン・パンチタン

desc_l10n.en: Singyechi is a Ramyeon (ramen) noodle restaurant that has been in operation for 25 years. They serve Korean instant ramen, not the Japanese variety. Their patented "shin-gye-chi" Ramyeon (spicy ramen with eggs and cheese) is very popular.
desc_l10n.ja: 創業25年のラーメン専門店。日本式ラーメンではなく、韓国式のインスタントラーメンを専門にしている。特許を受けたシンゲチラーメン（辛ラーメン+卵+チーズが入っている）が人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 25년이 넘는 한국식 인스턴트 라면전문점.  특허 받은 신계치라면(신라면+계란+치즈(치즈라면)).
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是具有25年历史的韩式方便面专卖店。“Xin gae chi方便面“（辛拉面+鸡蛋+奶酪）甚至取得了专利，也相当受欢迎 。

description: Singyechi is a Ramyeon (ramen) noodle restaurant that has been in operation for 25 years. They serve Korean instant ramen, not the Japanese variety. Their patented "shin-gye-chi" Ramyeon (spicy ramen with eggs and cheese) is very popular.
name: Singyechi

desc_l10n.en: Square Garden is a famous hand-drip coffee shop in Seorae Maeul. Their home-style burgers and quesadillas also taste excellent. This is a very small place with only four tables, but it is charmingly decorated, so it is the hideaway of choice for manypeople.
desc_l10n.ja: ソレマウルでおいしい評判のハンドドリップコーヒー店。コーヒーのほかにも食事もでき、手製ハンバーガーとケサディア(メキシコ風ピザ)がおすすめだ。 4つのテーブルしかない小さな店内だが、多くの人が訪れている。
desc_l10n.ko: 서래마을에서 핸드드립커피가 유명한 곳. 식사로 먹을 수 있는 수제홈버거와 퀘사디아의 맛도 일품. 4개의 테이블로 된 작은 공간이지만, 아기자기하게 꾸며져 있어 사람의 아지트 역할.
desc_l10n.zh: 位于瑞来村，因手冲滤泡式咖啡而出名的咖啡厅。在这里可以品尝到手工汉堡和quesadillas，非常美味。虽然店内只能容纳4张桌子，空间狭小，但不少的客人光顾。

description: Square Garden is a famous hand-drip coffee shop in Seorae Maeul. Their home-style burgers and quesadillas also taste excellent. This is a very small place with only four tables, but it is charmingly decorated, so it is the hideaway of choice for manypeople.
name: Square Garden

desc_l10n.en: Bella Praha has become famous for hand-drip coffee and trdlo, a kind of Czech pastry. One nice feature is that you can choose the brewing method for your coffee: espresso, hand drip, cotton-flannel drip, syphon, or Dutch style. To make trdlo, dough iswound around an iron bar and baked. The interior is charmingly decorated with eye-catching accessories imported from the Czech Republic.
desc_l10n.ja: ハンドドリップコーヒーとトゥールドゥールが楽しめるところ。エスプレッソ、ハンドドリップ、ネルドリップ、サイフォン、ダッチコーヒーなど、好きなようにコーヒーの抽出方式が決められるのがうれしい。トゥールドゥールとは、生地を鉄の棒に巻いて火であぶったパンの一種です。
desc_l10n.ko: 핸드드립 커피와 뜨르들르를 맛볼 수 있는 것으로 명소가 된 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店因提供手冲滤泡式咖啡和捷克面包卷(Trdlo)而出名。此店的优点在于，顾客可以自行选择偏好的咖啡冲泡方式，如意式浓缩咖啡、手冲滤泡式咖啡、法兰绒滤网冲泡咖啡(Nel drip)、虹吸式咖啡(Syphon)和冰滴咖啡(Dutch coffee)等。捷克面包卷是面包的一种，将面团缠绕于铁竿上后，再以火烘烤完成。店家从捷克带回来的可爱饰品，也相当引人注目

description: Bella Praha has become famous for hand-drip coffee and trdlo, a kind of Czech pastry. One nice feature is that you can choose the brewing method for your coffee: espresso, hand drip, cotton-flannel drip, syphon, or Dutch style. To make trdlo, dough iswound around an iron bar and baked. The interior is charmingly decorated with eye-catching accessories imported from the Czech Republic.
name: Bella Praha

desc_l10n.en: Jangsu Sikdang is famous for their kimchi samgyeopsal, pork belly that is grilled together with kimchi on a thin cast-iron pan and stir-fried with sesame leaves and spicy seasoning. After the meat course, you can have rice that is stir-fried on the same pan, which tastes excellent.
desc_l10n.ja: キムチ・サムギョプサルチム(キムチとサムギョプサルの蒸し物)が人気の店。キムチ・サムギョプサルチムを注文すると、真ん中にキムチを置いて、その周りにサムギョプサルを置いた状態でサービングされます。鉄板にキムチとサムギョプサルを焼きながらごまの葉とネギを入れ味付けます。肉を食べたあとは炒めご飯もできます。
desc_l10n.ko: 김치삼겹살, 부대찌개가 인기가 좋은 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店的招牌料理为辛奇（kimchi）五花肉。先将五花肉和辛奇（kimchi）放在薄薄的铁盘中稍微翻炒后，再加进芝麻叶和辣酱炒熟便可享用。五花肉吃完后，再加入白饭拌炒而成的炒饭亦相当美味。招牌上的名称为议政府部队锅辛奇（kimchi）五花肉。

description: Jangsu Sikdang is famous for their kimchi samgyeopsal, pork belly that is grilled together with kimchi on a thin cast-iron pan and stir-fried with sesame leaves and spicy seasoning. After the meat course, you can have rice that is stir-fried on the same pan, which tastes excellent.
name: Jangsu Sikdang

desc_l10n.en: Paolo de Maria is the first restaurant opened by Paolo de Maria, the former executive chef of the Italian restaurant Bona Sera. They style themselves as a 'fine-dining trattoria'. The dishes show the chef's attention to detail, and the desserts are quite pleasing. The atmosphere is modern, with an indoor terrace.
desc_l10n.ja: イタリアンレストラン「ポナセラ」のシェフだったパウロ・デ・マリアが自身の名前でオープンした最初のレストラン。シェフの繊細さがよく表れている料理とデザートはどれも満足させてくれます。テラス席もあり、店内の雰囲気もモダンだ。コース料理のほか、アラカルト料理も多くあります。
desc_l10n.ko: 이탈리안 레스토랑 보나세라의 총괄 셰프가 자신의 이름을 걸고 오픈한 레스토랑
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是曾担任博纳塞拉意式餐厅厨房长的Paolo de Maria用自己名字开设的第一家店。巴人Trattoria正是效仿他们。主厨精心准备的料理和甜点让人非常满意。店内的环境非常现代，除了这些套餐以外，还准备了多种单独的菜色。

description: Paolo de Maria is the first restaurant opened by Paolo de Maria, the former executive chef of the Italian restaurant Bona Sera. They style themselves as a 'fine-dining trattoria'. The dishes show the chef's attention to detail, and the desserts are quite pleasing. The atmosphere is modern, with an indoor terrace.
name: Paolo de Maria

desc_l10n.ja: イタリアの家庭料理が味わえるブランチカフェ。イタリア農家の素朴な家庭料理とワイン、ハンドドリップコーヒーが味わえる。世界各国の料理本もあり、本を眺めながらゆっくりとした時間を過ごせるところだ。午後2時から6時の間はドリンクのみ注文可能。
desc_l10n.ko: 이탈리아 가정식 브런치 카페.

desc_l10n.en: Yeojaman is run by a female film director, Ms. Mirye Lee. The name of the restaurant, "Yeojaman (Yeoja Bay)", comes from the name of a geographical location between Goheung and Yeosu. The restaurant expertly specializes in the cuisine of Jeollanam-do,the southern province of the region of Jeolla. The kkomak (ark shell) set menu is very popular.
desc_l10n.ja: 全羅南道(チョルラナムド)料理専門店。コマッジョンシク（ハイガイ定食)が人気。女性映画監督のイ・ミレ氏が運営するお店としても有名だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 전라남도 고흥과 여수 사이에 있는 ‘여자만’이라는 지명에서 이름을 따온 남도음식 전문주점. 꼬막정식이 인기. 여성 영화감독 이 미례 씨가 운영하는 곳으로도 유명.
desc_l10n.zh: 南道料理专卖店，店名取自位于全罗南道高兴和丽水之间的“汝自湾”，是由女性电影导演李美礼小姐所经营。人气料理为鸟蛤套餐。

description: Yeojaman is run by a female film director, Ms. Mirye Lee. The name of the restaurant, "Yeojaman (Yeoja Bay)", comes from the name of a geographical location between Goheung and Yeosu. The restaurant expertly specializes in the cuisine of Jeollanam-do,the southern province of the region of Jeolla. The kkomak (ark shell) set menu is very popular.
name: Yeojaman

desc_l10n.en: This dim sum and noodle restaurant was opened by the owners of Mao, a restaurant specializing in Peking duck. The prices here are quite reasonable.
desc_l10n.ja: 北京ダック専門店「マオ」で出している飲茶と麺の専門店。気軽に楽しめる庶民の中華料理が売り。
desc_l10n.ko: 북경오리 전문점 마오에서 운영하는 딤섬과 국수 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 北京烤鸭专卖店mao经营的点心和汤面专卖店，是可以轻松享用的大众化中华料理。

description: This dim sum and noodle restaurant was opened by the owners of Mao, a restaurant specializing in Peking duck. The prices here are quite reasonable.
name: Bruce Lee

desc_l10n.en: For 40 years, Busan Galbi has been serving galbi. They have a good reputation in their area. After enjoying a meal of galbi, it's nice to have naengmyun (buckwheat noodles either served in a chilled broth or mixed with spicy sauce). They also offer beoseot saeng-bulgogi (fresh, thinly sliced beef and mushrooms), galbi-tang (beef rib soup), and naengmyun set, which are quite popular with office workers in the neighbourhood.
desc_l10n.ja: 梨泰院(イテウォン)ハミルトンホテルの後ろに位置する焼肉店。同店で、少し変わってるのはカルビとシーフードを両方味わえるところだ。3階建ての建物すべてがレストランになっており、屋上でも食事が出来る。天気が良い日や夏の夜は野外で焼肉を楽しむことも可能。メインメニューは、カルビ、ヘムルタン(海鮮鍋)、カルナクタン(カルビとタコのスープ)など。肉がたっぷり入ったカルビタン(カルビのスープ)とカンジャンケジャン(カニの醤油漬け)は一番の人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 40년 가까이 되는 역사를 가진 갈빗집. 일대에서는 맛집으로 소문이 난 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 拥有40年悠久历史的排骨店，美味的菜肴早已远近闻名。吃完排骨后，再来碗冷面会更好。尽在午饭时供应的蘑菇生烤肉、排骨汤和冷面套餐备受附近上班族的喜爱。

description: For 40 years, Busan Galbi has been serving galbi. They have a good reputation in their area. After enjoying a meal of galbi, it's nice to have naengmyun (buckwheat noodles either served in a chilled broth or mixed with spicy sauce). They also offer beoseot saeng-bulgogi (fresh, thinly sliced beef and mushrooms), galbi-tang (beef rib soup), and naengmyun set, which are quite popular with office workers in the neighbourhood.
name: Busan Galbi

desc_l10n.en: Enjoy coffee at MK2 while perusing the accessories that decorate its interior. These accessories are also available for purchase. The surrounding area is very quiet, making this a good place to enjoy a peaceful moment.
desc_l10n.ja: おいしいコーヒーとともに飾られたインテリアも楽しめるお店。コーヒー関連の小物も販売している。静かな雰囲気も良い。
desc_l10n.ko: 커피와 함께 인테리어 소품들을 즐길 수 있는 곳. 소품 판매.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可一边品尝咖啡，一边欣赏室内的各种小饰品。本店还兼卖各种小饰品。周围安静的气氛也非常不错。

description: Enjoy coffee at MK2 while perusing the accessories that decorate its interior. These accessories are also available for purchase. The surrounding area is very quiet, making this a good place to enjoy a peaceful moment.
name: MK2

desc_l10n.en: Pancake Original Story is a brunch cafe where you can enjoy brunch items, such as pancakes and toast. The most popular choice on the menu is their light, fluffy pancakes, but they also offer a wide variety of other items, such as omelettes and pancakes sets.
desc_l10n.ja: パンケーキとトーストなどのブランチが楽しめるカフェ。ふんわりとしたパンケーキが人気で、オムレツ、パンケーキセットなど色々なメニューを用意している。
desc_l10n.ko: 팬케이크와 토스트 등 브런치를 즐길 수 있는 브런치 카페.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为早午餐咖啡厅，在此可品尝到薄煎饼和吐司等。松软、可口的薄煎饼备受顾客喜爱。此店还销售煎蛋卷、薄煎饼套餐等多种食物。

description: Pancake Original Story is a brunch cafe where you can enjoy brunch items, such as pancakes and toast. The most popular choice on the menu is their light, fluffy pancakes, but they also offer a wide variety of other items, such as omelettes and pancakes sets.
name: Pancake Original Story

desc_l10n.en: Manjok Ohyang Jokbal serves ohyang jokbal ("five spice" pigs trotters), and it has a loyal following of ardent fans. Their jokbal is so popular because they use five different spices that reduces the intense smell of the meat. They provide manduguk (dumplingsoup) with your meal. They open at 4 p.m, but if you want to have jokbal for dinner, its recommended that you arrive early as they usually run out quickly. Their sign reads "Jokbal Mandu", so be careful not to miss it.
desc_l10n.ja: ファンが多く訪れるオヒャンチョッパル(五香豚足)の店。五香を使って生臭さをなくした豚足が人気で、食事にはマンドゥクク(餃子スープ)が必ずついてくるのが特徴。午後4時から営業を始めるが、夜の遅い時間は豚足がなくなることもあるので早めに行くのがおすすめ。看板には「チョッパルマンドゥ」と書いているので間違えないように。
desc_l10n.ko: 마니아를 많이 거느리는 전설적인 오향 족발집.
desc_l10n.zh: 满足很多饕客传说中的五香猪蹄店，使用五香去掉腥味的猪蹄很有人气，用餐时还会附赠饺子汤。4点开始营业，但是猪蹄卖得很快。

description: Manjok Ohyang Jokbal serves ohyang jokbal ("five spice" pigs trotters), and it has a loyal following of ardent fans. Their jokbal is so popular because they use five different spices that reduces the intense smell of the meat. They provide manduguk (dumplingsoup) with your meal. They open at 4 p.m, but if you want to have jokbal for dinner, its recommended that you arrive early as they usually run out quickly. Their sign reads "Jokbal Mandu", so be careful not to miss it.
name: Manjok Ohyang Jokbal

name_l10n.ja: マンジョク・オヒャンチョッバル

desc_l10n.en: Samgakjeong is famous for samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly). Because you can enjoy good-quality samgyeopsal and the atmosphere is folksy and comfortable, this place is very popular. They are also famous for mosori-sal, a part of the jowl or cheek. People often visit this restaurant for the crispy grilled pork rinds.
desc_l10n.ja: サムギョプサル(豚の三枚肉焼き)で有名なお店。静かな雰囲気で質の良いサムギョプサルを味わえることして人気だ。ハンジョンサル(豚の首肉)の一種のモソリサル(豚の肩肉)やテジコプテギ(豚の皮)も人気。
desc_l10n.ko: 편안한 분위기에서 질 좋은 삼겹살을 맛 볼 수 있는 서민적인 분위기.
desc_l10n.zh: 以烤五花肉闻名的店家，可以在轻松的氛围下吃到优质的五花肉，因为平易近人的气氛，因此颇受欢迎。这里的后颈肉很有名，也有很多人来这里点烤猪头皮吃。

description: Samgakjeong is famous for samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly). Because you can enjoy good-quality samgyeopsal and the atmosphere is folksy and comfortable, this place is very popular. They are also famous for mosori-sal, a part of the jowl or cheek. People often visit this restaurant for the crispy grilled pork rinds.
name: Samgakjeong

desc_l10n.en: Jaembaeok, which has been run for three generations, specializes in Seolleongtang (ox bone soup). Another popular item on their menu is the assortment of steamed beef, with cuts such as head meat, brisket point cut, brisket, and flank, Swiss-cut tongue, shank, and spleen.
desc_l10n.ja: 約80年間、3代に続いて営業しているソルロンタン（牛骨肉の煮込みスープ）のお店。チァドルパギ（肋間にある固い脂肪質を含む肉）、ウソル（牛タン）など、数種類の肉が味わえるモドムスユク（茹で肉の盛り合わせ）が人気メニューだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 3대째 이어오는 설렁탕집. 모둠 수육이 인기 메뉴.
desc_l10n.zh: 经营至第3代的牛杂碎汤专卖店。招牌人气菜——综合水煮肉有牛头肉、霜降牛肉、牛排骨、牛舌牛腱和牛皮脏等。1933年在首尔站开业，最近已迁至市厅附近。

description: Jaembaeok, which has been run for three generations, specializes in Seolleongtang (ox bone soup). Another popular item on their menu is the assortment of steamed beef, with cuts such as head meat, brisket point cut, brisket, and flank, Swiss-cut tongue, shank, and spleen.
name: Jaembaeok

desc_l10n.en: Leonidas is a chocolate cafe opened by Leonidas, a famous Belgian chocolate company. Enjoy luxurious chocolates made from real cocoa butter. Beverages here are inexpensive.
desc_l10n.ja: ベルギーで有名なチョコレートの名店レオニダスがオープンしたチョコレートカフェ。天然カカオバターを使った高級なチョコレートが味わえる。
desc_l10n.ko: 벨기에의 유명한 초콜릿 명가 레오니다스에서 오픈한 초콜릿 카페.
desc_l10n.zh: 比利时的巧克力名店利奥尼达斯(Leonidas)所开设的巧克力咖啡厅，在此可以品尝到使用天然可可奶油制作而成的高级巧克力，也提供价格实惠的饮品。

description: Leonidas is a chocolate cafe opened by Leonidas, a famous Belgian chocolate company. Enjoy luxurious chocolates made from real cocoa butter. Beverages here are inexpensive.
name: Leonidas

desc_l10n.en: Le Brunchic is a French restaurant where you can enjoy brunch. The food is high quality, and the atmosphere is comfortable.
desc_l10n.ja: ブランチが楽しめるフランスレストラン。落ち着いた雰囲気でレベルの高いブランチを味わえる。
desc_l10n.ko: 브런치를 즐길 수 있는 프랑스 레스토랑. 편안한 분위기에서 수준급의 브런치.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店是可以尽情享受法国美食的法式餐厅。舒适的环境里可以品尝到高级的法国美食。

description: Le Brunchic is a French restaurant where you can enjoy brunch. The food is high quality, and the atmosphere is comfortable.
name: Le Brunchic

desc_l10n.en: At this famous Bukchang-area rice porridge house, you can choose from over ten different varieties of rice porridge, all of which are great. Another popular dish here is their nutritious rice cooked in a cauldron with oysters and prawns.
desc_l10n.ja: 北倉洞（プクチャンドン）で有名なお粥店。様々な種類のお粥が用意されている。それぞれの好みによって選んで食べられるのがうれしい。牡蠣が入っているヨンヤンソッパブ(栄養釜めし)も有名だ 。
desc_l10n.ko: 북창동 내에서 유명한 죽집으로, 10가지가 넘는 다양한 종류의 죽이 있어 각자의 입맛에 따라 선택. 굴과 대하가 들어 있는 영양 솥밥으로도 유명.
desc_l10n.zh: 位于北仓洞的知名粥店，店内提供10种以上的粥品供顾客选择。加入牡蛎和鲜虾的营养石锅饭也相当受到欢迎。

description: At this famous Bukchang-area rice porridge house, you can choose from over ten different varieties of rice porridge, all of which are great. Another popular dish here is their nutritious rice cooked in a cauldron with oysters and prawns.
name: Sogong Jukjip

desc_l10n.en: Mongjungheon offers Cantonese cuisine, Hong Kong-style dim sum, and congee (rice porridge). You can even watch dim sum being prepared in the kitchen located near the entrance. The restaurant has a classy atmosphere, and service is good. Prices are on the high side.
desc_l10n.ja: 広東風中華料理と香港風の飲茶とCongee(中国粥)が味わえるお店。入口にある厨房ではシュウマイを作っている姿が見られる。店内の雰囲気も高級感があり、サービスも一流。価格は若干高めだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 광동식 중식과 홍콩식 딤섬, 콘지 등을 맛볼 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到广式料理和港式点心、粥品等，在店门口便可以看见点心师傅在厨房制作点心。室内氛围雅致高档，服务亲切周到。

description: Mongjungheon offers Cantonese cuisine, Hong Kong-style dim sum, and congee (rice porridge). You can even watch dim sum being prepared in the kitchen located near the entrance. The restaurant has a classy atmosphere, and service is good. Prices are on the high side.
name: Mongjungheon

desc_l10n.en: This Jeong-dong area restaurant is quite famous for their light-tasting kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup) and mandu (dumplings). They prepare sagol (four legs) broth (made using the four leg bones of a cow), but the real delicacies at this restaurant are the white kimchi and red kimchi they offer as side dishes. They use napa cabbage that is grown in cold climates, and the seasonings are not strong, so it is a perfect match with the noodles. Their gookbap (rice in beef broth) and bossam (steamed pork with napa cabbage wraps) are also very good.
desc_l10n.ja: さっぱりした味のカルクグス(韓国式うどん)とマンドゥ(餃子)で貞洞(チョンドン)一帯ではかなり有名なお店。 牛骨スープを使っているのが特徴で、おかずに出てくる白いキムチと真っ赤なキムチは、同店自慢の一品。高冷地の白菜を使っていて、薬味も辛くなく麺との相性は抜群。クッパとポッサム(ゆで豚肉の葉野菜包み)もおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 담백하고 깔끔한 맛의 칼국수와 만두로 정동 일대에서는 꽤 유명한 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店在贞洞地区颇有名气，招牌料理为清爽的刀切面和饺子。特色为牛大骨汤汁以及随餐附赠的白辛奇（kimchi）和红辛奇（kimchi）。使用高山白菜，腌酱也不刺激。汤饭和辛奇（kimchi）包猪肉也值得一尝。

description: This Jeong-dong area restaurant is quite famous for their light-tasting kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup) and mandu (dumplings). They prepare sagol (four legs) broth (made using the four leg bones of a cow), but the real delicacies at this restaurant are the white kimchi and red kimchi they offer as side dishes. They use napa cabbage that is grown in cold climates, and the seasonings are not strong, so it is a perfect match with the noodles. Their gookbap (rice in beef broth) and bossam (steamed pork with napa cabbage wraps) are also very good.
name: Jeongdong Guksi

desc_l10n.en: Namu Sairo is a peaceful place to have a cup of coffee in the Gwanghwamun area. In the summer, it's nice to have your coffee on the terrace. They offer hand-drip coffee in addition to other kinds of coffee.
desc_l10n.ja: 静かな雰囲気の中でコーヒーを味わえるところ。夏は店内よりもテラスでコーヒーを楽しむのがおすすめだ。ハンドドリップのコーヒーは他の豆の種類でもお替りが可能。
desc_l10n.ko: 광화문 일대에서 조용하고 분위기 있게 커피를 마실 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店位于光化门，顾客可以在宁静的氛围中享用咖啡。夏天可以选择露天阳台的座位。另外，手工滴漏咖啡可选择其他口味续杯。

description: Namu Sairo is a peaceful place to have a cup of coffee in the Gwanghwamun area. In the summer, it's nice to have your coffee on the terrace. They offer hand-drip coffee in addition to other kinds of coffee.
name: Namu Sairo

desc_l10n.en: This is a fusion teahouse that combines modernity and tradition. Especially popular here are the slow brewed organic teas and traditional Korean drinks such as sweet rice drink (sikhye) and cinnamon punch (sujeonggwa). Visitors can also see on displaytraditional arts and crafts.
desc_l10n.ja: 伝統と現代のフュージョンカフェ。有機材料を長い時間煮詰めた伝統茶が味わえる。シッケ(韓国式甘酒)やスジョングァ(しょうがとシナモンの飲み物)が特に人気。伝統工芸の小物が展示されているので、お茶を飲みながら楽しめる。
desc_l10n.ko: 전통과 현대의 퓨전식 카페. 유기농 재료의 전통차. 식혜나 수정과
desc_l10n.zh: 传统与现代相结合的新概念咖啡馆。用有机原料慢慢冲泡的传统茶风味独特。韩式酒酿和水正果最具人气。店内还布置了很多传统手工艺品供宾客欣赏 。

description: This is a fusion teahouse that combines modernity and tradition. Especially popular here are the slow brewed organic teas and traditional Korean drinks such as sweet rice drink (sikhye) and cinnamon punch (sujeonggwa). Visitors can also see on displaytraditional arts and crafts.
name: Banjjakbanjjak Binnaneun

name_l10n.ja: パンチャッパンチャッ・ビンナヌン

desc_l10n.en: Om is a Nepalese and Indian restaurant run by the manager of the Nepal Tourism Board. You can have a variety of curries and tandoori chicken, which is marinated in traditional spices for one day and baked in a tandoori oven. The smells and flavors of the dishes here are typical of Indian cuisine, although not as strong.
desc_l10n.ja: ネパール観光庁所長が運営するネパール・インド料理専門店。インド伝統の香辛料で一日ねかせたあと、かまどで焼いたタンドリーチキンや様々な種類のカレーがおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 네팔관광청 소장이 운영하는 네팔/인도 요리 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店是由尼泊尔观光厅所长经营的尼泊尔印度料理专门店。在这里可以品尝到在印度传统香料腌制一天之后再拿到炉灶里进行烧烤的印度烤鸡和各式各样的咖喱。此店虽然保留了印度料理特有的香味，但是那种香味已没有那么强烈。

description: Om is a Nepalese and Indian restaurant run by the manager of the Nepal Tourism Board. You can have a variety of curries and tandoori chicken, which is marinated in traditional spices for one day and baked in a tandoori oven. The smells and flavors of the dishes here are typical of Indian cuisine, although not as strong.
name: Om

desc_l10n.en: Yeongdong Jokbal has been serving up Jokbal (pigs' feet) for over 30 years. Along with Nolbu Mandu and Seongsu Jokbal, Yeongdong Jokbal is considered one of the three best Jokbal restaurants in Seoul. The meat is tender, thick, and slightly salty for that perfect Jokbal flavor.
desc_l10n.ja: 30年の伝統を誇るチョッパル(豚足)のお店。ソウルで有名な「ソンスチョッパル」とともに3大チョッパル店の一つと呼ばれている。お肉は柔らかくてとてもジューシーだ 。
desc_l10n.ko: 30여 년 전통의 족발 집. 놀부만두, 성수족발과 서울의 3대 족발 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 该猪蹄店拥有30多年的悠久历史，与"Nolboo饺子"、" 圣水猪蹄子"一起，并称为首尔三大猪蹄子店。肉咸咸的、厚厚的，很有弹性，味道很好。

description: Yeongdong Jokbal has been serving up Jokbal (pigs' feet) for over 30 years. Along with Nolbu Mandu and Seongsu Jokbal, Yeongdong Jokbal is considered one of the three best Jokbal restaurants in Seoul. The meat is tender, thick, and slightly salty for that perfect Jokbal flavor.
name: Yeongdong Jokbal

name_l10n.ja: ヨンドン・チョッパル

desc_l10n.en: At The Kings buffet restaurant, the food is cooked in front of you, and they offer a selection of over 150 dishes including dim sum, Peking roast duck, and barbecued dishes freshly made to order. All of the seafood they use, including the lobster, is notably fresh.
desc_l10n.ja: 北京ダックやバーベキューなど約150種類の料理を楽しめるバイキングレストラン。ロブスターなど新鮮な海鮮が人気だ 。
desc_l10n.ko: 150여 가지의 음식을 즉석에서 서빙해주는 뷔페
desc_l10n.zh: 引入现场烹调概念，能够马上吃到点心、北京烤鸭、烤肉等150余种料理的自助餐，使用龙虾等新鲜海产品。

description: At The Kings buffet restaurant, the food is cooked in front of you, and they offer a selection of over 150 dishes including dim sum, Peking roast duck, and barbecued dishes freshly made to order. All of the seafood they use, including the lobster, is notably fresh.
name: The Kings

desc_l10n.en: Ayajin Saengtae Jjigae is famous for saengtae jjigae (fresh pollack stew), which they make with a generous portion of hard roe. They thoroughly boil the whole fresh pollack in a tin pot. The soup is spicy and flavorful, so saengtae jjigae on its own can make a satisfying meal.
desc_l10n.ja: センテチゲ(スケトウダラの鍋)が有名なお店。銀色の鍋にスケトウダラをまるごと入れて煮る。タラからダシが出たスープが味わい深い。
desc_l10n.ko: 곤이가 푸짐하게 들어 있는 생태찌개가 유명한 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 有着丰富鱼卵的鲜明太鱼锅很有名，在锅子里放上满满的鲜明太鱼鱼块然后煮滚，汤汁鲜美，咸淡合适，只吃一碗鲜明太鱼鱼锅也可以吃很饱。

description: Ayajin Saengtae Jjigae is famous for saengtae jjigae (fresh pollack stew), which they make with a generous portion of hard roe. They thoroughly boil the whole fresh pollack in a tin pot. The soup is spicy and flavorful, so saengtae jjigae on its own can make a satisfying meal.
name: Ayajin Saengtae Jjigae

name_l10n.ja: アヤジン・センテチゲ

desc_l10n.en: For over 40 years, Heungjinok has been offering traditional Gyeongsang-do-style haejang-guk (hangover soup). The soup is loaded with beef omasum, intestines, and coagulated ox-blood. There is also plenty of a lot of napa cabbage, dried napa cabbage, andmung-bean sprouts, and they prepare the broth made with beef bones, so the soup is rich but refreshing. Although not particularly clean-tasting, the soup is very rich and flavorful.
desc_l10n.ja: 清進洞(チョンジンドン)を代表するヘジャングク(二日酔いによいとされるスープ)のお店。40年の伝統を誇る慶尚道(キョンサンド)式ヘジャングクが味わえるところだ。センマイ、ソンジ(固めた牛の血)がたくさん入っている。また、牛骨スープに白菜とウゴジ(乾燥させた白菜)、もやしなども入っており、さっぱりしているが深くて濃い味のあるヘジャングクだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 청진동을 대표하는 해장국집. 40년 전통의 경상도식 해장국.
desc_l10n.zh: 本店是清进洞内众多解酒汤中极具代表的一家，来到本店可以品尝到传承四十年的庆尚道解酒汤。满锅的牛肚、内脏、牛血，以及用牛骨熬煮的汤汁还塞满白菜、辛奇（kimchi）叶、黄豆芽等，美味爽口。

description: For over 40 years, Heungjinok has been offering traditional Gyeongsang-do-style haejang-guk (hangover soup). The soup is loaded with beef omasum, intestines, and coagulated ox-blood. There is also plenty of a lot of napa cabbage, dried napa cabbage, andmung-bean sprouts, and they prepare the broth made with beef bones, so the soup is rich but refreshing. Although not particularly clean-tasting, the soup is very rich and flavorful.
name: Heungjinok

desc_l10n.en: At Chuncheon Son Kalguksu, which has been in business for 30 years, the big hit in the summer is makguksu (thick buckwheat noodles in chilled broth with hot sauce) is popular, and in the winter, it's their kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup). The kalguksu is topped with chicken and ground peanuts. They make their own chicken broth and their own noodles. The interior is decorated with artwork by the owner, who used to be an artist.
desc_l10n.ja: 夏にはマッククス(そば粉を用いた冷たい麺料理)、冬にはカルクグス(韓国式うどん)が人気の30年の伝統を持つ麺料理専門店。カルグクスには鶏肉とピーナッツの粉が入っている。スープは鶏ガラで、麺は自家製麺を使用。 画家出身の店長が自ら描いた絵が飾ってあるのが印象的だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 여름에는 막국수, 겨울에는 칼국수가 인기있는 30년 전통의 면요리 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为拥有30年历史的面料理专卖店，荞麦面在夏天较受欢迎，冬天则是刀切面。刀切面的配料为鸡肉和花生碎末，高汤是由鸡肉熬煮而成，面条是手工揉制的。画家出身的老板，用自己的作品装饰店面，让本店更具特色 。

description: At Chuncheon Son Kalguksu, which has been in business for 30 years, the big hit in the summer is makguksu (thick buckwheat noodles in chilled broth with hot sauce) is popular, and in the winter, it's their kalguksu (handmade knife-cut noodle soup). The kalguksu is topped with chicken and ground peanuts. They make their own chicken broth and their own noodles. The interior is decorated with artwork by the owner, who used to be an artist.
name: Chuncheon Son Kalguksu

name_l10n.ja: チュンチョン・ソンカルクグス

address: 서울특별시 강남구 논현동 영동시장 뒷길 일대

desc_l10n.ko: 외국인들도 반한 정겨운 나이트 라이프서민들의 삶이 녹아 있는 곳이 포장마차

name: 논현포차골목

desc_l10n.en: Enjoy Samhakdo-style cuisine from Mokpo, Jeolla-do. They use fresh ingredients delivered daily from Mokpo. Their specialties are kingfish, octopus, and skate, and the skate samhap (a combination of three ingredients: aged skate, boiled pork, and fermented kimchi) is recommended.
desc_l10n.ja: チョルラナムド(全羅南道)、モクポ(木浦)、サムハクド(三鶴島)スタイルの南道料理を味わえるところ。クポ(木浦)から毎日直送される新鮮な食材を使用。ニベ、タコ、ガンギエイを専門に扱っており、ガンギエイのサムハプ(醗酵させたガンギエイと茹で豚肉、完熟キムチを一緒に食べる料理)がおすすめ。
desc_l10n.ko: 전라남도 목포 삼학도 스타일의 남도 음식을 접할 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到具有全罗南道木浦三鹤岛特色的南道饮食。此店每天都使用从木浦直接运送过来的新鲜食材。值得推荐的菜色是由黄姑鱼，章鱼，斑鳐三种海鲜配上辛奇（kimchi）制作而成的斑鳐三合。
