description: Enjoy Samhakdo-style cuisine from Mokpo, Jeolla-do. They use fresh ingredients delivered daily from Mokpo. Their specialties are kingfish, octopus, and skate, and the skate samhap (a combination of three ingredients: aged skate, boiled pork, and fermented kimchi) is recommended.
name: SamhakdoA

desc_l10n.en: Suchiku opened recently, following the renovation of 63 Building. You can have sushi and sashimi prepared with very fresh ingredients. The view from the sushi counter on the 58th floor is said to be the best in Seoul.
desc_l10n.ja: 新鮮な素材の寿司と刺身が味わえる日本料理店。63ビル内にの58階に位置している。味はもちろん、寿司カウンターからの展望はソウルで一番だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 신선한 재료의 맛을 살린 스시와 사시미를 맛볼 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 63大楼美食街整修过后新开张的店，可以吃到用新鲜材料制成的寿司和生鱼片。

description: Suchiku opened recently, following the renovation of 63 Building. You can have sushi and sashimi prepared with very fresh ingredients. The view from the sushi counter on the 58th floor is said to be the best in Seoul.
name: Suchiku

desc_l10n.en: This Gangnam-area restaurant is famous for yukgaejang (spicy beef soup). They make their yukgaejang with less gosari (bracken fern) than other restaurants do, but it tastes very refreshing and is very popular. Their side dishes are also neatly presented and nicely accentuate the flavor of their yukgaejang.
desc_l10n.ja: ユッケジャン(野菜と牛肉のピリ辛スープ)で有名なお店。他店のユッケジャンに比べ、ワラビは少なめだが、スープの味で評判が高い。いつも多くの客で賑っているところだ。
desc_l10n.ko: 강남 육개장으로 유명한 집. 얼큰한 맛이 일품.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店位于江南附近，经营已久，因辣味牛肉汤而出名。与别家的辣味牛肉汤相比，此店的辣味牛肉汤中放入了更多的蕨菜，辛辣的味道美味至极，前来光顾的客人络绎不绝。各种小菜也很爽口，这让原本味美的辣味牛肉汤更是锦上添花。

description: This Gangnam-area restaurant is famous for yukgaejang (spicy beef soup). They make their yukgaejang with less gosari (bracken fern) than other restaurants do, but it tastes very refreshing and is very popular. Their side dishes are also neatly presented and nicely accentuate the flavor of their yukgaejang.
name: Donggyeong Jeontong Yukgaejang

name_l10n.ja: トンギョン・ジョントン・ユッケジャン
name_l10n.zh: 东京传统辣味牛肉汤(Donggyeong Jeontong Yukgaejang)

desc_l10n.en: Pohang sikdang specializes in gwamegi (winter-dried Pacific saury) delivered from Pohang. This gwamegi does not have the usual fishy smell, so it can be enjoyed even by those trying it for the first time. They also offer giant octopus and agu suyuk (boiledtender slices of puffer fish).
desc_l10n.ja: クァメギ(冬の潮風にニシンやサンマを乾燥したもの)専門店だ。クァメギの生臭さはなく、クァメギを初めて食べる人にもおすすめだ。クァメギの他、アグスユク(アンコウ蒸し)などもある。
desc_l10n.ko: 포항에서 직송으로 가져오는 과메기를 사용하는 과메기 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店使用从浦项直接运送过来的青鱼鱼干，是一家青鱼鱼干专营店。青鱼鱼干本身并没有腥味，第一次享用的人也可以尽情享用。除了青鱼鱼干以外，此店还有石章鱼、琵琶鱼白切肉。

description: Pohang sikdang specializes in gwamegi (winter-dried Pacific saury) delivered from Pohang. This gwamegi does not have the usual fishy smell, so it can be enjoyed even by those trying it for the first time. They also offer giant octopus and agu suyuk (boiledtender slices of puffer fish).
name: Pohang Sikdang

desc_l10n.en: This restaurant was the first in Korea to specialize in French cuisine. They have an atmosphere of a casual brasserie. With a sporty, casual interior, their menu now offers more selection at a wider range of prices, so you can enjoy dining here without concern for the cost. They offer Korean beef steak, and from the menu, you can choose which cut you want and the amount, making ordering very convenient.
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国で最も古いフランス料理専門店。最近改装され、カジュアルなブラッスリー(朝から晩まで飲んだり食べたりできるお店)となった。部位の種類が豊富で、グラム単位で味わえるブランド韓国産牛の韓牛ステーキメニューがおすすめだ 。
desc_l10n.ko: 우리나라에서 가장 오래된 프랑스 요리 전문 레스토랑
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为韩国历史最悠久的法式餐厅，2011年5月为抛弃过去传统的印象，因此以悠闲餐馆的概念重新开业。采用了活泼的室内装修之后，价格也分不同的档次。各种部位和不定期准备的韩牛牛排值得一尝。

description: This restaurant was the first in Korea to specialize in French cuisine. They have an atmosphere of a casual brasserie. With a sporty, casual interior, their menu now offers more selection at a wider range of prices, so you can enjoy dining here without concern for the cost. They offer Korean beef steak, and from the menu, you can choose which cut you want and the amount, making ordering very convenient.
name: The NiNth Gate Grille

desc_l10n.en: Donggyeong Sikdang offers home-style Japanese dishes prepared in modern Japanese style. You can have neatly-presented Japanese dishes in a modern Japanese-style atmosphere. They are famous for their home-style oden (fish cakes). This is a good place to enjoy sake at dinner time. The prices are somewhat high.
desc_l10n.ja: 日本の家庭料理店。アレンジされたモダンなスタイルの日本料理が味わえる。自家製のおでんが有名で、夜はお酒を楽しむにも良い。値段は少し高め。
desc_l10n.ko: 모던일식을 내세우는 일식 가정식 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 以时尚日本料理为主的日式专卖店，在既有日本风又有时尚感的店内，可以吃到清爽的日式料理。店家直接制作的手工黑轮很有名，晚上可以来杯日本烧酒也不错。本店价格稍微偏高。

description: Donggyeong Sikdang offers home-style Japanese dishes prepared in modern Japanese style. You can have neatly-presented Japanese dishes in a modern Japanese-style atmosphere. They are famous for their home-style oden (fish cakes). This is a good place to enjoy sake at dinner time. The prices are somewhat high.
name: Donggyeong Sikdang

desc_l10n.en: At Andong Mungtigi, you can enjoy excellent yuk-sashimi (fresh beef sliced like sashimi and served raw and unmarinated) made with Korean beef from Andong. It is a specialty restaurant serving Mungtigi yukhoe, where meat slaughtered on the same day is sliced ​​into large chunks and dipped in a fantastic sauce.
desc_l10n.ja: 安東(アンドン)地方から取り寄せたブランド韓国産牛の韓牛(ハヌ)のユクサシミ(牛肉の刺身)がおいしいところ。 当日屠殺した肉をムンタングムンタング切って幻のソースに撮って食べるムンチギ肉会専門店です。
desc_l10n.ko: 안동에서 올라온 한우를 사용하는 육사시미 맛이 일품인 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 这里供应的韩牛刺身（yuk sashimi）堪称一绝，选用的是安东产的韩牛。 这是一家特色餐厅，供应当天宰杀的牛肉，切成大块，蘸上特制酱汁。

description: At Andong Mungtigi, you can enjoy excellent yuk-sashimi (fresh beef sliced like sashimi and served raw and unmarinated) made with Korean beef from Andong. It is a specialty restaurant serving Mungtigi yukhoe, where meat slaughtered on the same day is sliced ​​into large chunks and dipped in a fantastic sauce.
name: Andong Mungtigwa

name_l10n.ja: アンドン Andong Mungtigwa twopulgui

desc_l10n.en: This bakery is known for its leavened breads. May Bell supplies bread to many of the restaurants in the area. Prices are reasonable and portions generous.
desc_l10n.ja: 天然発酵種を使ったパンで有名だ。適切な価格設定で質と量の両方を満足させている。イテウォン(梨泰院)にある多くのレストランがこの店のパンを使うほど信頼されている。
desc_l10n.ko: 천연발효종을 사용한 빵으로 유명. 적당한 가격에 질과 양 모두를 만족.
desc_l10n.zh: 因使用天然面肥来制作面包而享有盛名. 物美价廉令人称赞. 梨泰院的很多餐厅都采购这里的面包，非常值得信赖.

description: This bakery is known for its leavened breads. May Bell supplies bread to many of the restaurants in the area. Prices are reasonable and portions generous.
name: Oworui Jong

desc_l10n.en: Dakgomtang is a well-established restaurant that serves dakgomtang (chicken soup), and their dakgomtang is so popular with their patrons because of the clear broth. They have been in operation for nearly 50 years.
desc_l10n.ja: 昔から営業しているタッコムタン(鶏の煮込みスープ)店。コクのあるスープの味で有名だ。約50年の歴史を誇る。
desc_l10n.ko: 오래된 닭곰탕 집으로, 맑게 국물을 낸 닭곰탕이 아는 사람들에게는 이미 유명
desc_l10n.zh: 历史悠久的韩式炖鸡汤店，拥有50多年的历史，汤汁清澈，远近闻名。

description: Dakgomtang is a well-established restaurant that serves dakgomtang (chicken soup), and their dakgomtang is so popular with their patrons because of the clear broth. They have been in operation for nearly 50 years.
name: Dakgomtang

desc_l10n.en: Buwonmyeonok specializes in Pyeongyang-style naengmyeon (cold buckwheat noodles served either in a tangy broth). They have been operating in Namdaemun Market for around 50 years. This restaurant is especially popular with customers from North Korea. Two popular dishes on the menu are dakmuchim (shredded boiled chicken served with salt and pepper) and bindaetteok (Korean-style pancake made of ground mung beans, green onions, and kimchi)
desc_l10n.ja: 南大門(ナムデムン)市場で50年間営業している平壌(ピョンヤン)式ネンミョン(冷麺)店。北朝鮮出身のお客が多く訪れている。タッムチム(鶏の和えもの)とピンデトク(緑豆チヂミ)も人気メニュー。
desc_l10n.ko: 남대문 시장 내에서 50여 년간 자리를 지켜온 평양냉면 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店是在南大门市场经营了50多年的平壤冷面店。许多来自朝鲜的人经常光顾此店。凉拌鸡肉、绿豆煎饼也是此店的招牌菜。

description: Buwonmyeonok specializes in Pyeongyang-style naengmyeon (cold buckwheat noodles served either in a tangy broth). They have been operating in Namdaemun Market for around 50 years. This restaurant is especially popular with customers from North Korea. Two popular dishes on the menu are dakmuchim (shredded boiled chicken served with salt and pepper) and bindaetteok (Korean-style pancake made of ground mung beans, green onions, and kimchi)
name: Buwonmyeonok

name_l10n.ja: プウォン・ミョンノク

desc_l10n.en: Yangcholli is famous for chargrilled samgyeopsal (pork belly) and has a neat atmosphere. At dinner time, fresh samgyeopsal cooked on a charcoal brazier is recommended, and at lunch time, the kimchi jeongol (kimchi hot pot) and sundubu jjigae (soft tofu stew) is recommended. A plus is you can cook the hot pot and stew over oak charcoal. The restaurant has an airy feeling because both the first and second floor are open to the outside and each has its own outdoor terrace.
desc_l10n.ja: 炭火で焼くサムギョプサル(豚の三枚肉焼き)が有名。夜には炭火で焼いて食べるセンサムギョップサルの焼肉、お昼はキムチチゲ(キムチ鍋)とスンドゥブ(おぼろ豆腐のピリ辛鍋)などを味わえる。鍋とチゲも炭のコンロを使って食べられるのが特徴。パーティションのない開放的な雰囲気で1・2階の他、屋外テラスの席もある。
desc_l10n.ko: 참숯에 구워 먹는 삼겹살이 유명한, 깔끔한 분위기의 고깃집.
desc_l10n.zh: 此店为环境整洁的烤肉店，招牌菜色为使用顶级炭火烧烤的五花肉。晚餐时段适合享用放在炭火炉上烧烤的新鲜五花肉，午餐时段也可以品尝到 辛奇 (Kimchi) 锅和豆腐锅等，此店的特色为锅类也能使用炭火炖煮。宽敞的1、2楼给人畅快的感觉，另有独立的室外阳台。

description: Yangcholli is famous for chargrilled samgyeopsal (pork belly) and has a neat atmosphere. At dinner time, fresh samgyeopsal cooked on a charcoal brazier is recommended, and at lunch time, the kimchi jeongol (kimchi hot pot) and sundubu jjigae (soft tofu stew) is recommended. A plus is you can cook the hot pot and stew over oak charcoal. The restaurant has an airy feeling because both the first and second floor are open to the outside and each has its own outdoor terrace.
name: Yangcholli

desc_l10n.en: Coffee Tour specializes in house-roasted hand-drip coffee. It is quite small, but their great-tasting coffee has garnered a loyal following. They also carry a wide range of coffee-making equipment that is available for purchase.
desc_l10n.ja: ハンドドリップコーヒー専門店。狭い店内だが、常連客が多いところだ。コーヒーに関連する器具も販売している。
desc_l10n.ko: 직접 로스팅한 원두를 사용하는 핸드드립 커피 전문점. 아담하고 좁은 공간이지만 커피 맛이 뛰어나 단골로 찾는 손님들이 많음. 커피 관련 각종 기구도 판매.
desc_l10n.zh: 直接烘培原豆来使用的手工咖啡专卖店，虽然店内空间窄小，但是咖啡味道非常棒，所以熟客很多。本店也销售咖啡的各种相关用具。

description: Coffee Tour specializes in house-roasted hand-drip coffee. It is quite small, but their great-tasting coffee has garnered a loyal following. They also carry a wide range of coffee-making equipment that is available for purchase.
name: Coffee Tour

desc_l10n.en: Daedong is a Seoul branch of a famous Peking duck restaurant in Beijing. Enjoy authentic Peking duck prepared by Chinese chefs. The open kitchen gives the restaurant an airy feeling. Besides Peking duck, they offer a variety of other regional Beijing dishes.
desc_l10n.ja: 北京で有名な北京ダック専門店の韓国店。現地来たシェフが作る本場の北京ダックが味わえる。北京ダックの他に北京式の中華料理も多く揃えている。
desc_l10n.ko: 베이징의 유명한 북경오리 전문점의 서울 분점.
desc_l10n.zh: 著名的北京烤鸭店首尔分店。厨房长是从北京直接招聘过来的，厨房长亲自用炉灶烤鸭子，因此在这里也可以品尝到正宗的北京烤鸭。开放式的厨房给人一种舒服的感觉。此店除了北京烤鸭以外，还提供多种北京式的中国料理。

description: Daedong is a Seoul branch of a famous Peking duck restaurant in Beijing. Enjoy authentic Peking duck prepared by Chinese chefs. The open kitchen gives the restaurant an airy feeling. Besides Peking duck, they offer a variety of other regional Beijing dishes.
name: Daedong

desc_l10n.en: Despite its small size, the restaurant China is very famous for delicious jjamppong (spicy seafood noodle soup), jajangmyeon (stir-fried noodles with black soybean sauce), and tangsuyuk (sweet and sour beef or pork).
desc_l10n.ja: 中華料理店。小さなお店だがチャンポン、ジャージャー麺(チャジャンミョン)、タンスユク(酢豚)などがおいしいと評判だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 자그마한 집이지만 짬뽕, 짜장면, 탕수육 등이 맛있는 집.
desc_l10n.zh: 店面不大，但因此店的辣汤面、炸酱面、糖醋肉味道好，远近闻名。

description: Despite its small size, the restaurant China is very famous for delicious jjamppong (spicy seafood noodle soup), jajangmyeon (stir-fried noodles with black soybean sauce), and tangsuyuk (sweet and sour beef or pork).
name: Jungguk

desc_l10n.en: The owner of Sanchon, a former monk who learned to cook while living in a temple, prepares authentic temple food which is rustic and neatly presented. Your table is filled with a wide variety of side dishes. Their dishes are prepared without meat from seasonal vegetables and mountain herbs, so it is suitable for those with a vegetarian diet.
desc_l10n.ja: 野生草を使った素朴なスタイルの精進料理が味わえるところ。僧侶だった社長がお寺での生活で学んだ料理を提供しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 해초류등을 사찰음식으로 정성과 정갈, 청결하게 만들어 대중에게 알리는 음식점.
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到用野菜烹制而成的寺庙菜肴。僧侣出身的老板烹制出从寺庙生活中学到的菜肴。在此店可以品尝到清淡爽口的寺庙菜肴。

description: The owner of Sanchon, a former monk who learned to cook while living in a temple, prepares authentic temple food which is rustic and neatly presented. Your table is filled with a wide variety of side dishes. Their dishes are prepared without meat from seasonal vegetables and mountain herbs, so it is suitable for those with a vegetarian diet.
name: Sanchon

desc_l10n.en: For many years, this Yeoido-area restaurant has been serving dongtaetang (frozen pollack stew). It is very popular with people who work in the area, so be prepared to stand in line if you visit around lunchtime. The soup is prepared with a generous portion of ingredients and seasonings, so it is spicy and rich but also light tasting.
desc_l10n.ja: ヨイド(汝矣島)で長く営業しているトンテタン(スケトウダラの鍋)の店。ヨイド(汝矣島)のサラリーマンたちが足しげく通うところで、いつも行列ができています。たっぷり入ったトンテタンは絶品。
desc_l10n.ko: 여의도에서 오래된 동태탕 집. 직장인들에게 꾸준히 사랑 받는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 拥有悠久历史的冻明太鱼汤店，广受附近上班族的喜爱，经常需要排队等位。老板对材料和腌酱一点都不吝啬，可以吃到香辣，回味无穷的明太鱼汤。

description: For many years, this Yeoido-area restaurant has been serving dongtaetang (frozen pollack stew). It is very popular with people who work in the area, so be prepared to stand in line if you visit around lunchtime. The soup is prepared with a generous portion of ingredients and seasonings, so it is spicy and rich but also light tasting.
name: Buheung Dongtae

desc_l10n.en: It is a store run by CEO Kim Young-mo, a Korean confectionery master, and is a few private bakeries that have been consistently loved for more than 30 years. In particular, Mont Blanc, which is eaten round and round along the grain, melts in the mouth.
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国製菓の匠キム・ヨンモ代表が運営する店で、30年間愛されている、最近ではあまり見られなくなった個人経営のパン屋。特に、きめに沿ってくるくる回しながら食べるモンブランは、口の中で静かに溶ける。
desc_l10n.ko: 대한민국 제과 명장인 김영모 대표가 운영하는 빵집.
desc_l10n.zh: 韩国烘焙大师金英毛经营的店铺，在30余年间一直深受人们的厚爱，是目前为数不多的个人烘焙店之一。店中最受欢迎的是顺着层次转着圈吃的“勃朗峰”，入口即化，香甜美妙。

description: It is a store run by CEO Kim Young-mo, a Korean confectionery master, and is a few private bakeries that have been consistently loved for more than 30 years. In particular, Mont Blanc, which is eaten round and round along the grain, melts in the mouth.
name: Patisserie Kim Youngmo

name_l10n.zh: 金英毛果子店(Patisserie Kim Youngmo)

desc_l10n.en: Trattoria Moro is a casual Italian restaurant where you can enjoy Italian cuisine and wines. Their pasta is excellent, and a wide variety of main dishes are also available. It's a good place to enjoy wine as they are open until the early morning.
desc_l10n.ja: カジュアルなイタリア料理とワインが味わえるトラットリア。パスタがおいしい。早朝まで営業しているため、ワインバーとしても利用できる。
desc_l10n.ko: 그안의 셰프가 독립한 곳. 파스타 등 다양한 종류의 메인 요리 준비
desc_l10n.zh: 可品尝到意大利料理和红酒的餐饮店。该店的意大利面味道不错，还备有各种主菜。该店一直营业至凌晨，是一家口碑不错的红酒吧。

description: Trattoria Moro is a casual Italian restaurant where you can enjoy Italian cuisine and wines. Their pasta is excellent, and a wide variety of main dishes are also available. It's a good place to enjoy wine as they are open until the early morning.
name: Trattoria Moro

desc_l10n.en: Sujebi is hand-pulled noodles boiled in broth. Served in an earthenware bowl, the sujebi here is particularly delicious. Spicy sujebi with oysters and haemul pajeon (seafood and green onion pancake) are this restaurant’s specialties. Patrons can experience a very traditional Korean atmosphere at Insadong Sujebi.
desc_l10n.ja: 壺に盛られているすいとん専門店。 カキ入りのピリ辛すいとんと海鮮チヂミが有名です。 常連たちは個人の壺を持っていて壁に陳列されている。 室内の雰囲気はかなり土俗的だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 항아리에 담겨 나오는 수제비 전문점. 굴이 들어간 얼큰한 수제비와 해물파전. 단골들은 개인 항아리를 갖고 있어 벽에 진열. 실내 분위기는  토속적.
desc_l10n.zh: 特色罐子面片汤餐厅，新鲜贝类熬制的辣爽面片汤与海鲜葱饼都非常有名。老顾客们将个人专属的坛子寄放于店内并陈列於墙面的柜子中,餐厅内部装潢充满了传统气息。

description: Sujebi is hand-pulled noodles boiled in broth. Served in an earthenware bowl, the sujebi here is particularly delicious. Spicy sujebi with oysters and haemul pajeon (seafood and green onion pancake) are this restaurant’s specialties. Patrons can experience a very traditional Korean atmosphere at Insadong Sujebi.
name: Insadong Sujebi

name_l10n.ja: 仁寺洞ハンアリスジェビ

desc_l10n.en: Mung beans are freshly ground into paste with authentic millstones. Savory bindaetteok is made with the freshly made mung bean paste. Mung bean bindaetteok and meat pancakes are the only 2 items on the menu. You can eat hot made bindaetteokat one of the tables or take it to go. Enjoy with a drink of makgeolli.
desc_l10n.ja: その場ですった緑豆を使って作っているピンデトック(緑豆のチヂミ)。外はサクッ、中はふんわりとしたピンデトックを味わえる。メニューはピンデトックとコギワンジャ(肉と野菜入りのおやき)の2つのみ。持ち帰り可能。
desc_l10n.ko: 매장 한 쪽에서 맷돌을 사용하여 녹두가루를 만드는 녹두빈대떡
desc_l10n.zh: 广藏市场内最名声在外的煎饼店。店内现场磨制绿豆粉新鲜制作煎饼，虽仅提供绿豆煎饼与肉丸子两种菜单，却凭独特口味与热情服务脱颖而出，几乎每天都座无虚席。

description: Mung beans are freshly ground into paste with authentic millstones. Savory bindaetteok is made with the freshly made mung bean paste. Mung bean bindaetteok and meat pancakes are the only 2 items on the menu. You can eat hot made bindaetteokat one of the tables or take it to go. Enjoy with a drink of makgeolli.
name: Soonhee's Bindaetteok

name_l10n.ja: スニネ・ピンデトック

desc_l10n.en: One of the main reasons why everyone should go to Gwangjang Market is for the original "addictive gimbap." It's "addictive" attribute comes from it being so delicious and snackable thanks to its miniature size. People just keep going back for more. Though most other stores here claim that they are the original, Mother and Daughter's Gimbap is the real original with over 40 years of history.
desc_l10n.ja: クァンジャン(広蔵)市場に行くべき理由の一つが一度食べると癖になるキムバプ(韓国海苔巻き)の元祖店。ここは約40年前からキムバプを出しているところ。中身は人参とたくわんのみが入ったシンプルな海苔巻きだが、からしソースにつけて食べる味は病みつきにることから「やみつきキムバプ」と呼ばれている。
desc_l10n.ko: 광장시장을 가야 하는 이유 중의 하나가 된 겨자소스와 곁들여 먹는 김밥의 원조집.
desc_l10n.zh: 广藏市 场内让 人一吃就 会 上 瘾 的 芥 末紫菜包 饭 大 概 是 众 多 爱 好美食客必 访 广藏市 场 的 缘 由之一。在广藏市 场内 ，有非常多的店 铺门 口都挂有“ 芥末 紫菜包 饭 元祖”的招牌， 这 其中，母女紫菜包 饭开业 超 过 40 多年 历 史。 在 紫菜包 饭 在糯米上加入 腌黄萝 卜 与 胡 萝 卜卷成 圆 形， 蘸 上酸 甜 芥末 酱 品 尝 ，好吃到 让 人上 瘾 ，回味无 穷 ，故以芥末紫菜包 饭闻名。 母女紫菜包 饭 第一分店在广藏市 场 比 较 靠角落的位置，第二分店 则 位于广藏市 场 的中心位置 。

description: One of the main reasons why everyone should go to Gwangjang Market is for the original "addictive gimbap." It's "addictive" attribute comes from it being so delicious and snackable thanks to its miniature size. People just keep going back for more. Though most other stores here claim that they are the original, Mother and Daughter's Gimbap is the real original with over 40 years of history.
name: Mother and Daughter's Gimbap

desc_l10n.en: La Lune Violette is a bistro-style French restaurant with quality foods at an affordable price. Escargot, Ballotine (French stuffed chicken) and their signature Miso pasta are a few of their specialty dishes. Immerse yourself in gourmet French cuisine and wine.
desc_l10n.ja: 比較的手頃な価格で楽しめるフレンチビストロ。エスカルゴや鶏肉のバロティーヌなとが味わえる。その中でもカニ味噌パスタが人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 비스트로 개념의 프랑스 요리를 비교적 저렴한 가격으로 맛볼 수 있는 곳
desc_l10n.zh: 可以较低廉的价格品尝法国美食的餐厅。法式糕点配蜗牛、鹅肝鸡卷和蟹肉微笑pasta都是这里的招牌菜。浓郁的口感让人忍不住点上一瓶红酒搭配起来一同享用。

description: La Lune Violette is a bistro-style French restaurant with quality foods at an affordable price. Escargot, Ballotine (French stuffed chicken) and their signature Miso pasta are a few of their specialty dishes. Immerse yourself in gourmet French cuisine and wine.
name: La Lune Violette

desc_l10n.en: This food stall has been run by Kim Lim Ok for over 30 years. Unlike the tteokbokki that's found everywhere else Korea, the rice cakes are lightly fried in oil in the lid of a large iron pot. The crispy, yet savory rice cake cannot be found anywhere else. Though many nearby stores immitate the original, nothing comes close to it.
desc_l10n.ja: 市場内のトッポッキ店。通常の韓国餅をピリ辛ソースで煮たトッポッキとは異なり、ここは、裏返した大釜の蓋をフライパン代わりに、多めの油を入れ餅を炒めた「キルム・トッポッキ(油トッポッキ)」が有名だ。白いトッポッキと、ピリ辛ソースを絡めた赤いトッポッキがあり、注文を受けるとその場で作ってくれる。チョン(チヂミ：野菜や肉類に小麦粉や卵をつけて焼いたチヂミ)も売られている。
desc_l10n.ko: 통인시장에서 기름떡볶이로 유명해진 집. 양념에 볶듯이 해서 나오는 스타일.
desc_l10n.zh: 元祖奶奶辣炒年糕位于通仁市场，以辣椒油炒年糕最为知名。这家店的年糕是翻炒制成，没有普通辣炒年糕会有的酱汁。将年糕与各类煎饼一同售卖也是这家店的特色之一。

description: This food stall has been run by Kim Lim Ok for over 30 years. Unlike the tteokbokki that's found everywhere else Korea, the rice cakes are lightly fried in oil in the lid of a large iron pot. The crispy, yet savory rice cake cannot be found anywhere else. Though many nearby stores immitate the original, nothing comes close to it.
name: Wonjo Halmeoni Tteokbokki

name_l10n.ja: ウォンジョ・ハルモニ・トッポッキ

desc_l10n.en: At Mansuui Jeongwon, you can enjoy traditional Korean dishes, such as bibimbap (rice mixed with vegetables, hot sauce, and other ingredients) and tteokgalbi (chargrilled beef and pork patties). You can have a light meal, but it's also a nice place for dinner and drinks.
desc_l10n.ja: ピビンパ、トッカルビ(粗挽きカルビ焼き)などの韓国料理が楽しめるところ。簡単な食事ができるほか、夜は音楽と一緒に料理を楽しめる。
desc_l10n.ko: 저녁 시간에는 반주와 함께 비빔밥, 떡갈비 등의 한식을 즐길 수 있는 곳
desc_l10n.zh: 在此店可以品尝到拌饭和牛肉饼等韩国料理。吃点简简单单的菜，或者晚饭时喝点酒，都是不错的选择。

description: At Mansuui Jeongwon, you can enjoy traditional Korean dishes, such as bibimbap (rice mixed with vegetables, hot sauce, and other ingredients) and tteokgalbi (chargrilled beef and pork patties). You can have a light meal, but it's also a nice place for dinner and drinks.
name: Mansuui Jeongwon

name_l10n.ja: マンスエ・ジョンウォン

desc_l10n.en: Chai Lyn offers neatly-presented dishes in the stylish atmosphere. It is one of the more up-scale restaurants in the area. Many options are available à la carte, but their course set menus are more popular.
desc_l10n.ja: 中華料理店。こぎれいな店内でおいしい料理が味わえる。単品もあるが、コース料理が人気だ。
desc_l10n.ko: 깨끗한 실내 분위기에 음식도 전반적으로 깔끔한 중식당.
desc_l10n.zh: 干净的室内环境，食材也很新鲜，比普通的中国料理高级，虽然也可单点，但套餐更受欢迎。

description: Chai Lyn offers neatly-presented dishes in the stylish atmosphere. It is one of the more up-scale restaurants in the area. Many options are available à la carte, but their course set menus are more popular.
name: Chai Lyn

desc_l10n.en: Eonnyang Bulgogi has been in operation for 30 years. Their menu features only two items: deungsim (sirloin) and Eonnyang-style bulgogi (thinly sliced beef seasoned in sesame seeds oil, perilla seeds oil, and pine nuts). As soon as an order is placed, Korean sirloin is seasoned, grilled in a rectangular grilling basket, and served with perilla and sesame seeds oil for dipping.
desc_l10n.ja: 彦陽(オニャン)地方のプルコギ専門店。炭火の網で焼くプルコギだ。メニューはトゥンシム(ロースの焼肉)と彦陽プルコギのたった2つのみ。網で焼いた肉は、エゴマとゴマ油を混ぜたタレにつけて食べる。
desc_l10n.ko: 30여 년간 언양식 불고기를 해온 집. 메뉴는 등심과 언양불고기
desc_l10n.zh: 此店已经营了30多年的彦阳烤肉。菜色只有里脊肉和彦阳烤肉两个。此店只使用韩牛里脊肉，如果有人点餐，该店会将里脊肉放在调味料中随即提供给客人。客人可蘸着由荏油和香油混合调制而成的调味汁享用烤好的里脊肉。

description: Eonnyang Bulgogi has been in operation for 30 years. Their menu features only two items: deungsim (sirloin) and Eonnyang-style bulgogi (thinly sliced beef seasoned in sesame seeds oil, perilla seeds oil, and pine nuts). As soon as an order is placed, Korean sirloin is seasoned, grilled in a rectangular grilling basket, and served with perilla and sesame seeds oil for dipping.
name: Eonnyang Bulgogi

desc_l10n.en: Unknown Diner is an intimate Italian restaurant in a quiet neighborhood. You can enjoy a casual meal of pasta or pizza. Their lunch set menus are very popular, and this is also great place to enjoy a glass of wine with pasta at dinnertime.
desc_l10n.ja: 閑静な場所にある雰囲気の良いイタリアンレストラン。パスタやピザなどを気軽に楽しめる。ランチセットはボリュームがあり人気。夜はワインにパスタがおすすめ。
desc_l10n.ko: 한적한 곳에 위치한, 분위기 있는 이탈리아 레스토랑.
desc_l10n.zh: 此意大利餐厅地处幽静，环境舒适，在此可以轻松品尝披萨等美食。这里的午餐套餐很不错，晚上的时候，也可一边吃意大利面，一边喝葡萄酒。

description: Unknown Diner is an intimate Italian restaurant in a quiet neighborhood. You can enjoy a casual meal of pasta or pizza. Their lunch set menus are very popular, and this is also great place to enjoy a glass of wine with pasta at dinnertime.
name: Unknown Diner

desc_l10n.en: Gold fish is a dim-sum restaurant that was recently opened by a chef who used to live in China and Hong Kong. Enjoy quality dim sum that are packed with fillings. Other items on the menu are also good, like their stir-fried rice and noodle dishes.
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国では珍しい飲茶専門店。香港で育ったシェフが作る飲茶だ。飲茶の他、炒飯や麺類もおいしい 。
desc_l10n.ko: 중국, 홍콩에서 살다가 건너온 셰프가 새로 문을 연 딤섬 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 从中国、香港来的主厨，新开业的饮茶点心专门店。在这里可以品尝到内馅丰盛口感十足的点心，炒饭或汤面等其他菜色也不错。

description: Gold fish is a dim-sum restaurant that was recently opened by a chef who used to live in China and Hong Kong. Enjoy quality dim sum that are packed with fillings. Other items on the menu are also good, like their stir-fried rice and noodle dishes.
name: Gold Fish

desc_l10n.en: At Mongmyeon Sanbang, you can enjoy neatly-presented Korean dishes in a traditional Korean house. They offer only a few dishes such as bibimbap (rice mixed with vegetables, hot sauce, and other ingredients), buchu jeon (Korean leek pancakes), dotori muk(acorn jelly), and traditional teas which they make themselves.
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国式家屋で韓国料理が味わえるお店。メニューにはピビンパ、ガンジャンゲジャン(カニの醬油漬け)、プチュジョン(にらのチヂミ)、トトリムク(どんぐりの寒天)、伝統茶などがある。
desc_l10n.ko: 고풍스러운 한옥에서 정갈하게 차려지는 한식을 즐길 수 있는 곳. 메뉴는 비빔밥, 부추전, 도토리묵, 전통차.
desc_l10n.zh: 来到此店的顾客，可以在古色古香的韩屋中品尝着制作精巧的韩国菜。此店的菜色比较少，有拌饭、韭菜饼、橡子果凉粉、传统茶等。此店出售的茶都是自行烘制而成的。

description: At Mongmyeon Sanbang, you can enjoy neatly-presented Korean dishes in a traditional Korean house. They offer only a few dishes such as bibimbap (rice mixed with vegetables, hot sauce, and other ingredients), buchu jeon (Korean leek pancakes), dotori muk(acorn jelly), and traditional teas which they make themselves.
name: Mongmyeok Sanbang

desc_l10n.ja: 新しくリニューアルオープンし、爆発的な任意を呼んでいるバイキングレストラン。海鮮類が充実しており、羊カルビステーキなど他のホテルバイキングと比べると斬新なメニューが多い。
desc_l10n.ko: 새롭게 리뉴얼 오픈하면서 폭발적인 인기를 끄는 뷔페 레스토랑.
desc_l10n.zh: 重新开业并有极高人气的自助餐厅，店里提供的海产品种类充分，即时烘烤的羊肋排和牛排等，都比以前的味道可口。

desc_l10n.en: At Gusto Taco, you can enjoy warm tacos made by a graduate of a New York cooking school. The dishes are not complicated, but you should be prepared to wait as they make everything to order. It is quite a small place, so customers tend to order their food to go.
desc_l10n.ja: メキシカン料理を味わえるところ。ニューヨークの料理学校出身のシェフが作料理だ。テイクアウトしていく客が多い。
desc_l10n.ko: 뉴욕의 요리학교 출신 셰프가 만드는 따끈한 타코
desc_l10n.zh: 本店主厨来自纽约料理学校，在此可品尝到辛辣的墨西哥炸玉米卷。因为料理是现场制作，所以需要等一下，店面不大，外带的客人很多。

description: At Gusto Taco, you can enjoy warm tacos made by a graduate of a New York cooking school. The dishes are not complicated, but you should be prepared to wait as they make everything to order. It is quite a small place, so customers tend to order their food to go.
name: Gusto Taco

desc_l10n.ko: 북촌 한옥마을 최고의 스카이뷰를 자랑하는, 한옥뷰루프탑 레스토랑 콩지POT지
desc_l10n.zh: Kong Ji Pot Ji是一家坐拥北村韩屋村最佳天际线景观的休闲式意大利餐厅。其建筑风格是将现代美学融入到了首尔旧城区，并以过去与现在、东方与西方的审美视角共存而闻名，在为访客提供美味餐点的同时，带来精彩的文化体验。

It offers visitors delicious food along with an excellent cultural experience.
name: Kongji POTji

desc_l10n.en: This is a cozy, yet elegant French restaurant that uses fresh Korean ingredients and serves only the best dishes made with quality ingredients like snail, sea bream and premium beef tenderloin.
desc_l10n.ja: 新鮮な韓国料理の材料と正統フレンチが調和し、高級食材のエスカルゴ、タイ、韓牛ヒレなどを使った料理と、ほのかな照明が調和した味、サービス、雰囲気ともに最高のレストラン。
desc_l10n.ko: 신선한 한식 재료와 정통 프렌치 음식이 조화를 이루는 레스토랑.
desc_l10n.zh: 新鲜的韩式食材与正统法式烹调法相得益彰。选用蜗牛、鲷鱼和韩牛里脊等高档食材来制作菜肴，在柔和的灯光映衬下，一切都呈现出最美好的姿态。

description: This is a cozy, yet elegant French restaurant that uses fresh Korean ingredients and serves only the best dishes made with quality ingredients like snail, sea bream and premium beef tenderloin.
name: July

desc_l10n.en: Seongsan Wanggalbi is famous for saeng dwaeji galbi (fresh pork short ribs). The restaurant is popular because their dwaeji galbi tastes very good and the portions are generous. The gyeranjjim (steamed scrambled eggs with chopped vegetables) and doenjangjjigae (soybean paste stew) that accompany the galbi are also excellent.
desc_l10n.ja: センテジカルビ(豚カルビ)で有名なお店。おいしさだけではなく、量も多いため人気。カルビと一緒に出される茶碗蒸しとテンジャンチゲもおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 푸짐한 생돼지갈비로 유명. 돼지갈비 맛도 좋으며 양도 푸짐하여 인기
desc_l10n.zh: 以丰盛的烤猪排闻名，猪肋排量多又好吃，是非常受欢迎的店家，和猪肋排一起享用的鸡蛋糕和大酱汤也是美味的佳肴。

description: Seongsan Wanggalbi is famous for saeng dwaeji galbi (fresh pork short ribs). The restaurant is popular because their dwaeji galbi tastes very good and the portions are generous. The gyeranjjim (steamed scrambled eggs with chopped vegetables) and doenjangjjigae (soybean paste stew) that accompany the galbi are also excellent.
name: Seongsan Wanggalbi

name_l10n.ja: ソンサン・ワンカルビ

desc_l10n.en: Hannam Bugeotguk is a good place to go for a drink as they offer a wide variety of side dishes, including bugeotguk (dried pollack soup). Their many varieties of jeon (Korean savory pancakes) and suyuk (steamed pork hocks) are very popular, and ojingeo muchim (squid salad) is also good.
desc_l10n.ja: プゴグク(干しスケトウダラのスープ)専門店。プゴグクの他にもメニュー種類が多くお酒を飲むにもおすすめのお店だ。様々な種類のジョン(野菜や魚・肉を卵・小麦粉を付けて焼いたもの)とスユク(茹で肉)が人気メニュー。オジンオムチム(イカ和えもの)もおいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 북어국 외에도 안줏거리가 많아 술 한잔하기 좋은 곳. 다양한 종류의 전이랑, 수육.오징어무침이 인기 메뉴.
desc_l10n.zh: 除了明太鱼汤以外也有很多下酒菜。各种的jeon i rang、熟肉都是人气菜单，凉拌花枝也不错。

description: Hannam Bugeotguk is a good place to go for a drink as they offer a wide variety of side dishes, including bugeotguk (dried pollack soup). Their many varieties of jeon (Korean savory pancakes) and suyuk (steamed pork hocks) are very popular, and ojingeo muchim (squid salad) is also good.
name: Hannam Bugeotguk

desc_l10n.en: Saffron is a Middle Eastern restaurant. Many of the dishes here bear some similarity to Indian dishes, but they only use meat prepared according to Sharia Islamic law. The preparation of halal meat involves draining all of the blood, so the meat does not have its usual characteristic smell and tastes great.
desc_l10n.ja: アラブ料理専門店。イスラム式に処理された肉(ハラール)を使用しています。体内にある血をすべて取り出した肉は、臭みがなくておいしい。
desc_l10n.ko: 아랍 음식 전문점. 이슬랍 율법대로 도축한 고기 이용.
desc_l10n.zh: 阿拉伯饮食专门店。虽然看上去有点像印度饮食，但是此店只用halal肉类。这些肉本身的血已被完全清理干净，所以用这样的肉烹制出的食物既没有膻味，味道又好 。

description: Saffron is a Middle Eastern restaurant. Many of the dishes here bear some similarity to Indian dishes, but they only use meat prepared according to Sharia Islamic law. The preparation of halal meat involves draining all of the blood, so the meat does not have its usual characteristic smell and tastes great.
name: Saffron

desc_l10n.en: European café Mouse Rabbit, featuring a beautiful terrace, is a café run by Super Junior’s Yesung and his brother. The store, featuring 3 floors with different atmosphere and charm, provides the fun of selecting different floors and tables according to individual taste. The basement floor, called "rabbit hole" and "underworld," has tables and fireplaces, providing a comfortable place to relax and hangout. The first floor features the ordering counter and the outer terrace, and the second floor is decked out with decorations and other stores. There are various products available such as toys, cell phone cases, mugs, and eco bags, which are designed and produced by hand by Mouse Rabbit and are popular with its fans. Mouse Rabbit was named after the animals mouse and rabbit representing Yesung and his brother running the café. The showcase within the store is full of Yesung’s pictures, and because visitors can purchase art products created by Mouse Rabbit, fans are unceasingly visiting the café.
desc_l10n.ja: 白いテラスが印象的なヨーロッパ風カフェマウスラビットはスーパージュニアメンバーのイェソンと彼の弟が運営するカフェです。お互いの異なった雰囲気と魅力を備えた全3階の建物には好みに合う階とテーブルを選ぶ楽しみがあります。「ウサギの巣穴」、「地下世界」と呼ばれる地下1階では座敷型テーブルと風情がある暖炉が置いてあり、照度を下げ更に気楽に休憩する事ができます。会計や野外テラスがある1階と小物やフィギュアで飾られた店に野外テラスのある2階まで細かい心遣いで隅々まで配置された照明と額縁、小物が映えます。MouseRabbit(マウスラビット)が直接デザインし手作りしたペーパートイ、ケータイケース、マグカップ、エコバックなどのアイテムは既にマニアを確保するほど大人気！ Mouse Rabbit (マウスラビット)はカフェを運営するイェソンと彼の弟が各自の年を象徴する鼠と兎を合わせマウスラビットと名を付けたそう。店内ショーケースの上にはイェソンの写真がいっぱいでMouse Rabbit (マウスラビット)が作るアイテムを買うファンたちでいつもにぎわっています。
desc_l10n.ko: 슈퍼주니어의 예성과 그 동생이 운영하는 마니아층을 확보한 카페.
desc_l10n.zh: Mouse Rabbit是一家拥有白色凉台的典型欧洲风咖啡厅。是Super Junior成员艺声和亲弟弟经营的。共有三层风格迥异的空间，顾客可根据自己的喜好选择楼层和餐桌。被称作“兔子洞”“地下世界”的地下1层是坐席式的餐桌和优雅的壁炉，可降低亮度，获得更舒适的休息。有结账台和室外凉台的1层，以及用可爱有趣的摆件和手办装饰而成并拥有室外凉台的2层都运用细腻的手法在各个角落安置了照明、画框和摆件。Mouse Rabbit手工独创制作的纸玩具、手机壳、马克杯、购物袋等各种艺术品受到大家喜爱，俘获了一大批粉丝。 Mouse Rabbit是经营咖啡店的艺声和亲弟弟选取代表各自属相的老鼠和兔子命名而成。店面里的Show Case上摆满了艺声的照片，可以购买到Mouse Rabbit制作的艺术品，Super Junior粉丝们络绎不绝。

description: European café Mouse Rabbit, featuring a beautiful terrace, is a café run by Super Junior’s Yesung and his brother. The store, featuring 3 floors with different atmosphere and charm, provides the fun of selecting different floors and tables according to individual taste. The basement floor, called "rabbit hole" and "underworld," has tables and fireplaces, providing a comfortable place to relax and hangout. The first floor features the ordering counter and the outer terrace, and the second floor is decked out with decorations and other stores. There are various products available such as toys, cell phone cases, mugs, and eco bags, which are designed and produced by hand by Mouse Rabbit and are popular with its fans. Mouse Rabbit was named after the animals mouse and rabbit representing Yesung and his brother running the café. The showcase within the store is full of Yesung’s pictures, and because visitors can purchase art products created by Mouse Rabbit, fans are unceasingly visiting the café.
name: Mouse Rabbit

desc_l10n.en: Live café run by the father of EXO’s Chanyel. Making a Better Place provides various music and liver performances from the K-POP that the teenagers like and old pop songs of the middle-aged people. On the weekday evenings, live performances are provided, and band performances are provided on Saturdays. You can enjoy the music of talented artists, and the foods including handmade burgers, fried chicken, beer and drinks. The place can be rented for bands and club activities. This is the live café run by EXO Chanyeol’s father, with Chanyeol’s instruments displayed. Here you can discover the source of Chanyeol’s talent and communicate with him. Numerous EXO fans are attracted to the store. You can enjoy the Korean, Chinese and Japanese songs sung by talented artists, and the café is loved for the various performances and as the event hall of Crayon Pop and other singers’ fan meeting.
desc_l10n.ja: 韓国代表アイドルグループEXO(エクソ)のメンバーチャニョルのお父さんが経営するライブカフェ、「チョウン・セサン・マンドゥルギ」では10代の好きなK-POPから中高年層の郷愁をこもったオールドポップまで色々な音楽とライブ公演が楽しめます。平日の夕方には歌手のライブ公演が、土曜日にはバンド公演が催されます。実力のあるアーティストたちの音楽を鑑賞しながら手作りバーガーやチキン、ビール、ソフトドリンク等の飲食が楽しめます。まさにこのお店は心身を休ませる場所と言えます。サラリーマン・バンド、サークルイベントへの貸館も可能。 店内にはチャニョルの使った楽器が展示されており、チャニョルの才能を発見し、間接的なコミュニケーションの場として、沢山のEXOファンの訪問が続いています。実力のあるアーティストたちが生で聞かせてくれる韓中日の歌が鑑賞でき、クレヨンポップなど同僚歌手のファンミが開かれるなど、様々な公演及びイベント空間としても人気が高いです。
desc_l10n.ko: 엑소(EXO)의 멤버 찬열의 아버지가 운영하는 라이브카페
desc_l10n.zh: 韩国代表性偶像组合EXO成员灿烈父亲运营的Live咖啡店——“创造美好世界”中可享受到10多岁孩子喜欢的K-POP、中老年喜欢的旧式流行乐等多种音乐和现场演出。工作日晚有现场歌手演出，星期六则是乐队演出。欣赏着实力艺人们表演的音乐,享受着手工汉堡、炸鸡、啤酒、饮料等美食，心灵和身体都能得到放松。还可开展上班族乐队、社团的活动。 EXO成员灿烈父亲运营的Live咖啡厅中陈列着灿烈使用过的乐器。作为发现灿烈才能的源泉、间接得到沟通的场所而闻名，EXO粉丝们接二连三地来访。能够欣赏到实力艺术家现场表演的中日韩歌曲，Crayon Pop等同事们的粉丝见面会也在此举行，是各种演出和活动的热门地点。

description: Live café run by the father of EXO’s Chanyel. Making a Better Place provides various music and liver performances from the K-POP that the teenagers like and old pop songs of the middle-aged people. On the weekday evenings, live performances are provided, and band performances are provided on Saturdays. You can enjoy the music of talented artists, and the foods including handmade burgers, fried chicken, beer and drinks. The place can be rented for bands and club activities. This is the live café run by EXO Chanyeol’s father, with Chanyeol’s instruments displayed. Here you can discover the source of Chanyeol’s talent and communicate with him. name: Making a Better Place

name_l10n.ja: チョウン・セサン・マンドゥルギ(良い世界をつくる)

desc_l10n.en: In the 1930s, Shanghai was considered the Paris of the East and Shanghainese women of that era were bright and fashionable. Modern Nülang's concept is a nod to that era and to the modern women of that time. The restaurant's name itself means modern woman. "Modern" speaks for itself and "Nülang" is the Korean transliteration for the Chinese word for woman. Modern Nülang offers a fresh interpretation of Chinese classics in a romantic and stylish setting.
desc_l10n.ja: MODERN NÜLANGは1930年代東洋のパリ、上海を現代的な女性のコンセプトをベースにロマンチックでモダンな感性で作ったMODERN CHINESE LOUNGEだ。｢現代｣の英文表記(MODERN)と｢女性｣の中国語表記(NÜLANG)の合成語で、中国の食文化になかった洗練されたチャイニーズ料理を提供している。 ロマンチックな上海の文化と食事を一緒に楽しむことができる空間で、時代の先を行く女性たちが集まって楽しむエキゾチックな文化空間を目指している。
desc_l10n.ko: 1930년 대 상하이 문화의 현대적인 신여성 컨셉의 로맨틱 & 모던 차이니즈 라운지
desc_l10n.zh: 结合中英文名称在内的“摩登女郎1930”（MODERN NÜLANG），是一处浪漫时髦的MODERN CHINESE LOUNGE。它以1930年代当时现代新女性的概念，重现了素有东方巴黎之称的华丽上海。主打中式饮食文化中不曾出现过的简练风格与浪漫感，为客人们提供崭新的中式餐饮。 摩登女郎1930（MODERN NÜLANG）打造充满时代感的异国氛围的同时，为每一位食客提供带有传统上海浪漫用餐环境的文化空间。

description: In the 1930s, Shanghai was considered the Paris of the East and Shanghainese women of that era were bright and fashionable. Modern Nülang's concept is a nod to that era and to the modern women of that time. The restaurant's name itself means modern woman. "Modern" speaks for itself and "Nülang" is the Korean transliteration for the Chinese word for woman. Modern Nülang offers a fresh interpretation of Chinese classics in a romantic and stylish setting.
name: Modern Nülang

desc_l10n.en: Located near a mosque, Eid is one of the few restaurants to be recognized as a Halal restaurant by the Korea Muslim Federation. The three side dishes and soup offered with meals are made fresh everyday with organic ingredients and no additives, giving the food at Eid a refreshing taste.
desc_l10n.ja: モスクの近くにあり、韓国イスラム中央会でハラール認証を受けた唯一の韓国料理店。3種類のおかずとスープが基本的に提供され、オーナー夫婦が毎日作っています。環境にやさしい野菜を使用し、人工添加物は使用していません。
desc_l10n.ko: 이슬람사원 근처에 있는 곳으로, 한국이슬람중앙회에서 할랄 인증을 받은 유일한 한식당.
desc_l10n.zh: 如果说首尔市内的清真餐厅大部分专门经营印度、土耳其等穆斯林国家的食物。那么伊德则是使用通过清真认证的食材制作韩国菜品的餐厅，并且反响较好。主要菜品有深受外国人欢迎的参鸡汤、烤牛肉、拌饭等，与其他清真餐厅相比，这里的价格也较为低廉。

description: Located near a mosque, Eid is one of the few restaurants to be recognized as a Halal restaurant by the Korea Muslim Federation. The three side dishes and soup offered with meals are made fresh everyday with organic ingredients and no additives, giving the food at Eid a refreshing taste.
name: Eid

desc_l10n.en: Sudam specializes in high-end han-jeongsik (Korean table d'hote) and the head chef has over 26 years of experience in the kitchen. Only fresh ingredients are used to create the meals at Sudam and the dishes are as nutritious as they are tasty. Sudam is also well-suited to hold large parties of diners, whether for celebrations or business dinners.
desc_l10n.ja: スダムは高級韓定食専門店で、料理長は26年以上の厨房経験がある。 新鮮な材料だけでスダムの食事を作ることができ、料理はおいしいだけ栄養価が高い。 スダムはまた、お祝いやビジネスディナーに関係なく、大規模なディナーパーティーを開くのに適しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 정상급 기능장 쉐프가 신선한 재료를 사용하고 영양만점인 음식을 즐길 수 있는 맛집.
desc_l10n.zh: 与最珍贵的你共享，高端韩定食 SUDAM。 在特别的日子里，与最珍贵的人一起享用高端传统韩定食。拥有26年经验的主厨，精心挑选新鲜食材制作出营养丰富的韩式料理。严格的管理体系并坚持使用绿色天然材料，SUDAM为您打造与众不同的高端传统韩定食。

description: Sudam specializes in high-end han-jeongsik (Korean table d'hote) and the head chef has over 26 years of experience in the kitchen. Only fresh ingredients are used to create the meals at Sudam and the dishes are as nutritious as they are tasty. Sudam is also well-suited to hold large parties of diners, whether for celebrations or business dinners.
name: Sudam

desc_l10n.en: Texas de Brazil is a restaurant that mixes American-sized generous portions with the best of Brazil’s churrascaria culture. Texas de Brazil prides itself on using only the highest quality ingredients and employing expert chefs and carvers. As a result, there is probably no other place in Seoul where diners can experience an authentic churrasco. There are 15 different cutsof meats available and a salad bar stocked with seasonal offerings. Cuts of meat are grilled directly over open flames on the churrasco grill. No MSG is used, only natural herbs and spices flavor the food at Texas de Brazil. This Western-style restaurant is luxuriously styled and offers premium service. The house carver carves the meat at each table, and service touches like that just to add to the dining experience at Texas de Brazil. Dine at Korea’s first churrascaria fora culinary experience you won't soon forget.
desc_l10n.ja: ブラジル本格プレミアムレストラン - TEXAS de BRAZIL TEXAS de BRAZILは、テキサスの寛容な心をブラジルの南部料理に取り入れたアメリカンスタイルの本格的ブラジル料理店。 シュラスコ(Churrasco：ブラジル正統のプレミアムステーキ)専門レストランで、最高級の材料と専門的な調理方法で15種の部位のステーキと新鮮な季節のサラダバーとともに楽しめます。 シュラスコグリルで直火焼きし、人工化学調味料を使用せず、健康で自然な味をそのまま味わえます。ウエスタンスタイルの雰囲気の中でカーバー(Carver：肉切りスタッフ)が直接サービングしてくれるシュラスコの味とサービスが堪能できる韓国唯一のブラジリアン正統ステーキハウスです。
desc_l10n.ko: 정통 미국 브라질리언 스타일의 '슈하스코' 전문 레스토랑
desc_l10n.zh: TEXAS de BRAZIL 是一家将巴西南部的美味与德州的豁达风貌完美的融合在一起，主打“Churrasco（巴西传统烤肉）”的餐厅。 高级食材与专业的料理手法让顾客可以品尝到15种不同部位、不同口感的每美味牛排。同时还可享用新鲜的四季沙拉自助吧台。餐厅里的各种牛排不添加任何人工化学调味料，凭着巴西烧烤的碳烤技术，将肉汁完美锁住，给顾客最自然健康的美味。

description: Texas de Brazil is a restaurant that mixes American-sized generous portions with the best of Brazil’s churrascaria culture. Texas de Brazil prides itself on using only the highest quality ingredients and employing expert chefs and carvers. As a result, there is probably no other place in Seoul where diners can experience an authentic churrasco. There are 15 different cutsof meats available and a salad bar stocked with seasonal offerings. Cuts of meat are grilled directly over open flames on the churrasco grill. No MSG is used, only natural herbs and spices flavor the food at Texas de Brazil. This Western-style restaurant is luxuriously styled and offers premium service. The house carver carves the meat at each table, and service touches like that just to add to the dining experience at Texas de Brazil. Dine at Korea’s first churrascaria fora culinary experience you won't soon forget.
name: Texas de Brazil

desc_l10n.en: The atmosphere at God Eat is so relaxing that a meal at this restaurant feels like a mini-vacation. God Eat offers healthy fusion cuisine that combines the best of Korean and Western flavors. The food at God Eat is made with mild, fresh ingredients and the food is as healthy as it is tasty. Service is fast, so diners don’t have to wait long between ordering and receiving their meals. Everything on the menu is also available for take-out, so stop by when the weather is nice, get a meal to go, and have a fun picnic lunch or dinner.
desc_l10n.ja: おいしくて健康的な食事 - God Eat ソウルに旅行へ来た時、短い食事時間でも快適なリゾート地に来た様な雰囲気が感じられるレストラン。注文後、すぐにサービスされるファストフード店ですが、新鮮でヘルシーな素材を使用しています。また全てのメニューはテイクアウト可能。
desc_l10n.ko: 멕시코 현지에 온듯한 이국적인 분위기와 과카몰리와 살사소스 듬뿍 곁들인 멕시칸 푸드
desc_l10n.zh: 美味健康饮食—— God Eat 让用餐成为享受，短暂的用餐时间却可感受度假村的悠闲，这里就是God Eat餐厅。西式与韩式的完美融合，打造全新的味觉体验。店内选用新鲜食材制作健康餐饮，口感柔和不失美味。即便是快餐种类，也追求健康用心打造。店内全部菜品均可打包，是外出游玩时的最佳选择。

description: The atmosphere at God Eat is so relaxing that a meal at this restaurant feels like a mini-vacation. God Eat offers healthy fusion cuisine that combines the best of Korean and Western flavors. The food at God Eat is made with mild, fresh ingredients and the food is as healthy as it is tasty. Service is fast, so diners don’t have to wait long between ordering and receiving their meals. Everything on the menu is also available for take-out, so stop by when the weather is nice, get a meal to go, and have a fun picnic lunch or dinner.
name: God Eat

desc_l10n.en: Tongin Market is the place to go for traditional gireum tteok-bokki. The market is well-known as the best place in Korea for gireum tteok-bokki, and even foreign tourists come to have a taste. Gireum tteok-bokki is made by stir-frying rice cakes in oil and seasonings. There are two types of gireum tteok-bokki sold here. One kind is seasoned with just oil and soy sauce; the other is seasoned with spicy red pepper flakes and oil. Three of Tongshin Market’s gireum tteok-bokki eateries are particularly famous and popular. One such eatery is Original Grandmother's Gireum Tteok-Bokki. The shop has been featured on TV programs. Another is Hyoja-dong’s Old School Tteok-Bokki, once visited by John Kerry in 2014 while he was the U.S. Secretary of State.
desc_l10n.ja: トンイン(通仁)市場のキルム(油)トッポッキは外国人もお気に入りの韓国を代表するおやつ。キルムトッポッキは釜の蓋をひっくり返して、その上で味付けしたお餅を香ばしく炒めるのが特徴です。種類は、油と醤油を混ぜたソースで炒める白いトッポッキと唐辛子の味付けで炒めるトッポッキの2種類があります。トンイン(通仁)市場にある代表的なキルムトッポッキには、ソウルトッポッキ3大名家としてグルメ番組で紹介された｢元祖ハルモニ･キルムトッポッキ｣と2014年にアメリカのジョン・ケリー国務長官が訪韓した際に立ち寄った｢ヒョジャドン(孝子洞)昔ながらのトッポッキ｣があります。
desc_l10n.ko: 통인시장의 기름떡볶이는 외국인들도 즐겨 찾는 한국 대표 음식. 기름떡볶이는 가마솥 뚜껑에 양념한 떡을 노릇하게 볶아내는 것이 특징.
desc_l10n.zh: 通仁市场的油炒年糕是深受外国游客喜爱的韩国美食之一。油炒年糕不同于在辣酱面中拌炒的年糕，而是将沾了酱料的年糕放在铁锅中用油拌炒。口味则分为添加了酱油的白色炒年糕与涂抹辣椒酱的红色炒年糕两种。通仁市场的油炒年糕被列为首尔炒年糕三大名家之一，其余两家分别为电视美食节目中介绍过的“元祖奶奶炒年糕店”，与2014年美国国务卿凯瑞（John Forbes Kerry）访问韩国时曾去过的“孝子洞传统炒年糕店”。

description: Tongin Market is the place to go for traditional gireum tteok-bokki. The market is well-known as the best place in Korea for gireum tteok-bokki, and even foreign tourists come to have a taste. Gireum tteok-bokki is made by stir-frying rice cakes in oil and seasonings. There are two types of gireum tteok-bokki sold here. One kind is seasoned with just oil and soy sauce; the other is seasoned with spicy red pepper flakes and oil. Three of Tongshin Market’s gireum tteok-bokki eateries are particularly famous and popular. One such eatery is Original Grandmother's Gireum Tteok-Bokki. The shop has been featured on TV programs. Another is Hyoja-dong’s Old School Tteok-Bokki, once visited by John Kerry in 2014 while he was the U.S. Secretary of State.
name: Gireum Tteokbokki at Tongin Market

name_l10n.ja: トンイン(通仁)市場キルムトッポッキ
name_l10n.zh: 通仁市场 油炒年糕

desc_l10n.en: If you go around the Blue House and down the alley, you will find a bakery located next to Tongin Market. Hyoja Bakery has been in business for 35 years, since 1987, and its signboard is old-fashioned and nostalgic. It is the first bakery in Seochon that has been viralized through broadcasting and media for a long time, and has a wide range of options, including sweets, donuts, croquettes, and other traditional bakery items, as well as fermented bread and bagels that are popular these days. The shop is so famous and popular that many items are sold out on weekends.
desc_l10n.ja: 青瓦台 を 回 って 路地 を 下 っていくと 、 トンイン ( 通仁 ) 市場 の 隣 に 位置 するパン 屋 があります 。 1987 年 から 35 年間続 いているヒョジャベーカリーは 、 看板 からして 古風 で 懐 かしさを 感 じます 。 長 い 間放送 やメディアを 通 じて 口 コミで 広 まったソチョン ( 西村 )1 号店 のパン 屋 で 、 菓子 、 ドーナツ 、 コロッケなど 昔 のパン 屋 で 味 わえたパンから 最近人気 の 発酵 パンやベーグルまで 揃 っており 、 選択 の 幅 が 広 い 。 あまりにも 有名 で 人気 があるので 、 週末 には 売 り 切 れるものも 多 い 。
desc_l10n.ko: 콘브레드가 유명한 서촌 1호 빵집
desc_l10n.zh: 如果你绕过蓝屋 ， 沿着小巷走 ， 你会发现位于汤阴市场旁边的一家面包店 。 孝子面包店自 1987 年以来已经经营了 35 年 ， 其招牌古色古香 ， 令人怀念 。 西村第一面包店在电视和媒体上被病毒式传播了很久 ， 它提供各种烘焙食品 ， 包括糖果 、 甜甜圈 、 羊角面包和其他传统的烘焙食品 ， 以及最近流行的发酵面包和贝果 。 它是如此有名和受欢迎 ， 以至于许多商品在周末都被卖光了 。

name_l10n.ja: 孝子(ヒョジャ)ベーカリー

desc_l10n.en: Seochon Traditional Sundae Soup House is considered a must-visit destination. It was shown in the Korean drama series, “Doctors, as a restaurant owned by the father of the main character, Yoo Hye Jung (actress: Park Shin Hye). It is known for its special deep-tasting beef broth, which they brew with marrowbone for 24 hours. Its old-fashioned, traditional style Hanok architecture and its neat interior evokes the Korean traditional castle: Gyeongbokgung and its surroundings. Not only is the Sundae Soup first in its class, the in-house Kimchi is one of the best in its category as well. After the meal, don’t forget to take a photo where the “Doctors” couple, Jiho-Hyejung, enjoyed rice soup.
desc_l10n.ja: ドラマ「ドクターズ」でユ・へジョン(パク・シネ)の父が経営しているククパプ(クッパ)屋さんで登場したソチョン(西村)伝統スンデグクは肉骨だけで24時間煮込んだ濃い出汁で有名な店。昔ながらの韓屋とインテリアはキョンボックン(景福宮)周辺の景色とも調和しています。ピリ辛で風味が良いスンデグクも絶品ですが、手作りキムチもソウルで最も美味しいキムチだと言われています。食事を終えた後は、ジホ♡ヘジョンカップルが一緒にククパプ(クッパ)を食べた席での記念撮影を忘れずに！
desc_l10n.ko: 드라마 <닥터스>에서 유혜정(박신혜)의 아버지가 운영하는 국밥집으로 등장했던 서촌전통순대국은 사골로만 24시간 우려낸 진한 육수로 소문난 맛집. 얼큰하고 구수한 순댓국도 일품이지만 식당에서 직접 담근 김치 역시 서울에서 가장 맛있는 김치 중 하나로 꼽힐 정도.
desc_l10n.zh: 《Doctors》剧中刘慧静爸爸运营的汤饭店正是这家“西村传统米肠汤”。这家店以精心熬制34小时的牛骨高汤而闻名。 古色古香的韩屋与干净整洁的装饰，与景福宫周边的氛围融为一体。米肠汤与米肠拼盘作为店里的主打菜品远近闻名，店内直接腌制的泡菜更是堪称首尔一绝。餐后不要忘记在志弘和慧静曾经吃饭的餐桌前拍照留念哦！

desc_l10n.en: BHC Sadang Branch is a chain restaurant. It specializes in making fried chicken. The restaurant is very spacious with two floors; one underground floor and one ground floor. The restaurant’s recent hit is a spicy chicken feature in the menu called, “Mapster,” and another being, “Curry Chicken,” in which curry is applied to fried chicken. Another popular feature in the menu is called, “Sunflower Fried Chicken,” which is fried with Sunflower Oil instead of regular oil making the chicken more nutty.
desc_l10n.ja: BHCサダン(舎堂)チキン専門店。最近人気が高い辛いチキン｢メップスター｣をはじめインドカレーを使用した｢カレーチキン｣、ひまわり油で揚げて香ばしい食感の｢ひまわりフライドチキン｣などが人気。
desc_l10n.ko: BHC 사당점은 틴탑 리키의 부모님이 최근 오픈한 치킨 전문점. 지하 1층부터 옥상 테이블까지 자리가 넉넉하게 마련되어 있으며, 매장 곳곳에 리키와 틴탑 멤버들의 사진과 사인이 장식.
desc_l10n.zh: BHC舍堂店是T开业的炸鸡店。近来备受追捧的辣味炸鸡“mapster”，融合印度咖喱的“咖喱炸鸡”，用葵花籽油炸制的“葵花子炸鸡”等人气菜品分外夺目。

Another popular feature in the menu is called, “Sunflower Fried Chicken,” which is fried with Sunflower Oil instead of regular oil making the chicken more nutty.
name: BHC Sadang Branch

desc_l10n.en: Anthracite Coffee Roasters is a well-known cafe in Hapjeong-dong that brings new meaning to the term industrial chic. Anthracite's building was once a shoe factory and the cafe has maintained many of the factory's industrial elements and added modern decor. Beer and coffee are among the menu selections offered at Anthracite and one of the most popular coffees is the Butter Fat Trio. The coffee roasts are named after famed authors, so visitors can order a "Natsume Sōseki" or a "Pablo Neruda." Anthracite's pastry chef bakes the cafe's desserts on the premises. Patrons can choose from cakes, financiers, madeleines, and cookies.
desc_l10n.ja: 昔からの靴工房を改装して作られたカフェ。古びた外観をそのまま活かし、工場で使われていたベルトコンベアと鉄製の大門などをテーブルとして活用しています。コーヒーとビールの組み合わせの風味が生きた代表ブレンド、バターファットトリオ(Butter Fat Trio)を含め、そのほかにも夏目漱石、パブロ・ネルーダ等、作家の名前を冠したコーヒー豆があります。その他、パティシエが作ったケーキやフィナンシェなど多様なデザートがあります。また展示や公演が開かれることがあります。
desc_l10n.ko: 오래된 신발공장을 개조. 커피와 케이크, 다양한 종류의 디저트를 만날 수 있음.
desc_l10n.zh: Anthracite Coffee是由老制鞋工厂改建而来，工厂使用过的传送带、铁门都成为了如今咖啡厅的桌子。Butter Fat Trio、以及使用夏目漱石、巴勃罗•聂鲁达(Pablo Neruda)等作家名字来命名的原豆是店里的招牌咖啡豆。 此外，糕点师亲手制作的蛋糕、费南雪(Financier)等各式甜点也是人气商品。店内不定期举办展览或小型公演！

name_l10n.ja: Anthracite ハプチョン(合井)店

desc_l10n.en: The epitome of industrial chic, Cafe Onion operates out of a converted factory that was built in the 1970s. The building has actually seen a variety of businesses open shop in the past; there was once a supermarket and even restaurants throughout the years and at one time the building was even a regular residence. More recently, before Cafe Onion opened, the building housed an industrial factory that made small parts. Traces of the building's industrial past are still visible throughout Cafe Onion. The cafe even kept and converted many of the factory's design elements. There are over 20 varieties of bread at the cafe. Cafe Onion also sells the famed Bread 05 Bakery's butter bread. Korean patrons will have seen the butter bread on several Korean TV shows.
desc_l10n.ja: 70年代に建てられた建物を改装して作られたカフェ。それまでスーパーマーケット、食堂、個人家屋、そして金属部品工場として使われていました。床や壁面をそのまま活かし、時間の流れの跡を感じることができます。20種類以上のパンとコーヒーを販売しており、その中でも｢あんバターの達人｣としてTV番組で紹介され、｢ブレッド05｣の製品を味わうことができます。
desc_l10n.ko: 어니언은 70년대에 지어진 건물을 개조해 만든 카페.
desc_l10n.zh: Onion是由70年代建筑改造而成的咖啡厅。这栋建筑物曾做为超市、食堂、住宅使用，在改建成为咖啡厅之前，曾是一间金属配件工厂。陈旧的地板、斑驳的牆壁都原封不动的保留下来，不难发现珍贵的岁月痕迹。店里出售20多种面包与咖啡，并且曾被电视节目报导过，由”红豆奶油面包达人”所创立的品牌——BREAD05中出售的经典面包也能在这里买到！

desc_l10n.en: Pro Soy Crab first opened in 1980 and it is considered by many to be Korea's foremost ganjang-gejang (soy sauce marinated crab) restaurant. Pro Soy Crab's main branch is located at Sinsa-dong but there is another location in Samseong-dong, Seoul. Pro Soy Crab uses only the freshest high-quality ingredients to create their crab and seafood dishes. Diners can enjoy a range of seafood such as ganjang-gejang (soy sauce marinated crab), yangnyeom-gejang (spicy marinated crab), kkotge jjim (braised blue crab), and sannakji (sliced raw octopus). In a fun design touch, the walls of the restaurant interior are decorated with photos and autographs of famous Korean baseball players and Hallyu stars.
desc_l10n.ja: 1980年より韓国のカンジャンケジャンの代名詞として現地人はもちろん、外国人観光客にも人気の高いプロカンジャンケジャンはシンサドン(新沙洞)本店、サムソン(三成)店を運営しています。 最高品質の素材だけを使用し、カンジャンケジャン、味付けケジャン、ケアル・ビビンパプ(カニ卵ビビンバ)、サンナクチ(生テナガダコ)などの料理を楽しめます。店内には有名野球選手や韓流スターのサインと写真が展示されています。
desc_l10n.ko: 1980년부터 대한민국 간장게장의 대표 맛집. 내국인은 물론 외국인 관광객들의 입맛을 사로잡은 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 酱蟹专卖店“普乐酱蟹”从1980年代起就已成为韩国知名的美食餐厅。鲜美的酱蟹不仅深受韩国人喜爱，也抓住了外国游客的胃！除了新沙洞总店外，还有三成洞分店。店里使用最顶级的食材来制作酱油螃蟹、辣味螃蟹、蟹黄拌饭、蒸花蟹、活章鱼等海鲜料理。此外，美味的普乐酱蟹也是名人经常光顾的餐厅，店里墙上贴满了许多韩国棒球选手以及韩流偶像明星的签名与照片。

name_l10n.ja: プロカンジャンケジャン本店

desc_l10n.en: Loved by fans from all over Asia, Super Junior has been an A-list K-pop star for almost a decade now. A lesser known fact about the group is that the charming and witty member Kim Hee-chul has refined interest in food. One of the restaurants in Seoul that he has recommended is Solbin Superdog located in the Apgujeong Rodeo Street. On the menu are tacos, hot dogs and rice bowls. The foodie K-pop singer’s favorite menu item is the spicy dog, which is extremely hot yet highly addictive. The signature dish is the galbi (grilled beef ribs) rice, which comes with nachos, sour cream, jalapeño peppers and vegetables.
desc_l10n.ja: 東南アジアと中国で独歩的な人気を誇る韓流スター、スーパージュニア。彫刻のような容貌と巧みな話術を兼ね備えたスーパージュニアの「実力者」、ヒチョルは美食家として知られています。味にも一家言あるヒチョルが何年も前から常連客になっているのは、アックジョンロデオの名物、ソルビンドッグです。午後6時から午前5時30分まで営業するという特殊な営業時間帯のため、スケジュールを終えて小腹を空かしてここを訪れる芸能人がひっきりなしに目撃されています。ここのメニューは大まかに言えばタコスとホットドッグ、ライスボウルの三種類。ヒチョルがよく注文するメニューは、唇がヒリヒリするほど辛くて、毎晩思い出すほど中毒性のあるスボルドッグです。ナチョスやサワークリーム、ハラペーニョ、野菜とカルビをご飯と一緒に食べるカルビライスもここの看板メニューで、食べなければきっと後悔するでしょう。
desc_l10n.ko: 슈퍼주니어의 희철의 단골.  희철이 즐겨 먹는 메뉴는 매운 쓰벌덕.
desc_l10n.zh: 无论是在东南亚还是中国，韩流明星Super Junior都拥有其他组合无法匹敌的超高人气。组合内的“掌领导者”希澈不仅拥有如雕像般俊美的外貌和能言善辩的口齿，而且还是一位不折不扣的美食鉴赏家。而这家被称为“狎鸥亭罗德奥一绝”的SOLBIN DOG热狗，却让口味刁钻的希澈也深深的折服，并且成为了店内忠实的常客。值得一提的是，店内从下午6点开始营业，凌晨5点30分打烊。由于营业时间较为特殊，经常有艺人在结束日程后来吃宵夜充饥。SOLBINDONG热狗的菜品大致可以分为三类：墨西哥卷饼、热狗以及炒饭。味道火辣并且吃过就会上瘾的“变态辣热狗”是希澈的最爱。除此之外，将玉米片、酸奶油、墨西哥胡椒、蔬菜以及排骨放入米饭中烹饪而成的排骨米饭则是店内必点的招牌菜品。

desc_l10n.en: The exterior of the restaurant may seem rather humble, but Oriental Roast Chicken’s list of clientele is world class. The small eatery is filled with numerous autographs of K-stars including the two-time Olympic medallist Kim Yuna to Hallyu stars Ahn Sung-ki, Lee Jong-suk, Han Hyo-joo and Ahn Jae-wook. Roasted with glutinous rice, chestnuts and jujubes, the chhicken is juicy and tender, with distinctively nutty and sweet aromas. Take-outs are available as well.
desc_l10n.ja: 元フィギュアスケート韓国代表のキム・ヨナ選手、俳優アン・ソンギ、イ・ジョンソク、ハン・ヒョジュ、アン・ジェウクをはじめ、多くのセレブから愛されているトンダックイ(ローストチキン)のお店。壁一面をぎっしりと埋めた芸能人のサインを見れば、ここがどれほど有名なのかが分かります。身がしまった鶏にもち米や栗、ナツメをいっぱいに詰めてオークの木でじっくり焼きます。代表メニューである鶏の丸焼きは、油がしっかり落ちた皮がカリカリして香ばしく、ナツメの甘い香りが染み込んだ肉はあっさりして柔らかくなっています。鶏に添えられた塩かマスタードソースをつけてご賞味ください。もちろん、テイクアウトもできます。
desc_l10n.ko: 전 피겨스케이팅 국가대표 김연아 선수, 배우 안성기, 이종석, 한효주, 안재욱을 비롯해 수많은 유명인사들이 사랑하는 통닭구이집.
desc_l10n.zh: 这家烤全鸡店在演艺圈内拥有众多死忠粉，其中包括前花样滑冰国家队选手金妍儿，演员安圣基、李钟硕、韩孝珠以及安在旭等知名公众人物。店内墙壁上密密麻麻的艺人亲笔签名，可以让你直观地感受到这家店的火爆人气。将糯米、板栗和大枣放入鸡腹中，再置于橡树木头上进行烘烤。柴烤全鸡是店内最具特色的一道菜，烤过后的鸡皮除去了油脂所带来的油腻感，清爽酥脆。而大枣的清香则使鸡的肉质变得更加鲜嫩可口，可以搭配盐或芥末一同使用。另外，店内还提供外带服务。

description: The exterior of the restaurant may seem rather humble, but Oriental Roast Chicken’s list of clientele is world class. The small eatery is filled with numerous autographs of K-stars including the two-time Olympic medallist Kim Yuna to Hallyu stars Ahn Sung-ki, Lee Jong-suk, Han Hyo-joo and Ahn Jae-wook. Roasted with glutinous rice, chestnuts and jujubes, the chhicken is juicy and tender, with distinctively nutty and sweet aromas. Take-outs are available as well.
name: Oriental Roast Chicken

name_l10n.ja: ハンバントンタックイ

desc_l10n.en: Owned by the parents of Lee Hi, Lamese Cadeau specializes in Korean seafood dishes. The K-pop star’s favorite food on the menu is the ganjang-gejang (soy sauce-marinated crabs) made with fresh crabs sourced from the Incheon sea shore. The ganjang-gejang meal is served with several side dishes (banchan), featuring locally-sourced conch, abalone, and seaweed. Upon request, the dishes can be delivered directly from the restaurant. As for the interior, a large poster of Lee Hi hangs by the entrance while autographs of Lee’s fellow artists from YG Entertainment―such as Bobby and Lee Soo-hyun―decorate the walls.
desc_l10n.ja: 「海からの贈り物」という意味の韓食海鮮専門店。外部に装飾された垂れ幕が物語るように、歌手イ・ハイのご両親が運営している飲食店です。仁川から直送された旬のカニを秘伝の醤油に漬けたカンジャンケジャンが代表メニューです。カンジャンケジャン定食はカンジャンケジャンとともにサザエ、アワビ、ワカメ、コンブなど新鮮で身のしっかりした海産物を使ったおかずが盛りだくさんです。ボビー、イ・スヒョンなど、イ・ハイと同じ釜の飯を食べたYGエンターテイメント所属の芸能人たちが残したメッセージを見る楽しみもあります。イ・ハイが、目を閉じていてもお母さんが作ったものを区別できると公言するほど好きだというケジャンは、宅配便の注文も受け付けています。
desc_l10n.ko: 가수 이하이의 부모님이 운영하는 음식점.  제철 꽃게를 비법 간장으로 절인 간장게장이 대표메뉴.
desc_l10n.zh: 这家店名意为“海洋的馈赠”的饭店是一家韩式海鲜专营店。通过店铺门面上高高悬挂的横幅就可以一眼认出这是歌手李遐怡的父母经营的饭店。店内主打菜品是使用从仁川直云的当季新鲜花蟹秘制而成的酱蟹。酱蟹套餐除了酱蟹，还包含使用海螺、鲍鱼、裙带菜和海带等新鲜海产品所制成的小菜。在品尝美味酱蟹的同时，可以近距离观看与李遐怡同属YG娱乐公司的艺人BOBBY和李秀贤等人的亲笔留言。传闻李遐怡可以在闭着眼睛的情况下，轻松分辨出哪一个是由妈妈亲手做的酱蟹，由此可见这家店的酱蟹是多么的美味。酱蟹提供快递预定服务。

description: Owned by the parents of Lee Hi, Lamese Cadeau specializes in Korean seafood dishes. The K-pop star’s favorite food on the menu is the ganjang-gejang (soy sauce-marinated crabs) made with fresh crabs sourced from the Incheon sea shore. The ganjang-gejang meal is served with several side dishes (banchan), featuring locally-sourced conch, abalone, and seaweed. Upon request, the dishes can be delivered directly from the restaurant. As for the interior, a large poster of Lee Hi hangs by the entrance while autographs of Lee’s fellow artists from YG Entertainment―such as Bobby and Lee Soo-hyun―decorate the walls.
name: Lamese Cadeau

desc_l10n.en: Have delicious, authentic Hanoi-style pho and Vietnamese food at Dep Trai (literally meaning, "good-looking man" in Vietnamese). Dep Trai offers a range of delicious Vietnamese food such as banh mi, pho, rice bowls, and more.
desc_l10n.ja: 新鮮な生麺と濃いスープを使った生麺フォーが楽しめ、ベトナムハノイの現地の調理方法で作っています。多様なベトナム料理を Dep trai で味わうことができます。 ※ Dep trai：ベトナム語でイケメンという意味
desc_l10n.ko: 신선한 생면과 진한 육수를 사용한 생면쌀국수를  하노이의 현지 조리방식으로 요리.
desc_l10n.zh: Dep trai(越南文：Đẹp Trai)采用越南河内当地的料理方式，为顾客带来汤头清澈浓郁的越南河粉及各式越南料理。 ※ Đẹp Trai：越南文，意指英俊的男子。

description: Have delicious, authentic Hanoi-style pho and Vietnamese food at Dep Trai (literally meaning, "good-looking man" in Vietnamese). Dep Trai offers a range of delicious Vietnamese food such as banh mi, pho, rice bowls, and more.
name: Dep Trai

desc_l10n.en: Dok2 has opened up a pizza joint in the Apgujeong area offering authentic New York-style pizza with a buttery, crispy crust. The most popular item on the menu is Brooklyn's Best, featuring Italian sausage, hand-crushed plum tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, extra virgin olive oil, and red onions. Dok2’s favorite dish is known to be the earthy, aromatic Truffle Mushroom pizza. The pizza is certainly worth trying as it has turned Dok2 from a loyal patron into a restaurateur.
desc_l10n.ja: DOK2が運営するピザ専門店。すべてのピザは、既成の加工品を含まない原材料で作られています。濃厚な味付けのオリジナルピザから韓国人の口に合わせたあっさり味のピザまで、さまざまな種類のピザを楽しめます。メインメニューは、トマトソースベースの「ブルックリンズベスト」とアルフレドソースベースの「トリュフマッシュルーム」。トリュフオイルを使って、あっさりとしていながらも味わい深い「トリュフマッシュルーム」は、DOK2を常連客から社長に転身させたきっかけになりました。Gino's NY Pizzaは、格式にこだわらずに楽しめるピザが食べたくなったら、いつでも気楽に行けるレストランです。
desc_l10n.ko: 도끼를 단골손님에서 사장으로 거듭나게 한 피자 맛집.
desc_l10n.zh: Dok2经营的披萨店，店内所有的披萨都是由未经二次加工过的食材制作。从香味浓郁的原味披萨，到反映韩国人口味制作的清淡口味披萨，店内有各式披萨供客人选择。由番茄汁为主材料制成的“Brooklyn’s Best”和用奶油白汁制成的“Truffle Shroom”是这家的主打菜。加入了松露油调香的“Truffle Shroom”风味十足让人回味无穷。传闻也正是因为这道菜才让当时还是客人的Dok2滋生了接手这家店的想法。小清新披萨店Ginos的就餐环境一流，让你随时可以享用到美味的披萨！

description: Dok2 has opened up a pizza joint in the Apgujeong area offering authentic New York-style pizza with a buttery, crispy crust. The most popular item on the menu is Brooklyn's Best, featuring Italian sausage, hand-crushed plum tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, extra virgin olive oil, and red onions. Dok2’s favorite dish is known to be the earthy, aromatic Truffle Mushroom pizza. The pizza is certainly worth trying as it has turned Dok2 from a loyal patron into a restaurateur.
name: Gino's NY Pizza

desc_l10n.en: Located in Hannam-dong, the Italian restaurant Harmonium is a space named after the Latin word for “harmony.” Serving modern and sophisticated Italian cuisine, it features a terrace and private rooms, making it ideal for both dining and business gatherings. Experience a memorable meal in a sophisticated atmosphere.
desc_l10n.ja: 漢南洞にあるイタリアンレストラン「アルモニウム」は、ラテン語で「調和（harmony）」を意味する空間です。モダンで洗練されたイタリア料理を提供しており、テラスや個室を完備しているため、食事やビジネスミーティングのいずれにも最適です。洗練された雰囲気の中で、思い出に残る食事をお楽しみください。 ※ アルモニウム：ラテン語で調和(harmony)という意味
desc_l10n.ko: 정성스러운 이탈리아 요리를 편안하고 고급스러운 분위기를 느낄 수 있는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: 位于汉南洞的意大利餐厅Harmonium，其名称源自拉丁语“和谐”（harmony）。餐厅提供现代而精致的意大利美食，并设有露台和包间，既适合用餐，也适合商务聚会。请在别具一格的氛围中，体验一场难忘的美食之旅。 ※ Harmonium：在拉丁语中有和谐之意。

description: Located in Hannam-dong, the Italian restaurant Harmonium is a space named after the Latin word for “harmony.” Serving modern and sophisticated Italian cuisine, it features a terrace and private rooms, making it ideal for both dining and business gatherings. Experience a memorable meal in a sophisticated atmosphere.
name: Harmonium

desc_l10n.en: Ibis Styles Ambassador Myeongdong’s Le Style Restaurant & Bar is a rooftop space that captures panoramic city views, sunsets, and nightscapes, offering the most vivid way to experience the charm of Seoul.
desc_l10n.ja: イビススタイル アンバサダー明洞のル・スタイル レストラン＆バーは、都市の風景、夕焼け、夜景を一望できるルーフトップ空間で、ソウルの魅力を最も生き生きと体感できます。
desc_l10n.ko: 도심 전경과 석양, 야경을 한눈에 담아내는 루프탑
desc_l10n.zh: 明洞宜必思尚品大使酒店的 Le Style 餐厅&酒吧是一处屋顶空间，可将城市风景、夕阳与夜景尽收眼底，最生动地感受首尔的魅力。

description: Ibis Styles Ambassador Myeongdong’s Le Style Restaurant & Bar is a rooftop space that captures panoramic city views, sunsets, and nightscapes, offering the most vivid way to experience the charm of Seoul.
name: Ibis Styles Ambassador Seoul Myeongdong (Le Style Restaurant & Bar)

name_l10n.en: Ibis Styles Ambassador Seoul Myeongdong (Le Style Restaurant & Bar)
name_l10n.ja: イビススタイルズアンバサダーソウルミョンドン(明洞) ル・スタイル・レストラン＆バー
name_l10n.zh: 宜必思尚品首尔明洞大使酒店Le style&酒吧

desc_l10n.en: Expression of the highest peaks of the abdomen ​ This restaurant has served great ribs for the past 30 years. State dinners are often held here due to the beautiful traditional Korean house (hanok) exterior and private rooms available. Samwon Garden is a veteran of the local restaurant scene, first opening its doors in 1976, quickly achieving fame as being not only Seoul’s largest restaurant, but a place serving quality and authentic traditional Korean cuisine.
desc_l10n.ja: 式の腹部の最高峰 ​ 30年以上の伝統を誇るソウルを代表するカルビ専門店。新鮮で質の良いカルビを使い、素晴らしい料理が出される。韓国を訪問した国賓がディナーを楽しむ場所としても知られている。韓国伝統家屋スタイルの雰囲気も良く、プライベートルームがあるため集まりにも最適だ 。 サムウォン(三元)ガーデンは1976年にオープンして以来、韓国レストラン界の老舗としてソウルで最大規模の飲食店としてだけでなく、質の高い正統韓国料理を提供するレストランとして有名です。
desc_l10n.ko: 현지 레스토랑계의 장인으로, 1976년 처음 문을 열어 서울에서 가장 큰 식당으로서뿐만 아니라 질 높은 정통 한식 요리를 제공
desc_l10n.zh: 腹部的最高的山峰的表达 拥有30余年传统的知名烤排骨店，每天都为宾客呈现用新鲜优质的排骨烹制而成的美味菜肴。本店经常承办国宾晚宴，韩式房屋和院落别有情致。设有单间，适合聚会等活动。 SAMWON花园是当地餐饮业的匠心餐厅，于1976年开张。SAMWON花园是首尔最大的餐厅，以高品质正宗韩餐闻名四方。

description: Expression of the highest peaks of the abdomen ​ This restaurant has served great ribs for the past 30 years. State dinners are often held here due to the beautiful traditional Korean house (hanok) exterior and private rooms available. Samwon Garden is a veteran of the local restaurant scene, first opening its doors in 1976, quickly achieving fame as being not only Seoul’s largest restaurant, but a place serving quality and authentic traditional Korean cuisine.
name: [Baeknyeon-gage] Samwon Garden

name_l10n.ja: [百年の店] サムウォン(三元)ガーデン

desc_l10n.en: A multi-recreational venue, On River is designed to provide quality service for food and beverages as well as banquets. Consisting of 3-storey complex, guests can enjoy an excellent dining experience thanks to top on-site chefs and a variety of quality menu options suitable for all ages in a stylish and comfortable atmosphere.
desc_l10n.ja: 複合施設である ON River Station は、質の高い飲食サービスだけでなく会合も開けるようになっています。3フロアからなり、あらゆる年齢層に適した多彩なメニューと腕前のシェフによる料理で、洗練されたゆったりとした雰囲気の中で上質な食事を楽しむことができます。
desc_l10n.ko: 복합 레크리에이션 장소인 오엔은 질 높은 식음료 서비스뿐 아니라 연회를 제공
desc_l10n.zh: ON River Station是复合休闲场所，其成立目的是向广大顾客提供高品质餐饮服务和宴会服务。备有适合任何年龄段的菜单与顶级大厨，提供宾客在舒适气派的氛围中尽享美味佳肴。

description: A multi-recreational venue, On River is designed to provide quality service for food and beverages as well as banquets. Consisting of 3-storey complex, guests can enjoy an excellent dining experience thanks to top on-site chefs and a variety of quality menu options suitable for all ages in a stylish and comfortable atmosphere.
name: ON River Station

desc_l10n.en: Naeja Peanuts was founded 50 years ago when the current CEO's father was 26 years old, and he learned the art of making peanut pancakes from a relative. When you enter Naeja Peanut, which has been baking hot pot for more than half a century, you can see the machine that makes peanut hot pot opposite the entrance. It's still the same as it was in the old days, except that it's been switched from briquettes to gas. The twice-roasted peanuts are embedded with large peanuts, making them savory. The peanut pancake, which is made only about 130 bags a day, is their signature item. The green onion and ginger pancakes are also popular.
desc_l10n.ja: ナジャタンニャンは 、 現在 の 代表 の 父親 が 50 年前 、 26 歳 の 時 に 始 めた 店 で 、 ピーナッツチョンビョンを 作 っていた 親戚 から 技術 を 学 んで 店 を 開 いた 。 半世紀以上 にわたってチヂミを 焼 いているナンジャピーナッツに 入 ると 、 入口 の 向 かいにピーナッツチヂミを 作 る 機械 が 見 えます 。 煉炭火 からガス 火 に 変 わった 以外 は 、 昔 ながらの 製法 を 踏襲 している 。 二度焼 かれたピーナッツがぎっしり 詰 まっていて 、 噛 めば 噛 むほど 香 ばしい 。 一日 に 約 130 袋 しか 作 らないピーナッツチヂミがここの 代表的 な 商品 だ 。 青 のりチヂミと 生姜 チヂミも 人気 です 。
desc_l10n.ko: 매일 눈 깜짝할 새 완판돼 버리는 한정 수량 땅콩 전병
desc_l10n.zh: Naeja Peanut 是 50 年前开始的 ， 当时现任老板的父亲 26 岁 ， 他从一个做花生点心的亲戚那里学到了这门手艺 。 当你进入已经烤了半个多世纪火锅的 Naeja Peanut 时 ， 你会看到入口对面有一台制作花生火锅的机器 。 它的制作方法仍然和以前一样 ， 只是现在是用燃气而不是煤球 。 两次烘烤的花生中嵌有大颗的花生 ， 你越嚼越香 。 招牌菜是花生煎饼 ， 每天只做大约 130 袋 。 葱姜煎饼也很受欢迎 。

description: Naeja Peanuts was founded 50 years ago when the current CEO's father was 26 years old, and he learned the art of making peanut pancakes from a relative. When you enter Naeja Peanut, which has been baking hot pot for more than half a century, you can see the machine that makes peanut hot pot opposite the entrance. It's still the same as it was in the old days, except that it's been switched from briquettes to gas. The twice-roasted peanuts are embedded with large peanuts, making them savory. The peanut pancake, which is made only about 130 bags a day, is their signature item. The green onion and ginger pancakes are also popular.
name: Naeja Peanuts

desc_l10n.en: The current owner, who inherited 'Grandma Gimbap' from his mother in 1980, reopened it as 'Handmade Gimbap' and has been in Tongin Market for two generations. At her mother's request, she helped her mother sell gimbap every day since she had just entered university. Her second daughter suggested, "Since your mother has a good taste, let's call it 'Sonmat Gimbap' instead of 'Grandma's Gimbap,'" hence the current name. Tongin Market also operates a unique experience where you can purchase gimbap with Ipjeon, a currency unique to Tongin Market, and use the packed lunch cafe.
desc_l10n.ja: 1980 年 にオープンした 「 おばあちゃんキンパプ 」 を 母親 から 引 き 継 いだ 現在 の 社長 が 「 手味 キンパプ 」 として 再 オープンし 、 2 代 にわたってトンイン 市場 での 地位 を 守 っている 。 母親 の 要請 で 大学 に 入学 したばかりから 毎日 キムパプの 商売 を 手伝 ったのが 「 手味 キムパプ 」 の 始 まりだった 。 次女 は 「 お 母 さんの 手味 がいいから " おばあちゃんキムパプ " ではなく " 手味 キムパプ " にしよう 」 と 提案 し 、 今 の 名前 が 付 けられた 。 トンイン 市場 ならではのユニークな 通貨 である 葉銭 でキムパプを 購入 し 、 弁当 カフェを 利用 する 異色体験 も 運営 している 。
desc_l10n.ko: 2대째 통인시장을 지켜온 인기 만점 김밥
desc_l10n.zh: 现任店主于 1980 年从母亲那里继承了 " 奶奶拌饭 " ， 并以 " 手工拌饭 " 的名义重新开张 ， 在 Tongin Market 已经经营了两代人 。 在母亲的要求下 ， 她刚进大学时就每天帮助母亲卖饭 ， 她的二女儿建议说 ： " 我们叫它 ' 松麦饭 ' 而不是 ' 奶奶的饭 ' 吧 ， 因为她的口味很好 " ， 于是这个名字就诞生了 。 同仁市场还提供一种独特的体验 ， 你可以用同仁市场特有的货币 -- 明信片来购买 Gimbap ， 然后在便当咖啡馆里吃 。

At her mother's request, she helped her mother sell gimbap every day since she had just entered university. Her second daughter suggested, "Since your mother has a good taste, let's call it 'Sonmat Gimbap' instead of 'Grandma's Gimbap,'" hence the current name. Tongin Market also operates a unique experience where you can purchase gimbap with Ipjeon, a currency unique to Tongin Market, and use the packed lunch cafe.
name: Sonmat Gimbap

desc_l10n.en: Opened in 1985, Eulji Dabang is a charming cafe with a neo-noir feel. The owner runs the shop with the belief that he never plays with his food. The owner's friendly explanation of how to make the egg yolk-filled ssanghwa tea, which is served like a full moon, will quickly make you a fan. You can enjoy a unique experience in a place that has retained the appearance of an old-fashioned tea room among skyscrapers.
desc_l10n.ja: 1985 年 にオープンしたウルチ ( 乙支 ) 茶房 は 、 ニュートロな 感性 が 漂 う 魅力的 なカフェです 。 食 べることには 絶対手 を 出 さない 」 という 社長 の 信念 でお 店 を 運営 しています 。 卵黄 が 満月 のように 入 った 双花茶 を 初 めて 口 にする 人 も 、 社長 の 親切 な 説明 ですぐにファンになります 。 高層 ビルの 間 に 昔 の 喫茶店 の 姿 をそのまま 残 した 場所 で 、 異色 の 体験 ができる 。
desc_l10n.ko: BTS도 반한 특제 쌍화탕이 있는 찻집
desc_l10n.zh: 1985 年开业的乙支达邦是一家具有新派风格的迷人咖啡馆 。 店主本着 " 不能乱吃东西 " 的信念来经营这家店 。 店主友好地解释如何制作充满蛋黄的双花茶 ， 很快就成为粉丝的最爱 。 你可以在这个保留了摩天大楼中老式茶室外观的地方享受独特的体验 。

desc_l10n.en: A stalwart on Daehak-ro for more than 60 years since 1956, Hakrimdabang was a popular meeting place for university students who led the Hyehwa Station democracy movement, as well as a regular coffee shop for people in the arts, including music, art, theater, and literature. Today, it's the oldest cafe in Seoul, and the LP and paintings inside give it a nostalgic feel. Also the filming location for the drama "You from the Stars," Hakrimdabang is still loved by all generations. • This place has been selected as a 'Seoul Future Heritage'. Among Seoul's modern and contemporary cultural heritage, Seoul Future Heritage is a tangible and intangible asset that is worth passing on to future generations.( https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr)
desc_l10n.ja: 1956 年 から 60 年以上 の 間 、 大学路 で 堅固 な 地位 を 守 ってきた 鶴林茶房 は 、 恵化駅民主化運動 を 主導 した 大学生 たちの 議論 の 場 はもちろん 、 音楽 、 美術 、 演劇 、 文学 など 芸術界関係者 の 常連茶房 として 愛 されました 。 今 ではソウルで 最 も 古 いカフェで 、 店内 を 埋 め 尽 くす LP や 絵画 が 古風 な 雰囲気 を 醸 し 出 しています 。 ドラマ 「 星 から 来 たあなた 」 の 撮影地 でもあるハクリム 茶房 は 、 今 も 世代 を 問 わず 多 くの 人 に 愛 されている 。 - ここは 「 ソウル 未来遺産 」 に 選定 された 場所 です 。 ソウルの 近 ・ 現代文化遺産 の 中 で 、 未来世代 に 伝 える 価値 のある 有形 ・ 無形 の 資産 であるソウル 未来遺産 を 永続的 な 旅行 でご 覧 ください ( https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr) ​
desc_l10n.ko: 예술인들에게 사랑받은 온 서울의 최고령 카페
desc_l10n.zh: 自 1956 年以来 ， Hakrimdabang 已经在大河路上坚守了 60 多年 ， 它一直是领导惠化站民主运动的大学生们的热门聚会场所 ， 也是艺术界人士 （ 包括音乐 、 艺术 、 戏剧和文学 ） 的固定咖啡店 。 今天 ， 它是首尔最古老的咖啡馆 ， 内部排列的黑胶唱片和绘画给人一种怀旧的感觉 。 也是电视剧 《 来自星星的你 》 的拍摄地 ， Hakrimdabang 仍然受到各代人的喜爱 。 • 这里被选为 " 首尔未来遗产 " 。 在首尔近现代文化遗产中 ， 可以在老圃旅行中了解一下首尔未来遗产 ， 这是值得传给下一代的有形和无形资产 （ https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr ） 搜索 复制

desc_l10n.en: Like the many eateries commonly found along Japan’s streets of Ginza, Sushi Kaisin is a cozy, little sushi restaurant. From procuring and preparing the ingredients to plating and serving up the delectable morsels, the Japanese chef does everything from beginning to end, ensuring the utmost quality in taste for his customers. The restaurant has a counter which seats only 6 people, making it crucial for visitors to make reservations in advance.
desc_l10n.ja: 銀座にあるような小ぢんまりとして上品で洗練されたスタイルの高級鮨専門店。食材の買い付けから下ごしらえ、接客に至るまで、日本人の店主がひとりですべてをこなしています。いつもと変わらない味わいを保つため、カウンター6席のみで運営しています。おひとり様からお食事ができます。席が少ないため、事前の予約をおすすめしています。
desc_l10n.ko: 일본셰프가 제공하는 고품격 일본식 전통 스시와 오마카세
desc_l10n.zh: 能够品尝到媲美日本银座一带精致小巧的寿司店里的高级日式料理。从购买食材、备菜直到菜品摆放到客人面前，全程都是主厨一人亲力亲为。为了保证每一道菜的质量和味道，仅设可容纳6位客人的座位。所以如果想要品尝最美味的日式料理，请一定要提前预约哦！

desc_l10n.en: EXO member D.O. recommended this place to a magazine while other EXO members Xiumin and Sehun are regulars to this restaurant. The restaurant has received great reviews as seen in three blue ribbons in the Blue Ribbon Survey, a representative guidebook for Korean restaurants. D.O. recommends nakji-bokkeum (stir-fried octopus) and jumeok-bap (riceballs), both popular dishes at Duru, with its clean and neat ambience. The harmony between the spicy yet clean flavored Nakji-bokkeum, savory Jumeok-bap that soothes the mouth, and flavorful homemade side dishes are amazing. The icing on the cake is the purple sweet potato makgeolli. This cheeky pink drink is a go-to-drink item for patrons since it boasts great harmony with the Nakji-bokkeum.
desc_l10n.ja: EXOのディオが某雑誌に推薦した店。ディオの他にも、シウミン、セフンなどEXOのメンバーたちもよく訪れるそうです。チョンダムドン(淸潭洞)にあるこの店は、韓国のレストラン・ガイドブック＜ブルーリボン・ソベイ＞で、ブルーリボンを三つももらうほど、とても評判がよく、洗練された室内はこざっぱりした雰囲気です。 人気メニューは、ディオお勧めのテナガダコ炒め(ナクチポックム)、おにぎりです。スッキリ辛いテナガダコ炒めやその辛さから口のなかを落ち着かせてくれる香ばしいおにぎり、それから店で漬けるおかずとのハーモニーは絶品です。これにもう一品、紫色サツマイモ・マッコリも見逃せません。ほんのりと赤らめたほおみたいに、きれいな色の紫色サツマイモ・マッコリはテナガダコ炒めとの相性がよく、一緒に注文するお客さんが多いそうです。
desc_l10n.ko: EXO의 멤버 디오가 모 잡지에 추천한 식당
desc_l10n.zh: EXO的成员D.O.(都暻秀)在某杂志上推荐过这家饭店。除了D.O.以外秀珉(金珉锡), 世勋等EXO成员也经常光顾这家位于清潭洞的饭店，荳蒌在韩国餐厅指南 一书中得到了三个蝴蝶节嘉奖，受到好评。这里的环境干净整洁，招牌菜是D.O.曾推荐过的辣炒章鱼和饭团。香辣的辣炒章鱼和缓解辣味的饭团，再加上店内制作的各种小菜, 组合在一起堪称一绝。另外这里的紫色红薯米酒也非常值得推荐。米酒的颜色好似微红的脸夹一样漂亮，与辣炒章鱼的搭配更是绝妙，因此受到很多顾客的青睐。

desc_l10n.en: Nagwon Rice Cake, with a 90-year tradition that has been passed down through three generations since the 1920s, is the home of Korean rice cakes. It is a certified restaurant that has been introduced through various TV media and still makes rice cakes by hand to maintain the unique flavor of Korean traditional food. The representative Duteop tteok is famous for its luxurious flavor. The restaurant is also designated as a Seoul Cultural Heritage Site, as it makes rice cakes using techniques inherited from a court lady of Wonseo-dong. • This place has been selected as a 'Seoul Future Heritage'. Among Seoul's modern and contemporary cultural heritage, Seoul Future Heritage is a tangible and intangible asset that is worth passing on to future generations.( https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr)
desc_l10n.ja: 1920 年代 から 3 代 にわたって 受 け 継 がれてきた 90 年 の 伝統 を 持 つ 楽園餅屋 は 、 韓国餅 の 本家 と 言 っても 過言 ではない 。 様 々な TV メディアを 通 じて 紹介 された 認証 されたグルメ 店 で 、 韓国 の 伝統食品 である 餅本来 の 味 を 維持 するため 、 今 でも 手作業 で 餅 を 作 り 続 けている 。 代表的 なトトゥブトックは 高級 な 味 で 有名 だ 。 ウォンソドン ( 元西洞 ) の 出宮宮女 から 伝授 された 技術 で 餅 を 作 るところで 、 ソウル 文化遺産 にも 指定 されている 。 - ここは 「 ソウル 未来遺産 」 に 選定 された 場所 です 。 ソウルの 近 ・ 現代文化遺産 の 中 で 、 未来世代 に 伝 える 価値 のある 有形 ・ 無形 の 資産 であるソウル 未来遺産 を 永続的 な 旅行 でご 覧 ください ( https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr)
desc_l10n.ko: 한국 떡의 본가라 해도 손색없는 100년 전통 떡집
desc_l10n.zh: Nakwon Tteokjip ， 自 20 世纪 20 年代以来 ， 历经三代人 ， 拥有 90 年的传统 ， 是韩国年糕之乡 。 它是一家经过认证的餐厅 ， 通过各种电视媒体的介绍 ， 仍然用手工制作年糕 ， 以保持韩国传统食品的独特味道 。 具有代表性的 dduktteok 以其豪华的味道而闻名 。 它还被指定为首尔文化遗产 ， 因为它采用了从元寿洞朱宫的皇室夫人那里继承的技术 。 • 这里被选为 " 首尔未来遗产 " 。 在首尔近现代文化遗产中 ， 可以在老圃旅行中了解一下首尔未来遗产 ， 这是值得传给下一代的有形和无形资产 （ https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr ）

desc_l10n.en: p { text-align:justify; word-spacing:2px; } In 1949, Biwon Tteokjip, known as "Grandma Hong's Tteokjip," first opened its doors. It all started when Grandma Hong Gannan's rice cakes, which she served at Changdeokgung Palace's Nakseonjae, caught the eye of Han Hee-soon Sanggung, the last court caterer of the Joseon Dynasty, who personally taught her the secrets of court rice cakes during the chaotic period after the liberation of Korea and before the Korean War. The shop, which used to make and sell rice cakes in a house near Changdeokgung Palace, still uses the same recipe for royal rice cakes that was presented to the king, and the entire process, from selecting the finest ingredients to making the rice cakes, is done 100% by hand. • This place has been selected as a 'Seoul Future Heritage'. Among Seoul's modern and contemporary cultural heritage, Seoul Future Heritage is a tangible and intangible asset that is worth passing on to future generations.( https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr)
desc_l10n.ja: 1949 年 、「 ホンおばあちゃんの 餅屋 」 として 知 られるビウォン 餅屋 が 初 めて 開店 しました 。 光復後 の 混乱期 であり 、 6-25 戦争 が 起 きる 前 、 ホン・ガンナンおばあちゃんが 昌徳宮洛宣齋 で 披露 した 餅 を 、 当時朝鮮王朝最後 の 宮中料理技能保持者 であるハン・ヒスン 上宮 が 彼女 に 目 をつけ 、 直接 ホン・ガンナンおばあちゃんに 宮中餅 の 秘法 を 伝授 したのが 始 まりだった 。 昌徳宮近 くの 民家 で 餅 を 作 り 販売 していた 店 は 、 現在 も 王様 に 献上 する 宮中餅 のレシピ 通 りに 最高級 の 材料選定 から 餅 の 製造 まで 全 ての 工程 を 100% 手作業 で 行 っています 。 - ここは 「 ソウル 未来遺産 」 に 選定 された 場所 です 。 ソウルの 近 ・ 現代文化遺産 の 中 で 、 未来世代 に 伝 える 価値 のある 有形 ・ 無形 の 資産 であるソウル 未来遺産 を 永続的 な 旅行 でご 覧 ください ( https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr)
desc_l10n.ko: 조선 마지막 상궁에게 비법을 전수 하여 만든 궁중떡
desc_l10n.zh: 1949 年 ， 被称为 " 洪奶奶的宫廷米糕 " 的碧园宫廷米糕首次开门营业 。 事情的起因是 ， 在朝鲜解放后和朝鲜战争前的混乱时期 ， 洪甘南奶奶在昌德宫的乐善斋堂供应年糕 ， 朝鲜王朝最后一个宫廷食品职能部门的韩熙顺尚宫注意到了她 ， 并亲自将宫廷年糕的秘方传给了洪奶奶 。 这家曾经在昌德宫附近的房子里制作和销售年糕的商店 ， 仍然使用与国王雕像相同的宫廷年糕配方 ， 从选择最好的材料到制作年糕的整个过程都是 100% 手工完成的 。 • 这里被选为 " 首尔未来遗产 " 。 在首尔近现代文化遗产中 ， 可以在老圃旅行中了解一下首尔未来遗产 ， 这是值得传给下一代的有形和无形资产 （ https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr ）

desc_l10n.en: The owner started selling side dishes at his own stall after his brother's business failed. She sold delicious side dishes such as kimchi and crab paste at the stall, which went viral, and opened the first side dish shop in Gwangjang Market. She named the shop 'Soonhee's Banchan' after her eldest daughter. Nowadays, everyone uses the name 'Soonhee', but the original 'Soonhee' in Gwangjang Market is Soonhee's Banchan, which is the pride of the owner. Regular customers say that this place is like a second home.
desc_l10n.ja: 社長 は 兄 の 商売 が 失敗 した 後 、 自 ら 露店 でおかずを 売 り 始 めたそうです 。 露店 でキムチやカニジャムなど 美味 しいおかずを 売 ったことが 口 コミで 広蔵市場 の 中 に 初 めておかず 屋 を 出 すことになりました 。 店名 は 長女 の 名前 にちなんで 「 スンヒネ ( 순희네반찬 ) 」 と 名付 けた 。 今 では 誰 もが 「 スンヒ 」 という 名前 を 使 いますが 、 広蔵市場 の 元祖 「 スンヒ 」 はスンヒネバンバンバンであることが 社長 の 誇 りであり 、 自慢 です 。 スンヒネバンチャンの 常連客 は 、 ここがもう 一 つの 実家 のようだと 言 う 。
desc_l10n.ko: 맛깔난 젓갈과 게장으로 유명한 광장시장 반찬가게
desc_l10n.zh: 在他哥哥的生意失败后，老板开始在自己的摊位上卖配菜。他在摊位上出售泡菜和蟹酱等美味配菜，口碑相传，他在广昌市场开了第一家配菜店。她以大女儿的名字为店铺命名为 "顺喜配菜"。现在，每个人都使用 "顺熙 "这个名字，但广昌市场上最初的 "顺熙 "是顺熙烤肉，这是店主的骄傲。老顾客说，这里就像第二个家。
