desc_l10n.en: Since 1946, this bakery has been a favorite among generations of Seoulites. The founder, who dreamed of national liberation, created the Mugunghwa logo and the name Taegukdang to capture the ideals of the nation. The long-established bakery has continued to build on its reputation by developing numerous types of bread. In keeping with the spirit of the founder, who did not want to become a franchise, they take care to ensure that the flavors do not change. This is a place where you can find bread that appeals to both children and grandmothers.
desc_l10n.ja: 1946年から世代を超えたソウルを代表するパン屋として定着している。光復を夢見ていた創業者が民族の理想を込めるために、むくげ(無窮花)の花のロゴと太極堂という名前をつけた。歴史ある製菓の名門として、数多くの種類のパンを開発し、その名声を受け継いでいる。フランチャイズにならないようにという創業者の精神をそのまま受け継ぎ、味の変化がないように気を配っている。小さな子供からシニア層の口にも合うパンが集まっている。
desc_l10n.ko: 광복을 꿈꾸던 청년이 민족의 이상을 담아 만든 빵집
desc_l10n.zh: 自1946年以来，这家面包店一直在为几代首尔人服务。梦想着民族解放的创始人创造了Mugunghwa标志和Taegukdang这个名字，以捕捉民族的理想。这家历史悠久的面包店通过开发众多类型的面包来延续其声誉。为了与创始人不想成为特许经营的精神保持一致，他们注意不改变口味。在这里，你可以找到对孩子和祖母都有吸引力的面包。

description: Since 1946, this bakery has been a favorite among generations of Seoulites. The founder, who dreamed of national liberation, created the Mugunghwa logo and the name Taegukdang to capture the ideals of the nation. The long-established bakery has continued to build on its reputation by developing numerous types of bread. In keeping with the spirit of the founder, who did not want to become a franchise, they take care to ensure that the flavors do not change. This is a place where you can find bread that appeals to both children and grandmothers.
name: Taegeukdang

desc_l10n.en: Haha & Kim Jong-guk’s 401 bbq restaurant is located in Hongdae. Since the restaurant is already famous as a great place to dine in Hongdae, the entrance is full of people waiting in line. Looking at the numerous photos of celebrities and the two owners is one of the joys of coming to the restaurant. Its signature dish is a set where all different cuts including ohgyupsal, moksal, and hangjeongsal are served, and the order can be placed by the number of people in a group. Juicy meat is very tasty when dipped in the fermented anchovy and home-made sauce provided upon ordering. Chadol soybean soup will also be the perfect addition for a soft texture and spicy finish.
desc_l10n.ja: ホンデ(弘大)にある、ハハ＆キムジョングクの401精肉食堂。すでにホンデ(弘大)マッジブ(美味しい店)として名高い店で、入り口からお客の列が並ぶほどです。壁に貼ってある数多い芸能人のサインと社長二人の写真を見るのも、この店の楽しみ方の一つ！一番おすすめは、オギョプサル(皮付サムギョプサル)、モクサル(豚の肩肉)、ハンジョンサル(豚背首肉)など色んな部位の肉を味わうことができるセットメニューであり、人数に合わせて注文すれば美味しく楽しめます。 肉を注文すると一緒に提供されるカタクチイワシの塩辛と店の特製ソースに、肉汁たっぷりの肉をつけて食べると、もうたまりません。さらに、こくのある味とピリ辛い味が口直しの役割をしてくれるチャドルデンジャン(牛のともばら肉入りテンジャンチゲ)を一緒に食べると、完璧な一食の完成間違いなしです。
desc_l10n.ko: 홍대에 위치한 하하&김종국의 401 정육식당
desc_l10n.zh: HAHA&金钟国的401精肉餐厅位于弘益大学附近。它是弘大附近有名的美食店，从入口处便有很多排队等待就餐的客人。餐厅墙壁上有很多艺人的签名和两位店主的照片，这也为餐厅增添了魅力。最受顾客欢迎的菜单是可以品尝到五花肉，猪颈肉等多种部位的套餐，并且可以根据人数适量点餐。 店内为您提供的银鱼汁和自制调味汁，带着丰富肉汁的精肉沾上调味汁，味道堪称一绝。再配上店里清淡口味的泡菜和起到调换口味作用的牛胸肉酱汤，那才是真正完美的一顿。

description: Haha & Kim Jong-guk’s 401 bbq restaurant is located in Hongdae. Since the restaurant is already famous as a great place to dine in Hongdae, the entrance is full of people waiting in line. Looking at the numerous photos of celebrities and the two owners is one of the joys of coming to the restaurant. Its signature dish is a set where all different cuts including ohgyupsal, moksal, and hangjeongsal are served, and the order can be placed by the number of people in a group. Juicy meat is very tasty when dipped in the fermented anchovy and home-made sauce provided upon ordering. Chadol soybean soup will also be the perfect addition for a soft texture and spicy finish.
name: Haha & Kim Jong-guk’s 401 Restaurant

name_l10n.ja: ハハ＆キムジョングクの401精肉食堂

desc_l10n.en: Hwasa, a member of a powerful girl group Mamamoo, ate at this place on a reality show "I Live Alone", and a gopchang (grilled intestines) craze was caused in Korea. The name of the place is Daehan Gopchang in Jangan near Janghanpyeong Station. After the show was aired, so many people came over that the restaurant now closes early everyday as they sell out their food. Gopchang gets more savory as you chew it, and makchang has a very attractive chewy texture, and Daechang is very soft. The all-in-one set where you can taste all three is what the restaurant recommends. Enjoy their homemade sauce, onions, cheese, and curry seasoning to your taste. No meal will be more perfect than when you wrap up your meal with fried rice, just like Hwasa did.
desc_l10n.ja: 実力派ガールズグループ「ママム」のメンバーファサがリアル・バラエティ番組＜私一人で暮す＞で、グルメ番組を放送してから、韓国にはなんとコプチャン(牛もつ)大乱が起りました。ファサが訪れた店はチャンハンピョン駅近くにあるテハンコプチャン(チャンアン(長安)店)。放送後、あまりにも大勢の人々が店を訪れたため、コプチャン(牛もつ)が売り切れ、通常より非常に早く営業を終了するくらいの人気ぶりです。 噛めば噛むほど香ばしいコプチャン(牛もつ)、しこしことコシがあるマクチャン(牛ギアラ)、やわらかいデチャン(大腸)を全部味わえる「モドゥム・コプチャン(牛もつ盛り合わせ)」がおすすめです。この店だけの秘伝のソースと玉ねぎ、チーズ、カレー・シーズニングをお好みに合わせて、ぜひご堪能ください。ファサみたいに、シメのチャーハンも忘れずに！
desc_l10n.ko: 실력파 걸그룹 마마무의 멤버 화사가 리얼리티 예능 <나 혼자 산다>에서 먹방을 선보인 후, 대한민국에 곱창 대란이 일어난 곳.  화사가 찾은 식당은 장한평역 근처에 위치한 대한곱창 장안점.
desc_l10n.zh: 实力派少女组合MAMAMOO的成员华莎(Hwa Sa)出演的真人秀娱乐节目「我自己生活」播出之后，大韩民国便掀起了牛小肠的热潮。华莎去过的餐厅是位于长汗坪站附近的大韩牛小肠长安店。节目播出之后店里迎来了大量的顾客，曾一度因牛小肠缺货而提前打烊，真可谓是达到了门庭若市的程度。 越嚼越香的牛小肠，筋道的口感是牛小肠的魅力所在， 店内同时可以品尝到柔嫩的大肠的拼盘套餐更是值得推荐。这里还备有特制调味汁以及洋葱，芝士，咖哩等调料，可供顾客根据个人口味选用。让我们跟华莎一样最后来一份炒饭来完成完美的一餐吧。

description: Hwasa, a member of a powerful girl group Mamamoo, ate at this place on a reality show "I Live Alone", and a gopchang (grilled intestines) craze was caused in Korea. The name of the place is Daehan Gopchang in Jangan near Janghanpyeong Station. After the show was aired, so many people came over that the restaurant now closes early everyday as they sell out their food. Gopchang gets more savory as you chew it, and makchang has a very attractive chewy texture, and Daechang is very soft. The all-in-one set where you can taste all three is what the restaurant recommends. Enjoy their homemade sauce, onions, cheese, and curry seasoning to your taste. No meal will be more perfect than when you wrap up your meal with fried rice, just like Hwasa did.
name: Daehan Gopchang (Jangan Branch)

name_l10n.ja: テハンコプチャン (チャンアン(長安)店)

desc_l10n.en: Samgeori Pujutgan, operated by YG Entertainment, recently moved from Hongik University to a bigger location in Central City. Big Bang’s Seungri, Sandara Park, and other entertainers at YG, including Lee Seung Gi, Lee Seo Jin and other popular entertainers have also visited the place. Winner and other artists from YG often have parties here. It is also fun to look at celebrity photographs and signatures hanging on the wall. Though the location has moved, it still tastes the same. The signature pork ribs boast thickness and not overpowering sweetness, making it popular. Pyongyang noodles, made with buckwheat noodles and Korean beef broth, and Korean beef with soybean rice are also delicious.
desc_l10n.ja: YGエンターテインメントが運営する焼肉屋で、最近ホンデ(弘大)からセントラルシティへ拡張移転しました。BIGBANGのスンリやサンダラ・パクなどのYG所属の芸能人だけでなく、イ・スンギ、イ・ソジンなどの人気芸能人たちの行き付けの店です。WINNERなどYG所属のアーティストたちがここでよくパーティを開いたりするとか。壁に貼ってある芸能人の記念写真やサインを探してみるのも、なかなか面白いです。場所は変わりましたが、味は依然としておいしいです。代表メニューであるテジガルビ(豚カルビ)は、分厚い肉が自慢であり、刺激的ではなく風味のある甘さが人気の理由です。ハヌ(韓牛)を煮込んだスープにさっぱりした蕎麦麺が入った平壤冷麺、深い味が逸品であるハヌ(韓牛)ミソご飯も格別です。
desc_l10n.ko: YG엔터테인먼트에서 운영했던 고깃집
desc_l10n.zh: 这里是YG Entertainment经营的烤肉店，最近从弘大扩迁到CENTRAL CITY。不仅BIGBANG的李胜贤，Sandara Park等YG旗下演艺人，而且李升基，李瑞镇等知名演艺人也来到过这里。WINNER等YG旗下艺人经常在这里聚会。浏览墙上的演艺人纪念照片和签名也是十分有意思的。虽然位置有所变化，但是味道却是一如既往。这里的猪排肉味美，带着隐隐的甜味，十分受顾客的欢迎。用韩牛熬出的面汤配上荞麦面制作的平壤冷面和味道香淳的韩牛酱卷饭也是这里的特色美食。

description: Samgeori Pujutgan, operated by YG Entertainment, recently moved from Hongik University to a bigger location in Central City. Big Bang’s Seungri, Sandara Park, and other entertainers at YG, including Lee Seung Gi, Lee Seo Jin and other popular entertainers have also visited the place. Winner and other artists from YG often have parties here. It is also fun to look at celebrity photographs and signatures hanging on the wall. Though the location has moved, it still tastes the same. The signature pork ribs boast thickness and not overpowering sweetness, making it popular. Pyongyang noodles, made with buckwheat noodles and Korean beef broth, and Korean beef with soybean rice are also delicious.
name: Samgeori Pujutgan Central City

name_l10n.ja: サムゴリ・プジュッカン セントラルシティ店

desc_l10n.en: Neungra Bapsang is a North Korean restaurant run by a North Korean owner. He opened his restaurant in hopes of letting people know more about North Korean food and dishes like Pyongyang Onban and Gaeseong Mujjim.
desc_l10n.ja: ヌンラバプサンは北朝鮮から韓国へ移住したオーナーが運営する北朝鮮料理専門店です。ピョンヤン・ネンミョン(平壌式冷麺)、ピョンヤン・オンバン(平壌式温飯)、オボクジェンバンなどの北朝鮮料理を広く伝えたいオーナーの思いから店をオープンしました。
desc_l10n.ko: 능라밥상은 북한에서 남한으로 넘어온 사장님이 직접 운영하는 북한음식 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 绫罗饭桌是一间专门出售北韩料理的饮食店，由从北韩逃至南韩的李爱兰院长所经营。据说，院长是为了让大众认识御腹大盘、开城炖萝卜、平壤温饭等鲜为人知的北韩料理，而开设此餐厅。

description: Neungra Bapsang is a North Korean restaurant run by a North Korean owner. He opened his restaurant in hopes of letting people know more about North Korean food and dishes like Pyongyang Onban and Gaeseong Mujjim.
name: Neungra Bapsang

desc_l10n.en: Yesung from Super Junior opened Cafe Armoire following Mouse Rabbit. Though it just opened in August, it has already become famous. Once you step in to the cafe, a room with antique furniture and ornaments appear, so be prepared. Once you open the door of the furniture, that is how you get to the actual cafe. Rustic light, tables, and organ create an elegant and retro ambience, as if you came visiting a world from the Chronicles of Narnia. Their signature dishes are cutely-shaped cheesecake and the 24 hour milk tea that features boiled and matured milk with various types of earl grey.
desc_l10n.ja: スーパージュニアのイェソンが、「マウスラビット(Mouse Rabbit)」に続いてコンデ(建大)に手がけた、カフェ「アルムア」がオープンしました。8月にオープンしたばかりですが、すでに口コミが広がり、有名になりました。店内にはいると、すぐアンティーク小物や家具で飾られた部屋が出ますが、戸惑う必要はありません。タンスを開けてから、本物のカフェに入ることができるからです。古い電灯、昔風のテーブルと椅子、年季が入ったオルガンなどが、古風でレトロな雰囲気を醸し出しており、まるでナルニア国物語の中に入っているようです。可愛い形のチーズケーキ、オリジナル牛乳、それから各種のアールグレイを熱く入れてから一日を熟成させた24hミルクティーが人気メニューです。
desc_l10n.ko: 슈퍼주니어의 예성이 ‘마우스래빗’에 이어 오픈한 카페
desc_l10n.zh: 'Cafe Armoire'是Super Junior的艺声(Yesung)经营的继'Mouse Rabbit'之后又一家咖啡厅。虽然是一家8月才开业的新店，但是已经小有名气了。进入咖啡厅您首先会看到一个摆放着复古风的装饰品和家具的房间，打开衣橱的门才能真正地进到咖啡厅内。复古的电灯，桌子和椅子，陈旧的风琴等营造了一种复古的气氛，好似进入到纳尼亚传奇的世界一般。这里的招牌饮品和甜点有形状可爱的芝士蛋糕和牛奶，以及各种经过一天发酵熟成的24h伯爵红茶 。

description: Yesung from Super Junior opened Cafe Armoire following Mouse Rabbit. Though it just opened in August, it has already become famous. Once you step in to the cafe, a room with antique furniture and ornaments appear, so be prepared. Once you open the door of the furniture, that is how you get to the actual cafe. Rustic light, tables, and organ create an elegant and retro ambience, as if you came visiting a world from the Chronicles of Narnia. Their signature dishes are cutely-shaped cheesecake and the 24 hour milk tea that features boiled and matured milk with various types of earl grey.
name: Cafe Armoire

desc_l10n.en: This cafe, operated by Block B’s B-bomb, is located near Sookmyung Women’s University Station on line 4. The simple single story building has a very calm and clean interior. B Bomb frequently comes when he isn’t busy, which is why you can easily see his signatures or fan selfies on social networking services. The signature item is the bitter and sweet mujabi, meaning "merciless,"" latte, made of espresso, chocolate, and steamed milk. Aside from drinks, cakes, including carrot cake, are prepared and phone cases with printed cafe names and t-shirts are sold as souvenirs.
desc_l10n.ja: ブロックビー(Block B)のメンバー、ビボムが運営するカフェ。地下鉄4号線「淑大入口駅」からすぐの所に位置しており、1階建てのシンプルな外観に、店内のインテリアもオシャレで落ち着いた雰囲気です。SNSでは、ビボムがスケジュールの合間に店に来て、ファンたちと一緒に撮った認証シャットやサインを難なく見つけることができます。 代表メニューは、エスプレッソ、チョコレート、スチーム牛乳で作り、甘苦い味が特徴の独特な「ムジャビラテ」です。飲み物以外にも、ニンジンケーキをはじめケーキメニューも種類豊富に揃い、店名がプリントされたスマートフォンケースやTシャツなども記念品として販売しているので、ファンの方はお見逃しなく！
desc_l10n.ko: 블락비 멤버 비범이 운영하는 카페.
desc_l10n.zh: MUJABEE是Block B的成员B-BOMB经营的咖啡厅。它位于4号线淑大入口站附近，单层结构建筑的外观十分简洁，内部装璜也给人一种恬静的感觉。在SNS上可以看到B-BOMB在没有日程安排时在这里与粉丝们合影的照片。 这里的招牌饮品是意式浓缩咖啡和巧克力，以及使用泡沫牛奶制做的甜中带着苦调的'MUJABEE拿铁'。除饮品之外这里还准备了以胡罗卜蛋糕为代表的各种蛋糕，店内还出售印有店名的手机壳和T恤衫等纪念品。

description: This cafe, operated by Block B’s B-bomb, is located near Sookmyung Women’s University Station on line 4. The simple single story building has a very calm and clean interior. B Bomb frequently comes when he isn’t busy, which is why you can easily see his signatures or fan selfies on social networking services. The signature item is the bitter and sweet mujabi, meaning "merciless,"" latte, made of espresso, chocolate, and steamed milk. Aside from drinks, cakes, including carrot cake, are prepared and phone cases with printed cafe names and t-shirts are sold as souvenirs.
name: Cafe Mujabee

desc_l10n.en: RoyaD is a homemade dessert shop which uses traditional Korean ingredients to make fusion desserts. Their mini tteok cake and seolgi madeleine are their most popular menu and their tteok sandwiches are well received as a quick breakfast meal among busy businessmen.
desc_l10n.ja: カフェ ROYAD は韓国伝統菓子の要素を取り入れたフュージョン手作りデザート専門店です。ミニ餅ケーキや餅マドレーヌが人気があり、朝食代わりとして餅サンドウイッチも忙しい社会人にも好評です。
desc_l10n.ko: 카페 로야디는 한국 전통요소를 응용해 퓨전 디저트를 만드는 수제 디저트 전문점 .
desc_l10n.zh: ROYAD咖啡厅是一间运用韩国传统方式制作创意甜点的手工甜点专卖店。人气商品为迷你年糕蛋糕、雪糕马德莲。另外，使用年糕代替面包制作的年糕三明治是深受忙碌上的班族喜爱的早餐。

description: RoyaD is a homemade dessert shop which uses traditional Korean ingredients to make fusion desserts. Their mini tteok cake and seolgi madeleine are their most popular menu and their tteok sandwiches are well received as a quick breakfast meal among busy businessmen.
name: RoyaD

desc_l10n.en: Located in Namsung Market, Jeongaematdam is a fusion rice cake store that sells traditional rice cakes with a modern twist. Their most popular snacks are injeolmi (rice cake) with grain coating and angbeotteok, red bean and butter rice cake. A variety of freshly made traditional rice cakes are also available every day, giving visitors plenty of options to choose from.
desc_l10n.ja: ナムソン(南城)市場に位置するチョンエマッダムは韓国の伝統料理である餅を現代的な感覚で生まれ変わらせた餅店です。淡白な味のソルギ(蒸しもち)に餡とバターを挟んだあんバター餅が人気。その他にも毎朝、良質な材料で作った餅を販売しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울 남성시장에 있는 한국의 전통음식인 떡에 현대적인 감각을 더한 퓨전 떡집.
desc_l10n.zh: 南城市场的Jeongaematdam(정애맛담)是一家将韩国传统年糕与现代感相结合的创意年糕店。沾着黄豆粉吃的年糕与蒸糕代替面包制作而成的红豆奶油年糕是店里的人气商品。每日早晨严选食材制作的各式年糕，让顾客可以尝到多种美味。

description: Located in Namsung Market, Jeongaematdam is a fusion rice cake store that sells traditional rice cakes with a modern twist. Their most popular snacks are injeolmi (rice cake) with grain coating and angbeotteok, red bean and butter rice cake. A variety of freshly made traditional rice cakes are also available every day, giving visitors plenty of options to choose from.
name: Jeongaematdam

desc_l10n.en: Siroo Cake is a dessert cafe located in Sangsu-dong. They're known for using only Korean rice, milk, and whipped cream in their rice cake menu. Visitors looking for a modern and unique Korean dessert are highly recommended to visit this place. On top of selling delicious rice cakes, they also offer various cooking classes here.
desc_l10n.ja: Siroo Cakeはサンスドン(上水洞)にある餅デザートカフェ。韓国産の米と牛乳、生クリームを使用した餅デザートを販売しています。餅ケーキやマドレーヌ、生チョコは今までにはない感覚のデザートに出会えます。ワンデイ、短期、長期と講習期間を選べるクッキングクラスもあります。
desc_l10n.ko: 시루케이크는 상수에 위치한 떡 디저트 카페.
desc_l10n.zh: SIROO Cake是位于上水站附近的年糕咖啡厅，这里的年糕都是使用韩国国产米制作而成。若想要寻找带有韩国风味的甜点，千万不要错过SIROO Cake。除了出售年糕蛋糕外，还有开设年糕甜点制做的课程(一日、短期、长期)。

description: Siroo Cake is a dessert cafe located in Sangsu-dong. They're known for using only Korean rice, milk, and whipped cream in their rice cake menu. Visitors looking for a modern and unique Korean dessert are highly recommended to visit this place. On top of selling delicious rice cakes, they also offer various cooking classes here.
name: Siroo Cake

desc_l10n.en: Yebindang is a traditional Korean dessert cafe locatd in Seongsu-dong. They're well known for their Duteoptteok (Steamed Rice Cake with Red Bean and Nuts), Kkot Songpyeon (Flower-shaped Rice Cake), and Seolgi (Snow White Rice Cake).
desc_l10n.ja: ソンスドン(聖水洞)に位置するイェビダンは韓国伝統デザートカフェ。宮中の餅であったトゥトプトク(柚子、白小豆、末の実、ナツメ、シナモンなどを使った餅)、花松餅、蒸しもちが代表的なメニュー。
desc_l10n.ko: 예빈당은 성수동에 위치한 한국 전통 디저트 카페.
desc_l10n.zh: 想念的味道是位于圣水洞的韩国传统甜点咖啡厅。宫中流传下来的Duteoptteok、花松饼、蒸雪糕最为出名。 ※ Duteoptteok：韩文为「두텁떡」，指包著油栗子、枣子、柚子、松子等豆馅的年糕。

description: Yebindang is a traditional Korean dessert cafe locatd in Seongsu-dong. They're well known for their Duteoptteok (Steamed Rice Cake with Red Bean and Nuts), Kkot Songpyeon (Flower-shaped Rice Cake), and Seolgi (Snow White Rice Cake).
name: Yebindang

desc_l10n.en: p { text-align: justify; word-spacing: 2px; } Since 1958, the history of the shop, which started at Heungin Mill in Jongno, has been continued by moving to Mangwon-dong. Gyeonggi Tteokjip's founder, whose sons inherited his father's rice cake-making skills, is the second generation to run the business, and one of his sons holds the title of the youngest rice cake master. Their signature product is 'Ittitteok', a North Korean-style injeolmi with a unique shape of a rice cake wrapped around an egg. With the goal of preserving and carrying on the tradition, they have been researching rice cakes as a healthy dessert that modern people can enjoy lightly.
desc_l10n.ja: 1958年から鍾路(チョンノ)の興仁(ヒョンイン)製粉所で始まった店の歴史が、望遠洞に移転して続いている。京畿餅屋の創業者である父の餅製造技術を受け継いだ彼の息子たちが2代目に渡って運営しており、息子の一人は最年少餅名人の称号を持っている。代表商品は「イティトック(이티떡)」で、李北式インジョルミ(인절미)で、あんこが餅を包んでいる独特の形が印象的だ。伝統を守り続けることを目標に、現代人が気軽に楽しめる健康的なデザートとして餅を研究している。
desc_l10n.ko: 최연소 떡 명장이 개발한 이북식 인절미, 이티떡
desc_l10n.zh: 从1958年开始，从钟路的兴仁磨坊开始，搬到了望远洞，延续了该店的历史。Gyeonggi Tteokjip由他的儿子经营，他们继承了父亲的年糕制作技术，其中一个儿子拥有最年轻的年糕大师称号。招牌产品是 "Itteotteok"，这是一种北朝鲜风格的年糕，其独特的形状是年糕包裹着茴香。本着保护和延续传统的目标，公司一直在研究年糕作为现代人可以轻松享受的健康甜点。

description: p { text-align: justify; word-spacing: 2px; } Since 1958, the history of the shop, which started at Heungin Mill in Jongno, has been continued by moving to Mangwon-dong. Gyeonggi Tteokjip's founder, whose sons inherited his father's rice cake-making skills, is the second generation to run the business, and one of his sons holds the title of the youngest rice cake master. Their signature product is 'Ittitteok', a North Korean-style injeolmi with a unique shape of a rice cake wrapped around an egg. With the goal of preserving and carrying on the tradition, they have been researching rice cakes as a healthy dessert that modern people can enjoy lightly.
name: Gyeonggi Tteokjip

desc_l10n.en: This is one of the famous restaurants in Gongdeok-dong's instant tteokbokki street and has been operating for three generations. It has been featured in the Korean restaurant guidebook Blue Ribbon Survey for two consecutive years in 2017 and 2018 because of its delicious taste. After you finish eating the instant tteokbokki, it is a specialty to fry rice with the seasoning. Both the tteokbokki and tempura have long maintained affordable prices.
desc_l10n.ja: 孔徳洞の即席トッポッキ通りで有名なグルメ店の一つで、3代続いている。多くの人に味が認められ、韓国のレストランガイドブック「ブルーリボン調査」に2017年、2018年2年連続で紹介されました。 インスタントトッポッキを食べ終わった後、そのタレでご飯を炒めて食べるのも美味しいです。トッポッキと揚げ物ともに低価格を長く維持している。
desc_l10n.ko: 공덕동에서 3대째 이어지고 있는 떡볶이 맛집
desc_l10n.zh: 这是功德洞即墨铁锅街的著名餐厅之一，已经经营了三代。因为它的美味，它在2017年和2018年连续两年被韩国餐厅指南的蓝丝带调查收录。 吃完即食铁布奇后，可以用调料炒饭。无论是teokbokki还是天妇罗，都长期保持着实惠的价格。

description: This is one of the famous restaurants in Gongdeok-dong's instant tteokbokki street and has been operating for three generations. It has been featured in the Korean restaurant guidebook Blue Ribbon Survey for two consecutive years in 2017 and 2018 because of its delicious taste. After you finish eating the instant tteokbokki, it is a specialty to fry rice with the seasoning. Both the tteokbokki and tempura have long maintained affordable prices.
name: Koggiri

desc_l10n.en: Pimatgol is a food alleyway that extends from Jongno 1-ga to Jongno 6-ga. During the Joseon Dynasty, when commoners walked along the main road and encountered an aristocrat, they had to bow down before them regardless of the circumstances. Finding this bothersome, more and more commoners chose to walk along the alleyways next to the main road. These alleyways would lead and connect to pubs, liquor shops, and gukbap (Rice Soup) stores, becoming a beloved place among commoners, and was aptly named “Pimatgol” a shortened form of “alleyway to avoid the horses”.
desc_l10n.ja: ピマッコルはチョンノ(鍾路)区の鍾路1街から6街まで続くグルメ通りです。朝鮮王朝時代において下級官僚や庶民たちは大通りを身分の高い高官や顕職たちが通る時は、敬意を示すために道の端へ伏せて通り過ぎるのを待たなければなりませんでした。その煩わしさから避けるために、大通りの両側にある細い路地裏を利用しました。この路地裏には居酒屋やジャン・グクパプ(内臓クッパ)の店が並び庶民に愛される場所となり、馬を避ける通りとしてピマッコル(避馬通り)と呼ばれました。
desc_l10n.ko: 피맛골은 종로구 종로1가부터 6가까지 이어진 먹자골목
desc_l10n.zh: 避马街是朝鲜时代平民百姓们为避开贵族走小路而形成的巷子。名称的由来为当时高官贵族都骑乘马匹，百姓为了避开高官贵族的马匹而在此落脚，因此被称为“避马街”。古时避马街范围从钟路1街延伸到6街，但随着城市发展现在仅存一部份。沿着巷子走可以看见许多酒家、汤饭店等餐厅，是深受百姓喜爱的场所。

description: Pimatgol is a food alleyway that extends from Jongno 1-ga to Jongno 6-ga. During the Joseon Dynasty, when commoners walked along the main road and encountered an aristocrat, they had to bow down before them regardless of the circumstances. Finding this bothersome, more and more commoners chose to walk along the alleyways next to the main road. These alleyways would lead and connect to pubs, liquor shops, and gukbap (Rice Soup) stores, becoming a beloved place among commoners, and was aptly named “Pimatgol” a shortened form of “alleyway to avoid the horses”.
name: Pimatgol

desc_l10n.en: Doksuridabang was a dormitory for nearby university students in the 1970s and 80s, a meeting place and a place for public discussion. It originally started as a music room and was loved by literary figures such as novelist Seong Seokje and poet Ki Hyung-do. It was closed in 2005 due to the popularity of coffee shops, but reopened in 2013 by the owner, who is the grandson of the original founder, who promised to continue the history and identity of the place. There is a bulletin board where people used to exchange notes and share news, as well as old photos of the history of the cafe. • This place has been selected as a 'Seoul Future Heritage'. Among Seoul's modern and contemporary cultural heritage, Seoul Future Heritage is a tangible and intangible asset that is worth passing on to future generations.( https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr)
desc_l10n.ja: イーグル喫茶は1970～80年代、近隣の大学生たちのアジトで出会いの場であり、公論の場でした。もともと音楽喫茶店として始まり、小説家ソン・ソクジェ、詩人キ・ヒョンドなどの文人に愛された空間だ。コーヒーショップが盛況になり、経営難に陥ったイーグル喫茶は2005年に閉店したが、2013年に先代創業者の孫である代表がイーグル喫茶の歴史とアイデンティティを継承すると言って再びオープンした。イーグル喫茶店には、メモを交換してニュースを伝えた喫茶店の掲示板と喫茶店の歴史を伝える昔の写真が展示されています。 - ここは「ソウル未来遺産」に選定された場所です。ソウルの近・現代文化遺産の中で、未来世代に伝える価値のある有形・無形の資産であるソウル未来遺産を永続的な旅行でご覧ください( https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr)
desc_l10n.ko: 소설가 성석제, 시인 기형도가 사랑했던 아지트
desc_l10n.zh: Doksuridabang在20世纪70年代和80年代是一个大学生宿舍，是一个聚会场所和公共讨论的地方。它最初是一个音乐茶室，受到小说家Seong Seok-je和诗人Ki Hyung-do等文学界人士的喜爱。由于咖啡馆的成功，Doksuridabang于2005年关闭，并于2013年重新开放，当时老板是原创始人的孙子，他承诺将延续Doksuridabang的历史和身份。咖啡馆有一个公告栏，以前人们在这里交换纸条和分享新闻，还展示了咖啡馆历史的老照片。 • 这里被选为"首尔未来遗产"。 在首尔近现代文化遗产中，可以在老圃旅行中了解一下首尔未来遗产，这是值得传给下一代的有形和无形资产（ https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr ）

description: Doksuridabang was a dormitory for nearby university students in the 1970s and 80s, a meeting place and a place for public discussion. It originally started as a music room and was loved by literary figures such as novelist Seong Seokje and poet Ki Hyung-do. There is a bulletin board where people used to exchange notes and share news, as well as old photos of the history of the cafe. • This place has been selected as a 'Seoul Future Heritage'. Among Seoul's modern and contemporary cultural heritage, Seoul Future Heritage is a tangible and intangible asset that is worth passing on to future generations.( https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr)

desc_l10n.en: Located inside Gongdeok Market, Jokbal Alley is an alley filled with Jokbal stalls and stores. It was first created 30 years ago as more and more people gathered to eat Jokbal and Sundaetguk (Korean Blood Sausage Soup). Many of the stores found in Jokbal Alley has been around for more than 30 years.
desc_l10n.ja: コンドク(孔徳)市場の中にある豚足店通りで、30年前、市場の片隅にあった2坪の食堂が豚足店通りの始まり。当時、厳しい生活をなぐさめる酒のつまみとして豚足とスンデグク(腸詰め入りスープ)を食べ、以後訪れる人が増えたことで豚足店通りが形成されました。コンドク(孔徳)市場の路地には30年を超えて営業する豚足店があちこちにあります。
desc_l10n.ko: 공덕시장 내에 있는 족발 골목.
desc_l10n.zh: 孔德市场猪脚街以前是市场里一间面积约为两坪小餐厅。当时因为生活困苦，所以经常把猪脚和血肠汤作为下酒菜。之后随着客人逐渐增多，店家越聚越多，慢慢形成了现在的猪脚街。猪脚街离有好几家店的历史已超过30年。

description: Located inside Gongdeok Market, Jokbal Alley is an alley filled with Jokbal stalls and stores. It was first created 30 years ago as more and more people gathered to eat Jokbal and Sundaetguk (Korean Blood Sausage Soup). Many of the stores found in Jokbal Alley has been around for more than 30 years.
name: Jokbal Alley

name_l10n.ja: コンドク(孔徳)市場豚足店通り

desc_l10n.en: Located next to Jokbal Alley inside Gongdeok Market, Jeon Alley became famous after appearing on a Korean TV show. After choosing from the wide array of fried food on display by placing selected food into a basket, visitors can pay for their food by weight and be seated in the inner areas to eat their food. On top of common fried food like fried sweet potatoes and fried octopus, visitors can also find unusual fried food like fried potato shrimp, fried shrimp chives jeon, mushroom jeon and much more.
desc_l10n.ja: コンドク(孔徳)市場の中にある豚足店通りの隣にあるチヂミ通りはMBCのバラエティー番組「無限に挑戦」で放送され、一層有名になりました。陳列されているジョン(チヂミ)とティギム(天ぷら)をかごに入れ、量り売りをしています。会計を済ませたジョン(チヂミ)は店内で食べることができます。テハティギム(大正海老の天ぷら)、カムジャマリ・セウティギム(海老のフライドポテト巻き)、セウブチュジョン(エビとにらのチヂミ)、ピョゴジョン(椎茸のチヂミ)などいろいろなティギム(天ぷら)が味わえることができます。
desc_l10n.ko: 공덕시장 내 족발골목 바로 옆에 위치한 전골목은 MBC 예능 프로그램 <무한도전>에 나온 이후 더욱 유명.
desc_l10n.zh: 孔德市场煎饼街位于孔德市场里的猪脚街旁，韩国综艺《无限挑战》来此拍摄后这里变得更加有名。从陈列出来的煎饼和炸物中挑选自己想吃的，秤重结帐后即可到一旁的座位区用餐。除在一般常见炸物外，还有炸虾、炸马铃薯虾卷、韭菜虾煎饼、香菇煎饼等炸物与煎饼。

description: Located next to Jokbal Alley inside Gongdeok Market, Jeon Alley became famous after appearing on a Korean TV show. name: Jeon Alley

name_l10n.ja: コンドク(孔徳)市場チヂミ通り

desc_l10n.en: The first Starbucks store to be created in Korea, Starbucks Coffee Korea 1st Branch is a 3-story store with wide, comfy seating areas. Images of when it first opened its doors back in 1999 are still on display for visitors to browse through.
desc_l10n.ja: 1999年にオープンした韓国で一番古いスターバックスで、3階建ての空間で広々とした空間が好評。店内には開店当時の姿を撮影した写真が展示されています。
desc_l10n.ko: 대한민국에 스타벅스가 가장 처음 생긴 지점
desc_l10n.zh: 韩国的第一间星巴克咖啡厅，一共有三层，店内空间宽敞、座位舒适。1999年星巴克首次进军韩国，店里还展示当年星巴克建筑的照片。

description: The first Starbucks store to be created in Korea, Starbucks Coffee Korea 1st Branch is a 3-story store with wide, comfy seating areas. Images of when it first opened its doors back in 1999 are still on display for visitors to browse through.
name: Starbucks Coffee (Ewha Store)

name_l10n.ja: スターバックス梨大店 (韓国1号店)
name_l10n.zh: 星巴克梨大店（旧韩国1号店）

desc_l10n.en: Peter Pan 1978 is a bakery that has been operating for over 40 years with two generations. The bakery has been in business for two generations and has been learning techniques from French and Japanese artisans to make better bread, and uses naturally fermented seeds imported from France. The bakery uses good ingredients such as organic rye and unrefined sugar, and its breads are popular for their unique names, such as "Baby Bun" and "Bread Stolen by Jang Baljang," and their healthy flavors. The bakery is frequented by both locals and foreigners .
desc_l10n.ja: ピーターパン1978は2代にわたって40年以上運営しているパン屋です。より美味しいパンを研究するため、フランスと日本の職人から技術を学び、フランスから持ち込んだ天然発酵種を使ってパンを作っています。有機ライ麦、非精製砂糖など良い材料を使ってパンを作り、「赤ちゃんのお尻」、「ジャンバルジャンが盗んだパン」などユニークな名前と健康的な味で人気が高い。韓国人はもちろん、外国人もよく訪れるパン屋さんです。
desc_l10n.ko: 프랑스·일본 장인의 기술이 녹아 있는 베이커리
desc_l10n.zh: 小飞侠1978是一家已经经营了40多年的面包店，有两代人。这家面包店在两代人的努力下，一直在向法国和日本的工匠学习技术，以创造更多美味的面包。他们使用良好的原料，如有机黑麦和未精制的糖，他们的面包因其健康的味道和独特的名字而受到欢迎，如 "婴儿面包 "和 "被张百强偷走的面包"。当地人和外国人都经常光顾这家面包店。

desc_l10n.en: Located near the entrance of Hongik University, Cocky Pub Hongdae is a sports pub serving American-styled bar food. Serving from simple snacks to full-sized meals, Cocky Pub attracts many customers interested in watching sport matches. Pretty much an oasis for die-hard sports fans, Cocky Pub also features dart boards, beer pong, shuffle board, and many other recreational games for those not interested in sports. This establishment is frequented by many foreign residents and exchange students studying at nearby universities.
desc_l10n.ja: ホンデ(弘大)正門前にあるCOCKY PUBはアメリカンスタイルのBAR Foodが楽しめるスポーツパブです。軽めのスナックから食事にもなるメイン料理まで提供しています。毎日色々なスポーツの競技を観戦することができ、大きな試合のある日は開店時間を変更するほど、スポーツファンにとってはオアシスの様な店。ビアポンやシャッフルボードなど店内でゲームが楽しめます。韓国在住の外国人の常連客も多く、周辺大学の交換留学生も多く訪れる名所でもあります。
desc_l10n.ko: 홍대 정문 앞에 위치한 코키펍은 아메리칸 스타일의 BAR Food를 즐길 수 있는 스포츠펍.
desc_l10n.zh: 位于弘益大学正门旁的COCKY PUB是一间美式风格的运动酒吧，不仅提供轻食、点心，也提供一般餐点服务。在COCKY PUB每天都可以观看各种运动比赛，若遇上重要赛事，店家更会调整营业时间，让运动迷们可以尽情观战。此外，店内还有射飞镖、投杯球(Beer Pong)、沙狐球(Shuffleboard)等游戏，不看比赛的人也能享受游戏乐趣。许多居住在韩国的外国人、交换学生是COCKY PUB的常客。

Serving from simple snacks to full-sized meals, Cocky Pub attracts many customers interested in watching sport matches. Pretty much an oasis for die-hard sports fans, Cocky Pub also features dart boards, beer pong, shuffle board, and many other recreational games for those not interested in sports. This establishment is frequented by many foreign residents and exchange students studying at nearby universities.
name: Cocky Pub Hongdae

name_l10n.ja: COCKY PUB ホンデ(弘大)店

desc_l10n.en: Located in Itaewon, Sam Ryan's Sports Bar & Girl is a Western-style sports pub where customers can enjoy live sport channels with snacks and beer. At this Itaewon sports pub, visitors can enjoy watching a variety of sports or play beer pong, battle ship, shuffle board, and more in the gaming area. A place to enjoy beer and simple snacks at an unbeatable price, Sam Ryan's Sports Bar & Grill is a popular establishment frequented by both Korean and foreign customers.
desc_l10n.ja: Sam Ryan'sはイテウォン(梨泰院)の中心に位置するウェスタンスタイルのスポーツパブで、様々なスポーツチャンネルとともにグルメやビールを楽しむことができます。 イテウォン(梨泰院)の代表的なスポーツパブでビアポン、バトルショット、シャッフルボード、スピンなどのゲーム空間もあります。リーズナブルな価格でビールとともに軽食メニューとメインメニューを味わうことができます。韓国在住の外国人にも人気が高いパブです。
desc_l10n.ko: 이태원 중심에 위치한 웨스턴 스타일 스포츠펍.
desc_l10n.zh: Sam Ryan’s是位于梨泰院的西式运动酒吧，店内设有多个电视屏幕，让运动迷们可以在此观看各种运动比赛。此外，店内还规划了射飞镖、投杯球(Beer Pong)、沙狐球(Shuffleboard)等游戏空间。Sam Ryan’s以合理的价格提供啤酒、点心与餐点，让来访的顾客可以毫无负担的尽情享受。除了韩国人，海洋许多居住在韩的外国人也经常到访。

description: Located in Itaewon, Sam Ryan's Sports Bar & Girl is a Western-style sports pub where customers can enjoy live sport channels with snacks and beer. At this Itaewon sports pub, visitors can enjoy watching a variety of sports or play beer pong, battle ship, shuffle board, and more in the gaming area. A place to enjoy beer and simple snacks at an unbeatable price, Sam Ryan's Sports Bar & Grill is a popular establishment frequented by both Korean and foreign customers.
name: Sam Ryan's Sports Bar & Grill (Itaewon)

desc_l10n.en: A must-visit spot for foodies in Seoul, Sillim-dong Sundae Town is the place to go for sundae (Korean Sausage). Often frequented by nearby businessmen looking for a hearty dinner, this area is also located near various facilities like shopping centers and a movie theater, making it a very popular date spot among couples as well.
desc_l10n.ja: ソウルで必見のグルメタウンで有名なシンリムドン(新林洞)スンデタウンでは独自のスンデ(豚の腸詰め)を味わうことができます。飲み会の場所としてシンリムドン(新林洞)スンデタウンは会社員の間で人気が高く、周辺にはショッピング、映画館など多様な文化施設があるので、デートコースとしても人気があります 。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울에서 꼭 가봐야 할 먹거리 타운으로 유명한 신림동 순대타운.
desc_l10n.zh: 新林洞血肠城为首尔必访的美食城之一，在这里可以尝到最道地的辣炒血肠，其中又以白血肠最为出名。血肠城周围还有购物商场、电影院等各种文化设施，因此许多韩国情侣、上班族都会选择到此约会、聚餐。

description: A must-visit spot for foodies in Seoul, Sillim-dong Sundae Town is the place to go for sundae (Korean Sausage). Often frequented by nearby businessmen looking for a hearty dinner, this area is also located near various facilities like shopping centers and a movie theater, making it a very popular date spot among couples as well.
name: Sillim-dong Sundae Town

name_l10n.ja: シンリムドン(新林洞)スンデタウン

desc_l10n.en: Jangchung-dong Jokbal Alley is one of the many must-visit alleyways in Seoul. Jangchung-dong became famous for its jokbal (Pig's feet) because of Jangchung Arena. In the past, most sporting events or concerts were held at Jangchung Arena. This lead to an influx of people who'd go and stop by nearby jokbal restaurants after the match or concert, eventually coming to create what is known as Jokbal Alley today. This area continues to attract many visitors even today with its delicious jokbal and side menus like bindae-tteok (Mung Bean Pancake) and pajeon (Green Onion Pancake).
desc_l10n.ja: チャンチュンドン(奨忠洞)豚足通りはソウルで必見のグルメ通りです。チャンチュンドン(奨忠洞)が豚足で有名になったのは、以前スポーツ競技の試合はほとんどチャンチュン(奨忠)体育館で行われ、試合やコンサートの終了後、観覧客は近くの豚足店に直行したことから。チャンチュン(奨忠)体育館を多くの人が訪れることで豚足通りも活性化されました。当時より数十年間、味がよくボリュームもある豚足でずっと愛され続けています。豚足を注文すると出てくるピンデトクやねぎのチヂミなどのメニューも楽しめます。
desc_l10n.ko: 장충동 족발골목은 서울에서 꼭 가봐야 할 먹거리 골목.
desc_l10n.zh: 奖忠洞猪脚街是首尔必访的猪脚街之一。过去许多运动比赛都在奖忠体育馆进行，比赛或表演结束后大家都会直接到旁边的猪脚店吃饭。随着越来越多人到奖忠体育馆看比赛，旁边的猪脚街也跟着兴盛起来，因而闻名。数十年来，奖忠洞猪脚街的猪脚美味依旧，深受人们的喜爱。这里除了猪脚，还有绿豆煎饼、葱煎饼。

description: Jangchung-dong Jokbal Alley is one of the many must-visit alleyways in Seoul. Jangchung-dong became famous for its jokbal (Pig's feet) because of Jangchung Arena. In the past, most sporting events or concerts were held at Jangchung Arena. This lead to an influx of people who'd go and stop by nearby jokbal restaurants after the match or concert, eventually coming to create what is known as Jokbal Alley today. This area continues to attract many visitors even today with its delicious jokbal and side menus like bindae-tteok (Mung Bean Pancake) and pajeon (Green Onion Pancake).
name: Jangchung-dong Jokbal Alley

name_l10n.ja: チャンチュンドン(奨忠洞)豚足通り

desc_l10n.en: Famille Station is a space of trendy, delicious restaurants all gathered in one place. Attracting many trendsetters with various brand names and diverse cuisine, Famille Station has been built to look like New York's Grand Central Station, incorporating both tradition and modern elements in its design. Consisting of three floors, the first floor is made up of popular restaurants while the second and third floor is made up of a beauty salon and cafes.
desc_l10n.ja: ファミエステーション(Famille Station)は韓国有名グルメ店が集まった空間です。トレンドセッターが訪れるホットプレイスで、口コミで広まったグルメ店と健康食材にこだわる店まで新しい味と体験ができるスポットです。ニューヨークのセントラル駅のような伝統的な駅舎をテーマに設計され、伝統とモダンさが調和を成す空間で、グルメを楽しむことができます。1階には韓国内外の口コミで広まったグルメ店、2階及び3階には美容サロン、カフェなどが入った総3階で構成されています。
desc_l10n.ko: 내로라하는 국내 맛집을 한곳에 모아놓은 전 세계 다양한 맛의 공간
desc_l10n.zh: Famille Station将韩国知名美食店汇集在一起，是一处可以品尝世界饮食的全新空间。人气美食店、严选健康食材的美食品牌都能在此找到。建筑物的设计如同纽约中央车站，以传统风格为主，并融合现代感在其中。Famille Station共有3层楼，1楼为韩国国内外美食店，2楼与3楼则为咖啡厅与美容沙龙。

description: Famille Station is a space of trendy, delicious restaurants all gathered in one place. Attracting many trendsetters with various brand names and diverse cuisine, Famille Station has been built to look like New York's Grand Central Station, incorporating both tradition and modern elements in its design. Consisting of three floors, the first floor is made up of popular restaurants while the second and third floor is made up of a beauty salon and cafes.
name: Famille Station

name_l10n.ja: ファミエステーション(Famille Station)

desc_l10n.en: Attracting many visitors with large servings and low cost, Seongsu-dong Galbi Alley is the place to go for galbi (grilled ribs). The creation of a racetrack back in the 70s brought an influx of galbi restaurants around the area of Seongsu-dong, bringing this alley to become what it is today. Serving pork ribs with various side dishes, each restaurant offers slightly different tasting galbi due to their own special marinating sauce and methods.
desc_l10n.ja: ソンスドン(聖水洞)カルビ通りは安価でボリュームたっぷりの量のカルビが楽しめる人気のあるグルメ通りです。1970年代、ソンスドン(聖水洞)に競馬場が建設されてから、周辺にカルビ店が増えたのをきっかけに40年の歴史を持つスポットです。テジガルビ(豚カルビ)のほか、サービスのおかずで有名です。また店舗ごとに肉の味付けが違うので好みに合った店を探す楽しみがあります。
desc_l10n.ko: 성수동 갈비 골목은 저렴하고 푸짐한 양으로 사람들의 발길을 이끄는 먹자 골목.
desc_l10n.zh: 圣水洞排骨街是一条以餐点价格经济实惠、量多而闻名美食街。70年代赛马场进驻圣水洞后，排骨店生意跟着兴盛起来，至今已有40年的历史。除了猪排骨之外，爽口的小菜也非常出名。每个店家的排骨酱料都有些许不同，可以根据自己的口味喜好选择店家。

description: Attracting many visitors with large servings and low cost, Seongsu-dong Galbi Alley is the place to go for galbi (grilled ribs). The creation of a racetrack back in the 70s brought an influx of galbi restaurants around the area of Seongsu-dong, bringing this alley to become what it is today. Serving pork ribs with various side dishes, each restaurant offers slightly different tasting galbi due to their own special marinating sauce and methods.
name: Seongsu-dong Galbi Alley

name_l10n.ja: ソンスドン(聖水洞)カルビ通り

desc_l10n.en: p { text-align: justify; word-spacing: 2px; } Kim Yong-an Patisserie has been in business since 1967. The founder Kim Yong-an's know-how in making sweets has made it possible for people to enjoy delicious hot pot to this day. Senbei was made by following the Japanese confectionery technology to make a living during the Japanese occupation, but there is a clear difference in the way they have been reborn under the hands of the owner. Since its opening, the shop has maintained its flavor with good ingredients and craftsmanship from father to son, and today it still produces savory and crispy sweets with an eggy flavor.
desc_l10n.ja: 1967 年 から 続 いているキム・ヨンヨンアン ( 金龍安 ) 安座店 は 三角地 のチョンビョン ( 전병 ) 店 だ 。 創業者 キム・ヨンアンのノウハウが 詰 まった 菓子型 は 、 今日 まで 美味 しいチョンビョンを 楽 しむことができるようになりました 。 日本統治時代 に 生計 を 立 てるために 日本人 のお 菓子技術 を 真似 て 作 ったのが 煎餅 と 言 われていますが 、 社長 の 手 によって 生 まれ 変 わったので 、 明確 な 違 いがあります 。 オープン 以来 、 良 い 材料 で 父 から 息子 へと 受 け 継 がれ 、 職人技 で 味 を 守 り 続 けているお 店 で 、 今日 も 卵 の 香 りが 漂 う 香 ばしくサクサクのお 菓子 が 生産 されています 。
desc_l10n.ko: 옛 방식으로 정성껏 만드는 전병
desc_l10n.zh: Kim Yong-an Confectionery自1967年以来一直存在。创始人金永安制作糖果的诀窍使人们至今仍能享受到美味的火锅。据说，在日本占领时期，为了谋生而复制了日本糖果的技术，但与老板制作的糖果有明显区别。自开业以来，该店一直以优质的原料和工艺保持其口味，从父亲到儿子，如今该店生产的糖果咸香酥脆，有蛋香味。

description: p { text-align: justify; word-spacing: 2px; } Kim Yong-an Patisserie has been in business since 1967. The founder Kim Yong-an's know-how in making sweets has made it possible for people to enjoy delicious hot pot to this day. Senbei was made by following the Japanese confectionery technology to make a living during the Japanese occupation, but there is a clear difference in the way they have been reborn under the hands of the owner. Since its opening, the shop has maintained its flavor with good ingredients and craftsmanship from father to son, and today it still produces savory and crispy sweets with an eggy flavor.
name: Kim Yong-an Patisserie

name_l10n.ja: 金容安(キム・ヨンアン)菓子店

desc_l10n.en: p{text-align:justify;word-spacing:2px;} Kervan Itaewon Branch is a Turkish restaurant serving food made with Halal-certified ingredients. It is a popular date spot due to its great atmosphere.
desc_l10n.ja: ケルバンテウォン(梨泰院)店はハラール公式認証レスストランで、トルコ人シェフが腕をふるっています。雰囲気が良く、イテウォン(梨泰院)のデートコースとしても人気が高い。
desc_l10n.ko: 케르반 이태원점은 정식 할랄 인증을 받은 레스토랑으로 터키 요리사가 직접 요리.
desc_l10n.zh: Kervan梨泰院店是正式获得清真认证的土耳其料理餐厅，由土耳其厨师亲自掌厨。餐厅气氛佳，许多到梨泰院游玩的人，都会顺便到此用餐。

description: p{text-align:justify;word-spacing:2px;} Kervan Itaewon Branch is a Turkish restaurant serving food made with Halal-certified ingredients. It is a popular date spot due to its great atmosphere.
name: Kervan Itaewon Branch

desc_l10n.en: Owned by an Iranian, PB Plus is a restaurant serving pizza and burgers made with Halal-certified ingredients. Serving big portions at a reasonable price, Pizza Burgers Plus is a popular place among diners. Their signature menu is their Special Beef Slices Burger, a delicious savory burger that never gets old.
desc_l10n.ja: Pizza Burger Plusはイラン人オーナーがハラール認証を受けた材料で作ったバーガーとピザを提供しています。手頃な価格でボリュームたっぷりの量と美味しい味が楽しめるようにしています。代表メニューであるスペシャルビーフスライスバーガーは飽きのこない味で人気です。
desc_l10n.ko: 이란인 주인이 할랄 인증 재료를 이용한 버거와 피자.
desc_l10n.zh: PB Plus的老板是来自伊朗的穆斯林，店里贩售的汉堡与披萨都是使用清真认证的食材。便宜的价格、丰盛的量以及美味，吸引许多人的光顾。特制牛肉片汉堡是招牌餐点，味道清爽，就算常吃也不会感到腻口。

description: Owned by an Iranian, PB Plus is a restaurant serving pizza and burgers made with Halal-certified ingredients. Serving big portions at a reasonable price, Pizza Burgers Plus is a popular place among diners. Their signature menu is their Special Beef Slices Burger, a delicious savory burger that never gets old.
name: PB Plus

desc_l10n.en: Located in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, Bombay Grill Itaewon is a restaurant serving Indian and Pakistani cuisine. Using only the freshest ingredients, Bombay Grill Itaewon offers a great selection of Indian and Pakistani dishes, providing a wonderfully exotic dining experience to its visitors.
desc_l10n.ja: Bombay Grill 梨泰院店では、インド料理専門店で現地人シェフが調理し、インド料理本来の味を楽しむことができます。健康的な食文化のため、新鮮な素材を使用し、リラックスして楽しい食事を楽しめるよう最高のサービスを提供できるように努力しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 인도음식 전문점. 현지인셰프가 직접 음식을 조리.
desc_l10n.zh: 印度料理专卖店Bombay Grill位于首尔市龙山区，在此可品尝由来自印度厨师亲自料理的印度餐点。为了打造健康的饮食文化，Bombay Grill选用最新鲜的食材，并提供优质服务，让顾客享受舒适的用餐环境。

description: Located in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, Bombay Grill Itaewon is a restaurant serving Indian and Pakistani cuisine. Using only the freshest ingredients, Bombay Grill Itaewon offers a great selection of Indian and Pakistani dishes, providing a wonderfully exotic dining experience to its visitors.
name: Bombay Grill Itaewon

desc_l10n.en: A popular restaurant in Samseong-dong COEX, Kervan is a Halal-certified Turkish restaurant. Serving hard to find Turkish cuisine in Korea, Kervan COEX Branch also boasts of a pretty interior made with Turkish lamps and tiles.
desc_l10n.ja: サムソンドン(三成洞)コエックス(COEX)の美味しい店として有名なKervanはハラール公式認証を受けたトルコ料理レストランです。韓国では珍しいトルコ料理を味わうことができ、店内インテリアはトルコの文化が感じられる華やかな照明とタイルで装飾されており、見るのも楽しいレストランです。
desc_l10n.ko: 삼성동 코엑스 맛집으로 유명한 케르반은  정식 할랄 인증을 받은 터키 레스토랑.
desc_l10n.zh: 三成洞COEX知名的KERVAN是获得正式清真认证的土耳其餐厅。在此可以品尝到道地的土耳其料理。餐厅内部设计透过华丽的灯饰与瓷砖艺术，完整呈现土耳其文化风格 。

description: A popular restaurant in Samseong-dong COEX, Kervan is a Halal-certified Turkish restaurant. Serving hard to find Turkish cuisine in Korea, Kervan COEX Branch also boasts of a pretty interior made with Turkish lamps and tiles.
name: Kervan COEX Branch

desc_l10n.en: Starting as a food truck in New York City, The Halal Guys offer delicious servings of halal food on a platter or inside a sandwich. All branches of The Halal Guys coming into Korea are Halal-certified and serve food made with Halal ingredients.
desc_l10n.ja: ハラールフードのブランド、The Halal Guysはニューヨークでフードトラックからサンドウィッチを販売したのを始まりに立ち上げたブランドで、シンプルながらも栄養豊富なプラッターとサンドウィッチを提供しています。韓国のThe Halal Guysではアメリカから空輸されたすべて認証を受けた材料を使用しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 뉴욕의 푸드트럭으로 시작한 브랜드. 간편하면서도 영양소를 고루 갖춘 플래터와 샌드위치
desc_l10n.zh: 清真餐饮品牌THE HALAL GUYS是从纽约餐车起家，以贩售简单又营养的中东式盖饭(PLATTERS)及三明治为主。韩国开设的THE HALAL GUYS皆经过穆斯林自我认证，并且使用美国空运来的清真食材制作 。

description: Starting as a food truck in New York City, The Halal Guys offer delicious servings of halal food on a platter or inside a sandwich. All branches of The Halal Guys coming into Korea are Halal-certified and serve food made with Halal ingredients.
name: The Halal Guys Itaewon Branch

name_l10n.ja: The Halal Guys 梨泰院店

desc_l10n.en: Kervan is a chain of restaurants which serves Halal, or "permitted" food. As a Halal-certified restaurant, Kervan offers Turkish food made by a Turkish chef. The interiors is also adorned with various Turkish decorations, lending an exotic atmosphere to the restaurant.
desc_l10n.ja: Kervanは「許されている食べ物」という意味のハラルフードをメインにするブランドです。Kervanはハラルフード専門店で、トルコ人シェフが調理した料理を楽しむことができます。店内インテリアはトルコ式に装飾されており、エキゾチックな雰囲気が感じられます。
desc_l10n.ko: 케르반은 '허락된 음식'이라는 의미의 할랄푸드를 메인으로 하는 브랜드
desc_l10n.zh: KERVAN意旨“被允许的食物”，是一间以清真饮食为主的餐厅品牌。在此可以品尝到道地的土耳其料理。餐厅内部设计透过华丽的灯饰与瓷砖艺术，完整呈现土耳其文化风格。

description: Kervan is a chain of restaurants which serves Halal, or "permitted" food. As a Halal-certified restaurant, Kervan offers Turkish food made by a Turkish chef. The interiors is also adorned with various Turkish decorations, lending an exotic atmosphere to the restaurant.
name: Kervan Famille Station Branch

name_l10n.ja: Kervan ファミエステーション店

desc_l10n.en: Kervan Banpo Branch is a Halal restaurant located inside Shinsegae Department Store. A restaurant to enjoy Turkish food made by a Turkish chef, Kervan's interiors is also adorned with various Turkish decorations, lending an exotic atmosphere to the restaurant.
desc_l10n.ja: Kervan 盤浦店は新世界百貨店カンナム(カンナム)店に位置するハラールレストランです。トルコ人シェフが調理をし、様々なデザートも一緒に楽しむことができるレストランです。店内インテリアはトルコ式に装飾されており、エキゾチックな雰囲気が感じられます。
desc_l10n.ko: 케르반 반포점은 신세계몰에 위치한 할랄 음식점.
desc_l10n.zh: KERVAN盘浦店是位于新世界百货B1的清真饮食店。由来自土耳其的厨师亲自掌厨，可以品尝多种道地的土耳其料理。餐厅装潢以土耳其风格为主，充满异国情调。

description: Kervan Banpo Branch is a Halal restaurant located inside Shinsegae Department Store. A restaurant to enjoy Turkish food made by a Turkish chef, Kervan's interiors is also adorned with various Turkish decorations, lending an exotic atmosphere to the restaurant.
name: Kervan Banpo Branch

desc_l10n.en: Kervan Bakery sells traditional Turkish desserts made by a Turkish pastry chef. The bakery's displays are filled with a variety of Turkish pastries and desserts, such as Turkish delights, Baklava, pudding, jam, and more.
desc_l10n.ja: Kervan Bakeryはトルコ出身のパティシエが伝統的なトルコ式デザートを作り販売している店です。ロクム、バクラヴァなど口の中でとろけるデザートからトルコ式プディング、ジャム、多様なパンがスタンドをにぎやかにしています。
desc_l10n.ko: 케르반 베이커리는 터키 출신 파티셰가 전통 터키식 디저트를 만들어 파는 곳.
desc_l10n.zh: KERVAN Bakery专门出售由土耳其糕点师傅制作的土耳其传统甜点。土耳其面包、入口即化的土耳其软糖与果仁蜜饼，还有土耳其果冻、布丁、果酱等都可以在此买到。

description: Kervan Bakery sells traditional Turkish desserts made by a Turkish pastry chef. The bakery's displays are filled with a variety of Turkish pastries and desserts, such as Turkish delights, Baklava, pudding, jam, and more.
name: Kervan Bakery

desc_l10n.en: A restaurant famous for their maeuntang ( a spicy fish stew cooked with freshly caught catfish, Mandarin fish, and freshwater fish) in Gangdong-gu, Namhangang Maeuntang uses fish caught by fishermen in Gyeonggi-do, Yanggu and Gangwondo, Yangpeong to make their refreshingly spicy fish stew. Using a special seasoning made together with a food engineering professor in Korea National University of Transportation, the restaurant offers a special type of Mauentang that will not only prevent illness, but offers a tasty fish stew for visitors who love to eat fish.
desc_l10n.ja: ソウル市カンドン(江東)区のグルメとして評判のナムハンガン(南漢江)メウンタンでは京畿道ヤンピョン(楊平)で養殖されたナマズと江原道ヤング(楊口)郡の天然淡水魚と淡水カニを素材にしたメウンタン(魚の辛味スープ)を味わうことができます。 ナムハンガン(南漢江)メウンタンでは国立韓国交通大学校の食品工学科教授と共同開発したシーズニングを使用し、成人病予防に効果のあるメウンタンを提供しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 경기도 양평에서 양식한 메기, 강원도 양구군의 자연산 민물고기로 만든 매운탕집.
desc_l10n.zh: 江东区美食店“南汉江辣鱼汤”的辣鱼汤，选用京畿道杨平养殖场的鲶鱼、江原道杨口郡渔夫亲自捕捞的天然淡水鱼及河蟹料理而成，汤头又辣又爽口。店家与国立韩国交通大学食品科学教授共同开发调味料，料理出能够预防各种成人病、对健康有益的辣鱼汤。不仅吸引的喜爱鱼类料理的各国游客前来品尝，也再次向世界宣传的韩国料理。

description: A restaurant famous for their maeuntang ( a spicy fish stew cooked with freshly caught catfish, Mandarin fish, and freshwater fish) in Gangdong-gu, Namhangang Maeuntang uses fish caught by fishermen in Gyeonggi-do, Yanggu and Gangwondo, Yangpeong to make their refreshingly spicy fish stew. Using a special seasoning made together with a food engineering professor in Korea National University of Transportation, the restaurant offers a special type of Mauentang that will not only prevent illness, but offers a tasty fish stew for visitors who love to eat fish.
name: Namhangang Maeuntang

name_l10n.ja: ナムハンガン(南漢江)メウンタン

desc_l10n.en: Seolnun is a Korean restaurant specialized in Pyeongyang Naengmyeon dishes. A restaurant operated by a North Korean chef, Seolnun is a great place for visitors to try out and enjoy North Korean food. Also known for their delicious dumplings, nokdujeon (mung bean pancakes), and suyuk (boiled pork slices), Seolnun was featured on various TV programs.
desc_l10n.ja: ソルヌンはピョンヤン・ネンミョン(平壌式冷麺)専門店です。北朝鮮から移住してきたピョンヤン・コリョ(平壌・高麗)ホテルのシェフが調理し、ソウルで北朝鮮料理を味わうことあができます。また、マンドゥ(餃子)、緑豆のチヂミ、スユク(ゆで肉)などのメニューが評判となりテレビ番組で紹介されたこともあります。
desc_l10n.ko: 설눈은 한국의 전통 음식 평양냉면 전문점
desc_l10n.zh: Sulnoon是韩国传统饮食平壤冷面专卖店。由曾为北韩平壤高丽饭店的厨师亲自掌厨，制作北韩料理。除了平壤冷面，还有北韩式水饺、绿豆饼、白切肉等餐点。美味又道地的Sulnoon，也曾被电视节目采访过

description: Seolnun is a Korean restaurant specialized in Pyeongyang Naengmyeon dishes. A restaurant operated by a North Korean chef, Seolnun is a great place for visitors to try out and enjoy North Korean food. Also known for their delicious dumplings, nokdujeon (mung bean pancakes), and suyuk (boiled pork slices), Seolnun was featured on various TV programs.
name: Seolnun

desc_l10n.en: p { text-align: justify; word-spacing: 2px; } Hamcho Ganjang Gejang is a Korean seafood restaurant specializing in a soy-sauce marinated crab dish called Ganjang-gejang. They are most famous for their Ganjang-gejang marinated in a special type of fermented herb soy sauce. A restaurant with a traditionally Korean atmosphere, Hamcho Ganjang Gejang is a popular attraction among foreign tourists and has their menu available in Chinese, Japanese, and English.
desc_l10n.ja: 多くのテレビ番組で紹介されたカンジャンケジャン(カニの醤油漬け)、海鮮韓国料理店です。アッケシソウ(厚岸草)を発酵させて作った醤油を使ったカンジャンケジャンが人気メニューです。店内は韓国的な雰囲気で、外国人観光客も多く訪れます。メニューには日本語、中国語の表記と英語での説明がそえられています。
desc_l10n.ko: 다양한 방송매체에 소개된 간장게장, 해물요리 한식당.
desc_l10n.zh: 咸草酱蟹餐厅是韩式海鲜料理餐厅，接受过许多媒体的采访。使用发酵酱油制作的酱蟹是店里的招牌料理。餐厅装潢充满韩国特色，为服务外国顾客，同时准备了中文、日文菜单，并标有英文说明。

description: p { text-align: justify; word-spacing: 2px; } Hamcho Ganjang Gejang is a Korean seafood restaurant specializing in a soy-sauce marinated crab dish called Ganjang-gejang. They are most famous for their Ganjang-gejang marinated in a special type of fermented herb soy sauce. A restaurant with a traditionally Korean atmosphere, Hamcho Ganjang Gejang is a popular attraction among foreign tourists and has their menu available in Chinese, Japanese, and English.
name: Hamcho Ganjang Gejang

name_l10n.ja: ハムチョ・カンジャンケジャン

desc_l10n.en: Leaving out common allergen like egg, milk, and butter, Ooh Breado makes their bread using healthy domestically grown ingredients like rice, brown rice, and organic flour. Their signature menu is their "Sweet Pumpkin Cube," a flour-less bread made with a dough mixture of rice, brown rice, organic whole wheat, and other healthy ingredients, filled with pumpkin puree and red bean paste, topped with almond streusel.
desc_l10n.ja: OOH!ブレッドのパンはアレルギーを引き起こす可能性がある卵、牛乳、バターを使用せず、韓国産の米、玄米、有機農法で作った小麦粉でパンを作っているのが特徴です。小麦粉不使用で韓国産の白米と黒米で作った生地にカボチャのピューレとあんが入った「カボチャキューブ」がシグニチャーパンです。
desc_l10n.ko: 국내산 쌀, 현미, 유기농 우리밀 등 건강한 재료를 사용하는 것이 특징.
desc_l10n.zh: 禹富来道面包的特色是不使用容易过敏的鸡蛋、牛奶及奶油，并选用韩国产的米、玄米、有机农小麦等健康材料来制作。使用韩国产的白米与黑米制作的外皮中，加入满满的南瓜泥与红豆泥，最后在撒上杏仁菠萝酥烘焙而成的“南瓜方块面包”是店里的招牌。

description: Leaving out common allergen like egg, milk, and butter, Ooh Breado makes their bread using healthy domestically grown ingredients like rice, brown rice, and organic flour. Their signature menu is their "Sweet Pumpkin Cube," a flour-less bread made with a dough mixture of rice, brown rice, organic whole wheat, and other healthy ingredients, filled with pumpkin puree and red bean paste, topped with almond streusel.
name: Ooh Breado

desc_l10n.en: Gurkha Restaurant is a restaurant specializing in Indian and Nepalese food. Serving delicious curry, naan, tandoori chicken, lassi, and other Indian and Nepalese food, this restaurant is the perfect place to go for authentic tasting exotic food.
desc_l10n.ja: Gurkha Indian Restaurantは外国人シェフが運営し、料理するインド・ネパール伝統料理専門店です。カレー、ナン、タンドリーチキン、ラッシーはもちろん、その他のインド・ネパール料理の特別な味わいを提供しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 현지인이 직접 운영하며, 조리하는 인도, 네팔 전통음식 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: Gurkha Indian Restaurant为专门贩售印度、尼泊尔传统料理的餐厅，由当地人亲自经营与掌厨。印度咖哩、印度烤饼(NAAN)、印度烤鸡、印度优格拉西(Lassi)等各种印度与尼泊尔料理都可以在此品尝到。

description: Gurkha Restaurant is a restaurant specializing in Indian and Nepalese food. Serving delicious curry, naan, tandoori chicken, lassi, and other Indian and Nepalese food, this restaurant is the perfect place to go for authentic tasting exotic food.
name: Gurkha Restaurant

desc_l10n.en: p { text-align: justify; word-spacing: 2px; } Byeolnan Ori is a restaurant specialized in duck cuisiune. The restaurant serves mainly two dishes called Electric Smoked Duck (smoked duck) and Special Duck (spicy duck soup). Customers can also order half and half, trying both the smoked duckand spicyduck soup and finish off the meal with a tidying-over of fried rice to complete their course.
desc_l10n.ja: ピョルナンオリはトンデムン(東大門)にある鴨肉料理専門店です。メニューには電気燻製鴨肉、ピョルナン鴨肉スープの2種類があり、1/2羽ずつセットで注文することもできます。しめにはポクンバプ(チャーハン)もできます。
desc_l10n.ko: 별난오리는 동대문에 위치한 오리요리 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: Byeolnan Ori是位于东大门的鸭类料理餐厅。店内餐点非常简单，只有熏鸭及辣味鸭肉汤两种，可各点半只来品尝。若有点鸭肉汤，最后记得留一些汤汁请老板用剩剩汤汁炒饭，美味可口。

description: p { text-align: justify; word-spacing: 2px; } Byeolnan Ori is a restaurant specialized in duck cuisiune. The restaurant serves mainly two dishes called Electric Smoked Duck (smoked duck) and Special Duck (spicy duck soup). Customers can also order half and half, trying both the smoked duckand spicyduck soup and finish off the meal with a tidying-over of fried rice to complete their course.
name: Byeolnan Ori (Duck Cuisine)

desc_l10n.en: p { text-align: justify; word-spacing: 2px; } The only restaurant to be directly run by the Jogye Order of Korean Buddism, Balwoo Gongyang is a Michelin starred restaurant serving authentic temple cuisine. Serving authentic temple food made with traditional recipes passed down through temples, Balwoo Gongyang is a place to not only enjoy the taste of temple food but also experience the tradition and culture of temple food.
desc_l10n.ja: パルコンヤン(鉢孟供養)は曹渓宗で唯一運営されてる精進料理専門店で、ミシュランガイドにも紹介されました。パルコンヤン(鉢孟供養)の多様なメニューは寺院で伝承されている伝統的なレシピで作られてきた精進料理の原型が残る料理です。パルコンヤン(鉢孟供養)では精進料理の伝統と文化を料理とともに楽しむことができます。
desc_l10n.ko: 발우공양은 대한불교 조계종에서 유일하게 직접 운영하는 사찰 음식 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 钵孟供养是大韩佛教曹溪宗唯一直接经营的寺院饮食专门店，一举获得了2019米其林首尔指南一星。这里所提供的寺院饮食皆遵循寺院传统料理方法制作而成。在钵孟供养用餐可同时体验寺院饮食的传统与文化。

description: p { text-align: justify; word-spacing: 2px; } The only restaurant to be directly run by the Jogye Order of Korean Buddism, Balwoo Gongyang is a Michelin starred restaurant serving authentic temple cuisine. Serving authentic temple food made with traditional recipes passed down through temples, Balwoo Gongyang is a place to not only enjoy the taste of temple food but also experience the tradition and culture of temple food.
name: Balwoo Gongyang

name_l10n.ja: パルコンヤン(鉢孟供養)

desc_l10n.en: Kali is an Indian restaurant serving authentic Indian food made by local Indian chefs. A popular restaurant where there’s already a line forming outside by the end of lunch break, Kali boasts of an unique and exotic-looking interior decorated with props and accessories gathered and collected by the owner on his travels to India, Nepal, and Tibet over the years.
desc_l10n.ja: カーリー(Kali)はインドより招聘した現地のシェフが調理するインド料理専門店です。ブレイクタイム直前に行ってもウェイティングがあるほどの人気店です。数年間、インド、ネパール、チベットをバックパッカーをしながら収集した置物が、店内のエキゾチックな雰囲気を醸し出しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 깔리는 인도에서 직접 초빙한 현지인 요리사들이 조리하는 인도 음식 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: Kali是一间直接聘请当地厨师烹饪的印度料理专门店，非常受欢迎。即使在午休时间结束后立刻前往，也有可能需要排队。老板将数年间前往印度、尼泊尔、西藏旅行时收集的装饰品拿来布置，让店里充满了异国情调。

description: Kali is an Indian restaurant serving authentic Indian food made by local Indian chefs. A popular restaurant where there’s already a line forming outside by the end of lunch break, Kali boasts of an unique and exotic-looking interior decorated with props and accessories gathered and collected by the owner on his travels to India, Nepal, and Tibet over the years.
name: Kali

desc_l10n.en: Couscous is a Seochon-based restaurant serving Tunisian and North African dishes. A place to try out staple Tunisian dishes, a rare find in Korea, this place is highly recommended for diners wanting to expand their taste palate. Various Tunisian set meals are available at a price range from 16,000 won to 35,000 won.
desc_l10n.ja: Couscous Tunisian Home Kitchenはソチョン(西村)にある北アフリカのチュニジア伝統料理店です。珍しいチュニジア料理を味わえるレストランで、16,000ウォン～35,000ウォンの価格帯で様々なチュニジアンセットを提供しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 꾸스꾸스는 북아프리카 튀니지 전통음식을 파는 서촌 맛집.
desc_l10n.zh: 位于西村的Couscous是一间提供北非突尼斯传统饮食的餐厅，可以品尝独特的突尼斯家常菜，推荐给想尝试异国料理的人。价格约在16,000韩元~35,000韩元之间，有多种突尼斯套餐可选择。

description: Couscous is a Seochon-based restaurant serving Tunisian and North African dishes. A place to try out staple Tunisian dishes, a rare find in Korea, this place is highly recommended for diners wanting to expand their taste palate. Various Tunisian set meals are available at a price range from 16,000 won to 35,000 won.
name: Couscous

desc_l10n.en: Luna Asia is an Indian restaurant run by an Indian chef. Serving curry made with 100% organic spices and perfectly golden oven-baked naan, Luna Asia highly recommends their two signature dishes, Tandoori chicken and Prawn Vindaloo, to first time visitors.
desc_l10n.ja: Luna Asiaはインド人シェフが調理する伝統的なインド料理店です。100％天然スパイスを使用し、伝統的なカレーを作っています。かまどではナンが焼かれています。タンドリーチキンとプラウンビンダルが代表メニューです。
desc_l10n.ko: 루나아시아는 인도쉐프가 요리하는 전통 인도 요리 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: Luna Asia是由印度厨师掌厨的传统印度料理专门店。使用100%天然香料制作咖哩、火炉烤出的印度烤饼也又香又Q！印度烤鸡、印度咖哩是招牌餐点。

description: Luna Asia is an Indian restaurant run by an Indian chef. Serving curry made with 100% organic spices and perfectly golden oven-baked naan, Luna Asia highly recommends their two signature dishes, Tandoori chicken and Prawn Vindaloo, to first time visitors.
name: Luna Asia

desc_l10n.en: Ildossi Dakgalbi is a dakgalbi (spicy stir fry chicken) restaurant with a classy atmosphere. They sell a variety of dakgalbi menu including “Cheese Dakgalbi” and “Dakgalbi with Bean Sprouts”, making it a popular restaurant among visitors.
desc_l10n.ja: イルドシタッカルビは洗練されたレストランのような雰囲気のタッカルビ店です。チーズタッカルビ、コンナムル(豆もやし)タッカルビなど様々なタッカルビのメニューを提供しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 일도씨닭갈비는 세련된 레스토랑과 같은 분위기의 닭갈비 음식점.
desc_l10n.zh: 一道氏辣炒鸡是一间走精致餐厅风格的辣炒鸡店。提供起司辣炒鸡、豆芽辣炒鸡等多种辣炒鸡料理，深受食客们的喜爱。

description: Ildossi Dakgalbi is a dakgalbi (spicy stir fry chicken) restaurant with a classy atmosphere. They sell a variety of dakgalbi menu including “Cheese Dakgalbi” and “Dakgalbi with Bean Sprouts”, making it a popular restaurant among visitors.
name: Ildossi Dakgalbi Gwanghwamun Branch

name_l10n.ja: イルドシタッカルビ 光化門店
name_l10n.zh: 一道氏辣炒鸡光华门店

desc_l10n.en: Sushi Hiroba is a domestic brand and one of the biggest conveyor belt sushi restaurants in Korea. Serving sushi suited for the Korean palate, they offer interesting fusion menu like “Rib-eye Steak Sushi”, “Original Flatfish Kimchi Sushi”, and more.
desc_l10n.ja: すし広場は韓国最大の回転寿司店です。韓国人の好きな元祖コットゥンシム(霜降り牛ロース)寿司、元祖クァンオ(ヒラメ)寿司など和食と韓国料理の調和を提供します。
desc_l10n.ko: 스시히로바는 국내 순수 브랜드이자, 국내 최대 회전초밥 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: 寿司广场为韩国首间由韩国人自己创立的回转寿司店。在这里能够品尝符合韩国人口味、融合日韩风的元祖霜降牛握寿司、比目鱼泡菜握寿司等寿司。

description: Sushi Hiroba is a domestic brand and one of the biggest conveyor belt sushi restaurants in Korea. Serving sushi suited for the Korean palate, they offer interesting fusion menu like “Rib-eye Steak Sushi”, “Original Flatfish Kimchi Sushi”, and more.
name: Sushi Hiroba (Samsung-dong Branch)

name_l10n.ja: すし広場 三成本洞店
name_l10n.zh: 寿司广场 三成洞总店

desc_l10n.en: Ganga is an Indian restaurant serving authentic Indian cuisine. Everything on their menu are traditional Indian dishes and are very popular among Koreans for their great taste.
desc_l10n.ja: Gangaはインド伝統の味を提供するインド伝統料理専門店です。エキゾチックな店内の雰囲気と全てのメニューは韓国でも人気の高いレストランです。
desc_l10n.ko: 인도 정통의 맛을 선보이는 정통 인도 레스토랑.
desc_l10n.zh: Ganga是一家传统印度餐厅，为食客提供口味道地的印度料理。店内提供的所有餐点都为印度传统料理，因符合韩国人的口味而深受欢迎。除此之外，店内的装潢与摆饰也营造出满满的印度风情。

description: Ganga is an Indian restaurant serving authentic Indian cuisine. Everything on their menu are traditional Indian dishes and are very popular among Koreans for their great taste.
name: Ganga Yeoksam Branch

desc_l10n.en: Ganga is an Indian restaurant serving authentic Indian cuisine. Serving Indian food made by chefs with over 20 years of experience, Ganga is a popular restaurant with easy accessibility.
desc_l10n.ja: Gangaは2000年にシンサ(新沙)本店を皮切りに、韓国全土に店舗を置くインド伝統料理専門店です。20年以上経歴を持つのインド料理専門シェフが各店舗を定期的にチェックしており、すべてのメニューは人口調味料(MSG)を使用せずに、約20種類のスパイスだけで味を作り上げています。
desc_l10n.ko: 강가는 정통 인도 레스토랑.
desc_l10n.zh: Ganga是传统印度餐厅。拥有20年以上传统印度料理经验的一流印度厨师，为顾客提供最棒的印度料理。此外，Ganga也因餐地点交通便利深受顾客喜爱。

description: Ganga is an Indian restaurant serving authentic Indian cuisine. Serving Indian food made by chefs with over 20 years of experience, Ganga is a popular restaurant with easy accessibility.
name: Ganga Mugyo Branch

desc_l10n.en: Starting as a restaurant in Sinsa back in 2000, Ganga is currently a chain restaurant with many branch stores available throughout the country. Their food is made with over 20 different spices by chefs with over 20 years of experience and does not contain any MSG.
desc_l10n.ja: Gangaは2000年にシンサ(新沙)本店を皮切りに、韓国全土に店舗を置くインド伝統料理専門店です。20年以上経歴を持つのインド料理専門シェフが各店舗を定期的にチェックしており、すべてのメニューは人口調味料(MSG)を使用せずに、約20種類のスパイスだけで味を作り上げています。
desc_l10n.ko: 2000년 신사본점을 시작으로 전국에 매장을 두고 있는 인도 정통요리 전문점
desc_l10n.zh: Ganga是印度传统料理专门店，2000年于新沙开设总店，随后在韩国各地开设分店。为了维护餐点品质与口味，拥有20年以上经验的印度料理专业厨师都会定期前往每间分店进行确认。Ganga的所有餐点都是使用约20种香料制作而成，且不添加任何味精。

description: Starting as a restaurant in Sinsa back in 2000, Ganga is currently a chain restaurant with many branch stores available throughout the country. Their food is made with over 20 different spices by chefs with over 20 years of experience and does not contain any MSG.
name: Ganga Jamsil Branch

desc_l10n.en: A restaurant serving food made by an Indian chef, Kali Sadang Branch offers visitors a wide range of dishes and beverages from their menu.
desc_l10n.ja: カーリー(Kali)サダン(舎堂)はインドより招聘した現地のシェフが調理するインド料理専門店です。コース料理からアラカルトまで様々なインド料理やドリンクを提供しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 인도에서 초빙한 쉐프가 직접 조리해 이국적인 맛 선사.
desc_l10n.zh: Kali是一间直接聘请印度厨师烹饪的异国料理专门店。这里有套餐、单点等各式印度料理与饮品 。

description: A restaurant serving food made by an Indian chef, Kali Sadang Branch offers visitors a wide range of dishes and beverages from their menu.
name: Kali Sadang Branch

desc_l10n.en: Nammi Plant Lab is a 100% vegan restaurant run by a Colombian owner. They serve healthy food using the freshest ingredients. They offer a variety of vegetable dishes, and Italian dishes such as cheese vegetable pizza and spinach cream lasagna are especially delicious. Many customers come from far away to try this menu, so the taste is guaranteed. They also allow pets, so you can comfortably visit while traveling with your pet. If you want to experience the charm of vegetarianism for yourself, I recommend visiting.
desc_l10n.ja: Nammi Plant Labは、コロンビア出身のオーナーが運営する100％ビーガンレストラン。新鮮な素材でヘルシーな料理を提供しています。野菜を使った料理も豊富で、特にチーズベジタブルピザやほうれん草クリームラザニアといったイタリアンは絶品です。遠方からこのメニューを求めて訪れるお客様も多いほどで、その味は折り紙付きです。ペット同伴もOKなので、愛犬との旅行でも安心して利用できます。ベジタリアンの魅力を体感したい方は、ぜひ訪れてみてください。
desc_l10n.ko: 남미플랜트랩은 콜롬비아 출신 주인이 운영하는 100% 비건 음식점
desc_l10n.zh: Nammi Plant Lab由来自哥伦比亚的老板经营，是一间严选新鲜食材、制作健康料理的100%蔬食餐厅。 提供种类丰富的蔬菜料理，尤其是奶酪蔬菜披萨和菠菜奶油千层面等意大利菜，尤其美味。许多顾客不远万里前来品尝，因此味道绝对有保证。餐厅允许携带宠物，即使带着宠物一起旅行，也能安心用餐。如果您想亲身体验素食主义的魅力，我推荐您来这里用餐。

description: Nammi Plant Lab is a 100% vegan restaurant run by a Colombian owner. They serve healthy food using the freshest ingredients. They offer a variety of vegetable dishes, and Italian dishes such as cheese vegetable pizza and spinach cream lasagna are especially delicious. Many customers come from far away to try this menu, so the taste is guaranteed. They also allow pets, so you can comfortably visit while traveling with your pet. If you want to experience the charm of vegetarianism for yourself, I recommend visiting.
name: Nammi Plant Lab

desc_l10n.en: Delhi India is a Indian fusion restaurant run by an Indian chef. It’s the perfect place to try samosa, Indian fried rice, fried noodles, and other Indian dishes.
desc_l10n.ja: デリー・インディアはインド人が運営するフュージョンインド料理店です。サモサ、インド風炒飯、インド風炒麺など多様なインド料理を味わうことが出来ます。
desc_l10n.ko: 델리인디아는 인도인이 직접 운영하는 퓨전 인도음식점이다.
desc_l10n.zh: DELHI INDIA是由印度人亲自经营的创意印度料理店。在此可品尝印度咖哩饺、印度炒饭与炒面等各种印度料理。

description: Delhi India is a Indian fusion restaurant run by an Indian chef. It’s the perfect place to try samosa, Indian fried rice, fried noodles, and other Indian dishes.
name: Delhi India

name_l10n.ja: デリー・インディア(Delhi India)

desc_l10n.en: Durga is an Indian and Nepalese restaurant. Featuring over 70 Indian and Nepalese dishes, the restaurant also boasts of an unique and exotic interior featuring both Indian and Nepalese designs.
desc_l10n.ja: ドゥルガー(Durga)は本格的なインド・ネパール料理専門店です。インド、ネパール料理の本場の味の70種類以上の料理を提供しています。店内はネパールとインド風のインテリアで、エキゾチックな雰囲気を感じることができます。
desc_l10n.ko: 두르가는 정통 인도&네팔 전문 음식점.
desc_l10n.zh: DURGA为传统印度与尼泊尔料理专门店。店内提供70多种料理，让顾客可以尽情品尝印度与尼泊尔的美食。店内装潢设计可以同时感受尼泊尔与印度风情，充满异国情调。

description: Durga is an Indian and Nepalese restaurant. Featuring over 70 Indian and Nepalese dishes, the restaurant also boasts of an unique and exotic interior featuring both Indian and Nepalese designs.
name: Durga Main Branch

name_l10n.ja: ドゥルガー(Durga) 光化門店

desc_l10n.en: Himalaya is an Indian and Nepalese restaurant. Although both Indian and Nepalese cuisine is made with the heavy use of spices, they’re still popular among many Korean locals.
desc_l10n.ja: ( himallaya )はカジュアルなインド料理専門店です。インド、ネパール料理を味わうことができ、スパイスを多く使用していますが、現地人でも気軽に食べれるメニューを提供しています。
desc_l10n.ko: 히말라야는 캐주얼한 인도요리 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: Himalaya 为传统印度与尼泊尔料理专门店，可以品尝到各种印度与尼泊尔在地美食。虽然料理使用了各种辛香料，但仍然深受韩国人的喜爱。

description: Himalaya is an Indian and Nepalese restaurant. Although both Indian and Nepalese cuisine is made with the heavy use of spices, they’re still popular among many Korean locals.
name: Himalaya Jonggak Branch

desc_l10n.en: An Ikseon-dong hanok cafe built around a very old persimmon tree, Gamkkotdang is a beloved spot among both locals and visitors alike. Gamkottdang's signature menu includes their apple pie, scones, and egg tarts.
desc_l10n.ja: 柿花堂は韓屋の美しさと柿の木を生かしたインテリアでファンの多い韓屋カフェ。おすすめメニューはアップルパイ、発酵バターを使用したスコーン、エッグタルトなどがあります。
desc_l10n.ko: 한옥의 아름다움과 오래된 감나무를 살리는 인테리어로 많은 사랑을 받음.
desc_l10n.zh: 位于益善洞的韩屋咖啡厅"感化堂"利用古老的柿子树进行室内装饰,深受访客的欢迎。 卖场的主要零食是苹果派、司康饼、蛋挞。

description: An Ikseon-dong hanok cafe built around a very old persimmon tree, Gamkkotdang is a beloved spot among both locals and visitors alike. Gamkottdang's signature menu includes their apple pie, scones, and egg tarts.
name: Gamkkotdang

desc_l10n.en: p { text-align: justify; word-spacing: 2px; } [Advantages & Tips for When Visiting Viking's Wharf] Viking's Wharf strictly abides by only the best ingredients to ensure that each visit rewards you with the utmost of quality. 1. Only the finest lobster selection from Canada! Viking's Wharf makes it a yearly tradition to venture out to Canada each year and observe the fishery process, as well as perform detailed food inspections conducted for various purposes that include the processing of food, the freezing of food, product yield, taste, substance, aroma, the differences of food before and after cooking, and more. The head chef of Viking Group Inc., a former food specialist from a five-star hotel, then tries the food to provide feedback. Viking's Wharf lobster is a lobster carefully selected via the meticulous inspection as described above. 2. All this cuisine from only lobster? And it's unlimited?! Once a menu item only available on special days, prepared by the best of chefs, lobster is now available to have at as much you please! Try the wide array of lobster cuisine that includes such menu items as whole steamed lobster, prepared to order, lobster bisque, baked lobster, lobster steak, lobster ceviche, and a lobster mango tower. 3. Fresh seafood brought to your seat! Enjoy in-season seafood to your heart's content, prepared to order upon selection from aquariums filled with a variety of seafood that includes oysters, triploid oysters, abalones, scallops, sea squirts, clams, blood clams, octopus, seashells, small octopus, baby clams, and sea cucumber. Take advantage of the delicious sushi, as well, prepared with a variety of fish ranging from snappers, flatfish, and swordfish to tuna, salmon, red drums, and shrimp. 4. Enjoy fresh grilled seafood! Savor a delicious grilled menu, whether it's baked lobster, beef short ribs, or shrimp, or even abalone, grilled chicken, or salmon steak! Besides just being known as an all-you-can-eat lobster buffet, Viking's Wharf is known around social media as a tasty rib house, too! 5. Quality speaks for itself - From premium water to delectable desserts! For starters, Viking's Wharf serves up Aquafina water and S.Pellegrino sparkling water, meeting the Michelin restaurant standard, while also offering fruit extracts and other health drinks! And don't forget to save room for dessert with all the premium brand products to choose from! Some items include G.Fassi, the classic Italian gelato brand since 1880, TWG Black Tea, a tea brand enjoyed across the globe, Paul Basset Coffee, Noah's Bakery,listedamong one of the top three bakeries in Apgujeong, and more! A great selection of fruit is also available, including grapefruit, mango, and pineapple, with the mango prepared ri ght on the spot!
desc_l10n.ja: Viking's Wharf コエックス(COEX)店では最高の食材にこだわり、バイキングス・ワーフだけの特別な価値を提供しています。 1. カナダで5つ星ホテル出身のバイキンググループ統括専門シェフがロブスターを直に厳選したものを提供しています。 2. ロブスター蒸し、ロブスター焼き、ロブスタービスク、ロブスターケーキ、ロブスターマンゴータワーなどシェフがすぐに調理した多様なロブスター料理の食べ放題を楽しむことができます。 3. アワビ、ホタテ、鯛、メカジキ、マグロ、エビなど多様なシーフードも同時にテーブルにお持ちします。 4. グリル料理もおすすめです。ベイクロブスター、カルビ、ミニサーモンステークなども食べ放題です。SNSではカルビグルメも人気です。 5. プレミアムブランドのデザート特別です。ミシュランのレストランで有名なイタリアのプレミアムミネラルウォーターアクアパンナとサンペレグリノの炭酸水を提供。100％搾汁ジュースもおすすめです。 Viking's Wharfでは有名なブランドデザートを提供しています。100年の伝統あるイタリアンジェラートG.Fassi、TWG紅茶、Paul Bassetのコーヒー、アプクジョン(狎鴎亭)の3大ケーキショップのひとつNoah Bakeryと、グレープフルーツ、パイナップル、マンゴーなど多様なフルーツも楽しむことができます。
desc_l10n.ko: 국내 최초 랍스터 무한리필 뷔페 레스토랑
desc_l10n.zh: 严选最顶级的食材，让顾客享受最高级的美味的VIKING'S WHARF龙虾自助餐餐厅！ 1、VIKING'S WHARF每年前往加拿大监督龙虾的打捞过程，从加工方式、冷冻方式、虾肉口感、口味、香气等各个方面进行测试，并由五星级饭店出身的行政总厨亲自品尝并确认食材品质。 2、以特级厨师的巧手烹饪方法做出的各类龙虾料理，在这里可以无限品尝，包含清蒸龙虾、现烤龙虾、法式汤品、龙虾排、凉拌龙虾、龙虾芒果塔等多种料理。 3、在这里最新鲜的当季海鲜也可以无限享用。鲍鱼、海鞘、牛角江珧蛤、章鱼、海螺、小章鱼、海参等当季新鲜海鲜，都是主厨们现场挑选后进行料理的。鲷鱼、比目鱼、鲔鱼、鲑鱼、虾子等新鲜海鲜则被做成了鲜美的寿司。 4、烤排骨、虾、鲍鱼、炸鸡、鲑鱼排等美味烧烤料理也可以无限品尝！VIKING'S WHARF并不仅是龙虾自助餐，最近SNS上热门被网友们评价为烤排骨名店。 5、VIKING'S WHARF提供的矿泉水也选用米其林餐厅指定用水优质Acqua Panna和圣沛黎洛气泡矿泉水。当然，这里也提供100%的现榨果汁。 VIKING'S WHARF的甜点，也是选用知名品牌，包括了百年经典的义大利罗马冰淇淋G. Fassi、TWG红茶、 Paul Bassett咖啡、狎鸥亭三大蛋糕店之一NOAH BAKERY等甜点。还有葡萄柚、凤梨、芒果等优质新鲜水果值得品尝。

desc_l10n.en: Located along one of the many branching side streets of the infamous "Yeontral Park," Git-teol offers some respite to solo-goers out there looking to enjoy a leisurely cocktail. All you need to do is keep an open mind, and your manners, and you'll make new friends in no time! There's a plethora of different whiskey and liquor available with a vast menu of cocktails at the ready for a reasonable price. If luck is on your side, you can also enjoy the occasional open party or exhibition that takes place from time to time. During the big holiday seasons of Seollal and Chuseok, they even hold festive potluck celebrations as well! Stop on by and enjoy good company among new friends for memories you're sure not to forget. Git-teol is the perfect solution for those late nights when you're stuck alone, when you simply need a drink on a starry city night, or even when Netflixing at home just doesn't seem to cut it. Hope to see you there!
desc_l10n.ja: ヨンナムドン(延南洞)公園通りに位置するキットル(Feather)は、一人酒が楽しめる場所。開かれた心とマナーで、新しい友達も作ることができます。おすすめのウィスキーとリーズナブルな価格のカクテルが用意されています。もし運がよければ、時々開催されるパーティや展覧会に参加することもできます旧正月や秋夕(旧暦8月15日)などの連休には、「フォトラク·パーティー」が開催されます。家族と一緒でなくても新しい友達とグルメを交わしながら心暖かい時間を過ごしましょう。友達を呼ぶのにも曖昧な時間帯、お酒を一杯だけ飲みたい。寂しい都会の夜、一人でネットフリックスを見るのはうんざりする人なら、キットル(Feather)があなたを待っています。
desc_l10n.ko: 혼술러들의 성지, 연남동 혼술 Bar 깃털
desc_l10n.zh: 位于延南洞公园的酒吧羽毛Feather是一间可以自在享受独酒氛围的地方。怀着一颗开朗的心和礼貌，便能在这里交上新的朋友呢！酒吧里准备了多种威士忌与价格亲民的鸡尾酒，幸运的话，还能遇上偶尔举办的派对和展览。韩国中秋或春节连假期间，会特别举办Potluck Party，让独自过节的人也能与新朋友一起分享食物，度过不孤单的温馨佳节。不好呼唤朋友一起小酌的时间或寂静夜晚不想孤独看Netflix影片的时候，就来羽毛Feather吧！

desc_l10n.en: Also known as Neurin Maeul in Korean, the Slow Brew Pub is Korea's first-ever Seoul-based distillery that offers a unique array of food that is the perfect match for the wide selection of smooth, traditional alcohol, featuring freshly-distilled makgeolli and herbal liquor that are distinctive with the flavors of each season of fermentation all year round! The Slow Brew Pub was founded on the desire to make a makgeolli distillery accessible in the heart of the city so that people can experience makgeolli at its best. The pub distillery features a unique line of "downtown makgeolli food" provided by Bae & Brewing Co. so as to better accentuate that of a respite amid the business of modern daily life. Stop by and enjoy the delicious drinks and food that are prepared each day with the utmost of care.
desc_l10n.ja: 熟成日によって春夏秋冬の4つの味に分けられる柔らかい生マッコルリ(マッコリ)と生薬酒など、様々な伝統酒とともに幻想的な食べ合わせを誇る特別なつまみが味わえる韓国初の都心の中の醸造場。本気でマッコルリ(マッコリ)を一番新鮮に味わいたいという気持ちから始めた韓国初の都心型マッコリ醸造所です。毎日忙しく走る現代人の日常に、ゆったりとした憩いの場を提供するため、ペサンミョン(裵商冕)酒家が造る「都心型マッコルリ(マッコリ)フード」ヌリンマウル醸造場。毎日真心を込めた手作りの生ヌリンマウルとつまみを味わうことができます。
desc_l10n.ko: 전통주와 함께 특별한 안주를 맛볼 수 있는 국내 최초의 도심 속 양조장
desc_l10n.zh: 裴商冕酒家秉持着为顾客提供最新鲜的马格利酒的原则，以及让一天到晚奔波忙碌的现代人能够暂缓放松一下的理念，成立了韩国首座位于市区里的酿酒厂“慢村酿酒厂”。在这里可以品尝到根据发酵日期区分成春夏秋冬口味的温和生马格利酒、生药酒等多种韩国传统酒，以及店家根据酒类精心料理的下酒菜。

description: Also known as Neurin Maeul in Korean, the Slow Brew Pub is Korea's first-ever Seoul-based distillery that offers a unique array of food that is the perfect match for the wide selection of smooth, traditional alcohol, featuring freshly-distilled makgeolli and herbal liquor that are distinctive with the flavors of each season of fermentation all year round! The Slow Brew Pub was founded on the desire to make a makgeolli distillery accessible in the heart of the city so that people can experience makgeolli at its best. The pub distillery features a unique line of "downtown makgeolli food" provided by Bae & Brewing Co. so as to better accentuate that of a respite amid the business of modern daily life. Stop by and enjoy the delicious drinks and food that are prepared each day with the utmost of care.
name: Slow Brew Pub (Gangnam Branch)
