desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Nakwon Agwijjim is a Oraegage and Baeknyeon-gage that is confident that it is the originator of Seoul-style Agwi-jjim (Braised Spicy Monkfish) and has been in business for nearly 40 years since 1977. The founders of Nakwon Agwijjim moved to Seoul with the ambition to cook Masan-style Agwi-jjim, which is cooked by drying monkfish on the seashore. However, there was no place to dry monkfish in Seoul, so they had no choice but to develop and serve Seoul-style Agwi-jjim, made by trimming living monkfish right away. Seoul-style Agwi-jjim was well received by customers and became the main menu of Nakwon Agwijjim. The second-generation CEO, who succeeded in the family business, always does his best to airlift fresh ingredients to preserve the dish’s original name and authentic taste. Every morning at dawn, fresh monkfish are airlifted to Noryangjin Market, and only domestic ingredients are used for seasoning. The food taste is so delicious that it even received a franchise offer once, but it was rejected due to the monkfish’s unstable supply and demand. The decision was to preserve the food taste that could not be compromised no matter what. Thanks to the efforts of the second generation to protect tradition, Nakwon Agwijjim was selected as a Seoul Future Heritage in 2019 and received a certificate of modern and contemporary cultural heritage, showing the tradition’s dignity.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 楽園アンコウチムは、ソウル式アンコウチムの元祖を自負する ソウルの老舗 であり、百年企業でもあります。1977年から40年近く同じ場所で営業を続けているアンコウチム専門店です。 ナグォンアグチムの創業者は、海岸でアンコウを乾かして調理する馬山式アグチムで調理をするつもりでしたが、ソウルではアンコウを乾燥させる場所がなく、生アンコウの手入れをして作るソウル式アグチムを開発することになりました。ソウル式のアグチムは、次第に人気になり、ナグォンアグチムのメインメニューとして定着しました。家業を引き継いだ2代目の代表は、「ソウル式アグチムの元祖」と「元祖の味」を守るために、常に新鮮な食材の仕入れに最善の努力を尽くしています。毎朝シンノリャンジン(新鷺梁津)市場から生アンコウを仕入れ、調味料は、国産材料のみを使用しています。 チェーン店オープンの話も出ましたが、元祖の味や品質を維持するため話を断るほど伝統を守っていこうとする2代目代表の努力で、ナグォンアグチムは2019年にソウル未来遺産に選ばれ、近現代文化遺産証明書を受け取り伝統的な料理の地位へと上り詰めました。
desc_l10n.ko: 부드럽고 매콤한 아구살이 특징인 낙원동 터줏대감
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 乐园安康鱼炖菜自信是首尔式安康鱼炖菜的元祖，是一家 首尔老店 ，也是百年老店。自1977年以来，已在同一地点营业近40年，是一家专门制作安康鱼炖菜的店。 创立乐园辣炖安康鱼的父母以在海岸边晾干安康鱼烹饪的马山式辣炖安康鱼为抱负来到首尔,但由于首尔没有干燥安康鱼的场所,所以不得不开发并提供服务。 首尔式辣炖安康鱼受到顾客的好评,成为了乐园辣炖安康鱼的主要菜品。 继承家业的第2代代表为了守住"首尔式辣炖安康鱼鼻祖"的头衔和鼻祖的味道,总是竭尽全力空运新鲜的食材。 每天凌晨直接从鹭梁津市场空运生物安康鱼，调料只用国产材料。 虽然食物味道非常出色,甚至一度被提议特许经营,但以供应不固定的生物安康为由拒绝了。 这是为了保持在任何情况下都不能妥协的饮食味道而做出的决断。 得益于守护传统的2大代表的努力,乐园炖安康鱼于2019年被选 定为首尔未来遗产,获得了近现代文化遗产认证书,展示了传统的威严。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Nakwon Agwijjim is a Oraegage and Baeknyeon-gage that is confident that it is the originator of Seoul-style Agwi-jjim (Braised Spicy Monkfish) and has been in business for nearly 40 years since 1977. The founders of Nakwon Agwijjim moved to Seoul with the ambition to cook Masan-style Agwi-jjim, which is cooked by drying monkfish on the seashore. However, there was no place to dry monkfish in Seoul, so they had no choice but to develop and serve Seoul-style Agwi-jjim, made by trimming living monkfish right away. Seoul-style Agwi-jjim was well received by customers and became the main menu of Nakwon Agwijjim. The second-generation CEO, who succeeded in the family business, always does his best to airlift fresh ingredients to preserve the dish’s original name and authentic taste. Every morning at dawn, fresh monkfish are airlifted to Noryangjin Market, and only domestic ingredients are used for seasoning. The food taste is so delicious that it even received a franchise offer once, but it was rejected due to the monkfish’s unstable supply and demand. The decision was to preserve the food taste that could not be compromised no matter what. Thanks to the efforts of the second generation to protect tradition, Nakwon Agwijjim was selected as a Seoul Future Heritage in 2019 and received a certificate of modern and contemporary cultural heritage, showing the tradition’s dignity.
name: Yennaljip Nakwon Agwijjim

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Jinmi Sikdang is a Korean restaurant that has been serving Kong-guksu (Noodles in Cold Soybean Soup) with devotion for 45 years at the corner of Munbae-dong, Yongsan-gu. The founder who started and operated Jinmi Siktang moved to Seoul 45 years ago and made Kong-guksu and Ramyeon (Ramen.) The tradition of Jinmi Siktang, handed down from parents to sons, is that only fresh local ingredients are to be used. Even now, they only use wangtaeman purchased from Mungyeong, Gyeongsangbuk-do, to make fermented soybean paste. In the summer, the delicacy Kong-guksu is served. Cheonggukjang (Rich Soybean Paste) and Kong-guksu, made with wangtae beans, which have no fishy smell and are suitable for health, are receiving favorable reviews from customers for their light and rich taste. Jinmi Siktang’s unique rule of purchasing only the ingredients needed for the day and consuming them all is still thoroughly maintained even after 45 years.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ジンミシクタン(真味食堂)は、ヨンサン(龍山)区ムンベドン(文培洞)で45年間真心を込めたコングクスを届けてきた韓国料理店です。45年前にソウルでコングクスやラーメンなどを作りはじめた創業者は、ジンミシクタンを開業し、運営してきました。両親から息子へと続くジンミシクタンならではの伝統の味は、いつも新鮮な地域食材のみを使用しています。 今もキョンサンブクド(慶尚北道)ムンギョン(聞慶)で仕入れたワンテ豆で直接味噌を作りチョングクチャンを作っており、夏の旬の料理であるコングクスをサービスしています。生臭いにおいがなく、健康に良いワンテ豆で作ったチョングクチャンとコングクスは淡泊であり深い味で人気です。毎日、その日に使用する分だけの材料を仕入れるジンミシクタンだけのルールは、45年が過ぎた今も守られています。
desc_l10n.ko: 신선한 콩으로 45년간 청국장과 콩국수를 만드는 한식당.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 珍味餐厅是在龙山区文培洞角落连续45年提供充满诚意的豆制食品的韩食店。 45年前来到首尔，做豆浆面和拉面等料理进行销售的创始人创立了珍味餐厅，并一直经营至今。 从父母到儿子的美味餐厅独有的传统是,总是只使用新鲜的当地食材。 现在也只使用在庆尚北道闻庆购买的王太,亲自放豆酱发酵,制作清国酱,夏天还提供别样的豆浆面服务。 用无腥味、有益健康的王太豆制作的清国酱和豆浆面以清淡浓郁的味道获得了顾客的好评。 每天只购买当天使用的材料,当天全部用完的珍味餐厅独有的规则在45年后的今天仍然彻底维持。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} In the steaming soup, the thick broth's deep taste and savory aroma stimulate the nose, and the soft and flavorful meat tickles the tongue of the eater. Sigol Gamjatang, which has been making the same Gamjatang for nearly 33 years in Eunpyeong-gu, has Ugeoji Gamjatang (Pork Back-bone Stew) as its main menu item. Sigol Gamjatang is an emblematic gamjatang restaurant in Eunpyeong-gu, designated as a local restaurant in Eunpyeong-gu. Currently, sons, daughters, and sons-in-law run the restaurant together. They are raising brand awareness by operating packaging and delivery services so that although far away, people can have warm food anytime and anywhere. In addition, the sole signature menu of Sigol Gamjatang is made by boiling domestic pork backbone thoroughly for 4 hours by removing blood and trimming, then adding whole potatoes and beef brisket and broiling it again. The menu is simple, but the sincerity and effort put into serving a bowl of gamjatang are far from simple.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 湯気の出るスープは濃いスープならではの深い味と香ばしい香りが鼻を刺激し、柔らかくてコクのある肉は食べる人の舌を唸らせます。ウンピョン(恩平)区で33年近く変わらない味のカムジャタンを作っているシゴルカムジャタンの代表メニューは、白菜入りカムジャタンです。 シゴルカムジャククは、ウンピョン(恩平)区の地元の飲食店に指定されたウンピョン区の代表カムジャタン店です。現在、家族で分担して食堂を経営しており、距離が遠くてもいつどこでも暖かい食べ物を味わえるようにテイクアウトおよびデリバリーサービスを行っており、人気を高めています。また、シゴルカムジャククの唯一のメニューであり看板メニューであるカムジャタンは、韓国産豚の背骨を血の水除去と手入れを通じて4時間じっくり煮込み、丸ごとジャガイモと白菜を入れて再び沸かしています。シンプルなメニューですが、真心込めたカムジャタンを作るため日々努力を続けています。
desc_l10n.ko: 진하고, 구수한 국물과 부드러운 고기로 은평구에서 33년 가까이 자리를 지켜온 감자탕집 .
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 在热气腾腾的汤汁中,浓浓的肉汤独有的浓郁味道和香喷喷的香味刺激鼻子,柔软而鲜美的肉让食用者的舌头发痒。 在恩平区制作了33年不变味道的土豆汤的乡村土豆汤的代表菜品就是干白菜土豆汤。 乡村土豆汤是恩平区代表性的土豆汤店,被指定为恩平区土生土长的饭店。 目前,由儿子、女儿、女婿共同分担经营餐厅,即使距离稍远,也为了随时随地都能品尝到温暖的食物,同时运营包装及配送服务,提高知名度。 另外,作为乡村土豆汤的唯一菜品和招牌菜的土豆汤,将国产猪脊骨通过去除血水和修整熟透4个小时,放入整块土豆、干白菜,重新煮出来。 菜单虽然简单，但为推出一碗土豆汤而倾注的真诚和努力并不简单。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Galbi immersed in broth and deliciously cooked saeng samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly) tempt customers’ chopsticks. Since its opening in 1990, this restaurant has been running for 31 years, intending to serve homecooked meals. The main menu, “dwaeji galbi soup,” made by marinating fresh pork ribs and neck meat in more than ten different seasonings and then stewing them, is popular among customers. For freshness and chewiness, non-frozen pork bellies are cut directly with a knife without using a machine. Many repeat customers love kimchi and Mu-saengchae (Julienne Korean Radish Salad). Kimchi has been made with domestic ingredients since the restaurant opened. The operating principle is to faithfully provide the basics without resorting to technical skills. Many regular customers visit Ssaligol; not only do many come more than twice a week, but they are highly praised to the extent that customers who have visited once are said to come again.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} サリコルは、1990年に開業して以来、自宅で食べる食事をもてなすという気持ちで、31年間続いてきたグルメ店です。スープに浸ったカルビと美味しく煮える生サムギョプサルが訪れた人の舌を唸らせます。代表メニューである「スープ豚カルビ」は、新鮮な韓豚カルビ肉と肩ロースを10種類以上のタレで漬けた後、熟成させて煮詰めて食べるカルビとして人気のメニューです。 鮮度と歯ごたえのために凍らせない豚バラ肉を機械を使わずに直接ナイフで切っています。そして、キムチと大根の和え物を食べたさにリピート客も多いです。キムチは、国産の材料で直接作っており、基本の料理を美味しく提供することを運営原則としています。数多くの常連客が訪れるサリゴルは、週に2回以上通う人が多いほど人々から愛されている店です。
desc_l10n.ko: 손수 칼로 썬 생삽겹과 31년의 역사가 농축된 국물갈비가 주력인 가게.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 浸在汤里的排骨和熟透的生五花肉诱惑着顾客的筷子。 这家美食店自1990年开业以来，一直以在家吃一顿饭的心态经营了31年。 代表菜品"汤排骨"是新鲜韩豚排骨肉和猪颈肉用10多种调料腌制后发酵后炖着吃的排骨,顾客们经常光顾。 为了保证新鲜和咀嚼性，只要未冻透的猪生五花肉不用机器直接用刀切。 被辛奇和生拌萝卜丝迷住而再次光顾的客人也很多。 辛奇是国产材料,从开业初期到现在一直亲自制作。 运营原则是,不耍技巧,忠实提供基本。 众多常客光顾的荆条沟不仅有相当多的客人每周来两次以上,而且来过一次的客人几乎还会再来,赞不绝口。

Since its opening in 1990, this restaurant has been running for 31 years, intending to serve homecooked meals. The main menu, “dwaeji galbi soup,” made by marinating fresh pork ribs and neck meat in more than ten different seasonings and then stewing them, is popular among customers. For freshness and chewiness, non-frozen pork bellies are cut directly with a knife without using a machine. Many repeat customers love kimchi and Mu-saengchae (Julienne Korean Radish Salad). Kimchi has been made with domestic ingredients since the restaurant opened. The operating principle is to faithfully provide the basics without resorting to technical skills. Many regular customers visit Ssaligol; not only do many come more than twice a week, but they are highly praised to the extent that customers who have visited once are said to come again.

Renaissance Bakery, a bakery filled with memories that children return to as parents, is an old bakery that opened in 1982 as a permanent fixture of Mapo. Intending to create a friendly bakery that anyone of any age can visit and eat at any time, they have been striving to maintain the best technology, quality, and variety. In particular, they insist on fresh ingredients, organic flour grown in clean regions, and the best ingredients from Europe. Renaissance Bakery offers a variety of delicious products, ranging from old-fashioned bread to trendy bread, that satisfy the needs of the modern youth. The neighborhood bakery, which started in 1982, is looking forward to a renaissance bakery that will indeed greet the next 100 years by continuing the family business for the second generation.

desc_l10n.ko: 어린아이가 부모가 되어도 찾아오는 추억이 담긴 빵집.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Pictures of braised pigs’ feet decorate the front of the store. One of the famous braised pigs’ feet restaurants in Jangchung-dong and Korea’s No. 1 braised pigs’ feet restaurant that attracts customers is Big Grandma’s House. The 1st founder, Jeon Sook-ryeol, recalled the taste of pigs' feet cooked by his mother in the 1960s and started the Big Grandmother's House. As the taste of braised pigs’ feet went viral, braised pigs’ feet restaurants were naturally created around it, and the current braised pigs’ feet Alley in Jangchung-dong was born. Since then, CEO Kim Myung-sook, the second daughter-in-law, and director Kim Song-hyun, the third granddaughter, have continued the tradition of Big Grandmother's House. Big Grandmother's House stands out among the many braised pigs’ feet restaurants. When all the competitors raised prices, they were the only ones who maintained prices and kept customers satisfied. In addition, the restaurant quickly reflects trends by developing single-person and set menus and introducing delivery services and various promotions. This is very differentiated because most long-established stores are late in reflecting new trends.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ジューシーな豚足が店の前を彩っています。トゥントゥンイおばあさんの家は、たくさんの豚足店が並ぶジャンチュンドン(奨忠洞)で元祖豚足屋として有名な店の一つです。1代目のチョン・スクリョルさんは、60年代に母親が作ってくれた豚足の味を思い出しトゥントゥンイおばあさんの家を始めることにしました。豚足の味が口コミで広がりながら自然に周辺に豚足屋ができ、今のジャンチュンドンの豚足路地が誕生しました。以後、2代目の嫁のキム・ミョンスク代表と3代目の孫娘のキム・ソンヒョン理事がトゥントゥンイおばあさんの家の伝統を受け継いでいます。 トゥントゥンイおばあさんの家は、豚足屋の通りでとても目を引く存在です。ライバル店が値上げをする中、唯一価格を維持し顧客の満足度を保ちました。また、1人メニューやセットメニューを開発したり、配達サービスや多様なプロモーションを導入するなど飲食店トレンドを早くから反映するなど、老舗店だからこそ難しい点をカバーし、他の老舗店との差別化を図っています。
desc_l10n.ko: 장충동 원조 족발집중 하나이며, 3대 거쳐 계승된 족발 맛집.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 肥美的酱猪蹄点缀在店门口。 众多酱猪蹄吸引顾客的大韩民国酱猪蹄1号地,奖忠洞以元祖酱猪蹄店而闻名的地方之一就是胖嘟嘟奶奶家。 第一代创始人全淑烈想起60年代母亲做的猪蹄的味道,开始经营胖嘟嘟奶奶家。 随着酱猪蹄味道的口碑传开,周边自然而然地出现了酱猪蹄店,现在的奖忠洞酱猪蹄胡同也诞生了。 此后,第二代儿媳金明淑代表和第三代孙女金松贤理事延续了胖嘟嘟奶奶家的传统。 胖嘟嘟奶奶家在鳞次栉比的 酱 猪蹄店中尤为突出。 竞争企业都在提高价格时,唯一保持价格,保持了顾客的满意度。 另外,开发1人菜单和套餐,引进送货服务和多种宣传活动等,迅速反映趋势。 这在大部分老妇人反映新趋势较晚这一点上具有很高的差别性。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} For 25 years, Podonamu has been a restaurant specializing in spicy mudskipper stew, one of the main southern island dishes. Spicy Mudskipper, a food that lives only in clean tidal flats and is difficult to access due to its small population, is rich in amino acids and taurine and has been called "sea beef" since ancient times. In particular, it is a stamina health food that people of all ages can enjoy because it is rich in unsaturated fatty acids and is effective in antioxidant action, skin beauty, and liver function improvement. On top of that, the Korean table setting with freshly cooked pot rice and hand-torn raw kimchi is a pleasant taste that reminds people of their hometown's home-cooked meal. In addition, there are various dishes and foods, such as 4-year-old kimchi, skate, pork, kimchi combo, and octopus’ pancake, so you can enjoy the excellent taste of the mainland of Namdo no matter which menu you choose.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ブドウの木は、代表的な南道の郷土料理の一つであるムツゴロウスープを25年間提供してきたムツゴロウスープの専門店です。 ムツゴロウスープの材料であるムツゴロウは、清浄干潟でだけで生きる生き物として個体数が少なく貴重な食べ物です。昔から「海の牛肉」と呼ばれるほど豊富なアミノ酸とタウリンが含まれており、特に不飽和脂肪酸が多く抗酸化作用および皮膚美容、肝機能改善に効能があり老若男女を問わず楽しめるスタミナ保養食です。ここに炊きたての鍋ご飯と手でちぎった生キムチを添えたハンサンチャリムは、故郷の家庭料理を思い出させる懐かしい味です。それだけでなく、4年以上漬けたキムチ、ガンギエイのサムハプ、タコチヂミなど多様な料理と食べ物があり、どのメニューを選んでも優れた南道本土の味を感じることができます。
desc_l10n.ko: 짱뚱어탕,홍어삼합등 남도 토속음식을 즐길 수 있는 25년 된 식당
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 葡萄树是25年来一直固守着代表性南道土俗饮食之一的"小胖鱼汤"的"小胖鱼汤"专卖店。 小胖鱼是仅生活在清净滩涂上,个体数量少,很难接触到的食物,自古以来就含有被称为"大海的牛肉"的丰富的氨基酸和牛磺酸,特别是含有很多不饱和脂肪酸,具有抗氧化作用及改善皮肤美容、肝功能等功效,是男女老少都可以享受的补充体力食品。 再加上刚做好的锅饭和用手撕开的生泡菜，一桌饭菜让人看着就想起了故乡的家常饭。 不仅如此,还有4年以上的陈年辛奇、斑鳐三合、章鱼饼等多种料理和食物,无论选择哪个菜品,都能感受到南道本土的美味。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} For 25 years, Podonamu has been a restaurant specializing in spicy mudskipper stew, one of the main southern island dishes. Spicy Mudskipper, a food that lives only in clean tidal flats and is difficult to access due to its small population, is rich in amino acids and taurine and has been called "sea beef" since ancient times. In particular, it is a stamina health food that people of all ages can enjoy because it is rich in unsaturated fatty acids and is effective in antioxidant action, skin beauty, and liver function improvement. On top of that, the Korean table setting with freshly cooked pot rice and hand-torn raw kimchi is a pleasant taste that reminds people of their hometown's home-cooked meal. In addition, there are various dishes and foods, such as 4-year-old kimchi, skate, pork, kimchi combo, and octopus’ pancake, so you can enjoy the excellent taste of the mainland of Namdo no matter which menu you choose.
name: [Baeknyeon-gage] Podonamu

The CEO has been boiling chicken soup for the second generation in a cauldron in the traditional way inherited from his mother. Every day at 3:00 am, the day begins by adding water to the cauldron. This is because the first step is to boil the medicinal ingredients, the second is to boil the chicken bones and chicken, and the third is to boil everything with additional water. That way, the broth in the cauldron blends with the well-boiled native chicken to create the best taste. The CEO also believes that all ingredients purchased on the day will be sold out on the same day, maintaining the food's freshness.

desc_l10n.ko: 가마솥에 약재와 닭을 넣어 고아서, 채수를 추가해 끓이는 닭곰탕 맛집

The founder, Choi Hyung-il, the 1st CEO, started as an assistant at Napoleon Confectionery and went up to the deputy head of production. In 2002, he obtained a Master’s of Confectionery Skills. He is a bakery expert who participated in the world competition as a member of the national confectionery team in 2011. Elysee Bakery consists of the main store and two branches. desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} When the meat is placed on the heated stone plate, a pleasant smell catches the nose with light smoke and a sizzling sound. Samcheonpo Restaurant, named after Samcheonpo, the hometown of the founder's spouse, is a stone-grilled grilled pork belly restaurant that has maintained its tenacity by pursuing the taste of grilled pork belly that has not been imitated for 30 years. The founder’s spouse, who is in charge of the kitchen of Samcheonpo Restaurant, worked at restaurants serving items such as grilled pork galbi, ox bone soup, and ox knee soup for three years, learning the skills before starting the business. She has such a high level of cooking skills that she was recommended to become an assistant after completing the Sudo Culinary Institute as a top student. At first, it started as a spicy seafood stew restaurant, but soon after, it was changed to grilled pork belly. At that time, the owners came across stone grilling by chance and began to dig into it professionally. The main menu of Samcheonpo Restaurant is a thinly sliced stone-grilled frozen pork belly. Stone-grilled frozen pork belly, which is different from the once famous low-priced imported frozen pork belly, is made from 60-90 kg female pigs that are not too big. When meat comes in, it is aged for 24 hours in the refrigerator, exposed to room temperature for a short time, then sliced thinly and rapidly cooled according to the temperature and season of the day. Like grilled pork belly, made through a complicated process, their secret kimchi is also made systematically by measuring and reconciling all seasonings without adding salted fish. The tradition of Samcheonpo Restaurant, made with excellent cooking skills, has been passed down to the son, who has been involved in the management for six years.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 焼けた石板の上に肉がのり、薄い煙とシューッという音とともに気持ちの良い香りでいっぱいになります。創業主配偶者の故郷であるサムチョンポ(三千浦)の名前を取ったサムチョンポ(三千浦)食堂は、30年間サムギョプサルの味を追求する石焼きサムギョプサル専門店です。サムチョンポ食堂の厨房を担当している創業者の配偶者は、創業のために3年間豚カルビ、ソルロンタン、トガニタンなどの飲食店で働きながら技術を学び、修道料理学院を首席で履修し、助教を勧められるほど高い料理実力を持っています。最初は海鮮鍋屋として始めましたが、サムギョプサルに変更し、その時偶然接した石板焼きに魅力を感じ専門店として新たにスタートしました。サムチョンポ食堂の主なメニューは薄切りの石焼き冷凍サムギョプサルです。 一時話題になった低価格輸入産の冷凍鉋サムギョプサルとは肉質から異なる石焼き冷凍サムギョプサルは、大きすぎない60~90kgの雌豚を供給されて作られています。肉の仕入れ後、冷蔵庫で24時間熟成し、しばらく常温露出後、当日の温度と季節によって薄く切って急冷して出しています。ややこしい過程を経て作られるサムギョプサルと同様に、秘法キムチも塩辛は一切入れず、すべての調味料は計量化して細かく作られています。卓越した料理の実力で作られるサムチョンポ食堂の伝統は、6年前から経営に携わっている息子に受け継がれています。
desc_l10n.ko: 30년간 냉동 대패 삼겹살을 직접 만들어서 돌판에 굽는 삼겹살 맛집.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 肉放在烧热的石板上,淡淡的烟气、呲呲的声音和令人心情愉悦的味道会扑鼻而来。 以创始人配偶的故乡三千浦的名字命名的三千浦餐厅是30年来一直追求没有模仿过的五花肉味道,坚守韧劲的石烤五花肉专卖店。 负责三千浦餐厅厨房的创始人的配偶为了创业,在猪排、牛杂碎汤、牛膝骨汤等餐厅工作了3年,学习了技术。 以首都料理学院首席进修,被劝导担任助教,拥有很高的料理实力。 刚开始是海鲜汤店,但没过多久就换成了五花肉,当时偶然接触到的石板烤肉很有魅力,所以开始专门研究。 三千浦餐厅的主要菜品是切成薄片的石烤冷冻五花肉。 与一度成为话题的低价进口冷冻刨花五花肉相比,从肉质开始就不同的石烤冷冻五花肉是由60~90公斤母猪供应的。 肉进货后在自家冰箱里发酵24小时,短暂暴露在常温下后,根据当天的温度、季节切成薄片,迅速冷却。 和经过复杂过程制作的五花肉一样,秘方辛奇也是不放任何鱼酱,所有调料都是量化后系统地制作的。 以卓越的料理实力打造的三千浦餐厅的传统延续到了从6年前开始参与经营的儿子身上。

Samcheonpo Restaurant, named after Samcheonpo, the hometown of the founder's spouse, is a stone-grilled grilled pork belly restaurant that has maintained its tenacity by pursuing the taste of grilled pork belly that has not been imitated for 30 years. The founder’s spouse, who is in charge of the kitchen of Samcheonpo Restaurant, worked at restaurants serving items such as grilled pork galbi, ox bone soup, and ox knee soup for three years, learning the skills before starting the business. She has such a high level of cooking skills that she was recommended to become an assistant after completing the Sudo Culinary Institute as a top student. At first, it started as a spicy seafood stew restaurant, but soon after, it was changed to grilled pork belly. At that time, the owners came across stone grilling by chance and began to dig into it professionally. The main menu of Samcheonpo Restaurant is a thinly sliced stone-grilled frozen pork belly. Stone-grilled frozen pork belly, which is different from the once famous low-priced imported frozen pork belly, is made from 60-90 kg female pigs that are not too big. When meat comes in, it is aged for 24 hours in the refrigerator, exposed to room temperature for a short time, then sliced thinly and rapidly cooled according to the temperature and season of the day. Like grilled pork belly, made through a complicated process, their secret kimchi is also made systematically by measuring and reconciling all seasonings without adding salted fish. The tradition of Samcheonpo Restaurant, made with excellent cooking skills, has been passed down to the son, who has been involved in the management for six years.
name: [Baeknyeon-gage] Samcheonpo Restaurant

It is a holy place for bakery pilgrims and a bakery that retains the personality of an old neighborhood bakery. The bakery uses naturally fermented seeds rather than yeast to make healthy bread. It is an emblematic restaurant in Suyu-dong, Gangbuk-gu. All ingredients are sourced directly from the production area, and quality and freshness are controlled. The whole eel is supplied, and when an order comes in, fresh fish are taken out and cooked with a sauce and marinade for 10 hours with fresh vegetables and herbs according to a unique secret method. The side dishes are also handmade daily with domestic ingredients, adding to the richness. The secret to Seomjingang Minmul Jangeo’s long-lasting appreciation is that it provides friendly customer service, such as handwritten letters to guests who make reservations, while sparing no extra services for regular customers.

desc_l10n.ko: 산지작송의 장어와 신선한 야채와 약재로 우려낸 소스 그리고 40년의 정으로 조리한 민물장어 맛집.

Chungsoojang’s main dish is, without a doubt, ‘chungsoo grilled pork galbi.’ The grilled pork galbi cooking and eating methods are different from usual. The meat is usually marinated in seasoning, which softens the original texture and flavor. To preserve the meat’s texture and taste, Chungsoojang grills it immediately without marinating it in a special 'black sauce.' The grilled meat is then dipped into that 'black sauce' and eaten. This sauce can only be enjoyed at Chungsoojang. The salty and somewhat spicy taste gently stimulates the palate, and the sweetness and bitterness linger tantalizingly in the mouth. The crisp texture of raw meat, the rich local flavor, and the subtle taste of seasoning have been loved by many generations.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} チョンスジャンは、1984年に開業したジョンルン(貞陵)のグルメ店です。チョンスジャンの代表メニューは「チョンス豚カルビ」です。調理法と食べ方が普通の豚カルビとは違います。普通、豚カルビは肉をタレに漬けて熟成しますが、この時、肉本来の食感と風味が弱くなっていますため、チョンスジャンでは食感と風味を保つために肉を特製の「黒調味料」に和えて寝かさずにすぐ焼きます。そして焼かれた肉を再びこの黒タレにつけて食べます。このタレはチョンスジャンだけのオリジナルであり、塩味と辛味が柔らかく味覚を刺激し、甘さと苦味が口の中を漂います。生肉のシャキシャキとした食感、ジューシーな肉の風味、そして奥ゆかしい味付けで多くの人から愛されています。
desc_l10n.ko: 1984년 개업한 정릉 최고의 돼지갈비 맛집

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Chungsoojang, which opened in 1984, is the best restaurant in Jeongneung. Chungsoojang’s main dish is, without a doubt, ‘chungsoo grilled pork galbi.’ The grilled pork galbi cooking and eating methods are different from usual. The meat is usually marinated in seasoning, which softens the original texture and flavor. To preserve the meat’s texture and taste, Chungsoojang grills it immediately without marinating it in a special 'black sauce.' The grilled meat is then dipped into that 'black sauce' and eaten. This sauce can only be enjoyed at Chungsoojang. The salty and somewhat spicy taste gently stimulates the palate, and the sweetness and bitterness linger tantalizingly in the mouth. The crisp texture of raw meat, the rich local flavor, and the subtle taste of seasoning have been loved by many generations.
name: [Baeknyeon-gage] Chungsoojang

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} BistroMEXI sets a captivating atmosphere with its blue, emerald hues evoking the Caribbean Sea, energized by vibrant red tones symbolizing the passion of Latin America and drawing inspiration from Aztec patterns. Amidst this ambiance, a 10-meter-wide large-scale media wall displays NFT artists’ works, providing a unique experience of a Mexican tapas lounge where tradition and modernity harmoniously coexist. "Step into a Vibrant Latin Vibe" With three sides adorned with floor-to-ceiling glass, BistroMEXI offers a refreshing sense of openness, capturing the lively ambiance of Itaewon Street at a glance, a view rarely experienced indoors. Here, you can immerse yourself in an exhilarating atmosphere created by renowned domestic and international DJs, blending Latin and African world music with genres like Pop, Hip Hop, and Disco. "Authentic Mexican Tapas Experience" Treat yourself to a delectable selection of over six diverse tacos and various flavorful fajitas, all prepared in the genuine Mexican tradition. At BistroMEXI, you can also enjoy a creative twist on Caribbean cocktails and savor high-quality, rare non-alcoholic concoctions that are not easily found elsewhere. Additionally, we proudly offer the country's largest selection of tequila and mezcal, providing you with a distinctive and exclusive experience that can only be found at BistroMEXI.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 「ビストロメクシィ(bistroMEXI)」は、カリブ海を連想させる青いエメラルド色、ラテンアメリカの情熱を込めた赤い色彩、そしてアズテックの文様からインスピレーションを得た空間を作り上げました。空間に広がる10m幅の超大型メディアウォールのNFTアーティスト作品を通じて、伝統と現代が共存する新概念メキシカンタパスラウンジを体験することができます。 「楽しいラテンバイブの中へ」 三面ガラス張りの空間からは、広々とした梨泰院通りを一望でき、室内では感じられない開放感をお届けします。そして、国内外の有名DJの異国的な情緒が感じられるラテンミュージックやアフリカンワールドミュージックを基盤にPop、Hip Hop、Discoなどのジャンルを加えてより楽しい雰囲気を演出します。 「正統メキシカンタパスと共に」 6種類以上の多様なタコスと各種ファヒータが用意されており、メキシカンスタイルで再解釈したケルビアンカクテルと普段は味わえないハイクオリティノンケアルコールカクテル、そして、国内最多テキーラとメズカルセレクションは、ビストロメキシだけの特別メニューです。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울의 중심 이태원에서 즐기는 멕시칸 바이브, 비스트로 멕시(bistro MEXI)

The original wooden beams, traditional fireplace, courtyard, and wooden porch have been preserved, allowing visitors to experience the tranquil ambiance of an old hanok. The café is adorned with vintage items such as old speakers, record players, cauldrons, and jars, providing plenty of interesting sights. The café features various harmoniously designed spaces, from the courtyard to the attic and basement, making it an excellent spot for capturing photos full of Korean charm. Traditional food and beverages include lotus flower tea with lotus leaves, manggae tteok (rice cake), and Jeju mugwort red bean bread. Located in the trendy Hongdae area, ium 1966 offers a warm and authentic experience of Korean beauty.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ium 1966カフェは、1966年に建てられた古い韓屋をヴィンテージな感性で再生させた空間です。伝統的な韓屋の梁や囲炉裏、中庭や縁側がそのまま残されており、静かな昔の韓屋の情緒を感じることができます。さらに、古いスピーカーや蓄音機、鍋や壺など、ヴィンテージな小物が至る所に配置され、見て楽しむこともできます。 庭から屋根裏部屋、地下まで、調和の取れたさまざまな空間が設けられており、韓国の美しさを存分に感じる写真を撮るのに最適な場所です。蓮の花と蓮の葉を使った蓮茶や、伝統的な食べ物であるマンゲトク、済州ヨモギあんパンなども用意されています。

The original wooden beams, traditional fireplace, courtyard, and wooden porch have been preserved, allowing visitors to experience the tranquil ambiance of an old hanok. The café is adorned with vintage items such as old speakers, record players, cauldrons, and jars, providing plenty of interesting sights. The café features various harmoniously designed spaces, from the courtyard to the attic and basement, making it an excellent spot for capturing photos full of Korean charm. Traditional food and beverages include lotus flower tea with lotus leaves, manggae tteok (rice cake), and Jeju mugwort red bean bread. Located in the trendy Hongdae area, ium 1966 offers a warm and authentic experience of Korean beauty.

It is a delightful hanok café and wine bar, remodeled from a Joseon-era hanok. This cozy yet unique space exudes a rich and inviting atmosphere. The café’s first and second floors are designed with warm wooden accents that create a relaxed ambiance. Climbing up the narrow, steep stairs reveals a rooftop with a breathtaking view of the Jongmyo Shrine Stonewall Path, perfect for soaking in the surroundings. At Café Teumari, guests can enjoy carefully brewed coffee, desserts, beer, wine, and light snacks. This makes it an ideal spot for relaxed conversations with friends, loved ones, or family. Enjoy the cozy, nostalgic atmosphere and create memorable moments in this unique setting.

desc_l10n.ko: 종묘가 보이는 한옥 루프탑 카페이자 와인바

It is a delightful hanok café and wine bar, remodeled from a Joseon-era hanok. This cozy yet unique space exudes a rich and inviting atmosphere. The café’s first and second floors are designed with warm wooden accents that create a relaxed ambiance. Climbing up the narrow, steep stairs reveals a rooftop with a breathtaking view of the Jongmyo Shrine Stonewall Path, perfect for soaking in the surroundings. At Café Teumari, guests can enjoy carefully brewed coffee, desserts, beer, wine, and light snacks. This makes it an ideal spot for relaxed conversations with friends, loved ones, or family. Enjoy the cozy, nostalgic atmosphere and create memorable moments in this unique setting.
name: Teumari Cafe

The design contrasts light and dark elements, leading you from a dim hallway into a bright space with a large, floor-to-ceiling window. The spacious second floor, furnished with a long communal table and plenty of seating, provides an ideal setting for working. In addition to a selection of desserts and coffee, the café offers wine and herbal teas. Drinks are served directly to your table, eliminating the need for buzzers, and convenient parking is also available.

desc_l10n.ko: 무게감 있는 인테리어의 카페 <앤트러사이트 연희점>

It features a simple interior and a nostalgic atmosphere reminiscent of the past. The food generously uses ingredients and emphasizes a taste that stays true to the basics. Their fried meat — a dish rarely found in other Chinese restaurants — is Gabongru's signature menu item, seasoned with salt and pepper to offer a light and clean flavor. The taste of their jjambbong (spicy seafood noodle soup), tangsuyuk (sweet and sour pork), and jajangmyeon (black bean noodles) is also exceptional.

Located in a house designed in 1972 by Kim Chung Up, a representative figure of modern Korean architecture in the 20th century, the space has been sensitively remodeled. Preserving as much as possible the stories carried by the original walls, windows, and floors, the building has been modernly reinterpreted. Operated as a bakery café, all bread is baked fresh daily, and leftovers are discarded at the end of the day.

Featured on the well-known Korean food show "Heo Young-man's Baekban Journey," it has solidified its reputation as one of Seochon's top dining spots. The restaurant offers a single dish: stir-fried pork gopchang with vegetables, with the option to add fried rice. The flavor is mildly spicy with a satisfying kick, as the gochujang (Korean chili paste) deeply infuses the pork intestines, making it irresistibly delicious. Pairing it with a cold beer or soju completes the perfect meal. With only about five tables inside, arriving before peak hours is best to avoid long waits.

desc_l10n.ko: 허영만의 백반기행에 출연한 서촌의 곱창 맛집, 별미곱창

The restaurant offers clear pork gomtang made from pork broth slowly simmered at low temperature and high pressure, as well as Pyeongyang style mul naengmyeon and pork cheek seaweed soup. As suggested by the name HAU, the warm gomtang refreshes the body while the cold noodles provide a cooling experience that helps overcome summer heat.

desc_l10n.ko: 맑게 우려낸 돼지 육수를 바탕으로 속이 시원해지는 곰탕 맛집

You can experience the process of completing your own warm Bungeoppang by pouring the batter into the mold, choosing your desired fillings, and baking it yourself. Going beyond a cafe where you simply enjoy beverages and desserts, its greatest charm is feeling the fun of making and the joy of eating together. Since you can also take photos in the cutely conceptualized space, it is well-suited for a special date with a friend or lover, or a family outing course with a child.

You can experience the process of completing your own warm Bungeoppang by pouring the batter into the mold, choosing your desired fillings, and baking it yourself. Going beyond a cafe where you simply enjoy beverages and desserts, its greatest charm is feeling the fun of making and the joy of eating together. Since you can also take photos in the cutely conceptualized space, it is well-suited for a special date with a friend or lover, or a family outing course with a child.
name: Unique Cafe 'Tiki Room'

Starting as a snack bar, Wangjjanggu Restaurant has traces of time scattered throughout the premises. There, you can enjoy not only hearty stew dishes but also taste Korean snacks such as sweet potato stew, fish cakes, and sikhye (Sweet Rice Punch). Wangjjanggu Restaurant's signature dish is Gogumamattang (Deep-fried and Sugar-Glazed Sweet Potatoes), which pairs excellently with freshly cooked ramen. It has been in business for 40 years and offers a taste of traditional Korean flavors.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} With a tradition of 30 years, Shin Migyeong Hongdae Dakgalbi is a must visit restaurant in Seoul that is famous in Hongdae, Seongsu, and Yeonnam dong. With a 30 year secret recipe and cooking on an extra large cast iron griddle, it offers deep and rich flavors. As the original restaurant of the most famous cheese fondue dakgalbi in Seoul, it is an essential destination representing Korean gourmet culture. You can experience authentic K Dakgalbi with the aroma of the Maillard reaction completed on an 86 kg cast iron griddle. The signature menus, cheese fondue dakgalbi and snowflake cheese fried rice, are the courses most loved by foreign visitors. With English and Chinese service and an official website supporting nine languages in eight countries, it is very convenient for overseas tourists.

Featuring seasonal fruits, the desserts are meticulously crafted with attention to sweetness, ensuring guests enjoy them at their best. Its signature menu includes various types of bingsu (shaved ice dessert) topped with traditional ingredients or seasonal fruits. The sweet and refreshing bingsu, made with shaved milk ice, is a summer delicacy that helps momentarily forget the heat. Among them, the Injeolmi Sulbing, which includes nutty soybean powder and chewy rice cakes, is a bestseller that is popular with people of all ages. Besides bingsu, the café also sells a variety of Korean desserts such as cheese garaetteok (rice cake stick), kkul hotteok (honey-filled Korean pancake), and tteokbokki (stir-fried rice cake). This dessert cafe captivates Koreans and foreigners with its traditional, creative, and popular desserts.

desc_l10n.ko: 한국의 전통 디저트 카페 브랜드, 설빙

The 2nd branch is located near the 1st Seochon branch (main branch), and if both the 1st and 2nd branches are full, you can enjoy Scoff's desserts at Hyoja Cafe, where outside food is permitted.

The restaurant is known for its unique dough, blending 40% soybean flour with regular flour, rolled thin, and hand-cut to create soft noodles and a flavorful, aromatic broth. The signature dish is handmade kalguksu, served in a clear anchovy-based broth with fresh cabbage, providing a clean and delicate taste. Customers can adjust the flavor to their liking by adding soy sauce, extra spicy chili peppers, and minced garlic. Cabbage leaves served as a side dish can be used to make wraps with soybean paste and millet rice, offering a unique and flavorful experience. In addition to kalguksu, popular dishes include chewy boiled pork slices and crispy cabbage pancakes. Enjoy a memorable and satisfying meal at Andongjip Sonkalguksi, which brings the best of Korean cuisine to your table with its rich, traditional flavors.

It is an oriental speakeasy bar that originated in Sindang-dong. The name Sindang-dong originally meant “a neighborhood that worships gods,” as many shamans settled around Gwanghuimun Gate, though its Chinese characters have changed over time. This historical and cultural significance has been reinterpreted through the 12 zodiac animals, creating a mysterious and enchanting atmosphere unique to Zoosindang. At Zoosindang, you can enjoy 12 Zodiac Signature Cocktails made with traditional Korean liquor and various whiskies. The bar also offers distinctive dining menus, developed through extensive research and experimentation with Korean ingredients and cooking techniques, embodying Zoosindang's unique style.

Perched on a high vantage point, it offers a panoramic view of Jongno’s streets. The giant ginkgo tree in the garden is a popular photo spot for visitors. In autumn, many return to capture the tree’s golden leaves. Famous for its rich-flavored coffee and sweet pound cake, the café also showcases a variety of charming knick-knacks. Since it doubles as a concept store, guests can browse retro-themed items while enjoying the café’s atmosphere. On the second floor, a cozy bookstore is a great spot to explore during your visit.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ソチョン(西村)に位置する「STAFF PICKS」は、自然が美しい屋外テラスが特徴的なカフェです。高台にあるため、チョンノ(鍾路)の街並みが一望できます。庭にある大きなイチョウの木は、このカフェを訪れる人々に人気のフォトスポットとなっています。秋になると、黄色く染まったイチョウを思い出し、再び訪れる人が後を絶ちません。深みのあるコーヒーと甘いパウンドケーキが評判の名店で、店内にはさまざまな可愛らしい小物が展示されています。また、セレクトショップも兼ねており、レトロな小物を見ながら目でも楽しめるカフェです。さらに、2階には雰囲気のある書店もあるので、カフェを訪れた際には併せてチェックすることをお勧めします。
desc_l10n.ko: 커다란 나무와 푸른 정원이 있는 서촌의 카페

It offers visitors the chance to enjoy coffee while admiring the underwater scenery. Large tanks that vividly recreate a natural aquatic ecosystem surround the cafe, providing visitors with a rich visual experience from anywhere in the venue. The tanks, decorated with driftwood and aquatic plants, house dozens of different fish species, and the sound of flowing water and lighting create a mysterious atmosphere. It is a popular spot where people of all ages can relax and unwind. The cafe also provides high chairs for children. Additionally, there is a small shop where visitors can purchase fish, aquarium supplies, and mini terrariums. Since the entrance fee is included in the price of the beverages, it is relatively more expensive than other cafes.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} アクアガーデンカフェは、アクアリウムとカフェが合わさり、水の中の風景を鑑賞しながらコーヒーを楽しめるユニークな空間です。自然そのままの水中生態系を生き生きと再現した大型水槽が店内全体を囲んでおり、どこからでも大型水槽を楽しむことができます。流木と水草で飾られた水槽の中には数十種類の多様な魚種が泳いでおり、水が流れる音と照明は神秘的な雰囲気を醸し出します。ひと休みにぴったりな場所として、老若男女問わず人気です。 カフェには子供用のベビーチェアが用意されています。また、小さな別の店舗が一緒にあり、そこで魚や水槽用品、ミニテラリウムなどを購入することができます。ドリンク代に入場料が含まれているため、一般的なカフェに比べて価格帯がある方です。
desc_l10n.ko: 물멍이 가능한 이색 카페, 아쿠아가든카페
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Aqua Garden Cafe是一个将水族馆和咖啡馆结合在一起的地方，是一个可以欣赏水中美景并享受咖啡的独特空间。整个店内环绕着生动再现自然水下生态的大型水族箱，访客无论身处何处都可以享受丰富的视觉盛宴。水族箱内装饰有沉木和水草，游动着数十种不同种类的鱼，流水的声音和灯光营造出神秘的氛围。这里是一个不论男女老少都能享受休憩的地方，因此一直备受欢迎。 咖啡馆内还为孩子们准备了儿童座椅。此外，店内还有一个小卖部，可以购买鱼类、水族箱用品和迷你生态瓶。由于饮料费用已包含入场费，因此相比其他咖啡馆价格稍高一些。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} The Mirrorroom, a hanok cafe in Samcheong-dong, offers a contemporary take on the 100-year-old birthplace of the renowned artist Jang Seung-eop. The spacious area preserves the traditional hanok rafters, while the outdoor terrace features a wooden veranda, providing a peaceful and authentic hanok ambiance. The cafe's most striking feature is its mirrored walls, which, paired with large windows framing lush greenery, create an airy and refreshing atmosphere. The lights reflecting off the mirrors in the evening produce a beautiful and distinctive visual experience. Aligned with its nature-inspired ethos, the cafe serves a menu made from fresh, natural ingredients. Guests can savor a selection of fruit teas and wines, such as apple tea, plum tea, and omija tea, along with dessert options like apple tree croffles.

desc_l10n.ko: 100년된 한옥을 현대적으로 재해석한 카페, 거울 한옥 미러룸

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Sindang-dong Tteokbokki Town, located in Jung-gu, Seoul, is known as the birthplace of jeukseok tteokbokki, a style of rice cake dish that is cooked and eaten directly at the table. Beginning with the restaurant opened by Grandma Ma Bok-rim in 1953, the entire alley became lined with specialty tteokbokki restaurants. It is a place where visitors can experience the history and tradition of Korean street food culture while enjoying a variety of flavors and nostalgic charm. Variations such as seafood, jjajang (black bean sauce), and dakbal (spicy chicken feet) tteokbokki are also available. Popular restaurants include Ma Bok-rim Tteokbokki, I Love Sindang-dong, and Samdae Halmeonne. Although the number of visitors has declined in recent years, it remains a well-known destination for street food lovers and tourists as one of Korea’s representative snack streets.

Beginning with the restaurant opened by Grandma Ma Bok-rim in 1953, the entire alley became lined with specialty tteokbokki restaurants. It is a place where visitors can experience the history and tradition of Korean street food culture while enjoying a variety of flavors and nostalgic charm. Variations such as seafood, jjajang (black bean sauce), and dakbal (spicy chicken feet) tteokbokki are also available. Popular restaurants include Ma Bok-rim Tteokbokki, I Love Sindang-dong, and Samdae Halmeonne. desc_l10n.ko: 80년대 감성을 간직한 사이폰 커피와 프라페

The store also sells Da Yi teas and tea utensils. Even if you are not familiar with tea brewing methods, the café staff will guide you through the techniques, making it easy for anyone to enjoy Pu’erh tea. In addition to the tea brewing menu, the café offers a range of unique beverages made with their custom espresso machine, including Kingpresso (a machine-pressed Pu’erh tea), tea ades, and tea smoothies. You can also indulge in Korean-style café desserts, such as milk tea and shaved ice.

You can feel the retro sensibility of the old water intake station itself, which bears the traces of time, and because it is situated at a point overlooking the Hangang Bridge and Nodeulseom Island, you can appreciate a beautiful night view. In addition, media art programs and cultural events are held, transforming the space to be even more colorful.

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Café Lounge Heeum, Korea’s first fine drink omakase café, began as a project by artist Kim Jihee. Much like crafting an art piece, Lounge Heeum’s art brew omakase course is designed to offer connoisseurs a refined and meaningful experience. Behind the art studio, the space has been transformed into a modern interpretation of a 19th-century European train, inspired by Kim Jihee's artwork 'The Trunk Series.' Bringing the spirit of a journey into the unknown through taste, aroma, art, and atmosphere, Lounge Heeum delivers a dynamic and curated experience with each season. With a blend of elegance and freedom, Lounge Heeum invites guests to leave the mundane and savor a truly memorable moment.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} カフェ「LOUNGE HEEUM」は、作家キム·ジヒの作品から始まった、韓国初のファインドリンクのおまかせカフェです。芸術作品を創り上げるように、心を込めたアートブリューのおまかせコースを通じて、愛好家の方々に価値ある休息を提案します。ギャラリーの裏で作品を制作し、閉ざされていたスタジオの小さな空間を開き、作品<トランクシリーズ>のモチーフとなった19世紀のヴィンテージヨーロッパの汽車内部をモダンに再現しました。未知のキャンバスに向かう旅の空気を、味や香り、作品、そして空間に表現した「LOUNGE HEEUM」は、シーズンごとのキュレーションによって生き生きとした特別な体験を提供します。少し優雅に、少し自由に私たちを包み込む「LOUNGE HEEUM」の時間が、何気なく過ぎゆく日常の感覚を呼び覚ます、意義ある体験となることを願っています。
desc_l10n.ko: 국내 최초 파인드링크 오마카세 카페 라운지 희움.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 咖啡厅Lounge Heeum是以kimjihee作家的作品出发的韩国首家FINE DRINK Omakase咖啡厅，像制作艺术作品一样，通过精心策划的Art Brew Omakase服务，为咖啡爱好者们提供一种别具价值的休闲体验。在画廊后方创作作品时，打开关闭的工作室小空间，巧妙地以现代手法展现了作品《后备箱系列》的核心主题——模拟19世纪复古欧洲火车的内部场景。将前往未知领域的旅行以空气为载体，携带各种味道与香气，将作品与空间巧妙地融入一个充满喜悦的休息室中，通过四季更迭的策展设计，呈现生动而特别的体验作为珍贵的礼物。希望能这种体验能够暂时唤醒我们内心深处对优雅与自由的向往，让我们在休息室中悠然自得地享受时光，感受那些日常中不经意间流逝的喜悦瞬间。

With two locations—one in Seochon and another in Bukchon—this café offers a tranquil and cozy atmosphere as soon as you step inside, making it the perfect place to experience Sinola’s distinctive charm. The space is adorned with vintage decor, adding visual warmth. At the same time, the gentle sound of LP records playing in the background enhances the peaceful ambiance, creating an ideal setting for focus and relaxation. desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} CAFÉ SINOLA ソチョン(西村)店は、キョンボックン(景福宮)トルダムギル(石垣道)に沿ってソチョン(西村)方面へ歩いていくと現れるカフェです。ソチョン(西村)とプクチョン(北村)にそれぞれ店舗があります。店内に入ると、CAFÉ SINOLAならではの落ち着いた雰囲気が広がり、まさにゆったりとした時間を楽しむのにぴったりです。ヴィンテージ感漂う小物が随所に飾られ、穏やかに流れるLPレコードの音と相まって、集中できる環境が整っています。ドリップコーヒーの美味しさを求めて訪れる人も多く、ブランチメニューも評判です。特に、ふわふわのフレンチトーストが人気のメニューです。
desc_l10n.ko: 서촌에 위치한 프렌치토스트가 맛있는 카페

With two locations—one in Seochon and another in Bukchon—this café offers a tranquil and cozy atmosphere as soon as you step inside, making it the perfect place to experience Sinola’s distinctive charm. The space is adorned with vintage decor, adding visual warmth. At the same time, the gentle sound of LP records playing in the background enhances the peaceful ambiance, creating an ideal setting for focus and relaxation. Known for its exceptional drip coffee, Sinola also serves a highly praised brunch menu. The soft, decadent French toast is a favorite among visitors, drawing many to return for its delightful taste.
name: Cafe Sinola

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Jeong-dong Chueotang is a popular restaurant for chueotang (loach soup) located in Jeong-dong. During lunchtime, it is bustling with nearby office workers. Chueotang is a soup dish made with loach as the main ingredient, along with various vegetables and seasonings, resulting in a rich and deep flavor. The special feature of Jeong-dong Chueotang is that it comes with rice cooked in a stone pot, allowing you to enjoy crispy rice at the end of the meal. They also serve thin noodles, which can be added to the chueotang along with various prepared sauces. For those who are not fond of loach, there are alternative options such as pork chueotang (donchutang), loach soup with beef brisket (usamgyeop chueotang), and beef stew (soegogi tteokbaegi bulgogi). Additionally, side dishes like fried loach (chuotwigim) and loach dumplings (chuomandu) are recommended. This restaurant is a great place to visit on a cold day, for a hangover remedy, or to replenish energy.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} チョンドン(貞洞)にある「チョンドンチュオタン」は、昼食時になると近くの会社員たちで賑わう人気店です。チュオタンはどじょうを主な材料としたスープ料理で、どじょうに色々な野菜と調味料を加えて煮込んだ深く濃厚な味わいが特徴です。「チョンドンチュオタン」の人気の秘訣は、どじょうスープと一緒に釜炊きご飯が運ばれ、最後におこげを楽しむことができるところです。またそうめんも一緒に出てくるため、どじょうスープにそうめんや様々なソースを入れて楽しむのもおすすめです。どじょうが苦手な方には、豚肉入りの豚チュオタンや牛バラ入りの牛バラチュオタン、牛肉の石鍋プルコギなど、好みに合わせてメニューを選べます。さらに、各メニューと一緒に楽しめるどじょうの天ぷらやどじょう餃子もおすすめです。寒い日や二日酔い解消、あるいはスタミナ補給が必要な時にぴったりのお店です。
desc_l10n.ko: 추어탕을 맛볼 수 있는 정동의 추어탕맛집
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 位于贞洞的贞洞泥鳅汤餐厅，一到午餐时间便挤满了周边公司的职员。这家餐厅的招牌泥鳅汤，是以泥鳅为主要食材，搭配各式蔬菜和调料精心熬制而成，味道醇厚浓郁。贞洞泥鳅汤的特色在于，它不仅提供泥鳅汤，还会将锅饭一同上桌，让食客能享受到最后那层香脆的锅巴。此外，餐厅还备有素面，顾客可以将素面加入泥鳅汤中，再依个人口味添加调料，同样美味无比。对于那些不太偏好泥鳅的顾客，餐厅也贴心地准备了其他选择，如猪肉汤、牛五花泥鳅汤以及牛肉砂锅烤肉，确保每位顾客都能找到心仪的菜品。更值得推荐的是，这里的炸泥鳅和泥鳅饺子与各类菜品都极为相配，是绝佳的搭配选择。无论是寒冷天气里想要暖身，还是需要解酒或补充体力时，贞洞泥鳅汤餐厅都是一个不容错过的好去处。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Jeong-dong Chueotang is a popular restaurant for chueotang (loach soup) located in Jeong-dong. During lunchtime, it is bustling with nearby office workers. Chueotang is a soup dish made with loach as the main ingredient, along with various vegetables and seasonings, resulting in a rich and deep flavor. The special feature of Jeong-dong Chueotang is that it comes with rice cooked in a stone pot, allowing you to enjoy crispy rice at the end of the meal. They also serve thin noodles, which can be added to the chueotang along with various prepared sauces. For those who are not fond of loach, there are alternative options such as pork chueotang (donchutang), loach soup with beef brisket (usamgyeop chueotang), and beef stew (soegogi tteokbaegi bulgogi). Additionally, side dishes like fried loach (chuotwigim) and loach dumplings (chuomandu) are recommended. This restaurant is a great place to visit on a cold day, for a hangover remedy, or to replenish energy.
name: Jeong-dong Chueotang
