Although it’s a small space, the unique interior design, sunlight streaming through the windows, and soft music from the well-placed speakers make it a one-of-a-kind, distinctive spot. Here, visitors are welcomed with unique drinks and desserts such as chai, an Indian milk tea; Swedish cardamom buns; and cheddar cheese meat pies. Although it’s a small space, the unique interior design, sunlight streaming through the windows, and soft music from the well-placed speakers make it a one-of-a-kind, distinctive spot. Here, visitors are welcomed with unique drinks and desserts such as chai, an Indian milk tea; Swedish cardamom buns; and cheddar cheese meat pies. Especially popular is the filter coffee, which changes monthly with a new specialty bean, drawing people back regularly. While finding the entrance can be challenging, this only adds to the charm, making it a fun mystery for visitors.

Now a cornerstone of the Jangmi Shopping Center, the restaurant is especially renowned for its "tteokjjolla," a unique dish that combines chewy noodles and ramen with traditional tteokbokki. Their fried rice is also highly recommended, and it's perfect for sharing if you visit with a friend. Having operated for decades, Bbobbai Bunsik attracts many customers who come to relive childhood memories, as well as young people who enjoy the nostalgic ambiance. It's also a hit among office workers at lunchtime, thanks to its great value. Most visitors love how the tteokbokki evokes memories of the snacks they used to enjoy outside their schools.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 1983年創業のポパイブンシク(軽食)は、チャムシル(蚕室)にある老舗のトッポッキ名店で、現在はチャンミ商店街のランドマーク的な存在となっています。ここではトッポッキよりも「トッチョルラ」が有名で、トッポッキにチョルミョンとラーメンが追加されたメニューです。チャーハンも絶品で、２人で訪れた場合はトッチョルラとチャーハンを一緒に注文すれば満足できる食事となるでしょう。老舗であるため、子どもの頃の思い出を懐かしむために訪れる人も多く、昔ながらの雰囲気を楽しみたい若者たちもよく足を運びます。また、コストの良さからランチタイムには多くの会社員が訪れます。客の多くは、子どもの頃に学校の前で食べた懐かしいトッポッキの味を感じると話しています。

Now a cornerstone of the Jangmi Shopping Center, the restaurant is especially renowned for its "tteokjjolla," a unique dish that combines chewy noodles and ramen with traditional tteokbokki. Their fried rice is also highly recommended, and it's perfect for sharing if you visit with a friend. Having operated for decades, Bbobbai Bunsik attracts many customers who come to relive childhood memories, as well as young people who enjoy the nostalgic ambiance. It is a family-run restaurant that serves both anju and haejangramyeon, and a shop that serves as a neighborhood love room. The owner's heart for the ironworkers who work early in the morning has been conveyed to the customers, making them feel like neighbors. A bowl of noodle soup with the pride of being not just an iron business, but a shop that has been around for a long time, thin as noodles, leaves a warm feeling even today.

Its signature dish, Chili Eggplant, is particularly famous; it combines a unique crispiness with a garlic-infused chili sauce that can’t be found elsewhere, making it a must-try for anyone visiting LaiLai. In addition to this, you can enjoy a wide range of Chinese dishes commonly found in Chinese restaurants, such as Jjajangmyeon, Jjamppong, Sanlatang, and Lazogibap. The Jjamppong is both flavorful and clean-tasting, and the tender, savory Tangsuyuk are also highly recommended dishes. The restaurant is divided into a main dining hall and private rooms, so if you prefer a quieter dining experience, reservations can be made for private room use.

desc_l10n.ko: 연희동에 위치한 칠리가지가 맛있는 중식당

It's a large cafe converted from a house, where you can even use the rooftop. The interior design features a theme reminiscent of the ocean depths, with media art, jellyfish lighting, coral, and shells. You can find various photo spots throughout, and experience the deep sea in everyday life. We recommend trying the signature Wave Cream Latte, where blue foam resembles an ocean within your coffee.

The signature menu, Northern-style Samgye Baekban (Ginseng Chicken Set Meal), features a broth that is thick and milky white, achieved by simmering chicken in an iron cauldron for a long time. It is highly popular not only among foreign tourists but also among local office workers and the younger generation, making it a place where waiting is essential.

desc_l10n.ko: 가마솥으로 끓인 진한 육수가 특징인 닭 요리 전문점

Its unique setup does not include a traditional bar counter but tatami room-style seating areas. The space and menu are thoughtfully curated to offer guests a new whisky experience. In addition to whisky, the bar offers a wide range of beverages, including wine, beer, and cocktails. Their house-infused whiskies, featuring flavors like strawberry, mugwort, and mokmil, are ideal even for whisky newcomers. The bar also offers thoughtfully paired dishes such as rice cakes, yakgwa (honey cookie), cherry cheesecake, and basil pesto parfait, offering a satisfying experience for both taste and sight.

As soon as you enter the store, you can encounter the unique sight of bread being baked and fried directly. You can purchase items such as Feast Focaccia that expresses Korean jeon as focaccia, Gat Financier that contains the history of the Joseon Dynasty, and Guksundang Makgeolli Bread that captures traditional flavors using Guksundang makgeolli. Owner Mabokrim developed a secret recipe by mixing gochujang and chunjang black bean paste), which is characterized by its sweet flavor. A major attraction is the ability to cook tteokbokki directly at the table, allowing customers to enjoy personalized tteokbokki by adding a variety of toppings. Five years before her passing, Owner Mabokrim passed her secret recipe to her daughter-in-law, and the restaurant continues to uphold that delicious flavor to this day.

The space is adorned with shelves filled with CDs, antique furniture, and retro decor, creating a relaxing environment for guests. The lush green trees visible through the windows provide a serene view that enhances concentration, while the inviting aroma of hand-drip coffee, freshly brewed by the owner, fills the air. The space is thoughtfully arranged with seating options for both groups and those who prefer a quiet moment alone, making it a perfect spot for all. In addition to coffee, the menu includes a selection of alcoholic beverages such as whiskey and cocktails, making it a great place to visit in the evening for those looking to enjoy a drink.

The use of traditional Korean patterns in the interior, tableware inspired by Joseon white porcelain, and the use of seasonal ingredients sourced from all over the country have added authenticity and elegance to La Yeon. La Yeon's cuisine delicately reinterprets the flavors of Korea with modern cooking techniques, and it pairs well with wine to offer a unique culinary experience.

desc_l10n.ko: 라연은 한국을 대표하는 한식 레스토랑으로, 미쉐린 스타를 획득.

During peak crab seasons in June and December, they purchase crabs in bulk, rapidly freezing and storing them at -35°C. This process ensures that fresh and flavorful crabs are available year-round, with the use of female crabs adding an extra layer of taste to the dish. The soy-marinated crabs at Jinmi Sikdang are aged for three days in soy sauce fermented with Seosan ginger before being served. The meal comes with over ten side dishes, including gyeranjjim (steamed eggs), spicy crab stew, eoriguljeot (spicy salted oysters), and gamtae (seaweed), providing a rich variety of flavors. The restaurant is also a popular spot among celebrities and well-known figures.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 西海で獲れたワタリガニだけを使ったカンジャンケジャンメニューを提供しているチンミ食堂は、ワタリガニのシーズンである6月と12月に大量購入し、摂氏マイナス35度で急速冷却・保存したワタリガニのみを使用しています。そのため、ワタリガニのシーズンでなくても常に新鮮で美味しいカニを味わうことができ、メスのカニを使用してより美味しいケジャンを楽しめるのが特長です。 チンミ食堂で食べられるカンジャンケジャンは、ソサン(瑞山)の生姜を入れて発酵させた醤油で3日間熟成させてから提供されます。また、一緒に出される土鍋の茶碗蒸しや温かいケグクチ(カニとキムチを煮込んだ料理)、味付けカキの塩辛、カムテ(海藻類)など、10種類以上のおかずがあり、さまざまな味を楽しむことができます。多くの芸能人や著名人も訪れる場所です。
desc_l10n.ko: 미쉐린 가이드 서울 2025에 등록된 게장맛집
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 真味餐厅推出了只用在西海捕捞的梭子蟹腌制的酱蟹菜单，在梭子蟹季节的6月和12月大量购买，只使用在摄氏负35度下迅速冷却保管的梭子蟹。尽管不是梭子蟹的盛产季节，依然能够品尝到新鲜且可口的螃蟹。特别是选择母蟹制作出更加美味的蟹酱，这正是它的一个显著优点。 在真味餐厅可以吃的酱螃蟹是放入瑞山生姜，在发酵的酱油中发酵3天后上客桌的。同时上来的砂锅鸡蛋羹、蟹汤池、牡蛎酱、甘苔（海藻类）等10多种配菜，可以品尝到各种各样的菜肴。 这里也是很多艺人和知名人士经常光顾的地方。

The restaurant is also a popular spot among celebrities and well-known figures.

The exotic furnishings and vintage arched windows harmoniously blend to create a unique, restrained yet strikingly glamorous atmosphere. The minimalist and tasteful interior design with a mid-century modern style and trendy lounge music further enhances the opulence. Together, they create an ambiance of limitless charm and appeal. Glam Lounge takes inspiration from Japanese cuisine and incorporates various Asian flavors to develop a diverse menu. Using seasonal fresh fish, the lounge creates sushi and sashimi dishes that offer a gourmet experience not commonly found in traditional lounges. In addition, a carefully curated selection of signature cocktails and a trendy wine list complement the culinary offerings, providing the utmost service to stylish and discerning consumers. The menu and beverage list are updated annually to ensure that Glam Lounge stays harmoniously with the latest trends.

It offers a private, reservation-based storytelling tea course featuring seasonal teas and traditional Korean sweets (dasik). (Reservations can be made via Naver TalkTalk or Instagram DM. A la carte menu items are available for walk-in guests.) Located in the heart of the city, OMOT provides a healing experience where guests can fully enjoy personal time while embracing a new tea culture and a healthy, meaningful lifestyle. The shop also sells signature niche teas, single-origin teas, tableware, and handcrafted items.

Inspired by the cantinas of San Cristóbal, this Mexican-Chinese tequila pub brings a tough and moody charm that captivates you from the moment you step inside. Step into a dark, secretive tiger’s den glowing with orange flames, where intense stares and loud toasts fill the air. In the basement, beneath glowing red neon lights, an uninhibited tequila lounge unfolds—perfect for bold conversations and fiery energy. Signature Mexican dishes like tacos, quesadillas, and nachos are infused with a Chinese twist, creating a truly unique flavor. A tequila-glazing performance over a blazing 300-degree open flame adds to the full sensory experience. MexiTiger is one of Gangnam’s must-visit gourmet destinations.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} MEXITIGERはメキシコヒッピーたちの都市です。 サン・クリストバル・カンティーナをモチーフに仕上げたタフな魅力のメキシカンチャイニーズテキーラパブです。メキシコならではの濃いムードがあり、入口に入った瞬間からその雰囲気に圧倒されます。 オレンジ色の炎が揺れる暗くて神秘的な虎の巣窟には、ねっとりとした目つきと豪快な乾杯の音が満ちています。地下には、赤く広がるネオンサインの下で気兼ねなく話を交わす空間、テキーララウンジがあります。 タコス、ケサディーヤ、ナチョスなどアイコニックなメキシコ料理にチャイニーズのキックを加えた特色あるメニュー。300度の大型かまどで繰り広げられるテキーラグレージングパフォーマンスまで、江南を代表するグルメ空間です。
desc_l10n.ko: 산 크리스토발 칸티나를 모티브로 완성한 터프한 매력의 멕시칸 차이니즈 데낄라펍

It is a traditional herbal tea specialty cafe operated based on the know-how of the Food Business Division of Jongno Gangnam Oriental Medicine Clinic, established in 1967. Traditional herbal teas recreate the exact methods historically used to present offerings to the king, while adapting the flavors to suit modern tastes, allowing them to be enjoyed comfortably.

desc_l10n.ko: 전통한방 비법은 살리고 현대인의 입맛은 살린 프리미엄 한방차 카페

They make their own homemade miso and soy sauce, and continue their philosophy of not cheating customers with their food. The restaurant has been renovated from an old family house, giving it a homey atmosphere, and many regular customers come from far and wide to enjoy the exquisite food.

desc_l10n.ko: 포근한 가정집 분위기를 느끼며 맛보는 묵밥과 만두

The noodles have a delightful texture, being both chewy and soft, while the broth is prepared by simmering beef bones and various secret ingredients to create a deep and flavorful taste. If you are in Seoul, we highly recommend a refreshing bowl of cold noodles at Yeonbaek naengmyeon.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ヨンベク冷麺は、薄い麺と深いスープで有名な冷麺店です。ヨンベク冷麺の麺は、コシがあって柔らかい食感が絶品で、出汁は牛骨を8種類の秘法材料と一緒に煮込み、深い風味を出します。ソウルを訪れたら、ヨンベク冷麺をぜひ味わってみてください。

Offering a variety of beans, it caters to all tastes, guided by detailed tasting notes. A highlight of this café is its expansive view of the Hangang River, which enhances the coffee-drinking experience. Large windows offer panoramic views of Seogangdaegyo Bridge, Bamseom Island, and the National Assembly Building. This creates a unique atmosphere that perfectly complements the rich coffee flavors, ensuring customers keep coming back. On the 6th floor, the coffee bar offers a chance to explore Bean Brothers' seasonal coffees in diverse ways. From the “Coffee Flight,” which features three different coffees from various origins, to the coffee of the month and cocktails, there is a wide range of special seasonal beverages to enjoy. However, the seasonal coffee bar operates on a reservation basis, so be sure to book your visit in advance.

Chowol follows traditional brewing methods using only rice, nuruk, and water. It uses Haenam rice, grown in Korea’s southernmost tip where fertile plains meet sea breezes. Through makgeolli, Chowol connects past and present, and bridges the rural and the urban.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} マッコリを超越する、地下鉄5号線「マポ」駅と地下鉄5号線/6号線/空港鉄道/キョンイ・チュンアン線「コンドク」駅の間に位置する都心の醸造所『チョウォル』 チョウォルは米、麹、水だけを利用する伝統的な方法を追求し、肥沃な平野で海風に当たって育った韓国の最南端に位置する海南の米を使用し、マッコリを通じて過去と現在をつなぎ、農村と都市をつないでいきます。

Through makgeolli, Chowol connects past and present, and bridges the rural and the urban.

The menu offers only these two items, showcasing the owner's pride in their food. Each order is cooked immediately, allowing you to savor the rich red bean flavor and the chewy texture of the rice dumplings (ongsimi). Many regular customers return for its soft and rich taste that they can't forget. If you find it lacking in seasoning, you can adjust the flavor to your taste with the sugar and salt on the table. The friendly owner and delicious side dishes make this restaurant a favorite among people of all ages. A hearty bowl of warm red bean porridge is perfect for cold winter days, and visiting the restaurant on Dongji (the Winter Solstice) is highly recommended.

desc_l10n.ko: 팥죽과 팥칼국수를 전문으로하는 신당동 천팥죽

Some customers have been coming to the restaurant for three generations because it has remained in the same place for a long time with flavors that stimulate the childhood feelings of people in their 70s and 80s. The interior of the restaurant, which has maintained the same interior as it was in those days, is a place filled with memories of regular customers. desc_l10n.ko: 석촌호수 산책하다가 들리기 좋은 디저트 맛집

Including kalguksu menus, it provides Korean dishes suitable for both lunch and dinner gatherings, such as pork cutlet, steamed pork bones, and seafood green onion pancakes.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} パルドミルバン カンナム(江南)本店は、カンナム(江南)駅エリアで多彩なカルグクスと伝統的な韓国のお膳料理を楽しめる韓国料理店です。 カルグクスをはじめ、トンカツ、チョンゴル、パジョン、ピョッチムなど、バラエティ豊かな韓国の味を一つの空間で体験でき、清潔感のあるおかずと共に満足感たっぷりの食事を味わえます。 お昼は会社員のランチや、お一人様での気軽な食事に最適。夜はチョンゴルやピョッチム、海鮮パジョンを囲みながら、お酒を楽しむ飲み会や集まりの場としてもおすすめです。 本格的な韓国のお膳スタイルで提供されるため、外国人観光客の方も気軽にK-Foodを体験することができます。 江南駅からのアクセスも抜群で、ソウル旅行中に韓国料理をゆっくりと楽しみたい方にぴったりのスポットです。

Here, pork is stir-fried with green onions and wrapped in lettuce with red chili paste. The name “Mokno” refers to the long wooden planks once used as tables in old taverns, where customers placed their drinks and food. Inside the restaurant, writings left by the late father of the current owner remain intact, allowing visitors to feel a sense of nostalgia that keeps loyal patrons returning for decades.

The name “Mokno” refers to the long wooden planks once used as tables in old taverns, where customers placed their drinks and food. It offers a variety of Korean dishes such as galbijjim (braised beef short ribs), jeongol (hot pot), gejang (marinated crab), and bulgogi (marinated beef). Particularly, their galbijjim is slow-cooked for a long time with medicinal herbs, boasting a deep flavor and tender texture, making it a menu favorite loved by people of all ages. desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Nestled in Mangwon-dong, the design studio and cafe HHSS House was created with the idea that having trees right in front of you would be a perfect sight while working. True to this vision, the interior is thoughtfully arranged with a row of seats facing the lush greenery outside the large windows, providing a refreshing and tranquil view. The gentle fragrance of incense sticks fills the space, adding a soothing touch. The menu offers a delightful selection of beverages and charming desserts, with a range of alcoholic drinks available in the evening. While it’s not a spot you might casually discover, it’s a hidden gem for both focused work sessions and quiet solo visits. Tucked behind the building and away from the main street, the entrance is elusive. Head up to the 3rd floor, look for the door marked with a red ‘H’ made from tape, and step inside to experience the unique and welcoming ambiance of HHSS House.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} マンウォンドン(望遠洞)に位置するデザインオフィス兼カフェ「HHSS House」は、作業中にふと顔を上げた時に、目の前に木々が広がっている空間を作りたいという思いでデザインされた場所です。そのため店内に入ると、一列に並んだ座席が大きな窓越しに木々を眺めることができる配置となっており、店内に漂うお香の香りが心を落ち着かせてくれます。メニューには、さまざまな飲み物や可愛いデザートがあり、夜にはアルコールも提供されています。偶然見つけるのは難しいこのカフェですが、作業や一人での訪問にぴったりな場所です。大通り沿いではなく、建物の裏側に入り口があります。3階に上がって赤いテープで『H』と書かれたドアを開けると、「HHSS House」だけの特別な雰囲気を感じることができるでしょう。
desc_l10n.ko: 망원동에 위치한 디자인 사무실 겸 카페

Despite its popularity, the spacious restaurant ensures that wait times are short. The signature dish is jjukkumi, but you can also enjoy a variety of combinations such as jjukkumi with samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly) jjukkumi with shrimp, and jjukkumi with chadol (beef brisket). You can choose the level of spiciness, making it accessible for those who can't handle very spicy food. Additionally, a variety of side dishes pair well with jjukkumi and help balance the spiciness. A special treat is the complimentary fried rice you can enjoy after your meal. The restaurant also offers English menus, making ordering convenient for foreign visitors.

desc_l10n.ko: 18년 홍대 대표 쭈꾸미 맛집 홍스쭈꾸미

The main branch is very small but attracts long queues of customers. The second branch, located in an alley, offers a larger space with faster service. Although most orders are taken to-go due to limited seating, dining inside is also available. All dishes contain cilantro by default, but it can be removed upon request. However, the cilantro flavor at Oldy’s Taco is not overpowering, so it is recommended to try it together.

Here, you write your desired menu on a piece of paper and receive a numbered mailbox key. When your order is ready, you open the corresponding mailbox to collect your menu, replicating the thrill of receiving a letter. This special ordering method brings the excitement of opening a mailbox to your coffee experience. At Mailroom, you can enjoy coffee and write letters, creating memorable moments in your own way. Furthermore, Mailroom is a popular hotspot known for its vintage interior and inviting atmosphere, making it an ideal date spot. The signature menu features espresso coffee, espresso-based cocktails, and a variety of desserts that perfectly complement the coffee.

desc_l10n.ko: 색다른 경험을 해볼 수 있는 메일함 컨셉의 에스프레소 바, 메일룸

But when you step through the green gate, an outdoor seating area in the garden warmly welcomes you. Cobbler Yeonhui, a whiskey and cocktail bar, is a remodeled residence that used to be a private home. Here, there’s no menu. Instead, guests order their drinks through a conversation with the skilled bartenders, allowing them to discover personal tastes and drinks they may not have known about. Of course, you can also request specific drinks. With trustworthy bartending skills and a charming atmosphere, this place offers more than enough reasons to visit.

desc_l10n.ko: 메뉴판 없이 바텐더와 함께 주문하는 연희동의 분위기 좋은 칵테일 바

The space is divided into indoor and outdoor seating, but most customers opt for the outdoor area to enjoy the full yajang experience. The main (and only) dish is grilled pork belly (samgyeopsal), with optional add-ons like soybean paste stew (doenjang-jjigae) and fried rice. It's the only place among Euljiro’s yajang samgyeopsal spots that offers a "hidden menu" of fried rice—highly recommended after finishing your meat. As a popular hotspot in Euljiro, expect a wait.

Each table setting at Dojeongyukgwan, completed with honest ingredients and the delicate temperature of fire, embodies the essence of Korean cuisine. It is a place that presents a new gastronomic experience representing Seoul.

desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > img, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 「Appa ホットク」は1972年から続く長い伝統を誇り、多くの人々に愛されてきたホットク専門店です。この店の最大の特徴は、通常の鉄板ではなく、かまどスタイルの機器で焼き上げることで、油っぽさのないさっぱりとした味わいを提供している点です。 特に「かまどホットク」はバゲットの外皮のようなもちもちとした食感と香ばしい味わいが魅力で、一方「ハチミツホットク」は生地がしっとり柔らかく、パンのような食感が楽しめます。この店はKBS2TVの人気番組『新商品発売ピョンストラン』でコメディアンのイ・ヨンジャさんが訪れたことでも注目を集め、放送後さらに多くの人々が訪れるようになりました。 かまどで 焼く独特な調理法により、油っぽさを感じさせないすっきりとした風味が楽しめ、どちらのメニューもそれぞれの魅力で多様な好みに応えています。 50 年以上の 歴史が刻まれた「アッパホットク」は、香ばしさと素朴な伝統の調和を感じたい人におすすめの特別な場所です。
desc_l10n.ko: 남대문에서 오랜 전통의 아궁이 호떡을 만드는 담백한 맛의 호떡집

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Ferments started as a kombucha specialty shop in Seogyo-dong in 2021, and it has since evolved into a vegan restaurant now located in Yongsan. What sets Ferments apart is its commitment to offering healthy food made from plant-based ingredients that are fermented in-house without using chemical seasonings or artificial additives. From 12 PM to 5 PM, it operates as a kitchen and café, then transitions into an atmospheric kitchen and wine bar after 5 PM. The rooftop features an outdoor terrace where visitors can enjoy wine while enjoying city views on pleasant days. Inside, the space is filled with books, DVDs, and charming decor items that line the shelves, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere. On special occasions, such as during the "Ferments Daydream" event, guests can enjoy meals while watching performances by various artists, making it a must-visit spot for those who love music and natural wine.

desc_l10n.ko: 비건 발효 음식을 내추럴 와인, 수제 Raw 콤부차와 함께 제공
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} FERMENTS于2021年在西桥洞以康普茶专卖店的形式启航，随后迁至龙山，并转型为一家素食餐厅。FERMENTS的独特之处在于，它不使用任何化学调味料和人工添加剂，而是直接提供以发酵的植物性材料为基础提的康食品。上午12点至下午5点，主要经营厨房与咖啡厅服务；而从下午5点起，则转变为一个充满氛围的厨房与红酒吧。在屋顶上，设有一个露天露台，当天气晴朗时，您可以在此处远眺市中心的美景，并悠闲地品尝着红酒。踏入店内，首先映入眼帘的是密密麻麻排列在大书架上的书籍与DVD，以及一旁摆放得小巧精致的各类道具。这里不仅是一个书海与影音的宝库，更是体验室内装饰美学、享受阅读氛围的绝佳之地。在《FERMENTS Day Dream》这一偶尔举办的特别日子里，参与者不仅能一边享受各类艺人的精彩演出，还能同时品尝美食，使之成为音乐与天然红酒爱好者们不可错过的聚会场所之一。

The restaurant’s soup, made only from beef without any additives, is highly regarded for its rich and pure flavor. The building, used since the 1970s, preserves the traces of the times in Yonggang-dong, Mapo-gu, and has been designated as a Future Heritage of Seoul. It was frequented by famous singers of the past, including Lee Mi-ja, Ha Chun-hwa, and Nam Jin. It is said that the composer of the song “Mapo Terminal” by the Eunbangul Sisters drew inspiration while dining here.

Its name, “Taejo Daerim Gamjaguk,” was inspired by King Taejo of the Joseon Dynasty. While most people call the dish “Gamjatang,” restaurants in this area refer to it as “Gamjaguk” after the owner, Mr. Bae Ik-hoon, suggested using the term to encourage humility among neighboring restaurateurs. Today, it's run by a first-generation Korean barista who took over from Mr. Park Yichu, and it's recommended to visit in person if you want to savor the true flavor of the coffee. Far from a simple cafe, the entire building acts like a piece of content, offering a sanctuary where you can experience inspiration beyond just staying. Feel free to explore and make special memories across the space: the 1st floor is a media gallery connecting brands and culture; the 2nd floor is a lifestyle space where fragrance and design coexist; the 3rd floor is a modern lounge filled with calm food and urban leisure; and the 4th floor is a space opening up to city views and sensibilities.

Customers enjoy dipping chicken and vegetables cooked in a rich, garlic-infused broth with seasoning, and can choose to eat it either plain or spicy according to their preference. Additionally, the remaining broth can be enhanced by adding kalguksu (knife-cut noodles) or porridge for a more fulfilling meal. The restaurant is renowned for its hearty, garlic-laden broth. The founder previously operated a rice set meal restaurant near Cheonggyecheon and decided to add dakhanmari at the encouragement of regular patrons, eventually evolving into a single-menu establishment. The interior is cozy and welcoming, featuring multilingual menus and guides on how foreigners can enjoy their meals, making it an ideal spot for both locals and tourists.

The name 'WUMOK' is derived from the combination of the characters for beef (牛) and wood (木), as well as beef (牛) and smoke, reflecting its concept. Through cooking methods such as genshiyaki and smoking, it newly interprets the essence of Korean beef. The dishes that harmonize the aroma of wood and premium beef stimulate sight, smell, and taste. With the motto 'A Table of Fire with Philosophy', it provides a special gastronomic experience for memorable occasions. With a corkage-free policy, guests can enjoy dining with their own wine.

desc_l10n.ko: 불, 나무, 한우, 연기의 철학으로 한우를 새롭게 해석하는 한우 오마카세 전문점

The name 'WUMOK' is derived from the combination of the characters for beef (牛) and wood (木), as well as beef (牛) and smoke, reflecting its concept. Through cooking methods such as genshiyaki and smoking, it newly interprets the essence of Korean beef. The dishes that harmonize the aroma of wood and premium beef stimulate sight, smell, and taste. With the motto 'A Table of Fire with Philosophy', it provides a special gastronomic experience for memorable occasions. With a corkage-free policy, guests can enjoy dining with their own wine.
name: Korean Beef Omakase - WUMOK

It is ideal for enjoying natural wines. The restaurant offers a variety of seasonal dishes paired with wine and features a rooftop spanning the 3rd and 4th floors. Even if you're not well-versed in wine, a sommelier can recommend wines that suit your taste. The green curry at aff Seoul is particularly noteworthy.

It is a restaurant that has remained in the memories of many people since the days when the tteokbokki stall village was formed due to the gathering of seven schools. The business has been in the family for three generations, from mother-in-law to daughter-in-law and now to son. Tteokbokki, which is made the same way as the first owner taught, without any additives, is a sign of courtesy to customers. When you take a bite of the big and shot-tempered tteokbokki, you can taste the same flavor as the old days when you ate in front of the school.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 1978年から変わらぬ味でマンウードントッポッキの強者の座に君臨しているお店です。7つの学校が集まってトッポッキ屋台村が形成されていた時代から今まで、多くの人の思い出の中に残っている食堂です。義母から娘婿、そして今は息子で3代目の家業を受け継いでいる。他の添加物を使わず、1代目の社長の教えと同じように誠実に作るトッポッキには、お客さんへの礼儀が込められている。辛くてピリッとしたトッポッキを一口食べると、学校の前で食べていた昔の味がそのまま感じられる。
desc_l10n.ko: 온·오프라인을 주름잡는 망우동 떡볶이 맛집
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 这家餐厅自1978年以来一直在孟武洞制作teokbokki，其口味未变。从当年因七所学校聚集而形成的teokbokki摊位村开始，这家餐厅就一直留在很多人的记忆中。从婆婆到媳妇，再到现在的儿子，这个生意已经在家族中传承了三代人。Tteokbokki的制作方法与第一个主人所教的一样，没有任何添加剂，是对顾客的一种礼貌。当你咬一口又大又尖的铁布衫时，你可以感受到和以前在学校门口吃饭时一样的味道。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} This restaurant has been making tteokbokki in Mangwudong since 1978. It is a restaurant that has remained in the memories of many people since the days when the tteokbokki stall village was formed due to the gathering of seven schools. The business has been in the family for three generations, from mother-in-law to daughter-in-law and now to son. Tteokbokki, which is made the same way as the first owner taught, without any additives, is a sign of courtesy to customers. When you take a bite of the big and shot-tempered tteokbokki, you can taste the same flavor as the old days when you ate in front of the school.
name: Ingkko Tteokbokki

Instead of serving all dishes at once, each course is presented calmly in accordance with the guest’s dining pace, always centered around freshly cooked rice from a traditional cauldron. Ingredients are carefully selected every morning from Garak Market and Majang Meat Market, featuring premium Hanwoo++ beef and fresh seasonal seafood, prepared in limited quantities. This ensures that every dish reflects the finest quality and the flavors of the season. The warm, restrained atmosphere of the hanok space, where sunlight filters through lattice windows, creates a cozy setting suitable for couples, families, and international visitors alike. Each dish goes beyond simple plating to convey the stories, seasonal impressions, and dedication of the chef, offering not just a meal but a special moment to be remembered.

desc_l10n.ko: 전통에 뿌리를 두고, 정성으로 차린 맡김 차림 한식 다이닝

Climbing the steep stairs might make you wonder if you're on the right path, but as soon as jazz music drifts down, any doubts disappear. A cozy atmosphere greets you when you step through the rugged metal door, contrasting with the exterior. Here, you can enjoy a quality drip coffee accompanied by jazz played on LPs, creating an unexpectedly unique experience. Fizz Social Club is a hidden gem in Euljiro, where music and coffee blend perfectly.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 「Fizz Social Club」は、ウルチロ(乙支路)のパンサン(芳山)市場に近い、カフェがあるとは想像できないような建物の4階にあります。高い階段を登る途中で、正しい場所に向かっているのか不安になるかもしれませんが、ジャズ音楽が流れ始めるとその不安はすぐに消えます。無骨な鉄製の扉を開けると、外観とは裏腹に温かみのある落ち着いた雰囲気が広がっています。LPで流れるジャズとともに、丁寧に淹れたドリップコーヒーを楽しめるこの場所は、予想外の新鮮な体験を提供してくれます。音楽とコーヒーが完璧に調和するウルチロ(乙支路)の隠れたカフェ、「Fizz Social Club」です。
desc_l10n.ko: LP를 통해 재즈를 들을 수 있는 편안한 감성의 카페

The only meal on the menu here is mushroom hot and sour soup. If you order the hot and sour soup, it comes with noodles and fried rice, so you can enjoy a hearty meal at a reasonable price. The soup is flavored with fresh garlic, enoki mushrooms, and watercress, and the noodles are chewy and plump, more like udon noodles than kalguksu.

desc_l10n.ko: 30년 전통의 버섯매운탕

Its signature dishes include Tongyeong Gulbap (oyster rice), Maesaengi Oyster Soup, Jeongsik, and Oyster Pancakes. The restaurant also offers a variety of seafood dishes, such as octopus, cockles, and abalone. People return frequently for the fresh oysters and the mild, clean flavors that aren’t overpowering. The oysters are sourced directly from Tongyeong, allowing diners to experience a taste of fresh oysters that are hard to find in Seoul. Through flash freezing, the restaurant maintains the freshness of the oysters, allowing customers to enjoy them in winter and summer.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} キョンボックン(政府ソウル庁舎)駅の地下とチョクヒョン現代ビルディングの地下がつながるアーケードに位置する「トンヨンクルパッ(統営カキご飯)」は、近くの会社員たちの間でも評判の名店です。代表的なメニューにはトンヨン(統営)カキご飯やカプサアオノリのカキクッパ、カキ定食、 カキのチヂミなどがあります。このほかにも、チュクミ(イイダコ)、ハイガイ、アワビなどの海産物を使ったさまざまな料理を提供しています。新鮮なカキと、刺激的でないあっさりとした味わいに、訪れる人々は何度も足を運びます。トンヨン(統営)から直接取り寄せたカキを使用しているため、ソウルでは味わえないトンヨン(統営)の新鮮さを感じることができます。また、急速冷凍によって鮮度を保っているため、冬だけでなく夏にも新鮮なカキを楽しむことができるお店です。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울에서 맛볼 수 있는 통영 굴의 신선함, 통영굴밥
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 位于连接景福宫站地下和Jeoghyeon现代大厦地下室的拱廊的统营牡蛎饭是附近公司人也熟知的美食店。代表菜品有统营牡蛎饭和海藻牡蛎汤饭、牡蛎套餐、牡蛎煎饼等。除此之外还推出了八爪鱼、泥蚶、鲍鱼等多种海鲜料理。牡蛎新鲜，味道清淡无刺激，人们总是反复光顾这里。由于采用直接从统营空运而来的牡蛎，因此顾客能够享受到在首尔无法体验到的、源自统营的独特新鲜风味。另外，通过快速冷冻保持新鲜度，不仅是冬天，夏天也能品尝到新鲜的牡蛎。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Located in the arcade that connects Gyeongbokgung Station's underground area with Jeokseon Hyundai Building, Tongyeong Gulbap is a well-known restaurant among nearby office workers. Its signature dishes include Tongyeong Gulbap (oyster rice), Maesaengi Oyster Soup, Jeongsik, and Oyster Pancakes. The restaurant also offers a variety of seafood dishes, such as octopus, cockles, and abalone. People return frequently for the fresh oysters and the mild, clean flavors that aren’t overpowering. The oysters are sourced directly from Tongyeong, allowing diners to experience a taste of fresh oysters that are hard to find in Seoul. Through flash freezing, the restaurant maintains the freshness of the oysters, allowing customers to enjoy them in winter and summer.
name: Tongyeong Gulbap

It beautifully blends the tranquility of its former residential appearance with the sophistication of newly added remodel elements. Customers can choose their seating based on their mood for the day, whether on the terrace, at a desk in the yard, or on a cozy sofa in the corner, allowing them to enjoy both time and atmosphere to their liking. As the official Korean partner of the Danish specialty coffee brand La Cabra, Café Travertine offers a high-quality coffee menu. Among them, the standout is the signature hand-drip filter coffee. Those who prefer non-coffee options also offer alternatives like milk tea or lemon mate tea.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} カフェ「TRAVERTINE」はヨンサン(龍山)のイチョウ並木道にある、雰囲気とコーヒーが特徴のカフェです。 昔の住宅の面影が残る静けさと、リモデリングによって加えられた洗練された要素が共存するこの空間では、訪れたお客様はテラスや庭のテーブル、隅にあるソファなど、その日のムードに応じて自由に席を選び、時間と雰囲気を自分の好みに合わせて楽しむことができます。デンマークのスペシャルティブランド「La Cabra」の韓国公式パートナーとして、高品質なコーヒーメニューを提供していますが、その中でも特に人気のあるメニューは、ハンドドリップフィルターコーヒーです。また、コーヒーが苦手な方のために、ミルクティーやレモンマテ茶といったノンコーヒーメニューも取り揃えています。
desc_l10n.ko: 용산 은행나무길의 힙한 카페 트래버틴
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} TRAVERTINE咖啡厅坐落于龙山银杏树路，是一家以独特氛围和优质咖啡为特色的咖啡厅。 在这个空间里，既有传统住宅中宁静氛围的延续，又融入了改造后带来的干练元素。顾客们不仅能悠然自得地享受露台的美景，还能根据院子中摆放的书桌、角落里温馨的沙发等家具，结合当天的氛围与心情，自由选择座位，随心所欲地沉浸在自己喜欢的时光与氛围中。丹麦知名品牌Lacabra Coffee与韩国官方建立了紧密的合作伙伴关系，基于此，他们精心打造了一系列高品质的咖啡菜单。尤为引人注目的当属其标志性的手冲过滤咖啡。此外，为了照顾到那些对咖啡因较为敏感或偏好非咖啡饮品的顾客，贴心地提供了诸如奶茶、柠檬马黛茶等非咖啡类饮品。

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} For a long time, we have welcomed guests under the name Yeontral Dabang Yeonnam on the cherry blossom path next to Yeontral Park in Yeonnam-dong. We are starting another story with a new name, Folv Yeonnam. Folv is not merely a space with a changed name, but a space created by gathering accumulated experiences, learning, and the desire to deliver better tastes. We prepare pies and French toast baked with the utmost care using techniques learned directly from an artisan in Karuizawa, known as the home of jam in Nagano Prefecture, Japan. Furthermore, a cup of coffee is completed by hands that have built up experience as a barista in several European countries. Techniques and experiences learned in different times and places connect into a single taste in this small space. From those who have visited this space for a long time to those who first learned about Folv today. We hope you stay here for a while and take away a warm time and delicious memories.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 長い間、ヨンナムドン(延南洞)のヨントラルパークに隣接する桜並木道で、ヨントラル茶房ヨンナム(延南)として皆様をお迎えしてきました。 私たちは新しい名前、ポルブヨンナム(延南)として、新たなページを刻みます。ポルブは単に名前が変わっただけの場所ではありません。これまで積み重ねてきた経験と学び、そして「より良い美味しさを届けたい」という想いが形になった空間です。 ここでお出しするのは、ジャムの本場として知られる日本の長野県・軽井沢で、職人直伝の技術を活かし、丹精込めて焼き上げたパイとフレンチトースト。そして、ヨーロッパ各地でバリスタとして経験を積んだ手によって、至福の一杯のコーヒーが完成します。異なる時間と場所で培ってきた技術と経験が、この小さな空間で「ひとつの味」として繋がります。 長い間この場所を訪れてくださった方々、そして今日初めてポルブを知った皆様へ。ここで過ごすひとときが、温かな時間と美味しい記憶となりますように。
desc_l10n.ko: 연남동에서 드립커피와 파이가 맛있고, 분위기 좋아 사진 찍기 좋은 감성 카페
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 长久以来，本店坐落于延南洞延中央公园旁的樱花大道，一直以延中央茶房延南店之名接待八方来客。 我们将以Polv延南这一全新名称，开启全新的故事篇章。Polv并非只是换了名字的场所，而是沉淀了过往积累的经验和匠心，凝聚着想要为大家呈现更美味滋味的初心，全新打造而成的空间。 我们以在日本长野县被称作果酱发源地的轻井泽，师从匠人所学来的手艺，用心烤制出品各式派和法式吐司。另外，由拥有欧洲各国咖啡师从业经验的匠人，为您精心冲泡每一杯咖啡。从不同时光、不同地域习得的技艺和阅历，都在这间小小的空间里，交融汇聚成独一味觉。 致长久以来经常光临本店的各位，以及今天初次知晓Polv的每一位朋友。愿大家在此稍作停留，度过一段惬意温暖的时光，留下美味又美好的回忆。

In addition to fresh fruit, you can also enjoy variations like persimmon, red bean with butter, and Dubai-style glutinous rice cakes. As a take-out only store, there are no tables for dine-in. While there is usually a line, it moves quickly. The rice cakes are packaged like lucky pouches, symbolizing blessings, making them a perfect gift option.

The menu includes sogalbijjim (braised beef short ribs), salted galbi (marinated grilled ribs), Korean beef tartare, ojingeobokkeum (stir-fried squid), and traditional Korean liquors. If you're lucky, you might taste tteokbokki (stir-fried rice cake), which is not on the regular menu. The restaurant is small but consistently busy, thanks to its clean and upscale food offerings. One of the charms of Miro Restaurant is admiring the neatly sliced vegetables accompanying the dishes. The owner is dedicated to using high-quality ingredients and pays meticulous attention to cutting vegetables and preparing them fresh upon order. This attention to detail gives the vegetables a distinct texture and flavor that feels refreshingly different.

Centering on Gomtang (beef bone soup) boiled with the utmost care for a long time, it presents course dishes containing the essence of ingredients and the depth of time. Its signature dish is domestic female pork belly, cross-aged wet and dry for 240 hours, which is more tender and less greasy than standard raw meat. It also offers sets where you can taste pork belly, pork neck, and donmahawk (pork tomahawk) all at once, as well as aged beef and beef tartare. Because the staff grills the meat directly at the table, first-time foreign visitors can enjoy the meal without any language barrier, and it provides an English menu along with free corkage (bringing in outside alcohol). It has been selected by the Korean Blue Ribbon Survey for four consecutive years.

desc_l10n.ko: 240시간 웻·드라이 교차숙성한 국내산 암퇘지를 숯불에 구워내는 홍대 고기집

Their signature dish is the soft, sweet milk bingsu, topped with freshly made red beans and rice cakes. The shop also offers other delicious variations such as green tea bingsu and coffee bingsu, each offering a unique taste experience. Known for its affordable prices, the shop allows customers to explore various menu items. Besides bingsu, they also serve coffee and tea, which are perfect for soothing your palate after a cold dessert. The cozy interior, featuring brick and wood decor, enhances the warm and inviting atmosphere. A standout feature of this shop is the complimentary refill of red beans and rice cakes with every bowl of bingsu.

With a verse from 'Le Lethe' from Baudelaire's poetry collection as its motif, it encapsulates the hope that everyone who visits will momentarily forget the burdens of a tiring day and rest comfortably, at least while they are here.

desc_l10n.ko: 서래마을에 위치한 조용하고 아늑한 바

The bar offers a wide selection of beverages, including Soodowon beer, various bottled beers, two types of draft beer, wines, cocktails, and whiskey. The menu provides detailed descriptions of beers and wines, making choosing a drink that suits your taste easy. Various plates and snacks are also available to pair perfectly with your drink. desc_l10n.ko: 붉은 벽돌 건물의 지하, 중세시대 수도원이 연상되는 바

With a welcoming heart, we devote our utmost sincerity to providing generous portions and warm hospitality so you can comfortably come and enjoy. All batter, choux cream, and red bean paste are made directly by the owners, offering freshness and high quality, and the cafe presents the unique charm of gukhwabbang with fillings that change every season. Gukhwabbang with distinctive fillings such as choux cream, Earl Grey, matcha, and peanut butter elevates the familiar street snack to a new level. Along with gukhwabbang, a representative winter snack, ice cream is also sold, providing an appealing combination of warmth and coolness at the same time. Despite the absence of elaborate interiors or packaging, people line up because of the ever changing menu and the high quality flavors created with carefully selected ingredients. There may be days off due to pop up and flea market schedules, so please check Instagram before visiting.

Originally a private home, the café offers beautiful landscapes throughout the year. In the summer, it’s an ideal place to dip your feet in the stream and enjoy the cool, refreshing breeze. For those longing for a peaceful escape from the rush of daily life, Cafe Relax is the perfect destination to embrace the soothing tranquility of nature.

Unlike conventional fried chicken, which is typically oily, salty, spicy, sweet, and intense in flavor, Haebangchon Dak's slow-cooked chicken is filled with fresh domestic chicken, Geumsan ginseng, jujube, and glutinous rice. It is cooked for an hour and a half to reduce the oil content, resulting in a healthier and delicious slow-cooked chicken. You might think that the electrically roasted herbal whole chicken is too bland, but it is enhanced with a specially developed mustard and yogurt sauce that elevates its tender flavor. Additionally, Haebangchon Dak's unique leek kimchi, carefully prepared and fermented weekly, pairs perfectly with the glutinous rice stuffed inside the chicken, creating a delightful harmony of flavors.

In 1974, he opened “Pyeongtaek Go Doctor House” in Pyeongtaek, named after his nickname “Go Doctor,” earned for his cool and open personality. The restaurant moved to Sinchon in 1982, and later, his daughter Ms. Go Hee-seung continued the legacy, relocating to Yeonhui-dong in 2008. Loved for its refreshing broth and chewy noodles, the restaurant is also known for its unique topping of thinly sliced cucumber peppers on cold noodles.

Each bean's unique characteristics are conveniently displayed, allowing customers to select their perfect match. In addition to coffee, their milk teas, ades, and other beverages boast exceptional flavors. You can enjoy the highly addictive vegetable gopchang, al-gopchang, and green onion gopchang—the representative menus of the Booyas Gopchang Hongdae main branch—according to your various tastes. It doesn't have a proper signboard, but it hasn't changed over the years, so it's a place that keeps the memories of school days alive. Miribunsik's signature dish is instant tteokbokki, which you can choose according to your taste, including glass noodle, dumplings, ramen, and fish cakes. Actor Seol Kyung-gu, the main character of the movie "Bulhan-dang," filmed a scene where he ate tteokbokki here, so some people visit the restaurant as a movie spot.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 1988年からミリム女子高校のそばを守っているトッポッキ食堂。きちんとした看板はないが、長い間変わらない姿で学生時代の思い出をそのまま残している。春雨、餃子、ラーメン、かまぼこなど、好みに合わせて選べるミリムブンシクのシグネチャーメニューは即席トッポッキだ。映画「無法者」の主人公ソル・ギョングがトッポッキを食べるシーンをここで撮影したため、映画の名所として訪れる人もいる。

It doesn't have a proper signboard, but it hasn't changed over the years, so it's a place that keeps the memories of school days alive. Miribunsik's signature dish is instant tteokbokki, which you can choose according to your taste, including glass noodle, dumplings, ramen, and fish cakes. Actor Seol Kyung-gu, the main character of the movie "Bulhan-dang," filmed a scene where he ate tteokbokki here, so some people visit the restaurant as a movie spot.
name: Mirim Bunsik

It’s run by the “black spoon” chef, who gained recognition after appearing on Netflix’s Black and White Chef: Culinary Class Wars, ensuring top-notch flavors. The restaurant also features occasional pop-up events, introducing a variety of new and exciting dishes, perfect for a fresh and unique dining experience. It's an ideal spot to enjoy warm oden paired with a cold draft beer during the cold winter months. The cozy interior offers a range of seating options, from communal tables to more intimate settings, all thoughtfully designed for a detailed and welcoming ambiance. Closed: July 10th - July 30th

Upon opening the door, you are first greeted by the aroma of sesame and perilla oils, pressed fresh in the store every morning. This fragrance naturally permeates menus such as Perilla Oil Makguksu, Seasonal Bibimbap, Gangdoenjang Ssambap, Beef Tartare Gamtae Gimbap, and Grilled Mackerel with Bracken Risotto. It provides a novel impression even to those highly familiar with Korean cuisine without being overwhelming, making it an excellent destination for travelers experiencing Korean food for the first time to comfortably clear their plates.

Particularly, the rich marinade deeply penetrates the meat, and its sweet fragrance stimulates the senses. Not only is the food delicious, but the service is also outstanding — so much so that the president of a certain organization once recommended that his staff learn from the kindness of the restaurant’s employees.ness of the restaurant's employees.

One of the standout features of this place is grilling samgyeopsal with minari (water parsley). At the MGM Hongdae branch, the staff expertly grills the meat for you, allowing you to fully savor its true flavor. They also move around the restaurant, refilling any vegetables you might need, ensuring attentive and friendly service. Additionally, MGM offers a variety of side dishes, including cold noodles, bibim noodles, and stews, providing diverse combinations to complement the meat. With its spacious and comfortable setting, along with convenient parking in front of the restaurant, it is an excellent choice for group visits.

desc_l10n.ko: 홍대에 위치한 솥뚜껑 고깃집

It blends traditional Korean style with modern interiors, offering a comfortable setting across its 1st to 3rd floors and a rooftop view of Inwangsan Mountain that enhances the experience. Opening at 8 AM, it's perfect for grabbing a quick breakfast before starting a sightseeing tour. The café serves specialty coffee made with high-quality beans and freshly baked goods each morning, all in a cozy and inviting atmosphere.

Chewy noodles kneaded directly and a refreshing broth made with Manila clams serve as the base. desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Seoul Rabbit is a specialty carrot juice shop for travelers visiting Seochon and the residents. Our signature product is carrot juice, and we’ve developed the most diverse range of carrot-based beverages in Korea. Some of our offerings include 100% pure carrot juice, carrot coffee, Danke juice (a drinkable carrot cake), vitamin C-enhanced orange carrot ginger juice, and Carrot Lemon Soda, a refreshing option perfect for hot summer days. While carrots' health benefits are well-known, they are often seen only as a side dish. We believe juice is the most delicious and convenient way to enjoy carrots. However, we can’t ignore that carrots are a polarizing ingredient. This led us to create a variety of drinks to make carrots more approachable for those who may initially dislike them. In addition to carrot-based beverages, we also offer Ginseng Yogurt Smoothies, making the health benefits of Korean ginseng more accessible. These have been especially popular with international travelers seeking to refreshingly experience Korea’s iconic ginseng. The large rabbit mural in front of our store was designed to reduce the sense of hesitation toward carrots and instead evoke a feeling of familiarity. It has now become a popular photo spot for travelers wanting to commemorate their visit to Seoul.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 「Seoul Rabbit」は、ソチョン(西村)を訪れる観光客や地元住民のための、にんじんジュース専門店です。代表的なメニューとして、にんじんジュースがあり、にんじんジュースを使ったドリンクを韓国内で最も多く開発しているお店です。100%にんじんジュースをはじめ、にんじんコーヒー、飲むにんじんケーキとも言える、にんじんケーキジュース、ビタミンCを強化したオレンジ・にんじん・生姜ジュース、レモン入りで暑い夏にぴったりのにんじんレモンソーダなど、さまざまな商品を販売しています。 にんじんが健康に良いことは広く知られていますが、多くの人々にとっては副菜としてのイメージが強いのではないでしょうか。私たちは、にんじんを美味しく手軽に摂る方法としてジュースが最適だと考えています。しかし、にんじんは好みが分かれる食材であることも事実です。そのため、にんじんが苦手な方にも楽しんでもらえる方法を考え、さまざまなドリンクメニューを生み出しました。 さらに、にんじんジュースだけでなく、健康に良い高麗人参を手軽に飲める「高麗人参ヨーグルトスムージー」も開発しました。韓国産の高麗人参を求めて訪れる外国人観光客にも大変好評です。店舗前にある巨大なウサギの壁画は、にんじんに対する抵抗感を和らげ、親しみやすさを感じてもらいたいという思いから作られました。この壁画は今や、ソウルを訪れた証として人気のフォトスポットとなっています。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울래빗은 서촌을 찾는 여행자들과 서촌주민들을 위한 당근주스 전문점.
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Seoul Rabbit是一家专为西村游客及居民提供特色胡萝卜汁的饮品专卖店。我们的招牌产品包括各类胡萝卜汁饮品，其中，以胡萝卜汁为原料的饮品在我国最为丰富多样。我们制作并销售多种商品，如100%纯胡萝卜汁、胡萝卜咖啡、以胡萝卜风味著称的胡糕果汁、富含维生素C的橙子胡萝卜生姜汁，以及在炎炎夏日里备受欢迎的甜柠檬苏打，后者加入了柠檬，非常适合消暑。 虽然众所周知胡萝卜对健康有益，但多数人仅将其视为一种普通的配菜。将胡萝卜制成果汁是一种既美味又舒适的食用方式。然而，不可否认的是，胡萝卜是一种口味爱憎分明的食材。因此，在思考如何让那些不喜欢胡萝卜的人也能接受它时，研发出了多种多样的胡萝卜饮料菜单。 除了胡萝卜汁之外，我们还推出了“人参酸奶冰沙”，这是一款便于饮用且对健康有益的人参饮品。来韩国旅游的外国游客对此反响热烈。此外，卖场前的大型兔子壁画，其设计灵感源自对胡萝卜的亲近与喜爱，也深受大家欢迎。如今，这面壁画已成为到访首尔游客们争相拍照的热门地点，人气极高。

They pride themselves on using only the finest quality lamb sourced from New Zealand and Australia, ensuring an exceptional dining experience. From the moment you arrive, they take care of grilling the meat to your specifications so you can savor it just the way you like. Their lamb is halal-certified, making it an excellent choice for Muslim guests. Plus, they offer private rooms to provide a peaceful atmosphere for groups dining.

It offers traditional cultural experiences like royal cuisine, art performances, and wedding ceremonies. Built in 1957 as Yeong Bin Gwan to accommodate distinguished guests from home and abroad, the Korea House has undergone extensive renovations. It stands today as a high-quality, multi-cultural space dedicated to preserving and promoting Korea's beautiful traditional culture through vivid historical scenes. It is also renowned for its "Kohojae" program, which allows visitors to experience royal court cuisine, and it has gained popularity as a filming location for popular entertainment programs, movies, and dramas.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 韓国の家は、伝統文化の保存と普及を目的に作られた複合文化空間で、宮廷料理、伝統芸術公演、伝統婚礼など様々な伝統文化体験が楽しめる韓国を代表する伝統文化空間です。 1957年、国内外の貴賓館を目的に建てられた韓国の家(コリアハウス)は、大々的な改修と歴史の流れを経て、現在は韓国の美しい伝統文化を保存及び普及するための高品格複合文化空間として生まれ変わりました。 また宮廷の茶菓子を体験できるコホジェ(古好斎)プログラムやバラエティ番組、映画、ドラマのロケ地として人気を集めています。
desc_l10n.ko: 전통 복합문화공간 '한국의집'
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 韩国之家是以保存和普及传统文化为目的而建成的复合文化空间，是能够享受宫廷饮食、传统艺术表演、传统婚礼等各种传统文化体验的韩国代表性传统文化空间。 1957年，为迎接韩国及外国贵宾而建造的韩国之家，经过大规模维修，结合生动的历史现场。为了保存并普及韩国美丽的传统文化，它重新定位为高品质复合文化空间。 作为宫廷茶点体验“古好斋”活动和人气综艺节目、电影、电视剧的取景地也备受瞩目。

It offers traditional cultural experiences like royal cuisine, art performances, and wedding ceremonies. Built in 1957 as Yeong Bin Gwan to accommodate distinguished guests from home and abroad, the Korea House has undergone extensive renovations. It stands today as a high-quality, multi-cultural space dedicated to preserving and promoting Korea's beautiful traditional culture through vivid historical scenes. It is also renowned for its "Kohojae" program, which allows visitors to experience royal court cuisine, and it has gained popularity as a filming location for popular entertainment programs, movies, and dramas.
name: Korea House

These dishes use Hanjae minari, cultivated on Hwaaksan Mountain in Cheongdo, where it grows in ample sunlight and pure underground water, resulting in tender stems infused with the rich aroma of minari. At Neungdong, you can also enjoy gomtang (beef bone soup), served with rice in a clear broth made from premium-grade hanwoo, prized for its tender texture and savory umami flavor. The food's gentle, clean, and non-spicy taste continually draws patrons. The meticulously crafted dishes and warm, attentive service earn high praise from visitors. While a wait is often expected, visiting on a weekday provides faster access compared to the busier weekends.

desc_l10n.ko: 맛있는 곰탕을 맛볼 수 있는 신용산역 곰탕맛집 능동미나리

It has been a regular store for students for so long that they say they are not even Seoul National University students if they don't know Figaro. Test takers with light pockets are always grateful for the same low price. At the height of the student movement on Nokdu Street, students who were protesting here used to hide. Figaro was a place where students visited to relieve their anger and stress.

desc_l10n.ko: 안주 하나에 4천원 덤 안주가 있는 가성비 호프집

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Since its opening in 1974, the bakery has continued its tradition of making delicious bread rather than just pretty buns. The custom of running a supermarket-like bakery for customers visiting the racetrack in the 70s remains, creating a unique scene. The shop is filled with a wide variety of handmade breads, from old favorites like manchurian and doughnuts to garlic cream bread and ciabatta. The owner says that the secret to the shop's longevity is that the bread is naturally fermented, making it easy to digest. • This place has been selected as a 'Seoul Future Heritage'. Among Seoul's modern and contemporary cultural heritage, Seoul Future Heritage is a tangible and intangible asset that is worth passing on to future generations.( https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr)
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 1974年の開業以来、見た目よりも美味しいパンを作るという伝統を受け継いでいる。70年代、競馬場を訪れた客のためにスーパーマーケットのような菓子店を運営していた習慣が残っており、異色の風景を作り出している。まんじゅうや生ドーナツなどの昔ながらのパンから、ガーリッククリームパンやチアバターまで、さまざまな種類の手作りパンが店内を埋め尽くす。これまで長く愛され続けてきた秘訣は、天然発酵で作ることで消化が良いからだと、店主は話してくれました。 - ここは「ソウル未来遺産」に選定された場所です。ソウルの近・現代文化遺産の中で、未来世代に伝える価値のある有形・無形の資産であるソウル未来遺産を永続的な旅行でご覧ください( https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr)
desc_l10n.ko: 만주와 생도너츠로 유명한 중랑구 대표 베이커리

desc_l10n.ko: 굴다리 시절부터 마포를 지켜온 김치찌개 노포

Guests can taste and enjoy tea on site. The tea house on the second floor offers a wide view of the rooftops of Bukchon Hanok Village through large windows. On the third floor is a special tea tasting area unique to Osulloc, which is updated according to seasonal menus. Inspired by seasonal teas, the tea house presents tea cocktails, tea cakes, tea sparkling water, and other tea snacks. The tea tasting experience is available by reservation only, so please check the reservation methods in advance via the official website or on site.

Guests can taste and enjoy tea on site. The tea house on the second floor offers a wide view of the rooftops of Bukchon Hanok Village through large windows. On the third floor is a special tea tasting area unique to Osulloc, which is updated according to seasonal menus. The tea tasting experience is available by reservation only, so please check the reservation methods in advance via the official website or on site.
