desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Blgre is a name created by combining the first letters of the three primary colors of light: Blue, Green, and Red. Like the intersection of these three primary colors creates white, it embodies an open-minded approach to reinterpreting Korean cuisine. It represents the intention to express Korean cuisine in a new way, with an open mind and creativity. The interior space with a white tone incorporates media art that represents the sense of seasons, adding dynamism to the interior design. The dishes served in tapas style are based on recipes from ancient literature but reinterpreted with a modern touch. The cuisine at Blgre utilizes fermented ingredients such as ganjang (Soy Sauce) and doenjang (Soybean Paste ) made from Paju soybeans and kimchi. The dishes aim to preserve the original flavors of the ingredients. Various Korean liquors and wines are available, allowing for pairing with Korean-style tapas.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Blgreは光の3原色であるブルー(Blue)、グリーン(Green)、レッド(Red)の最初の文字を組み合わせて作った名前です。光の3原色を集合させたホワイトが持つ意味のように開かれた心で韓国式料理を新しく表現するという意味が込められています。ホワイトトーンの室内は、インテリアに季節感を表現するメディアアートを展示しています。タパスの形で提供される料理は、伝統的なレシピに基づきながらも、現代的なタッチを加えています。パジュ(坡州)長湍大豆で作った醤油と味噌、キムチなどの発酵食材を活用し、食材で本来の風味を生かします。様々な韓国酒とワインが用意されており、韓国料理タパスと組み合わせることができます。
desc_l10n.ko: 현대적인 방식으로 재해석한 한식 & 와인바

Jusindang Yongsan Branch is a Korean dining bar that features a facade and interior that modernly interprets Korean shamanic aesthetics, serves fusion Korean cuisine presented by internationally trained chefs, and offers a harmonious blend of original cocktails and premium whiskey—from the first floor reached through a mystical transitional space to the second floor that maximizes openness. Jusindang Yongsan Branch offers a time that satisfies all five senses with various seating options and private rooms. desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Café Ongoing, run by a Seochon native, offers a thoughtfully curated selection of drinks and desserts with a soft, refined flavor. Their standout, the "Ongoing Latte," blends misutgaru (roasted grain powder), ice cream, and espresso, creating a rich, nutty drink with deep flavor and just the right touch of sweetness—ideal for those who enjoy something distinct. Another must-try is the roasted sweet potato brûlée, a favorite among regulars for its unforgettable flavor. Paired with sweet treats like Basque cheesecake, financiers, and sablé cookies, the café's offerings perfectly complement a quiet moment. The interior reflects the owner’s warm, careful attention to detail, creating an inviting space to sip coffee and unwind while gazing out at Seochon’s charming streets. It feels ideal for reflecting on a creative project or soaking in inspiration—perfect for those who enjoy places with heart and soul.

desc_l10n.ko: 서촌에 위치한 작지만 따뜻한 카페. 맛있는 커피가 기다리는 카페 Ongoing
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 位于西村，由一位地道的本土老板精心经营的咖啡店Ongoing，整体上为顾客提供了一系列口感柔和的饮品与甜点。招牌饮品"On Going拿铁"将五谷粉、冰淇淋与意式浓缩咖啡融合在一起的。Ongoing拿铁的香气扑鼻，风味醇厚而不腻，甜度适中，非常适合那些渴望品尝特色咖啡的人。另一个代表菜品红薯烤布蕾，凡是品尝过一次的顾客，无不被其独特风味所吸引，因此常常会再次光顾。不仅如此，巴斯克奶酪蛋糕、费南雪以及萨布雷饼干等甜美的点心，无疑是与Ongoing咖啡搭配的绝佳选择。这家咖啡厅的内部装修洋溢着温馨与爱意，每一处细节都透露出主人的细心与费心。顾客在此小憩时，还能透过窗户，悠然地欣赏西村街道上的美丽景致，享受一段轻松惬意的时光。

The restaurant began in Myeong-dong and boasts a long history. Despite the turmoil of war, Kim So-seon opened the restaurant to support her family. The crispy kimchi pancake served before the main meal stimulates the appetite, while the signature bean sprout soup, with its blend of various ingredients, offers a perfectly spicy and refreshing taste. The multilingual menu also makes it easy for international tourists to visit and enjoy the food.

You can enjoy a variety of Korean food in a space that captures the mood of Korea in a modern way, and there are cozy private room spaces available for intimate gatherings. Furthermore, through spatial lighting direction, you can feel distinctly different atmospheres during the day and night. For lunch, enjoy a neat and hearty meal with high-quality noodle dishes, suyuk (boiled beef slices), and jeon (Korean pancakes). For dinner, savor various alcoholic beverages, including traditional liquor, alongside premium dishes, and host a meal for your esteemed guests or enjoy an atmospheric gathering.

desc_l10n.ko: 제일제면소의 정갈한 별미 칼국수와 샤브샤브, 한식 요리를 제공하는 코리안 누들 다이닝

desc_l10n.en: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Koraebul Gangnam Yeoksam Main Branch is a Korean fine dining restaurant specializing in seafood, located in Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul. Established in 2002 by the first-generation owner, a native of Yeongdeok, with the intention of introducing East Coast seafood cuisine to Seoul, it has been operating in the same location for 24 years as a single flagship establishment. It is a premier seafood restaurant in Yeoksam, Gangnam, visited by approximately 30,000 customers annually. The menu is primarily composed of seafood sourced directly from the East Coast. Seafood is managed in in-house aquariums, and ingredients of the day are prepared and served immediately. Major menu items include Dokdo Shrimp, Botan Shrimp, Spiny Lobster, 10-Year-Old Wild Rock Oysters, Mulgomtang (Snailfish Soup), Dodari Ssukguk (Flounder and Mugwort Soup), Mineotang (Croaker Soup), Whale Meat, and Pohang-style Mulhoe (Cold Raw Fish Soup). For lunch, meal sets accompanied by side dishes and hot stone pot rice are served, while dinner offers seafood course meals and signature menu-centric compositions. Koraebul has been featured in various media outlets, including being introduced as one of CNN's Best Restaurants in Seoul in 2012, as well as on France's France3TV, tvN's Wednesday Food Talk, SBS's Live Broadcast Today, MBC's Omniscient Interfering View, and SBS's Running Man. Additionally, it has been continuously selected by the Blue Ribbon Survey for 15 consecutive years from 2012 to 2026.

desc_l10n.ko: 동해안 산지에서 공수한 해산물 전문 한식 파인다이닝
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} KORAEBUL江南驿三总店是坐落于首尔江南区驿三洞的海鲜专业韩式高端精致料理餐厅。2002 年，出身于盈德的第一代店主，为了将东海岸海鲜风味带到首尔而创立该店，驿三总店单店已在同一位置稳定经营24年。这是一家每年约有3万名顾客到访的知名海鲜专门餐厅。 菜品以韩国东海岸产地直供海鲜为核心。店内设有海鲜水族箱活体养殖海鲜，当日新鲜食材现点现处理，新鲜上桌。 主打菜品包含独岛花虾、桃花虾、鸡虾、十年纯野生岩牡蛎、海鲜牛骨汤、比目鱼艾草汤、黄姑鱼汤、鲸肉、浦项式水拌生鱼片等。午餐提供搭配多款小菜和石锅饭的正餐套餐，晚上则以海鲜套餐及招牌特色菜品为主。 KORAEBUL餐厅不仅在2012年被CNN评选为首尔最佳餐厅并专题报道，还先后登上法国France3电视台、tvN《周三美食汇》、SBS《直播今日》、MBC《全知干预视角》、SBS《Running Man》等海内外多家媒体节目。除此之外，餐厅自2012年至2026年，连续15年入选韩国权威美食榜单《蓝丝带美食指南》。

While European styles dominated the era, the café focused on reviving forgotten native elements. The space is filled with objects such as old mother-of-pearl cabinets, woodwork, and tiles, each carrying the memory of time. Located on the site of Hye Min Seo, where the historical physician Heo Jun cared for the people, the café offers a heartfelt cup of coffee and a piece of sweet comfort.

desc_l10n.ko: 전통과 현대가 어우러진 을지로 대표 카페

Located along Seosulla-gil, it provides a quiet, reflective space for visitors looking to pause and unwind. The menu features a variety of Korean-inspired desserts and drinks, each named to harmonize with the character of Seosulla-gil, enhancing the space's ambiance. One of Sasa’s highlights is its seasonal menu, which complements the changing scenery along Seosulla-gil, making each visit a refreshing experience. Housed in a beautiful hanok building, Sasa occasionally hosts pop-up stores, offering guests a chance to try new and creative beverages in a unique setting.

desc_l10n.ko: 서순라길에 위치한 한옥 카페

Built in 1956 beside a ginkgo tree that has long been a fixture of Sangsamaeul Village, this house was restored to its old appearance after 22 years and designated as a preserved house by Seoul Metropolitan Government. This single species ginkgo tree, which has endured for a long time and cannot survive alone, felt very similar to this hanok space that has protected this place for a long time, so the name of this space was chosen as Ginkgo Seoul after the scientific name of the ginkgo tree, ginkgo biloba. Ginkgo Seoul does not allow pets and is a no kids zone, allowing entry for those aged 12 and above.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} ギンコソウルは韓屋カフェで、1956年にサンサ村の主であるイチョウの隣に建てられました。この家は、2022年に昔の姿に復元され、ソウル市保存家屋に指定された韓屋です。長い時代を耐えてきた単一種であり、独りでは生き残れないこのイチョウが、まるで長い間この場所を守ってきた韓屋の空間とよく似ていると感じ、この空間の名前をイチョウの学名(ginkgo biloba)にちなんで「ギンコソウル」と名付けました。 ギンコソウルは、ペット同伴が不可であり、ノーキッズゾーンとして12歳以上の入場が可能です。
desc_l10n.ko: 서울시 보존가옥으로 지정된 한옥에서 힐링할 수 있는 카페
desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} GINKGO SEOUL是一家韩屋咖啡厅。这栋建筑始建于1956年，位于想思村的“守护神”——一棵银杏树旁，2022年对其原貌进行了恢复，现已被指定为‘首尔市保存家屋’。这棵历经漫长岁月、作为单一树种存活、无法独自繁衍的银杏树，与长久守护此处的韩屋空间极为相似，令人深感共鸣，因此空间名称便借鉴了银杏树的学名（ginkgo biloba），命名为GINKGO SEOUL。GINKGO SEOUL不可携带宠物入内，且谢绝儿童入内，仅限12岁以上客人入内。

description: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} Ginkgo Seoul is a hanok cafe. Built in 1956 beside a ginkgo tree that has long been a fixture of Sangsamaeul Village, this house was restored to its old appearance after 22 years and designated as a preserved house by Seoul Metropolitan Government. This single species ginkgo tree, which has endured for a long time and cannot survive alone, felt very similar to this hanok space that has protected this place for a long time, so the name of this space was chosen as Ginkgo Seoul after the scientific name of the ginkgo tree, ginkgo biloba. Ginkgo Seoul does not allow pets and is a no kids zone, allowing entry for those aged 12 and above.
name: Ginkgo Seoul

Its signature “Crispy Bulgogi” is grilled over charcoal using fresh beef from Majang-dong, offering a taste loved by all generations. The restaurant’s house-made “Yeokjeonju,” brewed in its own distillery, won the Grand Prize in the Takju Raw Makgeolli General Category at the 2021 Korea Liquor Awards. Frequented by loyal patrons and celebrities alike, it is also famous as the restaurant visited by Hollywood actor Tom Cruise during his stay in Korea.

desc_l10n.ko: 100년 가까이 전통을 이어온 바싹불고기집

Their signature item is the snowflake milk bingsu, but they offer various options, including snowflake strawberry bingsu and snowflake Oreo bingsu. Each bingsu is served in a single serving size, perfect for solo visits and groups wanting to sample different flavors. The red bean topping is served separately, allowing you to add it for a rich and sweet taste gradually. Except for Fridays and Saturdays, Bookhaebingsu stays open late into the night so that you can enjoy bingsu even during the late hours. In addition to bingsu, the café also offers coffee, various drinks, and desserts. Its spacious and pleasant antique atmosphere makes it an ideal place to cool off on a hot summer night.
desc_l10n.ja: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} 北海氷水は、シンダン洞に位置するカフェで、特に細かい粒子の雪花ピンス(かき氷)が有名です。代表メニューは雪花ミルクピンスで、その他にも雪花イチゴピンスや雪花オレオピンスなど、さまざまなかき氷が揃っています。かき氷はすべて1人前で提供されるため、一人で訪れるのにも、複数人でさまざまな味を試すのにもおすすめです。別添えの小豆を少しずつ加えて食べると、香ばしくて甘い味わいを楽しめます。 金曜日と土曜日を除き、深夜まで営業しているので、夜遅くでもかき氷を楽しむことができます。かき氷の他にも、コーヒーやさまざまな飲み物、デザートも販売しています。アンティークな雰囲気の広く快適な店内は、暑い夏の夜に訪れて涼むのにぴったりです。
desc_l10n.ko: 신당동의 눈꽃빙수 맛집, 북해빙수

In addition to a wine tunnel showcasing a wide variety of wines, MOWa provides a tranquil "empty" space for a minimalist vibe and a private, comfortable "full" space for a more intimate setting. Indulge in exquisite contemporary cuisine at MOWa that pleases your eyes and taste buds. The perfect spot for a special anniversary date in Myeongdong or for meetings and gatherings where privacy matters. desc_l10n.zh: .se-contents .se-scrollbox{overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none;}.se-contents .se-scrollbox::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image .se-caption{max-width: 100% !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video{max-width: 100%; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-image > *, .se-contents .se-responsive.se-video > *{max-width: 100%; min-width: 10px; height: auto !important;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper{position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: block;}.se-contents .se-responsive.se-video .se-video-wrapper > iframe{width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; position: absolute; left: 0px} MOWa包含了要创造对葡萄酒留下美好回忆的空间的抱负。 拥有多种葡萄酒的葡萄酒隧道和氛围低调的"空置"空间和私人、舒适的"填满空间"。 现在在MOWa享受一下让眼睛和嘴都开心的特别Contemprory Quizin吧。 明洞纪念日约会、注重您隐私的聚会、会议最佳场所 。 葡萄酒的回忆 还有. 用专属自己的理解和创意完成的红酒晚餐，MOWa。 [多姿多彩的味道变奏] 用熟悉的材料创造出了一种新颖而独特的味道组合。 在名为"MOWa"的当代美食店融合了韩餐的精髓，并进行了多样化的创新演绎，为顾客提供别具一格的混合美食体验。 在"萨博首尔"、"Gometry"、"Mingles"等知名餐厅积累经验的实力派"MUN WONGI"主厨将引领厨房。 [深度不同的红酒] 明洞酒家"MOWa"除了1000多种葡萄酒外，还提供30多种威士忌、鸡尾酒、非酒精鸡尾酒等多种选择。 是不同种类提升口感的最佳酒杯，进一步保留了葡萄酒及白酒的风味。 [艺术的空间和氛围] 这是一条长达50米的葡萄酒隧道，内藏超过1000种不同的葡萄酒品种，隧道内采用绿色照明，营造出一种微妙而迷人的氛围。 MOWa美食店的装修本身就是一种别具一格的艺术，营造出了独特的氛围。 由宽敞的桌子、精心划分的空间以及私密的房间共同构成，是庆祝纪念日、进行私密约会或举办重要会议、聚会的理想之选。
